projectDesc.p: A plain, archival TEI rendering of the text published on e-Mādhavanidāna (https://github.com/sushrutaproject/eMadhava), itself built from the digital edition named in the sourceDesc. The file is generated automatically from the site's chapter pages.

editorialDecl.p: The text is given in IAST as it appears on the web edition. Chapter and verse divisions follow the source edition. Each stretch of text ending in one of the source's verse or section numbers (e.g. ||12||) is encoded as seg[@type='unit'] with that number in @n; the number itself is retained in the text.

Root text and commentary follow the source's own division of every word into registers. Root-text blocks are ab[@type='mula']; commentary blocks are ab[@type='commentary'], with @subtype naming the commentary and @resp pointing to its author(s) in the titleStmt.

The foot-of-chapter notes (pāṭhāntarāḥ) of the source record variant readings from the printed edition. Notes are placed at their point of reference as note[@place='foot'][@type='variant'], with the source's note number in @n.
The work has no sthāna division; the 70 adhyāyas are direct children of body.
A note with no anchor in the text (it records a variant of the chapter title) is placed in the chapter head.
One passage in adhyāya 21 (Ātaṅkadarpaṇa) is untagged in the source and could not be transliterated; it is kept in the source's ASCII romanization as seg[@type='untransliterated'].

div.head: pañcanidānalakṣaṇam‘pañcalakṣaṇanidānam’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: pañcanidānalakṣaṇam | praṇamya jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārakāraṇam | svargāpavargayordvāraṃ trailokyaśaraṇaṃ śivam ||1||
śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ| śaśiruciraharārdhavyaktasaktārdhadeho diśatu ghanaghanābhaḥ padmanābhaḥ śriyaṃ vaḥ| tridaśasaridaśītadyotajāvārimadhyabhramibhavamiva nābhau vārijaṃ yasya reje||1||

bhaṭṭārajejjaṭagadādhara ‘...bāṣpacandra...’ iti pā.| vāpyacandraśrīcakrapāṇibakuleśvarasenabhojaiḥ| īśānakārtikasukīra ‘...sudhīśvaravīravaidyai...’ iti pā.| sudhīravaidyairmaitreyamādhavamukhairlikhitaṃ vicintya||2||
tantrāntarāṇyapi vilokya mamaiṣa yatnaḥ sadbhirvidheya iha doṣavidhau samādhiḥ| martyairasarvavidurairvihite kva nāma granthe'sti doṣavirahaḥ sucirantane'pi||3||
tattadgranthatarubhyo ‘...leśamākṛṣya’ iti pā.| vyākhyākusumarasaleśamāhṛtya| bhramareṇeva mayā'yaṃ vyākhyāmadhukośa ārabdhaḥ||4||
upayuktamihānuktaṃ nidānaṃ mādhavena yat| granthavyākhyāprasaṅgena mayā tadapi likhyate||5||

atha prathitasarvāyurvedabodhaviśuddhabuddhiḥ śrīmādhavakaro vikāranikarahetvāditattvabubhutsotsukacikitsakajanānujighṛkṣayā vidhitsitagranthasandarbhārambhe tatpratyūhavyūhavyapohahetuṃ paramāptācāraparamparāpariprāptaṃ sveṣṭadevatāpraṇāmaṃ prāk prāṇaiṣīt; ‘granthādhyetṝṇāmapi’ iti pā.| granthaśrotṝṇāmapi viśveśvaramaheśvarasya praṇāmānuvādamātrādapi ‘sarvavighnoparamaḥ’ iti pā.| vighnopaśamo bhavatītyabhiprāyeṇa taṃ granthādau nibaddhavān– praṇamyetyādi| atra praśabdo bhaktyatiśayakhyāpakaḥ| nibandhanakriyāpekṣayā praṇāmasya pūrvakālabhāvitvāt praṇameḥ ktvāpratyayaḥ| jagacchabdenotpattimantaḥ ‘pṛthivyādayo' ... ’ iti pā.| kṣityādayo'bhidhīyante; teṣāmutpattau svakāraṇasamavāye, sthitau katicitkālāvasthāne, saṃhāre pradhvaṃse, kāraṇaṃ kartāram| svargaḥ sukham, apavargo mokṣaḥ ātyantikaduḥkhanivṛttilakṣaṇaḥ, tayordvāramupāyaṃ pradhānakāraṇam| etena sakalapuruṣārthahetutvamuktaṃ, sukhāvāptiduḥkhahānivyatiriktasya puruṣārthasyābhāvāt| ata eva trailokyaśaraṇaṃ trailokyarakṣitāram| na coktajagatsthitikāraṇatvena paunaruktyaṃ, jagacchabdenotpattimatāmevābhidhānāt| atra tu trailokyaśabdo bhuvanatrayavarticetanācetanasamūhavācī, lokaśabdasya bhuvanajanayorabhidhāyakatvāt| tathā cāmaraḥ– “lokastu bhuvane jane” (a. ko. kā. 3 va. 3) iti| trailokyamiti svārthe ṣyañ; ‘catvāro varṇāścāturvarṇyam’ iti pā.| cāturvarṇyavat| harādiparyāyān parityajya śivapadanirdeśena granthasya tadadhyetṝṇāṃ ca sakalakalyāṇamabhilaṣan śivapadaṃ nibaddhavān; śivakāritvenaiva maheśvarasya śivapadābhidhānamiti||1||
tulasīkusumaṃ dadhattamālapratimaṃ ballavigopabālasaktam| kimapi tribhavaikamūlakandaṃ paramānandamahaṃ mahaḥ smarāmi||1||

śrīhammīranareśvaraḥ ‘samabhavadvīrapratāpānala ... ’ iti pā.| samabhavatprauḍhapratāpānala- jvālājālakarāladagdhapavanaprāgbhāraśuṣkendhanaḥ| yasya prauḍhasabhāṅgaṇeṣvapi yaśaḥsvarlokakallolinī- kallolāmalamaṅganāḥ sumanasāṃ gāyanti romāñcitāḥ||2||

pratyarthikṣitināthasārthavanitāvaidhavyadīkṣāguroḥ śauryaṃ yasya raṇāṅgaṇe suragaṇaiḥ paśyan surāṇāṃ patiḥ| labdhvā netrasahasrajaṃ phalamalaṃ smṛtvā nijābhyarthitaṃ rāmaṃ rāvaṇaghātinaṃ ca samabhūttuṣṭo vilakṣaḥ punaḥ||3||
tasyābhavadvaidyavaraḥ prabhūtaviśvāsapātraṃ viditaścaritraiḥ| pramodanāmā sakalapramodī kalāvilāsaikanidhirdvijendraḥ||4||
jyeṣṭho'bhavattasya sutaḥ praśastaśāstrārthavettā śivasaktacetāḥ| ‘sauśarmanāmā’ iti pā.| raiśarmanāmā prathitaḥ kalābhirmahanmadakṣoṇipateḥ sabhāyām||5||
anyaśca tasyāsti sutaḥ kanīyānvācaspatiḥ sattvaguṇaikasaṅgaḥ|| sahodaraprītatamaḥ samastā yo vaidyavidyāḥ svayamadhyajīgapat||6||
‘bhṛguvacana ... ’ iti pā.| guruvacanavicāraiścārucañcaccaritraścarakacaturacetāḥ suśrute suśruto yaḥ| kapilamatavayasye brahmavidyārahasye prakaṭitapaṭubuddhirbuddhakāṇādasiddhiḥ||7||
tenojjvalā vivṛtiralpadhiyāṃ hitāya sambaddhyate vibudhamādhavasaṅgrahasya| vijñāya tārkikavaraikavicāravedyaṃ vaiṣamyagumphanavaśānmadhukoṣabandham||8||

tatra granthārambhe prārabdhagranthaparisamāptyarthaṃ granthaśrotṝṇāmapi ‘pratyūhavyapohārtham’ iti pā.| pratyūhavyūhavyudāsārthaṃ śiṣṭācāraparipālanārthaṃ granthakāraḥ prāgviśiṣṭeṣṭadevatāpraṇāmaṃ nibaddhavān– praṇamyetyādi| yugmam| mayā rogaviniścayo grantho nibaddhyata iti sambandhaḥ| kiṃ kṛtvā? praṇamya| ‘atra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | atra prakarṣārthadyotakena praśabdena granthakṛdbhaktyatiśayaṃ khyāpayati| kaṃ? śivam| sakalabhuvanapatermaheśvarasya nāmabāhulye'pi tadadhyāpakādhyetṝṇāṃ kalyāṇamabhilaṣan granthakāraḥ śivapadaṃ nibaddhavān| kīdṛśaṃ śivaṃ? jagadutpattisthitisaṃhārakāraṇam| jagacchabdenotpattimantaḥ pṛthivyādayo'bhidhīyante; teṣāmutpattau svakāraṇasamavāye, sthitau katicitkālāvasthāne, saṃhāre saṃharaṇe, kāraṇaṃ hetum| punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ? svargāpavargayordvāraṃ; svargaḥ sukham, apavargo mokṣaḥ, ‘ubhayordvāram’ iti pā.| tayordvāram upāyaṃ pradhānakāraṇam| punaḥ kīdṛśaṃ? trailokyaśaraṇaṃ bhuvanatrayasya rakṣitāram||1||
nānāmunīnāṃ vacanairidānīṃ samāsataḥ sadbhiṣajāṃ niyogāt | sopadravāriṣṭanidānaliṅgo nibadhyate rogaviniścayo'yam ||2||
nānātantravihīnānāṃ bhiṣajāmalpamedhasām | sukhaṃ vijñātumātaṅkamayameva bhaviṣyati ||3||

abhidheyasambandhaprayojanopadeśamantareṇa prekṣāvatāṃ na pravṛttiḥ ‘syāt iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | syāt iti, atastadabhidhānārthaṃ ślokadvayamāha– nānetyādi| rogāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇa ‘vātādijatvasādhyāsādhyatvādirūpeṇa’ iti pā.| vātajatvādisādhyāsādhyatvādirūpeṇa niścayo jñānaṃ yena sa rogaviniścayo grantho nibadhyate'bhidhīyate, ‘asmābhiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| tasya viśeṣaṇam– sopadravetyādi| saha upadravādibhirvartate yaḥ sa tathā; ‘etenāsya viśeṣaṇadvārā’ iti pā.| etena viśeṣaṇadvāreṇa upadravāriṣṭanidānaliṅgasvarūpamabhidheyamuktaṃ bhavati, ‘etadvyatirekeṇāsya granthasya’ iti pā., ‘etadvyatirekeṇābhidheyābhāvāt’ iti ca pā.| etadvyatiriktasyābhidheyasyābhāvāt; tathā sati upadravādibhirabhidheyaiḥ saha granthasya vācyavācakalakṣaṇaḥ sambandho'yabhihitaḥ| tatra, upadravo rogārambhakadoṣaprakopajanyo'nyavikāraḥ, ‘uktaṃ ca carake– “vyādherupari yo vyādhirbhavatyuttarakālajaḥ| upakramāvirodhī ca sa upadrava ucyate||” iti;’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | uktaṃ ca carake– “vyādherupari yo vyādhirbhavatyuttarakālajaḥ| upakramāvirodhī ca sa upadrava ucyate||” iti; niyatamaraṇakhyāpakaṃ liṅgamariṣṭaṃ; nidānaṃ rogotpādako hetuḥ; liṅgaṃ rogakhyāpako hetuḥ| tena ‘liṅgyate jñāyate vyādhiranena’ iti pā.[ “liṅgyante jñāyante vyādhayo'nena” iti vyutpattyā pūrvarūparūpopaśayasamprāptayo'bhidhīyante| yadyapi nidānamapi rogaviśeṣaṃ bodhayati, tathā'pyutpattijñaptihetutvena kāraṇadvaividhyapratipādanārthaṃ tasya pṛthagabhidhānam| eṣāṃ copadravādīnāṃ vistarābhidhānaṃ yathāvasaraṃ kariṣyate| nanu, roganidānāditattvamatisūkṣmatvenāsarvajñasya ‘na jñānaviṣayaḥ’ iti pā.| jñānaviṣayaḥ, tat kathaṃ tadupadeśe prekṣāvatāṃ pravṛttirityata āha– nānāmunīnāmityādi| etena granthasya prāmāṇyaṃ pravṛttyaṅgatvamuktaṃ bhavati; munayo hi tapoyogardhibalāttraikālikanikhilajñānaśālinaḥ puruṣātiśayā ucyante| nanu, yadyevambhūtaḥ ‘kasyacidgrantho'pyanya āste’ iti pā.| kasyacidgrantho'nyo'pyāste, tenaiva vyavahārasiddheḥ kṛtakāryatvenāsya niṣprayojanatā syādityata āha– idānīmityādi| idānīmasmābhireva ‘prathamam’ iti pā.| prāthamyena nānāmunīnāṃ vacanairevaṃvidho nibandhaḥ kriyate| samāsata iti saṅkṣepataḥ| ‘etenālpabuddhīnāmativistaratvenāpravṛttidoṣaḥ’ iti pā.| etenālpabuddhīnāmativistaratvenāpravṛttyaṅgatādoṣaḥ parihṛto bhavati| nanu, kṛte'pi granthe'nupādeyapuruṣapraṇītatvena na kaścidbhiṣak pravartiṣyata iti granthasya vaiyarthyaṃ syādityata āha– sadbhiṣajāṃ niyogāditi| niyogo niyojanam “asmadupakārāya granthaḥ kriyatām” ityevaṃ prārthanetyarthaḥ; athavā niyoga ājñā, etenātmanaḥ savinayatvamuktaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| atra ‘nanu, nānāmunivacanabāhulyādalpamedhasāṃ kathaṃ pravṛttirityata āha-’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| nānātantretyādi| sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ātaṅkaṃ rogaṃ vijñātumayameva grantho bhaviṣyati, ‘kāraṇam’ iti śeṣaḥ| etena rogajñānaṃ prayojanamityuktaṃ, phalaṃ cāsya cikitsitamiti mantavyam yaduktaṃ carake– “rogamādau parīkṣeta tato'nantaramauṣadham| tataḥ karma bhiṣak paścājjñānapūrvaṃ samācaret||” iti (ca. sū. a. 20)| nanu, nānāmunīnāṃ vacanaireva rogajñānaṃ bhaviṣyati, kimanena tadupajīvinā granthenetyata āha– alpamedhasāmiti alpamedhasām alpabuddhīnām; mahābuddhayo hi ‘vistaraduradhigamanātantrādhyayanakṣamā’ iti pā.| ativistaraduradhigamanātantrādhyayanakṣamā bhavanti, na tvalpabuddhaya iti| mahādhiyāmapi ālasyānāsāditadurupapādāśeṣasaṃhitānāmayameva rogajñānāya bhaviṣyatītyāha– nānātantretyādi||2-3||

nānāmunīnāmityādi| ayaṃ rogaviniścayo grantho nibadhyate vidhīyate, rogāṇāṃ viniścayo jñānaṃ yasmātsa tathā| kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ? sopadravāriṣṭanidānaliṅgaḥ; sahopadravādibhirvartate kvacitpustake ‘iti sopadravaḥ’ etatsthāne ‘sa tathā’ iti pā.| iti sopadravaḥ, upadravo rogārambhakadoṣaprakopajanyo vikāraḥ| uktaṃ ca carake– “vyādherupari yo vyādhirbhavatyuttarakālajaḥ| upakramāvirodhī ca sa upadrava ucyate||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti; niyatamaraṇakhyāpakaṃ liṅgamariṣṭaṃ; nidānaṃ rogotpādako hetuḥ, niścīyate ‘pratigrāhyate’ iti pā.| pratipādyate vyādhiraneneti nidānaṃ; liṅgaṃ rogakhyāpako hetuḥ, tena liṅgyate jñāyate'neneti vyutpattyā pūrvarūparūpopaśayasamprāptayo vijñāyante iti| nanu, sarvajñajñānaviṣaye paramasūkṣmanidānāditattvajñāne'sarvajñapuruṣavākyaiḥ kathaṃ buddhimatāṃ pravṛttirityata āha– nānāmunīnāṃ ‘vacanaiḥ’ iti pā.| vacanairiti| yogardhibalāttraikālikajñānadarśī ‘puruṣātiśayānmunirucyate’ iti pā.| puruṣātiśayo munirucyate| idānīmiti– asmābhireva prādhānyena nānāmunīnāṃ vacanairevaṃvidho granthaḥ kriyate; anyairācāryairevaṃvidho grantho na kṛta ityarthaḥ| samāsata iti saṅkṣepāt| nanu, kṛte'pi granthe na kaścidbhiṣak pravartiṣyata iti granthasya vaiyarthyaṃ syādityata āha– sadbhiṣajāṃ ‘niyogāt’ iti pā.| niyogāditi| niyogo niyojanam, asmadupakārāya granthaḥ kriyatāmevambhūtā prārthanetyarthaḥ ‘granthasyāsyotkarṣamāha’ iti pā.| granthasyāsyotkṛṣṭatvamāha– nānetyādi| mahābuddhayo hi duradhigamatantrādhyayanakṣamā bhavanti, ato nānātantravihīnānāmalpabuddhīnāṃ bhiṣajāṃ sukhaṃ yathā bhavati tathā ātaṅkaṃ rogaṃ vijñātumayameva grantho ‘bhaviṣyati’ iti pā.| bhaviṣyatīti; ‘kāraṇam’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘uktaṃ ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | uktaṃ ca– “rogajñānārthamevādau yatnaḥ kāryo bhiṣagvaraiḥ| sati tasmin kriyārambhaḥ puṇyāya yaśase śriyai||” rogamādau parīkṣeta tato'nantaramauṣadham| tataḥ karma bhiṣak paścājjñānapūrvaṃ samācaret iti||2-3||

div.ab: nidānaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇyupaśayastathā | samprāptiśceti vijñānaṃ rogāṇāṃ pañcadhā smṛtam ||4|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg: vyādherjñātavyasya ‘pañcadhā’ iti pā.| pañca jñānopāyā bhavantīti tānāha– nidānamityādi| ete pañca vyastāḥ samastāśca vyādhibodhakāḥ| na ca samastapakṣe kṛtakaraṇatvaṃ vācyaṃ, pramāṇasamplavasyāpi dṛṣṭatvāditi yataḥ pramātuḥ pramātavye'rthe pramāṇānāṃ pratyakṣānumānopamānaśabdānāṃ samplavaḥ samūho dṛṣṭaḥ, ataḥ samastapakṣe kṛtakaraṇatvaṃ na ca vācyam| pramāṇasamplavasyāpi dṛṣṭatvāt| ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | anumitavahnau pratyakṣopamānaśabdānāmapi sthitisattvāt) na yo anumānena pratīto yo vahniḥ sa kiṃ pratyakṣāgamābhyāṃ nopalabhyate? nahi, api tūpalabhyata eva| hyanumānena pratīto vahniḥ sa eva pratyakṣāgamābhyāṃ nopalabhyate [ ‘na ca nidānādīni prekṣāvanti, yenaivamālocayeyurekenaiva pratipāditamiti, vayamihodāsmahe iti’ iti pā., ‘athavā ye prekṣāvantaste nidānādīni na evam ālocayeyuḥ? na, apitu santi nidānādīni ālocayeyureva|’ iti ca pā.| na vā nidānādīni prekṣāvanto ye naivamālocayeyuḥ; ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kintu ye prekṣāvante nidānādīni syurityeva vetsyanti) ‘atisārādīnāṃ madhye kenacidekenaiva pratipādito vyādhiriti mataṃ vayamihodāsmahe na śraddadhmahe’ iti pā.| ekenaiva pratipādito vyādhiriti vayamihodāsmahe ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | na manyāmahe)| kiñca, ‘ekenā'pi pratipādite’ iti pā.| ekena pratipādite'pi vyādhāvapare'vaśyamabhidhātavyāḥ, bhinnaprayojanatvāt| tathāhi– yadi nidānaṃ nocyate tadā tatparivarjanaṃ kathaṃ labhyate? uktaṃ hi suśrute– “ ‘vātādīnāṃ pratīkāraḥ prokto vistarataḥ punaḥ|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vātādīnāṃ pratīkāraḥ prokto vistarataḥ punaḥ| saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam||” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 1)| kiñca, yathā– mṛdbhakṣaṇāt pāṇḍurogaḥ, makṣikābhakṣaṇācca chardiravasīyate; na ‘ca’ iti pā.| tu tathā nidānena sarvatra niyatarogādhyavasāyaḥ, ‘jaṭharagulmādīnāmekakāraṇatvāt’ iti pā.| jvaragulmādīnāmekakāraṇatvāt| yadāha carakaḥ– “eko heturanekasya tathaikasyaika eva hi| vyādherekasya ‘cāneko bahūnāṃ bahavo'pi ca’ iti carake pāṭhaḥ| bahavo bahūnāṃ bahavastathā||” iti (ca. ni. a. 8)| api ca kadācit pratyāsannaṃ nidānaṃ bādhitvā viprakṛṣṭanidānakṛto doṣasañcayo vyādhiṃ kuryāt, tasmāt ‘kevalānnidānādapi na’ iti pā.| kevalānnidānānna vyādhijñānaṃ bhavatīti pūrvarūpādīnāmupādānamiti ‘bāṣpacandraḥ’ iti pā.| vāpyacandraḥ| asati pūrvarūpābhidhāne tatroktaḥ kriyāviśeṣo na saṅgacchate| uktaṃ hi carake– “ ‘tatra pūrvarūpadarśane jvarādau vā hitaṃ laghvaśanamapatarpaṇaṃ vā’ iti carake pāṭhaḥ| jvarasya pūrvarūpe laghvaśanamapatarpaṇaṃ vā||” iti (ca. ni. a. 1)| tathā ca suśrute– “jvarasya pūrvarūpeṣu vartamāneṣu buddhimān| pāyayeta ghṛtaṃ svacchaṃ tataḥ sa labhate sukham||” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) suśrute pāṭhaḥ| vātikajvarapūrvarūpe ghṛtapānamiti| tathā'sādhyatvaṃ ca nopalabhyeta| uktaṃ ca carake– “pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvaroktānyatimātrayā| yaṃ viśanti viśatyenaṃ mṛtyurjvarapuraḥsaraḥ|| anyasyāpi ca rogasya pūrvarūpāṇi yaṃ naram| viśantyanena kalpena tasyāpi maraṇaṃ dhruvam||” (ca. i. a. 5) iti| tathā raktapittapramehayorviśeṣajñānaṃ ca na jāyate| uktaṃ ca carake– “hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya hi pūrvarūpaiḥ| yo mūtrayettaṃ na vadet pramehaṃ raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaḥ||” iti (ca. ci. a. 6)| asati rūpābhidhāne ‘vyādheraśeṣaviśeṣeṇa’ iti pā.| vyādheraśeṣeṇa svarūpameva na vyavacchidyate; kiṃ ca sādhyāsādhyatvaṃ ca na jñāyate| tathā hi sukhasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “hetavaḥ pūrvarūpāṇi rūpāṇyalpāni yasya vai| na ca tulyaguṇo dūṣyo na doṣaḥ prakṛtirbhavet||” iti (ca. sū. a. 10); kaṣṭasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “nimittapūrvarūpāṇāṃ rūpāṇāṃ madhyame bale|” (ca. sū. a. 10) iti; tathā– “sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ| sannipātajvaro'sādhyaḥ” (ca. sū. a. 3) iti| asatyupaśayābhidhāne saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇe'nabhivyaktaklaṣaṇe vā vyādhau viśeṣabodho na syāt| taduktaṃ carake– “gūḍhaliṅgaṃ vyādhimupaśayānupaśayābhyāṃ” (parīkṣeta) (ca. vi. a. 4) iti| asatyāṃ ca samprāptau pūrvarūpādipratītasyāpi vyādheścikitsopayoginoṃ'śāṃśavikalpanābalakālāderapratīteścikitsāviśeṣo na syāt| tasmāt pañcāpi nidānādayo vaktavyāḥ| pañcavidhamapyetadvyādhyutpattijñaptihetubhūtaṃ nidānaśabdenocyate| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “hetulakṣaṇanirdeśānnidānāni” (su. sū. a. 3) iti| tatraivaṃ ‘nidānaśabdaniruktiruktā’ iti pā.| nidānaśabdaniruktiḥ– “nirdiśyate vyādhiraneneti nidānaṃ”; “diśeḥ pṛṣodarāditvādrūpasiddhiḥ|” iti gadādharaḥ; “niścitya dīyate pratipādyate vyādhiraneneti nidānam||” iti jejjaṭaḥ| bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇāpi ‘tantrayuktyā nidānādivivaraṇaprastāve’ iti pā.| tantrayuktyādivivaraṇaprastāve eṣaiva niruktiruktā| niśabdo niścaye| tathā ca vararucerupasargasūtram– “ni niścayaniṣedhayoḥ” iti| loke'pi ‘adya te nidānaṃ kariṣyāmi’ ityukte niścayaṃ ‘ ... pratīyate’ iti pā.| kariṣyāmītyavagamyate| nidānamiti karaṇe lyuṭ; tena ‘vyādhiniścayakaraṇaṃ nidānam’ iti nidānādipañcakasāmānyalakṣaṇam| nidānaśabdo'yaṃ ‘nidānaviśeṣajātau’ iti pā.| nidānaviśeṣe jātau ca vartate; yathā– tṛṇaśabdaḥ tṛṇaviśeṣe tṛṇajātau ca vartate| yattu, ‘bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇāpi’ iti pā.| bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇa nidānasthāne– “yā gauḥ sudohā bhavati na tāṃ ‘nidīyeta’ iti pā., ‘ninanadīta’ iti ca pā.| nidadīta|” iti vyāsaprayogamupanyasya nibandhārtho nidānaśabdo vyākhyātaḥ ‘nidīyate nibadhyate ‘hetvādisambandho’ iti pā.| hetvādisambaddho vyādhiranena’ iti kṛtvā; tattu nidānasthānarūpagranthābhiprāyeṇa, nahi hetvādayo ‘hetvādisambandham’ iti pā.| hetvādisambaddhaṃ vyādhiṃ pratipādayanti svātmani kriyāvirodhādityarthaḥ|||4||

tasya ca vyādherjñātavyasya pañca jñānopāyā bhavanti tānāha– ‘nidānamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānamityādi| nidānaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ rūpamupaśayaḥ samprāptiścaite pañca vyastāḥ samastāśca vyādhibodhakāḥ| rogāṇāṃ vijñānaṃ viśiṣṭajñānaṃ, pañcadhā pañcaprakāreṇa, smṛtaṃ kathitaṃ, ‘munīndraiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘yathā nidānapūrvarūparūpāṇi rogāṇāṃ vijñānāya tathopaśayo'pīti’ iti pā.| upaśayastatheti ‘tulyakṛtyatām’ iti pā.| tathāśabdastulyakṛtyatāṃ dyotayati, evaṃ samprāptiścetyatra cakāro'pi| iti parisamāptau| ‘rogāṇām’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | rogāṇāṃ tacca nidānaṃ sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭabhedena dvidhā bhavati| sannikṛṣṭaṃ yathā– vātādayaḥ kupitāḥ jvarādirogamutpādayanti| viprakṛṣṭaṃ yathā– hemante nicitaḥ śleṣmā vasante ca prakupyati; tathā''hārādirapi, tatra kaṭukāmladadhyādikaṃ pittajvarasya| pūrvarūpaṃ yathā– jvarasyaivālasyādayaḥ| rūpaṃ yathā– svedāvarodha ityādi; “ ‘ āgamāpagamakṣobhakāṭhinyamṛdutā vedanoṣmaṇām’ iti pā.| āgamāpagamakṣobhakāṭhinyamṛdutoṣmaṇām| vaiṣamyaṃ tatra tatrāṅge tāstāḥ syurvedanāścalāt||” ityādi ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca| upaśayo yathā– vātaḥ snehanamardanādinopaśānta upalabhyate sa ‘upaśaya’ ityucyate| samprāptiryathā-yathā duṣṭenetyādilakṣaṇāt| nanvekenaiva kvacitpustake ‘roganiścaye'nyeṣāmupādānaṃ vyartham? ucyate-’ etatsthāne ‘roganiścaye'nyeṣāmupādānavaiyarthyaṃ vaktavyam’ iti pā.| roganiścaye'nyeṣāmupādānaṃ vyartham? ucyate– bhinnaprayojanatvāt nānyataravaiyarthyam| tacca yathā– nidānenādhigatasya vyādhestatparivarjanam; uktaṃ ca suśrute– “saṅkṣepataḥ kriyāyogo nidānaparivarjanam|” iti| kvacitpustake ‘pūrvarūpeṇa vyādherviśeṣajñānaṃ jāyate| yathā carake– “hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya ca pūrvarūpaiḥ| yo mūtrayettaṃ na vadetpramehaṃ raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaḥ||” iti; tathā'dhigatasya vyādhestatroktakriyākramaśca lakṣyate; ukte ca carake’ etatsthāne ‘pūrvarūpeṇādhigatasya vyādhestatroktakriyākramo lakṣyate; uktaṃ ca carake’ iti pā.| pūrvarūpeṇa vyādherviśeṣajñānaṃ jāyate| yathā carake– “hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya ca pūrvarūpaiḥ| yo mūtrayettaṃ na vadetpramehaṃ raktasya pittasya hi sa prakopaḥ||” iti; tathā'dhigatasya vyādhestatroktakriyākramaśca lakṣyate; ukte ca carake– “jvarasya pūrvarūpe laghvaśanamapatarpaṇaṃ ‘ca’ iti pā.| vā|” iti; tathā ca suśrute– “vātikajvarapūrvarūpe ghṛtapānam|” iti| tathā ca sādhyāsādhyatvamapi jñāyate| uktaṃ ca carake– “pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvaroktānyatimātrayā| yaṃ viśanti viśatyenaṃ mṛtyurjvarapuraḥsaraḥ|| anyasyāpi ca rogasya pūrvarūpāṇi yaṃ naram| viśantyanena kalpena tasyāpi maraṇaṃ dhruvam||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| rūpeṇāpi ca vyādheḥ sukhasādhyatvaṃ kaṣṭasādhyatvamasādhyatvaṃ ca jñāyate; yato'lparūpaḥ sukhasādhyo vyādhiḥ, madhyarūpaḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ, sampūrṇarūpastvasādhya iti| tathā ca sukhasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “hetavaḥ pūrvarūpāṇi ‘sūkṣmāṇyalpāni’ iti pā.| rūpāṇyalpāni yasya ca| na ca tulyaguṇo dūṣyo na doṣaḥ prakṛtirbhavet||” iti; kaṣṭasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “ ‘nimittaṃ pūrvarūpāṇi’ iti pā.| nimittapūrvarūpāṇāṃ rūpāṇāṃ madhyame bale|” iti; ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā “ ‘sampūrṇarūpaḥ’ iti pā.| sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ sannipātajvaro'sādhyaḥ|” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| upaśayena vinā pratītasya vyādheḥ saṅkīrṇalakṣaṇe'nabhivyaktalakṣaṇe vā vyādhau viśeṣāvabodho na syāt, uktaṃ hi carake– “gūḍhaliṅgaṃ vyādhimupaśayānupaśayābhyāṃ buddhyeta|” iti| tathā ca suśrute– “ ‘abhyaṅgasnehasvedādyairvātadoṣo’ iti pā.| abhyaṅgasnehasvedādyairvātarogo na śāmyati| vikārastatra vijñeyo duṣṭamatrāsti śoṇitam||” iti| śoṇitasekastatropaśama iti| asatyāṃ ca samprāptau pūrvarūpādibhiḥ pratītasyāpi vyādheścikitsitopayogyāṃśāṃśavikalpabalakālādīnāmajñāne cikitsāviśeṣo na syāt, tasmānnidānādipañcakavijñānena sarve rogā viśeṣeṇāvabudhyanta iti||4||

div.ab: nimittahetvāyatanapratyayotthānakāraṇaiḥ | nidānamāhuḥ paryāyaiḥ... |5| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

eṣāṃ nidānādīnāṃ madhye samānāsamānajātīyavyāvartakaṃ ‘nidānalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| kāraṇarūpanidānasya lakṣaṇamāha– nimittetyādinā paryāyairityantena| etaiḥ śabdairyo'rtho'bhidhīyate tannidānaṃ; yathā– “buddhirupalabdhirjñānamityanarthāntaram|” (nyā. da. pra. ā. sū. 15) ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| nanu, kiṃ militairekaikaśo vā? nādyaḥ, ekārthābhidhāyināṃ śabdānāṃ militānāmaprayogāt; dvitīyaścettadā savyabhicāraḥ; nimittasya śakunādau, hetoḥ ‘dhūmavatvādityādivacane’ iti pā.| prayojake kartari, āyatanasya sthāne, pratyayasya laḍādau, utthānasya ‘udgamanotsavayoḥ’ iti pā., ‘udgamanotsargayoḥ’ iti ca pā.| udgamanotsargayośca darśanāt| naivaṃ, śakunādīnāṃ nimittādibhiḥ sarvairanabhidhānāt| ata evāha– paryāyairiti| nahi teṣāṃ te paryāyāḥ, yataḥ krameṇaikārthavācakāḥ śabdāḥ parasparaṃ paryāyā ucyante| tasmānnimittādiśabdaiḥ ‘paryāyeṇa’ iti pā.| paryāyairabhidhīyamānatvaṃ nidānatvam| etacca paryāyakathanaṃ śāstre vyavahārārtham| idaṃ tu saṅkṣepato lakṣaṇam– “setikartavyatāko rogotpādakaheturnidānam|” iti| yanmate doṣetikartavyatārūpā samprāptiriṣyate tanmate samprāptivyudāsārthaṃ ‘setikartavyatāka’ iti padaṃ, tasyā ‘tasyāṃ doṣetikartavyatārūpāyām’ iti pā.| itikartavyatāntarābhāvāditi itikartavyatā vyāpāraḥ, itikartavyatāntarasya vyāpārāntarasyābhāvāt, vyāpāre vyāpārāntaraṃ na tiṣṭhatīti bhāvaḥ| doṣetikartavyatārūpāyā itikartavyatāntarābhāvāt| yanmate vyādhijanma samprāptiḥ, tanmate ‘vyādhyutpattiheturnidānam’ iti lakṣaṇam| ubhayatrāpi ‘utpatti’ ‘etat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | etatpadaṃ jñaptihetupūrvarūpādivyavacchedārtham| sa ca heturanekadhā; tatra ‘prathamaṃ caturvidhaḥ’ iti pā.| prathamaścaturvidhaḥ, yadāha upakalpanīyādhyāye haricandraḥ– “sannikṛṣṭaviprakṛṣṭavyabhicāriprādhānikabhedāccaturdhā|” iti| sannikṛṣṭo yathā– naktandinartubhuktāṃśā doṣaprakopasya hetavaḥ, na te cayādikamapekṣante| viprakṛṣṭo yathā– “hemante nicitaḥ śleṣmā vasante kapharogakṛt|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 64); ‘kiñca’ iti ca pā.| kiṃvā sannikṛṣṭo jvarasya rūkṣādisevā, viprakṛṣṭo rudrakopaḥ| vyabhicārī yathā– yo durbalatvādvyādhyadhikaraṇāsamarthaḥ| yadāha carakaḥ– “( ‘doṣā abalīyāṃso yadā vā'nubadhyante na tadā'vaśyaṃ vikārābhinirvṛttirbhavatīti’ iti pā.| nidānādiviśeṣā) abalīyāṃso'thavā'nubandhnanti, na tadā vikārābhinirvṛtiḥ|” iti (ca. ni. a. 4)| prādhāniko yathā– viṣādiḥ; trividho vā, asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaprajñāparādhapariṇāmabhedāt| tatra, asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogo'yogātiyogamithyāyogayuktā rūparasādayaḥ, prajñāparādho mithyājñānādiḥ, pariṇāmo'yogādiyuktā ṛtusvabhāvajāḥ śītādayaḥ| “adharmasya ca rogahetoratraivāntarbhāvaḥ” iti bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ, tasyāpi kālāntarapariṇatasya duḥkhakartṛtvāt| cakrastu prajñāparādhe tasyāntarbhāvamāha; mithyājñānakṛtabrahmavadhādijanmano'dharmasya prajñāparādha eva mūlaṃ; ‘balābalatvaṃ tatra’ iti pā., ‘balābalatvamatra ca’ iti ca pā.| balābalaṃ tvatra na nirūpyate, rogakāraṇatvenādharmasya sarvathā siddhatvāditi| doṣavyādhyubhayahetubhedācca ‘sa’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sa trividhaḥ| doṣahetavo yathā– cayaprakopapraśamanimittā yathartūtpannā madhurādayaḥ| vyādhihetavo yathā– mṛdbhakṣaṇaṃ pāṇḍurogasya kāraṇam| yadyapi mṛdapi doṣaṃ prakopayatyeva; yaduktaṃ carake– “kaṣāyā mārutaṃ, pittamūṣarā, madhurā kapham|” iti (ca. ci. a. 16) tathā'pi tajjairdoṣaiḥ pāṇḍuroga evārabhyate na tvanyo vikāra iti vyādhihetutā bhavati| ubhayaheturyathā vātarakte– “hastyaśvoṣṭrairgacchataścāśnataśca” (su. ni. a. 1) ityādi| ‘atra’ iti pā.| tatra yadyapi ‘doṣaprakopapūrvakam’ iti pā.| doṣaprakopapūrvakameva vyādhijananaṃ, tathā'pi doṣavadvyādhāvapi tasya kāraṇatvamiti bodhayati| tena tatra ‘na’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | na vyādhiharamātraṃ bheṣajaṃ prayojyaṃ, kintūbhayapratyanīkam| na ca vācyaṃ kāraṇabhūtadoṣanivṛttyaiva ‘kāryasya’ iti pā.| kāryabhūtasya vyādhernivṛttiriti; yataḥ pratiniyataśaktikāni bheṣajadravyāṇi bhavanti; kathamanyathā ślaiṣmikatimire ‘śleṣmaharaṇam’ iti pā.| śleṣmaharameva vamanaṃ na prayujyate| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “na vāmayettaimirikaṃ na gulminaṃ na cāpi ‘pāṇḍurogiṇam’ iti pā.| pāṇḍūdararogapīḍitam|” (su. ci. a. 33) iti| sa evotpādakavyañjakabhedācca dvidhā| tatrotpādako yathā– hemantajo madhurarasaḥ kaphasya| vyañjako yathā– tasyaiva ‘kaphacayasya’ iti pā.| kaphasya vyañjako vasante sūryasantāpaḥ iti bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ| tatra vyañjakaḥ ‘abhivyaktikārakaḥ’ iti pā.| preraka ityarthaḥ| bāhyābhyantarabhedācca dvidhā| tatra bāhyā āhārācārakālādayaḥ| etadabhiprāyeṇa ‘trijaṭācāryaḥ’ iti pā.| tīsaṭācāryaḥ– “vyāyāmādapatarpaṇāt prapatanādbhaṅgāt kṣayājjāgarādvegānāṃ ca vidhāraṇādatiśucaḥ śaityādatitrāsataḥ| rūkṣakṣobhakaṣāyatiktakaṭukairebhiḥ prakopaṃ vrajedvāyurvāridharāgame pariṇate cānne'parāhṇe'pi ca|| kaṭvamloṣṇavidāhitīkṣṇalavaṇakrodhopavāsātapastrīsamparkatilātasīdadhi-surāśuktāranālādibhiḥ| bhukte jīryati bhojane ca śaradi grīṣme sati prāṇināṃ madhyāhne ca tathā'rdharātrisamaye pittaṃ prakopaṃ vrajet|| gurumadhurarasātisnigdhadugdhekṣubhakṣyadravadadhidinanidrāpūpasarpiṣprapūraiḥ| tuhinapatanakāle śleṣmaṇaḥ samprakopaḥ prabhavati divasādau bhuktamātre vasante||” (ca. ka. a. 29-31) iti| ābhyantarā ‘yathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā– doṣā dūṣyāśca| tatra doṣo'pi prakupitaḥ prākṛtādibhedādanekadhā| prākṛto yathā– vasante śleṣmā, śaradi pittaṃ, ‘varṣāsu’ iti pā.| prāvṛṣi vāyuḥ| vaikṛtastu yathā– vasante pittaṃ vāyurvā, varṣāsu kaphaḥ pittaṃ vā, śaradi kapho vāyurvā| asya prayojanaṃ sukhasādhyatvādi| yaduktaṃ carake– “prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhyastu vasantaśaradudbhavaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 3) ityādi| anubandhyānubandhabhedācca dvidhā| anubandhyaḥ pradhānam, anubandho'pradhānam| yadāha carakaḥ– “svatantro vyaktaliṅgo yathoktasamutthānopaśamo bhavatyanubandhyaḥ, tadviparītalakṣaṇastvanubandhaḥ|” (ca. vi. a. 6) iti| asya prayojanaṃ saṃsargaje vyādhāvanubandhyo viśeṣeṇa cikitsyo'nubandhāvirodhena| ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| taduktaṃ carake– “tatropadravasya prāyaḥ pradhānapraśamāt praśamaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti| upadravo'nubandhaḥ| prakṛtivikṛtito yathā– vātaprakṛtervātarogaḥ kaṣṭasādhyo bhavati, ‘kaphaprakṛtestu’ iti pā.| kaphapittaprakṛtestu sukhasādhyaḥ| yadāha sukhasādhyalakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “na ca tulyaguṇo dūṣyo na doṣaḥ prakṛtirbhavet” (ca. sū. a. 10) iti| āśayāpakarṣato yathā– yadā ‘sthānasthitameva’ iti pā.| svamānasthitameva doṣaṃ svāśayādākṛṣya vāyuḥ sthānāntaraṃ gamayati tadā ‘samānastho'pi’ iti pā.| svamānastho'pi sa vikāraṃ janayati| yadāha carakaḥ– “prakṛtisthaṃ yadā pittaṃ mārutaḥ śleṣmaṇaḥ kṣaye| sthānādādāya gātreṣu yatra yatra ‘prasarpati’ iti pā.| visarpati|| tadā ‘todaśca’ iti pā.| bhedaśca dāhaśca tatra tatrānavasthitaḥ| gātradeśe bhavatyasya śramo daurbalyameva ca||” iti (ca. sū. a. 17)| asya prayojanaṃ vātasyaiva tatra viguṇasya svasthānānayanaṃ kāryaṃ, ‘natu pittasya hrāsanena svāśayāpakarṣaṇam’ iti pā.| natu pittasya hrāsanaṃ; “ye tvenāṃ pittasya sthānākṛṣṭiṃ na vidanti, te dāhopalambhena pittavṛddhiṃ manyamānāḥ pittaṃ hrāsayantaḥ pittakṣayalakṣaṇaṃ rogāntaramevotpādayanta āturamatipātayanti|” iti bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ| anye tvāhuḥ– bhrājakādibhedena sarvadehasthite pitte yadā svāśayākṛṣṭaṃ pittamavayavāntaramanilena prāpitaṃ tadā tadavayavāntarasthaṃ pittamāgantupittasambandhenādhikameva jātaṃ, tataśca pittavṛddhilakṣaṇaiveyaṃ duṣṭirna duṣṭyantaram, anyathā dāha eva na syāt nahi ‘samānastho’ iti pā.| svamānastho doṣo vikāraṃ janayatīti| bhaṭṭāraharicandrasya tvayamabhiprāyaḥ– yadyapyevaṃ tathā'pi cikitsābhedārthaṃ vṛddhikṣayavyatiriktasthānāntaragatirūpo duṣṭiviśeṣo'vaśyameveṣṭavyaḥ, anyathā vṛddhaṃ pittamiti matvā virecanaṃ pittahrāsanaṃ vā kāryaṃ, naca tattatra yogyaṃ, kiṃ tu svasthānānayanam| yaccoktaṃ carakeṇa– “kṣayaḥ sthānaṃ ca vṛddhiśca ‘doṣāṇām’ iti pā.| vijñeyā trividhā gatiḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 17) ityādi, tat prāyikamiti| gatito yathā– gatirdoṣāṇāṃ kṣīṇavṛddhatvādayaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake “kṣayaḥ sthānaṃ ca vṛddhiśca doṣāṇāṃ trividhā gatiḥ| ūrdhvaṃ cādhaśca tiryakca vijñeyā trividhā parā|| trividhā cāparā koṣṭhaśākhāmarmāsthisandhiṣu|” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti|| atra sthānamiti samatvam| tatra kṣayādilakṣaṇaṃ yathā– “doṣāḥ pravṛddhāḥ svaṃ liṅgaṃ darśayanti yathābalam| kṣīṇā jahati svaṃ liṅgaṃ, samāḥ svaṃ karma kurvate||” (ca. sū. a. 17)– iti| svaṃ liṅgamiti kupitasya vāyo raukṣyādayo dharmāḥ, karmāṇi ca sraṃsaśūlādīni| yadāha carakapāṭhasaṃvādī ‘sudattasenaḥ’ iti pā.| sudāntasenaḥ– “ādhmānastambharaukṣyasphuṭanavimathanakṣobhakampapratodāḥ, kaṇṭhadhvaṃsāvasādau ‘takramavilapanam’ iti pā.| śramakavilapanaṃ sraṃsaśūlaprabhedāḥ| pāruṣyaṃ karṇanādo ‘viṣayapariṇatibhraṃśadṛṣṭipramohā’ iti pā.| viṣamapariṇatibhraṃśadṛṣṭipramohā, ‘vispandācchādanāni’ iti pā.| vispandodghaṭṭanāni glapanamaśayanaṃ tāḍanaṃ pīḍanaṃ ca|| ‘nāmonmānau’ iti pā.| nāmonnāmau viṣādo ‘bhramaparisadanam’ iti pā.| bhramaparipatanaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ romaharṣo, vikṣepākṣepaśoṣagrahaṇaśuṣiratācchedanaṃ veṣṭanaṃ ca| varṇaḥ śyāvo'ruṇo vā tṛḍapi ca mahatī svāpaviśleṣasaṅgā, vidyāt karmāṇyamūni prakupitamarutaḥ syāt kaṣāyo rasaśca|| visphoṭāmlakadhūmakāḥ pralapanaṃ svedasrutirmūrchanaṃ, daurgandhyaṃ daraṇaṃ mado ‘viśaraṇam’ iti pā.| visaraṇaṃ pāko'ratistṛḍbhramau| ūṣmā'tṛptitamaḥ praveśadahanaṃ kaṭvamlatiktā rasā, varṇaḥ pāṇḍuvivarjitaḥ kvathitatā karmāṇi pittasya vai|| tṛptistandrā gurutā staimityaṃ kaṭhinatā malādhikyam| snehāpaktyupalepāḥ śaityaṃ kaṇḍūḥ prasekaśca|| carakartṛtvaṃ śotho nidrādhikyaṃ rasau paṭusvādū| varṇaḥ śveto'lasatā karmāṇi kaphasya jānīyāt|| dvidoṣaliṅgaḥ saṃsargaḥ sannipātastriliṅgakaḥ|” iti| liṅgajñānaprayojanaṃ ca cikitsābhedārtham| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “kṣīṇā vardhayitavyāḥ, vṛddhā hrāsayitavyāḥ, samāḥ pālayitavyāḥ” (su. ci. a. 33)– iti| ūrdhvādigatiryathā– ūrdhvagaṃ raktapittamityādi| asya prayojanaṃ raktapittasyordhvagasya virecanam, adhogasya vamanam| yathoktaṃ carake– “ ‘pratilomam’ iti pā.| pratimārgaṃ ca haraṇaṃ raktapitte vidhīyate|” (ca. ni. a. 2) iti| yastu gatibhedānabhijñaḥ saḥ “virekaḥ pittaharāṇāṃ” (ca. sū. a. 25) iti vacanādadhoge raktapitte virekaṃ prayuñjāna āturasyānarthamevotpādayati; jvarādiṣu tiryagdoṣagatiṣu yathoktaṃ cikitsitamiti| vṛddhā doṣāḥ kadācit koṣṭhaṃ, kadācicchākhāḥ, kadācinmarmāsthisandhīnāśritya rujanti; marmāsthisandhiṣu gatiḥ kṛcchrasādhyatvopādakatvādekatvena nirdiṣṭā| koṣṭha āmāśayādiḥ, śākhā raktādayo dhātavastvakceti, ‘carakakṛtaivaitā’ iti pā.| carakakṛtaiveyaṃ sañjñā| koṣṭhādyabhidhānaprayojanaṃ cikitsābhedārtham| yathoktaṃ carake– “āmāśayagate vāte kaphe pakvāśayāśrite| rūkṣapūrvo hitaḥ svedaḥ snehapūrvastathaiva ca||” (ca. sū. a. 14); tathā– “santataṃ rasaraktasthaḥ so'nyedyuḥ piśitāśritaḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ityādi; tathā– “nāgnikarmopadeṣṭavyaṃ snāyumarmavraṇeṣu ca|” (ca. ci. a. 25) iti| ete ca doṣāḥ sāmatvanirāmatvābhyāmapi jñātavyāḥ| yaduktam– “ūṣmaṇo'lpabalatvena dhātumādyamapācitam| duṣṭamāmāśayagataṃ rasamāmaṃ pracakṣate|| āmena tena saṃyuktā doṣā dūṣyāśca dūṣitāḥ| sāmā ityupadiśyante ye ca rogāstadudbhavāḥ|| srotorodhabalabhraṃśagauravānilamūḍhatāḥ| ālasyāpaktiniṣṭhīvamalabhedāruciklamāḥ|| liṅgaṃ malānāṃ sāmānāṃ nirāmāṇāṃ viparyayaḥ|” (vā. sū. a. 13)| “vāyuḥ sāmo vibandhāgnisādatandrāntrakūjanaiḥ|| vedanāśothanistodaiḥ kramaśo'ṅgāni pīḍayet| vicaredyugapaccāpi gṛhṇāti kupito bhṛśam| snehādyairvṛddhimāpnoti sūryameghodaye niśi| nirāmo viśado rūkṣo nirvibandho'lpavedanaḥ|| viparītaguṇaiḥ śāntiṃ snigdhairyāti viśeṣataḥ| durgandhaṃ haritaṃ śyāvaṃ pittamamlaṃ sthiraṃ guru|| amlikākaṇṭhahṛddāhakaraṃ sāmaṃ vinirdiśet| ātāmraṃ pittamatyuṣṇaṃ rase kaṭukamasthiram|| pakvaṃ vigandhaṃ vijñeyaṃ rucipaktṛbalapradam| āvilastantulaḥ styānaḥ kaṇṭhadeśe'vatiṣṭhate| sāmo balāso durgandhaḥ kṣududgāravighātakṛt|| phenavān piṇḍitaḥ pāṇḍurniḥsāro'gandha eva ca| pakvaḥ sa eva vijñeyaśchedavān vaktraśuddhikṛt||” iti| asya prayojanaṃ sāme pācanaṃ, nirāme śamanamiti| ete ca doṣāḥ ‘parasparasambaddhāstāratamyādibhedena’ iti pā.| parasparasambaddhāstaratamādibhedena dviṣaṣṭidhā bhavanti| tadudāharaṇāni vistaratvāpatteratra na likhyante, sauśrutadoṣabhedavikalpādhyāye (su. u. taṃ. a. 66) draṣṭavyāni| uktahetudoṣabhedayoḥ saṅgrahaślokau– “catvāro vyabhicāridūranikaṭaprādhānikatvāt, punaste'sātmyendriyakārthayukpariṇatiprajñāparādhāttridhā| rugdoṣobhayakāraṇādapi tathā, dvau vyañjakotpādakau, bāhyābhyantarabhedato'pi kathitā hetoḥ prabhedā amī|| doṣasya ca prākṛtavaikṛtābhyāṃ, bhedo'nubandhyādapi cānubandhāt| tathā prakṛtyaprakṛtitvayogāttathā''śayākarṣavaśādgateśca||” iti nidānam|5|–

nidānasya paryāyaśabdānāha– nimittetyādi| ‘paryāyairiti nimittādibhiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | paryāyairiti nimittādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhireva paryāyairnidānamāhuḥ, ‘munayaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; etacca ‘nidānakathanam’ iti pā.| paryāyakathanaṃ śāstre vyavahārāya, tatra tatra śāstrapradeśe nidānametaiḥ paryāyairboddhavyamiti| ekārthavācakāḥ śabdāḥ parasparaṃ paryāyā ucyante||5||–

...prāgrūpaṃ yena lakṣyate ||5|| utpitsurāmayo doṣaviśeṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitaḥ | liṅgamavyaktamalpatvādvyādhīnāṃ ‘yathāyathaṃ yadyasya vyādherjvarādyanyatamasya ātmīyamātmīyam; ataśca prāgrūpaṃ tridhā dṛśyate– kiñcicchārīraṃ, kiñcinmānasaṃ, kiñcicchārīramānasaṃ ceti-tatra śārīraṃ yathā– jvarasyālasyāsyavairasyagātragauravajṛmbhāsāsrākulākṣatetyevamprāyaṃ; mānasaṃ ca– “aratirhitopadeśeṣvakṣāntiḥ” ityevamprāyaṃ; kiñcicchārīramānasaṃ yathā– “prītiramle paṭūṣaṇe, dveṣaḥ svāduṣu bhakṣyeṣu” ityevaṃ prāyaṃ, śārīramānasadoṣajanitatvāt’ iti vāgbhaṭaṭīkāyāmaruṇadattaḥ (vā. ni. a. 1) tadyathāyatham ||6|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg: nidānānantarīyakatvāt pūrvarūpādīnāṃ tadanantaraṃ prāgrūpamāha– ‘prāgrūpaṃ yenetyādi’ iti pā.| prāgrūpamityādi| dvividhaṃ hi pūrvarūpaṃ bhavati, sāmānyaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ ca| tatra sāmānyaṃ yena doṣadūṣyasammūrchanāvasthājanitena bhāvijvarādivyādhimātraṃ pratīyate, na tu vātādijanitatvādiviśeṣaḥ| yathā– ‘śramo'ratirvivarṇatvaṃ’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39); ityādi, tathā ‘guruvākyabālapradveṣādi’ iti pā.| devaguruvipradveṣādi; sāmānyābhiprāyeṇaivata tantrāntaram– “vyādherjātirbubhūṣā ca pūrvarūpeṇa lakṣyate| bhāvaḥ kimātmakatvaṃ ca lakṣyate lakṣaṇena hi||” iti| ‘tathāhi’ iti pā.| tathā''ha parāśaraḥ– “pūrvarūpaṃ nāma yena bhāvivyādhiviśeṣo lakṣyate na tu doṣaviśeṣaḥ|” iti| viśiṣṭaṃ yathā– uraḥkṣatādau liṅgānyeva vātādijānyavyaktāni| yaduktaṃ tatraiva– “avyaktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tasya pūrvarūpamiti smṛtam|” (ca. ci. a. 11) iti tathā suśrutaḥ– “sāmānyato viśeṣāttu jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt| pittānnayanayordāhaḥ kaphādannārucistathā||” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) hārīte'pyuktam– “iti pūrvarūpamaṣṭānāṃ jvarāṇāṃ sāmānyataḥ, viśeṣatastu jṛmbhāṅgamardabhūyiṣṭhaṃ hṛdayodvegi vātajam|” ityādi| nanu, cātyarthaṃ vyaktatvaṃ tataśca jṛmbhāderapi rūpatvaṃ prasajyeta; yadvakṣyati– “tadeva vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpamityabhidhīyate|” (vā. ni. a. 1) iti| ucyate– yathā śramādaya itararogavyatiriktaṃ bhāvijvaramātraṃ bodhayanti na tu vātajatvādiviśeṣamityatasteṣāmavyaktatvaṃ, tathā pittādijvaravyatiriktaṃ bhaviṣyadvātajvaramātraṃ bodhayanti jṛmbhādayaḥ, na tu vātasya rūkṣaśītadhātukṣayāvaraṇādijanyatvarūpaviśeṣaṃ bodhayanti; ityato'vyaktavātajvarabodhakatvādavyaktatvameva jṛmbhādīnāmiti jejjaṭavāpyacandramādhavakarakārtikakuṇḍādayo vyācakṣate| anye tvāhuḥ– ‘prabhūtāvyaktapūrvarūpasahacaritavyaktasyāpi’ iti pā.| prabhūtāvyaktapūrvarūpasahacaritasya vyaktasyāpi jṛmbhādeḥ pūrvarūpavyapadeśaḥ; yathā– māṣarāśiḥ; chatriṇo gacchantyevamādi| na ca vyaktatvena rūpādabhedaḥ; niyamena pūrvarūparūpayorbhāvivartamānavyādhibodhakatvāditi| tatra ‘viśiṣṭapūrvarūpam’ iti pā.| viśiṣṭaṃ prāgrūpaṃ rūpāvasthāyāmanuvartate eva, tasyaivābhivyaktasya rūpatvāt; na tu doṣadūṣyasammūrchanāvasthājanitaṃ ‘romaharṣaguruvākyabālapradveṣādikam’ iti pā.| romaharṣabālapradveṣādikaṃ niyamenānurvate, yadyanuvarteta tadā sarvajvarāṇāmasādhyatvaṃ prasajyeta| etadabhiprāyeṇa, “pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi jvaroktānyatimātrayā| yaṃ viśanti viśatyenaṃ mṛtyurjvarapuraḥsaraḥ||” (ca. i. a. 5)– iti carakavacanamityāhuḥ| tadevaṃ dvividhe pūrvarūpe vyavasthite sāmānyapūrvarūpamāha– ‘prāgrūpaṃ yena lakṣayate| utpitsurāmayo doṣaviśeṣeṇānadhitiṣṭhitaḥ|| iti|’ iti pā.| prāgrūpamityādi| yena śramādinā, utpitsuḥ sāmagrīsākalyādutpādecchuḥ, āmayo rogaḥ, doṣaviśeṣeṇa vātādijanyāsādhāraṇavepathvādinā, anadhiṣṭhito'sambaddho, lakṣyate jñāyate, tat prāgrūpamiti| viśiṣṭaprāgrūpamāha– liṅgamavyaktamalpatvādvyādhīnāṃ tadyathāyathamiti| prāgrūpamityanena pūrvoktena sambandhaḥ| liṅgaṃ lakṣaṇam; avyaktaṃ nātyabhivyaktam, atra heturalpatvādaṇutvāt, ‘natvāvaraṇādiyogādityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| natvāvaraṇādiyogādavyaktamityarthaḥ; yathāyathaṃ yasya vyādheryadrūpaṃ tadevāvyaktaṃ ‘tasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasya pūrvarūpamityarthaḥ| anye tu pūrvarūpalakṣaṇamāhuḥ– “sthānasaṃśrayiṇaḥ kruddhā bhāvivyādhiprabodhakam| doṣāḥ kurvanti yalliṅgaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ taducyate||” iti| tannātiyuktaṃ, rājayakṣmaṇaḥ pūrvarūpasya tṛṇakeśanipātāderadṛṣṭajanyasyāvyāpakatvāt| yadāha carakaḥ– “yakṣmiṇāṃ ghūṇakeśānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ patanāni ca| prāyo'nnapāne, keśānāṃ nakhānāṃ ‘cātivardhanam’ iti pā.| cābhivardhanam||” (ca. ci. a. 8) iti| na ca tadapi doṣajaṃ, doṣāṇāṃ tṛṇādibhirasambandhāt, asambaddhasya ca bhāvasya kāraṇatvenādṛṣṭatvāt; paramparayā tu sambandhakalpanayā'tiprasaṅgāt, sarvaṃ sarvasya kāraṇaṃ syāt| etaddoṣaparijihīrṣayaiva paramakuśalena ‘vāgbhaṭenādṛṣṭadoṣajasakalapūrvarūpasaṅgrāhakam’ iti pā.| vāgbhaṭenādṛṣṭadoṣajasarvapūrvarūpopasaṅgrāhakaṃ yenetipadaṃ nibaddhamiti atra ‘carakenoktam’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| carakenoktaṃ matvā tadīyapūrvarūpalakṣaṇameva mādhavakaro likhitavān| saṅkṣepatastu lakṣaṇam– “bhāvivyādhibodhakameva liṅgaṃ pūrvarūpam|” iti| evakāreṇa nidānopaśayayoḥ samprāpteśca doṣetikartavyatārūpāyā vyavacchedaḥ, ‘teṣām’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | teṣāṃ tajjātīyānāmutpannānutpannavyādhibodhakatvāt| tathā hi– nidānaṃ mṛdbhakṣaṇarūpaṃ bhāvipāṇḍurogamanupaśayarūpaṃ ca vartamānaviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ bodhayati; upaśayo'pi pūrvarūpāvasthāprayukto bhāviviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ atra ‘jñāpayati’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| jñāpayati, rūpāvasthāprayuktaśca vartamānaviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ ‘gamayati’ iti pā.| jñāpayati; samprāptiśca pūrvarūpasya madhyāhnādāvutpattiprakopābhyāṃ ‘bhāviviśiṣṭavyādhim’ iti pā.| bhaviṣyadviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ, ‘rūpam’ iti pā., ‘rūpe’ iti ca pā.| rūpasya ca madhyāhnaprakopādinā vartamānaviśiṣṭavyādhiṃ jñāpayati; ityeṣāmutpannānutpannavyādhibodhakatvam| nanu, yadā ‘pūrvarūpam’ iti pā.| pūrvarūpaviśeṣaṃ smṛtvotpannavyādherviśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ tadā pūrvarūpamapi vartamānavyādhibodhakaṃ, yathoktaṃ raktapittaprameharūpasandehe carakeṇa– “hāridravarṇaṃ rudhiraṃ ca mūtraṃ vinā pramehasya hi pūrvarūpaiḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 6) ityādi| atrocyate– kiṃ vyādhijanmanaḥ pūrvaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ gṛhītaṃ na vā? ādye bhāvivyādhibodhakatvameva; dvitīye smaraṇotpattireva na syāt, anubhavābhāvāt| athocyate– pūrvarūpaṃ ‘dantānām’ iti pā.| dantādīnāṃ malāḍhyatvādirūpaṃ svarūpeṇānubhūtameva, kintu ‘pramehaliṅgatayā’ iti pā.| pramehapūrvarūpatayā na pratibhātam; utpanne tu vyādhau tat smṛtaṃ pramehaviśeṣamavadhārayati| ‘maivaṃ iti pā.| evaṃ ‘pūrvarūpasmaraṇaṃ tarhikāraṇam’ iti pā.| tarhi pūrvarūpasmaraṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ na tu pūrvarūpaṃ, rūpāvasthāyāṃ tasya vyapagatatvāt| smaraṇaṃ na pramāṇamiti cet, satyaṃ; kintu ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | (pūrvānubhavajanitasaṃskāropasthita)smaraṇasahakṛtaṃ ‘rūpam’ iti pā.| pūrvarūpaṃ vyādhiviśeṣabodhakaṃ, na tu kevalaṃ smaraṇaṃ; yathā– saṃskāropasthāpitasmaraṇasahakṛtaṃ cakṣuḥ pratyabhijñāyāṃ prāgavasthāviśiṣṭaghaṭāvabodhakam– so'yaṃ ghaṭa iti| evaṃ smaraṇavadāptopadeśe'pi vācyaṃ, ‘tasya ca liṅgapadena vyudāsaḥ;’ etatsthāne ‘tasya liṅgapadena vyudāsaḥ; bhāvipadena rūpasya ca;’ iti pā.| tasya ca liṅgapadena vyudāsaḥ; bhāvipadena rūpasya; liṅgapadena cakṣurādeḥ, tasya ghaṭajñānādisādhāraṇatvenāliṅgatvāt; asādhāraṇaṃ hi liṅgaṃ bhavati| etacca ‘pūrvarūpamavidyamānasya’ iti pā.| pūrvarūpamavidyamānasyāpi vyādherliṅgaṃ bhavatyeva; yathā– viśiṣṭameghodayo vṛṣṭeḥ| iti pūrvarūpam||5-6||

prāgrūpalakṣaṇamāha– ‘prāgrūpamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prāgrūpamityādi| yena ‘jṛmbhālasyādinā’ iti pā.| jṛmbhālasyārucyādinā utpitsurudbubhūṣurāmayo jvarādirlakṣyate jñāyate tat prāgrūpaṃ bhāvivyādhibodhakaliṅgamityarthaḥ| kimbhūta āmayaḥ? kvacitpustake ‘doṣaviśeṣeṇa vātādinā, anadhiṣṭhitaḥ’ etatsthāne ‘doṣaviśeṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitaḥ’ iti pā.| doṣaviśeṣeṇa vātādinā, anadhiṣṭhitaḥ anāsāditaḥ| tarhi ‘vātādidoṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitatvāt’ iti pā.| vātādidoṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitasya vyādherutpitsutaiva na ghaṭate, kāraṇābhāvāt; na hi vātādīn vihāya vyādheḥ prāyeṇānyataḥ sambhavaḥ sambhāvyate, tathāhi– “sarveṣāmeva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ|” iti; tasmāddoṣaviśeṣeṇānadhiṣṭhitatvamutpitsorāmayasya yaducyate, tadavyaktarūpadoṣāpekṣayā'vagantavyamiti| tat prāgrūpam| utpitsūnāṃ jvarādīnām, alpatvādanāsāditabalavattvāt, avyaktaliṅgamaspaṣṭalakṣaṇam| yathāyathamiti yathā yena ‘yadāsya’ iti pā.| yasya vyādheḥ jvarādyanyatamasyātmīyātmīyamavagantavyam| tacca prāgrūpaṃ dvividham– sāmānyaṃ, viśiṣṭaṃ ca| yena doṣadūṣyadhātusammūrchanāvasthājanitena bhāvijvarādivyādhimātraṃ pratīyate, na tu vātādijanitatvādiviśeṣaḥ, tat sāmānyaṃ; yathā– jvarasya ‘śramo'ratirvivarṇatvam’ ityādi; yena bhāvivyādhyārambhakadoṣacihnapradeśamātraṃ pratīyate tadviśiṣṭaṃ, yathā– “jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt| pittānnayanayordāhaḥ, kaphānnānnābhinandanam||” iti| atra tu viśiṣṭe prāgrūpe jṛmbhādirūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpatvameva na vaktavyaṃ, vyādhyārambhakadoṣamātrasūkṣmacihnarūpatvāt; ‘tathāhi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathāhi tṛṇādicaye patite'gnikaṇe sūkṣmatvāt dhūmamātravyaktiṃ jñātvā karavastrāditāḍanapratīkāraistadupaśamaḥ kartuṃ śakyate, na tu prajvalite vahnau; tathā– ‘bhaviṣyaddoṣārambhakadoṣāttatkṣaṇaikamātram’ iti pā.| bhaviṣyadrogārambhakadoṣalakṣaṇaikamātraṃ vyaktaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ prāgrūpaṃ jñātvā bhāvivyādherupaśamaḥ kartuṃ ‘śakyate’ iti pā.| pāryate iti| atastu pūrvarūparūpayorbheda eva| taddvayamapi kvacicchārīraṃ dṛśyate, kvacinmānasaṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca| tatra śārīraṃ yathā– “ ‘jvarasyālasyagātragauravasāsrākulekṣaṇam’ iti pā., ‘jvarasya gātragauravasāsrākulekṣaṇam’ iti ca pā.| jvarasyālasyavairasyagātragauravasāsrākulekṣaṇam|” ityādikam| mānasaṃ yathā– aratirhitopadeśeṣvakṣāntiḥ ‘amlakaṭvaśane prītirityādikam’ iti pā.| ityādikam||5-6||

div.ab: tadeva vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpamityabhidhīyate | saṃsthānaṃ vyañjanaṃ liḍgaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cihnamākṛtiḥ ||7|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg: yadyapi pūrvarūpānantaraṃ samprāptirbhavati, tathā'pi vyādhisvarūpajñānārthaṃ rūpamāha– “tadevetyevaśabdenaitad dyotayati– yadeva śārīraṃ prāgrūpaṃ pūrvopavarṇitaṃ tadeveha grahītavyaṃ, sthāyitvāt; taddhyāmayānubandhi| mānasaṃ śārīramānasaṃ vā'sthāyitvānna grahītavyaṃ, taddhi dvayamutpitsuvyādhisamanantaraṃ prāyeṇa naśyatīti tadvyaktatāṃ na yāti| ataḥ śārīramevotpitsuvyādhiprāgrūpamiha tadā parāmraṣṭuṃ yuktam” iti vāgbhaṭaṭīkāyāmaruṇadattaḥ (vā. ni. a. 1)| tadevetyādi| tadeva pūrvarūpameva| vyaktatāmudbhūtatāmiti| nanu vyaktatvaṃ pūrvarūpasya kiṃ kārtsyena, ekadeśena vā? ādye ‘sarvajvarādeḥ’ iti pā.| sarvajvarāṇāmasādhyatvaṃ syāt; yaduktaṃ carake– “pūrvarūpāṇi sarvāṇi” (ca. i. a. 5) ityādi; dvitīye hi “jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt| pittānnayanayordāhaḥ” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ityāderapi pūrvarūpasya rūpatvaprasaṅgaḥ? naivam, anabhyupagamānna kṛtsnasya nāpyekadeśasya, kintvanirdhāritaikatvānekatvaviśeṣasya pūrvarūpamātrasya vyaktasya ‘vyādhiliṅgatvam’ iti pā.| vyādherliṅgatvaṃ; yathā– tārṇapārṇādiviśeṣaviraheṇa dhūmamātrasya vahnibodhakatvam| evaṃ vyavasthite yadā sarvasyābhivyaktistadā na sādhyatvam, anyathā tu sādhyatvam| na ca ‘jṛmbhādau’ iti pā.| jṛmbhāde rūpatvaprasaṅgaḥ, tasya prāgeva vyaktatvāt; avyaktaṃ sadvyaktatāṃ yātaṃ tasya ‘rūpābhidhānatvābhyupagamāt’ iti pā.| rūpatvenābhidhānāt; aparaprabhūtāvyaktaliṅgasahacaritatvena pūrvarūparūpayorasamānakālatvena ca rūpatvāyogāditi īśvarasenastvāha– “ ‘vyādheḥ svarūpamavyaktaṃ pūrvarūpaṃ, yadvyaktaṃ tadrūpam”’ iti pā.| vyādheḥ svarūpaṃ yadvyaktaṃ tadrūpam” iti| tanna, vikalpāsahatvāt| tathā hi– svarūpamiti kiṃ ‘svaṃ rūpam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | svaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpam? āhosvit ‘svīyaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ? svīyamapi dharmaḥ, kāryaṃ vā?‘ etatsthāne ‘svīyaṃ rūpaṃ? svīyo'pi dharmaḥ, svīyaṃ kāryaṃ vā?’ iti pā., ‘svakīyaṃ rūpaṃ? svakīyo'pi dharmaḥ, svakīyaṃ kāryaṃ vā?’ iti ca. pā.| svīyaṃ rūpaṃ svarūpaṃ? svīyamapi dharmaḥ, kāryaṃ vā? na tāvat svarūpaṃ, svātmani kriyāvirodhāt; rūpaṃ hi vyādhipratipattinimittamuktaṃ, tacced vyādhisvabhāva eva tarhi vyādhisvabhāvādeva vyādhisvabhāvaḥ pratīyata iti vyaktaḥ svātmani kriyāvirodhaḥ| nāpi dharmaḥ, ‘ ... viṇmūtranetratvāderarśorūpatvānupapatteḥ’ iti pā.| carakoktakṛṣṇatvaṅnakhaviṇmūtratvāderarśorūpatvānupapatteḥ| nahi ‘kṛṣṇatvaṅnakhaviṇmūtranetratvādikamarśodharmaḥ’ iti pā.| kṛṣṇatvaṅnakhādikamarśodharmaḥ, atanniṣṭhatvāt; dharmāṇāṃ ca dharminiṣṭhatvāt, anyathā'tiprasaṅgāt| nāpi kāryam, upadravāderapi rūpatvaprasaṅgāt| tadapi kṛcchrasādhyāsādhyavyādherliṅgamiti cet, naivam; ‘asādhyatvādestalliṅgam’ iti pā.| asādhyatvādereva talliṅgaṃ, na tu vyādheḥ; ‘tasya kṛcchrasādhyāsādhyasya pūrvarūpeṇaiva jñātatvāt’ iti pā.| tasya pūrvameva jñātatvād, bhedenopādānācca; ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| taduktam– “sopadravāriṣṭanidānaliṅgo nibadhyate rogaviniścayo'yam|” iti, nanu, upadravo na vyādheḥ kāryaṃ, kintu vyādhyārambhakadoṣasya; yaduktaṃ suśrute– “sa ‘tanmūla’ iti pā.| tanmūlamūla evopadravasañjñakaḥ|” iti (su. sū. a. 35); vyācakṣate ca ṭīkākṛtaḥ– “ “tanmūlaṃ taddoṣarūpaṃ mūlaṃ yasya sa tanmūlaḥ|’ iti pā.| tanmūlaṃ tasya vyādhermūlaṃ doṣarūpaṃ mūlaṃ yasya sa tanmūlaḥ|” iti| naivam, apacāreṇa mūlabhūtadoṣopabṛṃhaṇalabdhabalaścedvyādhirupadravaṃ karoti tena ‘ ‘tanmūla’ iti pā.| tanmūlamūla’ ityuktavān| ata evāha carakaḥ– “kaściddhi rogo rogasya heturbhūtvā praśāmyati|” (ca. ni. a. 8) ityādi| ‘svarūpaśabdavācyaṃ kāryaṃ kvacidāśrīyate’ iti pā., ‘sarvamevaitatsvarūpaśabdasya vācyaṃ kvacitkiñciditi’ iti ca pā.| sarvamevaitatsvarūpaśabdavācyaṃ kvacitkiñciditi; tathā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca sati na vyabhicāra iti kecit| ‘tadapi’ iti pā.| tathā'pi vyavasthāmātraṃ syānna tu lakṣaṇam, ekasya sakalarūpasaṅgrāhakasya ‘dharmasyābhāvāt; dharmasyānvayavyatirekeṇa tanniṣṭhatvāt; upadravasya ca’ iti pā.| dharmasyābhāvāt, upadravasyāpi vyādhisvarūpatvāpatteśceti| tasmāt “utpannavyādhibodhakameva liṅgaṃ rūpam” iti lakṣaṇam| ‘utpanna’ iti padaṃ pūrvarūpavyavacchedārtham; ‘evakāro'pi nidānasamprāptyupaśayān vyavacchinatti’ iti pā.| evakāreṇa nidānasamprāptyupaśayā vyavacchidyante, teṣāmutpannānutpannavyādhibodhakatvāt; tacca darśitameva; liṅgapadena cakṣurādervyudāsaḥ; yanmate vyādhijanmarūpā samprāptistanmate tasyā liṅgapadena vyavacchedaḥ, na hi sā vyādhijñāne liṅgaṃ, kintu kāraṇamātram| śāstre vyavahārārthaṃ ‘lakṣaṇārthaṃ ca nidānavat’ iti pā.| nidānavallakṣaṇārthaṃ ca rūpaparyāyānāha– saṃsthānamityādi| ‘nanu rūpeṇa vyādhirjñāyeta, yadi rūpavyatirekeṇānyo vyādhirupalabhyeta’ iti pā.| nanu, rūpeṇa vyādhirjñāyate, na ca rūpavyatirekeṇa vyādhirupalabhyate; yato militā arucyādaya eva jvaraḥ, kāsādyekādaśarūpāṇyeva rājayakṣmā| ucyate– naivaṃ, tathāvidhadoṣadūṣyasammūrchanāviśeṣo jvarādirūpo vyādhiḥ, tatkāryāścārucyādayaḥ asyāgre ‘evaṃ kāsādirūpātirekeṇaiva yakṣmā, tatkāryāṇi kāsādaya iti’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate |; ‘kiṃvā’ iti pā.| kiñca arucyādaya eva pratyekaśo rūpāṇi, tatsamudāyo vyādhiḥ, yataḥ samudāyibhyo'nya eva samudāyaḥ, yathā– khadiratarūṇāṃ vanamiti; anye tu rāhoḥ śiraḥ, śilāputrasya śarīramitivadasatyapi bhede bhedavivakṣayā samarthayanti; naiyāyikāstu tatrāpi bhedamāpādayanti| nanu, “vikāro duḥkhameva ca|” iti (ca. sū. a. 9) carakavacanādduḥkhasyātmaguṇasya kathamarucyādisamudāyatvaṃ? naivaṃ, duḥkhayatīti duḥkhamiti vyutpattyā duḥkhahetordhātuvaiṣamyādervyādhitvasvīkārāt| arucyādayastu svarūpeṇa vikārā eva, ‘yadā'nyapratipādakāstadā liṅgānyucyante’ iti pā.| yadā tvanyapratipādakāstadā liṅgānyevocyante| yadāha carakaḥ– “jñānārthaṃ yāni coktāni vyādhiliṅgāni saṅgrahe| vyādhayaste tadātve tu liṅgānīṣṭāni nāmayāḥ||” iti (ca. ni. a. 8)| ‘iti rūpalakṣaṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti rūpalakṣaṇam||7||

idānīṃ rūpaṃ lakṣayitumāha– tadevetyādi| ‘tadeva’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tadeva prāgrūpaṃ vyaktatāṃ yātaṃ rūpamiti kathyate; anirdhāritaikatvānekatvaviśeṣasya pūrvarūpamātrasya vyaktasya vyādherliṅgatvaṃ, yathā ‘tṛṇaparṇādiviśeṣaviraheṇa’ iti pā.| tārṇapārṇādiviśeṣaviraheṇa dhūmamātrasya vahnibodhakatvamiti| saṃsthānamityādi| kvacitpustake ‘saṃsthānādyākṛtyantāḥ ṣaḍrūpasya paryāyavācakāḥ, tathā pūrvarūpasyāpi; yathā– pūrvasaṃsthānaṃ, pūrvavyañjanamityādyapare'pi’ etatsthāne ‘saṃsthānādyākṛtayastāḥ yaḍrūpasya paryāyavācakāḥ, tathā saṃsthānaṃ, pūrvavyañjanamityapare'pi’ iti pā.| saṃsthānādyākṛtyantāḥ ṣaḍrūpasya paryāyavācakāḥ, tathā pūrvarūpasyāpi; yathā– pūrvasaṃsthānaṃ, pūrvavyañjanamityādyapare'pi||7||

div.ab: hetuvyādhiviparyastaviparyastārthakāriṇām | auṣadhānnavihārāṇāmupayogaṃ sukhāvaham ||8|| vidyādupaśayaṃ vyādheḥ sa hi sātmyamiti smṛtaḥ | viparīto'nupaśayo vyādhyasātmyābhisañjñitaḥ ||9|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg: upaśayamāha– hetuvyādhītyādi| heturbāhya ābhyantaraśca, vyādhirjvarādiḥ, ‘etayorheturogayorvyastasamastayorviparyastā’ iti pā.| etayorhetuvyādhyorvyastasamastayorviparyastā viparītāḥ, etayoreva vyastasamastayorviparyastārthakāriṇo ‘nidānasadharmiṇo'pi’ iti pā.| nidānasamānadharmiṇo'pi prabhāvādrogapraśamakāriṇaḥ; evaṃvidhā ye auṣadhānnavihārā bheṣajāhārācārāsteṣāmupayogamācaraṇaṃ sukhāvahaṃ sukhakaramupaśayaṃ kvacitpustake ‘vidyādupaśayākhyaṃ jānīyādvyādheḥ’ etatsthāne ‘vidyādvyādheḥ’ iti pā.| vidyādupaśayākhyaṃ jānīyādvyādheḥ| tasya paryāyamāha– sa hi sātmyamiti smṛta iti| carake'pyuktam– “sātmyārtho hyupaśayārthaḥ” iti (ca. ni. a. 1)| hiśabdaḥ pādapūraṇe| sukhāvahamiti sukhaṃ roganivṛttilakṣaṇaṃ; yathā vyapadiśanti loke– ‘bhārāpagame sukhinaḥ saṃvṛttāḥ sma’ iti, tat sukhamāvahati samyagāyattyā'nubandhena ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca karotīti sukhāvaham| etena sadāhatṛṣṇānavajvariṇaḥ śītalajalapānaṃ tatkālasukhakaramapi nopaśaya ‘tadātvasukhakaramapi nopaśayakaram’ iti pā.| iti tātparyārthaḥ| atra, auṣadhānnavihārāṇāmityupalakṣaṇaṃ; tena deśakālāvapi boddhavyau| ata eva vṛddhavāgbhaṭena ‘vyādhyādikamabhidhāya’ iti pā.| vyādhyādiviparītamabhidhāya “etena deśakālāvapi vyākhyātau” (vṛ. vā. ni. a. 1) ityākhyātam| ‘sudattaseno'pyāha’ iti pā.| sudāntaseno'pyāha– “sukhānubandho yo heturvyādhyādiviparītakaḥ| deśādikaścopaśayo jñeyo'nupaśayo'nyathā||” iti| saṅkṣepatastu lakṣaṇam– “auṣadhādijanitaḥ sukhānubandha upaśayaḥ” iti| ‘srakcandanavanitādijanita ... ’ iti pā.| srakcandanavanitādyupabhogajanitasukhanivṛttyarthamauṣadhādipadam, anubandhaśabdaśca ‘apathyajanitatadātvasukhanivṛtyarthaḥ’ iti pā.| apathyajanitatadātvasukhavyavacchedārthaḥ| etadapyudāharaṇadarśanaparaṃ, na tu lakṣaṇam; auṣadhādīnāṃ ‘hetvādiviparītānām’ iti pā.| hetuviparītādīnāṃ ca parasparavyabhicāreṇa lakṣaṇatvāyogāt| tasmāt ‘samyagvyādhijaduḥkhopaśamaheturupaśayaḥ’, ‘sātmyamupaśayaḥ’ iti vā lakṣaṇam; ‘auṣadhajanitaḥ sukhānubandha upaśayaḥ’ iti vā lakṣaṇam| carake; āhārācāradeśakālalaṅghanādīnāṃ dravyādravyabhūtānāmauṣadhatvenābhidhānāt| athaiṣāmudāharaṇāni; tatra hetuviparītāni; auṣadhaṃ yathā– śītakaphajvare śuṇṭhyādyuṣṇaṃ bheṣajam| yaduktam– “śītenoṣṇakṛtānrogān śamayanti ‘bhiṣagvarāḥ’ iti pā.| bhiṣagvidaḥ| ye ‘ca’ iti pā.| tu śītakṛtā rogāsteṣāmuṣṇaṃ bhiṣagjitam||” iti (ca. vi. a. 3)| annaṃ yathā– śramānilaje jvare rasaudanam| vihāro yathā– divāsvapnotthe kaphe rātrau jāgaraṇamiti| atha vyādhiviparītāni| auṣadhaṃ yathā– atisāre stambhanaṃ pāṭhādi, tathā śirīṣo viṣaṃ hanti, khadiraḥ kuṣṭhaṃ, haridrā pramehamiti; naite doṣamapekṣante ‘rogapraśamakāriṇaḥ’ iti kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | prabhāvādrogapraśamakāriṇa iti| vāpyacandrastvāha– “jvarādivyādhiharaṃ yaddravyaṃ tadapi doṣapratyanīkaṃ”, ‘kintu’ iti kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | kintu doṣapratyanīkādasyāyaṃ bhedaḥ– yaddoṣapratyanīkaṃ tannāvaśyaṃ vyādhiharaṃ; yathā– vamanalaṅghane kaphahare na kaphagulmaṃ harataḥ; uktaṃ hi carake– “kaphe laṅghanasādhye tu kartari jvaragulmayoḥ| tulye'pi deśakālādau laṅghanaṃ na ca sammatam||” iti; tathā– “na vāmayettaimirikaṃ na gulminaṃ na cāpi ‘pāṇḍurogiṇam’ iti pā.| pāṇḍūdararogapīḍitam|” iti; (su. ci. a. 33); “yattu vyādhiharaṃ tadavaśyaṃ doṣaharaṃ, tadvyādhiṃ ‘śamayedetadārambhakadoṣaṃ ca’ iti pā.| śamayattadārambhakadoṣamapi śamayati; anyathā sa rogo jita eva na syāt, ‘kāraṇasya tādavasthyāt’ iti pā.| kāraṇatādavasthyāt” iti| tannātisaṅgatamityanye; yato doṣastatra samavāyī nimittaṃ vā; na ca samavāyinimittābhāvaprayukto niyamena kāryābhāvaḥ, ‘kintvasamavāyikāraṇābhāvaprayukto'pi’ iti pā.| kintvasamavāyinimittābhāvaprayukto'pi; yathā– kvacitpustake ‘kapālamālāsaṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasya vināśādapi ghaṭābhāvaḥ’ etatsthāne ‘kapālamālāsaṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasyābhāvādghaṭābhāvaḥ’ iti pā.| kapālamālāsaṃyogasyāsamavāyikāraṇasya vināśādapi ghaṭābhāvaḥ; tathā– roge'pi samprāptilakṣaṇasya saṃyogasya ‘vināśādapi’ pā.| vināśādrogasyāpi vināśaḥ, doṣastu svataḥ kriyāntareṇa vā nivartate; ‘kiñca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kiñca yadi vyādhipratyanīkamavaśyaṃ doṣaṃ nivartayediti svīkriyate, tadobhayapratyanīkādbhedo durupapādaḥ syāditi| nanu, yadi nimittakāraṇaṃ doṣastatkathaṃ tadārabdhavikāre vamanādinā doṣaharaṇaṃ vidhīyate? nahi daṇḍakulālādyucchede ghaṭoccheda iti| ucyate, yatra yāvannimittakāraṇasthāyikāryaṃ tatra ‘nimittakāraṇanāśādapi’ iti pā.| nimittakāraṇocchedādapi kāryanāśaḥ; yathā– ‘vartitailanāśāddīpanāśaḥ’ iti pā.| vartitailanāśādapi pradīpanāśaḥ; tathābhūtāśca doṣāḥ ‘prāyaśaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu na paṭhyate| prāyaśa iti| annaṃ yathā– atisāre stambhanaṃ masūrādi| vihāro yathā– udāvarte pravāhaṇaṃ; ‘mantrauṣadhividhāraṇa…’ iti pā.| mantrauṣadhidhāraṇabalyupahāraniyamaprāyaścittahomagurudevaśuśrūṣādayo'pi vyādhiviparītā vihārā iti vāpyacandraḥ| atha hetuvyādhiviparītāni– auṣadhaṃ yathā– vātaśothe daśamūlaṃ vātaharaṃ śothaharaṃ ca| yaduktaṃ carake ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīye'dhyāye ‘pāṭalā’ ityādi yāvat– “daśemāni śothaharāṇi” iti (ca. sū. a. 4) annaṃ yathā– vātakaphagrahaṇyāṃ takraṃ, śītavātotthe jvare peyā; sā hyuṣṇavīryatvādvātaṃ hanti prabhāvājjvaraṃ ca| yaduktaṃ carake– “ ‘jvaraghno’ iti pā.| jvaraghnyo jvarasātmyatvāt” iti (ca. ci. a. 3); ‘suśrute ca’ iti pā.| suśrute'pi– “jvare caivātisāre ca yavāgūḥ sarvadā hitā|” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 40)| vihāro yathā– snigdhadivāsvapnaprajātāyāṃ tandrāyāṃ rūkṣaṃ tandrāviparītaṃ rātrijāgaraṇamiti| atha hetuviparītārthakārīṇi; auṣadhaṃ yathā– pittapradhāne ‘pacyamāne’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pacyamāne vraṇaśothe pittakara uṣṇa upanāhaḥ| annaṃ yathā– ‘tatraiva’ iti pā.| pacyamāne vraṇaśothe'nnaṃ vidāhi| vihāro yathā– vātonmāde trāsanamiti| atha vyādhiviparītārthakārīṇi; auṣadhaṃ yathā– chardyāṃ vamanakārakaṃ madanaphalādi| annaṃ yathā– atisāre ‘virecanārtham’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | virecanārthaṃ virecanaṃ kṣīram uktaṃ hi– “bahudoṣasya dīptāgneḥ saprāṇasya na tiṣṭhati| paittiko yadyatīsāraḥ payasā taṃ virecayet||” iti (ca. ci. a. 19)|| vihāro yathā– chardyāṃ vamanārthaṃ pravāhaṇamiti| atha hetuvyādhiviparītārthakārīṇi; auṣadhaṃ yathā– agnipluṣṭe uṣṇo'gurvādilepaḥ, viṣe vā viṣam| annaṃ yathā– madyapānotthe madātyaye madakārakaṃ madyam| vihāro yathā– vyāyāmajanitasammūḍhavāte jalaprataraṇarūpo vyāyāma iti| nanu chardyāṃ bahuśleṣmajāyāṃ ‘saṃśamanayogyāyām’ iti pā., ‘saṃśamanayogyāyām’ iti ca pā.| vamanayogyāyāṃ yadi vamanaṃ na kriyate tadā ‘cirānuvṛttiḥ, rogānucchedo vā’ iti pā.; ‘vikārānuvṛttiḥ, rogānucchedo vā syād’ iti pā.; ‘vikārānuvartī doṣo rogānucchedo vā’ iti ca pā.| cirānuvartī rogo'nucchedyo vā syāt, tataśca vamanaṃ prayuktaṃ doṣapratyanīkameva bhavati; yaduktaṃ suśrute– “chardiṣu bahudoṣāsu vamanaṃ hitamucyate|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) iti, ‘tathā āmātisāre kṣīrasya virekitvenāmaniḥ saraṇāddhetupratyanīkameva bhavati|’ iti paṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā āmātisāre kṣīrasya virekitvenāmaniḥ saraṇāddhetupratyanīkameva bhavati| evamagnipluṣṭe'pyuṣṇakriyayā raktasya vilayanena sthānāntaragamanāt ‘hetupratyanīkataiva’ iti pā.| hetupratyanīkameva; ‘anyathā raktaṃ dāhaprakupitaṃ tatrastham’ iti pā.| anyathā dāhaprakupitaṃ raktaṃ tatrasthaṃ pākamārabhet; yaduktaṃ suśrute– “agninā kopitaṃ raktaṃ bhṛśaṃ jantoḥ ‘pradhāvati’ iti pā.| prakupyati| tatastenaiva vegena pittamasyāpyudīryate||” iti (su. sū. a. 12); śītakriyā ca tatra niṣiddhā, raktasya styānatvahetutvāt; yadāha suśrutaḥ– “prakṛtyā hyudakaṃ śītaṃ ‘skandayatyapi śoṇitam’ iti pā.| skandayatyatiśoṇitam| tasmāt sukhayati hyuṣṇaṃ natu śītaṃ kathañcana||” iti (su. sū. a. 12)| skandayati styānīkaroti; tathā jaṅgamaviṣe ūrdhvagasvarūpe maulaviṣamadhogasvarūpaṃ hetuviparītameva| yaduktaṃ carake– “viṣaṃ viṣaghnamuktaṃ yat prabhāvastatra kāraṇam| ūrdhvānulomikaṃ yacca ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tat prabhāvaprabhāvitam||” iti (ca. sū. a. 26)| asyāyamarthaḥ– viṣatvāviśeṣe'pi kuto gatibheda ityata uktam– tat prabhāvaprabhāvitamiti; tathā madyakṛte madātyaye yanmadyaṃ tadapi mātuluṅgacukrādiyutaṃ suśrutādibhirvihitaṃ kevalācca dravyāntarasaṃyuktamanyadeva, athavā vātamadātyaye rūkṣamādhvīkādinā janite snigdhapaiṣṭikādimadyaṃ prayujyamānaṃ hetuviparītameva; ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| yaccoktaṃ suśrute– “yathā narendropahatasya kasyacidbhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ| dhruvaṃ tathā madyahatasya dehino bhavet prasādastata eva nānyataḥ||” iti (su. u. taṃ. a. 47), tanmadyajātīyābhiprāyeṇaiva; yaccorustambhe jalaprataraṇaṃ, tatrāpi jalasya śaityena ‘bahirnirgacchan’ iti pā.| bahiragacchan dehoṣmā ‘liptakumbhakārapavananyāyenāntaḥpiṇḍitau’ iti pā.| kumbhakārapavananyāyenāntaḥpiṇḍitau medaḥśleṣmāṇau vilāyayati, vyāyāmaśca tau śoṣayati, ‘tataśca’ iti pā.| tatastu nirāvaraṇo vāyuḥ svamārgapratipanno bhavatīti hetupratyanīkataiva; ‘anenaiva’ iti pā.| anena nyāyena sarvameva tadarthakāri yathāsambhavaṃ hetupratyanīkādāvevāntarbhavatīti| ucyate– yadyapyevaṃ tathā'pyavāntaravaidharmyapratipādanārthamācāryaiḥ pṛthagdarśitam asyāgre ‘yathā śālyarthaṃ pravṛttayā kulyayā kriyamāṇaṃ bījāntarādhānaṃ tannāntarīyakaṃ, tadubhayahetutvaṃ sādharmyodāharaṇavat’ iti kvacitpustake'dhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ|| tathā carake'pyuktam– “upaśayaḥ punarhetuvyādhiviparītānāṃ ‘viparītārthakāriṇāmauṣadhāhāravihārāṇāmupayogaḥ’ iti pā.| viparītārthakāriṇāṃ cauṣadhāhāravihārāṇāmupayogaḥ sukhānubandhaḥ|” iti (ca. ni. a. 1)| ‘auṣadhādīnāṃ duḥkhavaidharmyam’ iti pā.| vaidharmyaṃ ca hetusamānadharmakatve'pi rogapraśamakatvamiti| viparīto'nupaśaya iti auṣadhādīnāṃ duḥkhakara upayogo'nupaśaya ityarthaḥ| tatparyāyamāha– vyādhyasātmya iti| vyādhigrahaṇena doṣo'pi bodhyaḥ| nanu, anupaśayaḥ kiṃ vyādhiviśeṣaṃ bodhayati no vā? neti cet, ‘tadupanyāso nidāne’ iti pā.| nidāne tadupanyāso vyarthaḥ; pratipādayatīti cet, ‘vijñānaṃ rogāṇāṃ pañcadhā ‘smṛtam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | smṛtam’ iti ‘vyāhanyeta’ iti pā.| vyāhanyate, tasya ṣaṣṭhatvāpatteḥ| naivaṃ, pratipādayatyeva; yadāha carakaḥ– “gūḍhaliṅgaṃ vyādhimupaśayānupaśayābhyāṃ parīkṣeta|” iti (ca. vi. a. 4)| kintu nidāne tasyāntarbhāvaḥ, doṣasya rogasya vā vardhakatvāt ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | ityanupaśayasya nidāne'ntarbhāvānna ṣaṣṭhatvāpattiḥ, vakṣyati ca– ‘nidānoktānupaśayaḥ’ iti|)| ityupaśayalakṣaṇam||8-9||

athopaśayalakṣaṇamāha– hetuvyādhiviparyastetyādi| yugmam| upayujyata ityupayogaḥ| sukhamāvahati samyaganubandhena sukhamutpādayatīti sukhāvahaḥ| etena ‘sadāhatṛṣṇānvitasya’ iti pā.| dāhatṛṣṇānvitasya navajvariṇaḥ śītajalapānaṃ ‘vyādhikaram’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vyādhikaraṃ tadātvasukhakaramapi nopaśaya iti tātparyārthaḥ| ‘īdṛśo ya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | īdṛśo ya upayogaḥ sukhāvahastamupaśayaṃ vidyāt jānīyāt| keṣāmupayogaḥ? auṣadhānnavihārāṇām|– auṣadhaṃ harītakyādi, annaṃ raktaśālyādi, vihāro– ‘dehamanonirvartitaśceṣṭāviśeṣo’ iti pā.| vāgdehamanonirvartitaśceṣṭāviśeṣo ‘vyāyāmo– jāgaraṇādhyayanādirūpaḥ’ iti pā.| vyāyāmajāgaraṇādhyayanādirūpaḥ; auṣadhaṃ ca annaṃ ca vihāraśca auṣadhānnavihārāsteṣām| kimbhūtānāṃ? hetuvyādhiviparyastaviparyastārthakāriṇām|– hetuśca vyādhiśca hetuvyādhī, tayorvyastasamastayorviparyastā nidānarogayorviparītāḥ; tathā viparyastānāmartho viparyastārthaḥ, tayorvyastasamastayoreva viparītamarthaṃ kurvantīti viparyastārthakāriṇaḥ; hetuvyādhiviparyastāśca viparyastārthakāriṇaśca hetuvyādhiviparyastaviparyastārthakāriṇasteṣām| ‘keṣām’ iti pā.| teṣāṃ viparyastānāmarthaṃ kurvantīti prakṛtatvāt hetuvyādhiviparyastānām| tadā'yamarthaḥ– nidānarogayorvyastasamastayorviparītā api kāraṇarūpā iva bhāsamānā vyādhirūpā iva bhāsamānā hetuvyādhiviparītānāmarthaṃ vyādhyupaśamalakṣaṇaṃ kurvantīti| yathā hetuviparītairauṣadhānnavihārairvyādhyupaśamaḥ kriyate pratipakṣatvāt; evaṃ viparyastārthakāribhirapītyarthaḥ| tathā ca hetuviparītānāṃ, vyādhiviparītānāṃ, hetuvyādhiviparītānāṃ, hetuviparītārthakāriṇāṃ, vyādhiviparītārthakāriṇāṃ, hetuvyādhiviparītārthakāriṇām, auṣadhānnavihārāṇāṃ yaḥ sukhāvaha upayogaḥ sa upaśaya iti sampiṇḍārthaḥ| atha krameṇodāharaṇāni| hetuviparītamauṣadhaṃ yathā– śītahetuke kaphajvare śuṇṭhyādyuṣṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ; yaduktaṃ, “śītenoṣṇakṛtān rogāñchamayanti bhiṣagvidaḥ| ye tu śītakṛtā rogāsteṣāmuṣṇaṃ hi bheṣajam||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| hetuviparītamannaṃ yathā– śramānilajvare rasaudanam| hetuviparīto vihāro yathā– divāsvapnotthe kaphe rātrau jāgaraṇam| atha vyādhiviparītamauṣadhaṃ yathā– atīsāre stambhanaṃ pāṭhādi| vyādhiviparītamannaṃ yathā– atīsāre stambhanaṃ masūrādi| vyādhiviparīto vihāro yathā– udāvarte pravāhaṇaṃ; saśabdaṃ hṛtkaṇṭhabalena vāyoradho'dho nayanaṃ pravāhaṇam| ‘mantrauṣadhadhāraṇabalyupahārādiniyamaprāyaścittācaraṇahomadevaguruśuśrūṣādayo vyādhiviparītā vihārāḥ’ ‘iti vyomacandraḥ’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti vyomacandraḥ| atha hetuvyādhiviparītamauṣadhaṃ yathā– vātaśothe daśamūlaṃ vātaharaṃ śothaharaṃ ca| hetuvyādhiviparītamannaṃ yathā– vātakaphagrahaṇyāṃ takraṃ vātakaphaharaṃ grahaṇīharaṃ ca| hetuvyādhiviparīto vihāro yathā– snigdhāyāṃ divāsvapnajāyāṃ tandrāyāṃ tandrāviparītaṃ ‘snigdhatāharaṇam’ iti pā.| snigdhatāharaṃ ca rātrau jāgaraṇamiti| atha hetuviparītārthakāryauṣadhaṃ yathā– pittapradhāne pacyamāne vraṇaśothe pittakara uṣṇa upanāhaḥ| hetuviparītārthakāryannaṃ yathā– pittaśothe'nnaṃ vidāhi| hetuviparītārthakārī vihāro yathā– vātonmāde trāsanamiti| atha vyādhiviparītārthakāryauṣadhaṃ yathā– kaphe vamanakārakaṃ madanaphalādi| vyādhiviparītārthakāryannaṃ yathā– atīsāre virekakṛtkṣīram| vyādhiviparītārthakārī vihāro yathā– chardyāmaṅguṣṭhotpalanālādinā vamanam| vamanavirekābhyāṃ chardyatīsārayorvṛddhireva kartuṃ yuktā, iha tu ‘samānakāritvāt’ iti pā.| śamanakaraṇād viparītārthakāritvam| atha hetuvyādhiviparītārthakāryauṣadhaṃ yathā– agnipluṣṭe uṣṇo'gurvādilepaḥ, viṣe vā viṣam| hetuvyādhiviparītārthakāryannaṃ yathā– madyāpānotthe madātyaye madakaraṃ madyam| hetuvyādhiviparītārthakārī vihāro yathā– vyāyāmajanite ‘mūḍhavāte’ iti pā.| sammūḍhavāte jalaprataraṇarūpo vyāyāma iti| evamapare'pi boddhavyāḥ| auṣadhānnavihārāṇāmityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena deśakālāvapi boddhavyau| hiśabdaḥ pādapūraṇe| sa upaśayo vyādherāmayasya sātmyamiti smṛtaḥ| evaṃvidhaguṇaviparīto ya āhāro vihāraśca prāyeṇa ‘nidānaviparītaḥ’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānaviparītaḥ sa vyādhisātmyaḥ| uktaṃ ca carake– “deśānāmāmayānāṃ ca viparītaguṇaṃ guṇaiḥ| sātmyamicchanti sātmyajñāśceṣṭitaṃ cādyameva ca||” iti upaśayakathanaprastāvādanupaśayo'pi vācya ityāha– viparīta ityādi| ato yathānirdiṣṭalakṣaṇādupaśayākhyādyo viparītalakṣaṇaḥ ‘auṣadhānnavihārāṇāmupayogo'sukhāvahaḥ’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | auṣadhānnavihārāṇāmupayogo'sukhāvahaḥ so'nupaśaya ityucyate, sa eva vyādherasātmyamitisañjñitaḥ ābhimukhyena saṅketita iti||8-9||

div.ab: yathāduṣṭena doṣeṇa yathā cānuvirsapatā | nirvṛttirāmayasyāsau samprāptirjātirāgatiḥ ||10|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg: samprāptimāha– yathetyādi| nānāvidhā hi doṣāṇāṃ duṣṭiḥ ‘prākṛtā vaikṛtā vā’ iti pā.| prākṛtī vaikṛtī vā, anubandhyarūpā anubandharūpā vā, ekaśo dviśo vā samastā vā, ‘rūkṣādibhiḥ samastairbhāvairalpairvā’ iti pā.| raukṣyādibhiḥ sarvairbhāvairalpairvā, evamādiduṣṭiduṣṭena doṣeṇa ‘yā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yā āmayasya rogasya nirvṛttirutpattiḥ ‘asau’ iti pā.| sā samprāptirucyate| yathā cānuvisarpateti anekadhā doṣāṇāṃ visarpaṇaṃ gatirūrdhvādhastiryagādibhedena, tathā visarpatā saṃsarpatā| samprāptiparyāyāvāha śāstre vyavahārārthaṃ lakṣaṇārthaṃ ca– jātirāgatiriti| jātyādibhiḥ ‘śabdairyo'rtho'bhidhīyate’ iti pā.| śabdairyā'bhidhīyate sā samprāptiriti| “ ‘jātirāgatiriti’ iti pā.| jātirāgatirityarthaḥ janmā'pi jñānakāraṇam, ajātasya jñānābhāvāt” ityāha haricandraḥ “atraike vyādhijanmamātramantyakāraṇavyāpārajanyaṃ samprāptimāhuḥ| iyaṃ ca samprāptiryadyapi nidānādivadvyādhibodhikā na bhavati, tathā'pi nānutpannasya vyādherliṅgaṃ bhavatīti kṛtvā utpattervyādhyupalambhakatvaṃ varṇayanti| etaccānye nānumanyante; yato naivaṃ sati samprāptitaḥ kaścidviśeṣo vyādheradhigamyate| na cāyaṃ niyamaḥ– yadutpanna eva paraṃ vyādhirupalabhyate, yato nidānapūrvarūpābhyāmanutpanno'pi vyādhirbhāvitvenopalabhyate; tasmādvyādhijanakadoṣavyāpāraviśeṣayuktaṃ vyādhijanmeha samprāptiśabdena vācyam, ata eva paryāye ‘āgatiḥ’ ityuktam| āgatirhi utpādakakāraṇasya vyādhijananaparyantaṃ gamanam| iyaṃ ca samprāptirvyādhiviśeṣaṃ bodhayatveva, yathā jvare “sa yadā prakupitaḥ praviśyāmāśayam” ityārabhya “tadā jvaramabhinirvartayati” ityantena yā samprāptirucyate, tathā jvarasyāmāśayadūṣakatvāgnyupaghātakatvarasadūṣakatvādayo dharmāḥ pratīyante| naca vācyam– doṣāṇāmayamāmāśayadūṣakatvādirdharmaḥ, tataśca kāraṇadharmāṇāṃ nidānagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavatīti; yataḥ kāraṇadharmo'pyayaṃ vyādhijanakadoṣavyāpārarūpaḥ samprāptiśabdena viśeṣabodhanārthaṃ pṛthakkṛtvocyate; yathā– liṅgatvāviśeṣe'pi bhāvivyādhibodhakatvaviśeṣāt pūrvarūpaṃ pṛthagucyate| ata eva vāgbhaṭenāpyevameva samprāptilakṣaṇamuktam– “yathāduṣṭena doṣeṇa yathā cānuvisarpatā| nirvṛttirāmayasyāsau samprāptirjātirāgatiḥ||” iti carakaṭīkāyāṃ nidānasthāne (ca. ni. a. 1) samprāptivivaraṇe cakraḥ| bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ| etenaitaduktaṃ bhavati– nahi nidānādivadbodhakatvena jñānakāraṇatvaṃ, kintu ‘viṣayatvena’ iti pā.| bodhaviṣayatvena| tanna ityanye, ālokacakṣurāderiva evaṃvidhasamprāpteścikitsāyāmanupayogāt| na cāsti niyamaḥ jātameva ‘jñāyate’ iti pā.| vijñāyate iti, ‘ajātasyāpi’ iti pā.| ajātasya vyādhernidānapūrvarūpābhyāṃ vṛṣṭyāderiva meghādinā jñāyamānatvāt| atha jātamiti janmāvacchinnamucyate, vṛṣṭyādikaṃ ca bhaviṣyajjanmāvacchinnameva, yasya tu kālatraye'pi janma nāsti tanna jñāyata eva; ‘tathā'pi na vyādhijanmasamprāptiḥ’ ityatra ‘na’ ityeva kvacitpustakeṣu pāṭhaḥ| tathā'pi na vyādhijanma samprāptiḥ; janmavadālokacakṣurāderapi ‘bādhyatvāpatteḥ’ iti pā.| vācyatvāpatteḥ, tairapi vinā ‘jātamiti vijñānābhāvāt’ iti pā.| jñānābhāvāt| tasmāt ‘doṣetikartavyatopalakṣitaṃ vyādhijanmeha samprāptiḥ natu kevalaṃ janma’ ‘iti bhaṭṭāraharicandrābhiprāyaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti bhaṭṭāraharicandrābhiprāyaḥ| vāgbhaṭenāpi ‘yathāduṣṭena’ (vā. ni. a. 1) ityādi vadatā viśiṣṭameva vyādhijanma samprāptiruktā; tathā ‘ca sati kriyāviśeṣo’ iti pā.| sati kriyāviśeṣo'pi labhyate; yathā– jvare āmāśayadūṣaṇāgnihananādibodhe laṅghanapācanasvedādikaraṇamiti| samprāptiścaivaṃvidhā yadyapi doṣāṇāmavāntaravyāpāratvena doṣagrahaṇenaiva prāpyate, tathā'pi cikitsāviśeṣārthameva pṛthak kriyate; yathā– ‘jñāpakatvāviśeṣe'pi’ iti pā.| vyādherjñāpakatvāviśeṣe'pi pūrvarūpameva rūpāt pṛthagiti| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasmāt “doṣetikartavyatopalakṣitaṃ vyādhijanma samprāptiḥ”, ityeva lakṣaṇam||10||

atha samprāptilakṣaṇamāha– ‘yathetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathetyādi| yena prakāreṇa duṣṭaḥ kupito vātādyanyatamo doṣo yathāduṣṭastena yathāduṣṭena doṣeṇa yathā cānuvisarpatā dehamanudhāvatā sanniveśaviśeṣeṇa gacchatā pratyāmayaṃ yā nirvṛttirutpattirnirdiṣṭā sā samprāptiḥ| sā ca jātirāgatiśca kathyate paryāyaśabdatvena| ‘vyādhijanyasamprāptirityeke’ iti pā.| vyādhijanma samprāptirityeke| yathā– jvarasya ‘malamūtretyādilakṣaṇalakṣitā| tatra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | malamūtretyādilakṣaṇalakṣitā| tatra malānāmāmāśayapraveśanena, tathā ‘cānugamanena’ iti pā.| cāmānugamanena, tathā srotonirodhena, tathā ca paktisthānājjvalananirasanena, tathā ca tenaiva jāṭhareṇa vahninā tathā'bhisaraṇena ‘sakaladehatāpena’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sakaladehatāpena sakalaṃ gātramuṣṇaṃ kurvatā, ‘evaṃvidhayātmaprāptyā’ iti pā.| evaṃvidhayā samprāptyā jvaro'yamiti niścīyate| evamatīsārādiṣvapyevaṃvidhaiva ‘cintyā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | cintyā samprāptiḥ||10||

div.ab: saṅkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālaviśeṣataḥ | sā bhidyate yathā'traiva vakṣyante'ṣṭau jvarā iti ||11|| doṣāṇāṃ samavetānāṃ vikalpoṃ'śāṃśakalpanā | svātantryapāratantryābhyāṃ vyādheḥ prādhānyamādiśet ||12|| hetvādikārtsnyāvayavairbalābalaviśeṣaṇam | naktandinartubhuktāṃśairvyādhikālo yathāmalam ||13|| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

ab.seg: tasyā aupādhikabhedamāha– saṅkhyetyādinā, sā bhidyata ityantena| atra ca prādhānyopādānādaprādhānyaṃ ca tatpratiyogitayā boddhavyam| ata eva ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vivaraṇe svātantryapāratantryābhyāmiti vakṣyati| evaṃ bale'pi vyākhyeyam| saṅkhyādikameva vivṛṇoti– yathetyādi| aṣṭau jvarā iti saṅkhyāvivaraṇam| aṣṭatvaṃ ca vātādikāraṇabhedāt; ‘ekajā dvandvajāśca trayaḥ’ ityeva paṭhyate kvacitpustakeṣu| ekajāstrayo, dvandvajāstrayaḥ, ‘sannipātajaśceka’ iti pā.| sannipātaja eka, āgantujaścaika iti| yadyapi vṛddhairdoṣaiḥ sannipātāstrayodaśa, yaduktaṃ carake– “dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇaiḥ ṣaṭ syurhīnamadhyādhikaiśca ṣaṭ| samaiścaiko vikārāste sannipātāstrayodaśa||” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti; tathā'pyatra tridoṣajatvasāmānyāt sānnipātika ekatvena gaṇitaḥ| evaṃ kāmaśokabhayādyanekakāraṇajo'pyāgantuja ‘āgantutvasāmānyādekatvena’ iti pā.| āgantujatvasāmānyādekatvena nirdiṣṭa ityaṣṭau jvarā iti| vikalpaṃ vivṛṇoti– doṣāṇāmityādi| doṣāṇāṃ samavetānāṃ parasparasambaddhānāṃ; tena dvandvasannipātayorgrahaṇam| aṃśāṃśakalpaneti aṃśā vātādigataraukṣyādayaḥ, tairekadvitryādibhiḥ samastairvā vātādikopāvadhāraṇaṃ vikalpanā| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “sarvairbhāvaistribhirvā'pi dvābhyāmekena vā punaḥ| saṃsarge kupitaḥ kruddhaṃ doṣaṃ doṣo'nudhāvati||” iti (su. sū. a. 21)| evaṃvidhaśca doṣakopo nidānavaicitryādbhavati| tadyathā– vātasya raukṣyaśaityalāghavavaiśadyādiguṇasya evaṅguṇaḥ kaṣāyarasaḥ kalāyaśca ‘sarvairaṃśairvardhakaḥ’ iti pā.| sarvairbhāvairvardhakaḥ, atra ‘tathā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| raukṣyaśaityalāghavaistaṇḍulīyakaḥ, raukṣyaśaityābhyāṃ kāṇḍekṣuḥ, raukṣyeṇa sīdhuḥ; ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā ‘kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇaguṇasya pittasya’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇe| pittasya sarvairbhāvairvardhakaḥ kaṭuko raso madyaṃ ca, hiṅgu ‘kaṭutīkṣṇoṣṇatvaiḥ’ iti pā.| kaṭūṣṇatīkṣṇatvaiḥ, dīpyakastaikṣṇyauṣṇyābhyām, auṣṇyena tilāḥ; tathā ‘snehamādhuryaśaityaguṇasya śleṣmaṇaḥ’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇe| śleṣmaṇaḥ sarvairbhāvairvardhako ‘madhurarasaḥ’ iti pā.| madhuro raso māhiṣaṃ ca payaḥ, snehagauravamādhuryai rājādanaphalaṃ, kaśeruḥ śaityagauravābhyāṃ, ‘śaityenaikena mṛṇālam’ iti ātaṅkadarpaṇe| śaityena kṣīriṇāṃ phalānīti| aparaguṇodāharaṇaprakārā ‘jejjaṭādīnāṃ granthe jñātavyāḥ| “sarvairaṃśaiḥ kaṣāyaśca kalāyo vātavardhanaḥ| pittasya kaṭuko dīpyaḥ, śleṣmaṇo māhiṣaṃ payaḥ||”; viśeṣeṇa granthasya vistaratvāpatteratra na likhitāḥ|’ iti pā.| jejjaṭagadādharavāpyacandravyākhyāviśeṣāśca vistaratvāpatteratra na likhitāḥ| prādhānyaṃ vivṛṇoti– svātantryapāratantryābhyāmiti| anubandhyānubandhabhāvenetyarthaḥ| atrāpi ‘doṣāṇāṃ samavetānām’ ityanuvartanīyam| ‘aprādhānyaṃ ca’ iti śeṣaḥ, gamyamānatvānnopadarśitam| tena svātantryāt prādhānyaṃ, pāratantryādaprādhānyamiti sidhyati| balaṃ vivṛṇoti– hetvādītyādi| hetupūrvarūparūpāṇāṃ sākalyādvyādherbalavattvaṃ, teṣāmavayavenaikadeśenābalavattvam| kālaṃ vivṛṇoti– ‘naktamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | naktamityādi| naktaṃ rātriḥ, dinamahaḥ, ṛtavo vasantādayaḥ, bhuktamāhāraḥ, eṣāmaṃśairekadeśaiḥ; vyādhikālo vyādhivṛddhihānihetukālaḥ| atra, ‘ṛtvoraṃśāḥ’ iti pā.| ṛtoraṃśāḥ katipayānyahorātrāṇi, yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “ṛtvorantyādisaptāhāvṛtusandhiriti smṛtaḥ|” iti (vā. sū. a. 3); ‘atha vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | atha vā saṃvatsararūpasya kālasya ṛturūpoṃ'śa ṛtvaṃśa ityevamapi yojyaṃ; ‘natu ṛturūpakālasyāṃśā vyādhyutpādakā na bhavanti, viśiṣṭasya vyādhihetutvāt; tatoṃ'śaśabdasya kathamṛtuśabdaprayogaḥ? ucyate– tanna, saṃvatsararūpasya ca kālasya ṛturūpoṃ'śaḥ ṛtvaṃśa iti yojyaṃ, natvekasya ṛtordināni madhyāntādyaṃśāḥ’ iti pā.| natvekasya ṛtordinādivadādimadhyāntā ṛtvaṃśāḥ, ṛtoḥ samuditasya tatra kāraṇatvenoktatvāt| yathāmalaṃ yathādoṣaṃ; tadyathā– rātrerādau śleṣmā, madhye pittaṃ, śeṣe vāyuḥ; evaṃ dinasya; vasante kaphasya, śaradi pittasya, varṣāsu vāyoḥ atra ‘kopaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| kopaḥ; evaṃ bhuktādau bhuktamātre kaphasya, madhye pacyamānāvasthāyāṃ pittasya, ‘ante samyakpariṇate vāyoḥ iti|’ iti pā.| ante samyakpariṇate bhukte vāyoḥ prakopa iti| taduktaṃ vāgbhaṭenaiva– “te vyāpino'pi hṛnnābhyoradhomadhyordhvasaṃśrayāḥ| vayo'horātribhuktānāṃ te'ntamadhyādigāḥ kramāt||” iti (vā. sū. a. 1)| atra te iti krameṇa vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ| nanu, samprāptibhede carakeṇa saṅkhyādivadvidhirapyuktaḥ; yathā– “dvividhā vyādhayo nijāgantubhedena” (ca. ni. a. 1), ‘dvividhaṃ raktapittam” (ca. ni. a. 2)’ iti pā.| “trividhaṃ raktapittam” (ca. sū. a. 11) ityādi; tat kuto'tra vidhirnoktaḥ? ucyate, saṅkhyāgrahaṇena vidheravarodhaḥ, tasyāvyabhicaritasaṅkhyāyogitvāt| vidhisaṅkhyayoścāyaṃ bhedaḥ– vidhirhi prakāraḥ, sa cābhinnajātīyānāmeva kasyaciddharmāntarasyānvayādbhavati, yathā– raktapittatvāviśeṣe'pi ūrdhvagādiprakāro bhavati; saṅkhyā tu bhinnatvamātre'pi; yathā– catvāro ghaṭāḥ, aṣṭau jvarā iti| atraiva vidhirhi prakāraḥ, sa ca bhinneṣu na yuktaḥ, ataḥ kvacitpustake ‘saṅkhyādibhinneṣu vyādhiṣu’ etatsthāne ‘saṅkhyādibhinneṣvapi’ iti pā.| saṅkhyādibhinneṣu vyādhiṣu kāraṇadharmānugataḥ prakāro yujyate| tathā ca nyāyavido bruvate– “samānena dharmeṇa parigraho bhedānāṃ yatra kriyate sa vidhiḥ, saṅkhyā tu bhedamātram|” iti; vaiyākaraṇā api vyācakṣate– “anvayavān prakāro, niranvayo bhedaḥ” iti vāpyacandro likhitavān| nanu yathāṃ'śāṃśavikalpanādinā jvaro jñāyate na tathā saṅkhyayā| ucyate– saṅkhyābhedena vyādherdoṣabhedo jñāyate, yato jvarādikaṃ svarūpato jñātvā cikitsārthaṃ viśeṣo jijñāsyaḥ, katamo'yaṃ jvaraḥ? iti; ‘tasmin jñāte viśeṣo bhavatīti paramparayā kāraṇatvaṃ saṅkhyāyāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasmin jñāte viśeṣo bhavatīti paramparayā kāraṇatvaṃ saṅkhyāyāḥ| ‘tatra yadyutpadyamāna’ iti pā.| atra yadutpanna evāsau doṣabhedādbhinno jā(jñā)tastato yuktamasya paryeṣaṇaṃ katamo'yamiti| ‘kutaḥ? cikitsāviśeṣārtham| iti samprāptilakṣaṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kutaḥ? cikitsāviśeṣārtham| iti samprāptilakṣaṇam||11-13||

atha samprāpterbhedānāha– saṅkhyetyādi| sā ca samprāptiḥ saṅkhyādiviśeṣeṇa bhidyate| saṅkhyā ca vikalpaśca prādhānyaṃ ca balaṃ ca kālaśca ta evaṃ, teṣāṃ viśeṣaḥ saṅkhyāvikalpaprādhānyabalakālaviśeṣastasmātsamprāptirbahudhā sampadyate| tatra saṅkhyāviśeṣo yathā– ihaivāsmin granthe ‘saṃvakṣyate’ iti pā.| vakṣyate– aṣṭau jvarā iti; evamapi pañca kāsā iti pañca gulmā ityādi, evamādayaḥ saṅkhyāviśeṣāḥ samprāptibhedāḥ| saṅkhyānantaraṃ vikalpaṃ vivṛṇoti– ‘doṣāṇāmityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | doṣāṇāmityādi| doṣāṇāṃ vātādīnāṃ, samavetānāmekasmin vyādhau kvacitpustake ‘saṅghaṭṭitānāṃ, yā aṃśāṃśavibhāgena’ etatsthāne ‘saṅghaṭṭitānāmaṃśāṃśavibhāgena’ iti pā.| saṅghaṭṭitānāṃ, yā aṃśāṃśavibhāgena kāryānumeyenānumānena yathā– parvato'yaṃ vahnimān dhūmavattvāditivannirūpaṇaṃ sa vikalpaḥ| aṃśaśca aṃśaśca aṃśāṃśau, tābhyāṃ kalpanā anekavidho viśeṣo ‘vātādigatatvāt raukṣyādiko’ iti pā.| vātādigataraukṣyādikaḥ, yathā– kimayaṃ vātaḥ sarvairguṇaiḥ kupitaḥ ‘kim’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kiṃ tribhiḥ kiṃ dvābhyāṃ kiṃ vaikena; kimidaṃ pittaṃ sarvairguṇaiḥ kupitaṃ, kiṃ tribhiḥ, kiṃ dvābhyāṃ, kimekena| kimayaṃ śleṣmā ‘sarvai rasaiḥ’ iti pā.| sarvairbhāvaiḥ kupitaḥ, kiṃ tribhiḥ, kiṃ dvābhyāṃ, kimekenetyādikā kalpanā| tadyathā– vāyo raukṣyaśaityalāghavavaiśadyādiguṇasyaivaṅguṇaḥ kaṣāyo rasaḥ ‘kaṣāyarasaḥ kalāyaśca sarvairaṃśaiśca vāyorvardhakaḥ’ iti pā.| kalāyaśca sarvairaṃśairvardhakaḥ, raukṣyaśaityalāghavaistribhistaṇḍulīyakaḥ, raukṣyaśaityābhyāṃ kāṇḍekṣuḥ raukṣyeṇaikena guṇena sīdhuḥ; tathā sarvairaṃśaiḥ ‘kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇaiḥ’ iti pā.| kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇaguṇasya pittasya kaṭuko raso madyaṃ ca, kaṭūṣṇatīkṣṇairhiṅgu, dīpyakaṃ tīkṣṇoṣṇābhyām, uṣṇenaikena tilāḥ; evaṃ sarvairaṃśaiḥ snehagauravamādhuryaśaityaguṇasya śleṣmaṇo madhuro raso māhiṣaṃ payaśca, snehagauravamādhuryai rājādanaphalaṃ, ‘kaseruḥ’ iti pā.| kaserukāḥ śaityagauravābhyāṃ, śaityenaikena mṛṇālaṃ śleṣmavardhakam| evamapare'pi jñeyāḥ| doṣāṇāmiti ‘bahutve pṛthaggrahaṇam’ iti pā.| bahutvaṃ pṛthaggrahaṇārtham| samavetānāmiti dvandvasannipātayorgrahaṇam| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “sarvairaṃśaistribhirvā'pi dvābhyāmekena vā punaḥ| saṃsarge kupitaḥ kruddhaṃ doṣaṃ doṣo'nudhāvati||” iti| atha prādhānyaṃ vivṛṇoti– ‘svātantryetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | svātantryetyādi| svātantryaṃ ca pāratantryaṃ ca, tābhyāṃ prādhānyaṃ vyādherādiśet| aprādhānyaṃ ceti śeṣaḥ| ‘tatra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tatra svatantrasya vyādheḥ svanirdiṣṭopakramasādhyatvātprādhānyaṃ, yathā jvarasya| atha balābalaṃ vivṛṇoti-kṛtsnasya bhāvaḥ ‘kārtsnyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kārtsnyaṃ, kārtsnyaṃ ca avayavāśca ‘kārtsnyāvayavāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kārtsnyāvayavāḥ, taiḥ| balaṃ ca abalaṃ ca balābale vyādhisambandhinī, tayorviśeṣaṇaṃ viśiṣṭatā balābalaviśeṣaṇam| tadyathāsaṅkhyena kārtsnyāvayavairādiśet| ādiśabdena prāgrūpādayo gṛhyante| teṣāṃ sākalyād vyādherbalatvaṃ, ‘teṣāmavayavaikadeśenābalatvam’ iti pā.| teṣāmevāvayavaikadeśenābalatvam| tatra pratirogaṃ yannidānamuddiṣṭaṃ tatkiṃ kārtsnyenāsya vyādherutpādakamutaikadeśena? evaṃ prāgrūpamapi kiṃ ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tat samastavyādherlakṣyate utāvayavairekena ca?, upaśayo'pyasya vyādhestarpaṇātarpaṇarūpaḥ, sa kiṃ kārtsnyena sukhānubandhaṃ karoti utāvayavena?; tatra kārtsnyena yathā– raktaśālyādimāṃsaghṛtakṣīradadhivasāmajjātailādinā, avayavena yathā– raktaśālinā māṃsādyanyatamaikena vā; evamanyadapi cintyam kālaṃ vivṛṇoti– naktamityādi| naktaṃ rātriḥ, dinamahaḥ, ṛtavo vasantādayaḥ, bhuktamāhāraḥ, eṣāmaṃśairādimadhyāntalakṣaṇairekadeśairvā; ‘tairyathāmalam’ iti pā.| yathāmalaṃ yathādoṣaṃ; vyādhikālaḥ vyādhivṛddhihānihetukālaḥ| yathā– rātrimukhe śleṣmā, madhye pittaṃ, śeṣe vāyuḥ; evaṃ dinasyāpi pūrvāhne śleṣmā, madhyāhne pittam, aparāhne vāyuḥ; evaṃ ṛtuṣu vasante śleṣmā, grīṣme pittaṃ, varṣāsu vāyuḥ kupyati; evaṃ bhuktamātre kaphasya, madhye pacyamānāvasthāyāṃ pittasya, samyakpariṇatau vāyoḥ kopaḥ| atra saṃvatsararūpasya kālasya kvacitpustake ‘ṛturūpā aṃśā ṛtvaṃśā’ etatsthāne ‘ṛtvaṃśa’ iti pā.| ṛturūpā aṃśā ṛtvaṃśā iti yojyaṃ, na tvekasya ṛtordinādivat| kecana ṛtvaṃśāḥ katipayāhorātrāṇi kathayanti| yaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe– “ ‘ṛtvorantyādisaptāhānṛtusandhiriti’ iti pā.| ṛtvorantyādisaptāhāvṛtusandhiriti smṛtaḥ|” iti||11-13||

div.ab: iti prokto kvacitpustake ‘nidānārthaḥ sa vyāsenopadekṣyate’ etatsthāne ‘nidānārthastadvyāsenopadekṣyate’ iti pā.| nidānārthaḥ sa vyāsenopadekṣyate |14| (vā. ni. a. 1) | ‘uktaṃ nidānapañcakamupasaṃharati– itītyādi|’ etatsthāne ‘uktanidānapañcakamupasaṃharati– iti prokto nidānārtha iti|’ iti pā.|

uktaṃ nidānapañcakamupasaṃharati– itītyādi| itiśabdaḥ samāptau| nidānaśabdo'tra sāmānyavacanaḥ, artho'bhidheyaḥ| tannidānaṃ saṅkṣepeṇa svarūpalakṣaṇamātreṇoktam, adhunā vyāsena vistareṇopadekṣyate kathayiṣyate; sakalena granthena pratirogaṃ nidānapūrvarūpādaya eva tattadviśeṣairvaktavyā ityarthaḥ|14|– ‘uktanidānaprapañcamupasaṃharati’ iti pā.|
