uktanidānapañcakamupasaṃharati– ‘itītyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | itītyādi| itiśabdaḥ prakāre, anena ‘saṅkṣepeṇa’ iti pā.| saṅkṣepākhyena prakāreṇa, ‘yathā nirdiṣṭena’ iti pā.| yathānirdiṣṭo nidānārtho nidānābhidheyaḥ, samāsataḥ saṅkṣepataḥ kathitaḥ| nidānaśabdo'tra sāmānyaḥ prāgrūpādiṣu| ya eva nidānārthaḥ samāsena proktastameva ‘vyāsato’ iti pā.| vyāsena vistareṇa upadekṣyate kathayiṣyate| tena sakalena granthena pratirogaṃ nidānapūrvarūpādaya eva tattadviśeṣairvaktavyā ityarthaḥ|14|–
sarveṣāmeva rogāṇāṃ nidānaṃ kupitā malāḥ ||14|| tatprakopasya tu proktaṃ vividhāhitasevanam |15| (vā. ni. a. 1) |

dvividhaṃ hi rogasya kāraṇaṃ viprakṛṣṭaṃ sannikṛṣṭaṃ ca; tatra viprakṛṣṭaṃ ‘āhārādi’ iti pā.| viruddhāhārādi, sannikṛṣṭaṃ vātādi, tasya vātādeḥ sarvarogeṣvavyabhicaritakāraṇatvamāha– sarveṣāmityādi| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “nāsti rogo vinā doṣairyasmāttasmādvicakṣaṇaḥ anuktamapi doṣāṇāṃ liṅgairvyādhimupācaret|” (su. sū. a. 35/19) iti asyāgre kvacitpustake ‘nanu, āgantuke kathaṃ doṣapūrvakatvaṃ? yatastatprakopakāraṇamāhārādikaṃ nāsti? ucyate– abhicārābhighātādinā vyathotpadyate, tena doṣotpattiḥ, tathā ca vyādhiriti; tathā'bhicārādinā'dṛṣṭapreritadoṣotpattiḥ, evamprakāreṇa doṣapūrvakatvam’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | (su. sū. a. 35)| āgantuvyādhiṣu yadyapyutpattau doṣakopo nāsti, tathā'pyutpattyanantaramavaśyambhāvī; utpannadravye guṇayogavat| yaduktaṃ carake– “āganturhi vyathāpūrvasamutpanno jaghanyaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vaiṣamyamāpādayati|” iti (ca. sū. a. 20)| nidānaṃ kāraṇam| malā doṣāḥ, malinīkaraṇāt| nanu, vātādīnāṃ kimidaṃ doṣatvam?; atrāhureke– svātantryeṇa dūṣakatvaṃ doṣatvam ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti; rasādidūṣyavyavacchedārthaṃ ‘svātantryeṇa’ iti padaṃ, te hi vātādiduṣṭāḥ santo dūṣyāntaradūṣakāḥ| atrāhuranye– kimidaṃ svātantryaṃ? kiṃ doṣāntaranirapekṣatvaṃ? hetvantaranirapekṣatvaṃ vā? ādye vātasyaiva doṣatvaṃ syāt, natu vātasāpekṣayoḥ kaphapittayoḥ; yaduktam– “pittaṃ paṅgu kaphaḥ paṅguḥ paṅgavo maladhātavaḥ| vāyunā yatra nīyante tatra gacchanti meghavat||” iti; dvitīye vātasyāpi na doṣatvaṃ, kaphapittayoriva nidānasāpekṣasyaiva tasya dūṣakatvāt; tasmāt “prakṛtyārambhakatve sati ‘duṣṭikāraṇatvam’ iti pā.| duṣṭikartṛtvaṃ doṣatvam” iti lakṣaṇam| rasaraktādinivṛttyarthaṃ ‘prakṛtyārambhakatvam’ iti viśeṣaṇam| nahi vātādiprakṛtivacchāstre ‘rasaraktādiprakṛtiruktaḥ puruṣaḥ, raktadūṣitaśukrāderasādhyatvena dehārambhakatvaṃ nāsti; raktasya dehārambhakatve satyapi prakṛtyārambhakatvaṃ nāsti, anabhidhānāt; śāstre na raktaprakṛtiruktaḥ puruṣaḥ’ iti pā.| rasaraktādiprakṛtiruktā; vātādiprakṛtitvaṃ ca śarīrasya vātādidūṣitaśukraśoṇitārabdhatvam asyāgre kvacitpustake ‘tatra vātādidūṣitatvaṃ nāma śukraśoṇitasaṃyogakāle śukraśoṇitayoradhikataradoṣādhikaraṇatvam, anyathā duṣṭayostayordehārambhakatvameva na syāt; uktaṃ ca– “vātapittakaphādiduṣṭaretasaḥ prajotpādane na samarthāḥ|” iti| tatrobhayorekādhikaraṇatvena ekadoṣajā prakṛtiḥ, bhinnādhikaraṇatvena dvandvajā tridoṣajā vā| vātādiprakṛtitvaṃ śarīrasya vātādidūṣitaśukraśoṇitārabdhatvāt’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ upalabhyate || yadāha carakaḥ– “doṣānuśayitā hyeṣāṃ dehaprakṛtirucyate|”; tathā– “vātalādyāḥ sadā''turāḥ|” iti (ca. sū. a. 7)| suśrutenāpi prakṛtilakṣaṇe “vātaprakṛtiḥ ‘sphuṭitacaraṇo jāgaruko'navasthitacittaḥ” (su. śā. a. 4) ityādi paṭhitam| prakṛtirogayoścāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ’ iti pā.| sphuṭitakaracaraṇo jāgaruko'navasthitacittaḥ” (su. śā. a. 4) ityādyuktam| prakṛtirogayoścāyaṃ ‘viśeṣaḥ’ iti pā.| bhedaḥ– prakṛtirapathyasevayā nātyantaṃ bādhate, yaduktam– “viṣajāto yathā kīṭo viṣeṇa na vipadyate| tadvat prakṛtibhirdehastajjātatvānna bādhyate||” (su. śā. a. 4) iti saṅkṣepaḥ| vistarastu suśrutaślokavārtike ‘praśnasahasranidānākhye’ iti pā.| praśnavidhānākhye ṭīkāsu ca draṣṭavyaḥ| nanu, ‘prakṛtyārambhakatvaṃ doṣatvam’ ityevāstu| satyaṃ, vipakṣādvyāvṛttirbhavatyeva, kintu ‘doṣasvarūpatvam’ iti pā.| doṣasvarūpaṃ noktaṃ syāditi| suśrutādibhirvātāderiva prakopakālaprakopaṇanirharaṇasthānaviśeṣarogaviśeṣaliṅgaviśeṣa-cikitsāviśeṣāṇāmabhidhānādraktasyāpi doṣatvaṃ ‘pūrvaṭīkākārairāṣāḍhadharmadāsādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| pūrvaṭīkākārairāṣāḍhadharmasvāmidāsādibhiḥ svīkṛtaṃ tadapyetena vyavacchinnam, adhunātanairasvīkriyamāṇatvāt| nanu, doṣāścet kāraṇaṃ tarhi teṣāṃ sarvadā dehe sadbhāvāt sarvadā rogotpādakatvaprasaṅga ityata āha– kupitā iti, vikṛtimāpannāḥ| nanu, tatprakopaḥ svabhāvāt, kāraṇāntarādvā? nādyaḥ, pūrvavatprasaṅgāt; atha kāraṇāntarāditi kiṃ tadityāha– vividhāhitasevanamiti| vividhasya nānāvidhasya, ahitasya asātmyendriyārthasaṃyogaprajñāparādhapariṇāmalakṣaṇasya sevanamiti||14||-

sannikṛṣṭakāraṇatvena vātādīnāṃ sarvarogeṣvavyabhicaritakāraṇatvamāha– ‘sarveṣāmityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sarveṣāmityādi| kupitatvena hi dhātūnāṃ ‘malinīkaraṇadoṣā’ iti pā.| malinīkaraṇāddoṣā eva malā ityucyante| kupitā vikṛtimāpannā vātapittakaphāḥ, ‘sarveṣāmeva’ iti pā.| sarveṣāmapi rogāṇāṃ, nidānaṃ kāraṇam| tatprakopasyeti tadityanena vātādayaḥ parāmṛśyante; tasya tu vātādiprakopasya, nidānaṃ kāraṇaṃ, vividhaṃ nānāprakāramahitasevanamahitānuṣṭhānaṃ, proktaṃ ‘kathitam’ iti pā.| kathitamiti||14||–

ab.seg: nidānārthakaro rogo rogasyāpyupajāyate ||15||

nanu, kimetadeva nidānam, utānyadapyastītyataścarakavacanamupanyasyati– nidānārthakara ityādi| apiśabdo'tra bhinnakrame| rogo'pi nidānārthakaro rogasya| ‘ayamarthaḥ’ iti pā.| asyāyamarthaḥ– nidānena yo'rthaḥ kriyate vyādhyākhyaḥ, sa rogeṇāpīti| rogo'pi rogakara iti vācye yannidānārthakara ityakarot, tenaivaṃ gamayati– rogo'pi rogāntaraṃ kurvāṇo nidānāntaropabṛṃhitabala eva ‘karotīti’ iti pā.| karoti; evaṃ rogo rogasya nidānamupajāyate ityeva ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | yojanā||15||

nanu, kimetadeva nidānamanyadapyastītyāha– ‘nidānārthakara ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānārthakara ityādi| rogasya vyādheḥ rogo'pi nidānārthakara upajāyate| nidānena yo'rthaḥ kriyate vyādhyākhyaḥ sa rogeṇāpītyarthaḥ||15||

div.ab: tadyathā jvarasantāpādraktapittamudīryate | raktapittājjvarastābhyāṃ śoṣasyāpyupajāyate ||16|| plīhābhivṛddhyā jaṭharaṃ jaṭharācchotha eva ca | arśobhyo jāṭharaṃ duḥkhaṃ gulmaścāpyupajāyate ||17|| (divāsvāpādidoṣaiśca pratiśyāyaśca jāyate) | pratiśyāyādatho kāsaḥ kāsāt sañjāyate kṣayaḥ | kṣayo rogasya hetutve śoṣasyāpyupajāyate ||18|| (ci. ni. a. 8) |

ab.seg: atraiva dṛṣṭāntamāha– tadyathetyādi| tābhyāmiti raktapittāt jvarācca| duḥkhamiti ‘duḥkhayatīti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | duḥkhayatīti duḥkhaṃ pīḍākaram| ayaṃ ca duḥkhaśabdo liṅgavipariṇāmena sarveṣveva jvarādiṣu yojya iti vāpyacandraḥ| gulmaścāpyupajāyata iti arśobhya eva| kāsāt sañjāyate kṣaya iti ‘ojaḥ prabhṛtīnām’ iti śeṣaḥ| sa ca kṣayo rogasya hetutve upajāyate| kasya rogasyetyāha– śoṣasyeti, rājayakṣmaṇaḥ| atra kecit haricandrādibhirvyākhyātaṃ pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti– “kṣayo rogasya hetutve śoṣaścāpyupajāyate|” iti ‘asyāyamarthaḥ’ iti pā.| asyārthaḥ– kṣayo rājayakṣmā, uroga uraḥkṣataḥ, samāhāradvandvenaikavacanaṃ, tasya hetutve śoṣo dhātukṣaya upajāyata iti| nanu, carake sarvaṃ nidānaṃ traividhyena saṅgṛhītaṃ ‘asātmyendriyārthasaṃyoga’ (ca. sū. a. 11) ityādinā, tataśca rogasyāpi nidānatvamācakṣāṇaḥ ‘traividhyaṃ katham’ iti pā.| svoktaṃ nidānatraividhyasaṅgrahaṃ kathaṃ na viruṇaddhi?; atraike samādhimabhidadhati– trividhaṃ yannidānamuktaṃ tat sarvavyādhiviṣayam, idaṃ tu pratiniyataviṣayaṃ, yato na sarve rogā rogājjāyante, kiṃ tarhi kaścideva vyādhiḥ ‘kutaścidrogājjāyate’ iti pā.| kutaścidrogāditi caturthamevaitannidānaṃ rogākhyamiti| anye tvāhuḥ– rogasya rogo'pi nidānaṃ ‘bhavat’ iti pā.| bhavan trividhanidānavyatirekeṇa na bhavatyeva; yato yāvadayaṃ jvaro'sātmyendriyārthasaṃyogādibhirupabṛṃhitabalo na bhavati na tāvadraktapittamārabhate, tasmād vyādhyutpāde trividha eva hetuḥ sākṣāt pāramparyeṇa veti||16-18||

atraiva dṛṣṭāntamāha– tadyathetyādi| kāraṇabhūtāt jvarasantāpāt raktapittamudīryate utpādyate, ‘kāraṇabhūtādraktapittājjvaraḥ samupajāyate’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kāraṇabhūtādraktapittājjvaraḥ samupajāyate, tābhyāṃ raktapittajvarābhyāṃ śoṣaśca upajāyate; plīhābhivṛddhyā jaṭharamudaravikāraḥ, tasmāt jaṭharāt śothaḥ, arśobhya eva jaṭharaṃ gulmaścāpyupajāyate, duḥkhamiti, duḥkhaṃ pīḍākaram| duḥkhaśabdo liṅgavipariṇāmena sarveṣveva jvarādiṣu yojyaḥ, atha pratiśyāyātkāso jāyate, kāsātkṣayaḥ sañjāyate, ‘ojaḥprabhṛtīnām’ iti śeṣaḥ; sa ca kṣayaḥ rogasya hetutve upajāyate, kasya rogasyetyāha– śoṣasyeti||16-18||

div.ab: te pūrvaṃ kevalā rogāḥ paścāddhetvarthakāriṇaḥ |19| (ca. ni. a. 8) |

nanu, ya ime rogā rogāntarasya nidānatvenoktāste kimutpannamātrā eva rogaṃ janayanti ‘utā'nantarakālaṃ vā ityata’ iti pā.| utānantarakālamityata āha– te pūrvamityādi| te vyādhaya upabṛṃhakahetvalābhāt prāk kevalāḥ svatantrāḥ kvacitpustake ‘santo rogā eva rujākartṛtvāt’ etatsthāne ‘rogā rujākartṛtvāt’ iti pā.| santo rogā eva rujākartṛtvāt; paścādupabṛṃhakahetulābhāt, hetornidānasya yo'rtho yatprayojanaṃ vyādhijananākhyaṃ tat kurvanti| yathā– ‘jvarāt’ iti pā.| jvaro raktapittamiti|19|–

te vyādhayaḥ prāk kevalāḥ svatantrāḥ santo rogā eva, rujākartṛtvāt; ūrdhvamupabṛṃhakahetulābhāddhetornidānasya yo'rthaḥ prayojanaṃ vyādhijananākhyaṃ ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tat kurvanti, yathā jvaro raktapittamiti|19|–
kaściddhi rogo rogasya heturbhūtvā praśāmyati ||19|| na praśāmyati cāpyanyo hetutvaṃ kurute'pi ca | evaṃ kṛcchratamā nṝṇāṃ dṛśyante vyādhisaṅkarāḥ ||20|| (ca. ni. a. 8) |

ab.seg: tasyaiva rogajanakasya vyādhervaicitryamāha– kaścidityādi| evamuktaprakāreṇa; vyādhisaṅkarā vyādhimelakāḥ dṛśyante| yathā– pratiśyāyo na nivartate kāsaśca jāyate, arśo na nivartate jaṭharagulmau syātāmiti| kṛcchratamatvaṃ caiṣāṃ bahuvidhaduḥkhajanakatvāt, prāyo viruddhopakramācceti||19-20||

tasyaiva rogajanakavyādhervaicitryamāha– kaścidityādi| evamuktaprakāreṇa, vyādhisaṅkarā vyādhimelakāḥ, kṛcchratamā dṛśyante; evaṃ kaścidrogo rogāntarasya kāraṇaṃ bhūtvā svayaṃ praśāmyati, anyaśca na praśāmyati; yathā pratiśyāyo na nivartate kāsaścotpadyate, arśo na vyāvartate jaṭharagulmau syātām| kṛcchratamatvaṃ caiṣāṃ bahuvidhaduḥkhajanakatvātprāyo viruddhopakramatvācca||19-20||
tasmādyatnena sadvaidyairicchadbhiḥ siddhimuddhatām | jñātavyo vakṣyate yo'yaṃ jvarādīnāṃ viniścayaḥ ||21||

uktanidānapañcakasya ‘roganivṛttilakṣaṇasiddhyādihetutvenāvaśyam’ iti pā.| roganivṛttilakṣaṇasiddhihetutvenāvaśyaṃ jñātavyatāmāha– tasmādityādi| uddhatāṃ bahuviṣayatvena mahatīm| viniścayo nidānamiti| atha vakṣyamāṇavikāreṣu prakṛtisamasamavāyavikṛtiviṣamasamavāyādijñānārthaṃ carakoktā vātādiguṇāḥ likhyante– “rūkṣaḥ śīto laghuḥ sūkṣmaścalo'tha viśadaḥ kharaḥ| viparītaguṇairdravyairmārutaḥ sampraśāmyati|| sasnehamuṣṇaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca dravamamlaṃ saraṃ kaṭu| viparītaguṇaiḥ pittaṃ dravyairāśu praśāmyati|| guruśītamṛdusnigdhamadhurasthirapicchilāḥ| śleṣmaṇaḥ praśamaṃ yānti viparītaguṇairguṇāḥ||” iti (ca. sū. a. 1)||21||

uktanidānapañcakaṃ roganivṛttilakṣaṇasiddhyādihetutvenāvaśyaṃ jñātavyamāha– tasmādityādi| tasmātkāraṇāt, uttamāṃ bahuviṣayatvena mahatīṃ, siddhimicchadbhirvaidyairyo'yaṃ jvarādīnāṃ viniścayo vakṣyate kathyate sa yatnena jñātavyaḥ||21||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne ‘pañcalakṣaṇanidānam’ iti pā.| pañcanidānalakṣaṇaṃ samāptam ||1||
iti ‘śrīmān ... ’ iti pā.| śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ ‘pañcalakṣaṇanidānam’ iti pā.| pañcanidānalakṣaṇaṃ samāptam||1||
iti ‘śrīmān ... ’ iti pā.| śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe ‘nidānaṭīkāyām’ iti pā.| rugviniścayavyākhyāne sarvaroganidānādipañcakakathanam||1||

div.head: jvaranidānam

ab.seg: atha jvaranidānam | dakṣāpamānasaṅkruddharudraniḥśvāsasambhavaḥ | jvaro'ṣṭadhā pṛthagdvandvasaṅghātāgantujaḥ smṛtaḥ ||1||

atha sarvarogaprādhānyāt prathamaṃ jvaro vācyaḥ| prādhānyaṃ ca tasya śārīrarogeṣu prathamotpannatvāt, ‘balavattvācca, dehendriyamanastāpitvācca, janmanidhanayoravaśyambhāvitvācca,’ iti pā.| balavattvāt, dehendriyamanastāpitvāt, janmanidhanayoravaśyambhāvitvāt, sthāvarajaṅgamarūpasarvabhūtavyāpitvācca; naivamanye vikārāḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “dehendriyamanastāpī sarvarogāgrajo balī| jvaraḥ pradhāno rogāṇāmukto bhagavatā purā|| tasya prāṇisapatnasya dhruvasya pralayodaye|” (ca. ci. a. 3) ityādi; yāvad “bhagavan! vaktumarhasi” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tathā– “jvareṇāviśatā bhūtaṃ nahi kiñcinna tapyate|” (ca. ci. a. 3) ityādi| uktaṃ ca ‘vaidyake’ iti pā.|, pālakāpyaviracite hastyāyurvede mahārogasthāne navamādhyāye'yaṃ viṣayo gadyena paṭhyate| pālakāpye– “pākalaḥ sa tu nāgānāmabhitāpastu vājinām| gavāmīśvarasañjñaśca mānavānāṃ jvaro mataḥ|| ajāvīnāṃ pralāpākhyaḥ karabhe cālaso bhavet| hāridro ‘mahiṣāṇām’ iti pā.| mahiṣīṇāṃ tu mṛgarogo mṛgeṣu ca| pakṣiṇāmabhighātastu matsyeṣvindramado mataḥ| pakṣapātaḥ pataṅgānāṃ vyāḍeṣvakṣikasañjñitaḥ||” ityādi| tathā'nyatra– “jalasya nīlikā bhūmerūṣaro vṛkṣasya koṭaraḥ|” ityādi| tasya prāgutpattimāha– dakṣāpamānetyādi| dakṣāpamānena ‘dakṣaprayuktaparibhaveṇa’ iti pā.| dakṣaprayuktaparibhavena kruddhasya rudrasya niḥśvāsāt sambhava utpattiryasya sa tathā| niḥśvāso'tra krodhaliṅgatvena nirdiṣṭaḥ, ata eva suśrutena “rudrakopāgnisambhūtaḥ” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ityuktam| kruddhena rudreṇa lalāṭe tṛtīyamāgneyaṃ cakṣuḥ sṛṣṭvā tato'pyāgneyo ‘bāṇa’ iti pā., ‘bāṇe’ iti ca pā.| bāṇo nirmitaḥ| yadāha carakaḥ– “sṛṣṭvā lalāṭe cakṣurvai dagdhvā tānasurānprabhuḥ bāṇaṃ krodhāgnisantaptamasṛjacchatrunāśanam||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti; atra ‘atra satranāśanaṃ yajñanāśanam’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| atra satranāśanaṃ yajñanāśanam| eṣā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca jvarotpattikathā carakacikitsite saviśeṣā ‘sāvaśeṣā’ iti pā.| śrotavyā| etena rudrakopasya viprakṛṣṭakāraṇatvamuktaṃ; yadi hi tato jvaro ‘nodapatat’ iti pā.| nodapatsyataṃ ‘nodapatsyate, utpannaśca tasmāt, tato rudrasantoṣārthaṃ japahomapūjāśivārcanādikaṃ kāryaṃ, tena sa na pīḍayiṣyati’ iti pā.| adhunā'pyapacārānnodapatsyata iti bhaṭṭāraharicandraḥ| etadabhidhānasya cikitsānupayogitvenānye ṭīkākṛto'nyathā vyācakṣate– kopodbhavatvena taijasatvaṃ prakāśyate; atra ‘krodho hyāgneyaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| krodho hyāgneyaḥ; yadāha carakaḥ– “krodhāt pittaṃ” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tena sarvajvare pittāvirodhinī kriyā kāryeti sidhyati| yaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭenaiva– “ūṣmā pittādṛte nāsti jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā| tasmāt pittaviruddhāni tyajet pittādhike'dhikam||” (vā. ci. a. 1) iti| ata eva carake kaṭvamlalavaṇān pācanān parityajya taruṇajvare pācakatvena tiktako rasaḥ pittaghno nirdiṣṭaḥ| yadāha– “laṅghanaṃ svedanaṃ kālo yavāgūstiktako rasaḥ| pācanānyavipakvānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ taruṇajvare||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | kālo'trāṣṭāha iti)| anye tvāhuḥ– rudrakopasambhavatvena devatātmakatvāt pūjārhatvamupadarśitam| yadāha videhaḥ– “jvarastu pūjanairvā'pi sahasaivopaśāmyati||” iti| harivaṃśe'pi– “jvarastripādastriśirāḥ ṣaḍbhujo navalocanaḥ| ‘mūrtimān harajo jñeyaḥ pāpināṃ nāśakārakaḥ|’ iti pā.| kvacitpustake uttarārdho na paṭhyate bhasmapraharaṇo raudraḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ||” iti mūrtimānevoktaḥ| bahuvidhamapi jvaraṃ saṅkṣepeṇāha– jvaro'ṣṭadhetyādi| aṣṭatvaṃ vivṛṇoti– pṛthagityādi| tacca samprāptau vivṛtam||1||

atha sarvarogaprādhānyāt prathamaṃ jvaro vācyaḥ| prādhānyaṃ cāsya śārīrarogeṣu prathamotpannatvāt, balavattvāddehendriyamanastāpitvācca janmanidhanayoravaśyambhāvitvācca ‘sthāvarajaṅgamabhūtavyāpitvācca’ iti pā.| sthāvarajaṅgamarūpasarvabhūtavyāpitvācca, naivamanye vikārāḥ| uktaṃ ca carake– “dehendriyamanastāpī sarvarogāgrajo balī| jvaraḥ pradhāno rogāṇāmukto bhagavatā purā||” iti| tathā– “jvareṇāviśatā kvacitpustake ‘bhūtaṃ nahi kiñcinna tapyate’ etatsthāne ‘bhūtāni kāni na pacyanta’ iti pā.| bhūtaṃ nahi kiñcinna tapyate|” iti| uktaṃ ca gajavaidyake– “pākalaḥ sa tu nāgānāmabhitāpastu vājinām| gavāmīśvarasañjñastu mānavānāṃ jvaro mataḥ|| ajāvīnāṃ pralāpākhyaḥ karabheṣvalaso bhavet| hāridro mahiṣāṇāṃ tu mṛgarogo mṛgeṣu ca|| pakṣiṇāmabhighātastu matsyeṣvindramado mataḥ| pakṣaghātaḥ pataṅgānāṃ ‘sarpamāṃsātpaśūvyālau’ ityamaraḥ|, ‘vyāḍeṣvakṣikasañjñakaḥ’ iti pā.| vyāleṣvakṣikasañjñakaḥ||” ityādi| tathā tantrāntare'pi– “jalasya nīlikā, bhūmerūṣaro, vṛkṣasya koṭaraḥ|” ityādi| tasya prāgutpattimāha– ‘dakṣetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dakṣetyādi| dakṣāpamānena dakṣaprayuktaparibhavena kruddhasya rudrasya niḥśvāsātsambhava utpattiryasya sa tathā| niḥśvāso'tra krodhaliṅgatvena nirdiṣṭaḥ| yathā suśrute– “rudrakopāgnisambhūtaḥ sarvabhūtapratāpanaḥ|” iti| kruddhena rudreṇa lalāṭe ‘tṛtīyamāgneyam’ iti pā.| tṛtīyakamāgneyaṃ cakṣuḥ spṛṣṭvā tato'pyāgneyo bāṇo nirmitaḥ| uktaṃ ca carake– “ ‘spṛṣṭvā’ iti pā.| sṛṣṭvā lalāṭe cakṣurvai dagdhvā tānasurān prabhuḥ| bāṇaṃ krodhāgnisantaptamasṛjacchatrutāpanam||” iti| etāvatā krodhodbhavatvena tasya taijasatvaṃ prakaśyate| taduktaṃ carake– “krodhātpittam” iti| tena sarvajvare pittāvirodhinī kriyā kāryeti sidhyati| yaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe– “ūṣmā pittādṛte nāsti kvacitpustake ‘jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā’ etatsthāne ‘nātyūṣmāṇāṃ vinā jvaraḥ’ iti pā.| jvaro nāstyūṣmaṇā vinā| tasmātpittaviruddhāni tyajetpittādhike'dhikam||” iti| anye tvāhuḥ– rudrasambhavatvena devatātmakatvātpūjārhatvamupadarśitam| yathāha videhaḥ– “jvarastu pūjanairvā'pi sahasaivopaśāmyati|” iti| uktaṃ ca harivaṃśe'pi– “jvarastripādastriśirāḥ ṣaḍbhujo navalocanaḥ| bhasmapraharaṇo raudraḥ kālāntakayamopamaḥ||” iti mūrtimānevoktaḥ| bahuvidhamapi saṅkṣepeṇāha– jvaro'ṣṭadheti| aṣṭadhātvaṃ vivṛṇoti pṛthak– vātikaḥ, paittikaḥ, ślaiṣmikaḥ, evaṃ trayaḥ; vātapaittikaḥ, vātaślaiṣmikaḥ, ‘śleṣmapaittikaḥ’ iti pā.| pittaślaiṣmikaḥ, evaṃ dvandvajāstrayaḥ; sāṅghātikaḥ sānnipātika ekaḥ; āgantuja ekaḥ; evamaṣṭau jvarā iti||1||
mithyāhāravihārābhyāṃ doṣā hyāmāśayāśrayāḥ | bahirnirasya koṣṭhāgniṃ jvaradāḥ syū rasānugāḥ ||2||

samprāptimāha– mithyetyādi| āhārasya mithyātvaṃ prakṛtyādīnāmāhāropayogahetūnāṃ viruddhatvenopayogaḥ| yadāha carakaḥ– "tatra khalvimānyaṣṭāvāhāravidhiviśeṣāyatanāni bhavanti; tadyathā– prakṛtikaraṇasaṃyogarāśideśakālopayogasaṃsthopayoktraṣṭamāni|" (ca. vi. a. 1) iti| atra prakṛtirdravyāṇāṃ svābhāvikagurutvalaghutvādiguṇayogaḥ, yathā– māṣamudgayoḥ; karaṇaṃ saṃskāraḥ, yathā– vrīhergurorlaghavo lājāḥ; saṃyogaḥ saṃhatībhāvaḥ, yathā– kṣīramatsyayoḥ; ‘rāśirāhāradravyasyāvayavena’ iti pā.| rāśirāhārasya dravādravasyāvayavena samudāyena vā parimāṇaṃ; deśo dravyotpattipracārādisthānaṃ; kālo nityagaścāvasthikaśca; upayogasaṃsthā upayoganiyamaḥ, yathā– jīrṇānna eva bhuñjīta; upayoktā svayaṃ nirūpitātmaprakṛtyādikaḥ puruṣa iti| vihārasya mithyātvamayathābalamārambhādi| āmāśayāśrayā ityanenāmāśayaprāptivyatirekeṇa doṣā jvaraṃ nārabhanta iti pratipādayanti| āmāśayaśca “nābhistanāntaraṃ jantorāmāśaya iti smṛtaḥ|” (ca. vi. a. 2) iti carakeṇoktaḥ| bahirnirasya koṣṭhāgnimiti koṣṭhāgnireva ‘doṣairākṣipto’ iti pā.| doṣotkṣipto bahirnirgata ūṣmatayā pratibhāti| koṣṭhāgnimiti ‘dhātvagninirāsārtham’ iti pā.| dhātvādyagninirāsārtham| jvaradā jvarakāriṇaḥ| rasānugā rasasambaddhāḥ, avaśyaṃ rasaṃ dūṣayitvā jvarotpādakā iti| ‘eṣā ca samprāptiḥ śārīrāṇāmeva natvāgantūnāṃ, teṣāṃ vyathāpūrvakatvaṃ tato vātādyanubandhaḥ,’ iti jejjaṭaḥ| ata eva suśrute āgantusamprāptiḥ pṛthageva paṭhyate| yathā– “śramakṣatābhighātebhyo dehināṃ kupito'nilaḥ| pūrayitvā'khilaṃ dehaṃ jvaramāpādayedbhṛśam||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| atra na āmāśayagata eva vāyuḥ, kintūrdhvādhastiryagrasavāhisrotaścaraḥ| carake'pyuktam– “tatrābhighātajo vāyuḥ prāyo raktaṃ pradūṣayan| savyathāśothavaivarṇyaṃ karoti sarujaṃ jvaram||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| nanu, āgantujvare'pyūṣmopalabhyate, “ūṣmā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca pittādṛte nāsti” (vā. ci. a. 1) ityuktam, ata āganturapi śārīraḥ syāt| naivam, uttarakālaṃ tadutpatteḥ| yaduktam– “āganturhi vyathāpūrvo jvaro'ṣṭamo bhavati; sa kiñcitkālamāgantuḥ kevalo bhūtvā ‘āganturhi vyathāpūrvo jāyate, paścānnijairdoṣairanubadhyate’ iti pā.| paścāddoṣairanubadhyate|” (ca. ni. a. 1); tathā– “āganturanveti nijaṃ vikāraṃ nijastathā''gantumapi pravṛddhaḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 19) iti| nanu, mithyāhāretyādinā ekaiva samprāptiruktā; etacca na yuktaṃ, yataḥ samprāptiḥ saṃyogabhedaḥ, saṃyogabhedaśca saṃyogibhedanibandhanaḥ, saṃyoginaścātra vātādayo nānāvidhāḥ, ‘ataḥ’ iti pā.| tataśca samprāpterapi nānātvaṃ syāt; nahi vātapittayoryaḥ saṃyogaḥ sa eva kaphapittayoriti| ucyate– anekaiva samprāptiḥ kintvekajātīyā, āśayaduṣṭyādeḥ sarvatrāviśeṣeṇābhidhānāt; evamāgantusamprāptirapi saṃyogabhedādbhinneti||2||

jvarasya samprāptimāha– mithyāhāretyādi| “akāle cātimātraṃ ca asātmyaṃ yacca bhojanam| ‘viṣamāśanaṃ ca yadbhuktam’ iti pā., viṣamāśanaṃ ca yaccoktam’ iti ca pā.| viṣamaṃ cāpi yadbhuktaṃ mithyāhāraḥ sa ucyate||” iti| mithyāhāro deśakālaprakṛtyādiviruddhaḥ, saṃyogaviruddhaśca kṣīramatsyayoriva| ‘mithyāvihāro'yathābalamārambhaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mithyāvihāro'yathābalamārambhaḥ| “aśaktaḥ kurute karma śaktimātraṃ karoti yaḥ| mithyāvihāra ityuktaḥ sadā ‘caiva vivarjayet’ iti pā.| taṃ parivarjayet||” iti| īdṛśasya puruṣasya āmāśayāśrayā doṣā vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ koṣṭhāgniṃ bahirnirasya jvaradāḥ syuḥ jvarakāriṇo bhaveyuḥ ‘āmāśayasthānamuktaṃ carake’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | āmāśayasthānamuktaṃ carake– “nābhistanāntaraṃ jantorāmāśaya iti smṛtaḥ||” iti| kiṃviśiṣṭāḥ? rasānugāḥ rasasambaddhāḥ rasaṃ dūṣayitvā jvarotpādakā iti| koṣṭhāgnimiti dhātvagninirāsārtham| eṣā ca samprāptiḥ śārīrāṇāmeva na tvāgantūnām| teṣāṃ tu vyathāpūrvako vātādyanubandhaḥ| uktaṃ ca suśrute, yathā– “ ‘śramaḥ kṣatābhighātebhyo’ iti pā.| śramakṣatābhighātebhyo dehinaḥ kupito'nilaḥ| pūrayitvā'khilaṃ dehaṃ jvaramāpādayedbhṛśam||” iti| uktaṃ ca carake– “tatrābhighātajo vāyuḥ prāyo raktaṃ pradūṣayan| savyathāśothavaivarṇyaṃ karoti sarujaṃ jvaram||” iti| nanvāganturapi śārīraḥ syāt, ‘yathā āgantujvare coṣmā upalabhyate’ iti pā.| yata āgantujvare'pyūṣmopalabhyate, ūṣmā ca pittādṛte nāstītyuktam| maivam, ‘āgantujvara’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | āgantujvara uttarakāle tadutpattiḥ| yaduktam– “āganturhi vyathāpūrvo jāyate paścānnijairdoṣairanubadhyate|” iti| ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā “āganturabhyeti nijaṃ vikāraṃ nijastathā''gantumapi pravṛddhaḥ|” iti||2||
svedāvarodhaḥ santāpaḥ sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ tathā | yugapadyatra roge ca sa jvaro vyapadiśyate ||3||

jvaralakṣaṇamāha– svedāvarodha ityādi| svedāvarodho gharmānirgamaḥ| tāpa iti ‘kartavye’ iti pā.| vaktavye santāpagrahaṇāddehendriyamanasāṃ tāpaṃ lakṣayati| taduktaṃ carake– “dehendriyamanastāpī” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti; agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | “indriyāṇāṃ ca vaikṛtyaṃ jñeyaṃ santāpalakṣaṇam|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tathā– “vaicittyamaratirglānirmanaḥsantāpalakṣaṇam|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ sarvāṅgavedanā| yugapaditi militametallakṣaṇaṃ, pratyekaśo vyabhicārāt; svedāvarodho hi kuṣṭhapūrvarūpe, tathā santāpo dāhākhye ‘dāhākhyo rogaḥ’ iti pā.| roge, sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ sarvāṅgavātaroge iti| nanu, paittike svedāgamāt, vātike ‘viṣamārambhavisargitvena’ iti pā.| viṣamārambhavisargitvāt sarvāṅgagrahaṇāvyavasthiteścāvyāpakaṃ lakṣaṇamiti| atra jejjaṭakārtikakuṇḍādayaḥ samādadhuḥ– utsargāpavādabhāvena vyavasthitiriti| tanna saṅgatamityanye; vidhau ‘utsargāpavādabhāvo’ iti pā.| hyutsargāpavādabhāvo natu lakṣaṇe, avyāptyativyāptyorlakṣaṇadoṣāt; tasmāt svedo'gniḥ ‘svidyate'nena’ iti vyutpattyā; tasyāvarodho doṣavyāptiḥ| vātajvare yadyapi vāyoścalatvenārambhavisargayorvaiṣamyaṃ, tathā'pi ‘sarvadehagatajvarārambhakadoṣadūṣyānuvṛtteḥranudbhūtasarvāṅgagrahaṇasya’ iti pā.| sarvadehagatajvarārambhakadoṣaduṣṭyanivṛtteranudbhūtasarvāṅgagrahaṇasya vidyamānataiveti na vyabhicāraḥ| carake tu jvaralakṣaṇaṃ “ ‘jvarapratyāyakam’ iti pā.| ‘jvarapratyātmakam’ iti ca pā.| jvarapratyātmikaṃ liṅgaṃ santāpo dehamānasaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| nanu, “śārīro jāyate pūrvaṃ dehe manasi mānasaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| carakavacanāddehamanasoranyonyavyabhicārādalakṣaṇamiti cet; tanna, sūkṣmatarakālavyavahitasyānyatararūpasyāvaśyambhāvitvāt| yathā– ‘guṇavaddravyam’ iti pā.| guṇavaddravyamiti dravyalakṣaṇamiti||3||

jvaralakṣaṇamāha– (yatra yasmin roge, yugapadekakāle, īdṛśalakṣaṇaṃ dṛśyate sa jvaraḥ kathyate|) svedāvarodhaḥ svedānirgamaḥ, anye paittike svedāvagamāllakṣaṇe vyabhicāraḥ, tena svedo'gniḥ ‘svidyate'nena’ iti vyutpattyā, tasyāvarodho doṣavyāptiḥ| kvacitpustake ‘santāpetyatra saṃśabdo dehendriyamanasāṃ tāpaṃ’ etatsthāne ‘santāpaḥ saśabdāddehendriyamanasaḥ santāpaṃ’ iti pā.| santāpetyatra saṃśabdo dehendriyamanasāṃ tāpaṃ lakṣayati| sarvāṅgagrahaṇaṃ sarvāṅgavedanetyāhuḥ| svedāvarodha ityatra ‘vegoparodha’ ityanye paṭhanti| tatra vegoparodho vātamūtrapurīṣādīnāmanirgamanaṃ; tadayuktam, pittajvare purīṣādīnāṃ nirgamanena tatrā'vyāpteḥ||3||

div.ab: śramo'ratirvivarṇatvaṃ vairasyaṃ nayanaplavaḥ | icchādveṣau muhuścāpi śītavātātapādiṣu ||4|| jṛmbhā'ṅgamardo gurutā romaharṣo'rucistamaḥ | apraharṣaśca śītaṃ ca bhavatyutpatsyati jvare ||5|| (sāmānyato viśeṣāttu jṛmbhā'tyarthaṃ samīraṇāt | pittānnayanayordāhaḥ ‘kaphānnānnābhinandanam’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ kaphādannārucirbhavet ||6|| ‘dvayordvayostu rūpeṇa saṃsṛṣṭaṃ dvandvajaṃ viduḥ’ iti mudritasuśrutapustake pāṭhaḥ rūpairanyatarābhyāṃ tu saṃsṛṣṭairdvandvajaṃ viduḥ | sarvaliṅgasamavāyaḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaje) ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpamāha– śrama ityādi| śramaḥ śrāntatvamiva| aratiranavasthitacittatvam, ‘aratiḥ krīḍābhāva iti’ ityasya sthāne ‘krīḍābhāvo'ratiriti’ iti pā.| aratiḥ krīḍābhāva iti kārtikaḥ| vivarṇatvaṃ mlānagātratvam| yattu ‘‘duṣṭāḥ svahetubhirdoṣāḥ’’ ityārabhya “svakāleṣu jvarāgamam| janayantyatha ‘buddhim’ iti pā.| vṛddhiṃ ca svavarṇaṃ ca tvagādiṣu||” (su. ci. a. 39) iti samprāptau vṛddhasuśrutavacanaṃ, tadatyarthajṛmbhādivadviśiṣṭapūrvarūpābhiprāyeṇa, samprāptyavasthāpannadoṣajanyatvāt pūrvarūpasyeti| vairasyamiti ‘mukhasya viruddharasatā’ ityasya sthāne ‘viruddhamukharasatā’ iti pā.| mukhasya viruddharasatā| nayanaplavo'śrupūrṇanetratvam| yaduktaṃ carake– " ‘gauravam’ iti pā.| ālasyaṃ nayane sāsre" (ca. ci. a. 3) ityādi| ādiśabdādambujvalanayorapi aniścitecchādveṣayorgrahaṇam| uktaṃ hi carake– ‘‘jvalanātapavāyvambubhaktidveṣāvaniścitau|’’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| anye tu śaityauṣṇyasādharmyājjalānalau grāhayanti, ādiśabdena ‘tu śayanāsanādikam’ iti pā.| ca śayanādikam| tamo'ndhakārapraviṣṭasyevāsaṃvittiḥ| apraharṣaḥ prītyabhāvaḥ| jvalanecchayā śīte labdhe śītaṃ ceti vacanaṃ ‘śītasya viśeṣeṇa bodhanārtham’ ityasya sthāne ‘viśeṣeṇa śītabodhanārtham’ iti pā.| śītasya viśeṣeṇa bodhanārtham| cakāreṇa ‘bālapradveṣādigrahaṇamityāhuḥ’ iti pā.| vātavidveṣādigrahaṇamityāhuḥ| utpatsyatīti bhaviṣyati jvare| utpatsyatīti ātmanepadānityatvena; tacca cakṣiṅa ikāreṇa ‘ ‘anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam’ ityasya sthāne ‘anudāttenātmanepade’ iti pā.| anudāttaṅita ātmanepadam’ (pā. a. 1/3/12) ityātmanepade siddhe tadarthaṃ ṅitkaraṇena jñāpitamiti śābdikāḥ| gadādharastu– ‘utpitsati’ iti paṭhitvā ‘pada gatau’ ‘ityasyaiva’ iti pā.| ityasya sannantasya ‘ ‘sanimimīmāghurabhalabhaśakapatapadām’ iti pā.| sanimīmāghurabhalabhaśakapatapadām|’ (a. 7 pā. 4 sū. 54) ityādinā ‘is bhāve’ iti pā.| isi kṛte ‘pūrvavat ‘san’ iti pā.| sanaḥ’ (a. 1 pā. 3 sū. 62) ityatra bhinnavākyatayā parasmaipadamiti vyācaṣṭe iti||4-7||

pūrvarūpamāha– śrama ityādi| śrāntatvamiva śramaḥ| aratiranavasthitacittatvam, aratiḥ krīḍābhāva ityapare| vivarṇatvaṃ malinagātratā| vairasyaṃ mukhasya, virasatā viruddharasatā| nayanaplavaḥ aśrupūrṇanetratvam| śītavātātapādiṣu viṣayeṣu icchādveṣau abhilāṣavidveṣau| ādiśabdādambujvalanayorgrahaṇam| uktaṃ hi carake– “jvalanātapavāyvambubhaktidveṣāvaniścitau” iti| anye tu śaityauṣṇyāsādharmyājjalānalau gṛhṇanti| te tvādiśabdena śayanādikaṃ manyante|| jṛmbheti jṛmbhā jṛmbhaṇam| aṅgamardo'ṅgamoṭanam| gurutā gātrāṇām| romaharṣo romāñcaḥ| arucirbhojye| tamaḥ andhakārapraviṣṭasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ| apraharṣaḥ ānandābhāvaḥ| śītamiti śītādau muhuricchādveṣāviti siddhe punarapi śītavacanaṃ viśeṣeṇa śītaprādurbhāvadarśanārtham| utpatsyati bhāvini jvare etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti| kvacitpustake ‘atra tu mādhavena sāmānyapūrvalakṣaṇaṃ suśrutoktaṃ likhitaṃ, natu viśiṣṭaṃ pūrvarūpalakṣaṇaṃ; taccāsmābhirihaiva likhyate– sāmānyata ityādi| sāmānyata iti pūrvapadyena sambadhyate|’ etatsthāne ‘sāmānyamiti’ iti pā.| atra tu mādhavena sāmānyapūrvalakṣaṇaṃ suśrutoktaṃ likhitaṃ, natu viśiṣṭaṃ pūrvarūpalakṣaṇaṃ; taccāsmābhirihaiva likhyate– sāmānyata ityādi| sāmānyata iti pūrvapadyena sambadhyate| bhāvini vātike jvare'tyarthaṃ jṛmbhā, paittike nayanayordāhaḥ, kaphaje nānnābhinandanamiti na annābhilāṣaḥ||4-7||

div.ab: vepathurviṣamo vegaḥ kaṇṭhauṣṭhapariśoṣaṇam | nidrānāśaḥ ‘kṣutaḥ stambhaḥ’ iti ḍalhaṇasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ kṣavastambho gātrāṇāṃ raukṣyameva ca ||8|| ‘śiroruk gātraruk gātrarugvaktravairasyaṃ gāḍhaviṭkatā’ iti pā.; “śirasaḥ pṛthagupādānamatyarthaṃ śirasi sā bhavatīti jñāpanārtham, anyathā gātrarugityanenaiva tatprāpteḥ” iti suśrutaṭīkāyāṃ ḍalhaṇaḥ śirohṛdgātrarugvaktravairasyaṃ gāḍhaviṭkatā | śūlādhmāne jṛmbhaṇaṃ ca bhavantyanilaje jvare ||9|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: vātapittakaphānāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ bhūridāruṇavikārakartṛtvena prādhānyaṃ, yaduktaṃ carake– ‘‘aśītirvātavikārāścatvāriṃśatpittavikārāḥ, viṃśatiḥ śleṣmavikārāḥ|’’ (ca. sū. a. 20) iti; tathā dāruṇāśca vātavikārā ākṣepakapakṣāghātādayaḥ; ataḥ prādhānyāt prathamaṃ vātajvaralakṣaṇamāha– vepathurityādi| evamanyatrāpi vātādikramanirdeśena ‘boddhavyam’ iti pā.| veditavyam| viṣamo vega iti vego jvarasya pravṛttirvṛddhirvā, tasya vaiṣamyamaniyatakālatvam, aṅgeṣu cauṣṇyādyaniyatatvam| kṣavaśchikkā ‘ atra ‘hā~ṃci’ iti loke’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| hā~ṃci’ iti loke| stambho gātrāṇāṃ jaḍimā, raukṣyamapi gātrāṇāmeveti gadādharādayo vyācakṣate; taccānavadhānādvyākhyātamiti lakṣyate; kṣavasya stambhaḥ kṣavastambha ityekapadatā'tra yujyate| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ– ‘‘harṣo romāṅgadanteṣu vepathuḥ kṣavathorgrahaḥ| bhramaḥ pralāpo gharmecchā vilāpaścānilajvare||’’(vā. ni. a. 2) iti| carake'pi nidāne ‘‘kṣavathūdgāravinigrahaḥ’’ (ca. ni. a. 1) ‘ityeva’ iti pā.| iti paṭhitam| vinigrahaśabdastu tatra nirodhārtha evācāryeṇa nirdiṣṭaḥ; yathā vātagulmanidāne– “rūkṣānnapānaṃ viṣamātimātraṃ viceṣṭitaṃ vegavinigrahaśca|” (ca. ci. a. 5) iti; tathā'ntarvegajvaralakṣaṇe “doṣavarcovinigrahaḥ” (ca. ci. a. 3) ‘ityevaṃ paṭhitam’ iti pā.| iti| etena, jvaramuktilakṣaṇe kṣavasya ‘bhāvāt’ iti pā.| pāṭhāt ‘kathamatra lakṣaṇatvam’ iti pā.| kathametallakṣaṇamiti yadāśaṅkitaṃ kārtikakuṇḍena tadapi nirastam| ādhmānaṃ vāyunā savedanamudarapūrṇatvam| ‘śirohṛdgātrarugityatra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śirohṛdgātrarugityatra gātragrahaṇena śirohṛdgrahaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣeṇa śirasi hṛdi ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vedanārtham| etāni rūpāṇi prāyobhāvitvena nirdiṣṭāni suśrutena, tena cakāreṇānyānyapi carakanidānoktāni boddhavyāni| tānyeva gadyenoktāni sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ ślokena mayā pradarśyante– “bhavanti vividhā vātavedanāḥ pādasuptatā| piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ karṇasvano vaktrakaṣāyatā|| ūrusādo hanustambho viśleṣaḥ sandhijānunoḥ| śuṣkakāso vamirlomadantaharṣaḥ śramabhramau|| aruṇaṃ netramūtrādi tṛṭpralāpoṣṇakāmitāḥ|” iti||8-9||

vātapittakaphānāṃ yathāpūrvaṃ bhūridāruṇavikārakartṛtvena vāyoḥ prādhānyamatastatprādhānyātprathamaṃ vātajvaralakṣaṇamāha– ‘vepathurityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vepathurityādi| vepathuḥ kampaḥ| viṣamo vego jvarasya hīnādhikabhāvena, aṅgeṣu coṣmādyaniyatatvam| kaṇṭhauṣṭhapariśoṣaṇamiti sugamam| tathā kṣavastambhaḥ kṣavaḥ chikkā tasyāḥ stambho'nirgamanam| kvacitpustake ‘kecittu ‘kṣavaḥ stambhaḥ’ iti bhinnaṃ padaṃ paṭhanti, tanmate kṣavaḥ chikkā, stambho gātrāṇāmiti vyākhyānayanti; tanna yuktam| yaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe– “harṣo romāṅgadanteṣu vepathuḥ kṣavathorgrahaḥ| bhramaḥ pralāpo gharmecchā viramaścānilajvare” iti|’ etatsthāne ‘kecittu kṣava iti bhinnaṃ padaṃ paṭhanti, tanmate kṣavaḥ chikkā, stambho gātrāṇāṃ śarīre namanābhāvaḥ ityādilakṣaṇamanilajvare iti|’ iti pā.| kecittu ‘kṣavaḥ stambhaḥ’ iti bhinnaṃ padaṃ paṭhanti, tanmate kṣavaḥ chikkā, stambho gātrāṇāmiti vyākhyānayanti; tanna yuktam| yaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe– “harṣo romāṅgadanteṣu vepathuḥ kṣavathorgrahaḥ| bhramaḥ pralāpo gharmecchā viramaścānilajvare||” iti| carake'pi nidāne– “kṣavathūdgāravinigrahaḥ” iti| ‘nigrahaśabdastannirodhārtha’ iti pā.| vinigrahaśabdastu nirodhārtha eva, yathā'ntarvegajvaralakṣaṇe “doṣavarcovinigrahaḥ” ityevaṃ paṭhitaḥ| raukṣyaṃ gātrāṇāmeva| cakārāt kṛṣṇaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ samuccīyate| anye tu “raukṣyameva ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca” ityatra sthāne “śyāvāṅgamalamūtratā” iti paṭhanti| ‘nanvatra’ iti pā.| atra gātragrahaṇena śirograhaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣeṇa śirasi hṛdi vedanādarśanārthaṃ; śirasi hṛdi gātreṣu ruk pīḍā| vairasyaṃ virasatā| gāḍhaviṭkatā baddhamalatā| śūlādhmāne ‘udaraśūlam’ iti pā.| śūlamudaraśūlam, ādhmānaṃ vāyunā savedanamudarapūrṇatvamityarthaḥ| jṛmbhaṇaṃ jṛmbhābāhulyam| anilaje jvare etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti| etāni ‘prakṛtisamavetāni’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamasamavetāni||8-9||

div.ab: vegastīkṣṇo'tisāraśca nidrālpatvaṃ tathā vamiḥ | kaṇṭhauṣṭhamukhanāsānāṃ pākaḥ svedaśca jāyate ||10|| pralāpo vaktrakaṭutā mūrchā dāho madastṛṣā | pītaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ paittike bhrama eva ca ||11|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: pittajvaralakṣaṇamāha– vegastīkṣṇa ityādi| atisāraḥ pittasya saratvena sadravā pravṛttirna tvatisāra eva, tasya jvaropadravatvāt| nidrālpatvaṃ ‘alpanidrātvam’ iti pā.| svalpanidrātvam| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “nidrānāśo'nilāt pittāt” (su. śā. a. 4) ityādi| vamiḥ pittasya ‘kaphasthānagatatvāt’ iti pā.| kaphasthānagamanāt| svedo gharmāgamanaṃ, prāyeṇa sāmadoṣeṇa srotasāṃ nirodhāt sarvajvareṣu gharmanirodhaḥ, atra tu pittasya taikṣṇyājjvaraprabhāvādvā sa na bhavatīti| pralāpo'sambaddhabhāṣaṇam| vaktrakaṭutā mukhatiktatvaṃ, carake hi ‘paittikanānātmajacatvāriṃśadvikāramadhye’ iti pā.| paittikanānātmajacatvāriṃśadvikāreṣu tiktāsyatāyāḥ pāṭhādanubhavācca| kārtikastvarocake “kaṭvamlamuṣṇaṃ virasaṃ ca pūti pittena vidyāllavaṇaṃ ca vaktram|” (ca. ci. a. 26) iti vacanaṃ ‘paṭhitvā, tadupanyasya’ iti pā.| dṛṣṭāntamupanyasya kaṭumukhatvamapīcchati| tanna, tatrāpi sandehāt| yaduktam– “kaṭu syāt kaṭutiktayoḥ|” iti| tasmāt “yo'mlaṃ bhṛśoṣṇaṃ kaṭutiktavaktraḥ pītaṃ saraktaṃ haritaṃ vamedvā| sadāhacoṣajvaravaktraśoṣaṃ sā pittakopaprabhavā hi chardiḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) iti suśrutavacanāt kaṭumukhatvamapyeṣṭavyamiti| mūrcheti mūrchā rūpādyavijñānaṃ, tamaḥpraveśo vismṛtirityāhuḥ| mado mattatvamiva, yathā– pūgakodravadhattūrabhakṣaṇādau| atra ‘bhrama iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| bhrama iti bhramaścakrasthitasyeva bhramadvastudarśanamityāhuḥ; anye tu svadehabhramaṇajñānam| nanu, bhramasyāśītivātavikārapaṭhitasya vātanānātmajatvāt kathaṃ pittavikāre pāṭhaḥ? ucyate, “na rogo'pyekadoṣajaḥ|” iti vacanāt ‘paittike'pi’ iti pā.| paittike vātānubandhāt bhramaḥ, iti jejjaṭaḥ samādhānamuktavān| athavā doṣadūṣyasammūrchanaprabhāvāt ‘kāraṇādṛṣṭadoṣasyāpi’ iti pā.| kāraṇādṛṣṭasyāpi rūpasya kārya upalambhaḥ; ‘yathā’ iti kvacitpustakeṣu na paṭhyate| yathā– arūpavātārabdhātisārādāvivāruṇatvaṃ, ‘...saṃyogato yathā’ iti pā.| haridrācūrṇasaṃyoga iva lauhityam| yattūktaṃ suśrute– “rajaḥpittānilādbhramaḥ|” (su. śā. a. 4) iti, tatrāpi vātānugatapittajatvameva boddhavyam, anyathā bhramasya vātikanānātmajatvameva na syāditi| apare tu pittadūṣitanetratvena viparyastajñānaṃ ‘bhramaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhramaḥ, ‘pītaḥ śaṅkha’ ityādivat| cakāraḥ pūrvavadanuktasamuccayārthaḥ| tadyathā– tīvroṣmatā ‘raktakoṭhatā’ iti pā.| raktakoṭhāḥ śītecchatā'ruciriti||10-11||

paittikamāha– ‘vega ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vega ityādi| vegastīkṣṇastīvravegaḥ| atīsāra iti pittasya ‘saratvena’ iti pā.| saratyena sadravā pravṛtirna tvatīsāraḥ, tasya jvaropadravatvāt| nidrālpatvaṃ svalpanidrātvam| vamiḥ pittasya kaphasthānagatatvāt| kaṇṭhauṣṭhamukhanāsānāṃ pāka iti sugamam| svedo gharmāmbunirgamanam| prāyeṇa sāmajvare svedanirodhaḥ, atra tu pittasya taikṣṇyājjvaraprabhāvādvā sa na bhavati| pralāpo'sambaddhabhāṣaṇam| vaktrakaṭutā mukhatiktatvam| yaduktamabhidhānāntare– “kaṭuḥ syātkaṭutiktayoḥ|” iti| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “ ‘yo'mlam’ iti pā.| yo'malaṃ ‘bhṛśaṃ vā’ iti pā.| bhṛśoṣṇaṃ kaṭutiktavaktraḥ pītaṃ saraktaṃ haritaṃ vamedvā| sadāhaśoṣajvaravaktraśoṣaṃ sā pittakopaprabhavā hi chardiḥ||” iti suśrutavacanāt kaṭumukhatvamapyeṣṭavyamiti| mūrchā rūpādyaparijñānaṃ tamaḥpraveśo vismṛtirityāhuḥ| mado mattatvamiva, yathā pūgaduṣṭakodravadhattūrabhakṣaṇādau| bhrama iti cakrasthitasyeva sambhramādvastudarśanamāhuḥ, anye tu svadehabhramaṇajñānam| nanu bhramasya aśītivātavikārapaṭhitasya ‘nānalajatvāt’ iti pā.| nānātmajatvāt kathaṃ pittavikāre pāṭhaḥ? ucyate– ‘na rogo'pyekadoṣajaḥ’ iti vacanāt, athavā doṣadūṣyasammūrchanaprabhāvāt| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “rajaḥpittānilādbhramaḥ” iti| apare tu pittadūṣitanetratvena viparyastajñānaṃ bhramaḥ pītaḥ śaṅkha ityādivat| ‘tṛṣāpītaviṇmūtranetratvam’ iti pā.| pītaviṇmūtranetratvamiti sugamam| paittike jvare etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti||10-11||

div.ab: staimityaṃ stimito vega ālasyaṃ madhurāsyatā | śuklamūtrapurīṣatvaṃ stambhastṛptirathāpi ca ||12|| (nātyuṣṇagātratā chardiraṅgasādo'vipākitā) | gauravaṃ śītamutkledo romaharṣo'tinidratā | ( ātaṅkadarpaṇasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ| srotorodho rugalpatvaṃ praseko lavaṇāsyatā | nātyuṣṇagātratā, cchardirlālāsrāvo'vipākatā) | pratiśyāyo'ruciḥ kāsaḥ kaphaje'kṣṇośca śuklatā ||13|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: kaphajvaralakṣaṇamāha– staimityamityādi| staimityamaṅgānāmārdrapaṭāvaguṇṭhitatvamiva| stimito vego mando vegaḥ| ālasyamiti “samarthasyāpyanutsāhaḥ karmaṇyālasyamucyate|” (su. śā. a. 4) ityālasyalakṣaṇamāhuḥ| stambho'ṅgastabdhatā| tṛptistṛptasyevānnānabhilāṣaḥ| utkledaḥ ‘upasthitavamanatvamiva’ iti pāṭh.| kaṇṭhopasthitavamanatvamiva| aruciratra ‘satyabhilāṣe’ iti pā.| satyapyabhilāṣe abhyavahārāsāmarthyamiti bhedaḥ| cakāraḥ pūrvavat| tena “tathā'ṅge pīḍakāḥ śītāḥ prasekaścharditandrike| hṛdupalepa uṣṇābhilāṣitā vahnimārdavam||” iti||12-13||

atha ślaiṣmikamāha– ‘staimityamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | staimityamityādi| ‘staimityamaṅgānāmārdravastrāvaguṇṭhitamiva’ iti pā.| staimityamaṅgānāmārdravastrāvaguṇṭhitatvamiva| stimito vego mandavegaḥ| ālasyaṃ “yaḥ śaktasyāpyanutsāhaḥ karmaṇyālasyamucyate|” iti| madhurāsyatā madhuravaktratvam| mūtrapurīṣayoḥ śauklyam| ‘aṅgastabdhatā’ iti pā.| stambho'ṅgastabdhatā| tṛptiḥ tṛptasevānnānabhilāṣaḥ| gauravaṃ gurugātratā| śītaṃ śītāvirbhāvaḥ| utkledaḥ upasthitavamanatvamiva, apare ‘śleṣmaniṣṭhīvanamiva’ iti pā.| śleṣmaniṣṭhīvanam| romaharṣo romāñcaḥ| atinidratā nidrādhikyam| pratiśyāyaḥ nāsāsravaṇam| aruciḥ astra satyapyabhilāṣe'bhyavahārāsāmarthyamiti tṛptito bhedaḥ| srotorodho rasavāhināṃ srotasāṃ rodhaḥ| kāsaḥ prasiddhaḥ| avipākatā annāvipākaḥ| cakāraḥ pūrvavadanuktasamuccayārthaḥ, kaphaje jvare etāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti||12-13||

div.ab: tṛṣṇā mūrchā bhramo dāhaḥ svapnanāśaḥ śirorujā | kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣo vamathū romaharṣo'rucistamaḥ ||14|| parvabhedaśca jṛmbhā ca vātapittajvarākṛtiḥ |15| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

vātapittajvaralakṣaṇamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| parvāṇi bhidyanta iva ‘parvabhedaḥ parvavedanā’ iti pā.| vedanā parvabhedaḥ| etāni ca liṅgāni vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhasya boddhavyāni| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhatvaṃ caiṣāṃ kevalavātikapaittikajvaralakṣaṇānāṃ madhye keṣāñcideva niyamena pāṭhāttadatiriktalakṣaṇapāṭhācca boddhavyam| yathā– atraiva vātapaittike'ruciromaharṣau, vakṣyamāṇavātaślaiṣmike ‘svedaḥ santāpaśca’ ityasya sthāne ‘santāpaḥ, iti kārtikaḥ’ iti pā.| svedaḥ santāpaśca, evaṃ ‘kaphapittaje’ iti pā.| kaphapaittike anavasthitaśītadāhau, evaṃ sannipātaje sāsrakaluṣādinetratvaṃ ‘śirasoloṭhanādi’ iti pā.| śiroloṭhanādi| ‘prakṛtisamasamavete’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamavāyārabdhe tu vātajādijvaraliṅgānyeva samastāni katipayāni vā bhavanti| ata eva cikitsite carakaḥ vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhānāṃ dvandvasannipātajvarāṇāṃ lakṣaṇāni sākṣāt paṭhitvā nidānasthānoktavātādijvaraliṅgātideśena prakṛtisamasamavetānāṃ ‘dvandvasannipātajvarāṇām’ iti kvacitpustakeṣu na paṭhyate| dvandvasannipātajvarāṇāṃ lakṣaṇamuktavān| yadāha– “nidāne trividhā proktā yā ‘pṛthaktve jvarākṛtiḥ’ iti pā.| pṛthagjajvarākṛtiḥ| saṃsargasannipātānāṃ tathā coktaṃ svalakṣaṇam||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| evaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ dvandvasannipātalakṣaṇaṃ vyākhyeyam| prakṛtisamasamavāyavikṛtiviṣamasamavāyayoścāyamarthaḥ– prakṛtyā hetubhūtayā samaḥ kāraṇānurūpaḥ samavāyaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaḥ prakṛtisamasamavāyaḥ, kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ; yathā– śuklatantusamavāyārabdhasya paṭasya śuklatvam| vikṛtyā hetubhūtayā viṣamaḥ kāraṇānanurūpaḥ samavāyo vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyaḥ, yathā– ‘haridrācūrṇasaṃyoge’ iti pā.| haridrācūrṇasaṃyogajaṃ lauhityamiti||14||– ‘atha vāta ... tṛṣṇetyādi’ ityasya sthāne ‘idānīṃ dvandvajajvaramāha|’ iti pā.|

atha vātapittajajvaralakṣaṇamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| tṛṣṇādyāḥ śirorujāntāḥ sugamāḥ| kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ kaṇṭhaśoṣo mukhaśoṣaśca| vamathuśchardibhedaḥ thugathugīti loke| romaharṣaḥ romāñcaḥ| aruciḥ prasiddhā| tamaḥ andhakāre praviṣṭasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ| parvabhedaḥ parvāṇi bhidyanta iti sandhiṣu vedanābhedaḥ| dvandvajeṣu sānnipātikeṣu ca kānicillakṣaṇāni ‘vikṛtisamavāyārabdhāni’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhāni bhavanti, kānicitprakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhāni bhavanti| doṣāṇāmeva lakṣaṇāni dṛśyante ‘prakṛtisamavāyārabdhāni’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhāni, viparītāni tu ‘vikṛtisamavāyārabdhāni’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhāni| yathātraiva vātapaittike jvare aruciḥ, romaharṣaśca; vakṣyamāṇavātaślaiṣmike santāpaḥ; evaṃ kaphapittaje liptatiktāsyatvaṃ sannipātaje sāsrakaluṣādinetratvaṃ śiroloṭhanādi, prakṛtisamasamavāyavikṛtiviṣamasamavāyayoścāyamarthaḥ– prakṛtyā hetubhūtayā samaḥ kāraṇānurūpaḥ samavāyaḥ kāryakāraṇabhāvasambandhaḥ prakṛtisamasamavāyaḥ, kāraṇānurūpaṃ kāryamityarthaḥ; yathā śuklatantusamavāyārabdhasya śuklatvaṃ paṭasya; vikṛtyā hetubhūtayā viṣamaḥ kāraṇānanurūpaḥ samavāyo ‘vikṛtisamavāyaḥ’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyaḥ; yathā haridrācūrṇasaṃyogajaṃ lauhityamiti, yathā vātapittayorlakṣaṇeṣu aruciromaharṣau| imau tu vikṛtyārabdhau dṛśyete; vātaśleṣmaṇorlakṣaṇeṣu santāpo nāsti, sānnipātikajvaralakṣaṇe dṛśyate so'pi vikṛtyārabdhaḥ| śiraso loṭhanaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ lakṣaṇeṣu na dṛśyate sānnipātikajvaralakṣaṇe dṛśyate tadapi vikṛtyārabdham| evaṃ dvandvajasannipātajeṣu sarveṣvapi rogeṣu boddhavyam||14||–
staimityaṃ parvaṇāṃ bhedo nidrā gauravameva ca ||15|| śirograhaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ kāsaḥ svedāpravartanam | santāpo madhyavegaśca vātaśleṣmajvarākṛtiḥ ||16|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: vātaśleṣmajvaralakṣaṇamāha– ‘staimityamityādi’ iti pā.| staimityaṃ parvaṇāṃ bheda ityādi| svedāpravartanaṃ svedasya ā ‘samantātprakāreṇa’ iti pā.| samantādakāraṇena ‘pravṛttiḥ’ iti pā.| pravartanaṃ vikṛtaviṣamasamasamavāyārabdhatvāditi kārtikaḥ| yuktaṃ caitat; yadāha hārītaḥ– “śirograhaḥ ‘svedabhavo jvarasya kāsaśca’ ityasya sthāne ‘svedabhavaśca kāso jvarasya’ iti pā.| svedabhavo jvarasya kāsaśca liṅgaṃ kaphavātajasya|” iti| svedabhavaḥ svedotpattiḥ| madhyavego nātitīkṣṇo nātimṛduriti||15-16||

vātaśleṣmajvaralakṣaṇamāha– ‘staimityamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | staimityamityādi| staimityaṃ ārdravastrāvaguṇṭhitamiva, anye niścalatvaṃ jvaritasya| parvaṇāṃ bhedo vedanāviśeṣaḥ sandhiṣu| nidrā prasiddhā| gauravam aṅgānām| śirograhaḥ śirogṛhītamiva manyate| pratiśyāyo nāsāsrāvaḥ| svedāpravartanaṃ svedasya āsamantātpravartanam| yaduktaṃ hārīte– “śirograhaḥ svedabhavaśca kāso jvarasya liṅgaṃ kaphavātajasya|” iti| svedabhavaḥ svedotpattiḥ| idamapi lakṣaṇaṃ ‘vikṛtisamavāyārabdham’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdham| santāpo'pi ‘vikṛtisamavāyārabdhaḥ’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhaḥ| madhyavego nātitīkṣṇo nātimṛduriti ||15-16||

div.ab: liptatiktāsyatā tandrā mohaḥ kāso'rucistṛṣā | muhurdāho muhuḥ śītaṃ ‘pittaśleṣmajvarākṛtiḥ’ iti pā.| śleṣmapittajvarākṛtiḥ ||17|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: pittaśleṣmajvaralakṣaṇamāha– liptetyādi| śleṣmaṇā liptaṃ atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ca pittena tiktaṃ ca āsyaṃ mukhaṃ yasya, tasya bhāvo liptatiktāsyatā| tandrā ‘locanaklāntiḥ’ iti pā.| nidrāvatklāntiḥ| moho mūrchā| etāni liṅgāni prāyobhāvitvena ‘likhitāni’ iti pā.| nirdiṣṭāni, ‘anyānyapi’ iti pā.| tenānyānyapi carakoktāni boddhavyāni| yathā– “tathā stambhaśca saṃsvedaḥ kaphapittapravartanam|” iti||17||

śleṣmapittajvaramāha– ‘liptetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | liptetyādi| śleṣmaṇā liptaṃ pittena tiktaṃ ca mukhaṃ yasya, tasya bhāvo liptatiktāsyatā, liptāsyatā tiktāsyatā cetyarthaḥ| tandrā nidrāvatklāntiḥ| tandrālakṣaṇamāha– “ ‘indriyārtheṣvasamprāptirgauravaṃ’ iti pā.| indriyārtheṣvasaṃvittirgauravaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ klamaḥ| nidrārtasyeva ‘yasyaite’ iti pā.| yasyehā tasya tandrāṃ vinirdiśet||” iti| moho mūrchā| anyatsugamam||17||

div.ab: kṣaṇe dāhaḥ kṣaṇe śītamasthisandhiśirorujā | sāsrāve kaluṣe rakte nirbhugne cāpi locane ||18|| sasvanau sarujau karṇau kaṇṭhaḥ śūkairivāvṛtaḥ | tandrā mohaḥ pralāpaśca kāsaḥ śvāso'rucirbhramaḥ ||19|| paridagdhā kharasparśā jihvā srastāṅgatā param | ṣṭhīvanaṃ raktapittasya kaphenonmiśritasya ca ||20|| śiraso loṭhanaṃ tṛṣṇā nidrānāśo hṛdi vyathā | svedamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ cirāddarśanamalpaśaḥ ||21|| kṛśatvaṃ nātigātrāṇāṃ pratataṃ kaṇṭhakūjanam | koṭhānāṃ śyāvaraktānāṃ maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanam ||22|| mūkatvaṃ srotasāṃ pāko gurutvamudarasya ca | cirātpākaśca doṣāṇāṃ sannipātajvarākṛtiḥ ||23|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg: sānnipātikajvaralakṣaṇamāha– kṣaṇe dāha ityādi| rujā śūlam, asthyādibhiḥ sambadhyate| sāsrāve sāśruṇī| kaluṣe āvilavarṇe| ‘nirgataṃ bhugnam’ ityasya sthāne ‘nirgatā bhugnatā’ iti pā.| nirgataṃ bhugnaṃ saṅkucitatā yayoste nirbhugne, “visphārite ityarthaḥ” iti jejjaṭaḥ; “antaḥpraviṣṭe” ityanye, “atikuṭile” iti cakraḥ| śūkaiḥ śūkaśimbi(mbā)dhānyādeḥ| paridagdhā dagdhavatkṛṣṇavarṇā| kharasparśā ‘kharo gojihvāvat sparśo yasyāṃ sā tathā’ ityasya sthāne ‘gojihvādivat’ iti pā.| kharogojihvāvat sparśo yasyāṃ sā tathā| srastāṅgatā niḥsahāvayavatā| ṣṭhīvanaṃ raktasya pittasya vā mukhena svalpodgiraṇam| śiraso ‘loṭhanamiti itastataḥ śiraścālanam’ iti pā.| loṭhanamitastataścālanam| kṛśatvaṃ nātigātrāṇāṃ doṣapūrṇatvena| pratataṃ nirantaram| koṭho bhālukitantre paṭhitaḥ| tadyathā– “varaṭīdaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ kaṇḍūmāṃllohito'srakaphapittāt| kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ||” iti| mūkatvaṃ ‘mandavacanatvam’ iti pā.| mandavacanatā, avacanatā vā| gurutvamudarasya ‘ca udaragauravam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca udaragauravam, cirātpākaśca doṣāṇāmiti ‘atisāmatvārabdhatvena’ iti pā.| atisāmatārabdhatvena| cakārādanyānyapi ca boddhavyāni| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “tadvacchītaṃ mahānidrā divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi| sadā vā naiva vā nidrā ‘mahān svedo'thavā na vā’ ityasya sthāne ‘mahāsvedo'ti naiva vā’ iti pā.| mahān svedo'thavā na vā|| gītanartanahāsyādivikṛtehāpravartanam|” (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| etacca lakṣaṇaṃ trayodaśasannipāteṣu madhye svamānādvṛddhairdoṣaistulyairārabdhasya jvarasya carakeṇa paṭhitaṃ; dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇādīnāṃ ca dvādaśānāṃ ‘lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam’ iti pā.| lakṣaṇaṃ tatraiva draṣṭavyam| tathāca kāśmīrapāṭhe carakaḥ– “bhramaḥ pipāsā dāhaśca gauravaṃ śiraso'tiruk| vātapittolbaṇe vidyālliṅgaṃ mandakaphe jvare|| śaityaṃ ‘...dāharuk tathā’ iti pā.| kāso'rucistandrāpipāsādāhahṛdvyathāḥ| vātaśleṣmolbaṇe vyādhau liṅgaṃ pittāvare viduḥ|| chardiḥ śaityaṃ muhurdāhastṛṣṇā moho'sthivedanā| mandavāte vyavasyanti liṅgaṃ pittakapholbaṇe|| ‘sandhyasthiśirasām’ iti pā.| sandhyasthiśirasaḥ śūlaṃ pralāpo gauravaṃ bhramaḥ| vātolbaṇe syāddvyanuge tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhāsyaśuṣkatā|| raktaviṇmūtratā dāhaḥ svedastṛṣṇā balakṣayaḥ| mūrchā ceti tridoṣe syālliṅgaṃ pitte garīyasi| ālasyārucihṛllāsadāhavamyaratibhramaiḥ| kapholbaṇaṃ sannipātaṃ tandrā kāsena cādiśet|| pratiśyācchardirālasyaṃ tandrā'rucyagnimārdavam| hīnavāte pittamadhye liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike matam|| hāridramūtranetratvaṃ dāhastṛṣṇā bhramo'ruciḥ| hīnavāte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ pittādhike matam|| śirorugvepathuśvāsapralāpaśchardyarocakāḥ| hīnapitte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam|| śītatā gauravaṃ tandrā pralāpo'sthiśirotiruk| hīnapitte vātamadhye liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike viduḥ|| ‘parvabhedo'gnidaurbalyam’ iti pā.| varcobhedo'gnidaurbalyaṃ tṛṣṇā dāho'rucirbhramaḥ| kaphahīne vātamadhye liṅgaṃ pittādhike viduḥ|| śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ pratiśyāyo mukhaśoṣo'tipārśvaruk| kaphahīne pittamadhye liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| vikṛtau niyamo nāsti; tena asyāgre kvacitpustake “prakṛtisamasamavāye tu sannipāte pṛthagvātādijvaralakṣaṇaṃ jñeyaṃ; hīnamadhyādhikakrameṇa sannipātā eva ṣaṭ, dvyulbaṇatvena trayaḥ, ekolbaṇatvena trayaḥ, samatvenaikaḥ, evaṃ trayodaśa prakṛtau” ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyā anekaprakārā bhavanti| ataḥ suśrutenāpyanyādṛśaḥ sannipātalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhitam– “nātyuṣṇaśīto'lpasañjño bhrāntaprekṣī hataprabhaḥ| kharajihvaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhaḥ svedaviṇmūtravarjitaḥ|| sāśrunirbhugnanayano bhaktadveṣī hatasvaraḥ| śvasannipatitaḥ śete pralāpopadravānvitaḥ|| abhinyāsaṃ tu taṃ prāhurhataujasamathāpare| sannipātajvaraṃ kṛcchramasādhyamapare jaguḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| tathā bhālukitantre ‘dvyulbaṇādilakṣaṇamanyathā’ iti pā.| dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇādilakṣaṇamanyathā paṭhitam| asyāgre kvacitpustake “vātaḥ pittādhiko'yaṃ prathamamupacito hanti vahniṃ śarīre śleṣmatvaṃ yāti bhuktaṃ sakalamapi tato'sau kapho vāyuduṣṭaḥ| srotāṃsyāpūrya rundhyādanilamatha marut kopayet pittamantaḥ sammūrchyānyonyamete prabalamiti nṛṇāṃ kurvate sannipātam” ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | tadyathā– “vātapittādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati| tasya jvaro'ṅgamardastṛṭtāluśoṣapramīlakāḥ|| ādhmānatandrārucayaḥ śvāsakāsabhramaśramāḥ| pittaśleṣmādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati|| antardāho bahiḥ śītaṃ tasya tandrā ca bādhate| tudyate dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvamuraḥśīrṣagalagrahāḥ|| niṣṭhīvet kaphapittaṃ ca tṛṣṇā ‘kaṇṭhaśca dūyate’ iti pā.| kaṇḍūśca jāyate| viḍbhedaśvāsahikkāśca bādhante sapramīlakāḥ|| ‘vibhuḥ phalguśca’ iti pā.| vibhuphalgū ca tau nāmnā sannipātāvudāhṛtau| śleṣmānilādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati|| tasya śītajvaro nidrā kṣuttṛṣṇā ‘pārśvasaṅgrahaḥ’ iti pā.| pārśvanigrahaḥ| śirogauravamālasyamanyāstambhapramīlakāḥ|| udaraṃ dahyate cāsya kaṭirbastiśca dūyate| sannipātaḥ sa vijñeyo makarīti sudāruṇaḥ|| vātolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati| tasya ‘cintājvaraglānipārśvarugdṛṣṭisaṅkṣayāḥ’ iti pā.| tṛṣṇājvaraglānipārśvarugdṛṣṭisaṅkṣayāḥ|| piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ dāha ūrusādo balakṣayaḥ| saraktaṃ cāsya viṇmūtraṃ śūlaṃ nidrāviparyayaḥ|| nirbhidyate gudaṃ cāsya bastiśca ‘parikṛṣyate’ iti pā.| parikṛtyate| āyamyate bhidyate ca hikkate vilapatyapi|| mūrchati sphāyate rauti nāmnā visphurakaḥ smṛtaḥ| pittolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|| tasya dāho jvaro ghoro bahirantaśca vardhate| śītaṃ ca sevamānasya kupyataḥ kaphamārutau|| tataścainaṃ pradhāvante hikkāśvāsapramīlakāḥ| visūcikā parvabhedaḥ pralāpo gauravaṃ klamaḥ|| nābhipārśvarujā tasya svinnasyāśu vivardhate| svidyamānasya raktaṃ ca srotobhyaḥ sampravartate|| śūlena pīḍyamānasya tṛṣṇā dāhaśca vardhate| asādhyaḥ sannipāto'yaṃ ‘śīghrakarīti’ iti pā.| śīghrakārīti kathyate|| nahi ‘jīvatyahorātrametenāriṣṭavigrahaḥ’ iti pā.| jīvatyahorātrametenāviṣṭavigrahaḥ| kapholbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|| tasya śītajvarasvapnagauravālasyatandrayaḥ| chardimūrchātṛṣādāhatṛptyarocakahṛdgrahāḥ|| ṣṭhīvanaṃ mukhamādhuryaṃ śrotravāgdṛṣṭinigrahaḥ| śleṣmaṇo nigrahaṃ cāsya yadā prakurute bhiṣak|| tadā tasya bhṛśaṃ pittaṃ kuryāt sopadravaṃ jvaram| nigṛhīte tu pitte ca bhṛśaṃ vāyuḥ prakupyati|| nirāhārasya so'tyarthaṃ medomajjāsthi ‘dhāvate’ iti pā.| bādhate| athātra snāti bhuṅkte vā trirātraṃ na hi jīvati|| medogataḥ sannipātaḥ ‘phamphaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| kapphaṇaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥ| kāmānmohācca lobhācca bhayāccāyaṃ prapadyate|| madhyahīnādhikairdoṣaiḥ sannipāto yadā bhavet| tasya rogāsta evoktāḥ prāyo doṣabalāśrayāḥ||” ityādi| nanu, vātādayaḥ parasparaṃ viruddhaguṇāḥ; viruddhaguṇānāṃ ca sambhūyaikakāryārambhakatvaṃ nopapadyate, parasparopaghātāttuhinadahanayoriva; tatkathaṃ ‘sānnipātikavikārotpāda iti’ iti pā.| sānnipātikavikārotpattiriti atra ‘tadyathā– vātasya’ ityārabhya ‘sambhavatītyanupadamevoktam|’ ityantaḥ bṛhatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ‘tadyathā– vātasya śītarūkṣādiguṇayuktasya uṣṇasnigdhādiguṇayuktena pittena, tathā kaphasya gauravasnigdhātmakasyobhābhyāṃ virodhaḥ| “tatra rūkṣo laghuḥ śītaḥ kharaḥ sūkṣmaścalo'nilaḥ| pittaṃ sasnehatīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ laghu visraṃ saraṃ dravam| snigdhaḥ śīto gururmandaḥ ślakṣṇo mṛtsnaḥ sthiraḥ kaphaḥ|| kaṭvamlalavaṇaṃ pittaṃ svādvamlalavaṇaḥ kaphaḥ| kaṣāyatiktakaṭuko vāyurduṣṭo'numānataḥ||” iti| kiñca, mithyāhāravihārābhyāṃ doṣā yugapadutpadyante āhosvitkālavyavadhānena? ādye samabalatvena tāratamyena vā? nādyaḥ, sarveṣāṃ samabalatvena parasparaghātakānāṃ yugapadutpattirna syāt| atha bhinnāśrayatayā sā'stu; tadapi na, kupitānāṃ sarvadehavyāpitvena parasparasambandhāt| ‘uktaṃ ca’ iti pā.| taduktam– “vyāpnoti sahasā dehamāpādatalamastakam|” iti| kiñca jvarotpattau tāvatkupitānāmāmāśayagatānāṃ rasadūṣakāṇāṃ jvarotpādakatvaṃ, tanmilitānāmeva syādyathāduṣṭeneti| na dvitīyaḥ, ‘pūrvadoṣo'dhikaḥ syāt’ iti pā.| pūrvadoṣādhikatvāt| kiñca tāratamyenotpattau mūṣakamārjāravadvirodhe prāgeva tena prabalena durbalāghātaḥ sukaraḥ; dṛśyate ca mātsyo nyāyaḥ| atha yugapadutpādakā āhārādayo na bhavanti; tatra yugapadutpādakadravyamekamanekaṃ vā? tasya ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ekatve)pāñcabhautikatvena viruddhaguṇādhikāra(karaṇa)sya tridoṣotpādakatvaṃ na syāt| astu vā'vicāritaramaṇīyam| ‘sākamevābhyavahrīyata’ iti pā.| ekamevābhyavahrīyata iti katham? astu vā sādhakatvena sahakāriṇi dravyābhyavahāre tasya viruddhaguṇavattvena ‘... ghātakatvenānupapattiḥ;’ iti pā.| doṣāntaraghātakatvenānutpattiḥ; tadavasthatayaiva jāyamānaḥ kevalaikadoṣajo na saṃsargasannipātajo jvara iti| athādṛṣṭādhīnatvena sahakāriṇo bhāve (sambhave) ekābhyavahāre sannipātaḥ, tarhi sarveṣāṃ samabalatvenetyatroktadoṣaḥ syāt| ‘atha tasyānekatve’ iti pā.| athānekadravyāṇāmabhyavahāre tridoṣaprakopaṇaṃ na sambhavati| tatra tulyānāmevābhyavahāraḥ kathaṃ? ‘yato bhinnarucitvāt’ iti pā.| yato'bhinnarucitvāt| yathārucyabhyavahāre ‘tāratamyasambhavāt’ iti pā.| tāratamyasambandhāt| tāratamyenaiva bhavati prakopo na yugapaditi pratijñāhāniḥ| atrāpyadṛṣṭādhīnatvāttulyābhyavahāre pratighātakatvābhāve'pi yaugapadyaṃ; tarhi sa eva doṣaḥ| atha kālavyavadhānena, tatra pūrvasmāduttarasya bhinnaḥ kālo bhavet; samabalo vā ‘nyūno vā adhiko’ iti pā.| nyūnādhikabalo vā? nādyaḥ, upasañjātavirodhitvenotpattumeva na śaknoti| na dvitīyaḥ, nyūnabalatvena pūrvaprabalenaiva vināśitatvāt, akiñcitkaratvācca| na tṛtīyaḥ, vicārāsahatvāt| tatra vaktavyam adhikabalatvamutpatteḥ pūrvaṃ paścādvā? nādyaḥ, ‘anutpannotpannasyā ...’ iti pā.| anutpannasyādhikyābhāvāt| adhikatvaṃ dharmaḥ, sa tu atra ‘sati’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sati dharmiṇi cintyaḥ| atha paścāt? tanna, utpattyadhike adhikena ghātasyopasañjātavirodhina utpattireva na, kuto'dhikatvam| atrāpyadhikatvaṃ na sambhavati| tasmādviruddhaguṇānāṃ sambhūya kartṛtvaṃ ghaṭaghaṭābhāvayoriva ghaṭaghaṭapradhvaṃsayoriva sahāvasthāyitvaṃ nāsti dahanatuhinavat| atrocyate– sarve vikalpā anaṅgīkārapāśahatāḥ, sannipātastu syādeva; mithyāhārādinā kupitā doṣā yugapatkālavyavadhānena vā, samabalatvena tāratamyena vā parasparaviruddhā api svasthānādāmāśayamāgatya rasaṃ dūṣayitvā dvandvasannipātotpādakā bhavanti, uktaṃ ca– mithyāhāretyādi| kālavyavadhānenotpannānāmapi kālāntareṇa yaugapadyameva bhavatīti na kadācidanupapattiḥ| nanu, kathamādipaścādbhāvenotpannānāṃ yaugapadyamiti cet? tanna, doṣāddoṣāntarotpatteḥ| taduktam– “ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāneva prakopayet| ekaḥ praśamito doṣaḥ sarvān doṣānnivārayet||” iti| tathāca carakaḥ– “kaściddhi rogo rogasya heturbhūtvā praśāmyati||” iti| atra rujākaratvāddoṣo'pi roga iti ṭīkākṛto vyācakṣate, ‘vikṛto doṣo roga’ iti samudāyasamudāyinorabhedavādināṃ mataṃ pūrvamevoktam| anyacca tathā– “vikṛtāvikṛtā dehaṃ ghnanti te vartayanti ca|” iti| vikṛtānāṃ ghātakatvaṃ rogarūpeṇaiva bhavati, yā vikṛtiḥ sa eva roga iti na doṣarogayorbhedaḥ| astu vā bhedaḥ, militairdoṣaiḥ rogaḥ kriyata iti| kathañcidapi ekānekadravyābhyavahāre sahakāriṇo daivāttrayāṇāṃ prakopo bhavatyeva| uktaṃ ca– “dṛṣṭāparādhajaḥ kaścitkaścitpūrvāparādhajaḥ| tatsaṅkarādbhavatyanyo vyādhirevaṃ tridhā ‘mataḥ’ iti pā.| smṛtaḥ||” iti| tathā– “pittakṣobhe tilābhyaṅgo rātrau ca dadhibhojanam| anidrā maithunaṃ yasya sannipāto bhaveddhruvam||” iti| nanu doṣāṇāṃ bādhyabādhakabhāvenādipaścādbhāvenotpattirdoṣāddoṣāntarotpattirvā na sambhavatītyanupadamevoktam|” atra samādhānamuktaṃ dṛḍhabalena, ‘yathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā– “viruddhairapi na tvete guṇairghnanti parasparam| doṣāḥ sahajasātmyatvādghoraṃ viṣamahīniva||” iti (ca. ci. a. 26)| etaccānye dūṣayanti– sahajatvādityanaikāntikaṃ, yataḥ sahajānapi dhātūn doṣā upaghnanti; sātmyatvādityapi sādhyāviśiṣṭaṃ, yataḥ sātmyatvamabādhakatvaṃ, tadeva ca ‘doṣāṇāmiha sādhyam’ ityasya sthāne ‘doṣāṇāṃ parasparaṃ sādhyam’ iti pā., ‘doṣāṇāmiha parasparaṃ sādhyate’ iti ca. pā.| doṣāṇāmiha sādhyam| atrocyate– doṣā nopaghnantīti ko'yamanupaghātaḥ sādhyate? vikṛterakārakatvaṃ vā, avināśakatvaṃ vā? nādyaḥ, doṣāṇāṃ parasparaṃ vikṛtikartṛtvāt| yathoktaṃ carake– “viśoṣayedvastigataṃ saśukraṃ mūtraṃ sapittaṃ pavanaḥ kaphaṃ vā| yadā tadā'śmaryupajāyate tu krameṇa ‘pittādiva’ iti pā.| pitteṣviva rocanā goḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 26) iti; ‘tathā coktam’ ityasya sthāne ‘yathoktam’ iti pā.| tathā coktaṃ vāgbhaṭena– “saśleṣmamedaḥ pavanaḥ sāmamatyarthasañcitam| abhibhūyetaraṃ doṣamūrū cetpratipadyate|| sakthyasthinī prapūryāntaḥ śleṣmaṇā stimitena ca| tadā stabhnāti tenorū stabdhau śītāvacetanau||’ (vā. ni. a. 15) atra kvacitpustake– ‘na dvitīyaḥ, doṣāddoṣāntarotpattirdarśitaivānupadam, ‘ekaḥ prakupito doṣa’ ityādinā; ato doṣasya kāraṇatvādanya evānupaghātaḥ’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | iti| avināśakatvaṃ tu vidyata eva, dhātudoṣayoḥ parasparaṃ ca doṣāṇāṃ sarvathocchedapratipādakāgamābhāvāt, atra kvacitpustake ‘ataḥ sātmyatvāt sahajatvādavirodhitvamiti yaduktamanaikāntikatvaṃ tanna, upaghātaśabdasya nyūnādhikaparyāyavirodhitvāt| āhāraṃ doṣā upaghnantīti dūṣyarasadhātudūṣakatvaṃ doṣāṇāṃ; tacca rasadūṣyaprakṛtyanyathāpādakatvameva nānyaditi kuto nāśaḥ sādhyāviśiṣṭatā tu nirastā spaṣṭatarā’ ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | maraṇaprasaṅgācca ; doṣāṇāmapi ‘dehadhāraṇakāraṇatvāt’ iti pā.| dehadhārakatvāt; tasmātsarvathocchedanirāsābhiprāyeṇaiva dṛḍhabalavacanamiha draṣṭavyaṃ; ‘tatkuto'naikāntikatā’ iti pā.| tataḥ kuto'naikāntikatā| na caivaṃ sati viṣasya viṣādakartṛtvena dṛṣṭāntaviphalatvaṃ, viṣasya ‘viṣādāvavāntaravyāpārasya’ iti pā.| viṣādādavāntarakhyāpārasya prāṇavināśakatvāt; naca sarvātmanā dṛṣṭānto bhavatīti| sātmyatvādityasyāyamarthaḥ– sātmyatvena pratīyamānatvāt| doṣāḥ parasparaṃ nopaghnanti, anupaghātakatvena pratīyamānatvāt; yadyathā pratīyate tattathā nirdiśyate, yathā'gnikāryo dhūmo'gnikāryatveneti, ‘kutaḥ’ iti pā.| tatkutaḥ sādhyāviśiṣṭatvamiti| cakradattastu sahajasātmyatvādityekameva hetuṃ vyākhyātavān– sahajaṃ svābhāvikaṃ doṣāṇāṃ sātmyatvamiti| dṛḍhabaloktahetudvayāsvarasena gayadāsastu hetvantaramuktavān– “daivāddoṣasvabhāvādvā doṣāṇāṃ sānnipātike| ‘viruddhaiḥ svaguṇaiḥ’ ityasya sthāne ‘viruddhaiśca guṇaiḥ’ iti pā.| viruddhaiḥ svaguṇaiḥ kaścinnopaghātaḥ parasparam||” iti saṅkṣepaḥ||18-23||

atha sānnipātikajvaralakṣaṇamāha– kṣaṇe 'dāhaḥ' iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dāha ityādi| 'rujā śūlam asthyādibhiḥ sambadhyate' iti pā.| rujāśabdo'sthyādibhiḥ sambadhyate| 'locane' iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | locane sāsrāve sāśruṇī, kaluṣe āvile, rakte lohitavarṇe, nirbhugne visphārite iti jejjaṭaḥ, atikuṭile iti cakraḥ| karṇau sasvanau saśabdau, sarujau vedanāyuktau bhavataḥ| kaṇṭhaḥ śūkairdhānyāgrasūkṣmakaṇṭakākāraiḥ, anye kapikacchūśūkairivāvṛtaḥ vyāpta iva| tandrā prasiddhā, moho'caitanyaṃ bhavati, pralāpo'sambaddhabhāṣaṇam| ‘bhramaścakrārūḍhastyeva, anye tu viparītapadārthajñānaṃ sthāṇau tuṣajñānavat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhramaścakrārūḍhastyeva, anye tu viparītapadārthajñānaṃ sthāṇau tuṣajñānavat| jihvā paridagdhā dagdhavatkṛṣṇavarṇā, kharasparśā kaṇṭakinī ca| srastāṅgatā niḥsahāvayavatā, anye vikalāṅgatvamāhuḥ| ṣṭhīvanaṃ mukhena raktapittasya| īṣatkaphamiśritasyodgiraṇam| śiraso loṭhanamitastataḥ śiraścālanam| tṛṣṇā pipāsā| ‘nidānāśaḥ hṛdi vyathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānāśaḥ hṛdi vyathā svedamūtrapurīṣāṇāṃ cireṇālpaśo darśanaṃ cirāt srutiḥ| kṛśatvaṃ nātigātrāṇāṃ nātidaurbalyaṃ doṣapūrṇatvāt| pratataṃ nirantaraṃ, kaṇṭhakūjanaṃ avyaktaśabdaḥ| koṭhānāṃ śyāvaraktavarṇānāṃ kvacitpustake ‘maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanaṃ’ etatsthāne ‘darśanaṃ maṇḍalānāṃ ca tathā’ iti pā.| maṇḍalānāṃ ca darśanaṃ; koṭhalakṣaṇaṃ kvacitpustake ‘bhālukitantre paṭhitam– “varaṭidaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ’ etatsthāne ‘bhālukiḥ– “varaṭidaṃṣsaṅkāśaḥ’ iti pā.| bhālukitantre paṭhitam– “varaṭidaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ kaṇḍūmāmँllohito'srakaphapittāt| kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha kvacitpustake ‘iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti’ etatsthāne ‘ityabhidhīyate sadbhiḥ’ iti pā.| iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti, athavā koṭhāḥ avyaktamukhāḥ piḍikāprāyāḥ, teṣāṃ ca śyāvaraktānāṃ darśanaṃ, śarīre maṇḍalānāṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca sakalānāṃ ca darśanam| mūkatvaṃ mandavacanatā avacanatā vā| srotasāṃ mukhanāsādirandhrāṇāṃ pākaḥ| ‘gurutvamudarasya udaragauravam| cirātpākaśca doṣāṇāmiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | gurutvamudarasya udaragauravam| cirātpākaśca doṣāṇāmiti atisāmatvārabdhena doṣāṇāmekatra militānāṃ cirakālena pāko nirāmatā| cakārādanyānyapi boddhavyāni| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “tadvacchītaṃ mahānidrā divā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi| sadā vā naiva vā nidrā mahān kvacitpustake ‘svedo'tha naiva ca’ etatsthāne ‘svedo'ti naiva vā’ iti pā.| svedo'tha naiva ca|| gītanartanahāsyādivikṛtehāpravartanam|” iti| etacca lakṣaṇaṃ trayodaśasannipāteṣu sāmānyaṃ vṛddhairdoṣaistulyairārabdhasya carakeṇa paṭhitam; evaṃ ‘ ‘dvyulbaṇaiḥ’ iti pā.| dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇaiḥ ṣaṭ syuḥ’ ityādidvādaśasannipātānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyam| tathā ca kāśmīrapāṭhe ‘carakaḥ’ iti pā.| carakatantre– “bhramaḥ pipāsā dāhaśca gauravaṃ śiraso'tiruk| vātapittolbaṇe vidyālliṅgaṃ mandakaphajvare|| śaityaṃ kāso'rucistandrā pipāsādāhahṛdvyathāḥ| vātaśleṣmolbaṇe vyādhau liṅgaṃ pittāvare viduḥ|| chardiḥ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śaityaṃ bahirdāhastṛṣṇā moho'sthivedanā mande vāte vyavasyanti liṅgaṃ pittakapholbaṇe|| sandhyasthiśirasaḥ śūlaṃ pralāpo gauravaṃ bhramaḥ| vātolbaṇe tridoṣe tu tṛṣṇā kaṇṭhāsyaśuṣkatā|| raktaviṇmūtranetratvaṃ ‘dāhastṛṭ ca balakṣayaḥ’ iti pā.| dāhatṛḍbalasaṅkṣayāḥ| mūrchā ceti tridoṣe syālliṅgaṃ pitte garīyasi|| ālasyārucihṛllāsadāhavamyaratibhramāḥ| kapholbaṇe sannipāte tandrā kāso'pi jāyate|| mūrchācchardiḥ pratiśyāyastandrā'rucyagnimārdavam| hīnavāte madhyapitte liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike matam|| hāridramūtranetratvaṃ dāhastṛṣṇā'rucirbhramaḥ| hīnavāte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ pittādhike matam|| śirorugvepathuḥ śvāsapralāpaścchardyarocakāḥ| hīnapitte madhyakaphe liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam|| śītakaṃ gauravaṃ tandrā pralāpaḥ śiraso'tiruk|| hīnapitte vātamadhye liṅgaṃ śleṣmādhike matam|| parvabhedo'ṅgadaurbalyaṃ tṛṣṇā dāho'rucirbhramaḥ|| kaphe hīne madhyavāte liṅgaṃ pittādhike viduḥ|| śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ pratiśyāyo mukhaśoṣo'tipārśvaruk|| kaphe hīne madhyapitte liṅgaṃ vātādhike matam|” iti|| vikṛtau niyamo nāsti, tena ‘vikṛtiviṣamasamavā’ iti pā.| vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhā anekaprakārā bhavanti| ‘prakṛtisamasvāyastu’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamasamavāye sannipāte pṛthagvātādijvarasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| hīnamadhyādhikakrameṇa sannipātāḥ ‘evaṃ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | evaṃ ṣaṭ, dvyulbaṇena trayaḥ, ekolbaṇena trayaḥ, samatvenaikaḥ, evaṃ trayodaśasannipātāḥ prakṛtau| atra suśrutastu doṣotkarṣāpakarṣatāratamyena dhātvādyāvaraṇabhedena ca sannipātabhedānāmānantyātpṛthaglakṣaṇaṃ noktavān; kintu tulyakupitairdoṣairekameva sannipātalakṣaṇaṃ paṭhitavān| tadyathā– “nātyuṣṇaśīto'lpasañjño bhrāntaprekṣī hataprabhaḥ|| kharajihvaḥ śūkakaṇṭhaḥ svedaviṇmūtravarjitaḥ|| sāśrunirbhugnanayano bhaktadveṣī hatasvaraḥ|| śvasannipatitaḥ śete pralāpopadravairyutaḥ|| abhinyāsaṃ tu taṃ prāhurhataujasamathāpare|| sannipātajvaraṃ kṛcchramasādhyamapare viduḥ|| nidropetamabhinyāsaṃ kṣīṇamenaṃ hataujasam|| sannyastagātraṃ sannyāsaṃ vidyātsarvātmakaṃ jvaram|” iti|| atha bhālukitantre dvyulbaṇaikolbaṇādilakṣaṇamanyathā paṭhitam| tadyathā– “āmo hyāhāradoṣātprathamamupacito hanti vahniṃ śarīre śleṣmatvaṃ yāti bhuktaṃ sakalamapi tato'sau kapho vāyuduṣṭaḥ| srotāṃsyāpūrya rundhyādanilamatha marutkopayetpittamantaḥ sammūrchyānyonyamete prabalamiti nṛṇāṃ kurvate sannipātam|| vātapittādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati| tasya jvaro'ṅgamardastṛṭ tāluśoṣapramīlakau|| ādhmānatandrārucayaḥ śvāsakāsabhramaśramāḥ| pittaśleṣmādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati|| antardāho bahiḥ śaityaṃ tasya tandrā ca vardhate| tudyate dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvamuraḥśīrṣagalagrahaḥ|| niṣṭhīvetkaphapittaṃ ca kṛcchrātkaṇḍūśca jāyate| viḍbhedaśvāsahikkāśca vardhante sapramīlakāḥ|| vibhuḥ phalguśca tau nāmnā sannipātāvudāhṛtau| śleṣmānilādhiko yasya sannipātaḥ prakupyati|| tasya śītajvaro nidrā kṣuttṛṣṇā pārśvanigrahaḥ| śirogauravamālasyamanyāstambhapramīlakāḥ|| udaraṃ dahyate cāsya kaṭī bastiśca dūyate| sannipātaḥ sa vijñeyo makarīti sudāruṇaḥ|| vātolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati| ‘tasya śītajvaro nidrā kṣuttṛṣṇāpārśvanigrahāḥ| śirogauravamālasyamanyāstambhapramīlakāḥ|| udaraṃ dahyate cāsya kaṭī bastiśca dūyate| sannipātaḥ sa vijñeyo makarīti sudāruṇaḥ|| vātolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasya śītajvaro nidrā kṣuttṛṣṇāpārśvanigrahāḥ| śirogauravamālasyamanyāstambhapramīlakāḥ|| udaraṃ dahyate cāsya kaṭī bastiśca dūyate| sannipātaḥ sa vijñeyo makarīti sudāruṇaḥ|| vātolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati| tasya tṛṣṇā jvaro glāniḥ pārśvaruk dṛṣṭisaṅkṣayāḥ|| piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ dāha ūrusādo balakṣayaḥ| saraktaṃ cāsya viṇmūtraṃ śūlaṃ nidrāviparyayaḥ|| nirbhidyate ‘gudaścāsya’ iti pā.| gudaṃ cāsya bastiśca parigṛhyate| āyamyate bhidyate ca hikkate vilapatyapi|| mūrchate sphāryate rauti nāmnā ‘visphūrakaḥ’ iti pā.| visphārakaḥ smṛtaḥ| pittolbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati|| tasya dāhajvaro ghoro bahirantaśca vardhate| śītaṃ ca sevamānasya kupyataḥ kaphamārutau| tataścainaṃ prabādhante hikkāśvāsapramīlikāḥ|| ‘viṣūcika’ iti pā.| visūcikā parvabhedaḥ pralāpo gauravaṃ klamaḥ| nābhipārśvarujā tasya ‘svinnasyāśu’ iti pā.| svinnatyāśu vivardhate|| svidyamānasya raktaṃ ca srotobhyaḥ sampravartate| śūlena pīḍyamānasya tṛṣṇā śvāsaḥ prabādhate|| asādhyaḥ sannipāto'yaṃ śīghrakārīti kathyate| na hi jīvatyahorātramanenāviṣṭavigrahaḥ|| kapholbaṇaḥ sannipāto yasya jantoḥ prakupyati| tasya śītajvaraḥ svapnagauravālasyatandrikāḥ| chardimūrchātṛṣādāhatṛṣṇārocakahṛdgrahāḥ| ṣṭhīvanaṃ mukhamādhuryaṃ śrotravāgdṛṣṭinigrahaḥ|| athātra snāti bhuṅkte vā trirātraṃ naiva jīvati| medogataḥ sannipāto ‘dyulbaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| hyulbaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ|| kāmānmohācca ‘lomaśca’ iti pā.| lobhācca bhayāccāpi prapadyate| madhyahīnādhikairdoṣaiḥ sannipāto yadā bhavet|| tasya rogāsta evoktāḥ prāyo doṣabalāśrayāḥ|” iti|| nanu vātādayaḥ parasparaṃ viruddhaguṇāḥ, parasparaṃ viruddhaguṇānāṃ ca ‘teṣāṃ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | teṣāṃ sambhūyaikakāryārambhakatvaṃ nopapadyate, parasparopaghātakatvāddahanatuhinayoriva, tatkathaṃ sānnipātikavikārotpattiḥ? ‘ityatra’ iti pā.| atra samādhānamuktaṃ dṛḍhabalena, yathā “viruddhairapi na tvete guṇairghnanti parasparam| doṣāḥ sahajasātmyatvādghoraṃ viṣamahīniva||” iti| ‘dṛḍhabaloktahetudvayāt’ iti pā.| dṛḍhabaloktahetudvayādanyaddhetudvayaṃ gayadāsaścoktavān– “daivāddoṣasvabhāvādvā doṣāṇāṃ sānnipātike| viruddhaiśca guṇaiḥ ‘kaścinnopapātaḥ’ iti pā.| kaścinnopaghātaḥ parasparam||” iti||18-23||

div.ab: doṣe vibaddhe naṣṭe'gnau sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ | sannipātajvaro'sādhyaḥ, kṛcchrasādhyastato'nyathā ||24|| (ca. ci. a. 3) | ( imau ślokau kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saptame divase prāpte daśame dvādaśe'pi vā | punarghorataro bhūtvā praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā |1| saptamī dviguṇā caiva navamyekādaśī tathā | eṣā tridoṣamaryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca) |2|

ab.seg: tasya sannipātajvarasyāsādhyalakṣaṇamāha– doṣe vibaddha ityādi| doṣo malaṃ ‘pittādiśca’ iti pā.| vātādiśca; jejjaṭastu ‘malaṃ purīṣamāha’ iti ā. da.| malamevāha, vibaddha iti vacanāt| ‘āhārāpācakatvam’ iti pā.| naṣṭāgnitvamāhārāpākagamyam| yaduktaṃ carake– “agniṃ jaraṇaśaktyā” (ca. vi. a. 4) iti| asādhyakṛcchrasādhyābhidhānena sukhasādhyo na bhavatīti darśitam| uktaṃ ‘ca’ iti pā.| hi carake– “sannipāto duścikitsyānām” (ca. sū. a. 25) iti| tathā bhālukiḥ– “mṛtyunā saha yoddhavyaṃ sannipātaṃ cikitsatā||” iti| sarvasampūrṇalakṣaṇa iti sarvāṇi samagrāṇi, sampūrṇāni balīyāṃsi lakṣaṇāni yasya sa tathā||24||

saṅkṣepataḥ ‘tasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasya sannipātajvarasyāsādhyalakṣaṇamāha– ‘doṣe ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | doṣe ityādi| doṣo malaṃ vātādiśca| jejjaṭastu malaṃ purīṣamāha, vibaddha iti vacanāt| naṣṭāgnitvamiti annāvipākādavagantavyam| sarvāṇi sampūrṇāni lakṣaṇāni yasya sa tathā| īdṛśo'sādhyaḥ, tato'nyathā visadṛśaḥ avibaddhadoṣo'lpalakṣaṇaḥ kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| asādhyatvakṛcchrasādhyatvābhidhānena sukhasādhyo na bhavatīti darśitam| uktaṃ ca bhālukinā– “mṛtyunā saha yoddhavyaṃ sannipātaṃ cikitsatā| yastu tatra bhavejjetā sa jetā''mayasaṅkule|| sannipātārṇave magnaṃ yo'bhyuddharati mānavam| kastena na kṛto dharmaḥ kāṃ vā pūjāṃ na so'rhati||” iti| suśrute'pi sannipātajvarasya mokṣavadhayoravadhikālo darśitaḥ– “saptame divase prāpte daśame dvādaśe'pi vā| punarghorataro bhūtvā praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā||” iti| bhālukinā'pyuktam– “saptamī dviguṇā yāvannavamyekādaśī tathā| eṣā tridoṣamaryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca||” iti| uktaṃ ca– “pittakaphānilavṛddhyā daśadivasadvādaśāhasaptāhāt| hanti vimuñcati vā'pi tridoṣajo dhātumalapākāt||” iti| vātādhikaḥ saptame dine, pittādhiko daśame, śleṣmādhiko dvādaśe, malapākādvimuñcati, dhātupākāddhanti| dhātupākalakṣaṇaṃ tantrāntaroktam– “sambādhyamāno hṛdi nābhideśe ‘netreṣu’ iti pā.| gātreṣu vā pākarujānviteṣu| pakveṣu ‘vāteṣu’ iti pā.| vā teṣu rujā jvarārtaḥ sa dhātupākī kathito bhiṣagbhiḥ||” iti| tantrāntare'pyuktam– “daśadvādaśasaptāhaiḥ pittaśleṣmānilādhikaḥ| ‘dagdhvoṣmaṇā’ iti pā., ‘dehoṣmaṇā’ iti capā.| paktvoṣmaṇā dhātumalān hanti muñcati vā jvaraḥ||” iti||24||
sannipātajvarasyānte karṇamūle sudāruṇaḥ | śothaḥ sañjāyate tena kaścideva pramucyate ||25||
(ca. ci. a. 3) | (trayaḥ prakupitā doṣā uraḥsroto'nugāminaḥ | āmābhivṛddhyā grathitā buddhīndriyamanogatāḥ ||1||
janayanti mahāghoramabhinyāsaṃ jvaraṃ dṛḍham | śrutau netre prasuptiḥ syānna ceṣṭāṃ kāñcidīhate ||2||
naca dṛṣṭirbhavettasya samarthā rūpadarśane | na ghrāṇaṃ na saṃsparśaṃ śabdaṃ vā naiva budhyate ||3||
śiro loṭhayate'bhīkṣṇamāhāraṃ nābhinandati | kūjati tudyate caiva parivartanamīhate ||4||
alpaṃ prabhāṣate kiñcidabhinyāsaḥ sa ucyate | pratyākhyātaḥ sa bhūyiṣṭhaḥ kaścidevātra sidhyati) ||5||
sannipātajvaropadravamāha– sannipātetyādi||25||

sannipātopadravamāha– ‘sannipātajvarasyetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sannipātajvarasyetyādi| sannipātajvarasya ante avasāne sannipātakṣapitaśarīrasya puṃsaḥ karṇamūle karṇaparyante sudāruṇaḥ kaṣṭatamaḥ śophaḥ samprāptiviśeṣātkarmavaicitryātsañjāyate, tena śophena kaścidevāturo vimucyate, prāyo mārayatītyarthaḥ||25||

div.ab: abhighātābhicārābhyāmabhiśāpābhiṣaṅgataḥ | āganturjāyate doṣairyathāsvaṃ taṃ vibhāvayet ||26|| śyāvāsyatā viṣakṛte ‘śotho'tīsāra eva ca’ iti pā. | tathā'tīsāra eva ca | bhaktāruciḥ pipāsā ca todaśca saha mūrchayā ||27|| ‘auṣadhigandhaje’ iti pā.| oṣadhigandhaje mūrchā śirorugvamathuḥ kṣavaḥ | kāmaje cittavibhraṃśastandrā''lasyamabhojanam ||28|| (hṛdaye vedanā cāsya gātraṃ ca ‘prakṛtikarmavaśādityarthaḥ’ iti pā. | pariśuṣyati) | bhayātpralāpaḥ śokācca bhavet kopācca vepathuḥ | abhicārābhiśāpābhyāṃ mohastṛṣṇā ca jāyate ||29|| bhūtābhiṣaṅgādudvego hāsyarodanakampanam |30| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

āgantujvaramāha– abhighātetyādi| abhighāto'bhihananaṃ ‘śastraloṣṭramuṣṭilaguḍādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| śastraloṣṭamuṣṭilaguḍādibhiḥ; abhicāraḥ śyenādiyāgakṛtaḥ, ‘athavā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | athavā viparītairmantrairlohasrucā sarṣapādihoma ityāhuḥ| abhiṣaṅgaḥ kāmādīnāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca sambandhaḥ; yaduktaṃ carake– “kāmaśokabhayakrodhairabhiṣaktasya yo jvaraḥ| so'bhiṣaṅgajvaro jñeyo yaśca bhūtābhiṣaṅgajaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| abhiśāpo brāhmaṇaguruvṛddhasiddhānāmaniṣṭābhiśaṃsanam| taṃ cāgantujvaraṃ yathāsvaṃ doṣairjānīyāt| yaduktam– “kāmaśokabhayādvāyuḥ” ityādi| ayaṃ ca doṣasambandhaḥ paścādbhāvī natvārambhaka iti samprāptyavasare nirūpitam| śyāvāsyatetyādi| śyāvaḥ śuklānuviddhaḥ kṛṣṇo varṇaḥ; ‘śākavarṇaḥ’ iti pā.| śyāmavarṇa ‘ityeke’ iti pā.| ityanye| viṣakṛte ‘sthāvaraviṣabhakṣaṇakṛte’ iti pā.| sthāvaraviṣabhakṣaṇādikṛte; atīsāraḥ tadviṣasyādhogatvāt| oṣadhigandhaja iti ‘auṣadhigandhaghrāṇaje’ iti pā., ‘tīvrauṣadhighrāṇaje’ iti ca pā.| tīvrauṣadhigandhaghrāṇaje, “puṣpebhyo gandharajasī ‘oṣadhībhyaḥ’ iti pā.| ojasvibhyo yadā'nilaḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ityādinā vṛddhasuśrutena paṭhitaṃ tṛṇapuṣpākhyaṃ jvaramatraivāntarbhāvayanti| kāmaja ityādi abhimatakāminyādyaprāptinimitte| cittavibhraṃśo bhramādiḥ| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “kāmād bhramo'rucirdāho hrīnidrādhīdhṛtikṣayaḥ|” (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| bhayāditi bhayājjāte jvare| evaṃ ‘śokāt’ iti pā.| śokācca kopādityetayorboddhavyaṃ; ‘śokācca’ iti pā.| śokāt pralāpa iti sambandhaḥ; pralāpaścātra vātakāryaḥ, tasya ‘vātakopitapittakāryatvāt’ iti pā.| vātapittakāryatvāt| ( ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | viśeṣaniścayastu nidānāt, nidānamapi lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati|) uktaṃ ca– “kāmaśokabhayādvāyuḥ, krodhāt pittaṃ, trayo malāḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 3) ityādi| yadyevaṃ tat kutaḥ krodhaje vepathuḥ? tasya vātakāryatvāt| ucyate– “ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāneva prakopayet|” iti vacanāt pittakopitavātajanya evātra vepathuḥ, ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | athavā kruddhaśca vepamāno dṛśyate iti na hi ‘ dṛṣṭeranupapannaṃ nāmeti’ ityasya sthāne ‘dṛṣṭeranupapannamiti’ iti pā.| dṛṣṭeranupapannaṃ nāmeti jejjaṭaḥ| krodhaḥ ‘pittamatha’ iti pā.| pittamiva vātaṃ ca kopayatīti, tadyuktam| yadāha videhaḥ– “krodhaśokau smṛtau vātaraktapittaprakopaṇau|” iti| kopācceti cakāreṇa śirorujaṃ samuccinoti| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “krodhāt kampaḥ śiroruk ca, pralāpo bhayaśokajaḥ|” (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| mānasatvāviśeṣe'pi bhayajādīnāṃ ‘pṛthagupapādo’ iti pā.| pṛthagupādānaṃ hetubhedāt; ‘hetubhedābhidhānaṃ ca’ iti pā.| hetubhedācca bhedābhidhānaṃ hetupratyanīkacikitsārthamiti| abhicāretyādi| tṛṣṇā ceti cakāreṇābhicāraje dāhādikaṃ samuccinoti| yaduktaṃ ‘hārītadarśinā’ iti pā.| hārītārthānuvādinā vāgbhaṭena– “tatrābhicārikairmantrairhūyamānasya tapyate| pūrvaṃ cetastato dehastato visphoṭatṛḍbhramaiḥ|| ‘sadāhamūrchāgrastasya’ iti pā.| sadāhamūrchairgrastasya pratyahaṃ vardhate jvaraḥ|” (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| bhūtābhiṣaṅgāditi ‘bhūtāni’ iti pā.| bhūtā devagrahādaya unmādanidāne vakṣyamāṇāḥ, teṣāmabhiṣaṅgaḥ sambandhaḥ| udvega udvignacittatā||26-29||–

ab.seg: athāgantukajvaralakṣaṇamāha– ‘abhighātetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | abhighātetyādi| abhighāto lohaśastrakāṣṭhādinā, abhicāraḥ viparītairmantraiḥ lohasrucā sarṣapādihomaḥ, abhiṣaṅgaḥ kāmādīnāṃ bhūtādīnāṃ ca sambandhaḥ, abhiśāpaḥ brāhmaṇaguruvṛddhasiddhānāmākrośo'niṣṭāpādanamabhiśapanam| taṃ cāgantukajvaraṃ ‘yathāsvairdoṣairjānīyāt’ iti pāṭha.| yathāsvadoṣairjānīyāt| yaduktaṃ “kāmaśokabhayādvāyuḥ” ityādi| ayaṃ ca doṣasambandhaḥ paścādbhāvī na tvārambhaka iti samprāptyavasare nirūpitam| āgantujvarāṇāṃ vaicitryamāha– ‘śyāvetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śyāvetyādi| śyāvaḥ śuklānuviddhaḥ kṛṣṇo varṇaḥ, śyāvavarṇa ityanye| viṣakṛte sthāvarādiviṣabhakṣaṇādikṛte, viṣasya tridoṣakartṛtve'pi atyantapittakaratvāt śyāvamukhatvam| atisāraḥ sthāvaraviṣayasyādhogatvāt| todo vyathā| śeṣaṃ sugamam| tīvrauṣadhigandhaghrāṇaje vamathuḥ chardiḥ, kṣavaḥ chikkā| śeṣaṃ sugamam| kāmaje abhimatakāminyādyaprāptinimittaje| cittavibhraṃśaḥ kiṅkartavyatāmūḍhatvam| yaduktaṃ vāgbhaṭe– “kāmādbhramo'ratirdāho hrīnidrādhīdhṛtikṣayaḥ| dhyānaniḥśvāsabahulaṃ liṅgaṃ kāmajvare smṛtam||” iti| śeṣaṃ subodham| bhayaśokakopābhiṣaṅgajvaramāha– kvacitpustake ‘bhayādityādi| bhayāditi bhayājjāte jvare’ etatsthāne ‘bhayāditi’ iti pā.| bhayādityādi| bhayāditi bhayājjāte jvare, evaṃ śokātkopādityatrāpi boddhavyam| pralāpaḥ asambaddhabhāṣaṇaṃ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ, ‘bhayājjāte jvare tathā śokāt kopādityetayorboddhavyam|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhayājjāte jvare tathā śokāt kopādityetayorboddhavyam| śokātpralāpa iti sambandhaḥ| kvacitpustake ‘pralāpaścātra vātakāryaḥ, sarvadaiva tasya vātakāryatvāt, viśeṣaniścayaśca nidānāt; nidānamapi kvacillakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| yadyevaṃ tatkathaṃ krodhādvepathuḥ, tasyāpi vātakāryatvāt|’ etatsthāne ‘viśeṣaniścayaśca nidānāt; anye nidānamapi kvacillakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| pralāpaścātra vātakāryaḥ, sarvadaiva tasya vātakāryatvāt, yadyevaṃ tatkathaṃ krodhādvepathuḥ, tasya api vātakāryatvāt|’ iti pā.| pralāpaścātra vātakāryaḥ, sarvadaiva tasya vātakāryatvāt, viśeṣaniścayaśca nidānāt; nidānamapi kvacillakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| yadyevaṃ tatkathaṃ krodhādvepathuḥ, tasyāpi vātakāryatvāt| ucyate– “ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāneva prakopaye|t” iti pittakopitavātajanya evātra vepathuḥ, kruddhaśca vepamāno dṛśyate kvacitpustake ‘iti na hi’ etatsthāne ‘na hīdṛśam’ iti pā.| iti na hi dṛṣṭeranupapannaṃ nāmeti jejjaṭaḥ| krodhaḥ pittamiva vātaṃ ca kopayatīti yuktaṃ; yadāha videhaḥ– “krodhaśokau smṛtau vātaraktapittaprakopaṇau|” iti| kopācceti cakāreṇa śirorogaṃ samuccinoti| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ– “krodhātkampaḥ śiroruk ca pralāpo bhayaśokaje|” iti| mānasatvāviśeṣe'pi bhayajādīnāṃ pṛthagupādānaṃ hetubhedāt, hetubhedācca bhedābhidhānaṃ ‘na tupratyanīkacikitsārthamiti’ iti pā.| hetupratyanīkacikitsārthamiti| abhicārābhiśāpābhyāṃ jāte jvare ‘mohaḥ acaitanyaṃ ca’ iti pā.| moho'caitanyaṃ jāyate; abhicāro mantrādibhirmāraṇaprayogaḥ, abhiśāpo brahmarṣigurusiddhādīnāmabhiśapanamākrośaḥ| tṛṣṇā ceti cakāreṇābhicāraje dāhādikaṃ samuccinoti| yaduktaṃ hārītamatānuvādinā vāgbhaṭena– “tantrābhicārikairmantrairhūyamānasya tapyate| pūrvaṃ cetastato dehastato visphoṭatṛḍbhramaiḥ|| sadāhamūrchāgrastasya pratyahaṃ vardhate jvaraḥ|” iti| bhūtā devagrahādaya unmādanidāne vakṣyamāṇāḥ, teṣāmabhisamantātsaṅgastasmāt| udvega udvignacittatā||26-29||

div.ab: kāmaśokabhayādvāyuḥ, krodhāt pittaṃ, trayo malāḥ ||30|| bhūtābhiṣaṅgātkupyanti bhūtasāmānyalakṣaṇāḥ |31| ‘āgantujeṣu’ iti pā.|

āgantujvareṣvapi pratiniyatadoṣānubandhapradarśanārthamāha– kāmaśoketyādi| trayo malā bhūtābhiṣaṅgāt kupyantīti bhūtaprabhāvāt| yacca carakeṇa nidānasthāne ‘abhiṣaṅgajaḥ punarvātapittābhyāṃ’ (ca. ni. a. 1) ityuktaṃ, tat prāyikaṃ mantavyamiti jejjaṭaḥ| cakrastvāha– “abhiṣaṅgaja ityanena kāmādyabhiṣaṅgaja ucyate, natu bhūtābhiṣaṅgajaḥ|” iti| bhūtasāmānyalakṣaṇā iti yasya bhūtasya devagrahāderabhiṣaṅgāt kupyanti tasya yallakṣaṇaṃ rodanādi tena ‘saha’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saha sāmānyaṃ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sadṛśa lakṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā, iti vyācakṣate jejjaṭādayaḥ; doṣalakṣaṇāni bhūtalakṣaṇāni ca bhavantītyarthaḥ||30||–

āgantujeṣu pratiniyatadoṣānubandhān pradarśayannāha– ‘kāmetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kāmetyādi| kāmaśokabhayairvāyuḥ kupyati, krodhena pittaṃ, bhūtābhiṣaṅgāttrayo doṣāḥ kupyanti| bhūtasāmānyalakṣaṇā iti yasya bhūtasya devagrahāderabhiṣaṅgātprakupyanti tasya yallakṣaṇaṃ rodanādi tena saha sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yeṣāṃ te tathā iti vyācakṣate jejjaṭādayaḥ| doṣalakṣaṇāni bhūtalakṣaṇāni ca bhavantītyarthaḥ; ‘tacca vakṣyamāṇe unmādanidāne draṣṭavyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tacca vakṣyamāṇe unmādanidāne draṣṭavyam||30||–

ab.seg: doṣo'lpo'hitasambhūto jvarotsṛṣṭasya vā punaḥ ||31||
dhātumanyatamaṃ prāpya karoti viṣamajvaram |32| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) | (santataḥ satato'nyedyustṛtīyakacaturthakau) ||2||

div.ab: atha viṣamajvarasamprāptimāha– doṣo'lpa ityādi| alpa ‘ityanenānatibalatvāt’ iti pā.| ityanenābalatvāt kālaviśeṣamavāpya labdhabalo jvarayati, yastu balavān sa nityajvarameva karoti| ahitasambhūta iti ‘...cārādijanitaḥ’ iti pā.| ahitāhārācārādisambhūto vṛddhaḥ| jvarotsṛṣṭasya sahasā nivṛttajvarasya| vāśabdena prathamato'pi viṣamajvaro bhavatīti darśayati| yaduktam– “ārambhādviṣamo yastu” ityādi| dhātumanyatamaṃ rasaraktādikam| viṣamajvaraṃ tṛtīyakādikam| viṣamajvarasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ ca bhālukinā paṭhitam– “yaḥ syādaniyatāt kālācchītoṣṇābhyāṃ tathaiva ca| vegataścāpi viṣamo jvaraḥ sa viṣamaḥ smṛtaḥ||” iti||31||–

atha viṣamajvarasamprāptimāha– ‘doṣa ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | doṣa ityādi| jvarotsṛṣṭasya puṃso'lpo doṣaḥ punarahitasambhūtaḥ san anyatamaṃ dhātuṃ prāpya viṣamajvaraṃ karoti| alpa ityanenābalatvātkālaviśeṣamavāpya labdhabalo jvarayati, yastu balavān sa nityameva jvaraṃ karoti| ahitasambhūta iti ahitāhārācārādijanitaḥ| jvarotsṛṣṭasya sahasā nivṛttajvarasya| vāśabdena prathamato'pi viṣamajvaro bhavatīti ‘darśayati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | darśayati| yaduktam– “ārambhādviṣamau yastu” iti| dhātumanyatamaṃ rasaraktādikam| viṣamajvaraṃ tṛtīyādikam| viṣamajvarasāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ ca bhālukinā paṭhitaṃ; tadyathā– “yaḥ syādaniyatātkālācchītoṣṇābhyāṃ tathaiva ca| vegataścāpi viṣamo jvaraḥ sa viṣamaḥ smṛtaḥ||” iti| ‘ete dhātugatāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ete dhātugatāḥ||31||–
