santataṃ rasaraktasthaḥ, so'nyedyuḥ piśitāśritaḥ ||32|| medogatastṛtīye'hni ‘asthimajjagataḥ’ iti pā.| tvasthimajjagataḥ punaḥ | kuryāccaturthakaṃ ghoramantakaṃ rogasaṅkaram ||33|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 31) |

ab.seg: santatādijvarāṇāṃ pratiniyatadūṣyān dhātūnāha– santatamityādi| santataśabdaḥ ‘upalakṣaṇam’ iti pā.| satatasyopalakṣaṇaḥ| tenaitaduktaṃ bhavati– rasasthaḥ santataṃ, raktasthaḥ ‘satatamiti’ iti pā.| satatakamiti; yaduktaṃ carake– “ ‘raktadhātvāśrito doṣaḥ kuryāt’ iti pā.| raktadhātvāśrayaḥ prāyo doṣaḥ satatakaṃ jvaram|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prāyograhaṇāt satatako raktavyatiriktaṃ rasadhātumāśrayate)| rasagrahaṇaṃ cātra viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvajvareṣu rasasyāvaśyadūṣyatvāt| anye tu satatagrahaṇārthaṃ ‘santatau rasaraktasthau’ iti paṭhanti| tannātiyuktam, atra hi santatasatataśabdau sañjñāparau, natu sātatyavacanau; tena santataśabdena satatakasyānabhidhānāt kathamekaśeṣa iti doṣaḥ| anyedyuriti anyedyuṣkam| ghoraṃ duḥsaham| antakaṃ yamamiva, mārakatvāt| rogasaṅkaram anekarogasaṅkulam||32-33||

santatādijvarāṇāṃ pratiniyatadūṣyān dhātūnāha– rasaraktastho doṣaḥ santataṃ kuryādityadhyāhāryamāṇena sambandhaḥ| ‘yo doṣo rasaraktāśrayaḥ sa santataṃ jvaraṃ karoti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yo doṣo rasaraktāśrayaḥ sa santataṃ jvaraṃ karoti| santataśabdaḥ satatasyopalakṣaṇaḥ| tenaitaduktaṃ bhavati– rasasthaḥ santataṃ, raktasthaḥ satatakamiti yaduktaṃ carake– “raktadhātvāśrayaḥ prāyo doṣaḥ satatakaṃ jvaram|” iti| rasagrahaṇaṃ cātra viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvajvareṣu rasasyāvaśyaṃ duṣṭatvāt| anye tu kvacitpustake ‘satataṃ sātatyārthakaṃ manyamānāḥ’ etatsthāne ‘satatagrahaṇārtham’ iti pā.| satataṃ sātatyārthakaṃ manyamānāḥ “santatau rasaraktasthau” iti paṭhanti| tanna yuktam| atra hetuḥ– santatasatataśabdau cātra sañjñāparau na tu sātatyavacanau, tena santataśabdena satatakasyānabhidhānātkathamekaśeṣaḥ? bhinnarūpayoḥ samānārthayoreva ekaśeṣavidhānāt| tathā ca vārtikam– “virūpāṇāmapi samānārthānām” iti| kecittu “satataṃ rasaraktasthaḥ” iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhitvā rasaraktastho doṣaḥ satatakaṃ jvaraṃ karotīti| anye tvatra santatamiti luptaṃ varṇayitvā santataṃ rasasthaḥ satataṃ raktasthaḥ kuryādityācakṣate| so'nyedyuriti sa iti doṣaḥ, piśitāśrito māṃsāśritaḥ, anyedyuriti anyedyuṣkam| doṣo'sthimajjagataścaturthe'hni cāturthakaṃ kuryāt| kīdṛśaṃ cāturthakaṃ? ‘ghorasuduḥsaham’ iti pā.| ghoraṃ suduḥsaham| antakaṃ yamamiva mārakatvāt| rogasaṅkaramanekarogasaṅkulaṃ, yato gambhīrasthānatvāccirakleśanatvācca rogānanyānapyāvahati||32-33||

div.ab: (srotobhirvisṛtā doṣā guravo rasavāhibhiḥ | kvacitpustake ‘sarvadehānugāḥ stabdhā jvaraṃ kurvanti santatam’ etatsthāne ‘sarvadehānugāḥ sarve kurvate santataṃ jvaraṃ’ iti pā.| sarvadehānugāḥ stabdhā jvaraṃ kurvanti santatam) | saptāhaṃ vā daśāhaṃ vā dvādaśāhamathāpi vā | santatyā yo'visargī syāt santataḥ sa nigadyate ||34|| ahorātre satatako dvau kālāvanuvartate | anyedyuṣkastvahorātra ekakālaṃ pravartate ||35|| tṛtīyakastṛtīye'hni, caturthe'hni caturthakaḥ |36| (su. u. taṃ. a. 31) |

athaiṣāṃ lakṣaṇānyāha– saptāhamityādi| ete vikalpā yathākramaṃ vātapittakapholbaṇatvena jñeyāḥ| yathoktam– “pittakaphānilavṛddhyā daśadivasadvādaśāhasaptāhāt| hanti vimuñcati vā''śu tridoṣajo dhātumalapākāt||” iti| ayaṃ ca santatastridoṣaja eva ‘dvādaśāhāśrayatvena’ iti pā.| dvādaśāśrayatvena| yaduktaṃ carakeṇa– “yathā dhātūṃstathā mūtraṃ purīṣaṃ cānilādayaḥ| yugapaccānupadyante niyamāt santate jvare||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| santatyā avicchedena saptāhādīn vyāpya avisargī aparityāgī, atyantasaṃyoge dvitīyā| nanu, yadyevaṃ kathamasya ‘viṣamajvaraprakaraṇe’ iti pā.| viṣamajvare pāṭhaḥ? muktānubandhitvaṃ viṣamatvaṃ, taccātra nāsti| naivam, asyāpi tathābhāvāt| tathā ca tallakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “visargaṃ dvādaśe kṛtvā ‘divase vyaktalakṣaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| divase'vyaktalakṣaṇaḥ| durlabhopaśamaḥ kālaṃ dīrghamapyanuvartate||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| yattūktaṃ kharanādena– “jvarāḥ pūrvaṃ mayoktā ye pañca santatakādayaḥ| catvāraḥ santataṃ hitvā jñeyāste viṣamajvarāḥ||” iti; tat santate muktānubandhitvasyaikadā bhāvitvenālpatvānna tadvyapadeśaḥ, ekataṇḍulābhyavahāre'naśanaśabdasya vyapadeśavat; nahi tṛtīyakādivadāvṛttyā muktānubandhitvamasyetyabhiprāyeṇa draṣṭavyam| athavā yā ‘viṣamajvarollekhenoktā’ iti pā.| viṣamajvarollekhena ‘cikitsā’ iti pā.| cikitsoktā sā ‘santate varjyā’ iti pā.| santatavarjaṃ satatādiṣu kāryeti pratipādanārtham| haricandreṇāpi ‘kila’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kila| “karma sādhāraṇaṃ jahyāttṛtīyakacaturthakau|” iti (ca. ci. a. 3) carakavacanādviṣamajvaroktacikitsā tṛtīyakacaturthakayoreva, anyeṣu doṣapratyanīkacikitsā ‘kāryetyabhidhāya vyākhyātam’ iti pā.| kāryeti vyākhyātam| asyāṃ haricandravyākhyāyāṃ karma sādhāraṇaṃ sarvatraiva viṣamajvare kāryaṃ, viśeṣeṇa tṛtīyakacaturthakayoriti draṣṭavyam; anyathā uktatantrāntaravirodhaḥ| ahorātre satatako dvau kālāvanuvartata iti ahni dvau kālau rātrau atra ‘dvau’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| dvau kālau vā; ahni ekakālaṃ rātrāvekakālamevaṃ vā; dvau kālau itīśānadevaḥ, niyamānabhidhānāt ‘tṛtīyamānānabhidhānāt’ iti pā.| tathā darśanācca| anuvartate vegaṃ karoti| tṛtīye'hni tṛtīyaka iti vegadināpekṣayā tṛtīye'hni yo bhavati sa tṛtīyako ‘bhavati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhavati, evaṃ caturthake'pi vācyam||34-35||– kvacitpustake ‘idānīmekadoṣadvidoṣajasya santatajvarasya visargakālāvadhidvāreṇa lakṣaṇamāha– srotobhirityādi|’ etatsthāne ‘santatasamprāptimāha-’ iti pā.|

idānīmekadoṣadvidoṣajasya santatajvarasya visargakālāvadhidvāreṇa lakṣaṇamāha– srotobhirityādi| sarvagātrānugāḥ sarve doṣā vātādayaḥ santatamavichinnaṃ kvacitpustake ‘jvaraṃ santāpaṃ’ etatsthāne ‘santāpaṃ jvaraṃ’ iti pā.| jvaraṃ santāpaṃ kurvanti| kimbhūtāḥ rasavāhibhiḥ srotobhiḥ atra ‘vistṛtāḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā., ‘vivṛtāḥ’ iti ca pā.| vistṛtāḥ vistṛtiṃ prāptāḥ, guravo duḥsahāḥ, sarvagātrānugāḥ santāpādinā samagraṃ gātraṃ ‘vyāpnuvate’ iti pā.| vyāpnuvanti| santatyā nairantaryeṇa saptāhādīn vyāpya avisargī atyāgaśīlaḥ sa jvaraḥ santataḥ| ayaṃ sukhasādhyaḥ; taduktaṃ tantrāntare “santatajvara evānyaḥ ‘svalpo durbalakārakaḥ’ iti pā.| svalpadurbalakāraṇaḥ| ekadoṣo dvidoṣo vā sukhasādhyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ||” iti| tathā ca– “vātikaḥ saptarātreṇa daśarātreṇa paittikaḥ| ślaiṣmiko dvādaśāhena jvaraḥ pākaṃ ‘niyacchati’ iti pā.| pragacchati” iti, prakṛtisamasamavetatvāt| nanu kathamasya viṣamajvare pāṭhaḥ? yaduktaṃ kharanādena– “jvarāḥ pañca mayoktā ye pūrvaṃ santatakādayaḥ| catvāraḥ santataṃ hitvā jñeyāste viṣamajvarāḥ||” iti; muktānubandhitvādviṣamatvaṃ, vimucyānubadhnātīti, taccātra nāsti| naivam, asyāpi tathābhāvāt| tathā ca tallakṣaṇe carakaḥ– “visargaṃ dvādaśe kṛtvā divase'vyaktalakṣaṇam| durlabhopaśamaḥ kālaṃ dīrghamapyanuvartate||” iti| satatakādīnāṃ kālānuvartanatvena lakṣaṇamāha– ‘ahorātra ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ahorātra ityādi| kālāḥ ṣaṭ pūrvāhṇamadhyāhnāparāhṇakapradoṣārdharātrapratyūṣāḥ; pūrvāhṇapradoṣayoḥ kaphasya kālaḥ, madhyāhnārdharātrayoḥ pittasya, aparāhṇapratyūṣayorvātasya| pūrvāhṇādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ kālānāṃ madhye ‘kāladvayamapyanuvartate’ iti pā.| kāladvayamanuvartate, vegaṃ karoti ‘sa’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sa satataḥ; ‘ahni ekakālaṃ rātrāvekakālaṃ vā, ahni dvau kālau rātrau dvau kālau vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ahni ekakālaṃ rātrāvekakālaṃ vā, ahni dvau kālau rātrau dvau kālau vā, kvacitpustake ‘evaṃ dvau kālāviti īśāno yaduktavān tatra doṣotkarṣāpakarṣābhyāmadhikakālatvaṃ hīnakālatvamapi jñātavyaṃ na tu niyamaḥ| anyedyuṣko jvara ekakālamanuvartate vegaṃ karoti ahorātrādanyasminnahorātre ekakālamāgacchatītyarthaḥ| tṛtīyakaḥ tṛtīye'hni ekakālamiti sambadhyate| cāturthakaścaturthe'hnītyatrāpyekaṃ kālamiti|’ etatsthāne ‘anyedyuṣko jvara ekakālamanuvartate vegaṃ karoti ahorātrādanyasminnahorātre ekakālamāgacchatītyarthaḥ| tṛtīyakaḥ tṛtīye'hni ekakālamiti sambadhyate| cāturthakaścaturthe'hnītyatrāpyekaṃ kālamiti| evaṃ dvau kālāviti īśāno yaduktavān tatra doṣotkarṣāpakarṣābhyāmadhikakālatvaṃ hīnakālatvamapi jñātavyaṃ na tu niyamaḥ|’ iti pā.| evaṃ dvau kālāviti īśāno yaduktavān tatra doṣotkarṣāpakarṣābhyāmadhikakālatvaṃ hīnakālatvamapi jñātavyaṃ na tu niyamaḥ| anyedyuṣko jvara ekakālamanuvartate vegaṃ karoti ahorātrādanyasminnahorātre ekakālamāgacchatītyarthaḥ| tṛtīyakaḥ tṛtīye'hni ekakālamiti sambadhyate| cāturthakaścaturthe'hnītyatrāpyekaṃ kālamiti| ete catvāro viṣamajvarāḥ| yaduktaṃ kharanādena– “jvarāḥ pañca mayoktāḥ” ityādinā| eṣāṃ cotpattikramo vṛddhasuśrutādavagantavyaḥ, sa ‘tadāha’ iti pā.| yadāha– “ ‘ahorātrādahorātraṃ sthānātsthānaṃ’ iti pā.| ahorātrādahorātrāt sthānātsthāne prapadyate| tataścāmāśayaṃ prāpya karoti viṣamajvaram|| tathā pralepako jñeyaḥ śoṣiṇāṃ prāṇanāśanaḥ| duścikitsyatamo mandaḥ sa kaṣṭo dhātuśoṣakṛt|| kṛśānāṃ jvaramuktānāṃ mithyāhāravihāriṇām| doṣaḥ svalpo'pi saṃvṛddho dehināmanileritaḥ|| kaphasthānavibhāgena yathāsaṅkhyaṃ karoti hi| satatānyedyuṣkatryākhyacaturthānsapralepakān||” iti| asyāyamarthaḥ– āmāśayahṛdayakaṇṭhaśiraḥsandhaya iti pañca kaphasthānāni, eṣu sthitairdoṣairyathāsaṅkhyamahorātrāt sthānaṃ prapadya āmāśayaṃ gatvā satatādayaḥ kriyante| tatrāmāśayasthitena doṣeṇa satataḥ kriyate parantu dvikālaṃ naca sarvadā; na cāmāśayaprāptyā sarvadā'sya ‘sambhavaprasaṅge'pi’ iti pā.| sambhavaprasaṅgaḥ, ahorātre svaprakopakālāpekṣayā jvarotpatteḥ| hṛdayasthitena doṣeṇa ekasmin dine āmāśayamāgatyānyedyuḥ kriyate, ‘satatārambhakadoṣāpekṣayā asya’ iti pā.| satatārambhakadoṣāpekṣayāsya vyavahitatvāt| kaṇṭhasthitena doṣeṇaikasmin dine hṛdayamāgamyate, anyasmin dine āmāśayamāgatya ‘jvaramārabhyate sa’ iti pā.| jvara ārabhyate tṛtīyakaḥ| evaṃ śirasi sthitena doṣeṇa kaṇṭhahṛdayāmāśayān tribhirdinaiḥ krameṇa prāpya caturthe'hni cāturthakaḥ kriyate| punaḥ svasthānagamanaṃ tu doṣāṇāṃ hṛtavegatvena lāghavādvegadina eva bhavati| sandhisthitena doṣeṇa pralepakaḥ, sandhayaścāmāśaye'pi santīti sa sarvadā bhavati| aviṣamo'pyayaṃ viṣamasahacaritaḥ paṭhitaḥ, ‘kaphasthānotpādakānurodhāt’ iti pā.| kaphasthānotpādānurodhāt| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “ ‘pralepakastu viṣamaḥ’ iti pā.| pralepakastvaviṣamaḥ prāyaḥ kleśāya śoṣiṇām|” iti| viṣamajvara evānyaścāturthakaviparyayaḥ, iti| atra tantrāntare– “asthimajjobhayagate cāturthikaviparyayaḥ| madhye'hani jvarayati hyādāvante ca muñcati||” iti| ādāvekadinaṃ na bhūtvā madhye dinadvayaṃ bhūtvā ante ekadinaṃ na bhavatīti vyācakṣate jejjaṭādayaḥ| “asthimajjobhayagate cāturthakaviparyayaḥ| tryahāddvyahaṃ jvarayati hyādāvante vimuñcati||” iti ‘tantrāntaram’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tantrāntaram| ‘cāturthikaviparyayo’ iti pā.| cāturthakaviparyayo nāmnā jvaraḥ| asthi ca majjā ca asthimajjānau asthimajjñorubhayaṃ tatra gato yo malo'sthiṣu majjasu vā gatastasmin ‘triprakāro jāyate’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | triprakāro jāyate||34-35||–
kecidbhūtābhiṣaṅgotthaṃ bruvate viṣamajvaram ||36|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: viṣamajvarasyaikīyamatena bhūtābhiṣaṅgajatvamāha– kecidityādi| paravacanamapratiṣiddhamanumataṃ suśrutena; ata eva viṣamajvare daivavyapāśrayaṃ balihomādi bhūtocitaṃ, yuktivyapāśrayaṃ kaṣāyapānādi doṣocitaṃ ca vidhīyate| yadāha carakaḥ– “karma sādhāraṇaṃ jahyāttṛtīyakacaturthakau| āganturanubandho hi prāyaśo viṣamajvare||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| atra sādhāraṇamiti daivayuktivyapāśrayamiti vyācakṣate iti||36||

parakīyamatamāha– kecidityādi| kecana ācāryā viṣamajvaraṃ bhūtābhiṣaṅgotthaṃ kathayanti| ata eva viṣamajvare daivavyapāśrayaṃ balimaṅgalahomādibhūtocitaṃ yuktivyapāśrayaṃ kaṣāyapānādikaṃ kvacitpustake ‘doṣocitaṃ ca’ etatsthāne ‘doṣocite’ iti pā.| doṣocitaṃ ca vidhīyate| yadāha carakaḥ– “karma sādhāraṇaṃ jahyāttṛtīyakacaturthakau| āganturanubandho hi prāyaśo ‘viṣamajvaraḥ’ iti pā.| viṣamajvare||” iti| atra sādhāraṇamiti daivayuktivyapāśrayamiti vyācakṣate||36||

div.ab: kaphapittāttrikagrāhī pṛṣṭhādvātakaphātmakaḥ | vātapittācchirogrāhī trividhaḥ syāttṛtīyakaḥ ||37|| caturthako darśayati prabhāvaṃ dvividhaṃ jvaraḥ | jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pūrvaṃ śirasto'nilasambhavaḥ ||38|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg: ulbaṇadoṣabhedena tṛtīyakacaturthakayorlakṣaṇāntaramāha– kaphapittādityādi| trikagrāhī vedanayā trikavyāpī, trikasya vātasthānatvena tadgatau pittakaphāvanyasthānagatatvena durbalau ‘tṛtīye dine’ iti pā.| tṛtīyadine vegaṃ kurutaḥ, yadi tu svasthānasthitau syātāṃ tadā ‘santatameva’ iti pā.| santatajvarameva kuryātāmiti jejjaṭaḥ| evaṃ śirasi kaphasthāne, pṛṣṭhe ca pittasthāne boddhavyam| pṛṣṭhāditi lyablope karmaṇi pañcamī, pṛṣṭhaṃ vedanayā vyāpyetyarthaḥ| naca vācyaṃ yadi trikaṃ vātasthānaṃ tatkathaṃ tatra pittakaphāviti; prakṛtisthānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ sthānaniyamo natu prakupitānāṃ, teṣāṃ sarvadehagatatvāt| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “kupitānāṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ śarīre paridhāvatām| yatra saṅgaḥ khavaiguṇyādvyādhistatropajāyate||” (su. sū. a. 24) iti| evamanyasthānagatatvena doṣadaurbalyādi caturthake'pi vācyam| prabhāvaṃ ‘rujārūpaśaktim’ iti pā.| rujārūpāṃ śaktim| ‘dvaividhyam’ iti pā.| dvividhaṃ vivṛṇoti– ‘jaṅghābhyāmityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | jaṅghābhyāmityādi| jaṅghābhyāṃ śirasta iti| etacca pañcamīdvayaṃ pūrvavat| pūrvamiti prathamaṃ, tatra bhūtvā ‘sarvadeham’ iti pā.| nikhilaṃ dehaṃ vyāpnoti| ślaiṣmika iti śleṣmolbaṇaḥ, santatasatatakānyedyuṣkatṛtīyakacaturthakānāṃ pañcānāṃ ‘sannipātajatvāt’ iti pā.| sānnipātikatvāt| yaduktaṃ carake– “prāyaśaḥ sannipātena dṛṣṭaḥ pañcavidho jvaraḥ| sannipāte tu yo bhūyān sa doṣaḥ parikīrtitaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| athavā ‘prāyograhaṇena ekadoṣajā’ iti pā.| prāyograhaṇādekadoṣajā dvidoṣajā api bhavanti| anye tvāhuḥ– vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhāḥ santatādayaḥ sannipātajāḥ, teṣāmevodbhūtadoṣeṇa vyapadeśaḥ; prakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhāste ‘tvekadoṣajā’ iti pā.| ekadoṣajadvidoṣajā api bhavantīti jejjaṭaḥ| ‘caturthakastu’ iti pā.| prakṛtisamasamavāyārabdhaścaturthakastu pittena na kriyata eva, vyādhisvabhāvāt; pittajagalagaṇḍavat| nanu, asti paittiko'pi caturthakaḥ; tathā ca ‘hārīto’ iti pā.| hārītācāryo vyāharati– “caturthako nāma gado dāruṇo viṣamajvaraḥ| śoṣaṇaḥ sarvadhātūnāṃ balavarṇāgnināśanaḥ|| tridoṣajo vikāraḥ syādasthimajjagato'nilaḥ| kupitaṃ pittamevaṃ tu kaphaścaivaṃ ‘svakālataḥ’ iti pā.| svabhāvataḥ|| śītadāhakarastīvrastrikālaṃ cānuvartate| ‘sa sannipātasambhūto’ iti pā.| sannipātasamudbhūto viṣamo viṣamajvaraḥ|| ūrdhvaṃ kāyasya gṛhṇāti yaḥ pūrvaṃ so'nilātmakaḥ| pūrvaṃ gṛhṇātyadhaḥkāyaṃ ‘śleṣmapūrvajvaraśca saḥ’ iti pā.| śleṣmavṛddhaścaturthakaḥ||” iti| atrāhuḥ– anubandharūpamatra pittaṃ, na tvārambhakaṃ; kathameṣā pratītiriti cet, sthānaviśeṣānabhidhānāt; ata eva hārītenāpi sthānaṃ nodāhṛtameva jaṅghādivaditi carakaṭīkākṛto vyācakṣate| kintveṣā vyākhyā tadā saṅgacchate yadi pittaliṅgaṃ kvacitpustake ‘nodbhūtaṃ dṛśyate, dṛśyate ca;’ etatsthāne ‘samudbhūtaṃ na dṛśyate|’ iti pā.| nodbhūtaṃ dṛśyate, dṛśyate ca; ‘tathā’ iti pā.| tathāhi kathyate– bheḍe'pi paittikaḥ paṭhyate– “āmāśayasthaḥ pavano hyasthimajjagato'pi vā| kupitaḥ kopayatyāśu śleṣmāṇaṃ pittameva ca||” iti| kiñca nāgabhartṛtantre sthānamapyuktameva– “ūrdhvakāyaṃ tu yaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhṇāti so'nilātmakaḥ| madhyakāyaṃ tu gṛhṇāti pūrvaṃ yastu sa pittajaḥ|| pūrvaṃ gṛhṇātyadhaḥkāyaṃ śleṣmavṛddhaścaturthakaḥ||” iti| tasmāt prāyeṇa kaphavātābhyāṃ bhavatīti paittikaścaturthakaścarakādibhirnodāhṛtaḥ, ‘ prāyo'sambhavāt’ iti pā.| natvasambhavāditi mantavyam| eṣāṃ cotpattikramo vṛddhasuśrutādavagantavyaḥ| sa yadāha– “ahorātrādahorātrāt sthānāt sthānaṃ prapadyate| tataścāmāśayaṃ prāpya karoti viṣamajvaram|| kaphasthānavibhāgena yathāsaṅkhyaṃ karoti hi| satatānyedyuṣkatryākhyacaturthān sapralepakān||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| ‘asyārthaḥ’ iti pā.| asyāyamarthaḥ– āmāśayahṛdayakaṇṭhaśiraḥsandhayaḥ pañca kaphasthānāni, eṣu sthitairdoṣairyathāsaṅkhyaṃ satatādayaḥ kriyante| tatrāmāśayasthitena doṣeṇa satatakaḥ kriyate dvikālaṃ ‘na ca sarvadā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | na ca sarvadā; na ‘cāmāśayaprāptau’ iti pā.| cāmāśayaprāptyā sarvadā prasaṅgaḥ, ‘ahorātre’ iti pā.| ahorātreṣu ‘prakopakālāpekṣayā’ iti pā.| kāleṣu svaprakopakālāpekṣayā jvarotpatteḥ| hṛdayasthitena doṣeṇāmāśayamāgatyānyedyuṣkaḥ kriyate ekakālaṃ, atra ‘naca sarvadā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| naca sarvadā, satatārambhakadoṣāpekṣayā'sya vyavahitatvāt| kaṇṭhasthitena doṣeṇaikasmin dine hṛdayamāgamyate, aparasminnāmāśayamāgatya jvara ārabhyate tṛtīyakaḥ| evaṃ śiraḥsthitena doṣeṇa kaṇṭhahṛdayāmāśayān atra ‘trīn’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| trīn tribhirdinaiḥ krameṇa prāpya caturthakaḥ kriyate| punaḥ svasthānagamanaṃ tu doṣāṇāṃ hṛtavegatvena lāghavādvegadina eva bhavati| sandhisthitena doṣeṇa pralepakaḥ kriyate, sandhayaścāmāśaye'pi santīti atra ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sa “sarveṣu kaphasthāneṣu vyavasthito doṣaḥ santataṃ karotīti jñeyaṃ, tantrāntaroktatvāt” iti vṛndaṭīkāyāṃ śrīkaṇṭhadattaḥ| sarvadā bhavati| ayaṃ cāviṣamo'pi viṣamasahacaritaḥ paṭhitaḥ kaphasthānotpādānurodhāt| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “ ‘pralepakastu viṣamaḥ’ iti pā.| pralepakastvaviṣamaḥ prāyaḥ kleśāya śoṣiṇām||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti||37-38||

ulbaṇadoṣabhedena tṛtīyakacaturthakayorlakṣaṇāntaramāha– ‘tṛtīyaka ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tṛtīyaka ityādi| tṛtīyako jvarastrividho bhavati| kaphapittāttrikagrāhī vedanayā trikavyāpī| trikasya ‘vātasthānatvena tadgatau’ iti pā.| vātasthānatvāttadgatau kaphapittau anyasthānagatatvena durbalau tṛtīyadine vegaṃ kurutaḥ, yadi tu svasthānasthitau syātāṃ tadā santatameva kuryātāmiti jejjaṭaḥ| evaṃ śirasi kaphasthāne pṛṣṭhe ca pittasthāne boddhavyam| na ca vācyaṃ yadi trikaṃ vātasthānaṃ tatkathaṃ tatra pitta kaphāviti? ucyate– prakṛtisthānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ ‘sthānaniyamāt,’ iti pā.| sthānaniyamo na tu kupitānāṃ, teṣāṃ sarvagatatvāt| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “kupitānāṃ hi doṣāṇāṃ śarīre paridhāvatām| yatra saṅgaḥ khavaiguṇyādvyādhistatropajāyate||” iti| evamanyasthānagatatvena doṣadaurbalyādicaturthake'pi vācyam| ‘vātakaphātmako jvaro vedanayā pṛṣṭhagrāhī, vātapittātmako vedanayā śirogrāhī, evaṃ traividhyam| iti pāṭhaḥ’ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vātakaphātmako jvaro vedanayā pṛṣṭhagrāhī, vātapittātmako vedanayā śirogrāhī, evaṃ traividhyam| cāturthiko dviprakārāṃ śaktiṃ darśayati– jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ, anilasambhavaḥ śirasaḥ, vedanayetyarthaḥ| cāturthikaḥ pittena atra ‘na’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| na kriyate ityeke, vyādhisvabhāvāt pittajagalagaṇḍavat| hārītastu cāturthiko'pi paittiko'stīti vadati– “cāturthiko nāma gado dāruṇo viṣamajvaraḥ| śoṣaṇaḥ sarvadhātūnāṃ balavarṇāgnināśanaḥ|| tridoṣajo vikāraḥ syādasthimajjāgato'nilaḥ| ‘kurvanti’ iti pā.| karoti pittamevaṃ tu kaphaścaivaṃ svabhāvataḥ||” ityādi| atrāhuḥ– ‘anubandharūpamātram’ iti pā.| anubandharūpamatra pittaṃ na tvārambhakaṃ, kathameṣā pratītiriti cet, sthānaviśeṣānabhidhānāt; ata eva hārītenāpi sthānaṃ nodāhṛtaṃ jaṅghādivaditi carakaṭīkākṛto vyācakṣate| kiṃ tveṣā vyākhyā tadā saṅgacchate yadi pittaliṅgaṃ nodbhūtaṃ ‘dṛśyate’ iti pā.| dṛśyeta, dṛśyate ca| tathā ca bheḍe'pi paṭhitam– “āmāśayasthaḥ pavano hyasthimajjagato'pi vā| kupitaḥ kopayatyāśu śleṣmāṇaṃ pittameva vā||” iti| kiñca vāgbhaṭatantre sthānamapyuktameva “ūrdhvakāyaṃ tu yaḥ pūrvaṃ gṛhṇīte so'nilātmakaḥ| madhyakāyaṃ tu gṛhṇāti pūrvaṃ yastu sa pittajaḥ|| pūrvaṃ gṛhṇātyadhaḥkāyaṃ śleṣmā vṛddhaścaturthakāḥ|” iti| tasmāt prāyeṇa kaphavātābhyāṃ bhavatīti paittikaścāturthakaścarakādibhinodāhṛta eva, ‘prāyosambhavāditi’ iti pā.| natvasambhavāditi mantavyam||37-38||

div.ab: viṣamajvara evānyaścaturthakaviparyayaḥ | ‘sa madhye jvarayatyahnī ādāvante ca muñcati’ iti pā., ‘tryahād dvayaham’ ityasya sthāne ‘madhye'hani’ iti pā. tryahād dvayahaṃ jvarayati hyādāvante ca muñcati ||39|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg: caturthakaviparyayamāha– viṣametyādi| atra tantrāntaram– “asthimajjobhayagate caturthakaviparyayaḥ| ‘tryahād dvayahaṃ jvarayati’ ityasya sthāne ‘madhye'hani jvarayati’ iti pā., ‘sa madhye jvarayatyahnī’ iti ca pā.| tryahād dvyahaṃ jvarayati hyādāvante ca muñcati||” iti| ādāvekadinaṃ ‘na bhūtvā’ iti pā.| muktvā, madhye dinadvayaṃ bhūtvā, ante ekadinaṃ na bhavatīti vyācakṣate jejjaṭādayaḥ| “asthimajjobhayagate caturthakaviparyayaḥ| tryahāddvyahaṃ jvarayatyādāvante ca muñcati||” iti parāśaravacanasyāpi sa evārthaḥ; tryahāditi tryahasyādidinaṃ vimuñcati, dinadvayaṃ jvarayati, tryahasyānte ‘caturthadine’ iti pā.| caturthadinaṃ muñcatīti ‘tātparyato’ iti pā.| tātparyārthaṃ vyācakṣate| haricandrastvāha-dve ahanī nirantaraṃ jvarayitvā uparamyaikamahaḥ punarjvarayatītyeṣaścaturthakaviparyaya iti| ‘ādidinābhāvaścottarottarapālidivaseṣvavadhāryaḥ’ iti pā.| ādidinābhāvaścottarottarapātidivaseṣvavadhāryaḥ| caturthakaviparyayasyopalakṣaṇatvena tṛtīyakādiviparyayo'pyūhyaḥ ityāhuḥ| tadyathā– madhye ekadinaṃ jvarayati, ādyantayormuñcatīti tṛtīyakaviparyayaḥ; kvacitpustake ‘ekakālaṃ vimucya sarvamahorātraṃ vyāpnotītyanyedyuṣkaviparyayaḥ; kāladvaye muñcati, sarvamahorātraṃ jvarayatīti satatakaviparyayaḥ|’ etatsthāne ‘kāladvaye muñcati, sarvamahorātraṃ jvarayatīti satatakaviparyayaḥ; ekakālaṃ vimucya sarvamahorātraṃ vyāpnotītyanyedyuṣkaviparyayaḥ|’ iti pā.| ekakālaṃ vimucya sarvamahorātraṃ vyāpnotītyanyedyuṣkaviparyayaḥ; ( ( ) etaccihnāntargataḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kāladvaye muñcati, sarvamahorātraṃ jvarayatīti satatakaviparyayaḥ)| atra doṣavikṛtireva nānāvidhā heturiti| “kaphasthāneṣu vā tiṣṭan doṣo dvitricaturṣu ca| viparyayākhyān kurute viṣamān kṛcchrasādhanān||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti vṛddhasuśrutavākyaṃ vyācakṣāṇo jejjaṭaḥ– anyedyuṣkatṛtīyacaturthakamātrasya viparyayamudāharati, tadyathā– āmāśayahṛdayasthadoṣeṇa yathodāhṛta evānyedyuṣkaviparyayaḥ; āmāśayahṛdayakaṇṭhasthitena tṛtīyakaviparyayaḥ; tatraikasmin dine hṛdayastho doṣa āmāśayamāgatya tatsthena saha jvarayati, taddine ‘kaṇṭhastho’ iti pā.| kaṇṭhasthitaśca hṛdayamāyāti, aparadine so'pyāmāśayamāgatya jvarayati, evaṃ ‘dinadvaye’ iti pā.| dinadvayaṃ bhūtvā paścādekadinaṃ na bhavatīti tṛtīyakaviparyayaḥ; āmāśayahṛdayakaṇṭhaśiraḥsthena doṣeṇa caturthakaviparyaya kriyate tatra yasmin dine hṛdayastho doṣa āmāśayamāgatya jvarayati ‘tasmin dine’ ityasya sthāne ‘tasminneva’ iti pā.| tasmin dine kaṇṭhastho hṛdayaṃ śirasthaḥ kaṇṭhamāyāti, aparadine ‘hṛdistha’ iti pā.| hṛdayastha āmāśayamāgatya jvarayati kaṇṭhasthitaśca hṛdayamāyāti, aparadine hṛdistha ‘āmāśayamāgatya’ iti pā.| evāmāśayamāgatya jvarayati, evaṃ dinatraye bhūtvā paścādekadinaṃ na bhavatīti caturthakaviparyaya iti| ete ca sarva eva ‘pakṣā’ iti pā.| jvarā na viruddhāḥ, sarveṣāmeva munipraṇītatvāt| yathoktaṃ smṛtiśāstre– “smṛtidvaidhaṃ tu yatra syāttatra dharmāvubhau matau||” (manu. smṛ. a. 2/14) iti| dṛśyante ca nānāvidhā eva viṣamajvarāḥ; eṣa ‘ca’ iti pā.| eva nyāyaścarakasuśrutayoḥ ‘kaṇṭhavaiṣamye’ iti pā., ‘kuṣṭhavaidharmye’ iti ca. pā.| kuṣṭhavaiṣamye vāpyacandreṇa darśitaḥ; na vā cikitsābhedo'pyeṣāmuktaḥ; yaiva tṛtīyakādau cikitsā saiva tadviparyaye'pīti||39||

cāturthikaviparyayamāha– ‘viṣametyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | viṣametyādi| cāturthakaviparyayo'nyo viṣamajvaraḥ| ‘tryahāttryahamiti tryahāttryahaṃ tridinam’ iti pā.| tryahāddvyahamiti tryahāddvyahaṃ dvidinaṃ jvarayati ekaṃ dinaṃ vimuñcati, evaṃ ‘tṛtīyakaviparyayo’ ityasya sthāne ‘dvitīyatṛtīyake viparyayo’ iti pā.| tṛtīyakaviparyayo vācyaḥ| atra doṣavikṛtireva heturiti| pūrvokteṣu kaphasthānavibhāgeṣu kvacitpustake ‘dvitricaturṣu tiṣṭhan doṣo’ etatsthāne ‘tiṣṭhan doṣo dvitricaturṣu’ iti pā.| dvitricaturṣu tiṣṭhan doṣo viparyayaṃ kurute| uktaṃ ca– “kaphasthāneṣu vā tiṣṭhandoṣo dvitricaturṣu vā| viparyayākhyānkurute viṣamānkṛcchrasādhanān” iti| nānāvidhā eva viṣamajvarā dṛśyante| eṣa nyāyaścarakasuśrutayoḥ kuṣṭhavaidharmye vāpyacandreṇa darśitaḥ| suśrute viṣamajvarāṇāmupaśāntavegānāmapi ‘dehe sthānam’ iti pā.| dehe'vasthānaṃ darśitam| tadyathā– “sa cāpi viṣamo dehaṃ na kadācidvimuñcati| ‘yasmādgauravavaivarṇyakārśyebhyo’ iti pā.| yasmādgauravavairasyakārśyebhyo na vimucyate|| vege tu samatikrānte gato'yamiti lakṣyate| gauravaṃ śiraso glānirnātiśraddhā ca bhojane|| mādhuryamatha vairasyaṃ tiktatvamathavā punaḥ| vaktrasya jāyate yasmātpravege'pi gate sati| tasmāttu niyato ‘kuṣṭhaḥ’ iti pā., ‘puṣṭaḥ’ iti ca pā.| juṣṭaḥ śarīre viṣamajvaraḥ” iti||39||

div.ab: nityaṃ mandajvaro rūkṣaḥ śūnakastena sīdati | stabdhāṅgaḥ śleṣmabhūyiṣṭho ‘naro vātabalāsakī’ iti pā. bhavedvātabalāsakī ||40|| (a. saṃ. ni. a. 2) |

ab.seg: uktasaṅgatyā pralepakādanūpadravatvena ‘tatsamadharmiṇi’ iti pā.| tatsadharmiṇi vātabalāsake vācye pratilomatantrayuktyā vātabalāsakamevāha– nityamityādi| vātabalāsakākhyo jvaro'syāstīti vātabalāsakī naraḥ, tena jvareṇa, śūnakaḥ śothī, sīdati avasanno bhavati; śothinaḥ sa upadrava ityarthaḥ| ‘śūnaḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyati’ iti pāṭhāntare ‘tena’ iti śeṣaḥ| vātabalāsakameke kumbhāhvayapāṇḍurogaviṣayamāhuriti ‘gayadāsaḥ’ iti pā.| gadādharaḥ| vātabalāsakārabdhatvādvātabalāsakaḥ; balāsakaḥ śleṣmā, pittamapyatra boddhavyam| ‘tantrāntare yaduktam’ iti pā.| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “vāyuḥ prakupito doṣāvudīryobhau vidhāvati| sa śirasthaḥ śiraḥśūlam||” ityādi| yaccoktaṃ suśrutena– “pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ vā kaphādhikatvāt pravadanti tajjñāḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti, tattu śleṣmaṇo nityānuṣaktatveneti jejjaṭaḥ| rūkṣatvaṃ cāsya vātapittābhibhūtatvāt kaphasnehasya vyādhiprabhāvādveti||40||

vātabalāsakajvaramāha– vātabalāsako jvaro'syāstīti vātabalāsakī naraḥ, tena jvareṇa, śūnakaḥ śothī, sīdati avasanno bhavati, ‘śothitaḥ’ iti pā.| śothinaḥ sa upadrava ityarthaḥ| kvacitpustake ‘kīdṛśaḥ? nityaṃ mandajvaro nityaṃ satataṃ, mandajvaro mandavegaḥ,’ etatsthāne ‘kīdṛśo, nityaṃ mandajvaro mandavegaḥ, nityaṃ satatam,’ iti pā.| kīdṛśaḥ? nityaṃ mandajvaro nityaṃ satataṃ, mandajvaro mandavegaḥ, vātabalāsakārabdhatvādvātabalāsakaḥ| balāsaḥ śleṣmā| ‘pittamatrāpi’ iti pā.| pittamapyatra boddhavyam| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “vāyuḥ prakupito doṣāvudīryobhau vidhāvati| sa śirasthaḥ śiraḥśūlam” ityādi| yaduktaṃ suśrutena– “pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ vā kaphādhikatvātpravadanti tajjñāḥ” iti| ‘tataḥ śleṣmaṇā pittānuṣaktatveneti’ iti pā.| tattu śleṣmaṇo nityānuṣaktatveneti jejjaṭaḥ| rūkṣatvaṃ cāsya vātapittābhibhūtatvātkaphasya vyādhiprabhāvādvā| stabdhāṅgaśleṣmabhūyiṣṭha iti stabdhāṅgaśca śleṣmabhūyiṣṭhaśca; taduktaṃ suśrute– “pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ vā kaphādhikatvena vadanti tajjñāḥ” iti| anyatra tu vātādhikatvena darśitaḥ, tatkathamatra ‘śleṣmabhūyiṣṭhamuktam’ iti pā.| śleṣmabhūyiṣṭhatvamuktam| atrocyate– vāteritasarvasandhirūpakaphārabdhatvāt, vātabalāsakastu yathārthanāmā ‘vāterita iti’ iti pā.| vāterito balāsaka ārambhako yasyeti| śūnaḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyatīti pāṭhāntaram| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tena vātabalāsakameke kumbhāhvayapāṇḍurogaviṣayamāhuriti gayādāsaḥ||40||

div.ab: pralimpanniva gātrāṇi gharmeṇa gauraveṇa ca | mandajvaravilepī ca saśītaḥ syātpralepakaḥ ||41|| (a. saṃ. ni. a. 2) |

ab.seg: pralepakamāha– pralimpannityādi| mandajvaraścāsau vilepī ceti ‘mandajvaratvam’ iti pā.| mandajvaravilepī, vilepitvaṃ cāsya yasmādgharmagauravābhyāṃ limpati sambadhnātītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ ca kaphapittajaḥ| yaduktaṃ suśrutena “pralepakaṃ vātabalāsakaṃ vā” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ityādi| tathā yakṣmaṇi “jvaro dāho'tisāraśca pittādraktasya cāgamaḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) ityuktaṃ, yakṣmaṇi cāyaṃ bhavatīti| anye tu tridoṣajayakṣmajanitatvena tridoṣaja evāyam, udbhūtatvena tu kaphapittavyapadeśaḥ||41||

mandajvaraścāsau vilepī ca kvacitpustake ‘mandajvaravilepī, vilepitvaṃ’ etatsthāne ‘mandajvaravilepitvaṃ’ iti pā.| mandajvaravilepī, vilepitvaṃ cāsya gharmeṇeti ātapeneva gauraveṇa ‘gurutvena vā’ iti pā.| gurutveneva limpati sambadhnāti sa pralepakākhyo jvaraḥ| ‘saśītaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saśītaḥ śītayuktaḥ| ayaṃ ca kaphapittajaḥ| yaduktaṃ suśrutena yakṣmaṇi– “jvaro dāho'tisāraśca pittādraktasya cāgamaḥ|” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| yakṣmaṇi cāyaṃ ‘bhavatīti’ iti pā.| bhavati| anye tu tridoṣajanitatvena tridoṣaja evāyam, ‘tadbhūtatvena’ iti pā.| udbhūtatvena tu kaphapittavyapadeśaḥ| gātrāṇi ‘pralampatīva’ iti pā.| pralimpatīveti pralepako'nvarthasañjñaḥ||41||

div.ab: vidagdhe'nnarase dehe śleṣmapitte vyavasthite | tenārdhaṃ śītalaṃ ‘dehe cārdhaṃ coṣṇam’ iti pā. dehamardhamuṣṇaṃ prajāyate ||42|| kāye duṣṭaṃ yadā pittaṃ śleṣmā cānte vyavasthitaḥ | tenoṣṇatvaṃ śarīrasya śītatvaṃ hastapādayoḥ ||43|| kāye śleṣmā yadā duṣṭaḥ ‘pitte’ iti pā. pittaṃ cānte vyavasthitam | śītatvaṃ tena gātrāṇāmuṣṇatvaṃ hastapādayoḥ ||44|| (a. saṃ. ni. a. 2) | tvaksthau śleṣmānilau śītamādau janayato jvare | tayoḥ praśāntayoḥ pittamante dāhaṃ karoti ca ||45|| karotyādau tathā pittaṃ tvaksthaṃ dāhamatīva ca | tasmin praśānte tvitarau kurutaḥ śītamantataḥ ||46|| dvāvetau dāhaśītādijvarau saṃsargajau smṛtau | dāhapūrvastayoḥ kaṣṭaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatamaśca saḥ ||47|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: viṣamajvaraviśeṣānāha– vidagdha ityādi| vidagdhe'nnarase duṣṭe āhārarase tathā duṣṭe pitte duṣṭe śleṣmaṇi kvacitpustake ‘dehe’ etatsthāne ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ, kvacitpustake ‘dehe’ iti pāṭho nopalabhyate ca| dehe vyavasthite ‘sati’ iti pā.| bhavataḥ, ‘tena hetunā ‘ dehe'rdham’ iti pā.| dehamardhaṃ śītalaṃ kaphenārdhaṃ coṣṇaṃ pittena prajāyate| ardhatvaṃ cārdhanārīśvarākāreṇa narasiṃhākāreṇa vā, yathādoṣaṃ vyavasthānaniyamahetorabhāvāditi| kāya ityādi| kāye antaragnau, koṣṭha iti yāvat| ante ‘hastapāde’ iti pā.| hastapādayoḥ| uktārthasya viparyayeṇa jvarāntaramāha– kāye śleṣmetyādi| tvaksthāvityādi|– tvakśabdena tvakstho rasa ucyate, ‘tātsthyāt’ iti pā.| tatsthasya tadupacāreṇeti gadādharaḥ; jejjaṭastu tvacamevāha| etadabhiprāyeṇaiva carakeṇa jvare'bhyaṅgārthaṃ ‘... dīnabhidhā ...’ iti pā.| tailādīnyabhidhāyoktam– “tairāśu prathamaṃ yāti bahirmārgagato jvaraḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tayoḥ śleṣmānilayoḥ| praśāntayoriti ‘praśāntavegayoḥ’ iti pā.| praśāntavegayorityarthaḥ; nahi viṣameṣu doṣasya praśāntirbhavati, punarvegāgamāt| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “sa cāpi viṣamo dehaṃ na kadācidvimuñcati| glānigauravakārśyebhyaḥ sa yasmānna ‘vimucyate’ iti pā.| pramucyate|| vege tu samatikrānte gato'yamiti lakṣyate| dhātvantarastho līnatvāt saukṣmyānnaivopalabhyate [ |” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| itarau vātakaphau| dāhaśītādīti eko dāhādiḥ, aparaḥ śītādiḥ| nanu, etayoḥ samprāptau tridoṣajatvamuktaṃ; tat kathaṃ saṃsargajāvityuktaṃ, saṃsargo hi dvayorbhavati trayāṇāṃ sannipāta iti sthitiḥ| ucyate– saṃsargaḥ sambandhaḥ, sa ca dvayorbahūnāṃ ca bhavati, atra ‘trayāṇāmāhuḥ’ iti pā.| trayāṇāmuktaḥ, na caivaṃ sarvatra; athavā ‘saṃsargaḥ sāmyāt’ iti pā.| saṃsargaḥ ‘saumyāgneyadoṣakoṭidvayamelakaḥ’ iti pā.| saumyāgneyadoṣakoṭidvayamelāpaḥ| tatra śītādau jvare pittamanubandhaḥ, dāhādau vātakaphāvanubandhau; anubandhyaśca prādhānyena cikitsyo'nubandhāvirodheneti prayojanametasya| tayordāhaśītādijvarayormadhye dāhapūrvo dāhādiḥ kaṣṭa iti duḥkhapradaḥ| dāhādeḥ kaṣṭasādhyatvābhidhānena śītāderarthato'kaṣṭatvamiti| uktaviṣamajvarāṇāmupalakṣaṇatvādanye'pi viṣamajvarā rātrijvarādayo boddhavyā iti jejjaṭaḥ| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare– “samau vātakaphau yasya ‘hīnapittasya’ iti pā.| kṣīṇapittasya dehinaḥ| prāyo rātrau jvarastasya divā hīnakaphasya tu||” iti| sarveṣu ca viṣamajvareṣvavaśyambhāvī vāyuḥ| yadāha ‘suśrutaḥ’ iti pā.| vṛddhasuśrutaḥ– “narte'nilādvai viṣamajvaraḥ samupajāyate| kaphapitte hi niśceṣṭe ceṣṭayatyanilaḥ sadā||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| tathā videhe'pi– “pavano gativaiṣamyādviṣamajvarakāraṇam|” iti| eṣāṃ ca jvarāṇāmṛtvādihetvantaralābhādanyathābhāvo'pi dṛśyate| tadyathā– santataḥ svarūpaṃ tyaktvā satatādīnāmanyatamatvaṃ ‘prapadyate’ iti pā.| pratipadyate, tathā ‘tṛtīyakacaturthakādirūpatvam’ iti pā.| caturthakastṛtīyakādirūpatvam| yadāha carakaḥ– “ṛtvahorātradoṣāṇāṃ manasaśca balābalāt| kālamarthavaśāccaiva jvarastaṃ taṃ prapadyate||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| asyārthaḥ– balābalāditi ṛtvādimano'ntena sambadhyate, balaṃ cābalaṃ ca balābalam| ‘arthaśabdaḥ’ iti pā.| arthaśabdo'tra prāktanakarmavācī| taṃ taṃ kālaṃ satatakādyuktaṃ, jvaraḥ pratipadyate iti yojanā| udāharaṇaṃ ca ṛtvahorātrabalābalādyathā– yadā nidāghotpanno vātapradhānaścaturthako varṣāsamayamāpnoti tadā ‘tenartunā''pyāyitabalastṛtīyakādīnāmanyatamatvam’ iti pā.| tenartunā''pyāyitabalastṛtīyakāntānāṃ ‘santatakādīnāmanyatamatvaṃ’ iti pā.| satatakādīnāmanyatamatvaṃ prāpnotyutkarṣāt| evaṃ ‘varṣāsu samutpannaḥ’ iti pā.| varṣāsamutpannaḥ santataḥ śaradaṃ prāpyāpakṛṣṭabalaḥ satatādīnāmanyatamatvametyapakarṣāt| evaṃ pittakaphayorapi utkarṣāpakarṣau ṛtukṛtau vyākhyeyau| ahorātraśabdena katipayānyahorātrāṇi gṛhyante, nahi ekasminnahorātre ‘santatādīnāmutkarṣāpakarṣābhyāmanyathābhāva’ iti pā.| satatādīnāmutkarṣāpakarṣābhyāmanyathābhāva upapadyate; kintu katipayaireva| yadā varṣāśaradvasantaprārambhe vātādayo jvaraṃ caturthakamārabhante tadā madhyāni katipayadinānyavāpya sa eva ‘tṛtīyakatvena’ iti pā.| tṛtīyakapūrvakatvena vipariṇamate utkarṣāt; apakarṣāttu ‘anyāni’ iti pā.| yadā'ntyāni dinānyāpnoti tadā santato (vātārabdhaḥ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | prāvṛṣaḥ,) pittārabdhaḥ ‘śarado’ iti pā.| śārado, vasantasya ca śleṣmārabdhaḥ, pratanukatvāddoṣasya satatādīnāmanyatamatvena vipariṇamata iti| doṣabalābalādyathā– yadā satatādīnāmanyatamakārī doṣaḥ śleṣmā madhurasnigdhādīn divāsvapnādīṃśca hetūnāpnoti tadā ‘santatam’ iti pā.| santatakādīn karoti| evaṃ ‘vātapittayorapyudāhāryam’ iti pā.| vātapittayorapyūhyam| manobalābalādyathā– yadā santatajvarī sattvaguṇodrekāt praharṣāvaṣṭambhabahulo bhavati tadā satatādīnāmanyatamatvaṃ prāpnoti; yadā caturthakajvarī tamoguṇabhūyiṣṭhatvādviṣādādibhirabhibhūyate tadā tṛtīyakādīnāmanyatamo bhavati, “viṣādo rogavardhanānām” (ca. sū. a. 25) ityāgamāt| anye tu manaḥśabdena buddhiṃ vyākhyānayanti, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt| tasyāśca balābalaṃ yathā– yadā caturthakajvarī ‘prajñāparādhāddevatādīnabhibhūyāhitānyācarati’ iti pā.| prajñāparādhāddevādīnabhibhūyāhitānyācarati tadā tṛtīyakapūrveṣāmanyatamatvamāpnoti; yadā tu śuddhasattvotkarṣādvivekinyā buddhyā yuktaḥ syāttadā śubhāni devatārādhaneṣṭibalyupahārādīnyācarati tadā santatajvarī satatādīnāmanyatamatvaṃ prāpnoti| arthavaśādyathā– santatajvariṇo'pi yadi caturthakavedanīyaṃ karma syāttadā santato'pi caturthakatvena vipariṇamate; atha ‘caturthakādijvarāviṣṭasya’ iti pā.| caturthakajvarāviṣṭasya yadi tatkālaparipāki karma balīyo bhavati tadā santatatvena pariṇamate| etacca karmavaśatvamṛtvahorātradoṣabalābaleṣvapi boddhavyaṃ, tadanantaraṃ tannirdeśāditi||42-47||

viṣamajvaraviśeṣānāha– dehe vidagdhe annarase duṣṭe āhāre rase tathā śleṣmapitte duṣṭaṃ vyavasthite sati tena hetunā ‘dehe’ iti pā.| dehe'rdhe śītatvaṃ kaphena, ardhe ‘cauṣṇatvam’ iti pā.| coṣṇatvaṃ pittena prajāyate; ardhatvaṃ cārdhanārīśvarākāreṇa narasiṃhākāreṇa vā, yathādoṣavyavasthānaniyamahetorabhāvāditi| kāya ityādi kāye'ntaragnau koṣṭhe ‘iti yāvat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti yāvat| yadā pittaṃ duṣṭaṃ bhavati śleṣmā cānte duṣṭo ‘cāvyavasthito’ iti pā.| vyavasthito bhavati tena hetunā śarīrasya uṣṇatvaṃ hastapādayoḥ śītatvam| atra ‘viparyayeṇa jvarāntaramāha– kāye ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| viparyayeṇa jvarāntaramāha– kāye ityādi| viparītatve tu pūrvavadvyākhyeyam| ataḥ paraṃ santatādīnāṃ śītadāhapūrvakatvena bhedamāha– atra ‘tvaksthāvityādi| yadā śleṣmānilau tvaci kupitau bhavatastadā jvarasyādau tvaci śītaṃ janayataḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate pā.| tvaksthāvityādi| yadā śleṣmānilau tvaci kupitau bhavatastadā jvarasyādau tvaci śītaṃ janayataḥ| dvāvetau dāhaśītādijvarau saṃsargajau smṛtau kathitau ‘munīndraiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| etau kau? jvare ādau pūrva kaphavātau tvaksthau santau śītamutpādayataḥ, tayoḥ śleṣmānilayoḥ praśāntayoḥ satorante pittaṃ dāhaṃ karoti; tathā tenaiva prakāreṇa ādau pittaṃ tvaksthaṃ sadatīva dāhaṃ karoti, tasmiṃstu pitte praśānte sati itarau vātakaphau śītaṃ kurutaḥ| tvakśabdena tvakstho rasa ucyate, tātsthyāttadupacāreṇeti gadādharaḥ; jejjaṭastvacamevāha| tayoḥ śleṣmānilayoḥ praśāntavegayoḥ svakālāpagamāt pratyanīkaprāptyā vā viṣameṣu doṣasya praśāntirbhavati paraṃ vegopagamāt| yaduktaṃ suśrutena– “sa cāpi viṣamo dehaṃ na kadācidvimuñcati|” ‘iti| pūrvamevoktaṃ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| pūrvamevoktaṃ yadā tau praśāntavegau bhavatastadā pittamantardāhaṃ karoti, ‘cakārānmūrchādi’ iti pā.| cakārānmūrchādīn| yadā tu pittaṃ tvaksthaṃ bhavati tadā tvaci atīva dāhaṃ karoti, tvagdāhakārake pitte ‘praśānte gatavege’ ityasya sthāne ‘praśāntavege’ iti pā.| praśānte gatavege sati tāvapi itarau śleṣmānilau antataḥ śītaṃ kurutaḥ| ‘ādiśabdādvamathutandrādayaḥ’ iti pā.| ādiśabdādvamathutandrādīn| dvāvetau dāhaśītādī saṃsargajau kathitau, eko dāhādiḥ, aparaḥ śītādiḥ| tayordāhaśītapūrvakayorjvarayormadhye dāhapūrvakaḥ kaṣṭo'tyantaduḥkhapradaḥ, kaṣṭaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatama iti viśeṣaṇadvayopādānādatyarthaṃ duḥsādhyatvaṃ darśitaṃ, ‘śītapūrvasya sukhasādhyatvam’ ityasya sthāne ‘śītāderarthato'kaṣṭatvamiti’ iti pā.| śītapūrvasya sukhasādhyatvaṃ; kutaḥ? rogaśakteracintyatvāt| nanvetayostridoṣajatvamuktaṃ tatkathaṃ saṃsargajāvityuktam| ucyate– saṃsargaḥ sambandhaḥ sa ca dvayorbahūnāṃ ca bhavati, ato'tra trayāṇāmuktaḥ, na caivaṃ sarvatra| athavā saṃsargaḥ saumyāgneyadoṣadvayamelakaḥ| tatra śītādau jvare pittānubandhaḥ, dāhādau jvare ‘vātakaphānubandhaḥ| anu uparyadhaśca’ ityasya sthāne ‘vātakaphānubandhaśca| saṃsarge’ iti pā.| vātakaphānubandhaḥ| anu uparyadhaśca prādhānyena cikitsyata ityanubandhātsaṃsargajāvityuktamiti na virodhaḥ| uktaviṣamajvarāṇāmupalakṣaṇatvādanye'pi viṣamajvarā rātrijvarādayo boddhavyā iti jejjaṭādayaḥ| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare– “samau vātakaphau yasya hīnapittasya dehinaḥ| rātrau prāyo jvarastasya divā hīnakaphasya tu” iti| sarveṣu viṣamajvareṣvaśyambhāvī vāyuḥ| yadāha vṛddhasuśrutaḥ– “narte'nilādvai viṣamo jvaraḥ samupajāyate| kaphapitte tu niśceṣṭe ceṣṭayatyanilo balī||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| tathā videhe'pi– “pavano gativaiṣamyādviṣamajvarakāraṇam||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti||42-47||

div.ab: gurutā hṛdayotkleśaḥ sadanaṃ chardyarocakau | rasasthe tu jvare liṅgaṃ dainyaṃ cāsyopajāyate ||48|| raktaniṣṭhīvanaṃ dāho mohaśchardanavibhramau | pralāpaḥ ‘piḍikā’ iti pā. piḍakā tṛṣṇā raktaprāpte jvare nṛṇām ||49|| piṇḍikodveṣṭanaṃ tṛṣṇā sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣatā | ūṣmā'ntardāhavikṣepau glāniḥ syānmāṃsage jvare ||50|| bhṛśaṃ svedastṛṣā mūrchā pralāpaśchardireva ca | daurgandhyārocakau glānirmedaḥsthe cāsahiṣṇutā ||51|| bhedo'sthnāṃ kūjanaṃ śvāso virekaśchardireva ca | vikṣepaṇaṃ ca gātrāṇāmetadasthigate jvare ||52|| tamaḥpraveśanaṃ hikkā kāsaḥ śaityaṃ vamistathā | antarndāho mahāśvāso marmacchedaśca majjage ||53|| maraṇaṃ prāpnuyāttatra śukrasthānagate jvare | śephasaḥ stabdhatā mokṣaḥ śukrasya tu viśeṣataḥ ||54|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) | (rasaraktāśritaḥ sādhyo māṃsamedogataśca yaḥ | asthimajjagataḥ kṛcchro śukrasthastu na sidhyati) ||1|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg: uktavātādijvarāṇāṃ dhātuviśeṣadūṣyatayā'dhikalakṣaṇāni bhavanti; yaduktam– ‘vātapittakaphotthānāṃ jvarāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ yathā| tathā teṣāṃ bhiṣagbrūyādrasādiṣvapi buddhimān||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti; etadabhidhānaṃ ca rasādidhātvavirodhena vātādicikitsākaraṇārtham; atastānāha– gurutetyādi| hṛdayotkleśaḥ hṛdayasthitasya doṣasyopasthitavamanatvamiva, rasasya hṛdayasthatvāt| rasastha ityanena viśeṣeṇātra raso dūṣyaḥ, sarveṣāmeva jvarāṇāṃ ‘rasānugatatvāt’ iti pā.| rasānugatvāt| dainyaṃ klāntacittatvam| piṇḍiketyādi| piṇḍikā jānvadho jaṅghāmāṃsapiṇḍaḥ, tasyā udveṣṭanaṃ daṇḍādinā pīḍaneneva vedanā piṇḍikodveṣṭanam; evamanyatrāpi| sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣatā asyāgre ‘rogaprabhāvāt’ ityadhikamātaṅkadarpaṇe| pravartamānamūtrapurīṣatā| ūṣmā bahiḥ, etacca viśeṣaparaṃ, prāyaḥ sarvajvareṣu tathābhāvāt| ‘ūṣmā'ntarmohavikṣepau’ iti pāṭhāntare ūṣmā'ntaḥ antardāha ityarthaḥ, vikṣepo hastādicālanam| bhṛśaṃ sveda iti gharmasya medomalatvāt; tadvikṛtyaiva daurgandhyaṃ gātre| asahiṣṇutā vedanāyā ‘asahiṣṇutvam’ iti pā.| asahatvaṃ, krodhanatvamiti kārtikaḥ| bhedo'sthnāmiti bheda iva bhedaḥ bhaṅgavatpīḍetyarthaḥ, ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | (parapadārtheṣu prayujyamānāḥ śabdā vṛtti(vati)mantareṇāpi vṛttya(vatya)rthaṃ gamayanti) yathā– agnirmāṇavakaḥ| evamanyatrāpi bhedādau draṣṭavyam| kūjanaṃ ‘asphuṭadhvaniḥ’ iti pā.| kunthanaṃ; ‘kuñcanam’ iti pāṭhāntare'sthnāmeva saṅkoca ityarthaḥ| tamaḥpraveśanam andhakārapraviṣṭasyevāsaṃvittiḥ| mahāśvāsaḥ śvāsādhikāre vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaḥ| marmaśabdena hṛdayamucyate, prādhānyāditi kārtikaḥ; tasya cheda iva marmacchedaḥ| maraṇamityādi ‘śukragatasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śukragatasya| tatraiteṣu rasādidhātugatajvareṣu madhye śukrasthānagate maraṇaṃ prāpnuyāditi yojyam| śukraṃ ca tatsthānaṃ ceti śukrasthānaṃ; ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | (natu śukrasya sthānaṃ śukrasthānaṃ) śukrasya sarvadehagatvena niyatasthānāsambhavāditi kārtikaḥ| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | (yaduktam– “yathā payasi sarpistu ‘gūḍhaścekṣau raso’ iti pā.| guḍaścekṣurase yathā| śarīreṣu tathā nṝṇāṃ śukraṃ vidyādbhiṣagvaraḥ||” (su. śā. a. 4) iti|) viśeṣata iti padena śukrasya bāhulyena visargaḥ, anyasyāpi raktāderiti vadanti||48-54||

atha ‘... jvaramāha’ iti pā.| rasādidhātugatajvarānāha– gurutetyādi| gurutā gātrāṇāṃ, hṛdayotkleśaḥ hṛdayasthasya doṣasyopasthitavamanatvamiva, rasasya hṛdayasthitatvāt| sadanamaṅgaglāniḥ, dainyaṃ klāntacittatā, rasasthe rasadhātugate jvare| yadyapi rasaikadhātuprāptyā santata evāyaṃ tathā'pyanukramadhātugatakathanārthamatra nirdeśaḥ| raktagaṃ jvaramāha– moho vigatacittatā| asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘piḍikātṛṣṇeti|’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| piḍikātṛṣṇeti| māṃsagatamāha– ‘piṇḍiketyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | piṇḍiketyādi| piṇḍikā jānvadhobhāge māṃsapiṇḍaḥ, tasyā udveṣṭanaṃ daṇḍādinipīḍaneneva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| sṛṣṭamūtrapurīṣatā pravartamānamūtrapurīṣatvam| ūṣmāntardāhavikṣepau tatra ūṣmā bahiḥ, antardāhaḥ; etacca viśeṣaparaṃ, prāyaḥ sarvajvareṣu tathābhāvāt; anye “ūṣmāntarmohavikṣepau” iti paṭhanti| tatra– ūṣmā antardāhaḥ, vikṣepo hastādicālanam| ‘medogatamāha’ iti pā.| medogate bhṛśaṃ sveda iti medomalatvāt, tadvikṛtyaiva daurgandhyaṃ gātre, asahiṣṇutā vedanāsahatvaṃ, krodhanatvamiti kārtikaḥ| ‘asthigatamāha’ iti pā.| asthigate bhedo'sthnāmiti bheda iva bhedaḥ, bhaṅgavatpīḍetyarthaḥ parapadārtheṣu prayujyamānāḥ śabdā ivāntareṇāpi iva ityarthaṃ gamayanti, yathā agnirmāṇavakaḥ; evamanyatrāpi| kūjanaṃ kunthanaṃ, kuñcanamiti kecana paṭhanti; tacca sānnidhyādasthnāmityanena sambadhyate| ‘majjagatamāha’ iti pā.| majjagate– tamaḥpraveśanam andhakārapraviṣṭasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ| mahāśvāsa iti śvāsanidāne vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaḥ| marmaśabdena hṛdayamucyate prādhānyāditi kārtikaḥ, tasya cheda iva marmacchedaḥ| śukragatalakṣaṇamāha– ‘maraṇamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | maraṇamityādi| tatra teṣu rasādidhātugatajvareṣu madhye śukrasthānagate maraṇaṃ prāpnuyāditi yojyam| nanu śukrage jvare maraṇamityuktaṃ, tacca śukraṃ sarvadehagaṃ, tataśca rasādidhātvabhibhave'pi śukraprāpteḥ tadṛte'pi maraṇamiti| naivam– sarvaśarīrasthasyāpi śukrasya kalāntaritatvena krameṇa tvaci prāpteḥ| krameṇāpi śukraṃ jvareṇa kathaṃ prāpyamiti cet, dhātvantarādatikramya śukragamanāditi| viśeṣata iti padena śukrasya bāhulyena visargaḥ, anyasyāpi raktāderiti vadantītyuktam| suśrute– “dagdhendhano yathā vahnirdhātūn hatvā yathā viṣam| kṛtakṛtyo vrajecchāntiṃ dehaṃ hatvā tathā jvaraḥ”iti| granthāntare'pi– “rasaraktāśritaḥ sādhyo māṃsamedogatastathā| ‘... majjāgataḥ’ iti pā.| asthimajjagataḥ kṛcchraḥ śukrasthāne na jīvati” iti||48-54||

div.ab: varṣāśaradvasanteṣu vātādyaiḥ prākṛtaḥ kramāt | vaikṛto'nyaḥ sa duḥsādhyaḥ prākṛtaścānilodbhavaḥ ||55|| (vā. ni. a. 2) |

ab.seg: uktavātādijvarāṇāṃ kālaprakṛtimuddiśya prākṛtatvaṃ vaikṛtatvaṃ cāha– varṣetyādi| varṣādiṣu vātādyaiḥ kramādyo jvaraḥ sa prākṛtaḥ; varṣāsu vātikaḥ, śaradi paittikaḥ, vasante ślaiṣmikaḥ| asmādanyo vaikṛtaḥ, yathā– varṣāsu paittika ityādi| sa iti vaikṛto duḥsādhyaḥ, arthāt ‘prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhya’ ityasya sthāne ‘sukhasādhyaḥ prākṛtaḥ’ iti pā.| prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhya iti| yaduktam– “prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhyastu vasantaśaradudbhavaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| atra vāgbhaṭena vātajasya prākṛtatvapraṇayanaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tadanye nānumanyante, duḥsādhyatvena vaikṛtādabhinnatvāt| jatūkarṇenāpyasau na paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “vasantaśaradoḥ ‘prāyaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prāyaḥ prākṛto'nyatra vaikṛtaḥ|” iti| atrocyate– na prākṛtatvaṃ sukhasādhyatvakhyāpanaparā sañjñā, kintu kumbhakārādivadyaugikatvaṃ; yato ‘yathartukupito’ iti pā.| yathartuprakupito doṣaḥ prakṛtirucyate, ‘tata udbhūtaḥ’ ityasya sthāne ‘tathābhūtaḥ’ iti pā.| tata udbhūtaḥ prākṛtaḥ; tena prākṛtatve'pi ‘doṣaprabhā ...’ iti pā.| doṣasvabhāvādvātikasya duḥkhasādhyatvaṃ vaikṛtavaditi duḥkhasādhyatvena vaikṛtasādharmyāttu carakajatūkarṇābhyāṃ noktaḥ, natu prākṛtatvābhāvādityabhiprāyo vāgbhaṭasyeti| anyarogeṣu prākṛtatvena ‘duḥkhasādhyatvam’ iti pā.| duḥsādhyatvaṃ, jvarasya tu vyādhiprabhāvāt sukhasādhyatvam| tantrāntaraṃ hi– “jvare tulyartudoṣatvaṃ pramehe tulyadūṣyatā| raktagulme purāṇatvaṃ sukhasādhyasya lakṣaṇam||” iti||55||

atha kālabhedena jvarasya sādhyāsādhyalakṣaṇamāha– varṣetyādi| varṣādiṣu ṛtuṣu vātādyaiḥ kramādyo jvaraḥ sa prākṛtaḥ, varṣāsu vātikaḥ, śaradi paittikaḥ, vasante ślaiṣmikaḥ| asmādanyo vaikṛtaḥ, kramādyathā– varṣāsu paittikaḥ, śaradi ślaiṣmiko, vasante vātikaḥ atra kvacitpustake ‘sa’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| sa iti| vaikṛto duḥsādhyaḥ arthātsukhasādhyaḥ prākṛta iti| yaduktam– “prākṛtaḥ sukhasādhyastu vasantaśaradudbhavaḥ” iti| anilodbhavaśca prākṛto duḥsādhyaḥ||55||

div.ab: varṣāsu māruto duṣṭaḥ pittaśleṣmānvito jvaram | kuryāt pittaṃ ca śaradi tasya cānubalaḥ kaphaḥ ||56|| tatprakṛtyā visargācca tatra nānaśanādbhayam | kapho vasante tamapi vātapittaṃ bhavedanu ||57|| (vā. ni. a. 2) |

ab.seg: teṣāmeva prākṛtajvarāṇāṃ cikitsāviśeṣārthamutpattikramamāha– varṣāsvityādi| duṣṭa iti kupitaḥ, grīṣme sañcitatvāt| pittaśleṣmānvita iti tatkālocitapittakaphānubandhaḥ| yaduktam– “bhūbāṣpānmeghaniṣyandāt pākādamlājjalasya ca| varṣāsvagnibale kṣīṇe kupyanti pavanādayaḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 6) iti| kuryāditi chedaḥ| atra kvacitpustake ‘pittamityādi’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| pittamityādi pittaṃ ca ‘śaradīti’ iti pā.| śaradi duṣṭaṃ jvaraṃ kuryāditi pūrvoktena sambadhyate; evaṃ kapho vasante ‘ityapi’ iti pā.| ityatrāpi yojyam| pittaduṣṭiśca śaradi varṣāsu ‘sañcitatvena’ iti pā.| sañcitatvāt| anubalo'nubandhaḥ, tasya ca heturvārṣikakledānuvṛttireva| tatprakṛtyeti tayoḥ pitta śleṣmaṇoḥ prakṛtyā svabhāvena, tatkṛtayorjvarayoranaśanāllaṅghanānna bhayaṃ bhavati| yaduktam– “kaphapitte drave dhātū sahete laṅghanaṃ mahat| ‘āmakṣayādūrdhvamato vāyurna sahate kṣaṇam||” iti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ, kvacitpustake nopalabhyate |, ‘... mapi’ iti pā.| āmakṣayādūrdhvamato vāyurna sahate kṣaṇam||” iti| visargācca hetornānaśanādbhayam| varṣāśaraddhemantā visargaḥ, tatropacitabalāḥ prāṇino bhavanti, ‘somasya balavattvāt’ ityasya sthāne ‘somabalattvāt’ iti pā.| somasya balavattvāt; śiśiravasantagrīṣmāstvādānaṃ, tatrāpacitabalāḥ prāṇinaḥ, ‘sūryasya balavattvāt’ ityasya sthāne ‘sūryabalattvāt ’ iti pā.| sūryasya balavattvāt iti vyutpāditaṃ śāstre| ‘tatprakṛtyā visargasya’ iti pāṭhāntare tatprakṛtyā ‘kaphapittaprakṛtyā’ iti pā.| kaphavātapittaprakṛtyā, visargasya ca prakṛtyeti yojyam| kapha ityādi| taṃ kaphamanu vātapitte bhavataḥ, anubandharūpe bhavata ityarthaḥ| hetuścātra vasantasyādānamadhyatvenāgneyarūkṣatvāt vātapittaprakopakatvam| yaduktaṃ carake– ‘ādānamadhye tasyāpi vātapittaṃ bhavedanu (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| atra kaphapittaprakṛtyā laṅghanaṃ yuktameva, kintvādānamadhyatvena ‘na nirbhayaṃ tat’ ityasya sthāne ‘nirbhayaṃ tanna’ iti pā.| na nirbhayaṃ tat kāryam| ata eva ‘tatra nānaśanādbhayam’ ityetasmāt pūrvameva paṭhitam, anyathā sarvaśeṣe paṭhitaṃ syāditi||56-57||

teṣāmeva prākṛtajvarāṇāṃ cikitsāviśeṣārthamutpattikramamāha– ‘varṣāsvityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | varṣāsvityādi| grīṣme sañcitatvāt varṣāsu duṣṭaḥ kupito vāyuḥ pittaśleṣmānvita iti tatkālocitapittakaphānubandhaḥ jvaraṃ kuryāt| yaduktam– “ ‘bhūvāṣpā ...’ iti pā.| bhūbāṣpānmeghaniṣyandātpākādamlājjalasya ca| varṣāsvagnibale hīne kupyanti pavanādayaḥ||” iti| asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘kupitaṃ pittam’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| kupitaṃ pittaṃ ca śaradi duṣṭaṃ sat jvaraṃ kuryāditi pūrvoktena sambadhyate| evaṃ kapho vasanta ityatrāpi yojyam| pittaṃ duṣṭaṃ ca śaradi varṣāsu sañcitatveneti| etasya ca pittajvaraṃ kartumudyatasya śaradi anubalo anubandhī kapho bhavati| tasya ca heturvārṣikakledānuvṛttireva| anubalamivānubalaṃ yathā svatantrasya kasyacidrājño gajarathaturagapuruṣādibalavato vairibhiḥ saha yudhyamānasya paścādanyabalaṃ ‘... balobṛṃhaṇā ...’ iti pā.| tacchakteranubalopabṛṃhaṇārthamāgacchati, evaṃ svatantrasya pittasya jvaraṃ kurvato balopabṛṃhaṇaṃ śaradi kaphaḥ karoti| tayoḥ pittaśleṣmaṇoḥ, prakṛtyā svabhāvena, tatkṛtayorjvarayoranaśanāllaṅghanādbhayaṃ na bhavati| yaduktam– “kaphapitte drave dhātū sahete laṅghanaṃ mahat|” iti| ‘kasmāvisargācca’ iti pā.| tasmādvisargācca hetornānaśanāllaṅghanādbhayam| varṣāśaraddhemantā visargakālāḥ, tatropacitabalāḥ prāṇino bhavanti, somabalatvāt; śiśiravasantagrīṣmāstvādānakālaḥ, tatrāpacitabalāḥ prāṇino bhavanti, sūryabalatvāt| “tatprakṛtyā visargasya” iti pāṭhāntare tatprakṛtyā pittakaphayoḥ ‘prakṛtyā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prakṛtyā visargasya ca prakṛtyeti yojyam| candranandanastvevaṃ vyācaṣṭe– tatra śaradi pittajvare'naśanāllaṅghanādbhayaṃ na bhavati, kena kāraṇena! tatprakṛtyā, tayoḥ pittakaphajvarayoḥ laṅghanasādhyatvena; tathā visargācca kālasya visargākhyabhāvāttatra laṅghanātpratyavāyaśaṅkā notpadyate, jvarasyāmāśayasamutthatvāt| ‘... sādhyatvāt’ iti pā.| pittaśleṣmaṇorlaṅghanasādhyatve| ‘uktam’ iti pā.| vacanaṃ ca– “kaphapitte dravatvācca sahete laṅghanaṃ mahat| āmakṣayādūrdhvamapi vāyurna sahate kṣaṇam” iti| aruṇadattastvevaṃ vyācaṣṭe– tacchabdena varṣāśaradudbhūtau vātajvarapittajvarau parāmṛṣyete, tayoḥ ‘prakṛtistathā’ iti pā.| prakṛtistayā tatprakṛtyā tatsvabhāvena tatra prākṛte jvare'naśanādbhayaṃ na ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ; visargācca varṣāśaradupalakṣito hi kālo visargaḥ saumyasvabhāvaḥ, asmācca kāraṇāttasminkāle jvarotpatterlaṅghanānmṛtyupratyavāyaśaṅkā na tathā bhavati yathā'nyasmin jvare ādānakālasvabhāvādvātapittānubalatvāccānaśanādbhayaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| vasante kāle kapho duṣṭo jvaraṃ kuryāditi, taṃ kaphamanu vātapittaṃ bhavediti anubandharūpe bhavata ityarthaḥ| hetuścātra vasantasyādānamadhyatve'gneruṣṇatvādvātapittaprakopanam| yaduktaṃ carake– “ādānamadhye tasyāpi vātapittaṃ bhavedanu” iti| ataḥ kaphapittaprakṛtyā ca laṅghanaṃ yuktameva kintvādānamadhyatvena nirbhayaṃ tanna kāryam| ata eva tatra ‘... dbhayamititasmā ...’ iti pā.| nānaśanādbhayamityetasmātpūrvameva paṭhitam, anyathā sarvaśeṣe paṭhitaṃ syāditi ||56-57||

div.ab: kāle yathāsvaṃ sarveṣāṃ pravṛttirvṛddhireva vā |58| (vā. ni. a. 2) |

kālo'pi doṣaviśeṣasya lakṣaṇamityāha– kāla ityādi| yathāsvaṃ kāle yasya vātāderyaḥ prakopakālastatra ‘tajjasyajvarasya’ iti pā.| tajjanyajvarasya pravṛttirutpādo vṛddhirvā bhavati; athavā pravṛttirnityajvarasya, vṛddhirviṣamajvarasyeti|58|–
yathāsvaṃ kāle vātāderyaḥ prakopakālastatra tajjanyasya jvarasya pravṛttirutpādaḥ abhivṛddhirvā bhavati| athavā pravṛttirnityajvarasya vṛddhirviṣamajvarasyeti| kālo'pi doṣaviśeṣalakṣaṇam|58|–
nidānoktānupaśayo viparītopaśāyitā ||58|| (vā. ni. a. 2) | ‘(yathā kālo doṣaviśeṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ)’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate |

ab.seg: (yathā kālo doṣaviśeṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ) tathopaśayānupaśayāvapi lakṣaṇamityāha– nidānetyādi| nidānatvena ye uktā āhārācārādayastairanupaśayo duḥkhaṃ nidānoktānupaśayaḥ| ‘... doṣāhārācārādyaiḥ’ iti pā.| viparītairdoṣādiviparītāhārācārairupaśāyitāsukhajananaśīlatvaṃ viparītopaśāyiteti||58||

tathopaśayānupaśayāvapītyāha– nidānetyādi| nidānatvena ye uktā āhārācārādayastairanupaśayo duḥkhaṃ nidānokto'nupaśayaḥ, viparītairdoṣāhārācārairupaśāyitā ‘janana’ ityasya sthāne ‘janaka’ iti pā.| sukhajananaśīlatvaṃ viparītopaśāyiteti; nidānatvenopayukta āhārācārādiḥ ‘sadoṣasya’ iti pā.| doṣasya atra ‘duḥkha’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| duḥkhajanakatvenānupaśayo ‘upaśaya’ ityasya sthāne ‘upaśāyitopaśayaśceci’ iti pā.| viparītastvāhārācārādirdoṣānutpādakatvādupaśaya iti piṇḍārthaḥ||58||

div.ab: antardāho'dhikastṛṣṇā pralāpaḥ śvasanaṃ bhramaḥ | sandhyasthiśūlamasvedo doṣavarcovinigrahaḥ ||59|| antarvegasya liṅgāni jvarasyaitāni lakṣayet | santāpo hyadhiko bāhyastṛṣṇādīnāṃ ca mārdavam ||60|| bahirvegasya liṅgāni sukhasādhyatvameva ca |61| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

uktajvarāṇāṃ madhye samprāptivaśāt kaścidantarvego bhavati kaścidbahirvegastayorlakṣaṇamāha– antardāha ityādi| śvasanaṃ śvāsaḥ; ‘sadanam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tanna yuktamiti jejjaṭaḥ; yato'ntarvega eva suśrute gambhīrākhyaḥ paṭhitaḥ, tatra ca śvāsa ‘eva’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | eva paṭhita iti| vinigraho'pravṛttiḥ| asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘santāpa ityādi|’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| santāpa ityādi| tṛṣṇādīnāmityādiśabdenoktapralāpādīnāṃ grahaṇam| mārdavaṃ svalpatvam| asya sukhasādhyatvābhidhānenāntarvegasya kṛcchrasādhyatāṃ sūcayati, asādhyatāṃ vā, “gambhīratīkṣṇavegārtaṃ jvaritaṃ parivarjayet|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti suśrutavacanāditi||59-60||–

uktajvarāṇāṃ madhye ‘kaścit’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | samprāptivaśātkaścidantarvego bhavati, kaścidbahirvegastayorlakṣaṇamāha– antarityādi| etairliṅgairantarvegajvaraṃ lakṣayet| śvasanaṃ śvāsaḥ, anye ‘sadanam’ iti paṭhanti| doṣasya vāyorvarcasaḥ purīṣasya ca vinigraho'pravṛttiḥ| bahirvegasya lakṣaṇamāha– ‘santāpa ityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | santāpa ityādi| etairliṅgairbahirvegaṃ lakṣayet| tṛṣṇādīnāmityādiśabdena pralāpādīnāṃ grahaṇaṃ, mārdavaṃ svalpatvam| asya tu sukhasādhyatvābhidhānenāntarvegasya kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ darśitamasādhyatvaṃ vā| suśrute antarvego gambhīrākhyayā paṭhitaḥ– “gambhīratīkṣṇavegārtaṃ jvaritaṃ parivarjayet” iti||59-60||–

lālāpraseko hṛllāsahṛdayāśuddhyarocakāḥ ||61|| tandrālasyāvipākāsyavairasyaṃ gurugātratā | kṣunnāśo bahumūtratvaṃ stabdhatā balavān jvaraḥ ||62|| āmajvarasya liṅgāni na dadyāttatra bheṣajam | bheṣajaṃ hyāmadoṣasya bhūyo jvalayati jvaram ||63|| ( ātaṅkadarpaṇasammato'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ śodhanaṃ śamanīyaṃ ca karoti viṣamajvaram) | jvaravego'dhikastṛṣṇā pralāpaḥ śvasanaṃ bhramaḥ | malapravṛttirutkleśaḥ pacyamānasya lakṣaṇam ||64|| kṣut kṣāmatā laghutvaṃ ca gātrāṇāṃ jvaramārdavam | ‘doṣapravṛttirutsāha’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ doṣapravṛttiraṣṭāho nirāmajvaralakṣaṇam ||65|| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg: cikitsāviśeṣārthamāmapacyamānapakvalakṣaṇānyāha– lāletyādi| nanu, na dadyāttatra bheṣajamiti viruddhaṃ, dvividhaṃ hi bheṣajamuktaṃ carakeṇa dravyabhūtamadravyabhūtaṃ ceti; tatra dravyabhūtaṃ kaṣāyādi, adravyabhūtaṃ laṅghanasvedādi; atra laṅghanādikaṃ ṣaḍaṅgārdhaśṛtaṃ ca prayujyate| ucyate– ‘annapāna’ ityasya sthāne ‘anupāna’ iti pā.| bheṣajaśabdenātrānnapānasādhanavyatiriktā kalpanocyate, ‘na’ iti pā.| ca tu sāmānyenauṣadhamātraṃ; kathameṣā pratītiriti cet, taruṇajvare ‘bheṣajaniṣedhe'pi’ iti pā.| bheṣajapānaniṣedhe'pi ‘teṣāṃ vidhānadarśanāt’ iti pā.| bheṣajavidhānadarśanāt| evaṃ pacyamāne'pi boddhavyaṃ, tatrāpi sāmatāyāḥ sadbhāvāt| kṣudityādi| asamāsakaraṇāt kṣudādayo vyastāḥ samastāśca bhoddhavyāḥ| aṣṭāhaḥ ‘lakṣaṇamiti’ iti pā.| pakvalakṣaṇamiti jejjaṭaḥ| haricandrastvāha– asatyapyaṣṭāhe kṣudādibhirnirāmatvaṃ doṣapravṛttyā vā kṣudhādyabhāve'pyaṣṭāhenaiva śiṣyahitaiṣitayā kālaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ ca nirdiṣṭavāniti| dvividhā hi sāmatā– ekā rasasya, aparā doṣasya; rasasāmatā tu mukhavairasyādilakṣaṇā, doṣasāmatā taruṇatvarūpā, sā'ṣṭāhenaivāpaiti| atra ca haricandreṇa heturuktaḥ– (‘ ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saptāhenaiva pacyante saptadhātugatā malāḥ| nirāmaścāpyataḥ prokto jvaraḥ prāyo'ṣṭame'hani||’ iti|) saptānāṃ dhātūnāṃ dhātvagninā saptāhenāmapākādaṣṭāhenaiva ‘nairāmyamiti|’ iti pā.| nirāmatvamiti| rasasāmatā tvaṣṭāhāt parato'pyanuvartate| enamartha jejjaṭo'pīcchati, yadevaṃ likhati carakasuśrutaṭīkāyām– ‘taruṇā sāmatā'ṣṭāhādapaiti, rasasāmatā tu ‘pareṇāpi’ iti pā.| parato'pyanuvartate’| iti etatprayojanaṃ ca taruṇasāmatāyāmauṣadhaṃ nopayujyate, rasasāmatāyāṃ tu pācanaṃ dīyate| ata evāha carakaḥ ‘jvaritaṃ ṣaḍahe'tīte laghvannapratibhojitam| pācanaṃ śamanīyaṃ vā kaṣāyaṃ pāyayettu tam||’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| tathā– ‘mṛdau jvare laghau dehe pracaleṣu maleṣu ca| pakvaṃ doṣaṃ vijānīyājjvare deyaṃ tadauṣadham||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ityabhidhāyāpi yat suśrute na paṭhitam– ‘saptarātrāt paraṃ kecinmanyante deyamauṣadham| daśarātrāt paraṃ keciddātavyamiti niścitāḥ| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti, tenaivaṃ jñāpayati– saptāhādarvāk pācanamapi na dīyata iti kārtikakuṇḍenāpi vyākhyātamiti| nanu ‘jvaritaṃ ṣaḍahe'tīte’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti carakavacanasya ‘saptarātrāt paraṃ’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ityādinā suśrutavacanena virodhaḥ, yataḥ ṣaḍahe'tīte saptamadinaṃ bhavati, tatra kaṣāyaṃ vidhatta iti| ucyate, ṣaḍahe'tīte saptame laghvannapratibhojitamaṣṭame kaṣāyaṃ ‘padalopāt’ iti pā.| pāyayedityaṣṭamapadalopādyojyaṃ rasaudanavaditi cakraḥ, ‘bheṣajaṃ hyāmadoṣasya bhūyo jvalayati jvaram|’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti doṣaśruteruktasuśrutavirodhācca| prakārāntareṇainamarthaṃ kārtikakuṇḍo'pyāha, tadyathā– ṣaḍahe'tīte iti jvarotpādadinaṃ parityajya gaṇanā, ‘bastikālaparihāreṇa kālagaṇanāvat’ iti pā.| bastidānadinaparihāreṇa ‘yathā suśrutoktatryahaparihārakāla eva bastidānadinaṃ tyaktvā carakeṇa dviguṇaḥ parihārakāla ukta iti vṛndaṭīkāyāṃ śrīkaṇṭhadattaḥ|’ iti pā.| parihārakālagaṇanāvat evaṃ ‘pāyayedāturaṃ sāmamauṣadhaṃ saptame dine| śamanenāthavā dṛṣṭvā nirāmaṃ tamupācaret||’ ityetadapi vacanaṃ vyākhyeyam| bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇāpi saptamadine kaṣāyapānaṃ yadvyākhyātaṃ tasyāyamevābhiprāyo gaveṣaṇīyaḥ, suśrutadivirodhāt| candrikākāreṇāpi vyākhyātam– “akṣiroge dinacatuṣṭayavajjvarasya saptāhaṃ sāmatākālaḥ, tatra na pācanaṃ na vā śamanaṃ śodhanam” iti| yattu peyādyanantaraṃ hārītenoktam– “etāṃ kriyāṃ prayuñjīta ṣaḍrātraṃ saptame'hani| pibet kaṣāyasaṃyogān jvaraghnān sādhusādhitān||” iti; tathā– “iti ṣaḍrātrikaḥ prokto navajvarahito vidhiḥ| ataḥ paraṃ pācanīyaṃ śamanaṃ vā jvare hitam|” iti kharanādavacanaṃ ca pūrvavadaṣṭāhapratipādakaṃ draṣṭavyam| atha vā pittajvarābhiprāyeṇaiva tadvacanadvayam| yadāha suśrutaḥ– ‘saptarātrātparam’ ityārabhya, yāvat ‘paittike vā jvare deyamalpakālasamutthite| acirajvaritasyāpi ‘bhaiṣajyam’ iti pā.| bheṣajyaṃ ‘doṣapācanam’ iti pā.| doṣapākataḥ||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) iti| ‘saptāhāt parato'pi’ iti pā.| saptāhādarvāgapi yadetatpācanaṃ kaṣāyapānamuktaṃ ‘tadanubhūta ...’ iti pā.| tannātyudbhūtasāmatāyāṃ draṣṭavyam| yadāha vāgbhaṭaḥ– ‘saptāhādauṣadhaṃ kecidāhuranye daśāhataḥ| kecillaghvannabhuktasya yojyamāmolbaṇe na tu|| tīvrajvaraparītasya doṣavegodayo yataḥ| doṣe athavā atinicite tandrāstaimityakāriṇi|| apacyamānaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ bhūyo jvalayati jvaram||’ (vā. ci. a. 1) iti| ‘ayamartho'bhiyuktaiśca kaiściduktaścikitsakaiḥ| saptāhāt parato'stabdhe sāme syāt pācanaṃ jvare|| nirāme śamanaṃ, stabdhe sāme nauṣadhamācaret|’ iti saṅkṣepaḥ| vistarastu kaṣāyanirṇayaprakaraṇe draṣṭavyaḥ| pakvajvaralakṣaṇena jīrṇajvaralakṣaṇamapi cikitsocitaṃ boddhavyam| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– ‘āsaptarātram’ ityādi| jatūkarṇenāpyuktam– ‘jīrṇastrayodaśadivasaḥ’ iti| ‘trisaptāhe vyatīte tu jvaro yastanutāṃ gataḥ| plīhāgnisādaṃ kurute sa jīrṇajvara ucyate||’ iti tu ‘tantrāntaravacanaṃ purāṇābhiprāyeṇa’ iti pā.| tantrāntaramatipurāṇābhiprāyeṇa draṣṭavyam||61-65||

div.ab: cikitsāviśeṣadarśanārthamāmajvaralakṣaṇamāha– lāletyādi| lālāprasekaḥ lālāsrāvaḥ, hṛllāsaḥ upasthitavamanatvamiva, hṛdayāśuddhiḥ hṛdayaṃ pūrṇamiva, guru iva cāpare| kṣunnāśaḥ chikkāyā aniḥsaraṇam, athavā kṣut kṣudhā tasyā nāśaḥ| atra ‘balavān jvaro balādhikaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| balavān jvaro balādhikaḥ etāni lakṣaṇāni āmajvare bhavanti, tatra bheṣajaṃ pācanādi na deyaṃ, yadi dattaṃ bheṣajaṃ bhūyo jvaraṃ vardhayati śodhanaṃ yat, yacca śamanīyaṃ tadviṣamajvaraṃ kuryāt| tatra sāmatā dvidhā– ekā rasasyāparā doṣasya, doṣasāmatā taruṇatvarūpā, rasasāmatā'ṣṭāhātparato nivartate, taruṇasāmatāyāmauṣadhaṃ nopayujyate| uktaṃ ca suśrute– “saptarātrātparaṃ kecitmanyante deyamauṣadham| daśarātrātparaṃ keciddātavyamiti niścitāḥ” iti| etacca madhukośe bahu vistṛtam| pacyamānajvaralakṣaṇamāha– ‘jvaretyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | jvaretyādi| jvaravego'dhiko bhavati, yathā nirvāṇāvasthāyāṃ dīpaḥ prajvalati tadvatpacyamānāvasthāyāṃ jvarasya vegādhikyaṃ bhavati, malapravṛttiśca bhavatīti pacyamānasya doṣasya lakṣaṇaṃ jānīyāt| atha nirāmajvaralakṣaṇamāha– ‘kṣudityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣudityādi| kṣucchikkā tasyāḥ prādurbhāvaḥ| anye kṣut kṣudhā| kṣāmatā kṛśatvaṃ, jvaramārdavaṃ jvarālpatvaṃ, doṣapravṛttiḥ vāyoḥ pravartanaṃ ‘gudena’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘utsāha’ ityatra ‘ ‘aṣṭāhāt’ iti pā.| aṣṭāha’ iti paṭhanti, aṣṭadinebhyaḥ parataḥ| etannirāmajvaralakṣaṇaṃ, tatrauṣadhaṃ deyaṃ jvarasya|| 61-65||
balavatsvalpadoṣeṣu jvaraḥ sādhyo'nupadravaḥ |66| (ca. ci. a. 3) |

jvarasya sādhyalakṣaṇamāha– balavatsvityādi| balavatsu puruṣeṣu sādhyaḥ, yaduktam– ‘balādhiṣṭhānāmārogyam’ (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| alpadoṣeṣu nātiprabaladoṣeṣu| anupadrava iti jvarasyopadravāḥ kāsādayaḥ| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “kāso mūrchā'ruciśchardistṛṣṇātīsāraviḍgrahāḥ| hikkāśvāsāṅgabhedāśca jvarasyopadravā daśa||” iti|66|–

sādhyajvaralakṣaṇamāha– ‘balavatsvityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | balavatsvityādi| balavatsu balayukteṣu puruṣeṣu jvaraḥ sādhyo bhavati| yaduktam– “balādhiṣṭhānamārogyam” iti| svalpadoṣeṣu nātibaladoṣeṣu puruṣeṣu| anupadravaḥ jvarasyopadravā ‘hikkādayaḥ’ iti pā.| kāsādayaḥ| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “kāso mūrchā'ruciśchardistṛṣṇātīsāraviḍgrahāḥ| hikkā śvāso'ṅgabhedaśca jvarasyopadravā daśa” iti|66|–

hetubhirbahubhirjāto balibhirbahulakṣaṇaḥ ||66|| jvaraḥ prāṇāntakṛdyaśca śīghramindriyanāśanaḥ | jvaraḥ kṣīṇasya śūnasya gambhīro dairgharātrikaḥ ||67|| asādhyo balavān yaśca keśasīmantakṛjjvaraḥ | (ca. ci. a. 3) | gambhīrastu jvaro jñeyo hyantardāhena tṛṣṇayā ||68|| ānaddhatvena cātyarthaṃ śvāsakāsodgamena ca | (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) | ārambhādviṣamo yastu yaśca vā dairgharātrikaḥ ||69|| kṣīṇasya cātirūkṣasya gambhīro yasya ‘hanti mānavam’ iti pā. | hanti tam | visañjñastāmyate yastu śete nipatito'pi vā ||70|| śītārdito'ntaruṣṇaśca jvareṇa mriyate naraḥ | yo hṛṣṭaromā raktākṣo hṛdi saṅghātaśūlavān ||71|| vaktreṇa caivocchvasiti taṃ jvaro hanti mānavam | hikkāśvāsatṛṣāyuktaṃ mūḍhaṃ vibhrāntalocanam ||72|| santatocchvāsinaṃ kṣīṇaṃ naraṃ kṣapayati jvaraḥ | hataprabhendriyaṃ ‘kṣāmaṃ ...’ iti pā. | kṣīṇamarocakanipīḍitam ||73|| gambhīratīkṣṇavegārtaṃ jvaritaṃ parivarjayet | (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: jvarasyāsādhyalakṣaṇānyāha– hetubhirityādi| nanu, yo ‘... rbahubhirjā ...’ iti pā.| hetubhirbalibhirbahubhiścopajāyate sa bahulakṣaṇa eva ‘utpadyate’ iti pā.| bhavati, tat kiṃ bahulakṣaṇavacanena? ucyate– yathā svahetukupitā doṣāḥ sarvasyaiva rogasya hetavo bhavanti, prāktanakarmāpekṣayā tu yadā viśiṣṭāṃ sāmagrīṃ samprāptilakṣaṇāmāsādayanti tadā jvaramāpādayanti, tathā dūṣyādisahakārikāraṇasānnidhyāsānnidhyābhyāṃ bahulakṣaṇatāmalpalakṣaṇatāṃ ca kurvanti| tathā hi tantrāntaram– ekaṃ dvau trīn bahūn vā'pi dehe dhātvādiyogataḥ| darśayanti ‘vikārāśca’ iti pā.| vikārāṃste kupitāḥ pavanādayaḥ||’ iti| ‘api ca’ iti pā.| athavā vikṛtiviṣamasamavāyādbahuhetuko'pyalpalakṣaṇo'lpahetuko'pi bahulakṣaṇa iti| prāṇāntakṛditi chedaḥ| śīghramindriyanāśana iti utpannamātra eva cikitsyamāno'pīndriyaśaktiṃ rūpādigrahaṇalakṣaṇāmupahanti so'pyasādhyo na tūpekṣayā; anye'pi hi rogā upekṣyamāṇā indriyaśaktimupaghnanti asādhyatāṃ cādhirohanti| evaṃ bahulakṣaṇo'pyādāveva cikitsyamāna eva boddhavyaḥ| indriyāṇyatra ekādaśa boddhavyāni sāṅkhyasiddhāntena, tathā carakasuśrutanirdiṣṭatvāt; ‘cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ sparśanaṃ ceti ‘dhīndriyāṇi’ iti pā.| buddhīndriyāṇi, hastapādagudopasthajihvāḥ karmendriyāṇi atra ‘ceti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ceti, ubhayātmakaṃ manaḥ||’; evamanyatrāpi draṣṭavyam| jvaraḥ kṣīṇasya śūnasyeti aparamasādhyalakṣaṇam| gambhīro dairgharātrika iti gambhīro'ntardhātusthaḥ; athavā gambhīra iva gambhīraḥ, yatra vātādīnāṃ niścayaḥ kartuṃ na śakyate; anye tvāhuḥ– gambhīro'ntarvegaḥ| dairgharātrika iti ‘dīrgharātrānubandhī’ iti jejjaṭaḥ, “dīrghāṃ maraṇarūpāṃ rātrimanuvartate iti dairgharātrikaḥ” iti cakraḥ, asādhya ityarthaḥ| atra pakṣe dairgharātrika iti pūrveṇa sambadhyate, asādhya iti pareṇa| keśasīmantakṛditi akasmāt keśeṣu sīmantān yaḥ karoti| uktaṃ hi tantrāntare “keśāḥ sīmantino yasya saṅkṣipte vinate bhruvau| ‘calanti’ iti pā.| lunanti cākṣipakṣmāṇi so'cirādyāti mṛtyave||” iti| gambhīrārthā ye jejjaṭādibhirvyākhyātāsteṣu madhye atra gambhīro'ntarvega ityayamartho mādhavakarasyābhimataḥ; ‘ata evāsau’ ityasya sthāne ‘yata’ iti pā.| ata evāsau etadanantaraṃ sauśrutaṃ gambhīralakṣaṇaṃ likhati– gambhīra ityādi| ‘yastu’ iti pā.| ya eva carake'ntarvegaḥ sa eva suśrute gambhīraḥ paṭhitaḥ; samalakṣaṇatvāt, pṛthakpāṭhābhāvācceti| ānaddhatvena ceti ‘vibaddhamalatvena’ iti pā.| baddhadoṣatvena| ārambhādityādi| ārambhādutpādāt prabhṛti ‘yo’ iti pā.| yasya viṣamajvaraḥ so'sādhyaḥ, yasya tu nityajvariṇo jvarotsṛṣṭasya vā'pacārādinā viṣamaḥ sa sādhya eva| etacca viṣamatvaṃ satatādirūpaṃ boddhavyaṃ, natu viṣamatvamātreṇa, vātikajvare'pi prasaṅgāditi| dairgharātriko vyāhṛta eva; na cāsya punaruktatvaṃ, tantrāntarīyavākyatvāt; adhikārthapratipādanārthaṃ ‘tadvākhyam’ iti pā.| buddhvā'pi likhitam; evaṃ gambhīre'pi vācyam| ‘atirūkṣasya’ ityatra ‘animiṣākṣasya’ iti pāṭhāntare sadā sphāritanetrasyetyarthaḥ| visañjñaḥ vihvalaḥ, tāmyate muhyati| śete nipatita iti śayito nipatita evāste na ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca utthātuṃ samarthaḥ| śītārdito'ntaruṣṇaśceti śītārdito bahiḥ, ‘antaruṣṇordāhavān’ iti pā.| antaruṣṇo'ntardāhavān| hṛṣṭaromā romāñcitagātraḥ| hṛdi saṅghātaśūlavāniti saṅghātarūpeṇa vastunā aṣṭhīlikādinā''krāntamiva hṛdayaṃ manyate yaḥ ‘sa tathā;’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sa tathā; anye tvāhuḥ– nānāprakāraśūlavāniti| vaktreṇa caivocchvasitītyevakāreṇa nāsikāṃ vyavacchinatti ‘vyāpāditasya’ iti pā.| vyāditāsyapratipādanārthaṃ, kharaśvāsa ityarthaḥ| hikketyādi| hikkādibhirmilitairekenāpyatibalavatā'sādhyatvam| mūḍhaṃ mohayuktam| vibhrāntalocanaṃ bhrāntaprekṣaṇaṃ, calitanetraṃ vā| santatocchvāsinaṃ ‘nirantarocchvāsinam’ iti pā.| nirantarakharaśvāsayuktam| hataprabhetyādi| hataprabhāṇi hataśaktīni svaviṣayāgrāhīṇi cakṣurādīni yasya sa tathā; athavā hatā prabhā dīptirindriyāṇi ca yasya sa tathā| ‘arocakanipīḍitam’ ityatra sthāne jejjaṭaḥ pāṭhāntaradvayaṃ paṭhati– ‘durātmānamupadrutam’ iti, vyācaṣṭe ca– “durātmānaṃ duṣṭāntaḥkaraṇam, upadrutamiti śvāsādibhirupadravairupadrutam; durātmabhirupadrutam” iti pāṭhāntare tu rākṣasādibhirjuṣṭamityarthaḥ| eṣāmasādhyalakṣaṇānāmupalakṣaṇatvādanyānyapi tantrāntareṣu draṣṭavyāni| tadyathā– ‘pretaiḥ saha pibenmadyaṃ svapne yaḥ kṛṣyate śunā| sughoraṃ jvaramāsādya ‘na jīvenna ca mucyate’ iti pā.| sa jīvamapasṛjyate|| jvaraḥ paurvāhṇiko yasya śuṣkakāsaśca dāruṇaḥ| balamāṃsavihīnasya yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| jvaro yasyāparāhṇe tu śleṣmakāsaśca dāruṇaḥ| balamāṃsavihīnasya yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| sahasā jvarasantāpastṛṣṇā mūrchā balakṣayaḥ| viśleṣaṇaṃ ca sandhīnāṃ mumūrṣorupajāyate|| gosarge pratyūṣe| gosarge ‘vedanādyasya’ iti pā.| vadanādyasya svedaḥ pracyavate bhṛśam| lepajvaropasṛṣṭasya durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam|| mṛtyuśca tasmin bahupicchilatvācchītasya jantoḥ paritaḥ saratvāt| svedo lalāṭe himavannarasya śītārditasyaiti supicchilaśca|| kaṇṭhe sthito yasya na yāti vakṣo nūnaṃ yamasyaiti gṛhaṃ sa martyaḥ|| srutasvedo lalāṭādyaḥ ślathasandhānabandhanaḥ| muhyedutthāpyamānastu sa sthūlo'pi na jīvati|| yasya svedo'tibahulaḥ picchilo yāti sarvataḥ| rogiṇaḥ śītagātrasya tadā maraṇamādiśet||’ iti| ‘nidhanaṃ janmataḥ saptamaṃ, pratyaraṃ pañcamaṃ, vipatkaraṃ tṛtīyam’ ityaṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahavyākhyāyāminduḥ| ādhānajanmanidhane pratyayākhye vipatkare| nakṣatre vyādhirutpannaḥ kleśāya maraṇāya vā| jvarastu jātaḥ ṣaḍrātrādaśvinīṣu nivartate||’ (vṛ. vā. ni. a. 1) ityādinā granthena nakṣatrabhedena jvarasya sādhyatvāsādhyatvaṃ yadabhihitaṃ, taddhārītavṛddhavāgbhaṭayordraṣṭavyam, iha tu vistarabhayānna likhitam| sannipātā sādhyaprakaraṇaṃ yathā– ‘pittakaphānilavṛddhyā daśadivasa dvādaśāha– saptāhāt| hanti vimuñcati vā''śu tridoṣajo dhātumalapākāt||’ iti| saptāhādvātādhikaḥ, daśāhāt pittādhikaḥ, dvādaśāhāt kaphādhikaḥ; pittādhikavadvātapittādhikaḥ, kaphādhikavadvātakaphādhikaḥ, yogavāhitvādvāyoḥ| ( ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustakeṣu nopalabhyate | yadāha carakaḥ– ‘yogavāhī paraṃ vāyuḥ saṃyogādubhayārthakṛt| dāhakṛttejasā yuktaḥ śītakṛtsomasaṃśrayāt||’ iti (ca. ci. a. 3)| dhātupākāddhanti, malapākādvimuñcatīti vyavasthitavikalpaḥ; ‘dhātumalapākabhede’ iti pā.| dhātumalapākavikalpe ca daivameva hetuḥ| uttarottararogavṛddhibalahānibhyāṃ śukrādidhātusahitamūtrādinā ca dhātupāko jñeyaḥ, atra kvacitpustake ‘anyathā tu malapākaḥ;’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| anyathā tu malapākaḥ| yaduktam– ‘nidrānāśo hṛdi stambho viṣṭambho gauravārucī| aratirbalahāniśca dhātūnāṃ pākalakṣaṇam|| iti; anyatāca malapākaḥ– ‘... vaicitryam’ iti pā.| doṣaprakṛtivaikṛtyaṃ laghutā jvaradehayoḥ| indriyāṇāṃ ca vaimalyaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pākalakṣaṇam||’ iti| nanu, ‘taratamabhāvāt’ iti pā.| taratamādibhāvavyavasthitaśīghramadhyamandaśaktitvāt asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘sthiraśīghramadhyamaśaktitvāt’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| sthiraśīghramadhyamaśaktitvāt doṣāṇāṃ kathaṃ saptāhādiniyama iti cet| na, tathā– svabhāvādvyādheḥ, vicitrā hi pratirogaṃ svabhāvāḥ; yathā'gnirohiṇī saptāhena hanti na tathā'nye ‘rogā’ iti pā.| vikārā iti| ‘tatra’ iti pā.| athaḥ ‘saptamī dviguṇā ‘yātu’ iti pā.| yāvat navamyekādaśī tathā| eṣā ‘dvidoṣa’ iti pā.| tridoṣamaryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca||’ (vā. ni. a. 2) iti hārītavacanasaṃvādārthamevaṃ vyācakṣate– daśamīpratyāsattyā navamī, dvādaśīpratyāsattyā ekādaśī ca gṛhyate; ‘tatra’ iti pā.| tato vṛddhyeti padamāvartya sarvatra dvaiguṇyaṃ kāryam| evaṃ, ‘saptame divase prāpte daśame dvādaśe'pi vā| punarghorataro bhūtvā praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā||’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) ityatra suśrutavākye punaḥśabdena dvaiguṇyamiti kārtikakuṇḍo vyākhyātavān| evaṃ daśadvādaśasaptāhaiḥ pittaśleṣmānilādhikaḥ| dagdhoṣmaṇā dhātumalān hanti muñcati vā jvaraḥ||’ (vā. ni. a. 2) ityatrādhikaśabdamāvartya kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā dvaiguṇyaṃ ‘boddhavyam’ iti pā.| vyākhyātam| tathā vātapittakaphaiḥ saptadaśadvādaśavāsarān| prāyo'nuyāti maryādā mokṣāya ca vadhāya ca||’ (vā. ni. a. 2) ityatrāgniveśamate prāyograhaṇena dvaiguṇyamiti| nanu, saptamītyādau kathaṃ tarhi daśaviṃśatidvādaśacaturviṃśatīnāṃ grahaṇamiti cet| ucyate– ekādaśītyatra eketi padamāvartanīyaṃ, tena navamī eketi daśamī labhyate, ekādaśī eketi dvādaśī asyānantaraṃ kvacitpustake ‘labhyate’ iti adhikaḥ pā.|, tataḥ sarvatra dvaiguṇyam| tu śabdaḥ samuccaye, tena saptamī gṛhyate sā dviguṇā ca| evaṃ navamyādiṣu yojyam| caturviṃśatyadhikastu maryādādivaso nāsti, tatpratipādakāgamādarśanāt||66-73||

div.ab: jvarasyāsādhyalakṣaṇamāha– hetubhirityādi| yo jvaro balibhiḥ prabalairhetubhiḥ kāraṇairjāto'ta eva bahulakṣaṇaḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇa ityarthaḥ sa tvasādhyaḥ; yaśca śīghramindriyanāśano bhavati so'pi jvaraḥ prāṇāntakṛt maraṇātmaka ityarthaḥ| utpannamātra eva cikitsitamātro'pi indriyaśaktiṃ ‘... ghnanti’ iti pā.| rasarūpādigrahaṇalakṣaṇāmupaharati ‘so'pyasādhyo na tūpekṣayā| anye'ti hi rogā upekṣyamāṇā indriyaśaktimupaghnanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | so'pyasādhyo na tūpekṣayā| anye'ti hi rogā upekṣyamāṇā indriyaśaktimupaghnanti asādhyatāṃ cādhirohanti; evamuktalakṣaṇo'pyādāvevācikitsyamāna eva bodhyaḥ| indriyāṇi cātra cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ ghrāṇaṃ rasanaṃ sparśanaṃ ceti pañca buddhīndriyāṇi hastapādagudopasthajihvāḥ pañca karmendriyāṇi ubhayātmakaṃ mana evamekādaśendriyāṇi| aparamasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– śūnasya śothayuktasya puruṣasya, ‘kṣīṇasya jvareṇa ’ ityasya sthāne ‘jvarakṣīṇasya jvareṇakṣīṇasya’ iti pā.| kṣīṇasya jvareṇa, gambhīro dairghyarātrikaḥ, gambhīro'ntardhātusthaḥ, athavā gambhīra iva gambhīraḥ, yatra vātādīnāṃ niścayaḥ kartuṃ na śakyate, anye gambhīro'ntarvegaḥ| ‘dairgharātrika’ iti pā.| dairghyarātrika iti dīrgharātrānubandhīti jejjaṭaḥ, dīrghāṃ maraṇarūpāṃ rātrimanuvartata iti cakraḥ, asādhya ityarthaḥ| keśasīmantakṛditi akasmātkeśeṣu sīmantān karoti yaḥ| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare– “keśāḥ sīmantino yasya saṅkṣipte vitate bhruvau| ‘lulanti’ iti pā.| lunanti cākṣipakṣmāṇi so'cirādyāti mṛtyave” iti| suśrutoktaṃ sādhyagambhīrajvaralakṣaṇamāha– gambhīrastvityādi| ānaddhatveneti ‘... vibandhaneti’ iti pā.| doṣapurīṣavibandhena| ‘gambhīrasyāmasādhya ...’ iti pā.| aparamasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– ‘ārambhādityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ārambhādityādi| ārambhātprabhṛti yasya viṣamo jvaraḥ so'sādhyaḥ| tacca viṣamatvaṃ ‘... rūpatvam’ iti pā.| satatādirūpatyena boddhavyaṃ na tu viṣamatvaṃ vegādinā| ‘dairghyarātrikaḥ’ iti pā.| dairgharātrikaḥ pūrvameva vyākhyāto'pi na ‘paunaruktaḥ’ iti pā.| punaruktaḥ, tantrāntarīyavākyatvāt ‘adhikārtha ...’ iti pā.| adhikāryapratipādanārthaṃ tadvākyaṃ ‘paṭhanti’ iti pā.| paṭhitam| ‘atirūkṣasya’ ityatra ‘animiṣākṣasya’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhantyanye| tatra sarvadā sphāritanetrasyetyarthaḥ| anyadapyasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– visañjño vihvalaḥ, tāmyati pramuhyati, ‘śete nipatata iva’ ityasya sthāne ‘śete nipatata iti| kṣayito'pi nipatita’’ iti pā.| śete nipatata iva āste naivotthātuṃ samarthaḥ| śītārdito bahirantardāhavān| anyadapyasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– ‘ya ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ya ityādi| hṛṣṭaromā romāñcitaḥ| hṛdi saṅghātaśūlavāniti saṅghātarūpeṇa vastunā aṣṭhīlakādinā ‘... ntameva’ iti pā.| ākrāntamiva hṛdayaṃ manyate yaḥ, aṣṭhīlā pāṣāṇaloṣṭikā, anena prakāreṇa śūlavāniti| anye tvāhuḥ– nānāprakāraśūlavāniti| vaktreṇa caivocchvasitīti ‘evaṃ prakāreṇa’ iti pā.| evakāreṇa nāsikābhyāṃ vyavacchinatti| hikketyādibhirmilitairekena ‘... sādhyatm’ iti pā.| vā'pyatibalavatā'sādhyatvam| mūḍhaṃ mohayuktaṃ, vibhrāntalocanaṃ bhrāntaprekṣaṇaṃ calitanetraṃ vā, santatocchvāsinaṃ nirantarocchvāsinam| lakṣaṇāntaramāha– ‘hatetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | hatetyādi| hataprabhāṇi hataśaktīni svaviṣayāgrāhīṇi ca indriyāṇi cakṣurādīni yasya sa tathā; athavā hatā prabhā dīptirindriyāṇi ca yasya sa tathā| arocakanipīḍitamityatra jejjaṭaḥ pāṭhadvayaṃ paṭhati ‘durātmānamudrupatam’ iti pā.| ‘durātmānamupadrutaṃ iti| durātmānaṃ duṣṭāntaḥkaraṇam| upadrutamupadravayuktam| ‘durātmabhirupadrutam’ iti pāṭhāntare rākṣasādibhirjuṣṭamityarthaḥ| gambhīro'ntarvegaḥ, tīkṣṇo'tiduḥsaho bahirantaśca, tābhyāmanyonyamārtaṃ pīḍitaṃ, ‘kṣāmaṃ kṣīṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣāmaṃ kṣīṇaṃ, tamitthambhūtaṃ jvaritaṃ svārthavidyāyaśohānibhayādasādhyatvātparivarjayet| eṣāmasādhyalakṣaṇānāmupalakṣaṇatvādanyānyapi tantrāntareṣu draṣṭavyāni| tadyathā– “pretaiḥ saha pibenmadyaṃ svapne yaḥ kṛṣyate śunā| sa ghoraṃ jvaramāsādya naro jīvādvimucyate|| jvaraḥ pūrvāhṇiko yasya śuṣkakāsaśca dāruṇaḥ| ‘... vihīnasya’ iti pā.| balamāṃsavihīnaśca yathā pretastathaiva saḥ|| gosarge ‘vedanā yasya’ iti pā.| varanādyasya svedaḥ pracyavate bhṛśam| lepajvaropasṛṣṭasya durlabhaṃ tasya jīvitam” iti| atra ‘atra’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| atra gosarge pratyūṣe| “mṛtyuśca tasminbahupicchilatvācchītasya jantoḥ paritaḥ saratvāt| svedo lalāṭe himavannarasya ‘... tasyāpi’ iti pā.| śītārditasyaiti supicchilaśca|| kaṇṭhe sthito yasya na yāti vakṣo nūnaṃ yamasyaiti gṛhaṃ sa martyaḥ” iti| tathā'nyatrāpi– “āvilākṣaṃ pratāmyantaṃ nidrāyuktamatīva ca| kṣīṇaśoṇitamāṃsaṃ ca naraṃ kṣapayati jvaraḥ|| srutasvedo lalāṭādyaḥ ślathasandhānabandhanaḥ| ‘guhyatyutthā...’ iti pā.| muhyatyutthāpyamānastu sa sthūlo'pi na jīvati|| yasya svedo'tibahulaḥ picchilo yāti sarvataḥ| rogiṇaḥ śītagātrasya tadā maraṇamādiśet|| yastāmyati svapiti śītalagātrayaṣṭirantarvidāhasahitaṃ ‘smaraṇādupetam’ iti pā.| smaraṇādapetam| socchvāsinaṃ ‘dūṣitaroma ...’ iti pā.| kupitaromacayaṃ saśūlaṃ taṃ varjayedbhiṣagiha jvaritaṃ vidhijñaḥ” iti “jvarastu jātaḥ ṣaḍrātrādaśvinīṣu nivartate” ityādi nakṣatrabhedena jvarasyāsādhyatvam| yaduktaṃ ‘taddhārītavāgbhaṭayo ...’ iti pā.| taddhārītavṛddhavāgbhaṭayordraṣṭavyam||66-73||–

ab.seg: dāhaḥ svedo bhramastṛṣṇā ‘... sañjñitā’ iti pā. | kampaviḍbhidasañjñatā | kūjanaṃ cāsyavaigandhyamākṛtirjvaramokṣaṇe ||74||

jvaravimuktipūrvarūpamāha– dāha ityādi viḍbhiditi viḍbhedaḥ; sampadādipāṭhāt ‘bhāve’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhāve kvip| asañjñitā sañjñānāśaḥ| kūjanam ‘kunthanam’ iti pā.| asphuṭadhvaniḥ| yaduktam– ‘jvarapramokṣe puruṣaḥ ‘kūjanvamati’ iti pā.| kūjedvamati ceṣṭate||’(ca. ci. a. 3) iti| vāgbhaṭo'pyāha– ‘dhātūn prakṣobhayan doṣo mokṣakāle balīyate| tato naraḥ śvasan svidyan kūjan vamati ceṣṭate|| (vā. ni. a. 2) iti| vaigandhyaṃ durgandhatā gātre| jvaramokṣaṇe bhaviṣyati ākṛtirlakṣaṇaṃ ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| nanu, doṣakṣayaṃ vinā na vyādhinivṛttiḥ, kṣīṇaśca doṣaḥ kathamevaṃvidhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt? ucyate– kaścidbhāvaḥ kṣīṇo'pi vināśakāle svaśaktiṃ darśayati, yathā– nirvāṇāvastho dīpo viśeṣāt prajvalati| athavā doṣābhibhūtānāṃ dhātūnāṃ doṣāpagamena kṣobhāddāhādayaḥ taralataravānaraparihīyamānataruṇataruvallarīśikharakampavaditi||74||

jvaramuktasya pūrvarūpamāha– ‘dāha ityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dāha ityādi| jvaramokṣakāle etādṛśyākṛtirlakṣaṇaṃ ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ viḍbhiditi viḍbhedaḥ, asañjñatā sañjñānāśaḥ, kūjanaṃ kunthanam| yaduktam– “jvaramokṣeṣu puruṣaḥ kūjannativiceṣṭate” iti| vāgbhaṭa'pyāha– “dhātūnprakṣobhayandoṣo mokṣakāle balīyate| tato naraḥ śvasansadyaḥ kūjannativiceṣṭate” iti| vaigandhyaṃ daurgandhyamatīva gātre| nanu doṣakṣayaṃ vinā na vyādhinivṛttiḥ, kṣīṇaśca doṣaḥ kathamevaṃvidhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kuryāt? ucyate– ‘kaścidbhāvaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kaścidbhāvaḥ kṣīṇo'pi vināśakāle svaśaktiṃ darśayati, yathā ‘nirvāṇavastho'pi’ iti pā.| nirvāṇāvastho'pi dīpo viśeṣātprajvalati| athavā doṣābhibhūtānāṃ dhātūnāṃ doṣāpagamena kṣobhāddāhādayaḥ, ‘yathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā– taralataravānaraparihīyamānataruṇataruvallarīśikharakampavaditi| etacca dāhamārabhya lakṣaṇaṃ tridoṣaje bhavati na sarvatra; ‘etadanantaraṃ ’ iti pā.| tathācaitadanantaraṃ bhālukiḥ prāha– “tridoṣaje jvare hyetadantarvege ca dhātuje| lakṣaṇaṃ mokṣakāle syādanyasmin svedadarśanam” iti ||74||

div.ab: svedo laghutvaṃ śirasaḥ kaṇḍūḥ pāko mukhasya ca | kṣavathuścānnalipsā ca jvaramuktasya lakṣaṇam ||75|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 39) |

ab.seg: jvaramuktilakṣaṇamāha– sveda ityādi| svedo gharmāgamanaṃ, srotasāṃ sphuṭatvāt| laghutvaṃ gātrasya| śirasaḥ kaṇḍūriti sarvo hi jvarastaijaso virodhivyapagamāt saumyaḥ śleṣmā labdhabalaḥ san śirasi svasthāne'sādhāraṇātmalakṣaṇaṃ kaṇḍūṃ karoti, vyādhimahimnā tu nānyatra kaphasthāne iti vadanti| pāko mukhasyeti jvaroṣmakopitāt pittāt, yattu pūrvaṃ nākārṣīdanyatra vā tadapi vyādhimahimnaiva| etacca dāhamārabhya lakṣaṇaṃ tridoṣaje'ntarvege jvare bhavati, natu sarvatra| tathā caitadanantaraṃ bhālukiḥ prāha– ‘tridoṣaje jvare hyetadantarvege ca dhātuge| lakṣaṇaṃ mokṣakāle syādanyasmin svedadarśanam||’ iti| nanu, jvarasya pratyakṣatvāttasyābhāvo'pi pratyakṣaḥ, tat kiṃ tallakṣaṇapāṭhena? tathā'pi vā paṭhitavyaṃ, tarhi sarvavikāreṣu paṭhyatām? ucyate– viṣamajvaraśaṅkānirāsārthaṃ, viṣamajvare hi nivṛtto'pi jvaraḥ punarāyāti, doṣāṇāṃ dhātulīnatvāt; etallakṣaṇe tu niḥśeṣadoṣanivṛttyā na punarāgamaḥ| yatra caivaṃvidhā śaṅkā tatraiva lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhati na sarvatra, yathā pramehātīsārādiṣviti sarvaṃ sustham||75||

jvaramuktasya lakṣaṇamāha– jvaramuktasya puruṣasyaivaṃ vidhaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati| svedo gharmāgamaḥ srotasāṃ sphuṭatvāt, laghutvaṃ gātrasya; śirasaḥ kaṇḍūriti| sarvo hi jvarastaijasaḥ virodhivyapagamāt saumyaḥ śleṣmā labdhabalaḥ san ‘śirasaḥ’ iti pā.| śirasi svasthāne'sādhāraṇātmakalakṣaṇaṃ kaṇḍūṃ janayati vyādhimahimnā nānyatra sthāne iti vadanti| pāko mukhasyeti jvaroṣmakopitātpittāt|| kṣavathuḥ chikkā| paramate– “deho laghurvyapagataklamamohatāpaḥ pāko mukhe karaṇasauṣṭhavamavyathatvam| svedaḥ kṣavaḥ prakṛtiyogimano'nnalipsā kaṇḍūśca mūrdhni vigatajvaralakṣaṇāni” iti||75||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne jvaranidānaṃ samāptam ||2||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ jvaranidānaṃ samāptam||2||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe rugviniścayavyākhyāne jvaranidānaṃ samāptam||2||

div.head: atīsāranidānam
div.ab: athātīsāranidānam | gurvatisnigdharūkṣoṣṇadravasthūlātiśītalaiḥ | viruddhādhyaśanājīrṇairviṣamaiścāpi bhojanaiḥ ||1|| snehādyairatiyuktaiśca mithyāyuktairviṣairbhayaiḥ | śokādduṣṭāmbumadyātipānaiḥ sātmyartuparyayaiḥ ||2|| jalābhiramaṇairvegavighātaiḥ krimidoṣataḥ | nṛṇāṃ bhavatyatīsāro lakṣṇaṃ tasya vakṣyate ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 40) |

ab.seg: pittajvare'tīsārapāṭhājjvarātīsārayoranyonyopadravatvācca jvarānantaramatīsāramāha gurvatisnigdhetyādi| guruśabdena mātrāgururgṛhyate, ‘yathā'timātropayukto raktaśālyādiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā'timātropayukto raktaśālyādiḥ; tathā svabhāvaguru ca māṣādi; athavā guṇataḥ pākataśca| atiśabdaḥ sthūlāntaiḥ ‘saha’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saha sambadhyate| sthūlaṃ saṃhatāvayavaṃ, yathā– laḍḍukapiṣṭakādi| śītalaṃ sparśādvīryācca| viruddhamiti saṃyogadeśakālamātrādibhirviruddhaṃ, yathā– kṣīramatsyādi; tacca bahuprakāraṃ suśrute hitāhitīye'dhyāye (su. sū. a. 20), carake ‘bhadrakālīyādhyāye’ iti pā.| cātreyabhadrakāpyīyādhyāye (ca. sū. a. 26) draṣṭavyam| adhyaśanaṃ pūrvadināhārājīrṇe bhojanam| uktaṃ hi carake– “bhuktaṃ ‘pūrvāhṇaśeṣe’ iti pā.| pūrvānnaśeṣe tu punaradhyaśanaṃ matam|” (ca. ci. a. 15) iti;
