tasya viśiṣṭāṃ samprāptimāha– kaphetyādi| kaphaḥ pradhānaṃ yeṣāmanilādidoṣāṇāṃ ‘tathā’ iti pā.| taistathā| nanu doṣairiti bahutvena doṣatrayamucyate, tatkathaṃ kaphasya pradhānatā? ucyate– tasya pradhānatā ca vegarodhādikṣubhitavātaviplutāgnimāndyādinā boddhavyā| rasavartmasu rasavahadhamanīṣu| atrādiśabdo luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena raktādivahasroto'pi boddhavyam| athavā rasakāraṇatayā raktādīnāṃ rasaduṣṭyaiva raktādiduṣṭiriti kārtikaḥ| idamatra sūcitam– yanmārgāvarodhāddhṛdayastho raso vidahyate, tatraivāvasthito vikṛtibahulapicchilavisraharitapītaśvetakāsavegena mukhamārgeṇa niḥsarati| yaduktaṃ carake– “rasaḥ srotaḥsu ruddheṣu svasthānastho vidahyate| sa ūrdhvaṃ kāsavegena bahurūpaḥ pravartate” iti| etenānulomakṣayo darśitaḥ| kāraṇabhūtarasadhātukṣaye sati raktādīnāṃ rasakāryāṇāṃ poṣakābhāvena kṣīyamāṇatvāt| pratilomakṣayaṃ darśayannāha– atītyādi| ativyavāyinaḥ atyarthaṃ grāmyadharmasevinaḥ| yadi strībhyo na nivartate tadā kṣīṇe retasi kṣīyamāṇe śukre anantarāḥ samīpasthā dhātavaḥ kṣīyante, tadyathā– śukre kṣīṇe majjā kṣīyate, majjani kṣīyamāṇe'sthi, evaṃ pūrvaṃ pūrvam| nanu, rasavartmarodhāt raso na raktasya bṛṃhaṇāyālaṃ, raktāpacayānmāṃsasyāpacaya ityādipūrvapūrvadhātukṣīṇatayā śukrakṣayo yuktaḥ, kāryabhūtaśukrakṣaye pūrvadhātūnāṃ kathaṃ kṣayaḥ? ucyate, śukrakṣayādvāyuḥ kupyati; yaduktam– “vāyordhātukṣayātkopo mārgasyāvaraṇena ca” iti| sa vāyuḥ sānnidhyāt majjānaṃ śoṣayati, evaṃ pūrvapūrvadhātūn| dṛṣṭaṃ ca pratyāsannatayā kāryajanakatvam| yathā'gnisantaptāyogolakasannidhānādārdrabhūbhāgasya śoṣaḥ, yathā ca mahājalādhāraparikṣaye tatra praviśatāṃ jalāśayānāṃ parikṣayaḥ||2||

div.ab: śvāsāṅgamardakaphasaṃsravatāluśoṣavamyagnisādamadapīnasakāsanidrāḥ | śoṣe bhaviṣyati bhavanti sa cāpi jantuḥ śuklekṣaṇo bhavati māṃsaparo riraṃsuḥ ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) | svapneṣu kākaśukaśallakinīlakaṇṭhā gṛdhrāstathaiva kapayaḥ kṛkalāsakāśca | taṃ vāhayanti sa nadīrvijalāśca paśyecchuṣkāṃstarūn pavanadhūmadavārditāṃśca ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpamāha– śvāsetyādi| saṃsravaḥ ṣṭhīvanam| pīnasaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ| māṃsaparo māṃsabhojanecchuḥ| riraṃsuḥ striyaṃ rantumicchuḥ; etacca vyādhimahimnā manodoṣāt| tathā svapneṣu kākādivāhanaṃ ca pūrvarūpameva| śallakī ‘ ‘śajāru’ iti pā.| śarāru’ iti khyātā, nīlakaṇṭho mayūraḥ| vijalā nirjalāḥ| davo vanāgniḥ| arditān abhibhūtān| cakārāttṛṇakeśanipātādayo ‘bhojane grāhyāḥ’ iti ātaṅkadarpaṇasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ| draṣṭavyāḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “pūrvarūpaṃ pratiśyāyo ‘dauḥśīlyam’ iti pā.| daurbalyaṃ doṣadarśanam| adoṣeṣvapi bhāveṣu kāye bībhatsadarśanam|| ghṛṇitvamaśnataścāpi balamāṃsaparikṣayaḥ| strīmadyamāṃsapriyatā priyatā cāvaguṇṭhane|| ‘yakṣmiṇaṃ ... ’ iti pā.| makṣikāghuṇakeśānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ patanāni ca| prāyo'nnapāne, keśānāṃ nakhānāṃ cātivardhanam|| patattribhiḥ pataṅgaiśca śvāpadaiścābhidharṣaṇam|| atra “svapne keśāsthirāśīnāṃ bhasmanaścādhirohaṇam|| jalāśayānāṃ śailānāṃ vanānāṃ jyotiṣāmapi| śuṣyatāṃ kṣīyamāṇānāṃ patatāṃ cāpi darśanam|| prāgrūpaṃ bahurūpasya tajjñeyaṃ rājayakṣmaṇaḥ|” ityātaṅkadarpaṇe'dhikaṃ paṭhyate| ” (ca. ci. a. 8) iti| ‘atra’ iti pā.| tatra śvāpadā vyāghrādayaḥ||3-4||

pūrvarūpamāha– śvāsetyādi| bhaviṣyati utpadyamāne śoṣe śvāsādayo bhavantīti sambandhaḥ| aṅgasādo'ṅgaglāniḥ| kaphasaṃsravaḥ kaphaṣṭhīvanaṃ, mado dhattūraphalabhakṣaṇādiva manomohaḥ, pīnasaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ, ‘kāsahikkā’ itisthāne'nye ‘pāṇḍunidrā’ iti paṭhanti, atra ‘tatra pāṇḍuḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| tatra pāṇḍuḥ pāṇḍudehacchaviḥ| sa ca puruṣaḥ śuklanayano bhavati| māṃsaparo māṃsabhakṣaṇakāmaḥ| riraṃsuḥ striyaṃ rantumicchuḥ, etacca vyādhimahimnā manodoṣādboddhavyam| tathā svapne kākādivāhanaṃ ca pūrvarūpameva, śallakī godhānukārī vajraśakalī ‘sellaka’ iti vikhyātaḥ, nīlakaṇṭho mayūraḥ, kṛkalāsaḥ saraṭaḥ ‘giragiṭa’ iti pūrvadeśīyā bhāṣante; ete taṃ vāhanībhūya vahanti| vijalā nirjalāḥ| pavano vāyuḥ, davo dāvāgniḥ, arditān abhibhūtān| cakārāt keśatṛṇādinipātādayo bhojane grāhyāḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “pūrvarūpaṃ pratiśyāyo daurbalyaṃ doṣadarśanam| adoṣeṣvapi bhāveṣu kāye bībhatsadarśanam|| ‘ghṛṇitvamaśnataścāpi’ iti pā.| ghṛṇitvamaścāpi balamāṃsaparikṣayaḥ| strīmadyamāṃsapriyatā priyatā cāvaguṇṭhane|| ‘makṣikāghuṇakeśānāṃ tṛṇānām’ ityasya sthāne ‘makṣikāghuṇakeśāditṛṇānām’ iti pā.| makṣikāghuṇakeśānāṃ tṛṇānāṃ patanāni ca| prāyo'nnapāne keśānāṃ nakhānāṃ cābhivardhanam|| patattribhiḥ ‘pataṅgaiśca’ iti pā.| pataṅgaśca śvāpadaiścāpi gharṣaṇam| svapne keśāsthirāśīnāṃ bhasmanaścādhirohaṇam|| jalāśayānāṃ śailānāṃ vanānāṃ jyotiṣāmapi| śuṣkatāṃ kṣīyamāṇānāṃ patatāṃ cāpi darśanam| prāgrūpaṃ bahurūpasya tajjñeyaṃ rājayakṣmaṇaḥ||” iti| atra śvāpadā vyāghrādayaḥ||3-4||

div.ab: aṃsapārśvābhitāpaśca santāpaḥ karapādayoḥ | jvaraḥ sarvāṅgagaśceti lakṣaṇaṃ rājayakṣmaṇaḥ ||5|| (ca. ci. a. 8) |

ab.seg: trirūpasampannamāha– aṃsetyādi| aṃsapārśvayorabhitāpaḥ pīḍā, aṃso bhujasyoparibhāgaḥ, abhitāpatvenaikaṃ rūpam, evaṃ santāpe'pi vācyam| karapādayorityatra prāṇyaṅgatvādekavadbhāvaṃ manyamānāḥ kāśmīrāḥ– ‘tāpaḥ pādakarasya ca’ iti paṭhanti, ‘karapādikaḥ’ iti ca pāṭhāntaram| etattrayaṃ prāyobhāvitvena carakeṇoktaṃ, tenaikādaśarūpeṣu madhye'nyadapi trayaṃ bodhyam| tathāca bhojaḥ– “kāso jvaro raktapittaṃ ‘trirūpam’ iti pā.| trirūpe rājayakṣmaṇi|” iti| anye tvāhuḥ– rājayakṣmaṇi yo jvarastasyaitallakṣaṇamiti; jejjaṭastu trirūpasampattimeva vyākhyātavān||5||

trirūpasampattiṃ darśayannāha– aṃsetyādi| aṃsapārśvayorabhitāpaḥ pīḍā, aṃso bhujasyoparibhāgaḥ| karapādayorityatra prāṇyaṅgatvenaikavadbhāvaṃ manyamānāḥ kāśmīrāḥ ‘tāpaḥ pādakarasya ca’ iti paṭhanti; ‘santāpaḥ ‘karapādikaḥ’ iti pā.| karapādādikaḥ’ ityapare| etattrayaṃ prāyobhāvitvena carakeṇoktam||5||

div.ab: ( ‘śloko ayaṃ suśrutena nirmito viṣayabhedapradarśanāya mādhavena likhitaḥ’ iti bhaktadveṣo jvaraḥ śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ śoṇitadarśanam | svarabhedaśca ‘jāyeta ṣaḍrūpam’ ityasya sthāne ‘jāyante ṣaḍrūpe’ iti pā. | jāyeta ṣaḍrūpaṃ rājayakṣmaṇi) |6|
idānīṃ tasyaiva ṣaḍrūpāṇi darśayitumāha– bhaktetyādi|6|

svarabhedo'nilācchūlaṃ saṅkocaścāṃsapārśvayoḥ | jvaro dāho'tisāraśca pittādraktasya cāgamaḥ ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) | śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvamabhaktacchanda eva ca | kāsaḥ kaṇṭhasya coddhvaṃso vijñeyaḥ kaphakopataḥ ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

ab.seg: rājayakṣmaṇastraidoṣikasyaikādaśarūpāṇi vibhajya vyādhiprabhāvājjāyante, natu sannipātajvaraliṅgavat sarvadoṣaiḥ sarvāṇītyāha– svarabhedo'nilādityādi| śūlamaṃsapārśvayoreva, ‘aṃsapārśvayoḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | aṃsapārśvayoḥ saṅkoca eka eva gaṇanīyaḥ| abhaktacchando bhaktāruciḥ| kaṇṭhasyoddhvaṃsaḥ kaṇṭhabhedaḥ; ‘utkāsikā’ iti kārtikaḥ||6-7||

doṣabhedenaikādaśarūpāṇi darśayannāha– svaretyādi| ‘śūlam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śūlam aṃsapārśvayoḥ saṅkoca eka eva| apare ‘saṃloca’ iti paṭhanti, tatra saṃloco luñcitamiva aṃsayoḥ pārśvayośca, tenaivaṃ trīṇi; jvarādīni catvāri pittena; śirasaḥ paripūrṇatvaṃ kapheneti śeṣaḥ, abhaktacchando bhojane aśraddhā, kaṇṭhasya coddhvaṃsaḥ kaṇṭhabhaṅgaḥ, uddhvaṃsa ‘utkāsiketi’ iti pā.| utkāripheti kārtikaḥ, evaṃ catvāri kaphena; evamekādaśarūpāṇi; evaṃ ṣaḍrūpāṇyapi vātādibhedena jñeyāni||6-7||
ekādaśabhirebhirvā ṣaḍbhirvā'pi samanvitam | kāsātīsārapārśvārtisvarabhedārucijvaraiḥ ||8||
tribhirvā pīḍitaṃ liṅgaiḥ ‘jvarakāsā ... ’ iti pā. | kāsaśvāsāsṛgāmayaiḥ | jahyācchoṣārditaṃ jantumicchan suvimalaṃ yaśaḥ ||9||
(su. u. taṃ. a. 41) | sarvairardhaistribhirvā'pi liṅgairmāṃsabalakṣaye | yukto varjyaścikitsyastu sarvarūpo'pyato'nyathā ||10||
mahāśanaṃ kṣīyamāṇamatīsāranipīḍitam | śūnamuṣkodaraṃ caiva yakṣmiṇaṃ parivarjayet ||11||
śuklākṣamannadveṣṭāramūrdhvaśvāsanipīḍitam | kṛcchreṇa bahumehantaṃ yakṣmā hantīha mānavam ||12||

asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– ekādaśabhirityādi| ekādaśabhirebhiriti svarabhedādibhiḥ kaṇṭhoddhvaṃsāntaiḥ| ṣaḍbhiriti suśrutena ṣaḍrūpāṇi paṭhitāni “bhaktadveṣo jvaraḥ śvāsaḥ kāsaḥ śoṇitadarśanam| svarabhedaśca jāyeta ṣaḍrūpaṃ rājayakṣmaṇi||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) iti| “kāsātisārapārśvārtisvarabhedārucijvaraiḥ” iti tu kasyacittantrasya ṣaḍrūpāṇi mādhavakareṇa likhitānīti| etāni caikādaśa ‘rūpāṇi’ ityasya sthāne ‘ṣaḍvā trirūpāṇi vā’ iti pā.| rūpāṇi prāyobhāvitvāduktāni, anyatamarūpaparihārāt; rūpāntarayoge'pyekādaśatvaṃ ṣaṭtvaṃ ca syādeva, tathāhi carako nidāne ekādaśarūpāṇi paṭhitvā cikitsite'pi vegarodhādikāraṇacatuṣṭayaje pratikāraṇaṃ caturdhā ekādaśarūpāṇi ‘paṭhitāni’ iti pā.| paṭhitavān| yathā– “kāsoṃ'satāpo vaisvaryaṃ jvaraḥ pārśvaśirorujā| chardanaṃ raktakaphayoḥ śvāso ‘varcobhido ... ’ iti pā.| varcograho'ruciḥ|| rūpāṇyekādaśaitāni, yakṣmaṇi ṣaḍimāni ca| kāso jvaraḥ pārśvaśūlaṃ svaravarcograho'ruciḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 8) iti| ekādaśavacanenaivaṃ bodhayati– sampūrṇe yakṣmaṇyekādaśaiva rūpāṇi bhavantīti| jahyāditi ‘ ‘balamāṃsakṣaye’ iti pā.| balamāṃsakṣate sati’ iti śeṣaḥ| tathāca carakaḥ– “vātavyādhirapasmārī kuṣṭhī bradhnī cirajvarī| gulmī ca madhumehī ca rājayakṣmī ca yo naraḥ|| acikitsyā bhavantyete balamāṃsaparikṣayāt| svalpeṣvapi vikāreṣu bhiṣagetān vivarjayet||” (ca. i. a. 9) iti| ‘sarvairardhaurityādi’ iti pā.| sarvairityādi| nanu, sarvarūpāṇyekādaśa, ekādaśānāmardhaṃ ‘ardhonāni ṣaṭ’ iti pā.| sārdhapañca bhavanti, tatra katamasya rūpasyārdhatvaṃ kimbhūtaṃ vā bhavati? ucyate– ekasya rupasyārdhatvāsambhave ‘ ... rardhayorutkṛṣṭatvāt’ iti pā.| ṣaṭpañcarūpayorutkṛṣṭatvāt ṣaḍrūpa evārdho grāhyāḥ| liṅgairyukta iti sambandhaḥ| ato'nyatheti balamāṃsakṣayābhāve sati| mahāśanaṃ kṣīyamāṇamityekamasādhyalakṣaṇam, ariṣṭarūpatvāt; ‘atisāranipīḍitamiti’ iti pā.| atīsārapīḍitamiti dvitīyaṃ, yakṣmiṇo malāyattajīvitasyoktatvāt; śūnamuṣkodaramiti tṛtīyaṃ, muṣkaśothasya virekasādhyatvena viruddhopakramatvāt| śukletyādi| śuklākṣatvādayaḥ ekaikaśo'sādhyalakṣaṇāni||8-12||

bahurūpo rājayakṣmā'sādhyastamāha– ekādaśabhiriti| ‘ebhirvā’ ityatra ‘etairvā’ iti pā. etairiti svarabhedo'nilācchūlamityādikairekādaśabhiḥ| ṣaḍbhirvāpīti bhaktadveṣo jvara ityādibhiḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ, apiśabdāt tribhirvā aṃsapārśvābhitāpaścetyādikaiḥ, samanvitaṃ jahyāt tyajet| ‘śoṣānvitamiti’ iti pā.| śoṣānvitaṃ puruṣaṃ yakṣmiṇamiti śeṣaḥ| vahnimāṃsabalakṣaye satīti bodhyam| asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– sarvairiti sarvaiḥ ekādaśabhiḥ| nanu, sarvāṇi rūpāṇyekādaśa, ekādaśānāmardhaṃ sārdhapañca bhavanti, tatra katamarūpasyārdhatvaṃ kimbhūtaṃ vā bhavati? ucyate– ekasya ‘rūpasyārdhāsambhave’ iti pā.| rūpasyārthāsambhave ‘ ... rardhayorutkṛṣṭatvāt’ iti pā.| ṣaṭpañcarūpayorardhayorutkṛṣṭatvāt ṣaḍrūpamatrārdho grāhyaḥ| etairliṅgairmāṃsabalakṣayairyukto varjya iti sambandhaḥ| māṃsabalayoḥ ‘kṣayaiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣayaiḥ| kṣayaliṅgāni suśrutenoktāni| tadyathā– “māṃsakṣaye'sthigaṇḍopasthoruvakṣaḥkakṣāpiṇḍikodaragrīvāśuṣkatā rūkṣatā sādo gātrāṇāṃ dhamanīśaithilyaṃ ca” iti| balam ojaḥ| “mūrchā māṃsakṣayo mohaḥ pralāpo'jñānameva ca| pūrvoktāni ca liṅgāni maraṇaṃ ca balakṣaye” iti| apare māṃsabalakṣaye iti paṭhanti, tatra māṃsabalakṣaye satīti yojyam| ato'nyatheti māṃsabalakṣaye'satīti| etena balamāṃsāgniyuktaḥ pratyākhyeya cikitsyaḥ sarvarūpo'pi| aparamasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– ‘mahāśinamiti’ iti pā.| mahāśanamiti|– ‘mahāśinam’ iti pā.| mahāśanaṃ bahvaśanamapi kṣīyamāṇaṃ māṃsabalābhyāṃ kṣīṇamariṣṭatvāt| atīsāranipīḍitaṃ atīsārayuktam| uktaṃ ca– “malāyattaṃ balaṃ puṃsāṃ śukrāyattaṃ tu jīvitam| tasmādyatnena saṃrakṣedyakṣmiṇo malaretasī” iti; śūnamuṣkodaraṃ śophayuktaṃ muṣka udaraṃ ca yasya taṃ; muṣkaśothasya virekasādhyatvena viruddhopakramatvāt| ‘mahāśinam’ iti pā.| mahāśanaṃ kṣīyamāṇamityekamasādhyalakṣaṇam, atīsāranipīḍitamiti dvitīyaṃ, śūnamuṣkodaramiti tṛtīyam| ‘aparamapi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | aparamapi varjyamāha– śuklākṣamityādi| kṛcchreṇa bahumehantamiti kaṣṭena bahutaraṃ ‘mukhena’ iti pā.| mehantaṃ ‘malam’ iti śeṣaḥ| etenāhārasya malabhāvaḥ kathitaḥ| yasya cātiśayo malo niṣpadyate tasya māṃsaraktakṣayo bhavati, sa punarasādhyaḥ syāt| itthambhūtaṃ naraṃ śuklākṣatvādyupadravasahitaṃ yakṣmā hantīti sambandhaḥ| ihetyasmin śāstre| śuklākṣatvādaya ‘ekaikaśo'pyasādhyalakṣaṇāni’ iti pā.| ekaikaśo'pyalakṣaṇāni boddhavyāni||8-12||

div.ab: jvarānubandharahitaṃ balavantaṃ kriyāsaham | upakramedātmavantaṃ dīptāgnimakṛśaṃ naram ||13|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

ab.seg: cikitsyatvamāha– jvaretyādi| upakramet cikitset| akṛśamityanena vayaḥstho'pi pratyākhyāyopakramyata iti sūcyate| yaduktamanyatra– “paraṃ dinasahasraṃ tu yadi jīvati mānavaḥ| subhiṣagbhirupakrāntastaruṇaḥ śoṣapīḍitaḥ||” iti||13||

atha cikitsyamāha– ‘jvaretyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | jvaredityādi| ‘upakramedātmavantaṃ dīptāgnimakṛśaṃ naram| śuklākṣamannadveṣṭāramūrdhaśvāsanipīḍitām|| kṛcchreṇa bahumahantaṃ yakṣmā hantīha mānavam||’ iti pā.| upakramediti| upakramet cikitset| akṛśamityanena vayastho'pi pratyākhyāyopakramya iti sūcyate| yaduktamanyatra– “paraṃ dinasahasraṃ tu yadi jīvati mānavaḥ| subhiṣagbhirupakrāntastaruṇaḥ śoṣapīḍitaḥ” iti||13||

div.ab: vyavāyaśokavārdhakyavyāyāmādhvapraśoṣitān | vraṇoraḥkṣatasañjñau ca śoṣiṇau lakṣaṇaiḥ śṛṇu ||14|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

ab.seg: vyavāyādijanitadhātuśoṣaṇamātreṇa rājayakṣmatvaṃ ‘nirasannāha’ iti pā.| nirasyannāha– vyavāyetyādi| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “keṣāñcidevaṃ śoṣo hi ‘lakṣaṇaibheda ... ’ iti pā.| kāraṇairbhedamāgataḥ| ‘na tatra doṣaliṅgānām’ ityasya sthāne ‘na tu tridoṣaliṅgānām’ iti pā.| na tatra doṣaliṅgānāṃ samastānāṃ nipātanam|| kṣayā eva hi te jñeyāḥ ‘kevalam’ iti pā.| pratyekaṃ ‘dhātusañjñitāḥ’ iti pā.| dhātusaṅkṣayāt|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) iti| vṛddhasya bhāvo vārdhakyamiti svārthe ‘vyañjiti’ iti pā.| kya(ṣya)ñ” iti kārtikaḥ||14||

vyavāyādijanitaśoṣamātreṇa rājayakṣmatvaṃ nirasyannāha– ‘vyavāyetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vyavāyetyādi| vyavāyaḥ strīsevā, śokaḥ putrādiviyogena cittodvegaḥ, vārdhakyaṃ vṛddhatvaṃ, vyāyāmaḥ śarīrāyāsajananaṃ, ‘adhvā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | adhvā dīrghamārgāṭanaṃ, vraṇaṃ kṣatam, uraḥkṣatamurontarabhighātajanitavraṇam| yakṣmaṇo etacca– ‘yakṣmaṇo lakṣaṇaiḥ śṛṇu’ iti pā.| lakṣaṇairiti talliṅgaiḥ, na tu ‘yakṣmaiva’ iti pā.| yakṣma vai; yaduktaṃ suśrute– “keṣāñcidevaṃ śoṣo hi kāraṇairbhedamāgataḥ| ‘na tatra doṣaliṅgānām’ ityasya sthāne ‘na tu tridoṣaliṅgānām’ iti pā.| na tatra doṣaliṅgānāṃ samastānāṃ nipātanam|| kṣayā eva hi te jñeyāḥ pratyekaṃ dhātusaṅkṣayāt” iti||14||

div.ab: vyavāyaśoṣī śukrasya kṣayaliṅgairupadrutaḥ | pāṇḍudeho yathāpūrvaṃ kṣīyante cāsya dhātavaḥ ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

ab.seg: vyavāyaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamāha– vyavāyetyādi| śukrasya kṣayaliṅgairiti suśrutoktaiḥ| tadyathā– “śukrakṣaye meḍhravṛṣaṇavedanā, aśaktirmaithune, cirādvā prasekaḥ, praseke ‘cālpadarśanaṃ raktasyaśukrasya vā’ iti pā.| cālparaktaśukradarśanam|” (su. sū. a. 15) iti||15||

vyavāyaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamāha– vyavāyetyādi| śukrakṣayaliṅgairiti suśrutoktaiḥ “śukrakṣaye meḍhravṛṣaṇavedanā'śaktirmaithune cirādvā ‘prasekaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prasekaḥ, praseke cālpaśukradarśanaṃ raktasya ca” iti| yathāpūrvaṃ dhātavaḥ kṣīyante; tatra śukrasya pūrvo majjā, majjño'sthi asthno medaḥ medaso māṃsaṃ māṃsasya raktamityevaṃ paraṃ yadi strībhyo na nivartate||15||

div.ab: pradhyānaśīlaḥ srastāṅgaḥ śokaśoṣyapi tādṛśaḥ |16| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

śokaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamāha– pradhyānetyādinā| śokaśoṣyapi tādṛśa iti śukrasya kṣayalakṣaṇavyatiriktena śukraśoṣaliṅgena yuktaḥ; yaduktaṃ suśrute– “vinā śukrakṣayakṛtairvikārairupalakṣitaḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) iti|16|–

śokaśoṣamāha– pradhyānaśīlaḥ cintāparaḥ, srastāṅgaḥ avasannagātraḥ, tādṛśa iti ‘pāṇḍudehaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pāṇḍudehaḥ| ‘śukrakṣayalakṣaṇavyatiriktasya’ iti pā., etacca– vināśukrakṣayakṛtairvikārairupalakṣita ityadhikaḥ pāṭhaśca| śukrakṣayalakṣaṇavyatiriktaiḥ ‘śukrakṣayalakṣaṇaiḥ’ iti pā.| śukraśoṣilakṣaṇairyuktaḥ|16|–

jarāśoṣī kṛśo mandavīryabuddhibalendriyaḥ ||16|| kampano'rucimān bhinnakāṃsyapātrahatasvaraḥ | ṣṭhīvati śleṣmaṇā hīnaṃ ‘gauravārucipīḍitaḥ’ iti pā. | gauravāratipīḍitaḥ ||17|| ‘ ... nāsākṣaḥ’ iti pā. | samprasrutāsyanāsākṣiḥ śuṣkarūkṣamalacchaviḥ | (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

vārdhakyaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamāha– jaretyādi| kampanaḥ kampayuktaḥ| bhinnasya ‘bhagnasya’ iti pā.| sphuṭitasya kāṃsyapātrasya hatasya daṇḍādineva svaro yasya sa tathā| ṣṭhīvati śleṣmaṇā hīnamiti śleṣmaharaṇāya ‘bale’ iti pā.| yatne kṛte'pi na śleṣmaniḥsaraṇam atra kvacitpustake ‘punararucigrahaṇamatyantārocakakhyāpanārtham’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate|| śuṣkarūkṣamalacchaviriti śuṣkarūkṣe yathākramaṃ malacchavī yasya sa tathā||16-17||–

jarāśoṣiṇamāha– jaretyādi| mandaśabdo vīryādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, balamojo hṛdi sthitaṃ saptadhātūnāṃ dhāma| kampanaḥ kampayuktaḥ| bhinnasya sphuṭitasya kāṃsyapātrasya daṇḍādinā hatasyeva svaro yasya sa tathā| ṣṭhīvati śleṣmaṇā hīnamiti śleṣmaharaṇāya bale kṛte'pi na śleṣmaniḥsaraṇam| arucipīḍita etacca– ‘gauravārucipīḍita’ iti pā.| iti punararocakagrahaṇamatyantamarocakatākhyāpanārtham| samprasrutaśabda āsyādibhiḥ sambadhyate| āsyaṃ mukhakuharam, akṣi locanam| śuṣkarūkṣamalacchaviriti śuṣkarūkṣe yathākramaṃ malacchavī yasya sa tathā||16-17||–
adhvaśoṣī ca srastāṅgaḥ sambhṛṣṭaparuṣacchaviḥ ||18|| prasuptagātrāvayavaḥ śuṣkaklomagalānanaḥ | (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

adhvaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamāha– adhvetyādi| sambhṛṣṭasyeva bharjitasyeva ‘paruṣā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | paruṣā chaviḥ varṇo yasya sa tathā| prasuptaḥ sparśānabhijñaḥ| kloma pipāsāsthānaṃ ‘hṛdaye’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | hṛdaye, klomasthāne tālviti pāṭhāntaram||18||–

adhvaśoṣiṇamāha– ‘srastāṅga iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | srastāṅga iti| srastāṅgaḥ śithilagātraḥ| sambhṛṣṭasyeva bharjitasyeva chavirvarṇo yasya sa tathā| prasuptagātrāvayava iti prasuptaḥ sparśānabhijñaḥ akarmaṇyaḥ śarīrapradeśo yasya tathoktaḥ| śuṣkaśabdaḥ klomādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, kloma pipāsāsthānaṃ hṛdaye, klomasthāne tālviti pāṭhāntaram| yadyapi yathoddeśaṃ jarāśoṣyanantaraṃ vyāyāmaśoṣī vācyo nādhvaśoṣī, tathā'pyadhvaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇānāṃ vyāyāmaśoṣiṇyatideśāt ‘pūrvamannādhvaśoṣī’ iti pā.| pūrvamatrādhvaśoṣī nirdiṣṭaḥ| yadyevaṃ tarhi vyāyāmaśoṣilakṣaṇānyeva kuto'dhvaśoṣiṇi nātidiśyante| satyam, uraḥkṣataliṅgānāmadhikānāṃ vyāyāmaśoṣiṇi sadbhāvāt| athoddeśa evādhvaśoṣī kasmānnādāvukta iti cet– chandonurodhāt| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kecidatra tṛḍhaṅagabalapāruṣyāratitodanairiti paṭhanti tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ||18||–
vyāyāmaśoṣī bhūyiṣṭhamebhireva samanvitaḥ | liṅgairuraḥkṣatakṛtaiḥ saṃyuktaśca kṣataṃ vinā ||19|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

ab.seg: vyāyāmaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamāha– vyāyāmetyādi| ebhiriti srastāṅgatvādibhiradhvaśoṣalakṣaṇaiḥ, adhvano ‘vyāyāmamātrasāmyatvāt’ iti pā.| vyāyāmamātrasāmānyāt| bhūyiṣṭham atyartham, adhvaśoṣe'lpāni lakṣaṇāni, vyāyāmaje tu mahāntītyarthaḥ| ‘tathā ‘uraḥkṣatakṛtairliṅgaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ kṣatavarjitaiḥ’ iti sugamaḥ pāṭhaḥ’ ityasya sthāne ‘tathā sa evoraḥkṣatairliṅgaiḥ saha yuktaḥ kṣataṃ vineti iti sugamaḥ pāṭhaḥ’ iti pā.| tathā ‘uraḥkṣatakṛtairliṅgaiḥ saṃyuktaḥ kṣatavarjitaiḥ’ iti sugamaḥ pāṭhaḥ| gadādharastu– “liṅgairuraḥkṣatakṛtaḥ saṃyuktaśca kṣataṃ vinā|” iti paṭhati, vyācaṣṭe ca– uraḥkṣatena vyāyāmabhārādhyayanadrutayānādihetunā yaḥ kṛtaḥ śoṣaḥ so'pyebhirevādhvaśoṣaliṅgairbhūyiṣṭhaṃ saṃyuktaḥ, kṣataṃ kṣatakāryaṃ vinā| kṣatakāryaṃ tu suśrute yathā– “tasyorasi kṣate raktaṃ pūyaḥ śleṣmā ca gacchati|” ityārabhya “bhinnavarṇasvaro naraḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) ityantametānyeva lakṣaṇāni kṣate'dhikāni, uraḥkṣatakāraṇavyāyāmabhārādikṛtaśoṣasya lakṣaṇameva bhūyiṣṭhaṃ yattadevoraḥkṣatakāraṇamātratvādadhvano'pītyarthaḥ| athavā kṣataṃ vinā vraṇaṃ vinā, uraḥkṣatanimittabhārādhyayanādinā'mātreṇa yaḥ kṛtaḥ śoṣaḥ so'pyebhirevātyarthādhvaśoṣaliṅgaiḥ samanvita iti prakṛtena sambandhaḥ; savraṇasya tu vakṣyamāṇameva lakṣaṇamiti||19||

vyāyāmaśoṣiṇo lakṣaṇamāha– vyāyāmetyādi| ebhiriti| srastāṅgatvādibhiranantaroktairevādhvapraśoṣilakṣaṇaiḥ; bhūyiṣṭhamatyartham, adhvaśoṣe alpāni liṅgāni vyāyāmaje tu mahāntītyarthaḥ| ‘sa evoraḥkṣatakṛtaiḥ samprayukta’ iti sugamaḥ pāṭhaḥ| gadādharastu– ‘ ‘liṅgairuraḥkṣatakṛtaiḥ’ iti pā.| liṅgairuraḥkṣatakṛtaḥ saṃyuktaśca kṣataṃ vinā’ iti paṭhati; vyācaṣṭe ca– uraḥkṣatena vyāyāmabhārādhyayanadrutapṛṣṭhayānādihetunā yaḥ kṛtaḥ śoṣaḥ so'pyebhirevādhvaśoṣaliṅgairbhūyiṣṭhaṃ saṃyuktaḥ| kṣataṃ vinā kṣatakāryaṃ vinā, kṣatakāryaṃ tu suśrute yathā– “tasyorasi kṣate raktaṃ pūyaḥ śleṣmā ca gacchati| “kāsamānaśchardayecca pītaraktāsitāruṇam|| santaptavakṣāḥ so'tyarthaṃ dūyanātparitāmyati|| durgandhocchvāsavadano bhinnavarṇasvaro naraḥ” iti||19||

div.ab: raktakṣayādvedanābhistathaivāhārayantraṇāt | vraṇitasya bhavecchoṣaḥ sa cāsādhyatamo mataḥ ||20|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 41) |

ab.seg: kāraṇatrayeṇa ‘vraṇaśoṣalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| vraṇaśoṣiṇamāha– raktakṣayādityādi| vedanā vraṇavedanāḥ, ‘abhirapi ... ’ iti pā.| tābhirbhayaśokavanmanaḥkṣobhādvātaprakopādeva śoṣaḥ| sa cāsādhyatama iti svārthikastamap, yathā “yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śreṣṭhatamaḥ kurūṇām|” iti| atreṣṭhanaivātiśāyikapratyayena praśastatamatvasya pratipāditatvāt; athavā ‘ ... tamatvena’ iti pā.| yāpyāpekṣayā'sādhyatamaśabdena pratyākhyeya ucyate, yāpyasyāpyasādhyarūpatvāt| nanu, evaṃ sati “kṛśānāṃ vraṇaśoṣiṇām| bṛṃhaṇīyo vidhiḥ kāryaḥ” (su. ci. a. 1) iti suśrutenaivoktaṃ cikitsitasthāne virudhyate? ucyate– prabalaśoṣe pratyākhyeyatvaṃ, nātiprabale tu cikitsāvidhānamiti samarthanīyam| candrikākārastu ‘sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityasya sthāne “yāpyāsādhyatamastu saḥ” iti paṭhati, cikitsāyāṃ ‘bṛṃhaṇavidherabhidānāt’ iti pā.| bṛṃhaṇavidherabhidhānāditi||20||

vraṇaśoṣiṇamāha– raktetyādi| raktātisruteḥ, vedanāḥ vraṇavedanāḥ, tābhirapi bhayaśokavanmanaḥkṣobhādvātaprakopādeva śoṣaḥ; sa cāsādhyatamaḥ, atha vā yāpyāpekṣayā asādhyatamaḥ; asādhyatamaśabdena pratyākhyeya ucyate, yāpyasyāpyasādhyarūpatvāt| evaṃ sati “kṛśānāṃ vraṇaśoṣiṇām| bṛṃhaṇīyo vidhiḥ kāryaḥ” iti suśrutenaivoktam| tathā ca prabalaśoṣe pratyākhyeyatvaṃ, nātiprabale cikitsāvidhānamiti||20||

div.ab: dhanuṣā''yasyato'tyarthaṃ bhāramudvahato gurum | yudhyamānasya balibhiḥ patato viṣamoccataḥ ||21|| vṛṣaṃ hayaṃ vā dhāvantaṃ damyaṃ vā'nyaṃ nigṛhṇataḥ | śilākāṣṭhāśmanirghātān kṣipato nighnataḥ parān ||22|| adhīyānasya vā'tyuccairdūraṃ vā vrajato drutam | mahānadīrvā tarato hayairvā saha dhāvataḥ ||23|| sahasotpatato dūraṃ tūrṇaṃ vā'pi pranṛtyataḥ | tathā'nyaiḥ karmabhiḥ krūrairbhṛśamabhyāhatasya vā ||24|| vikṣate vakṣasi vyādhirbalavān samudīryate | strīṣu cātiprasaktasya rūkṣālpapramitāśinaḥ ||25|| uro ‘virujyate'tyartham’ iti pā. | vibhajyate'tyarthaṃ bhidyate'tha ‘vibhajyate’ iti pā. | virujyate | prapīḍyate tataḥ pārśve śuṣyatyaṅgaṃ pravepate ||26|| kramādvīryaṃ balaṃ varṇo ruciragniśca hīyate | jvaro vyathā manodainyaṃ viḍbhedāgnivadhāvapi ||27|| duṣṭaḥ śyāvaḥ sudurgandhaḥ pīto vigrathito bahuḥ | kāsamānasya cābhīkṣṇaṃ kaphaḥ sāsṛk pravartate ||28|| sa kṣatī kṣīyate'tyarthaṃ tathā śukraujasoḥ kṣayāt | (ca. ci. a. 16) |

ab.seg: śoṣanidānenaiva sāhasādinā uraḥkṣatasya sambhavāt, uraḥkṣatenāpi śoṣasambhavāt, śoṣādhikāre sanidānamuraḥkṣatamāha– dhanuṣetyādi| āyasyata iti āyāsaṃ kurvato ‘narasya’ atra ‘iti śeṣaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| iti śeṣaḥ, ‘āyamyataḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare vistīryamāṇahṛdayasya| damyaṃ damanārhaṃ vṛṣādikameva balavantamityarthaḥ| anyaṃ vā gajoṣṭrādikaṃ, nigṛhṇataḥ vidhārayataḥ| śilā dīrghaśilā, aśmā ‘parvatādiprastarakhaṇḍaḥ’ iti pā.| taditaraprastarakhaṇḍaḥ, nirghāto'straviśeṣaḥ, kiṃvā nirghātaḥ śilādīnāṃ preraṇaviśeṣo'tibalasampāditaḥ| nighnataḥ parān śatrūn tāḍayataḥ| adhīyānasya paṭhataḥ| mahānadīstarata iti ‘bāhubhyām’ iti śeṣaḥ| tūrṇaṃ śīghram| tathā'nyaiḥ karmabhiḥ krūrairmallayuddhādibhirabhyāhatasya, ‘krūrairityatra śūrairiti’ ityasya sthāne ‘krūrairiti’ iti pā.| krūrairityatra śūrairiti śatrubhirityanye| eṣāṃ kāraṇānāṃ madhye kiñcinnikhiladehasyāyāsakaraṃ, kiñcidurasa eveti boddhavyam| vyādhiriti uraḥkṣatalakṣaṇaḥ; athavā vyādhirvāyuḥ, ‘doṣā api vyādhiśabdaṃ labhanta’ ityāgamāditi jejjaṭaḥ| uro ‘virujyate’ iti pā.| vibhajyate bhajyata iva, bhidyate ‘vidīryate’ iti pā.| vidāryate ‘vibhajyate’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vibhajyate dvidhā kriyata iva; ‘vidahyate’ iti pāṭhāntaramasaṅgataṃ, kāraṇābhāvāt ṭīkākārairavyākhyātatvācca| vīryaṃ śaktiḥ| balaṃ māṃsopacayaḥ| ‘viḍbhedo'gnivadhādapi’ iti pāṭhāntare agnivadhāddhetorviḍbhedo bhavatītyarthaḥ; apiśabdāt vyādhimahimnā vinā'pyagnivadhādviḍbhedo bhavatītyāhuḥ| duṣṭo vyāpannaḥ; tadeva vivṛṇoti– śyāva ityādi| vigrathito ‘viśeṣeṇa granthilaḥ’ ityasya sthāne ‘viśeṣād grathitaḥ’ iti pā.| viśeṣeṇa granthilaḥ, ‘vibaddha’ iti jejjaṭaḥ| sa puruṣaḥ, kṣatī uraḥkṣatavān, kṣīyate dhātuśoṣamāpnoti| na kevalaṃ kṣatādeva kṣīyate, kiṃ tarhi strīsevādinā śukraujasoḥ kṣayādapītyāha– tathetyādi||21-28||

div.ab: sanidānamuraḥkṣatamāha– dhanuṣetyādi| ‘āyasyataḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | āyasyataḥ āyāsaṃ ‘kurvato’ iti pā.| kurvataḥ, ‘narasya’ iti śeṣaḥ| ‘āyamyata’ iti pāṭhāntare vistāryamāṇahṛdayasya| damyaṃ damanārhaṃ vṛṣādikameva balavattaramityarthaḥ, athavā gajoṣṭrādikaṃ; nigṛhṇato vidhārayataḥ| śilā dīrghapāṣāṇaḥ; aśma taditaraprastarakhaṇḍaḥ, nirghāto'straviśeṣaḥ, kiṃ vā śilādinā preraṇaviśeṣo'tibalasampāditaḥ| tān kṣipataḥ| parān śatrūn| adhīyānasya uccaiḥ paṭhataḥ| dūraṃ vā vrajato drutamiti śīghraṃ dūraṃ gacchataḥ| mahānadīṃ tarataḥ ‘bāhubhyām’ iti śeṣaḥ| tūrṇaṃ śīghramatinṛtyataḥ| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | anyaiḥ karmabhiḥ krūrairiti mallayuddhādibhirabhyāhatasya, śūrairiti śatrubhirityanye| vikṣate vidārite, vakṣasi hṛdi| vyādhiriti uraḥkṣatalakṣaṇaḥ, athavā vyādhirvāyuḥ, doṣā api vyādhiśabdaṃ labhante ityāgamāditi jejjaṭaḥ| balavān samudīryate utkaṭa utpadyate| uraḥkṣatakṣīṇatve'paramapi kāraṇamāha– strīṣvityādi| rūkṣaṃ caṇakādiḥ, alpaṃ stokaṃ, pramitamakālabhojanam| uro virujyate rujyata iva bhidyata iva śūlena, vibhajyate dvidhā kriyata, iva ‘vidahyate’ iti pāṭhāntaram| vīryaṃ śaktiḥ, balaṃ māṃsopacayalakṣaṇaṃ, varṇo gaurādiḥ, vyathā aṅgānāṃ, manodainyaṃ manoglāniḥ, agnivadho'gnyabhāvaḥ, ‘viḍbhedo'gnivadhādapi’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca– agnivadhāddhetorviḍbhedo bhavatītyarthaḥ; apiśabdādvāyādhimahimnā vinā'pyagnivadhāt viḍbhedo bhavatītyāhuḥ| duṣṭo vyāpannaḥ, vigrathito viśeṣāt granthilaḥ, vinibaddha iti jejjaṭaḥ| kaphaḥ etacca– ‘sāsram’ iti pā. sāsraḥ pravartate iti rudhirayuktaṃ kaphaṃ ṣṭhīvate, ‘sāsram’ ityatra ‘sāndra’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra sāndro ghanaḥ| ebhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ, sakṣataḥ kṣatavān; ‘sa tata’ iti pāṭhe sa puruṣaḥ, tata uraḥkṣatāt; atyarthaṃ kṣīyate dhātuśoṣamāpnotītyarthaḥ| na kevalaṃ kṣatādeva kṣīyate kiṃ tarhi strīsevādinā śukraujasoḥ kṣayādapi||21-28||–

ab.seg: avyaktaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ tasya pūrvarūpamiti smṛtam ||29||
pūrvarūpamāha– avyaktamityādi| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasya kṣatasya lakṣaṇamavyaktamaprakaṭam||29||
pūrvarūpamāha– agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣatakṣīṇayorasādhāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇamidam| tasya kṣatasya lakṣaṇamavyaktamaprakaṭam||29||

div.ab: uroruk śoṇitacchardiḥ kāso vaiśeṣikaḥ kṣate | kṣīṇe saraktamūtratvaṃ pārśvapṛṣṭhakaṭīgrahaḥ ||30|| (ca. ci. a. 16) |

ab.seg: kṣatakṣīṇayorasādhāraṇalakṣaṇamāha– urorugityādi| vaiśeṣiko viśiṣṭaḥ kāsaḥ; sa ca viśeṣa ukto duṣṭaśyāvādikaphasaṃyuktatvaṃ; kiṃvā vaiśeṣika udbhūtaḥ| kṣata iti chedaḥ| ‘kṣīṇe iti kṣaye’ ityasya sthāne ‘kṣīṇa iti kṣaya’ iti pā.| kṣīṇe iti kṣaye ityarthaḥ| ‘saraktamūtratvam ālohitamūtratā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saraktamūtratvam ālohitamūtratā||30||

kṣatakṣīṇayorasādhāraṇamāha– urorugityādi| kṣate uraḥkṣate| kāso vaiśeṣika iti viśiṣṭaḥ kāsaḥ kṣīṇakāsāpekṣayā adhika ityarthaḥ| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣīṇasya rūpamāha– kṣaya iti| śukraujasoḥ kṣaye tu saraktamūtrādirupadravaḥ| vaiśeṣikaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ kāsa iti asmin lakṣaṇe sambadhyate||30||

div.ab: alpaliṅgasya dīptāgneḥ sādhyo balavato navaḥ | parisaṃvatsaro yāpyaḥ sarvaliṅgaṃ tu varjayet ||31|| (ca. ci. a. 16) |

ab.seg: tayoḥ sādhyalakṣaṇamāha– alpetyādi||31||
uraḥkṣate sādhyayāpyāsādhyatvamāha– alpetyādi| alpaliṅgasya alpalakṣaṇasya||31||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne rājayakṣmakṣatakṣīṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||10||
iti śrīvijarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ rājayakṣmakṣatakṣīṇanidānaṃ samāptam||10||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāne rājyakṣmanidānam||10||

div.head: kāsanidānam
div.ab: atha kāsanidānam | dhūmopaghātādrasatastathaiva vyāyāmarūkṣānnaniṣevaṇācca | vimārgagatvācca hi bhojanasya vegāvarodhāt kṣavathostathaiva ||1|| prāṇo hyudānānugataḥ praduṣṭaḥ sa bhinnakāṃsyasvanatulyaghoṣaḥ | nireti vaktrāt sahasā sadoṣo manīṣibhiḥ kāsa iti pradiṣṭaḥ ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 52) |

ab.seg: kṣayarūpe kāsapāṭhāt kāsopekṣayā ca ‘kṣayotpattiḥ atastadanantaram’ iti pā.| kṣayotpattestadanantaraṃ kāsanidānamāha– dhūmopaghātādityādi| dhūmena mukhanāsāpraviṣṭenopaghāto dhūmopaghātaḥ| rasata iti vātenordhvaṃ nītādāmarasāt, ‘rajasa’ iti pāṭhāntare mukhanāsāpraviṣṭadhūlerityarthaḥ| ‘vimārgagatvācca’ iti pā.| vimārgagatvaṃ ca hi bhojanasyātidrutābhyavahārādinā| caśabdaḥ samuccaye, hi pādapūraṇe| vegāvarodhāditi purīṣādeḥ, tena hi vāyurūrdhvagaḥ syāt| kṣavathostathaiveti vegāvarodhāditi sambandhaḥ| prāṇo vāyurudānena duṣṭenānugato vaktrānnireti| sa vāyuḥ, bhinnakāṃsyapātravat hatasvanaḥ kāsa iti pradiṣṭaḥ| sadoṣaḥ sakaphapittaḥ, ‘vātikapaittikādibhedādbhinna’ iti pā.| vātikapaittikādibhedabhinna iti vā| etenaiva samānasthānanidānābhyāṃ hikkāśvāsābhyāmasya bhedaḥ, na hi tatra vātikapaittikādibhedena vyapadeśa iti gadādharaḥ| kasati śiraḥkaṇṭhādūrdhvaṃ gacchati vāyuriti kāsaḥ, ‘kasa’ gatau ityasmāt; ‘kasanāt kāsaḥ’ (ca. ci. a. 18) iti carake pāṭhaḥ; kāsanaṃ kāsa iti vā, “bhinnasvaraḥ kāsati śuṣkameva” (su. u. taṃ. a. 52) iti suśrutadarśanāt||1-2||

kṣayarūpe kāsapāṭhāt tadanantaraṃ kāsanidānamāha– dhūmetyādi| dhūmena mukhanāsāpraviṣṭena upaghāto dhūmopaghātaḥ, etacca– ‘dhūmopaghātādrajaseti’ iti pā.| rajaseti rajasā mukhanāsāpraviṣṭena tathaiva, ‘rasataḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra raso jalaṃ, vyāyāma āyāsaḥ, rūkṣānnaṃ caṇakādi, vimārgagatvāditi bhojanasya atidrutābhyavahārādinā, vegāvarodhāditi ‘sambandhaḥ’ iti pā.| purīṣādeḥ| tasya samprāptimāha– prāṇa ityādi| prāṇo vāyurduṣṭaḥ udānena duṣṭenānuyātaḥ vaktrānnireti gacchati, sa doṣo rogaḥ kāsa iti pradiṣṭaḥ| kārye kāraṇopacārāt doṣe rogaḥ iti sañjñā| kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ sa doṣaḥ? bhinnakāṃsyapātrasvanaḥ bhagnakāṃsyapātrasvanaḥ, sa vātapittakaphabhedairbhinna iti tasya niruktiḥ| kāsa iti ‘ ‘dīptyarthakadantyasakāraghaṭitakāsṛdhātoranupalabdheḥ, antarbhāvitaṇijarthasyāvaśyakatvāt, pramāṇabhūtasuśrutavākyavyavahitatvāt tatrakutsitaśabdārthakakāsṛdhātorabhyupagamāt gatyarthasādhaka ‘kasa’ dhātorvartamānatvācca cintya iva pratibhātyayaṃ granthaḥ’ iti pā.| kāsṛ’ dīptau, ityasmāddhātoḥ, ‘kāsatiḥ anekārthatvātprāptyarthaḥ apratyayāntaḥ śiraḥ kaṇṭhasyordhvagatiṃ vāyu nayati|’ iti pā.| apratyayāntaḥ; anekārthatvātprāptyarthaḥ; kasati śiraḥkaṇṭhādūrdhvaṃ gacchati vāyuriti kāsaḥ ‘kasa’ gatāviti dhātuḥ| athavā kāsanaṃ kāsa iti ghañaḥ “kasanāt” kāsa iti carakapāṭhāt atra ‘kasagatāviti dhātuḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| “bhinnasvaraḥ kāsati śuṣkameva” iti suśrutavacanam||1-2||

div.ab: pañca kāsāḥ smṛtā vātapittaśleṣmakṣatakṣayaiḥ | kṣayāyopekṣitāḥ sarve balinaścottarottaram ||3|| (a. hṛ. ni. a. 3) |

ab.seg: saṅkhyāmāha– pañcetyādi| pañca kāsā iti saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ pañcagrahaṇaṃ jarākāsasya doṣajeṣvantarbhūtasyādhikatvanirāsārthaṃ, pañcānāmapi vā kṣayakāraṇatvapratipādanārthamiti| kṣayāya dhātukṣayāya||3||

tasya saṅkhyāmāha– pañcetyādi| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ pañcagrahaṇaṃ jarākāsasya doṣajeṣvevāntarbhūtasyādhikatvanirāsārtham| upekṣitāste apratikriyamāṇāḥ kṣayāya dhātukṣayāya bhavanti; uttarottaramiti vātātpaittikaḥ, paittikāt ślaiṣmikaḥ, tasmātkṣatajo balī, tasmāt kṣayajaḥ||3||

div.ab: pūrvarūpaṃ bhavetteṣāṃ śūkapūrṇagalāsyatā | kaṇṭhe kaṇḍūśca bhojyānāmavarodhaśca jāyate ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 22) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpamāha– pūrvetyādi| bhojyānāmavarodha iti arucirabhyavahārāsāmarthyaṃ vā||4||
tasya pūrvarūpamāha– pūrvarūpamityādi| śūko dhānyāgrasūkṣmakaṇṭakākāraḥ| bhojyānāmavarodha iti abhyavaharaṇāsāmarthyam ||4||

div.ab: hṛcchaṅkhamūrdhodarapārśvaśūlī kṣāmānanaḥ kṣīṇabalasvaraujāḥ | prasaktavegastu samīraṇena bhinnasvaraḥ kāsati śuṣkameva ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 52) |

ab.seg: vātikakāsasvarūpamāha– hṛdityādi| śaṅkho lalāṭaikadeśaḥ| kṣāmānanaḥ śuṣkamukhaḥ, vātena śoṣaṇāt| prasaktavegaḥ satatakāsavegaḥ| śuṣkamiti śleṣmādiniṣṭhīvanarahitam||5||

vātikakāsarūpamāha– hṛdityādi| śaṅkho lalāṭaikadeśaḥ| kṣāmānanaḥ śuṣkamukhaḥ, vātaśoṣaṇāt| ‘kṣīṇabalasvaraujā iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣīṇabalasvaraujā iti kṣīṇaṃ balaṃ svara ‘ojo’ iti pā.| ojaśca yasya sa tathā| prasaktavegaḥ satatakāsavegaḥ| bhinnasvaraḥ dvidhākṛta iva| śuṣkamiti śleṣmaniṣṭhīvanarahitam||5||

div.ab: urovidāhajvaravaktraśoṣairabhyarditastiktamukhastṛṣārtaḥ | pittena pītāni vamet kaṭūni kāset sapāṇḍuḥ paridahyamānaḥ ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 52) |

ab.seg: paittikakāsamāha– ura ityādi| abhyarditaḥ pīḍitaḥ||6||

paittikamāha– ‘urovidāhetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | urovidāhetyādi| etairupadravaiḥ abhyarditaḥ pīḍitaḥ| pītāni vamet pittaṃ kaphasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ niṣṭhīvati; uktaṃ ca tantrāntare– “śleṣmāṇaṃ pittasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ niṣṭhīvati ca paittikaḥ” iti| pāṇḍunā saha vartata iti sapāṇḍuḥ, etena nayanādīnāmapi pāṇḍutvamuktam| paridahyamānaḥ dāhapariplutaḥ||6||

div.ab: pralipyamānena mukhena sīdan śirorujārtaḥ kaphapūrṇadehaḥ | abhaktaruggauravakaṇḍuyuktaḥ kāsedbhṛśaṃ sāndrakaphaḥ kaphena ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 52) |

ab.seg: kaphajakāsamāha– pralipyamānenetyādi| pralipyamānena śleṣmaliptena mukhenopalakṣitaḥ, sīdan ‘avasādayuktaḥ’ iti pā.| aṅgāvasādayuktaḥ| abhaktaruk aruciḥ||7||

kaphajamāha– pralipyamānena ‘kaphenopalakṣitaḥ’ iti pā.| kaphopaliptena mukhenopalakṣitaḥ, sīdan sādayuktaḥ, abhaktaruk aruciḥ, kaphapūrṇadehatvādgauravaṃ, kaṇḍūḥ kaṇṭhasyaiva, sāndrakaphaḥ ‘ghanaśleṣmaḥ’ iti pā.| ghanaśleṣmā||7||

div.ab: ativyavāyabhārādhvayuddhāśvagajavigrahaiḥ | rūkṣasyoraḥkṣataṃ vāyurgṛhītvā kāsamācaret ||8|| sa pūrvaṃ kāsate śuṣkaṃ tataḥ ṣṭhīvet saśoṇitam | kaṇṭhena rujatā'tyarthaṃ virugṇeneva corasā ||9|| sūcībhiriva tīkṣṇābhistudyamānena śūlinā | duḥkhasparśena śūlena bhedapīḍābhitāpinā ||10|| parvabhedajvaraśvāsatṛṣṇāvaisvaryapīḍitaḥ | pārāvata ivākūjan ‘kāsavegān’ iti pā. | kāsavegāt kṣatodbhavāt ||11|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 52) |

ab.seg: kṣatakāsamāha– ativyavāyetyādi| vigraho vidhāraṇaṃ yuddhasyopāttatvāt; ‘nigraha’ iti pāṭhe sa evārthaḥ| tataḥ ṣṭhīvet saśoṇitamiti kāsābhighātena ‘hṛdayavidāraṇāt’ iti pā.| hṛdayasya vidāraṇāt| kaṇṭheneti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, evamuraseti| virugṇeneva bhagneneva, sūcībhiriva tudyamānena, śūlinā duḥkhasparśena coraseti sambandhaḥ| duḥkhasparśatvaṃ sparśāsahatvam| śūlenopalakṣitaḥ, tacca pārśvādau bodhyam| vāgbhaṭenāpi paṭhyate– ‘pārśvaśūlī’ (vā. ni. a. 3) iti| bhedapīḍābhitāpineti śūlaviśeṣaṇam| pārāvata iva kūjan, bhavatīti śeṣaḥ||8-11||

kṣatakāsamāha– atītyādi| vigraho ‘vidāraṇam’ iti pā.| vidhāraṇaṃ, yuddhasyoktatvāt| etaiḥ kāraṇai rūkṣasya puruṣasya uraḥkṣataṃ gṛhītvā vāyuḥ etacca– ‘kāsamāvahet’ iti pā.| kāsamāvahet karoti| yuddhaṃ mallayuddhādikam| tataḥ ṣṭhīvet śoṇitamiti kāsābhighātena hṛdayasya vidāraṇāt| atyarthaṃ rujatā pīḍāyuktena, kaṇṭhenetyupalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, evamuraseti| virugṇeneva dvidheva vidīrṇena, tīkṣṇābhiḥ sūcībhiriva tudyamānena, śūlinā rujāyuktena atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|, duḥkhasparśena coraseti sambandhaḥ| duḥkhasparśatvaṃ sparśāsahatvam| śūlena copalakṣitaḥ, tacca pārśvādau boddhavyaṃ “pārśvaśūlī” iti vāgbhaṭena paṭhyamānatvāt| ‘bhedapīḍābhitāpinā’ iti śūlaviśeṣaṇam| pārāvata ivākūjan ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ||8-11||

div.ab: viṣamāsātmyabhojyātivyavāyādveganigrahāt | ghṛṇināṃ śocatāṃ nṝṇāṃ vyāpanne'gnau trayo malāḥ | kupitāḥ kṣayajaṃ kāsaṃ kuryurdehakṣayapradam ||12|| sa gātraśūlajvaradāhamohān prāṇakṣayaṃ copalabheta kāsī | ‘śuṣkam’ iti pā. | śuṣyan viniṣṭhīvati durbalastu prakṣīṇamāṃso rudhiraṃ sapūyam | taṃ sarvaliṅgaṃ bhṛśaduścikitsyaṃ cikitsitajñāḥ kṣayajaṃ vadanti ||13|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 52) |

ab.seg: kṣayajakāsamāha– viṣametyādi| ghṛṇināṃ śocatāṃ cāhārābhāvāt kupitena vāyunā'gneruplavāddoṣatrayaprakopa iti| kṣayajamiti śukrādidhātukṣayajaṃ, natu rājayakṣmajam| tridoṣaje'pi rājayakṣmaṇi kāsaḥ kaphenaiva kriyate| yaduktam– “kāsaḥ kaṇṭhasya coddhvaṃso vijñeyaḥ kaphakopataḥ|” iti; kṣayajakāsastu tridoṣaja iti| nanu, kāsādeva kṣayo jāyate tat kathaṃ ‘kṣayajakāsa’ iti pā.| kṣayajaḥ kāsa iti? uktaṃ hi– “kāsāt sañjāyate kṣayaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 8) iti| ucyate– dṛṣṭo hi parasparaṃ vyaktibhedena kāryakāraṇabhāvo bahuśaḥ, ‘ ... māndyādāya iti ’ iti pā.| yathā'tīsārārśognimāndyādāviti| ‘nanu’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nanu sa gātraśūletyādiślokārdhasya kṣayajakāsamadhye pāṭho'yuktaḥ pratibhāti, suśrute kṣatajakāse paṭhitatvāt; kṣayakāsaścātra ‘carakasuśrutavākye’ iti pā.| carakasuśrutavākye melayitvā mādhavakareṇa likhitaḥ; ucyate– sa gātraśūletyādyanantaraṃ kṣayakāsaḥ suśrutena paṭhitaḥ; tena ‘sagātraśūla’ ityādiślokārdhasya pareṇa sambandhāt ‘kṣayakāsatvamiti’ iti pā.| kṣayakāsaliṅgatvamiti mādhavakarasyābhiprāya; etaccānye nānumanyante, yataḥ ‘kṣatajakāsa ... ’ iti pā.| kṣatakāsasyāvasthāyāmasādhyatvakhyāpanaparametadvyākhyātaṃ jejjaṭena, gayadāsenāpi kṣatajakāsarūpatveneti||12-13||

kṣayajamāha– viṣametyādi| ghṛṇināṃ ghṛṇāṃ kurvatāṃ, śocatāṃ śokaṃ kurvatāṃ, puṃsāmagnau vypanne sati trayo malāḥ kupitāḥ santo dehakṣayapradaṃ kṣayajaṃ kāsaṃ kuryuḥ| kṣayajamiti raktādikṣayajam| asyopadravānāha-sa ityādi| sa kāsī gātraśūlādīn prāṇakṣayaṃ copalabheta| ‘śuṣkamiti’ iti pā.| śuṣyanniti pratidinaṃ śuṣyamāṇaḥ, durbalaḥ upacayarahitaḥ, prakṣīṇamāṃsastvagasthibhūtaḥ, sarvaliṅgamiti tridoṣaliṅgatvādasādhyam||12-13||

div.ab: ityeṣa kṣayajaḥ kāsaḥ kṣīṇānāṃ dehanāśanaḥ | sādhyo balavatāṃ vā ‘ ... stveva’ iti pā. | syādyāpyastvevaṃ kṣatotthitaḥ ||14|| navau kadācitsidhyetāmapi pādaguṇānvitau | sthavirāṇāṃ jarākāsaḥ sarvo yāpyaḥ prakīrtitaḥ | trīn pūrvān sādhayet sādhyān pathyairyāpyāṃstu yāpayet ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 52) |

ab.seg: asādhyatvādilakṣaṇamāha– itītyādi| pādaguṇānvitāviti vaidyādicatuṣpādasampannau| sthavirāṇāṃ vṛddhānāṃ; sthavirāṇāmityukte'pi jarāśabdopādānaṃ jarānimittadhātukṣayaja eva kāso yāpyaḥ, apacārajanitadoṣajastu sādhya iti bodhanārtham||14-15||

asādhyasādhyayāpyatvamāha– itītyādi| balavatāṃ kadācitsādhyo vā syādyāpyaśca, ‘kṣatajaḥ evam’ iti pā.| evaṃ kṣatajaḥ kadācitsādhyo ‘yāpyo vā’ ityasya sthāne ‘yāpyaḥ’ iti pā.| yāpyo vā| punaḥ sādhyatvamāha– navāvityādi| acirotthau kṣatakṣayajau dvau pādaguṇānvitau vaidyādicatuṣpādasampattiyuktau kadācit sidhyetāṃ sādhyau bhavata ityarthaḥ| yāpyatvamāha– sthavirāṇāmiti| vṛddhānām etasya doṣajeṣvantarbhūtatvānna pṛthaktvam| pañcānāmapi cikitsādvāreṇa sādhyayāpyatvamāha– trīniti| vātapittaśleṣmajān pathyaiḥ sādhayet, etena trayaḥ kāsāḥ sādhyā uktāḥ; aparān pathyairyāpayet yāpyatāṃ nayet| jarākāsā iti bahuvacanājjarākāsa ‘bahutvamiti jarākāsāḥ sarve yāpyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ’ iti pā., etacca– ‘jarākāsāḥ sarve yāpyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ’ iti vā pā.| upekṣitaḥ asādhyo bhavatīti ‘darśayati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | darśayati| “pūyābhamaruṇaṃ śyāvaṃ haritaṃ pītanīlakam| niṣṭhīvecchvāsakāsārto na jīvati hatasvaraḥ|| kāsaśvāsakṣayacchardisvarabhedādayo gadāḥ| bhavantyupekṣayā'sādhyāstasmāttān tvarayā jayet||” iti||14-15||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne kāsanidānaṃ samāptam ||11||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ kāsanidānaṃ samāptam||11||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspativiracite ātaṅkadarpaṇe rugviniścayavyākhyāne kāsanidānam||11||

div.head: hikkāśvāsanidānam
div.ab: atha hikkā-śvāsanidānam | vidāhiguruviṣṭambhirūkṣābhiṣyandibhojanaiḥ | śītapānāśanasthānarajodhūmātapānilaiḥ ||1|| vyāyāmakarmabhārādhvavegāghātāpatarpaṇaiḥ | hikkā śvāsaśca kāsaśca nṛṇāṃ samupajāyate ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 50) |

ab.seg: samānanidānatvāt kāsānantaraṃ hikkāśvāsau| nanu, eteṣāṃ prāyastulyanidānacikitsitatvenaikādhikāre kathamanabhidhānam? ucyate– yadyapi kāsaśvāsahikkānāṃ nidānaṃ samānaṃ, tathāpi kāsasya doṣabhedādbhedaḥ; yathā– vātikaḥ, paittikaḥ, ślaiṣmika ityādi; hikkāśvāsau tu kaphavātātmakāveva; yadāha dṛḍhabalaḥ– “kaphavātātmakāvetau pittasthānasamudbhavau|” (ca. ci. a. 17) iti| suśruto'pyāha– “vāyuḥ kaphenānugataḥ pañca hikkāḥ karoti hi|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 51) iti| bhedastvanayoḥ samprāptibhedādvegakriyādinā ca, natu kāsavaddoṣabhedena; śvāsakāsābhyāṃ hikkāyāḥ ‘svarato'pi’ iti pā.| svanato'pi bhedaḥ| pittasthānasamudbhavāviti viśeṣaṇaṃ suśrutamate kṣudrāṃ na prāpnoti, sā hi ‘jatrumūlāt pradhāvitā’ iti paṭhyate; carakamate tu vyapetāṃ na prāpnoti, sā'pi ‘jatrumūlādasantatā’ iti paṭhyate; tasmāt pittasthānasamudbhavāviti viśeṣaṇaṃ chatriṇo gacchantīti nyāyena bodhyam| śītaśabdaḥ pānādibhistribhiḥ sambadhyate| rajo dhūliḥ, sā ca dhūmavannāsādipraveśāt kāraṇam| vyāyāmakarma dhanurākarṣaṇādivyāpāraḥ, vegāghāto malādivegavidhāraṇam, apatarpaṇamanaśanādi| kāsaścokto'pyekanidānatvapratipādanārthaṃ punarabhihita iti||1-2||

div.ab: samānanidānatvātkāsanidānānantaraṃ hikkāśvāsāvāha– vidāhītyādi| vidāhīni yāntrikekṣurasamadyamaricādīni vidahanaśīlāni, gurūṇi guṇataḥ pākataśca, viṣṭambhīni caṇakādīni, abhiṣyandīni ābhimukhyena syandituṃ śīlaṃ yeṣāṃ tānyabhiṣyandanaśīlāni phāṇitamāṣamatsyakṣīrādīni| śītaśabdaḥ pānādibhistribhiḥ sambadhyate; rajo dhūliḥ, sā ca dhūmavat nāsādipraveśāt kāraṇam| vyāyāmakarma dhanurākarṣaṇādivyāpāraḥ, vegāghāto malādivegadhāraṇam, apatarpaṇamanaśanādi| atra ‘nanu’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| trayāṇāmekakāraṇatvena kathaṃ bhedaḥ? ucyate– doṣajanyabhedādbhedaḥ| kāso vātikaḥ, paittikaḥ, ślaiṣmikaśca; hikkāśvāsau tu kaphavātātmakāveva| yaduktaṃ dṛḍhabalena– “kaphavātātmakāvetau pittasthānasamudbhavau” iti| suśrute'pi– “vāyuḥ kaphenānugataḥ pañca hikkāḥ karoti hi” iti||1||2||
muhurmuhurvāyurudeti sasvano ‘yakṛtplihāntrāṇi’ iti pā. | yakṛtplīhāntrāṇi mukhādivākṣipan | sa ghoṣavānāśu hinastyasūn yatastatastu hikketyabhidhīyate budhaiḥ ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 50) |

ab.seg: hikkānāṃ svarūpaṃ niruktiṃ cāha– muhurmuhurityādi| vāyuratra sodānaḥ prāṇa ityāhuḥ| udeti ūrdhvaṃ gacchati| sasvana iti ‘hik’ iti śabdavān| ūrdhvagamanameva viśinaṣṭi– yakṛdityādi| atra ‘pliho’ iti pā.| pliheti ‘hrasvekāravān chando'nurodhāt’ iti pā.| hrasvekāraśchandonurodhāt| mukhāditi lyablope karmaṇi pañcamī, tena yakṛtplīhāntrāṇi mukhamānīya, ākṣipan niḥsārayannivetyarthaḥ| sa iti vāyuḥ| ‘hinastyasūn’ iti hikketi niruktiḥ pṛṣodarādinā rūpasiddhiḥ| ‘higiti kṛtvā kāyati śabdāyate iti ‘hikketi’ iti pā.| hikkā’ śābdikāḥ||3||

samprāptimāha– muhurmuhurityādi| vāyuriti, sodānaḥ prāṇo vāyuḥ sasvanaḥ śabdavān, muhurvāraṃvāram, udeti ūrdhvaṃ gacchati, ‘ūrdhvagamanatvāt’ iti pā.| ūrdhvagatatvāt| yakṛtplīhāntrāṇi mukhādivetyatra mukhaśabdena prāṇodakānnavāhīni srotāṃsi bhaṇyante; uktaṃ ca tantrāntare– “prāṇodakānnavāhīni srotāṃsi vikṛto'nilaḥ| hikkāḥ karoti saṃrudhya tāsāṃ liṅgaṃ pṛthakchṛṇu” iti| hikkāśabdo'tra dvirāvartayitavyaḥ; tena hikketi hikkāsvarūpakathanaṃ syāt, sa ghoṣavānityādinā hikkāniruktikathanamiti| sasvana ityanena gatatvāt sa ghoṣavānityabhidhānaṃ niruktipradarśanārtham| sa iti vāyuḥ, hinastyasūniti hikketi pṛṣodarāditvātsādhuḥ| higiti kṛtvā kāyati śabdāyate iti hikketi śābdikāḥ||3||

div.ab: annajāṃ yamalāṃ kṣudrāṃ gambhīrāṃ mahatīṃ tathā | vāyuḥ kaphenānugataḥ pañca hikkāḥ karoti hi ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 50) |

ab.seg: tāsāṃ bhedaṃ samprāptiṃ cāha– annajāmityādi| yamalaiva carake vyapeteti nāmnā paṭhitā, annapāne vyapete pariṇate ‘jāyete’ iti pā.| jāyate ityato hetoḥ; asyāṃ cānuktamapi yamalavegatvaṃ suśrutadarśanādvijñeyam| ‘annajādīnām’ iti pā.| annajāyāḥ sādhyatvena prāśastyāt pūrvamabhidhānam||4||
tāsāṃ bhedaṃ ‘samprāptimāha’ iti pā.| samprāptiṃ cāha– annajāmityādi| annajetyādīni tāsāṃ nāmāni||4||

div.ab: kaṇṭhorasorgurutvaṃ ca vadanasya kaṣāyatā | hikkānāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi kukṣerāṭopa eva ca ||5|| (ca. ci. a. 21) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpamāha– ‘kaṇṭhetyādi’ iti pā.| kaṇṭhorasorityādi| vadanasya kaṣāyatā vātāt, natu kaphānmādhuryaṃ, vyādhiprabhāvāt||5||
pūrvarūpamāha– kaṇṭha ityādi| vadanasya kaṣāyatā vātāt, na tu ‘kaphāt, mādhuryam’ iti pā.| kaphānmādhuryaṃ; vyādhiprabhāvāt| kukṣerudarasya, āṭopaḥ pūrṇatvamiva||5||

div.ab: pānānnairatisaṃyuktaiḥ sahasā pīḍito'nilaḥ | hikkayatyūrdhvago bhūtvā tāṃ vidyādannajāṃ bhiṣak ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 50) |

ab.seg: annajāyā lakṣaṇamāha– pānānnairityādi| hikkayati hikkāṃ karoti||6||

annajālakṣaṇamāha– pānānnairityādi| śītairiti śeṣaḥ| ‘uparyupari atyupayuktaiḥ’ iti pā.| atisaṃyuktairiti uparyuparyatyupayuktaiḥ| sahasā pīḍito'nilo hṛdisthaḥ prāṇo vāyurūrdhvagatatvāddhikkayati hikkāṃ karoti, sā hikkā annajeti kathyate||6||

div.ab: cireṇa yamalairvegairyā hikkā sampravartate | kampayantī ‘śirogrīvām’ iti pā. | śirogrīvaṃ yamalāṃ tāṃ vinirdiśet ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 50) |

ab.seg: yamalāmāha– cireṇetyādi| kampayantī ‘śirogrīvāṃ ... ’ iti pā.| śirogrīvamityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena carakaktapralāpamūrchāvamitṛṣṇāvaicittyajṛmbhāviplutākṣatvamukhaśoṣā bodhyā iti gayadāsaḥ||7||
yamalāmāha– cireṇetyādi| yā hikkā yamalairvegairyugmairupakramaiḥ ‘śirogrīvām’ iti pā.| śirogrīvaṃ kampayati carakalena pravartate tāṃ nāmato yamalāmāhuḥ||7||

div.ab: prakṛṣṭakālairyā vegairmandaiḥ samabhivartate | kṣudrikā nāma sā hikkā jatrumūlāt pradhāvitā ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 50) |

ab.seg: kṣudrāmāha– ‘vikṛṣṭetyādi’ iti pā.| prakṛṣṭetyādi| prakṛṣṭakālaiścireṇa| jatru kaṇṭhorasoḥ sandhiriti jejjaṭaḥ; jatru grīvāmūlaṃ, tadgrahaṇenaiva hṛdayaklomakaṇṭhagrahaṇamiti gayadāsaḥ||8||

kṣudrāmāha– mūlaśloke ‘prakṛṣṭa ... ’ iti pā.| vikṛṣṭakālairityādi| mūlaśloke ‘prakṛṣṭa ... ’ iti pā.| vikṛṣṭakālairacarakalaiḥ mandavegaiḥ| jatruḥ kakṣorasoḥ sandhiriti jejjaṭaḥ, jatrumūlagrahaṇena hṛdayaklomakaṇṭhasya grahaṇamiti gayadāsaḥ| iyaṃ nāmataḥ kṣudrikā||8||

div.ab: nābhipravṛttā yā hikkā ghorā gambhīranādinī | anekopadravavatī gambhīrā nāma sā smṛtā ||9|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 50) |

ab.seg: gambhīrāmāha– nābhītyādi| nābhipravṛtteti nābhitaḥ prabhṛti ‘pravṛttā’ iti pā.| sañjātā, ata evāsyā gambhīratvam| anekopadravavatī tṛṣṇājvarādiyuktā||9||
gambhīrāmāha– nābhītyādi| ya hikkā nābhipravṛtteti nābhitaḥ pravṛttā sañjātā, ata evāsyā gambhīratvam| anekopadravavatī tṛṣṇājvarādiyuktā| seyaṃ nāmato gambhīrā||9||

div.ab: marmāṇyutpīḍayantīva satataṃ yā pravartate | mahāhikketi sā jñeyā sarvagātravikampinī ||10|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 50) |

ab.seg: mahatīmāha– marmāṇītyādi| marmāṇīti pradhānāni bastihṛdayaśirāṃsi, iyaṃ nāmato mahāhikkā||10||
mahatīmāha– marmāṇītyādi| marmāṇīti ‘prādhānyena nābhibastihṛdayaśirāṃsi’ iti pā.| pradhānāni bastihṛdayaśirāṃsi, ||10||

div.ab: āyamyate hikkato yasya deho dṛṣṭiścordhvaṃ nāmyate yasya nityam | kṣīṇo'nnadviṭ kṣauti yaścātimātraṃ tau dvau cāntyau varjayeddhikkamānau ||11|| atisañcitadoṣasya bhaktacchedakṛśasya ca | vyādhibhiḥ kṣīṇadehasya vṛddhasyātivyavāyinaḥ ||12|| āsāṃ yā sā samutpannā hikkā hantyāśu jīvitam | yamikā ca pralāpārtimohatṛṣṇāsamanvitā ||13|| akṣīṇaścāpyadīnaśca sthiradhātvindriyaśca yaḥ | tasya sādhayituṃ śakyā yamikā hantyato'nyathā ||14|| (ca. ci. a. 21) |

ab.seg: avasthāyāmasādhyatvamāha– āyamyata ityādi| āyamyate vistāryata iva| dṛṣṭiścordhvaṃ ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| nāmyate ākuñcyate deha iti sambandha iti jejjaṭagayadāsau| ‘tāmyati’ iti pāṭhāntare muhyati hikkī| kṣauti ‘hikkati’ iti pā.| chikkati| tau dvāviti āyamyata ityādinā nityamityantenaikāvastho hikkī, kṣīṇetyādinā'timātrāntenāparaḥ; sādhyānāmapi madhye evaṃvidhau varjayedityarthaḥ| gambhīrāmahatyoḥ svabhāvādevāsādhyatvamiti tadyuktau hikkamānāvantyau śeṣapaṭhitāvasādhyau; pāṭhāntarāṇi vyākhyāviśeṣāśca vistarabhayānna likhitāḥ| āsāṃ yā seti āsāṃ sādhyahikkānāṃ madhye yā'tisañcitadoṣāderbhavati sā hantīti yojyam; athavā āsāmiti pañcavidhānāmeva| tena mahatīprabhṛtīnāṃ svarūpeṇa yadasādhyatvamuktaṃ tat prāyikam| yadāha jatūkarṇaḥ– “ atra ‘ādyāścatasro ... ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ādyā duḥsādhyā yamikā mohatṛṣṇāvataḥ sadyaḥprāṇahṛt|” iti| yamiketyādi| yamikā cetyanena cakārāt kṣudrā annajā vā yā sādhyatvenoktā sā yamalairvegairjāyamānā hantīti yojyam| saivākṣīṇādeḥ sādhyā bhavatītyāha– akṣīṇa ityādi| akṣīṇo balavān| adīnaḥ prasannamanāḥ| anye tu annajāṃ yamalāmityādisuśrutagranthapaṭhitāṃ yamalāṃ yamikāśabdena vyācakṣate| tanna, yamikā ca pralāpārtītyādiślokaścarake paṭhitaḥ, atra yamalā yamikānāmnā na paṭhitaiva hikketi| yamikāśabdenaivārthagatyā vyapetocyateti cet, na, tarhi vyapetā ca pralāpārtītyevamabhidadhyāt||11-14||

avasthāyāmasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– āyamyata ityādi| āyamyate vistāryata iva dehaḥ| dṛṣṭiścordhvaṃ ‘bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| nāmyate ākuñcate deha iti sambandha iti jejjaṭagayadāsau| ‘tāmyate’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra muhyatītyarthaḥ| yaśca kṣīṇo'nnadveṣī, atikṣauti chikkati tāṃ hikkāṃ varjayet, dvau cāntyau varjayet| antyāviti gambhīrā mahatī ceti| sādhyānāmapyavasthāviśeṣeṇāsādhyatvamāha– atisañcitadoṣasyetyādi| ‘āsāmasādhyānāṃ yā’ iti pā.| āsāṃ sādhyānāṃ madhye yā hikkā ‘atisañcitadoṣādibhirbhavati’ iti pā.| atisañcitadoṣāderbhavati sā naraṃ hantīti boddhavyam| mahatīprabhṛtīnāṃ tu svarūpeṇaivāsādhyatvamuktaṃ tatprāyikamiti| punaravasthāviśeṣeṇāsādhyatvamāha– yamiketyādi| ‘annajā’ iti pā.| atrānnajā kṣudrā ca sādhyaiva, ‘yamalavegavato'yamityucyate’ iti pā.| yamalavegavato'sādhyetyucyate; na tu yamalā, carakoktatvāt| akṣīṇo balavān, adīnaḥ prasannamanāḥ, atra ‘sthiradhātvindriya iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sthirāṇi dhātvindriyāṇi yasya sa tathā; anyathā etadviparīta iti||11-14||

div.ab: mahordhvacchinnatamakakṣudrabhedaistu pañcadhā | bhidyate sa mahāvyādhiḥ śvāsa eko viśeṣataḥ ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 51) | (vātādhiko bhavet kṣudrastamakastu kaphodbhavaḥ | kaphavātādhikaścaiva saṃsṛṣṭaśchinnasañjñakaḥ | śvāso mārutasaṃsṛṣṭo mahānūrdhvastathā(to) mataḥ) | (su. u. taṃ. a. 51) |

ab.seg: śvāsānāha– mahordhvetyādi| eko viśeṣata iti śvāsatvenaika eva san viśeṣaṃ hetuliṅgabhedaṃ prāpya pañcadhā bhidyate, pañcasu śvāsatvaṃ vegavadūrdhvavātatvaṃ; yaduktamanyaiḥ– “śvāsastu bhastrikādhmānasamavātordhvagāmitā|” iti| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva pañcaprakāratve siddhe pañcavacanaṃ tamakabhedasya pratamakasya pṛthaktvasaṅkhyānirāsārtham||15||

hikkāśvāsayorekahetutvāddhikkānantaraṃ śvāsamāha– mahetyādi| sa mahāvyādhiḥ śvāsatvena eka eva san viśeṣahetuliṅgabhedaṃ prāpya mahordhvādibhedaiḥ pañcadhā bhidyate| pañcasvapi śvāsatvaṃ vegavadūrdhvavātatvam| uktaṃ ca tantrāntare– “śvāsastu bhastrikādhmānasamavātordhvagāmitā” iti| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva pañcaprakārake siddhe pañcavacanaṃ tamakabhedasya pratamakasyādhika saṅkhyāniṣedhārtham| tantrāntare pañcānāmapi doṣotkaṭatvamuktam– “vātena kṣudrakaḥ, śleṣmabhūyiṣṭhastamakaḥ smṛtaḥ| chinnaḥ pittapradhānaḥ syādanyau mārutakopajau” iti||15||

div.ab: prāgrūpaṃ tasya hṛtpīḍā śūlamādhmānameva ca | ānāho vaktravairasyaṃ śaṅkhanistoda eva ca ||16|| yadā srotāṃsi saṃrudhya mārutaḥ kaphapūrvakaḥ | viṣvagvrajati saṃruddhastadā śvāsān karoti saḥ ||17|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 51) |

ab.seg: samprāptimāha– yadetyādi| srotāṃsīti ‘ ... prāṇānnodavahāni’ iti pā.| hikkānirdiṣṭaprāṇodānavahāni | kaphaḥ pūrvaṃ pradhānaṃ yasya sa tathā| tenaiva kaphena ruddhaḥ vimārgagatirvimārgagatvena viṣvagvrajati viṣvagañcatīti viṣvak sarvata ityarthaḥ||16-17||

tasya pūrvarūpamāha– atra ‘prāgrūpamityādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| prāgrūpamityādi| śūlamudare, ādhmānamāṭopaḥ, ānāhaḥ āmaṃ śakṛdvā viguṇānilena ‘nibaddham’ iti pā.| vibaddham ‘ayathāvatpravṛttiḥ’ iti pā.| (ayathāvatpravṛttam)| śaṅkhanistodaḥ śaṅkhayorvyathā|| tasya samprāptimāha– yadetyādi| yadā kaphapūrvakaḥ kaphapradhāno vāyuḥ, tenaiva kaphena saṃruddhagatiḥ vimārgagaḥ, prāṇodakānnavāhīni srotāṃsi saṃrudhya, viṣvagvrajati sarvatra prasarati, tadā śvāsān karoti||16-17||

div.ab: uddhūyamānavato yaḥ śabdavadduḥkhito naraḥ | uccaiḥ śvasiti saṃrudvo mattarṣabha ivāniśam ||18|| pranaṣṭajñānavijñānastathā vibhrāntalocanaḥ | vivṛtākṣyānano baddhamūtravarcā viśīrṇavāk ||19|| dīnaḥ praśvasitaṃ cāsya dūrādvijñāyate bhṛśam | mahāśvāsopasṛṣṭastu kṣiprameva vipadyate ||20|| (ca. ci. a. 21) |

ab.seg: mahāśvāsalakṣaṇamāha– uddhūyamānetyādi| uddhūyamānavāta iti ut ūrdhvaṃ dhūyamāno nīyamāno vāto yasya sa tathā| śabdavat saśabdaṃ yathā bhavati| uccairdīrgham| saṃruddho mattarṣabha iveti ‘ ... jñānārthamayam’ iti pā.| svaraviśeṣajñāpanārthamayaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ| jñānaṃ śāstraṃ, vijñānaṃ tadarthaniścayaḥ| vibhrāntalocanaḥ cañcalanetraḥ| vivṛte stabdhe akṣyānane yasya sa tathā; netrasya vibhrāntastabdhatve kālabhedāditi jejjaṭaḥ| viśīrṇavāk vaktumakṣamaḥ, mandavacano vā| dīnaḥ klāntamanāḥ; hīnamiti pāṭhāntaramayuktaṃ, dūrādvijñāyate bhṛśamityanupapatterityāhuḥ||18-20||

mahāśvāsalakṣaṇamāha– atra ‘uddhūyamānetyādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| uddhūyamānetyādi| ut ūrdhvaṃ dhūyamāno vāto yasya sa tathā, śabdavat saśabdo yathā bhavati tathā, evamuccaiḥ śvasiti, duḥkhito duḥkhayuktaḥ, aniśamanavaratam, ka iva? saṃruddho mattarṣabha iva mattamahokṣa iva, svaraviśeṣajñāpanārthamayaṃ dṛṣṭāntaḥ| jñānaṃ śāstraṃ, vijñānaṃ tadarthaniścayaḥ| ‘vibhrāntalocanaśca, calākṣaḥ’ iti pā.| vibhrāntalocanaścañcalākṣaḥ| vivṛte stabdhe akṣiṇī nayane ānanaṃ ca yasya sa tathā| netrasya vibhrāntastabdhatve kālabhedāditi jejjaṭaḥ| viśīrṇavāk vaktumakṣamo mandavacano vā| dīnaḥ klāntamanāḥ| asya ca śvāsavataḥ śvasitamatyarthaṃ dūrādeva śrūyate| anena mahāśvāsenopasṛṣṭo yuktaḥ śīghrameva vinaśyati||18-20||

div.ab: ūrdhvaṃ śvasiti yo dīrghaṃ na ca pratyāharatyadhaḥ | śleṣmāvṛtamukhasrotāḥ kruddhagandhavahārditaḥ ||21|| ūrdhvadṛṣṭirvipaśyaṃstu vibhrāntākṣa itastataḥ | pramuhyan vedanārtaśca ‘śuṣkāsyo ... ’ iti pā. | śuklāsyo'ratipīḍitaḥ ||22|| ūrdhvaśvāse prakupite hyadhaḥśvāso nirudhyate | muhyatastāmyataścordhvaṃ śvāsastasyaiva hantyasūn ||23|| (ca. ci. a. 21) |

ab.seg: ūrdhvaśvāsalakṣaṇamāha– ūrdhvamityādinā| ūrdhvamiti viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvaśvāsānāṃ tathāvidhatvāt| dīrghamiti dīrghakālam| naca pratyāharatyadha iti na śvāsamadhaḥ karoti dīrghakālamityarthaḥ| śleṣmāvṛtamukhasrotā iti ‘śleṣmāvṛtamukhāni srotāṃsi’ iti pā.| śleṣmaṇā āvṛtāni mukhaṃ srotāṃsi ca yasya sa tathā| kruddhagandhavahārditaḥ kupitavātapīḍitaḥ; samastapāṭhe tu śleṣmāvṛtamukhasrotastvena kruddho yo gandhavahastenārditaḥ| vipaśyaṃstu itastata iti itastato vikṛtiṃ paśyan| ‘ūrdhvaṃ śvasiti yo dīrghaṃ na ca pratyāharatyadhaḥ’ iti yaduktaṃ tatra hetumāha– ūrdhvaśvāsa ityādi| nirudhyata iti hṛdaya evātistambhitaḥ| athavā śvāso vātaḥ so'dho na vartate| ūrdhvaṃ śvāsa ūrdhvaśvāsaḥ| tāmyato glāyato muhyataścāsūn prāṇān hanti, nānyatheti||21-23||

ūrdhvaśvāsamāha– ūrdhvamityādi| ūrdhvaśvāse atra ‘yaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| pumān dīrghakālamūrdhvaṃ ‘śvasiti’ iti pā.| śvāsiti, na ca pratyāharatyadha iti na śvāsamadhaḥ karoti dīrghakālamityarthaḥ; sarvaśvāsānāmūrdhvagatvādatrordhvamiti viśeṣaparam| śleṣmaṇā āvṛtaṃ mukhaṃ srotāṃsi ca yasya sa tathā; athavā śleṣmāvṛtāni mukhasambandhīni srotāṃsi yasya sa tathā| kruddhagandhavahārditaḥ kupitavātapīḍitaḥ, athavā śleṣmāvṛtamukhasrotastvena kruddho yo gandhavahastenārditaḥ| ūrdhvaṃ dṛṣṭirdarśanaṃ yasya sa ūrdhvadṛṣṭiḥ| vipaśyannitastato vikṛtaṃ paśyan, vibhrāntākṣaḥ parikṣiptanetraḥ, pramuhyan mohamupagacchan, śuṣkāsyaḥ śuṣkamukhaḥ, aratiḥ kasminnapi viṣaye na cirāvasthitiḥ| ūrdhvaṃ śvasiti na cādhaḥ pratyāharatīti yaduktaṃ tatra hetumāha– ūrdhvetyādi| nirudhyata iti hṛdaya eva stambhitaḥ syāt, athavā śvāso vātaḥ so'dho na pravartate ūrdhvaśvāse| tāmyato glāyataḥ; muhyatastamasi majjata iva, athavā niśceṣṭāvataḥ, tasyaivaṃvidhapuruṣasya asūn prāṇān hanti nānyatheti||21-23||

div.ab: yastu śvasiti vicchinnaṃ sarvaprāṇena pīḍitaḥ | na vā śvasiti duḥkhārto marmacchedarugarditaḥ ||24|| ānāhasvedamūrchārto dahyamānena bastinā | viplutākṣaḥ parikṣīṇaḥ śvasan raktaikalocanaḥ ||25|| vicetāḥ pariśuṣkāsyo vivarṇaḥ pralapannaraḥ | chinnaśvāsena vicchinnaḥ sa śīghraṃ vijahātyasūn ||26|| (ca. ci. a. 29) |

ab.seg: chinnaśvāsalakṣaṇamāha– yastvityādi| vicchinnaṃ savicchedam| sarvaprāṇena atra ‘yāvadbalena’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| na vā śvasiti śvāsaṃ na labhate| marmacchedarugardita iti hṛdayacchedavedanayā pīḍitaḥ| dahyamānena bastinopalakṣitaḥ, etena vātasya pittānubandho darśitaḥ| viplutākṣaḥ ‘calaccakṣuḥ ... ’ iti pā.| cañcalanetro'śrupūrṇacakṣurvā| atra ‘na vā śvasiti na vā śvāsaṃ labhate’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| raktaikalocanatvaṃ vyādhiprabhāvāt, doṣāttu dvayorapi syāt| vicetā udvignacittaḥ| vicchinno atra ‘ ... sandhibandhaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| vimokṣitasandhiḥ, ‘pīḍita’ ityanye; ‘vihataḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram||24-26||

atha chinnaṃ lakṣayati– ya ityādi| vicchinnamiva vicchinnamantarā'ntarā vicchidyamānamanuvartate sāntarāyamityarthaḥ| sarvaprāṇena samastayā śaktyā, duḥkhārtaḥ san, na vā śvasiti| marmacchedarugardita iti marmāṇi hṛdayabastiśirāṃsi teṣāṃ chedaneneva pīḍitaḥ| dahyamānena bastinopalakṣitaḥ| etena vātasya pittānubandho darśitaḥ| viplutākṣaḥ calaccakṣuḥ aśrupūrṇacakṣurvā| raktaikalocanatvaṃ vyādhidoṣāt, ‘tadā’ iti pā.| anyathā dvayorapi syāt||24-26||

div.ab: pratilomaṃ yadā vāyuḥ srotāṃsi pratipadyate | grīvāṃ śiraśca saṅgṛhya śleṣmāṇaṃ samudīrya ca ||27|| karoti pīnasaṃ tena ruddho ghurghurakaṃ tathā | atīva tīvravegaṃ ca śvāsaṃ prāṇaprapīḍakam ||28|| pratāmyati sa vegena tṛṣyate sannirudhyate | pramohaṃ kāsamānaśca sa gacchati muhurmuhuḥ ||29|| śleṣmaṇyamucyamāne tu bhṛśaṃ bhavati duḥkhitaḥ | tasyaiva ca vimokṣānte muhūrtaṃ labhate sukham ||30|| tathā'syoddhvaṃsate kaṇṭhaḥ kṛcchrācchaknoti bhāṣitum | na cāpi labhate nidrāṃ śayānaḥ śvāsapīḍitaḥ ||31|| pārśve tasyāvagṛhṇāti śayānasya samīraṇaḥ | āsīno labhate saukhyamuṣṇaṃ caivābhinandati ||32|| ucchritākṣo lalāṭena svidyatā bhṛśamārtimān | viśuṣkāsyo muhuḥ śvāso muhuścaivāvadhamyate ||33|| meghāmbuśītaprāgvātaiḥ śleṣmalaiśca vivardhate | sa yāpyastamakaḥ śvāsaḥ sādhyo vā syānnavotthitaḥ ||34|| (ca. ci. a. 21) |

tamakaśvāsalakṣaṇamāha– pratilomamityādi| śleṣmāṇaṃ samudīrya cetyanena sāmānyasamprāptilabdhasyāpi śleṣmaṇaḥ punarabhidhānādiha viśeṣeṇa kāraṇatvaṃ bodhayati| tena ruddhaḥ kaphenāvṛtaḥ| ghurghurakaṃ kaṇṭhe ghurghuraśabdam| prāṇaprapīḍakaṃ ‘prāṇādhiṣṭhānahṛdayapīḍakam’ iti pā.| prāṇādhiṣṭhānahṛdayasya pīḍakam| pratāmyati tamasi praviśatīva| sannirudhyate ‘niśceṣṭo bhavati’ iti cakraḥ, jejjaṭastu sannirudhyate ‘śvāsaḥ’ iti atra ‘śeṣamāha’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| tasyaiveti śleṣmaṇaḥ| sukhaṃ sukhamiva| uddhvaṃsate kaṇḍūyate| pārśve iti karmapadam, avagṛhṇāti pīḍayati| uṣṇamabhinandati vātakaphārabdhatvāt| ucchritākṣa ‘ucchūnākṣaḥ’ iti pā.| ucchūnanetraḥ| lalāṭenetyupalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā| avadhamyate gajārūḍhasyeva sarvagātraṃ cālyate||27– 34||

ab.seg: tamakalakṣaṇamāha– pratītyādi| yadi vāyuḥ pratilomaṃ vaiparītyena srotāṃsi pratipadyate prāpnoti, tadā sa vāyuḥ śleṣmāṇaṃ samudīryaṃ ūrdhvapreraṇayā grīvāṃ śiraśca saṅgṛhya samantāt gṛhītvā pīnasaṃ karoti, paścāttenaivāvṛtaḥ kaṇṭhe ghuraghuraśabdaṃ karoti, prāṇaprapīḍakaṃ prāṇādhiṣṭhānahṛdayaprapīḍakaṃ śvāsaṃ karoti, tena śvāsavegena pratāmyati tamasi praviśatīveti, sannirudhyate niśceṣṭo bhavatīti carakaḥ, jejjaṭastu saṃrudhyate ‘śvāsaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| mucyamānena kaphenātīva duḥkhito bhavati| tasyaiva śleṣmaṇo vimokṣānte muhūrtaṃ sukhaṃ prāpnoti atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| atra ‘tatheti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| uddhvaṃsate kaṇḍūyate| pārśve'vagṛhṇāti ‘pīḍyati’ iti pā.| pīḍayati paraṃ śayānasya, āsīnaḥ san sukhaṃ labhate| uṣṇamabhinandati vātakaphārabdhatvāt| ucchritākṣaḥ ucchūnākṣaḥ, svidyatā lalāṭenopalakṣitaḥ| avadhamyate gajārūḍhasyevākhilagātraṃ cālyate||27-34||

div.ab: jvaramūrchāparītasya vidyāt pratamakaṃ tu tam | ‘ ... rajojīrṇa ... ’ iti pā. | udāvartarajo'jīrṇaklinnakāyanirodhajaḥ ||35|| tamasā vardhate'tyarthaṃ śītaiścāśu praśāmyati | majjatastamasīvāsya vidyāt santamakaṃ tu tam ||36|| (ca. ci. a. 21) |

ab.seg: tamakasyaiva pittānubandhatvājjvarādiyogena pratamakasañjñāmāha– jvaretyādi| jvaramūrchābhyāṃ parīto jvaramūrchāparītaḥ; jvareṇa mūrchā jvaramūrcheti jejjaṭaḥ| etasyaivāparakāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ cāha– udāvartetyādi| udāvarto rogaḥ, rajo dhūliḥ, ajīrṇamāmādi, klinnaṃ vidagdhaṃ, kāye vegānāṃ nirodhaḥ kāyanirodhaḥ; athavā klinnakāyo vṛddhanara ityāhuḥ, nirodhaḥ veganirodhaḥ, athavā kuyogināṃ kumbhakādirūpavātanirodha iti jejjaṭaḥ| tamasā andhakāreṇa, mānasadoṣeṇa vā; atyarthamiti itarakāraṇāpekṣayā viśeṣeṇa; vātakaphārabdho'pi pittasambandhāt śītairupaśāmyatītyāhuḥ| santamakaḥ pratamaka eveti| anye tu udāvartetyādinā pratamakasyopasargamāhuriti jejjaṭaḥ||35-36||

tamakasyaiva ‘pittānubandhatvājjvarādiyogena’ iti pā.| pittānubandhakatvājjvarādiyogena pratamakasañjñāmāha– jvaretyādi| jvaramūrchābhyāṃ parīto jvaramūrchāparītaḥ, jvareṇa vā mūrchā, iti jejjaṭaḥ| etasyaivāparalakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ cāha– atra ‘udāvartetyādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| udāvartetyādi| udāvarto rogaviśeṣaḥ, rajo dhūliḥ, ajīrṇamāmādi, klinnaṃ vidagdhaṃ, kāyavegānāṃ nirodhaḥ, etairhetubhiḥ janitaḥ; anye “klinnakāyo vṛddhanaraḥ” ityāhuḥ, nirodho veganirodhaḥ| jejjaṭastu kuyogināṃ kumbhakādivātanirodhajaḥ| tamasā andhakāreṇa, ‘ ... doṣeṇeti’ iti pā.| mānasatamoguṇādidoṣeṇa vā| atyarthamiti ‘jvarakāraṇāpekṣayā’ iti pā.| itarakāraṇāpekṣayā viśeṣeṇa vātakaphārabdhapittasambandhāt| śītairupaśāmyatīti tamasyandhakāre majjata ivāsya puruṣasya taṃ pratamakamāhuḥ||35-36||

div.ab: rūkṣāyāsodbhavaḥ koṣṭhe kṣudro vāta udīrayan | kṣudraśvāso na so'tyarthaṃ duḥkhenāṅgaprabādhakaḥ ||37|| hinasti na sa gātrāṇi na ca duḥkho yathetare | na ca bhojanapānānāṃ niruṇaddhyucitāṃ gatim ||38|| nendriyāṇāṃ vyathāṃ nāpi kāñcidāpādayedrujam | sa sādhya ukto, balinaḥ sarve cāvyaktalakṣaṇāḥ ||39|| (ca. ci. a. 21) | kṣudraḥ sādhyo matasteṣāṃ tamakaḥ kṛcchra ucyate | trayaḥ śvāsā na sidhyanti tamako durbalasya ca ||40|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 51) |

ab.seg: kṣudraśvāsamāha– rūkṣetyādi| rūkṣamannapānam| kṣudro'lpanidānaliṅgaḥ| udīrayan ūrdhvaṃ gacchan| itare urdhvaśvāsādayaḥ| sa sādhya ukta iti chedaḥ| sarve mahāśvāsādayo'vyaktalakṣaṇāḥ santaḥ sādhyā iti yojyam| trayaḥ śvāsā na sidhyanti mahordhvacchinnāḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇāḥ atra ‘upekṣaṇīyāḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|||37-40||

kṣudramāha– rūkṣetyādi| rūkṣamannapānam, āyāso vyāyāmaḥ, tajjanitaḥ| kṣudra iti kṣudraśvāsaḥ, alpanidānaliṅgatvāt kṣudraḥ| koṣṭhe vātaṃ prakopayat etacca– ‘kṣudro vātamudīrayan’ iti pā.| kṣudraśvāsaṃ karoti| ‘duḥkhena sa’ iti pā.| sa duḥkhena kṣudraśvāsaḥ nāṅgaprabādhako bhavati| kintu sa gātrāṇi na hinasti māraṇātmako na bhavati| na ca duḥkhakārī yathā itare catvāraḥ| indriyāṇāṃ vyathāṃ nāpādayet| kāñcidapi rujaṃ rogaṃ nāpādayet| sarveṣāṃ sādhyatvamāha– atra ‘sa ityādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sa ityādi| sa kṣudraśvāso balinaḥ puruṣasya sādhyaḥ, sarve mahāśvāsādayo'vyaktalakṣaṇāḥ santaḥ sādhyā iti yojyam| sādhyāsādhyānāha– atra ‘kṣudra ityādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| kṣudra ityādi| teṣāṃ śvāsānāṃ kṣudraḥ sādhyatamaḥ, tamako yāpyaḥ, mahordhvacchinnāstrayaḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇā asādhyāḥ, durbalasya tamako'sādhyaḥ||37-40||

div.ab: kāmaṃ prāṇaharā rogā bahavo na tu te tathā | yathā śvāsaśca hikkā ca harataḥ prāṇamāśu ca ||41|| (ca. ci. a. 21) |

ab.seg: upekṣaṇāsamyagupakramābhyāṃ hikkāśvāsayoḥ śīghrāvaśyamārakatvamāha– kāmamityādi| kāmamanumatau, prāṇaharāḥ ‘sannipātādayaḥ’ iti pā.| sannipātajvarādayaḥ| śeṣaṃ subodhamiti||41||

hikkāśvāsayoḥ śīghrāvaśyamārakatvamāha– atra ‘kāmamityādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| kāmamityādi| kāmamityanumatau, prāṇaharāḥ sannipātādayo rogāḥ bahavaḥ santi, te tathā prāṇaharā na bhavanti, yathā śvāsaśca hikkā ca etau rogāvāśu śīghraṃ prāṇān harataḥ||41||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne hikkāśvāsanidānaṃ samāptam ||12||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ hikkāśvāsanidānaṃ samāptam||12||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānaṭīkāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇābhidhāyāṃ śvāsanidānaṃ samāptam||12||

div.head: svarabhedanidānam
div.ab: atha svarabhedanidānam | atyuccabhāṣaṇaviṣādhyayanābhighātasandūṣaṇaiḥ prakupitāḥ pavanādayastu | srotaḥsu te svaravaheṣu gatāḥ pratiṣṭhāṃ hanyuḥ svaraṃ bhavati cāpi hi ṣaḍvidhaḥ saḥ ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) | (vātādibhiḥ pṛthak sarvairmedasā ca kṣayeṇa ca) |

ab.seg: prāṇodānaduṣṭisādharmyāt ‘śvāse'pi’ iti pā.| śvāse ca svarabhedo bhavatīti śvāsānantaraṃ svarabhedamāha– atyuccabhāṣaṇetyādi| adhyayanamuccairvedādipāṭhaḥ, abhighātaḥ kaṇṭhādideśe laguḍādibhirāghātaḥ, etaiḥ ‘sandūṣaṇaiścānyairyathāsvam’ iti pā.| sandūṣaṇairanyaiśca yathāsvaṃ vātādikopanaiḥ, viṣaṃ tu sarvadoṣaprakopaṇameva| ‘svaravaheṣu srotaḥsu śabdavāhinīṣu’ iti ḍalhaṇaḥ| srotaḥsu svaravaheṣu caturṣu; yaduktaṃ suśrute– “dvābhyāṃ bhāṣate, dvābhyāṃ ghoṣaṃ karoti” (su. śā. a. 9) iti; bhāṣaṇaghoṣaṇayoralpatvamahattvābhyāṃ bhedaḥ| pratiṣṭhāṃ sthitiṃ, vṛddhiṃ vā| sa iti svarabhedaḥ; ṣaḍvidho vātapittakaphasannipātakṣayamedojabhedāt||1||

hikkāśvāsau prāṇodānaduṣṭyā sambhavataḥ, tadduṣṭisādharmyāt śvāsānantaraṃ svarabhedamāha– atyuccetyādi| ‘ ... vedapāṭhaḥ’ iti pā.| adhyayanamuccairvedādipāṭhaḥ; abhighātaḥ kaṇṭhapradeśe laguḍādibhiḥ, athavā balena chardijanitaḥ, athavā'sthyādikaṭhinabhojyajanitaḥ| viṣatastu tridoṣaprakopaḥ| srotaḥsu svaravaheṣu caturṣu, yaduktaṃ suśrute– “dvābhyāṃ bhāṣate, dvābhyāṃ ghoṣaṃ karoti” iti; bhāṣaṇaghoṣaṇayoralpatvamahattvābhyāṃ bhedaḥ| etaiḥ ‘sandūṣaṇaiścānyaiśca’ iti pā.| sandūṣaṇairanyaiśca yathāsvaṃ vātādikopanairdoṣāsteṣu srotaḥsu pratiṣṭhāṃ sthitiṃ vṛddhiṃ vā gatāḥ svaraṃ hanyuḥ| sa svarabhedaḥ ṣaḍvidha iti vātapittakaphasannipāta kṣayamedojanita iti bhedāt||1||

div.ab: vātena kṛṣṇanayanānanamūtravarcā bhinnaṃ śanairvadati gardabhavat kharaṃ ca |2| (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) |

vātikamāha– vātenetyādi| kṛṣṇatvaṃ mūtrādiṣu svarabhedārambhakadoṣasya sarvāṅgavyāpakatvāt, arśovat| bhinnaṃ bhinnasvaraṃ, tadevāha– gardabhavat ‘kharaṃ ca’ iti pā.| kharamiti; kharaṃ niṣṭhuram, udvejakamiti yāvat|2|–

vātikamāha– vātenetyādi| atra ‘nayanādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| kṛṣṇatvaṃ ‘ ... bhedanārambhaka’ iti pā.| svarabhedārambhakadoṣasya sarvāṅgavyāpakatvāt, arśovat| bhinnaṃ bhinnasvaraṃ, gardabhasvaravat ‘svaraṃ ca ityevaṃ mukhyaṃ pāṭhaṃ manyate’ iti pā.| svaraṃ kharamudvejakamiti yāvat| anye gardabhavatsvaramityatra gardabhavatkharamiti paṭhanti, gardabhasya vacanābhāvāt; ‘kaṇṭhena’ iti śeṣaḥ|2|–
pittena pītanayanānanamūtravarcā brūyādgalena sa ca dāhasamanvitena ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) |

ab.seg: paittikamāha– pittenetyādi| galeneti viśeṣyopadarśanaṃ, dāhasamanviteneti viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣyādhīnapratītatvāt; galaḥ sadāho bhavatītyarthaḥ||2||
paittikamāha– atra ‘pittenetyādi’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| pittenetyādi| galastasya sadāho bhavatītyarthaḥ||2||

div.ab: brūyāt kaphena satataṃ kapharuddhakaṇṭhaḥ svalpaṃ śanairvadati cāpi divā viśeṣāt |3| (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) |
ślaiṣmikamāha– brūyādityādi| divā viśeṣāditi dine sūryaraśmibhiḥ kaphasya mandībhāvādviśeṣādviśiṣṭaṃ vadatītyarthaḥ| ‘divāviśeṣa’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ|3|–
kaphajamāha-brūyādityādi| brūyādityatra kṛcchrāditi kecitpaṭhanti|3|–
sarvātmake bhavati sarvavikārasampat taṃ cāpyasādhyamṛṣayaḥ svarabhedamāhuḥ ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) |

ab.seg: sānnipātikamāha– sarvātmaka ityādi| sarvavikārasampaditi uktavātādisvarabhedaliṅgayogaḥ| taṃ cāpyasādhyamiti apiśabdo bhinnakrame, asādhyamapi; tena “sarvaje kṣayaje cāpi pratyākhyāyācaret kriyām||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) iti suśrutavacanamupapannaṃ bhavatīti||3||

sannipātajamāha– sarvavikārasampadityādi| uktavātādisvarabhedaliṅgāni| taṃ cāpyasādhyamiti apiśabdo bhinnakramaḥ| asādhyamapi; tena “sarvaje kṣayaje cāpi pratyākhyāyācaret kriyām” iti suśrutavacanamupapannaṃ bhavatīti||3||

div.ab: dhūpyeta vāk kṣayakṛte kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgeṣa ‘sarveṣu’ iti pā. | cāpi hatavāk parivarjanīyaḥ |4| (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) |

kṣayajamāha– dhūpyetetyādi| ‘dhūmyeta’ iti pā.| dhūpyeta vāgiti sadhūmeva nirgacchantī vedanāyā'nubhūyate| kṣayakṛta iti dhātukṣayakṛta svarabhede| kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgiti padacchedaḥ| eṣa ca yadā hatavāgbhavati ojaḥkṣayādvacanākṣamastadā na sādhyate, anyathā tu sādhyaḥ; tena pratyākhyāya kriyākaraṇamupapannaṃ bhavati| ‘eṣu cāpi’ iti pāṭhe vātādisvarabhedeṣu madhye hatavāgasādhyaḥ, kintvayaṃ pāṭhaṣṭīkākārairna vyākhyātaḥ|4|–

kṣayajamāha– dhūmyeta vāgiti| sadhūmeneva ‘nirgacchatīti’ iti pā.| nirgacchantī ‘vedanayābhibhūyate’ iti pā.| vedanayā'nubhūyate, ‘dhūmāyate’ iti pā.| ‘dhūmāvate’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ| kṣayakṛta iti dhātukṣayakṛte svarabhede| kṣayamāpnuyācca vāgiti padacchedaḥ, vacanaṃ kṣayamāpnuyāt ‘vātāt’ iti śeṣaḥ| sa eva yadā hatavāk ojaḥkṣayādvacanākṣamaḥ, tadā na sādhyaḥ, anyathā tu sādhyaḥ| anye ‘eṣu ca’ iti paṭhanti; tataścaiṣu vātādisvarabhedeṣu madhye hatavāgasādhyaḥ; kiṃ tvayaṃ pāṭhaṣṭīkākārairna svīkṛtaḥ|4|–
antargatasvaramalakṣyapadaṃ cireṇa medo'nvayādvadati digdhagalastṛṣārtaḥ ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) |

ab.seg: medojalakṣaṇamāha– ‘antargatasvaramityādinā’ iti pā.| antargatetyādinā| antargatasvaramiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam; ‘antargataṃ svaram’ iti pāṭhe ‘tu’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tu kaṇṭhasyāntargataṃ yathā bhavati tathā ‘tadgatam’ iti pā.| svaraṃ vacanaṃ vadatīti yojyaṃ; ‘antargalam’ iti pāṭhāntare galasyāntariti antargalaṃ atra ‘tadgatam’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| svaraṃ vadatītyarthaḥ| digdhagala iti śleṣmaṇā medasā vā liptagala ityarthaḥ| ‘tṛṣārto’ iti pā.| tṛṣārtaśca medoruddhasrotastvāt||4||

medojamāha– antarityādi| antargatasvaramiti kriyāviśeṣaṇam; tena kaṇṭhasthāntargataṃ yathā bhavati tathā svaraṃ vacanaṃ vadatīti yojyam| ‘anye antargalam’ iti paṭhanti, tatra galasya antaḥ antargalaṃ, tadgataṃ svaraṃ vadatītyarthaḥ| medonvayānmedaḥsambandhāt| ‘medaścayāt’ iti kecitpāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti, medaścayānmedovṛddheriti; ‘bhedaḥkṣayāt’ iti pāṭhāntaram, atra svaraśabdo lupto madhye'tidiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena medasā svarakṣayādityarthaḥ| digdhagala iti śleṣmaṇā medasā vā liptagala ityarthaḥ| tṛṣārta iti medoruddhasrotastvāt||4||

div.ab: kṣīṇasya vṛddhasya kṛśasya vā'pi cirotthito yaśca sahopajātaḥ | medasvinaḥ sarvasamudbhavaśca svarāmayo yo na sa siddhimeti ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 53) |

ab.seg: uktavātādijānāmevāvasthāyāmasādhyatvamāha– kṣīṇasyetyādinā sahopajāta ityantena| kṣīṇasya kṣīṇamāṃsasya| kṛśasya abalasya| sahopajāto janmaprabhṛtibaddhaḥ, ‘kākasvara’ iti loke| ‘sahopajātaḥ’ ityatra ‘madopajātaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram, mado rogaviśeṣaḥ| medasvino'tisthūlasya medasā''vṛtasrotastvena yo jātaḥ; amedasvinastu medoduṣṭyā atra ‘yo’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| jātaḥ sa sādhyaḥ pūrvamukta iti na virodhaḥ| ‘sarvasamudbhavaśca gāḍhaḥ’ iti pā.| sarvasamudbhavaścāvagāḍhaḥ sampūrṇaliṅgo vā'sādhyo draṣṭavya iti||5||

asādhyamāha– kṣīṇasyetyādi| kṣīṇasya abalasya, kṛśasya kṣīṇamāṃsasya, sahajopajātaḥ janmapratibaddhaḥ, sa ca kākasvara iti loke; ‘sahajopajāta’ ityasya sthāne ‘samadoṣajāta’ iti pā.| ‘sa madopajāta’ iti paṭhantyanye; tatra ‘samado’ iti pā.| mado rogaviśeṣaḥ| medasvina iti atisthūlasya medasāvṛtasrotastvena yo jātaḥ, medasvinastu medovṛddhyā yo jātaḥ so'sādhyaḥ pūrvamuktamiti na virodhaḥ| sarvasamudbhavaścāvagāḍhaḥ sampūrṇaliṅgo vā'sādhyo draṣṭavyaḥ||5||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne svarabhedanidānaṃ samāptam ||13||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ svarabhedanidānaṃ samāptam||13||
ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ svarabhedanidānam||13||

div.head: arocakanidānam
div.ab: athārocakanidānam | vātādibhiḥ śokabhayātilobhakrodhairmanoghnāśanarūpagandhaiḥ | arocakāḥ syuḥ ... |1| (ca. ci. a. 26) |

ūrdhvagavikārasādharmyādarocakamāha– vātādibhirityādi| ekaikaśo vātādibhistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, ‘śokādīnāmāgantutvena’ iti pā.| śokādinā gandhāntenāgantureka eva gaṇanīyaḥ, yataḥ pañcānāmekaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyati; suśrute coktam– “bhaktopaghātamiha pañcavidhaṃ vadanti|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 57) iti| śokādijastu yadyapi ‘vātajaḥ’ iti pā.| vātādijaḥ, tathā'pi hetupratyanīkacikitsākaraṇārthaṃ pṛthaguktaḥ| atilobho'trāhitasya satatopayogahetutayā doṣaprakopaka iti darśayati| arocakāḥ syuriti chedaḥ|1|–

ūrdhvagavikārasādharmyādarocakamāha– vātādibhiriti| ekaikaśo vātādibhistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, śokabhayādinā''gantureka eva gaṇanīyaḥ, yataḥ pañcānāmapi lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyati; suśrute coktam– “bhaktopaghātamiha pañcavidhaṃ vadanti” iti| tantrāntare'pi– “arocako bhaveddoṣaireko hṛdayasaṃśrayaiḥ| sannipātena manasaḥ santāpena ca pañcamaḥ” iti| śokādijo yadyapi vātajastathā'pi hetupratyanīkacikitsārthaṃ pṛthaguktaḥ| etairhetubhirarocakā bhavanti| manoghnāśanamucchiṣṭakṛmiklinnādirūpaṃ śarīraśvayathugataṃ, gandhaḥ pūtiḥ, taiḥ|1|–
... parihṛṣṭadantaḥ kaṣāyavaktraśca mato'nilena ||1|| (ca. ci. a. 26) |

ab.seg: vātikalakṣaṇamāha– parītyādi| parihṛṣṭadanta iti amlabhakṣaṇeneva||1||
vātikamāha– parihṛṣṭadanta iti amlabhakṣaṇeneva, kaṣāyavaktra iti lodhracarvitasyeva||1||

div.ab: kaṭvamlamuṣṇaṃ virasaṃ ca pūti pittena vidyāt ... |2| (ca. ci. a. 26) |
paittikalakṣaṇamāha– kaṭvityādi| kaṭuśabdo'tra tiktavācī| yadāha videhaḥ– “pittena tiktāsyavidāhakṛt syāt, svādvāsyahṛllāsakaraḥ kaphena|” iti|2|–

pittajamāha– kaṭvityādi| kaṭuratra tiktavācakaḥ| yadāha videhaḥ– “pittena tiktāsyavidāhakṛtsyātsvādvāsyahṛllāsakaraḥ kaphena” iti| virasamiti rogasvabhāvāt, anyathā vātena virasāsyatā| pittena pūti durgandhaṃ jānīyāt| lavaṇaṃ ca vaktramiti kaphajalakṣaṇe paṭhanīyaṃ, yato vidagdhaḥ śleṣmā lavaṇabhāvamupaiti|2|–
... lavaṇaṃ ca vaktram | mādhuryapaicchilyagurutvaśaityavibaddhasambaddhayutaṃ kaphena ||2|| (ca. ci. a. 26) |

ab.seg: ślaiṣmikalakṣaṇamāha– lavaṇamityādi| lavaṇaṃ vaktramiti vidagdhasya śleṣmaṇo lavaṇarasatvāt| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “śleṣmā vidagdho lavaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ, pittaṃ vidagdhamamlam|” (su. sū. a. 40) iti| vibaddhasambaddhayutamiti vibaddhaṃ ca tat sambaddhayutaṃ ceti vibaddhasambaddhayutam| atra vibaddhaṃ baddhamiva, bhakṣaṇādyasāmarthyāt; sambaddhayutaṃ ‘kaphasya’ iti śeṣaḥ; bhāve ktaḥ, kaphaliptamityarthaḥ| ‘vidagdhasambaddhayutam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam| ‘vibaddhasannaddhayutam’ iti pāṭhe vibaddhaḥ sannaddhaḥ sa ca prakṛtatvāt kaphasya, sannaddho baddhaḥ; ‘ṇaha’ bandhane ityasmāddhātoḥ pūrvavat ktādi| ‘vibaddhasaṃstambhayutam’ iti kāśmīrāḥ||2||

kaphajamāha– ‘mādhuryeti’ iti pā.| lavaṇamityādi| kaphena lavaṇaṃ ca vaktramiti yojyaṃ, mādhuryādiyutamiti vaktreṇaiva| vibaddhasambaddhayutamiti nibaddhaṃ ca tatsambaddhayutaṃ ca tattathā; atra ‘vibaddham’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| vibaddhamiva bhakṣaṇākṣamaṃ, sambaddhayutaṃ kaphasyeti śeṣaḥ, ‘liptamityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| kaphaliptamityarthaḥ| anye vibaddhasannaddhayutamiti paṭhanti, vibaddhaḥ sannaddhaḥ sa ca prakṛtatvāt kaphasya; sannaddho baddhaḥ, ‘ṇaha’ bandhane, ityasya dhātoḥ prayogaḥ||2||

div.ab: arocake śokabhayātilobhakrodhādyahṛdyāśucigandhaje syāt | svābhāvikaṃ cāsyamathāruciśca ... |3| (ca. ci. a. 26) |

āgantujamāha– arocaka ityādi| ahṛdyagandho ‘prāṇodvejakaḥ’ ityātaṅkadarpaṇe pāṭhaḥ| ghrāṇodvejako gandhaḥ| svābhāvikaṃ cāsyamiti avikṛtamukharasatvaṃ, na tu vātādivat kaṣāyatvādi|3|– ‘śokajamāha’ iti pā.|

āgantujamāha– ahṛdyaḥ prāṇodvejako gandhaḥ, aśuciḥ ucchiṣṭaṃ, svābhāvikaṃ cāsyamiti avikṛtamukharasatvaṃ na tu vātādivadvaktrakaṣāyatvādikam, atha ‘aruciriva śeṣatvam’ iti pā.| aruciriti viśeṣatvam|3|–
... tridoṣaje naikarasaṃ bhavettu ||3|| (ca. ci. a. 26) |

ab.seg: tridoṣajamāha– tridoṣaja ityādi| tridoṣaje naikarasamiti vātajādyuktakaṣāyādyanekarasatvam||3||
tridoṣajamāha– atra ‘tridoṣaje ityādi| naikarasamiti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| anekarasamāsyamityarthaḥ||3||

div.ab: hṛcchūlapīḍanayutaṃ pavanena, pittāttṛḍdāhacoṣabahulaṃ, sakaphaprasekam | śleṣmātmakaṃ, bahurujaṃ bahubhiśca vidyādvaiguṇyamohajaḍatābhirathāparaṃ ca ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 26) |

ab.seg: vātajādibhedena mukhavikṛtimabhidhāyānyadeśavikṛtimāha– ‘hṛcchūlamiti’ iti pā.| hṛcchūletyādi| hṛdi śūlena pīḍanam atra ‘hṛcchūlapīḍanam’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| coṣaścūṣaṇavat pīḍā| bahubhiriti tridoṣaiḥ| vaiguṇyamohajaḍatābhirathāparamiti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, vaiguṇyaṃ manaso vyākulatvam| aparamiti ‘ ... danyadāgantuja ... ’ iti pā.| doṣajādanyamāgantujamityarthaḥ| ‘satyapi’ iti pā.| satyāmapi bubhukṣāyāmabhyavahārāsāmarthyamaruciḥ, abhilaṣitamapyannaṃ dīyamānaṃ nābhyavaharatītyannānabhinandanam, annasya śravaṇasmaraṇadarśanagandhasparśanairyatrodvijate sa bhaktadveṣaḥ; evaṃ trividho'pi rogaścarakasuśrutābhyāmarocakaśabdena saṅgṛhītaḥ| uktaṃ hi vṛddhabhojena– “prakṣiptaṃ tu mukhe cānnaṃ jantorna svadate muhuḥ| arocakaḥ sa vijñeyo, bhaktadveṣamataḥ śṛṇu|| cintayitvā tu manasā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā'pi bhojanam| dveṣamāyāti yo janturbhaktadveṣaḥ sa ucyate|| kupitasya bhayārtasya yaśca bhaktanirodhajaḥ” atra ‘abhicārahatasya ca| yasya nānne bhavecchraddhā so'bhaktacchanda ucyate||’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| iti||4||

vātādibhedena mukhe vikṛtimabhidhāyānyadeśavikṛtimāha– hṛcchūletyādi| hṛdi śūlena pīḍanaṃ hṝcchūlapīḍanaṃ tena yuktaṃ, coṣaḥ cūṣaṇavatpīḍā| arocakamiti śeṣaḥ| śleṣmātmakaṃ sakaphaprasekaṃ syāt| bahubhiriti tridoṣaiḥ, bahurujamanekapīḍākaram| vaiguṇyamohajaḍatābhirathāparaṃ ceti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā, vaiguṇyaṃ manaso vyākulatvam, aparamiti ‘doṣādanyat’ iti pā.| doṣajādanyat āgantujamityarthaḥ| arocakalakṣaṇam– satyāṃ bubhukṣāyāmabhyavahārāsāmarthyamiti aruciḥ, abhilaṣitamapyannaṃ dīyamānaṃ nābhyavaharatīti nānnābhinandanam, annasya śravaṇasmaraṇadarśanasparśanagandhairyatrodvijate sa bhaktadveṣaḥ| evaṃ trividho'pi rogaścarakasuśrutābhyāmarocakaśabdena saṅgṛhītaḥ| uktaṃ hi vṛddhabhojena– “prakṣiptaṃ tu mukhe cānnaṃ jantorna svadate muhuḥ| arocakaḥ sa vijñeyo bhaktadveṣamataḥ śṛṇu|| cintayitvā tu manasā dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca bhojanam| dveṣamāyāti yo janturbhaktadveṣaḥ sa ucyate|| kupitasya bhayārtasya abhicārābhibhūtaye| yasyānne na bhavecchraddhā sa bhaktadveṣa ucyate” iti||4||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne arocakanidānaṃ samāptam ||14||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmarocakanidānaṃ samāptam||14||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānaṭīkāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāmarocakanidānam||14||

div.head: chardinidānam
div.ab: atha chardinidānam | duṣṭairdoṣaiḥ pṛthak sarvairbībhatsālocanādibhiḥ | chardayaḥ pañca vijñeyāstāsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyate ||1|| atidravairatisnigdhairahṛdyairlavaṇairati | akāle cātimātraiśca tathā'sātmyaiśca bhojanaiḥ ||2|| śramādbhayāttathodvegādajīrṇāt krimidoṣataḥ | nāryāścāpannasattvāyāstathā'tidrutamaśnataḥ ||3|| bībhatsairhetubhiścānyairdrutamutkleśito balāt | chādayannānanaṃ vegairardayennaṅgabhañjanaiḥ | agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate atyantamaparītasya cchardervai sambhavo dhruvam | nirucyate chardiriti doṣo vaktraṃ pradhāvitaḥ ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) |

ab.seg: chardyāmapyarucerbhāvāttathā'rocakavatpañcavidhatvādarocakānantaraṃ chardiḥ, tasyā nidānaṃ niruktiṃ cāha– duṣṭairityādi| bībhatsālocanaṃ vikṛtidarśanam; ādigrahaṇenāniṣṭagandhabhakṣaṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam| nāryāścāpannasattvāyā iti garbhiṇyāḥ, tasyā garbhotpīḍanena vātavaiguṇyācchardiḥ| chādayannānanamityādi vegairmukhaṃ chādayan pūrayan, ardayan pīḍayan, aṅgabhañjanaiḥ aṅgabhedaiḥ| chādayati mukham, ardayati cāṅgānīti chardiḥ; ‘chada apavāraṇe’, ‘arda hiṃsāyāṃ’, anayoḥ pṛṣodarāditvena rūpasiddhiḥ||1-4||

chardyāmarucerbhāvādarocakānantaraṃ chardirucyate, tasyā nidānaṃ niruktiṃ cāha– duṣṭairityādi| etaiḥ kāraṇairvakṣyamāṇairduṣṭairdoṣaiḥ chardayaḥ pañca bhavanti| vātādibhistrayaḥ, tridoṣeṇaikā, bībhatsādibhirekā, evaṃ pañca| bībhatsaṃ vikṛtadarśanam, ādiśabdenāniṣṭagandhabhakṣaṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam| nidānapūrvāṃ samprāptimāha-atītyādi| nāryāścāpannasattvāyā iti gurviṇyāḥ, tasyā garbhotpīḍanena vātavaiguṇyācchardiḥ| bībhatsairhetubhiścānyairiti pūyāmedhyādidarśanagandhāsvādanairghṛṇākāribhiḥ| chādayannānanamiti doṣavegena mukhaṃ pūrayan, ardayan aṅgabhañjanairaṅgabhedaiḥ; chādayati mukhamardayati ca aṅgāni sa chardiriti nirucyate, vegairmukhaṃ prati pradhāvito doṣa udāno vāyuḥ chardiṃ kuryādityarthaḥ||1-4||

div.ab: hṛllāsodgārarodhau ca praseko lavaṇastanuḥ | dveṣo'nnapāne ca bhṛśaṃ vamīnāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇam ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpamāha– hṛllāsetyādi| udgārarodha udgārāpravṛttiḥ| praseko mukhaprasekaḥ, tasya lavaṇatvaṃ prabhāvāt, āmāśayotkleśabhavatvena kaphavidāhādvā; tanuraghano'lpo vā||5||

tasyāḥ pūrvarūpamāha– hṛdityādi| chardīnāmidaṃ pūrvarūpam| udgārarodha udgārāpravṛttiḥ, praseko mukhaprasekaḥ udakasrāvaḥ, tasya lavaṇatvaṃ prabhāvādāmāśayotkleśabhavatvena kaphavidāhādvā, tanuḥ aghanaḥ alpo vā||5||

div.ab: hṛtpārśvapīḍāmukhaśoṣaśīrṣanābhyartikāsasvarabhedatodaiḥ | udgāraśabdaprabalaṃ saphenaṃ vicchinnakṛṣṇaṃ tanukaṃ kaṣāyam | kṛcchreṇa cālpaṃ mahatā ca vegenārto'nilācchardayatīha duḥkham ||6|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: vātajāyā lakṣaṇamāha– hṛtpārśvetyādi| śīrṣanābhyartiḥ mastake nābhau ca śūlaṃ; todairityanantaraṃ ‘yukta’ iti śeṣaḥ, upalakṣaṇe vā tṛtīyā| ārto naraśchardayatīti yojyam| kimbhūtaṃ chardayatītyāha– udgāretyādi| udgāraśabdābhyāṃ prabalamudgāraśabdaprabalam| vicchinnaṃ sāntaravegamalpadravaṃ vā, vātasya ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | svato dravatvābhāvāt| tanukamaghanam| kaṣāyaṃ kaṣāyarasaṃ, kaṣāyasya vātakṛtatvāt||6||

vātajāmāha– hṛdityādi| śīrṣanābhyartiriti mastake nābhau ca śūlam| todairityanantaraṃ ‘yukta’ iti śeṣaḥ, upalakṣaṇe vā tṛtīyā| atra ‘udgāreti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| vātānnaraśchardayatīti yojyam| kimbhūtaṃ chardayatītyāha– udgāraśabdābhyāṃ prabalamudgāraśabdaprabalam| vicchinnaṃ viralavegaṃ alpadravaṃ vā, ‘tasya dravyatvābhāvāt’ iti pā.| vātasya dravatvābhāvāt| tanukamaghanam| kaṣāyaṃ kaṣāyarasaṃ, kaṣāyarasasya vātakṛtatvāt| kṛcchreṇa kaṣṭena, alpaṃ stokaṃ, mahatā vegena||6||

div.ab: mūrchāpipāsāmukhaśoṣamūrdhatālvakṣisantāpatamobhramārtaḥ | pītaṃ bhṛśoṣṇaṃ haritaṃ satiktaṃ dhūmraṃ ca pittena vamet sadāham ||7|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |
