ab.seg: pittajāmāha– mūrchetyādi| tamo'ndhakāradarśanamiva| dhrūmraṃ kṛṣṇalohitavarṇam||7||

pittajāmāha– mūrchetyādi| mūrdhni śirasi tālvakṣṇośca santāpavān| tamo'ndhakāradarśanamiva, bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva, padārthasya anyathājñānaṃ vā, tairārtaḥ| kīdṛśaṃ vamedityāha– pītamityādi| bhṛśoṣṇamatyuṣṇaṃ, haritaṃ śākavarṇaṃ, dhūmraṃ kṛṣṇalohitavarṇaṃ, pitteneti yojyam||7||

div.ab: tandrāsyamādhuryakaphaprasekasantoṣanidrārucigauravārtaḥ | snigdhaṃ ghanaṃ svādu kaphādviśuddhaṃ saromaharṣo'lparujaṃ vamettu ||8|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: kaphajāmāha– tandretyādi| āsyamādhuryaṃ mukhasya madhurarasatvam| santoṣa iti santoṣa iva santoṣaḥ, annānabhilāṣa ityarthaḥ; tṛpto hi nānnamabhilaṣati| arucirabhyavahārāsāmarthyam| svādu madhuram| viśuddhamatiśubhraṃ, suśrute “śuklaṃ himaṃ sāndrakaphaṃ kaphena|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) iti pāṭhāt||8||

kaphajāmāha– tandretyādi| etairupadravairārtaḥ snigdhādikaṃ vamet| āsyamādhuryaṃ mukhasya madhurarasatvam| santoṣa iva santoṣaḥ annānabhilāṣa ityarthaḥ, tṛpto hi nānnamabhilaṣati| arucirabhyavahārāsāmarthyam| svādu madhuram| viśuddhamiti viśuddhaṃ kevalaṃ kaphaṃ; yaduktaṃ suśrute– “śuklaṃ himaṃ ‘sāndram’ iti pā.| sāndrakaphaṃ kaphena|” iti| alparujamiti kaphasya dravarūpatvāt mukhena niḥsaraṇamityarthaḥ||8||

div.ab: śūlāvipākārucidāhatṛṣṇāśvāsapramohaprabalā prasaktam | chardistridoṣāllavaṇāmlanīlasāndroṣṇaraktaṃ vamatāṃ nṛṇāṃ syāt ||9|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: tridoṣajāmāha– śūletyādi| śūlādibhiḥ pramohāntaiḥ prabalā śūlādiprabalā| prasaktaṃ nirantaram| tridoṣādityatra ‘tridoṣā’ iti pāṭhāntare tridoṣajetyarthaḥ||9||
tridoṣajāmāha– śūletyādi| tridoṣāt yā chardiḥ tayā vamatāṃ nṛṇāmityarthaḥ| śūlādibhiḥ pramohāntaiḥ prabalā, prasaktaṃ nirantaraṃ, tridoṣādityatra ‘tridoṣā’ iti pāṭhastatra tridoṣajetyarthaḥ||9||

div.ab: viṭsvedamūtrāmbuvahāni vāyuḥ srotāṃsi saṃrudhya yadordhvameti | utsannadoṣasya samācitaṃ taṃ doṣaṃ samuddhūya narasya koṣṭhāt ||10|| viṇmūtrayostatsamagandhavarṇaṃ tṛṭśvāsahikkārtiyutaṃ prasaktam | pracchardayedduṣṭamihātivegāttayā'rditaścāśu vināśameti ||11|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: asādhyāmāha– viḍityādi| utsannadoṣasya udgatadoṣasya | doṣamiti pittaṃ kaphaṃ vā, svedādikān vā tadduṣṭān dhātumalān| taditi yasmādviḍādivāhisrotoduṣṭistato hetorviṇmūtrayoḥ samagandhavarṇaṃ chardayatīti yojyam| iyaṃ tu chardirvikṛtiviṣamasamavāyārabdhā tridoṣajeti kecit, anye tvāhuḥ– sarvā eva chardayaḥ prabalā evaṃvidhāḥ satyo'sādhyāḥ syuriti||10-11||

asādhyāmāha– viḍityādi| etacca– ‘utpannadoṣasyeti’ iti pā.| utpannadoṣasya udgatadoṣasya pittaṃ kaphaṃ vā, agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake ‘ ... chardayatīti yojyam|’ etatpāṭhapaścādupalabhyate | vāyuḥ koṣṭhāduddhūya ūrdhvaṃ nītveti| svedādikān atra ‘vāyu’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| doṣān dhātumalān vā ‘samasthānāt’ iti pā.| svasthānāt sañcālya ūrdhvametyāgacchati| taditi ‘tasmād ... ’ iti pā.| yasmādviḍādivāhisrotoduṣṭistato viṇmūtrayoḥ samagandhavarṇaṃ chardayatīti yojyam| atra ‘yadā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| iyaṃ tu chardistridoṣajetyeke| anye tu sarvā eva chardayaḥ prabalāḥ evaṃvidhāḥ satyaḥ asādhyā ityarthaḥ||10-11||

div.ab: bībhatsajā daurhṛdajā''majā ca ‘asātmyajā’ iti pā. | hyasātmajā ca krimijā ca yā hi | sā pañcamī tāṃ ca vibhāvayecca doṣocchrayeṇaiva yathoktamādau ||12|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) |

ab.seg: āgantujāmāha– bībhatsajetyādi| daurhṛdajā daurhṛdālābhajā, āmajā ajīrṇajā, asātmyajā ‘ ... bhojanajā’ iti pā.| asātmyabhakṣaṇādisambhūtā, krimijā koṣṭhakrimisambhavā; bībhatsajetyādinā krimijāntenaikatvenaiva gaṇanīyā, āgantujatvasāmānyāt| atra ‘āgantujvaravat|’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sā pañcamīti tridoṣajāpekṣayā sāmānyenāgantujaiva, āgantujvaravat; yadi tu bībhatsajāpekṣayā krimijā pañcamīti gaṇyate, tadā tāṃ ca vibhāvayet| doṣocchrayeṇaivetyanena krimijāyā eva doṣasambandhaḥ syāt, tataśca bībhatsajādīnāṃ cikitsopayogidoṣasambandho na labhyate| anye tu taddoṣaparihārārthaṃ’ ‘sā pañcamī tāśca’ iti bahuvacanāntaṃ paṭhanti, evaṃ ‘sati antargaṇanamaprayojanamiti antargaṇanayā’ iti pā.| satyantargaṇanayā na prayojanamityantargaṇanāṃ nādriyante| kathamatra doṣocchrayo vibhāvanīya ityāha– yathoktamādāviti| ādau vātādilakṣaṇe ityarthaḥ||12||

āgantujāmāha– bībhatsajetyādi| bībhatsajā pūyāmedhyādidarśanagandhasvādajā, āpannasattvāyā striyā daurhṛdālābhajā, āmajā ajīrṇajā, asātmyajā asātmyabhojanajā, krimijā koṣṭhakrimisambhavā, bībhatsajetyādinā krimijāntā ekaiva gaṇanīyā| evaṃ ‘sarvātirekai ... ’ iti pā.| sarvābhirekaivāgantujatvasāmānyāt, āgantujvaravat| pañcamīti tridoṣajāpekṣayā| āgantujāṃ doṣocchrayeṇaiva jānīyāt| yathoktamādāviti yathā vātādilakṣaṇena ādāviti pūrvoktena||12||

div.ab: śūlahṛllāsabahulā krimijā ca viśeṣataḥ | krimihṛdrogatulyena lakṣaṇena ca lakṣitā ||13|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 49) |

ab.seg: krimijāyā lakṣaṇamāha– śūletyādi| krimihṛdrogatulyena lakṣaṇena lakṣiteti krimihṛdroge ‘krimilakṣaṇavatt’ iti pā.| krimilakṣaṇāt yat pīḍādikaṃ tadasyāṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ||13||

krimijāyā viśeṣalakṣaṇamāha– śūletyādi| kṛmijāyā ayaṃ viśeṣaḥ– hṛcchūlahṛllāsādhikā ‘krimijā ... ’ iti pā.| krimijahṛdrogatulyalakṣaṇena ca lakṣiteti; yathā– “utkledaḥ ṣṭhīvanaṃ todaḥ śūlaṃ hṛllāsakastamaḥ| aruciḥ śyāvanetratvaṃ śoṣaśca krimije bhavet|” iti||13||

div.ab: kṣīṇasya yā chardiratiprasaktā sopadravā śoṇitapūyayuktā | sacandrikāṃ tāṃ pravadedasādhyāṃ sādhyāṃ cikitsennirupadravāṃ ca ||14|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– kṣīṇasyetyādi| sacandrikāmiti medaḥprabhṛtidhātūnāṃ snehaḥ pravartamāno ‘ ... candravat’ iti pā.| mayūrapicchacandrikāvat pratibhāti| nirupadravāmiti kāsādyupadravarahitām| taduktam– “kāsaḥ śvāso jvaro hikkā tṛṣṇā vaicittyameva ca| hṛdrogastamakaścaiva jñeyāścharderupadravāḥ||” iti||14||

asādhyāṃ sādhyāṃ cāha– atiprasaktā atiśayena nirantarā, sopadravā vakṣyamāṇopadravayuktā| sacandrikamiti| medaḥprabhṛtidhātūnāṃ snehaḥ pravartamāno mayūrapicchacandrikāvatpratibhāti| itthaṃ pañcavidhāmapi chardimasādhyāṃ pravadet varjayedityarthaḥ| nirupadravāṃ kāsādyupadravarahitāṃ sādhyāṃ cikitset ‘bhiṣak’ iti śeṣaḥ||14||

tālvoṣṭhakaṇṭhāsyaviśoṣadāhasantāpamohabhramavipralāpāḥ | pūrvāṇi rūpāṇi bhavanti tāsāmutpattikāle tu viśeṣato hi | kāsaḥ ‘śvāso'jvaro’ iti pā. | śvāso jvaro hikkā tṛṣṇā vaicittyameva ca | hṛdrogastamakaścaiva jñeyāścharderupadravāḥ ||15||
tasyā upadravamāha– kāsa ityādi| vaicittyaṃ vimatacittatā||15||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne chardinidānaṃ samāptam ||15||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ chardinidānaṃ samāptam||15||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānaṭīkāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ chardinidānam||15||

div.head: tṛṣṇānidānam
div.ab: atha tṛṣṇānidānam | bhayaśramābhyāṃ balasaṅkṣayādvā ‘ūrdhvam’ iti pā. | hyūrdhvaṃ citaṃ pittavivardhanaiśca | pittaṃ savātaṃ kupitaṃ narāṇāṃ tāluprapannaṃ janayet pipāsām | srotassvapāṃvāhiṣu dūṣiteṣu doṣaiśca tṛṭ sambhavatīha jantoḥ ||1|| tisraḥ smṛtāstāḥ kṣatajā caturthī kṣayāttathā hyāmasamudbhavā ca | bhaktodbhavā saptamiketi tāsāṃ nibodha liṅgānyanupūrvaśastu ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: chardestṛṣṇopadravatvācchardyanantaraṃ tṛṣṇānidānam| tasyāḥ samprāptimāha– bhayetyādi| pittavivardhanairiti kaṭvamloṣṇādibhiḥ krodhopavāsādibhiśca svasthāna eva sañcitaṃ kupitaṃ ca pittaṃ, vātaśca bhayaśramabalakṣayaiḥ kupitaḥ, ūrdhvaṃ prasarat pipāsāṃ janayati| tālvityupalakṣaṇaṃ; tena klomādyapi bodhyaṃ, tasya pipāsāsthānatvenoktatvāt| carake'pyuktam– “rasavāhinīśca ‘ ... tāluklomnaḥ’ iti pā.| dhamanīrjihvāmūlagalatālukaklomnaḥ| saṃśoṣya nṝṇāṃ dehe ‘ ... balām’ iti pā.| kurutastṛṣāmatibalau tau tu||” (ca. ci. a. 22) iti| annakaphāmajānāṃ samprāptimāha– srotaḥsvityādi| nanu, apāṃvāhiṣviti bahuvacanaṃ viruddhaṃ, ‘dve udakavahe’ (su. śā. a. 9) iti suśrutenoktatvāt| naivaṃ, tayorevānekapratānayogāditi| doṣairiti annakaphāmaiḥ, duṣṭikartṛtvādduṣṭadoṣasambandhādvā'nnāmayorapi doṣatvamiti gadādharaḥ ‘gayadāsaḥ’ iti pā.|| tisra iti vātādibhiḥ pratyekam| kṣatajeti ‘ ... nimittavraṇinām’ iti pā.| kṣatanimittā vraṇināṃ yā ‘bhavatīti’ iti pā.| bhavati| caturthītyanenoktānāṃ catasṛṇāṃ sukhasādhyatvaṃ bodhayati, anyāsāṃ tu kaṣṭasādhyatvam||1-2||

chardestṛṣṇopadravatvācchardyanantaraṃ tṛṣṇānidānaṃ, tasyāḥ samprāptimāha– atra ‘bhayaśramabalakṣayaiḥ kupito vāyuḥ’ iti pā.| bhayaśramābhyāmityādi| pittavivardhanaiḥ kaṭvamloṣṇādibhiḥ krodhopavāsādibhiśca svasthāne hṛdi sañcitaṃ pittaṃ, vātaśca bhayaśramabalakṣayaiḥ kupitaḥ, ūrdhvaṃ prasaran pipāsāṃ janayet| tāluprapannamiti savātaṃ pittaṃ tālugatamityarthaḥ| tālvityupalakṣaṇam; tena klomagatamapi boddhavyaṃ, ‘tasyāḥ’ iti pā.| tasya pipāsāsthānatvāt| uktaṃ ca carake– “rasavāhinīśca dhamanīrjihvāmūlagalatālukaklomnaḥ| saṃśoṣya nṛṇāṃ dehe kurutastṛṣāmatibalau tau tu” iti| annakaphajāmajānāṃ samprāptimāha– srotaḥsvityādi| nanu srotaḥsviti bahuvacanaṃ viruddhaṃ yaduktaṃ suśrute– “dve udakavahe” iti| maivaṃ, tayorevānekapratānayogāditi| atra ‘doṣairiti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| annakaphāmaiḥ, duṣṭikartṛtvādduṣṭadoṣasambandhādannāmayorapi doṣatvamiti gayadāsaḥ| tisra iti vātādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ, kṣatajeti kṣatanimittā vraṇināṃ yā bhavati, caturthītyanena coktānāṃ tisṛṇāṃ ‘sukhasādhyatvam’ iti pā.| sādhyatvaṃ bodhayati, anyāsāṃ tu kaṣṭasādhyatvamiti| kṣayādanyā pañcamī, āmasamudbhavā ṣaṣṭhī, bhaktodbhavā saptamiketi, krameṇa tāsāṃ lakṣaṇāni jānīhi||1-2||

div.ab: kṣāmāsyatā mārutasambhavāyāṃ todastathā śaṅkhaśiraḥsu cāpi | srotonirodho virasaṃ ca vaktraṃ śītābhiradbhiśca vivṛddhimeti ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: vātajāmāha– kṣāmāsyatetyādi| kṣāmāsyatā śuṣkadīnamukhatvam| srotonirodho atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| rasāmbuvāhidhamanīnirodhaḥ| śītābhiradbhirityanena vāyoḥ śītasya śītāmbunā vṛddhirityanupaśayanidarśanam| cakārāccarakoktanidrānāśasya grahaṇam| yadāha carakaḥ– “nidrānāśaḥ śiraso bhramastathā śuṣkagalatāluḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 22) iti||3||

vātajāṃ tṛṣṇāmāha– kṣāmetyādi| kṣāmāsyatā śuṣkadīnamukhatvaṃ, vaktuṃ carvituṃ vā'sāmarthyamityeke| śaṅkhaśiraḥsviti śaṅkhayoḥ śirasi vā, todo vyathāviśeṣaḥ; śaṅkhayordvitvena bahuvacanatvam| srotonirodhaḥ rasāmbuvāhidhamanīnirodhaḥ; anye śabdāśravaṇamiti| śītābhiradbhirityanena vāyoḥ śītaḥ sparśaḥ, tena vṛddhirityanupaśayasya nidarśanaṃ; cakārāccarakoktanidrānāśasya grahaṇam||3||

div.ab: mūrchānnavidveṣavilāpadāhā raktekṣaṇatvaṃ pratataśca śoṣaḥ | śītābhinandā mukhatiktatā ca pittātmikāyāṃ paridūyanaṃ ca ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: pittajāmāha– mūrchetyādinā| ‘vilāpaḥ ’ iti pā.| vilāpo'tra pralāpaḥ| pratataśca śoṣaḥ atīva mahatī tṛṣṇā| śītābhinandā śītecchā, ‘gurośca halaḥ’ ityakārapratyayaḥ| ‘paridūyanamanutāpaḥ’ iti pā.| paridūyanamupatāpaḥ, ‘paridhūmanam’ iti pāṭhe'ntaḥkṣobhaṇaṃ, dhūmanirgama iva vā| cakārāt pītaviṇmūtranetratvādayo grāhyāḥ||4||

pittajāmāha– mūrchetyādi| vilāpo vividhaprakāreṇa bhāṣaṇaṃ, raktekṣaṇatvaṃ raktanetratvaṃ, pratataśca śoṣa iti atimahatī tṛṣṇā, śītābhinandā śītecchā, paridūyanamupatāpaḥ, ‘paridhūpanam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatrāntaḥkṣobhaṇaṃ dhūmasyodgiraṇamiva atra ‘vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|,cakārātpītaviṇmūtranetrādayo grāhyāḥ||4||

div.ab: bāṣpāvarodhāt kaphasaṃvṛte'gnau tṛṣṇā balāsena bhavettathā tu | nidrā gurutvaṃ madhurāsyatā ca tṛṣṇārditaḥ śuṣyati cātimātram ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: śleṣmajāmāha– bāṣpetyādi| svakāraṇakupitena kaphenopariṣṭādācchādite'ntaragnau kaphāvaruddhabāṣpeṇa pāvakoṣmaṇā'dhogatenāmbuvahasrotaḥśoṣaṇāt atra ‘kaphajatṛṣṇā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| kaphajā tṛṣṇā bhavati| nanu, kaphajā tṛṣṇā'nupapannā? kaphasya vṛddhasya kevaladravasya pipāsākartṛtvāyogāt, vātapittayoreva tṛṣṇākartṛtvenoktatvāt| yaduktam– “pittaṃ savātaṃ kupitaṃ narāṇāṃ” ityādi| carake'pyuktam– “nāgnervinā tarṣaḥ pavanādvā, tau hi śoṣaṇe hetū|” (ca. ci. a. 22) iti| suśrute'pyuktam– “madyasyāgneyavāyavyaguṇāvambuvahāni tu| srotāṃsi śoṣayeyātāṃ tatastṛṣṇā prajāyate||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) iti| ata āha– tatheti| uktaprakāreṇa kaphādagnerbāṣpāvarodhādinā, natu svaguṇena; ata eva carake kaphajā tṛṣṇā na paṭhitaiva, suśrutena tu cikitsābhedārthaṃ paṭhitā, hārītenāpi sapittenaiva śleṣmaṇā tṛṣṇā paṭhitā na tu kevalena| yadāha– “svādvamlalavaṇājīrṇaiḥ kruddhaḥ śleṣmā sahoṣmaṇā| prapadyāmbuvahaṃ srotastṛṣṇāṃ sañjanayennṛṇām|| śiraso gauravaṃ tandrā mādhuryaṃ vadanasya ca| bhaktadveṣaḥ prasekaśca nidrādhikyaṃ tathaiva ca|| etairliṅgairvijānīyāttṛṣṇāṃ kaphasamudbhavām|” iti||5||

śleṣmajāmāha– bāṣpetyādi| svakāraṇakupitena kaphena saṃvṛte ‘uparicchādite ... ’ iti pā.| upariṣṭādācchādite'ntaragnau kaphāvaruddhabāṣpeṇa atra ‘pāvakoṣmaṇā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| adhogatānāmambuvāhasrotasāṃ śoṣaṇāt kaphajā tṛṣṇā bhavati| nanu kaphena tṛṣṇā'nupapannā? kaphasya vṛddhasya kevaladravabhūtasya pipāsākartṛtvāsambhavāt, vātapittayoreva tṛṣṇākartṛtvenoktatvāt; yaduktam– “pittaṃ savātaṃ kupitaṃ narāṇām” ityādi| carake'pyuktam– “nāgnervinā hi tarṣaḥ pavanādvā tau hi śoṣaṇe hetū” iti| suśrute'pyuktaṃ “madyasyāgneyavāyavyau guṇāvambuvahāni ca| srotāṃsi śoṣayeyātāṃ tatastṛṣṇā pravartate” iti| ata evāha– tatheti| uktaprakāreṇa kaphādagnerbāṣpāvarodhādinā na tu svaguṇena, ata eva carakeṇa kaphajā tṛṣṇā na paṭhitaiva, suśrute tu cikitsābhedārthaṃ paṭhitā, hārītenāpi sapittena śleṣmaṇaiva tṛṣṇā paṭhitā na tu kevalā| “svādvamlalavaṇājīrṇaiḥ kruddhaḥ śleṣmā sahoṣmaṇā| prapadyāmbuvahaṃ srotastṛṣṇāṃ sañjanayennṛṇām|| śiraso gauravaṃ tandrā mādhuryaṃ vadanasya ca| bhaktadveṣaḥ prasekaśca nidrādhikyaṃ tathaiva ca|| liṅgairetairvijānīyāttṛṣṇāṃ kaphasamudbhavām” atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| tayā tṛṣṇayā pīḍito manuṣyo'titarāṃ kṛśo bhavati, dhātūnāmanupacayāt||5||

div.ab: kṣatasya rukśoṇitanirgamābhyāṃ tṛṣṇā caturthī kṣatajā matā tu |6| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |
kṣatajāmāha– kṣatasyetyādi| śastrādikṣatayuktasya|6|–
kṣatajāmāha– atra ‘kṣatasyeti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| śastrādikṣatayuktasya narasya rukpīḍanācchoṇitasrāvācca tṛṣṇā jāyate| sā kṣatasambhavā caturthī|6|–

rasakṣayādyā kṣayasambhavā sā tayā'bhibhūtaśca niśādineṣu ||6|| pepīyate'mbhaḥ sa sukhaṃ na yāti tāṃ sannipātāditi kecidāhuḥ | etaccātaṅkadarpaṇakāro mūle nāṅgīkaroti rasakṣayoktāni ca lakṣaṇāni tasyāmaśeṣeṇa bhiṣagvyavasyet ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: kṣayaśabdasyānekaviṣayatvāt kṣayajāṃ viśeṣayannāha– rasakṣayādityādi| pepīyate punaḥ punaḥ pibati; etacca viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvatṛṣṇāsu tathābhūtatvāt| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “satataṃ yaḥ pibedvāri na tṛptimadhigacchati| punaḥ kāṅkṣati toyaṃ ca taṃ tṛṣṇārditamādiśet||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 58) iti| rasakṣayoktāni ca lakṣaṇāni suśrutoktāni| tadyathā– “rasakṣaye hṛtpīḍā kampaḥ atra ‘śoṣaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śoṣaḥ śūnyatā tṛṣṇā ca|” (su. sū. a. 15) iti| tasyāṃ kṣayajāyām| aśeṣeṇa kārtsnyena||6-7||

kṣayaśabdasyānekaviṣayatvāt kṣayajāṃ viśeṣayannāha– rasakṣayādityādi| rasakṣayoktāni ca lakṣaṇāni tasyāmaśeṣeṇa bhiṣagvyavasyet| rasakṣayāttṛṣṇā bhavati, sā kṣayajā jñeyā| tayā vyāptaḥ pumān jalaṃ pepīyate punaḥ punaḥ pibati, paraṃ sukhaṃ na labhate, jalena tṛpto na bhavatītyarthaḥ| etacca viśeṣaparaṃ, sarvatṛṣṇāsu tathābhūtatvāt| tāṃ kecana sannipātāt kathayanti| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “satataṃ yaḥ pibettoyaṃ na tṛptimadhigacchati| punaḥ kāṅkṣati toyaṃ ca taṃ tṛṣṇārditamādiśet” iti| rasakṣayoktāni tu lakṣaṇāni suśrutoktāni– tathā ca “rasakṣaye hṛtpīḍā kampaḥ śoṣaḥ śuṣkatā tṛṣṇā ca” iti| etāni samastānyapi bhavanti||6-7||

div.ab: tridoṣaliṅgā''masamudbhavā ca hṛcchūlaniṣṭhīvanasādakartrī |8| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |
āmajāmāha– tridoṣetyādi| tridoṣaliṅgā tridoṣaliṅgayuktā| ‘āme hi ajīrṇe'jīrṇāt ... ’ iti pā.| āmādajīrṇāttridoṣakopaḥ syāditi|8|–
āmajāmāha– tridoṣetyādi| tridoṣaliṅgā tridoṣaliṅgayuktā| sādo'ṅgānām| etānupadravān karoti| āme hi ajīrṇāttridoṣakopaḥ syāditi| uktaṃ ca suśrute– “ajīrṇātpavanādīnāṃ vibhramo balavānbhavet” iti|8|–
snigdhaṃ tathā'mlaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca bhuktaṃ gurvannamevāśu tṛṣāṃ karoti ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 48) |

ab.seg: bhuktodbhavāmāha– snigdhamityādi| cakārāt kaṭu ca, ‘na ca’ iti pā.| natu tiktakaṣāyamadhurāṇītyarthaḥ| guruśabdena mātrāguru dravyaguru ca gṛhyate| dṛḍhabalena tu pañca tṛṣṇāḥ paṭhitāḥ, vātapittakṣayāmopasargajāḥ (ca. ci. a. 22) iti; tatra, kaphajā āmajāyāmevāvaruddhā; kṣatajā vātajāyāṃ; bhaktajā ca vātajāyāṃ, bhaktāvaraṇena vātaprakopāt; pittajāyāṃ vā, vidāhena ‘pittaprakopaṇāt’ iti pā.| pittaprakopāt| suśrute copasargajā yathāsvaṃ doṣajāsu| nanu, madyajā'pi suśrutena madātyaye (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) paṭhitā, tat kathaṃ saptetyucyate? satyaṃ, tasyā vātapittajāyāmavarodhaḥ, evaṃ dṛḍhabalamate'pi||8||

bhaktodbhavāmāha– snigdhamityādi| cakārāt kaṭu ca, na tu tiktakaṣāyamadhurāṇītyarthaḥ| guruśabdena mātrāguru dravyaguru ca gṛhyate| dṛḍhabalena tu pañca tṛṣṇā uktāḥ vātapittakṣayāmopasargajanitā iti| tatra kaphajāyāmāmajā'ntarbhūtā, vātājāyāṃ kṣatajā; bhaktajā'pi vātajāyāṃ, bhaktāvaraṇena vātakopāt, pittajāyāṃ vā vidāhena pittakopāt| suśrute ‘ca upasargāt’ iti pā.| copasargajā ‘yathā’ iti pā.| yathāsvaṃ doṣajāsu| nanu, madyajā'pi suśrute madātyaye paṭhitā, tat kathaṃ saptetyucyate? tasyā vātajāyāmantarbhāvāt; evaṃ dṛḍhabalamate'pi||8||
dīnasvaraḥ pratāmyan dīnaḥ saṃśuṣkavaktragalatāluḥ | bhavati khalu yopasargāttṛṣṇā sā śoṣiṇī kaṣṭā ||9||

tatropasargajāmāha– dīnetyādi| dīnasvaraḥ kṣāmavacanaḥ, pratāmyan muhyan, dīnaḥ klāntaḥ| upasargāditi ‘upadravāt’ iti pā.| upadravādrogāt; upadravaśabdaśca sāmānyena rogamātre'pi vartate, yathā– “nirūhopadravacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|” (su. ci. a. 38) ityatra| kaṣṭā kaṣṭasādhyā, vyādhikarṣitadehatvāt||9||

tatropasargajāmāha– dīnetyādi| dīnasvaraḥ kṣāmavacanaḥ, pratāmyan muhyan, dīnaḥ klāntaḥ, upasargāditi upadravāt rogāt, upadravaśabdastu sāmānyena rogamātre'pi vartate| yathā– “nirūhopadravacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ” iti| śoṣiṇī dhātuśoṣaṇātmikā| sā kaṣṭā kaṣṭasādhyā, vyādhikarṣitadehatvāt||9||

div.ab: jvaramohakṣayakāsaśvāsādyupasṛṣṭadehānām |10| (ca. ci. a. 22) |
tānevopasargānāha– jvaretyādi| ādiśabdenātīsārādīnāṃ grahaṇam|10|–
tānevopasargānāha– jvaretyādi| ādiśabdenātīsārādīnāṃ grahaṇam| etairvyādhibhirgṛhītadehānāṃ nṛṇām; atra pūrvalakṣaṇānurodhaḥ|10|–
sarvāstvatiprasaktā rogakṛśānāṃ vamiprayuktānām | ghoropadravayuktāstṛṣṇā maraṇāya vijñeyāḥ ||10|| (ca. ci. a. 22) |

ab.seg: asādhyānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha– sarvāstvityādi| sarvā vātajādayaḥ, atiprasaktā atipravṛddhāḥ| ghoropadravayuktā mukhaśoṣādibhirbalavadbhirupadravaiḥ samanvitā iti jejjaṭaḥ||10||

asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– sarva ityādi| atiprasaktā atipravṛddhā, etacca– ‘vamiprasaktānām’ iti pā.| vamiprasaktānāmiti śarīraśleṣmaśodhanāya vamanaśīlānām, ghoropadravayuktāḥ śvāsaśoṣādibhirbalavadbhirupadravairyuktā iti jejjaṭaḥ| tā maraṇakārikā ityarthaḥ||10||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne tṛṣṇānidānaṃ samāptam ||16||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ tṛṣṇānidānaṃ samāptam||16||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānaṭīkāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ tṛṣṇānidānam||16||

div.head: mūrchābhramanidrātandrāsannyāsanidānam
div.ab: atha mūrchā-bhrama-nidrā-tandrā-sannyāsanidānam | kṣīṇasya bahudoṣasya viruddhāhārasevinaḥ | vegāghātādabhighātāddhīnasattvasya vā punaḥ ||1|| karaṇāyataneṣūgrā bāhyeṣvābhyantareṣu ca | niviśante yadā doṣāstadā mūrchanti mānavāḥ ||2|| sañjñāvahāsu nāḍīṣu pihitāsvanilādibhiḥ | tamo'bhyupaiti sahasā sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛt ||3|| sukhaduḥkhavyapohācca naraḥ patati kāṣṭhavat | moho mūrcheti tāmāhuḥ ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā ||4|| vātādibhiḥ śoṇitena madyena ca viṣeṇa ca | ṣaṭsvapyetāsu pittaṃ tu prabhutvenāvatiṣṭhate ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg: tṛṣṇāyāṃ moho bhavatīti tṛṣṇānantaraṃ mūrchā, uktaṃ hi– ‘tṛṣito mohamāyāti’ iti| nidānaṃ samprāptiṃ cāha– kṣīṇasyetyādi| bahudoṣasyeti vipuladoṣasya, na tvanekadoṣasya; tathā satyekadoṣajāyāḥ samprāptirnoktā syāt| vegāghātāt malādivegadhāraṇāt| ‘abhighātāt laguḍādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| abhighātāllaguḍādeḥ| hīnasattvasya hīnasattvaguṇasya| karaṇaṃ manaḥ, tasyāyatanāni bāhyāni cakṣurādīni, ābhyantarāṇi manovahāni srotāṃsi, yairāgatya manaścakṣurādīnyadhitiṣṭhati; athavā bāhyāni karmendriyāṇi, ābhyantarāṇi dhīndriyāṇi; teṣu yadā ugrā doṣā niviśante tadā mūrchantīti yojyam| punaḥ kayā samprāptyā ityata āha– sañjñāvahāsvityādi| sañjñāvahanāḍīśabdena sirādhamanīsrotasāṃ grahaṇamityāhuḥ, yatastairmana ‘indriyādideśam’ iti pā.| indriyadeśaṃ prāpnoti| pihitāsu āvṛtāsu| tamo manoguṇo'jñānahetuḥ, abhyupaiti vardhate, sahasā jhaṭiti| anyeṣu tamobahuleṣu rogeṣu madātyayādiṣu sattvarajasī atra ‘dṛśyete’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| na tathā līyete, yathā mūrchāyāmityata āha– sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛditi| sukhaduḥkhayorasaṃvittikaram| etattu prāyikatvenoktaṃ, (trividhaṃ jñānaṃ bhavati heyopādeyopekṣaṇīyabhedāt,) tenopekṣaṇīyajñānābhāvo'pi jñeyaḥ| vyavahārārthaṃ tatparyāyāmāha– moho mūrcheti| vātādibhistisraḥ, śoṇitamadyaviṣaiśca tisraḥ, evaṃ ṣaṭ| prabhutveneti vyāpakatvena, tena vātajādiṣvapi jvaravadrogamahimnā'vaśyaṃ pittasambandhaḥ, ata eva vakṣyati– “mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyā” iti, cikitsāyāṃ ca śītakriyāvidhānamiti||1-5||

tṛṣṇāyāṃ moho bhavatītyatastṛṣṇānantaraṃ mūrchārambhaḥ, tasyā nidānapūrvā samprāptimāha– kṣīṇasyeti puruṣasya| bahudoṣasyeti vipuladoṣasya vegāghātāt malādivegavidhāraṇāt| abhighātāllaguḍādeḥ| viruddhāhārasevinaḥ viruddha āhāraḥ kṣīramatsyādiḥ| hīnasattvasya kṣīṇasattvaguṇasya| karaṇaṃ manastasyāyatanāni bāhyāni cakṣurādīni, ābhyantarāṇi manovāhīni srotāṃsi vairāgatya manaścakṣurādīnyadhitiṣṭhati; athavā bāhyāni karmendriyāṇi ābhyantarāṇi ‘buddhīndriyāṇi’ iti pā.| dhīndriyāṇi| teṣu yadā ugrā atiprasṛtā doṣā niviśante avatiṣṭhante, tadā mānavā mūrchanti, iti yojyam| samprāptimāha– sañjñāvahāsviti| atra ‘“sukhaduḥkhavyapohācca naraḥ patatīkāṣṭhavat”’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sañjñāvahanāḍīśabdena ‘śirā ... ’ iti pā.| sirādhamanīsrotasāṃ grahaṇaṃ, yatastairindriyadeśaṃ manaḥ prāpnoti| pihitāsu ruddhāsu| tamo manoguṇaḥ ajñānahetuḥ, tasyāvaraṇātmakatvāt| abhyupaiti vardhate, sahasā jhaṭiti| anyeṣu tamobahuleṣu rogeṣu madātyayādiṣu na tathā sattvarajasī līyete yathā mūrchāsvityata āha– agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sukhaduḥkhavyapohakṛditi; sukhaduḥkhayorvyapohastiraskārastayorasaṃvittirityarthaḥ; athavā sukhaṃ sattvaṃ, duḥkhaṃ rajaḥ, tayorvyapohakṛt, tamasā tayorāvṛtatvāt; ataḥ ‘kāṣṭhavanniṣpatati ... ’ iti pā.| kāṣṭhavannipatatītyarthaḥ| vyavahārārthaṃ tatparyāyānāha– moho mūrcheti tasyāḥ paryāyau| uktaṃ cābhidhānāntare– “sañjñopaghāte mūrchāyo mūrchā syānmūrchanaṃ tathā| kaśmalaṃ pralayo mohaḥ sannyāsastu mṛtopamaḥ” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| sā ca mūrchā ṣaḍvidhā ṣaṭprakārā bhavati| vātādibhiḥ śoṇitamadyaviṣaiśca tisraḥ, evaṃ ṣaḍvidhatvamāha– vātādibhiriti| prabhutveneti vātādiṣvapi vyāpakatvena pittamevāvatiṣṭhate ‘jvarahṛroga ... ’ iti pā.| jvaravadrogamahimnā'vaśyaṃ pittasambandhaḥ; ihaiva vakṣyatyagre– “mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyā” iti, cikitsāyāṃ ca śītakriyāvidhānamiti ||1-5||

div.ab: hṛtpīḍā jṛmbhaṇaṃ glāniḥ sañjñādaurbalyameva ca | sarvāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇi, yathāsvaṃ tā vibhāvayet ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg: tasyāḥ pūrvarūpamāha– hṛtpīḍetyādi| sañjñādaurbalyamasamyagjñānatā| sarvāsāṃ pūrvarūpāṇīti chedaḥ| yathāsvaṃ vibhāvayediti ‘tāṃ mūrchām’ iti pā.| tāḥ mūrchāḥ vātādibhedena jānīyāt vyaktarūpāvasthāyāṃ, natu pūrvarūpāvasthāyāmiti jejjaṭaḥ||6||

tasyāḥ pūrvarūpamāha– hṛdityādi| sañjñādaurbalyamasamyagjñānatā| pūrvarūpāṇīti pādatrayeṇa chedaḥ| yathāsvaṃ atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| vibhāvayediti tāṃ mūrchāṃ vātādibhedena jānīyādityarthaḥ; vyaktarūpāvasthāyāṃ natu pūrvarūpāvasthāyāmiti jejjaṭaḥ||6||

div.ab: nīlaṃ vā yadi vā kṛṣṇamākāśamathavā'ruṇam | paśyaṃstamaḥ praviśati śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyate ||7|| vepathuścāṅgamardaśca prapīḍā hṛdayasya ca | kārśyaṃ śyāvā'ruṇā chāyā mūrchāye vātasambhave ||8|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: tā evāha (vātajāmāha)– nīlamityādi| nīlaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇaṃ rūkṣakṛṣṇam, aruṇamīṣallohitam| tamaḥ praviśatyandhakāramiva praviśati mūrchatītyarthaḥ| śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyata iti vāyoḥ śīghrakāritvāt| kārśyaṃ śyāvā'ruṇā chāyā, ‘gātrasyeti’ iti pā.| ‘gātre’ iti śeṣaḥ| mūrchāyaśabdo mūrchāparyāyaḥ||7-8||

vātajāmāha– nīlamityādi| nīlaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇam, aruṇamīṣallohitamīdṛśaṃ gaganaṃ paśyan tamaḥ praviśati andhakāramiva praviśati mūrchatītyarthaḥ| śīghraṃ ca pratibuddhyate vāyoḥ śīghrakāritvāt| kārśyaṃ śyāvā'ruṇā chāyā gātrasyeti śeṣaḥ| mūrchāyaśabdo mūrchāparyāyaḥ||7-8||

div.ab: raktaṃ haritavarṇaṃ vā viyat pītamathāpi vā | paśyaṃstamaḥ praviśati sasvedaśca prabudhyate ||9|| (sapipāsaḥ sasantāpo raktapītākulekṣaṇaḥ) | agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate jātamātre patati ca śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyate | sambhinnavarcāḥ pītābho mūrchāye pittasambhave ||10|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: pittajamūrchāyamāha– raktamityādi| viyadākāśam| atra “sapipāsaḥ sasantāpo raktapītākulekṣaṇaḥ|” iti kvacidadhikaḥ pāṭha||9-10||

pittajāmāha– raktamityādi| viyadākāśaṃ, raktaṃ, haritavarṇaṃ śākavarṇaṃ, pītaṃ vā paśyan tamaḥ praviśatīti mūrchatītyarthaḥ| yadā prabudhyate tadā svedo bhavati, sapipāsaḥ tṛṣṇānvitaḥ, santāpavāṃśca bhavati| rakte pīte ākule traste iva īkṣaṇe locane yasya sa tathā| ‘anye raktapittākulekṣaṇaḥ’ iti paṭhanti| tatra raktapitto vikāraḥ| (jātamātre utpannamātre, patati śīghraṃ ca pratibudhyate|) pītābhaḥ pītaśarīracchaviḥ||9-10||

div.ab: meghasaṅkāśamākāśamāvṛtaṃ vā tamoghanaiḥ | paśyaṃstamaḥ praviśati cirācca pratibudhyate ||11|| gurubhiḥ prāvṛtairaṅgairyathaivārdreṇa carmaṇā | saprasekaḥ sahṛllāso mūrchāye kaphasambhave ||12|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: kaphajamūrchāyamāha– meghetyādi| tamoghanairiti tamobhirghanaiśca; tamo'ndhakāraḥ, ghano'tra meghavācī||11-12||
śleṣmajāmāha– meghasaṅkāśamityādi| ārdreṇa carmaṇā iva prāvṛtairveṣṭitairaṅgairupalakṣitaḥ| praseko mukhasrāvaḥ, upasthitavamanatvamiva||11-12||
ab.note: atra ‘yathā catvāro'pasmārā vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā sannipātena, tadvanmūrchā apītyarthaḥ’ ityadhikamātaṅkadarpaṇe

div.ab: sarvākṛtiḥ sannipātādapasmāra ivāgataḥ | sa jantuṃ pātayatyāśu vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitaiḥ ||13|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: sānnipātikamāha– sarvetyādi| nanu, sarvākṛtiriti viruddham, uddeśe “ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā” ityabhihitatvāt; sannipātajayā atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| saha ‘saptatvaṃ prasajyeta’ iti pā.| sapta prasajyeran? ucyate– uddeśaḥ suśrutagranthena, carakagranthena ca vivaraṇam| carake ‘hi ekajāḥ tridoṣajā’ iti pā.| hyekajāstisrastridoṣajā ‘caiketi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | caiketi catasraḥ paṭhyante| yaduktamaṣṭodarīya– “catvāro mūrchāyā iti apasmārairvyākhyātāḥ|” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti| raktamadyaviṣajānāṃ yathādoṣametāsvantarbhāvaḥ; suśrute caitā raktādijā lakṣaṇacikitsābhedakhyāpanārthaṃ sākṣāt paṭhitāḥ, tridoṣajāyāḥ doṣajāsvantarbhāvaḥ ityabhiprāyeṇa bheda ācāryayoḥ; saṅgrahe cātra sarvatantrasvīkārādubhayamapi likhitamityadoṣaḥ| apasmāra iveti ‘yathā'pasmārī’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā'pasmārī mahatā'bhighātena patati cireṇa pratibudhyate| apasmāre phenavāmitvadantaghaṭṭanākṣivaikṛtādikamadhikamiti bhedaḥ| bībhatsaceṣṭitairiti phenavāmitvādibhireva||13||

sannipātajāmāha– sarvākṛtirityādi| nanu sarvākṛtiriti viruddham? pūrvamuddeśe ‘ṣaḍvidhā sā prakīrtitā’ ityuktaṃ, sannipātajayā saha saptasaṅkhyātvaṃ syāt| ucyate– uddeśaḥ suśrutena vivaraṇaṃ carakeṇa, yatastatra paṭhitā ‘vātādibhistrayaḥ’ iti pā.| vātādibhistisraḥ, tridoṣajā caturthā| yaduktamaṣṭodarīyādhyāye– “catasro mūrchāyā iti apasmāraiḥ vyākhyātāḥ” iti; agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā catvāro'pasmārāḥ vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā sannipātena, tadvanmūrchā apītyarthaḥ| raktamadyaviṣajānāṃ yathāsvaṃ doṣajāsvantarbhāvaḥ suśrute etacca lakṣaṇañcikitsābhedakhyāpanārthaṃ sākṣātpaṭhitam| tridoṣajāyāśca doṣajāsvantarbhāvaḥ ityabhiprāyeṇa mādhavena saṅgṛhīteyamiti sarvatantrasvīkārādubhayamapi likhitamityadoṣaḥ| apasmāra ivāgata iti āgatasyāpasmārasya vegavat sā mūrchā jantuṃ prāṇinaṃ śīghraṃ pātayati cirācca pratibudhyate, vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitairiti apasmāre phenāgamanaṃ dantāvaghaṭṭanākṣivaikṛtasattvādidarśanamasti, tridoṣajāyāṃ mūrchāyāṃ tu na tathā, ayameva bhedaḥ; ata eva vinā bībhatsaceṣṭitairiti||13||

div.ab: pṛthivyāpastamorūpaṃ raktagandhastadanvayaḥ | tasmādraktasya gandhena mūrchanti bhuvimānavāḥ ||14|| dravyasvabhāva ityeke dṛṣṭvā yadabhimuhyati | (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg: raktajamūrchāsamprāptimāha– pṛthivyāpa ityādi| pṛthivī āpaśca etaddvayaṃ tamorūpaṃ tamobahulam, uktaṃ hi– “tamobahulā pṛthivī, sattvatamobahulā āpaḥ|” (su. śā. a. 1) iti| ‘pṛthivyambha’ iti pāṭhe ayamevārthaḥ| tadanvayaḥ pṛthivyambho'nvayaḥ; ‘tanmayaḥ’ iti pāṭhe pṛthivījalamayaḥ, prakṛtivikārabhāve mayaṭ| tasmāditi yasmāt pṛthivyāpastamorūpaṃ raktagandhaśca tadanvayaḥ, mūrchā ca tamaḥprāyā, tasmādityarthaḥ| bhuvimānavāḥ iti pāñcabhautikatve'pi śarīrasyodbhūtabhūmiguṇā ye te bhuvimānavāḥ pārthivāḥ, tāmasā ityarthaḥ; natu rājasāḥ, sāttvikā vā| nanu campakādigandhenāpi mūrchā prasajyeta? tatrāpi gandhasya pārthivatvāt pṛthivyāśca tamorūpatvādityata āha– dravyasvabhāva ityādi| raktasyāyaṃ svabhāvaḥ, tena tadgata eva gandho mūrchayatīti| svabhāvameva draḍhayati– dṛṣṭvā yadabhimuhyatīti| ‘yacca dṛṣṭvā'pi muhyati’ iti pāṭhāntaram| anye tu gandhāsambandhe'pi darśanamātrānmūrchopalambhādanaikāntikatvaṃ gandhasya manyamānāḥ svabhāvameva hetvantaramāhuḥ; etena gandhasya prāyikatvamuktam| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | anye tu gandhasya hetutvamapāsya darśanasyaiva hetutvaṃ manyanteḥ; tanna, ‘yadāha bheḍaḥ’ iti pā.| yadāha bhojaḥ– “stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭirbhavati gūḍhocchvāsastathaiva ca darśanādasṛjastajjādgandhāccaiva pramuhyati||” iti| “pṛthivyā yattamorūpam iti” pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam| ‘pṛthivyāpastamorūpā’ iti pā.| “pṛthivyambhastamorūpaṃ raktagandhena tattrayam|” iti pāṭhāntarasya jejjaṭalikhitasyāyamarthaḥ– raktagandhena tu yaduktamavyabhicaritaṃ prakṛtivikārayostādarthyāt kiṃ tattrayamityata uktam– pṛthivyambhastamorūpamiti; pṛthivyambhastamasāṃ rūpamityarthaḥ, śeṣaṃ pūrvavat| dṛṣṭveti raktamiti śeṣaḥ||14||

pṛthvītyādi| pṛthivī āpa etadubhayaṃ tamorūpaṃ tamobahulam| uktaṃ hi suśrute– “tamobahulā pṛthvī sattvatamobahulā āpaḥ” iti tadanvayaḥ| ‘pṛthivyambha ... ’ iti pā.| “pṛthivyāpastamorūpaṃ raktagandhaśca tanmayaḥ” iti pāṭhe tanmaya iti pṛthivījalamayastadanvayāt| gandhe'pi tamastvaṃ siddhaṃ; mūrchā ca tamaḥprāyā, tasmādityarthaḥ| anye ‘pṛthivyambhā’ iti paṭhanti| tatra pṛthivī cāmbhaśca pṛthivyambhasī tayoḥ sambandhi yattamaḥ tadrūpaṃ tadbahulaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ raktamiti; rūpaśabdo'tra bāhulye svalakṣaṇe vā vartate, yataḥ sattvarajastamasāṃ paramaṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭipathaṃ nopagacchati kintu viśeṣeṣvabhivyajyate, sarva eva viśeṣāstamomayā ityuktatvāt| bhuvimānavā iti pāñcabhautikatve'pi śarīrasyodbhūtabhūmiguṇāḥ, etai bhuvimānavāḥ pārthivāstāmasā ityarthaḥ| tasmādye mānavāstāmasā bhavanti ta eva raktagandhena mūrchanti na tu rājasāḥ sāttvikā vā raktagandhena mūrchantīti bhāvaḥ| nanu, campakādigandhenāpi mūrchā prasajyeta tatrāpi gandhasya pārthivatvāt, pṛthivyāśca tamorūpatvādityatrāha– dravyasvabhāva ityeke dṛṣṭvā yadabhimuhyatīti; raktasyāyaṃ svabhāvo yena ‘tadvadgatagandho’ iti pā.| tadgatagandho mūrchayatīti| prabhāvameva draḍhayati– dṛṣṭvā'pi yanmūrchayatīti ‘raktam’ iti śeṣaḥ| yadāha bhojaḥ– “stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭirbhavati gūḍhocchvāsastathaiva ca| darśanādasṛjastajjādgandhāccaiva pramuhyati” iti||14||

div.ab: guṇāstīvrataratvena sthitāstu viṣamadyayoḥ ||15|| ta eva tasmāttābhyāṃ tu mohau syātāṃ yatheritau | (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg: viṣamadyaje prāha– guṇā ityādi| guṇā daśa; yaduktaṃ dṛḍhabalena– “laghu rūkṣamāśu viśadaṃ vyavāyi tīkṣṇaṃ vikāśi sūkṣmaṃ ca| uṣṇamanirdeśyarasaṃ daśaguṇamuktaṃ viṣaṃ tajjñaiḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 23) iti| te tailādau vyastāstīvrāḥ santi, viṣamadyayostu tīvratarāḥ, atastailādibhirna mohaḥ, kintu viṣamadyābhyāmiti| ta eveti guṇā laghutvādayaḥ| yatheritāviti viṣajo moho na svayaṃ nivartate viṣasyāpākitvāt, madyajastu ‘madyapariṇāmāt’ iti pā.| madyapariṇāmādeva śāmyati, ayaṃ ca bhedo viṣamadyayoḥ prabhāvāt| uktaṃ hi tantrāntare– “ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāḥ sannipātaprakopaṇāḥ| ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe ‘ca’ iti pā.| tu balavattarāḥ||” iti||15||

div.ab: viṣamadyaje prāha– guṇā ityādi| tatra guṇā daśa, yaduktaṃ dṛḍhabalena– “laghu rūkṣamāśu viśadaṃ vyavāyi tīkṣṇaṃ vikāśi sūkṣmaṃ ca| uṣṇamanirdeśyarasaṃ daśaguṇamuktaṃ viṣaṃ tajjñaiḥ” iti| te guṇāstailādau vyastāstīvrāḥ santi, viṣamadyayostu tīvratarāḥ, atastailādibhirna mohaḥ, kintu viṣamadyābhyāṃ moha eveti; guṇā laghutvādayaḥ ta eva guṇā atra ‘viguṇā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| viṣamadyayostīvrataratvena sthitāḥ| tatrāpi bhedaḥ– viṣe tīvratamāḥ, madye tīvratarāḥ, tailādiṣu tīvrā vyastāḥ| yatheritāviti tābhyāṃ viṣamadyābhyāṃ yatheritau taratamādibhedena yathoktau mohau syātām| viṣeṇa tīvratamaḥ, madyena tīvratara ityarthaḥ| viṣajo mohaḥ svayaṃ na nivartate, viṣasyāpākitvāt; madyajastu madyapariṇāmādeva śāmyati, viṣajo mohaḥ svayaṃ na nivartate, viṣasyāpākitvāt; madyajastu madyapariṇāmādeva śāmyati, viṣamadyayostvayameva bhedaḥ prabhāvāt, uktaṃ hi tantrāntare– “ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktā sannipātaprakopiṇaḥ| ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe tu balavattarāḥ” iti|15|

stabdhāṅgadṛṣṭistvasṛjā gūḍhocchvāsaśca mūrchitaḥ ||16|| madyena vilapaṃśchete naṣṭavibhrāntamānasaḥ | gātrāṇi vikṣipan bhūmau jarāṃ yāvanna yāti tat ||17|| vepathusvapnatṛṣṇāḥ syustamaśca viṣamūrchite | veditavyaṃ tīvrataraṃ yathāsvaṃ viṣalakṣaṇaiḥ ||18|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 46) |

ab.seg: raktajādimūrchātrayasya rūpāṇyāha– stabdhāṅgetyādi mūrchita ityantaṃ raktajāyāḥ gūḍhocchvāsaścāspaṣṭocchvāsaḥ| ‘mūḍha’ iti pāṭhe sanniruddha ityarthaḥ iti jejjaṭaḥ| madyenetyādi tadityantaṃ madyajāyāḥ| ‘naṣṭavibhrāntamānasa’ ityatra niṣṭalan bhrāntamānasaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare niṣṭanan śabdaṃ kurvan| vepathvādinā viṣajāyāḥ| yathāsvaṃ viṣalakṣaṇairiti viṣasya mūlapatrakṣīrādibhedena prātisvikaṃ yallakṣaṇamuktaṃ sauśrutakalpasthāna (su. ka. a. 2) tallakṣaṇayuktā mūrchā bhavatītyarthaḥ||16-18||

raktajāyā rūpamāha– stabdhāṅgetyādinā mūrchita ityantena| gūḍhocchvāsaḥ ityatra mūḍheti pāṭhe atra ‘tatra’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sanniruddhocchvāsaḥ atra ‘ca sphuratītyarthaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| madyajāmāha vilapan pralapan| naṣṭavibhrāntamānasa iti naṣṭaṃ smṛtirahitaṃ vibhrāntaṃ vikṣiptaṃ mānasaṃ cittaṃ yasya sa tathā| jarāṃ yāvanna yāti taditi yāvajjarāṃ paripākaṃ na gacchati tāvadgātrāṇi bhūmau vinikṣipan tāḍayan mūrchitastiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ| viṣajāmāha– vepathvityādi| vepathuḥ kampaḥ; svapno nidrā| tamo'ndhakārapraviṣṭasyevārthāsaṃvittiḥ| yathāsvaṃ viṣalakṣaṇairiti viṣasya mūlakandapatrakṣīrādibhedena yallakṣaṇaṃ suśrute kalpasthāne uktaṃ teṣāṃ lakṣaṇaireva tīvrataratvena yuktā mūrchā bhavatītyarthaḥ||16-18||

div.ab: mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyā rajaḥpittānilādbhramaḥ | tamovātakaphāttandrā nidrā śleṣmatamobhavā ||19|| (su. śā. a. 4) | (cakravadbhramato gātraṃ bhūmau patati sarvadā | bhramaroga iti jñeyo rajaḥpittānilātmakaḥ) |

ab.seg: sañjñānāśasādharmye'pi mūrchādīnāṃ ko bhedaḥ? ityāha– mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyetyādi| tamovātakaphāditi samāhāradvandvaḥ| nidrātandrayoścaitāni kāraṇāni vyastasamastāni; tena suśrutena yadatilaṅghitalakṣaṇe nidrātandre paṭhite ‘te naiva kaphāt’ iti pā.| vinaiva kaphāt atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| atilaṅghanasya śleṣmakṣayahetutvāt||19||

sañjñānāśasādharmyānmūrchāyā bhedānāha– tatra mūrchāhetumāha– mūrchā pittatamaḥprāyā tamoguṇayuktena pittena mūrchā bhavati| bhramahetumāha– raja iti| rajoguṇena pittānilābhyāṃ yuktena bhramo bhavati, tatra bhramaḥ sthāṇau puruṣajñānaṃ, puruṣe viparītasattvajñānādikam; anye cakrasthitasyeva sambhrāmadvastudarśanamiti| atra ‘samāhāra dvandvaikavacanam|’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| tandrāhetumāha– tama iti| tamoguṇena yuktābhyāṃ vātakaphābhyāṃ tandrā bhavati, ‘samāhāradvandvenaikavacanam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | samāhāradvandvenaikavacanam| nidrāhetumāha– śleṣmaṇā militena tamoguṇena nidrā bhavati; tasyā lakṣaṇam– arativiklāntamanasaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayanivṛttiḥ| carake'pi “yadā tu manasi klānte karmātmānaḥ klamānvitāḥ| viṣayebhyo nivartante tadā svapiti mānavaḥ” iti| atra karmātmānaḥ indriyāṇi, nirindriyapradeśe manaso'vasthitirnidretyarthaḥ| suśrutenātilaṅghitalakṣaṇe nidrātandre paṭhite, atilaṅghitasya śleṣmakṣayatvānnidrātandrayostūktakāraṇatvādbhedaḥ| tathā ca nidrāyāmindriyamanomohaḥ, tandrāyāmindriyamohaḥ||19||

div.ab: indriyārtheṣvasaṃvittirgauravaṃ jṛmbhaṇaṃ klamaḥ | nidrārtasyeva yasyehā tasya tandrāṃ vinirdiśet ||20|| (su. śā. a. 24) |

ab.seg: tandrālakṣaṇamāha– indriyārtheṣvityādi| nidrābhramayostu lakṣaṇaṃ noktamiha, atiprasiddhatvāt| ‘nidrā'tividrutamanasaḥ’ iti ka. nidrā hi viplutamanasaḥ sarvendriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayanivṛttiḥ| yadāha carake– “yadā tu manasi klānte karmātmānaḥ klamānvitāḥ| viṣayebhyo nivartante tadā svapiti mānavaḥ||” (ca. sū. a. 21) iti| atra karmātmāna indriyāṇi; nirindriyapradeśe manaso'vasthitirnidreti mate'pyayamevārthaḥ| nidrātandrayostūktakāraṇabhedādbhedaḥ, udbhūtajṛmbhādeścānubhavasiddhatvāditi; tathā atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| nidrāyāmindriyamanomohaḥ; ‘tandrāyāṃ manomohaḥ’ iti pā.| tandrāyāmindriyamohaḥ| bhramalakṣaṇaṃ tu cakrasthitasyeva bhramadvastudarśanamiti||20||

tandrālakṣaṇamāha– indriyārtheṣvityādi| atra ‘indriyārtheṣviti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| indriyārtheṣu viṣayeṣu, asamprāptiragrahaṇam| gauravamaṅgānām| nidrārtasyeva utpannanidrasyeva| asyāgre klamalakṣaṇaṃ ‘yo'nāyāsaḥ śramo dehe pravṛddhaḥ śvāsavarjitaḥ| klamaḥ sa iti vijñeya indriyārthaprabādhakaḥ||’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | paṭhanti– ‘ya ityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ya ityādi| yaḥ śarīre āyāsavarjitaḥ śramaḥ pravṛddho bhavati paraṃ śvāsavarjitaḥ sa klama iti kathitaḥ| indriyārthaprabādhakaḥ viṣayagrahaṇe'samarthaḥ| ayaṃ pāṭho mādhavena na likhitaḥ||20||

div.ab: doṣeṣu madamūrchāyāḥ kṛtavegeṣviti vegaṃ kṛtvā kṣīṇabaleṣu, vego hi doṣāṇāṃ balakṣayakāraṇaṃ bhavati yaduktaṃ viṣamajvare– “kṛtvā vegaṃ gatabalāḥ” ityādi ‘hṛtavegeṣu’ iti pā. | kṛtavegeṣu dehinām | svayamevopaśāmyanti sannyāso nauṣadhairvinā ||21|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: sannyāsasya mūrchādibhyo bhedamāha– doṣeṣvityādi atra ‘(kṛtavegeṣviti vegaṃ kṛtvā'lpabaleṣu yaduktaṃ, viṣamajvare, “vegaṃ kṛtvā gatabalāḥ” ityādi)’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|||21||

sannyāsasya mūrchādibhyo bhedamāha– doṣeṣvityādi| ādiśabdo'tra lupto draṣṭavyaḥ| āviṣṭavegeṣu atra ‘rogeṣu’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| doṣeṣu yā madādibhirmūrchā bhavati sā upaśāntavegeṣu svayamevopaśamaṃ yāti, bhiṣakpratīkāraṃ vinetyarthaḥ; sannyāsastu cikitsakajanasānubhāvauṣadhairvinā na śāmyatītyarthaḥ||21||

div.ab: vāgdehamanasāṃ ceṣṭāmākṣipyātibalā malāḥ | sannyasyantyabalaṃ jantuṃ prāṇāyatanamāśritāḥ ||22|| sa nā sannyāsasannyastaḥ kāṣṭhībhūto mṛtopamaḥ | prāṇairvimucyate śīghraṃ muktvā sadyaḥphalāṃ kriyām ||23|| (ca. sū. a. 24) |

ab.seg: tallakṣaṇamāha– vāgityādi| atibalā ityanena mūrchādyārambhakadoṣebhyo'dhikatvena pravṛddhā doṣāstamaśceti bodhayati| sannyasyanti mohayanti| sa nā puruṣaḥ, sannyāsasannyastaḥ sannyāsapīḍitaḥ, kāṣṭhībhūtaḥ iti atyantaniṣkriyatvena akāṣṭhameva kāṣṭhavadbhūtaḥ, atra ‘amṛta eva mṛtopama iti’ etat kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ata eva mṛtopama iti| muktvā sadyaḥphalāṃ kriyāmiti sūcīvyadhanāñjanāvapīḍanaśūkaśimbīphalāvagharṣaṇādirūpā ‘na’ iti pā.| kriyā yadi kriyate tadā prāṇairna vimucyate, anyathā tu mriyate iti||22-23||

tallakṣaṇamāha– vāgityādi| atibalā iti mūrchādyārambhakadoṣebhyo'dhikatvena pravṛddhāḥ, prāṇāyatanaṃ cetanāsthānaṃ hṛdayamāśritāḥ, vāgdehamanasāṃ ceṣṭāmākṣipya vināśya, abalaṃ hīnasattvaṃ puruṣaṃ, sannyasyanti| tadā sa nā puruṣaḥ, sannyāsasannyastaḥ sannyāsapīḍitaḥ, kāṣṭhībhūta ityatiniṣkriyatvādat akāṣṭhameva kāṣṭhavadbhūtaḥ, ata eva mṛtopamaḥ| muktvā sadyaḥphalāṃ kriyāmiti sadyaḥphalaṃ yasyāstāṃ kriyāṃ tyaktvā ityarthaḥ| tatra sadyaḥphalā kriyā sūcīvyadhanaṃ ‘tīkṣṇāñjanamiva ... ’ iti pā.| tīkṣṇāñjanāvapīḍanakapikacchūphalāvagharṣaṇādirūpā yadā na kriyate tadā prāṇairvimucyate, anyathā tu jīvati||22-23||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne mūrchābhramanidrātandrāsannyāsanidānaṃ samāptam ||17||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ mūrchābhramanidrātandrāsanyāsanidānaṃ samāptam||17||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe rugviniścayavyākhyāne mūrchādinidānam||17||

div.head: pānātyayaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānam

ab.seg: atha pānātyaya-paramada-pānājīrṇa-pānavibhramanidānam | ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāste'pi madye pratiṣṭhitāḥ | tena mithyopayuktena bhavatyugro madātyayaḥ ||1||

‘mūrchā madyena ca viṣeṇa ca’ iti vacanānmūrchānantaraṃ madyavikārān madātyayādīnāha| nanu, kathaṃ madyaṃ mohayatītyāha– ye viṣasyetyādi| te ca viṣaguṇā mūrchādhyāye nidarśitāḥ| mithyopayukteneti ayathāvidhipītena, vidhiścāyaṃ, tadyathā– asyāgre kvacitpustake “śuddhakāyaḥ pibet prātaḥ sopadaṃśaṃ paladvayam| madhyāhne dviguṇaṃ tacca snigdhāhāreṇa pāyayet| pradoṣe'ṣṭapalaṃ tadvanmātrā madyarasāyane|| vāme rāmā ramaṇakuśalā dakṣiṇe pānapātraṃ cāgre dhṛtvā maricalavaṇaiśchāgalaṃ bhṛṣṭamāṃsam| vīṇānādaiḥ parabhṛtakṛtaiḥ kākalīgītayuktaiḥ so'yaṃ dhanyaḥ pibati madirāṃ bhairavo yasya tuṣṭaḥ||” ityadhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | | kusumitalatopagūḍhaiḥ prarūḍhanirantaranavāṅkuranikararomāñcairmadhukaramadhurajhaṅkārasītkārairmuktakaṇṭhakalakaṇṭhakūjitairdakṣiṇasamīraṇasamullasitapallavakarapracāraiḥ taruṇatarubhiḥ ‘upakrāntaratibhi ... ’ iti pā.| upakrāntalatābhiratiśobhaneṣu tuṣārakarakiraṇarājiparājitāśeṣatāpadoṣeṣu ‘pradoṣeṣu’ iti pā.| pradeśeṣu ‘śṛṅgārasamucitā ... ’ iti pā.| śṛṅgārarasasamucitālaṅkṛtikamanīyakāminīsevitaṃ lalitalalanopanīyamānaṃ surabhirucirarūparasopadaṃśaṃ kaṃ nāma parimitaṃ ‘parārdhya ... ’ iti pā.| parārdhamadhupānaṃ na sukhayati? carake tu vistareṇaitaduktam||1||

‘mūrchā madyena viṣeṇa ca’ iti vacanānmūrchānantaraṃ madyavikārānācaṣṭe, nanu kathaṃ ‘viṣaṃ ’ iti pā.| madyaṃ mohayatītyāha– ya ityādi| ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāḥ, te ca viṣaguṇā mūrchādhyāye nidarśitāḥ, te guṇā madye'pi kīrtitāḥ, tena madyena mithyopayuktena ayathāvidhipītenogro madātyayo bhavati| vidhiścāyaṃ; tadyathā– kusumitalatopagūḍhaiḥ ‘ ... navāṅkuravikāra ... ’ iti pā.| prakaṭanirantaranavāṅkuranikararomāñcaiḥ madhukaramadhurajhaṅkārasītkārairmuktakaṇṭha-kalakaṇṭhakūjitairdakṣiṇasamīraṇodvījitasamullasitapallavakara-pracāraistaruṇatarubhirupakrāntataralalatābhiratiśobhaneṣu vanopavaneṣu tuṣārakarakiraṇārañjitapradeśeṣu ‘śṛṅgārasamucitā ... ’ iti pā.| śṛṅgārasarasamucitālaṅkṛtikamanīyakāminīsammitaṃ lalitalalanopanīyamānaṃ surabhirucirarasopadaṃśaṃ kaṃ nāma parimitaṃ madhupānaṃ na sukhayati| carakeṇa tu vistareṇaitaduktam| vidhiḥ prakāraḥ||1||

div.ab: kintu madyaṃ svabhāvena yathaivānnaṃ tathā smṛtam | ayuktiyuktaṃ rogāya yuktiyuktaṃ yathā'mṛtam ||2|| prāṇāḥ prāṇabhṛtāmannaṃ tadayuktyā hinastyasūn | viṣaṃ prāṇaharaṃ tacca yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanam ||3|| (ca. ci. a. 24) |

ab.seg: nanu, viṣasya ye guṇāste cenmadye'pi santi, tarhi viṣavanmadyamanupayojyaṃ prasajyeta? ata āha– kintvityādi| yathaivānnamiti dehadhārakasvabhāvaṃ, tadevāyuktiyuktamavidhiyuktaṃ rogāya; tasmādahitamapi viśiṣṭavidhinopayuktaṃ hitaṃ, hitamapyavidhinopayuktamanarthāya bhavatīti| atraiva dṛṣṭāntamāha– prāṇā ityādi| tadayuktyeti atimātratvādinā visūcyādikaṃ kṛtvā mārayatītyarthaḥ| yuktiyuktamiti yathā carakarasāyanaprayoge uktam– “dvau yavāvatra hemnastu tilaṃ dadyādviṣasya ca|” (ca. ci. a. 1) iti| atra tilamiti tilapramāṇam||2-3||

nanu viṣasya ye guṇāste cenmadye'pi santi tarhi viṣavanmadyamanupayojyaṃ syādityata āha– kintvityādi| madyaṃ svabhāvena prakṛtyā annavat jñeyaṃ dehadhāraṇasvabhāvaṃ, tadevānnaṃ madyaṃ vā ayuktiyuktamavidhiprayuktaṃ rogāya bhavati, yuktiyuktamamṛtavadbhavatītyarthaḥ| tasmādahitamapi viśiṣṭavidhinopayuktaṃ hitaṃ, hitamapyavidhinopayuktamanarthāya bhavati| atraiva dṛṣṭāntamāha– prāṇā iti| annaṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ śarīriṇāṃ prāṇāḥ, śarīradhāraṇātmakatvāt| tadevānnam ayuktyā atimātratvādinā visūcyādīn kṛtvā mārayatītyarthaḥ| atra ‘dṛṣṭāntamāha’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| prāṇaharamapi tadvadviṣaṃ yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanaṃ bhavati, śarīraṃ dhārayatītyarthaḥ||2-3||

div.ab: vidhinā mātrayā kāle hitairannairyathābalam | prahṛṣṭo yaḥ pibenmadyaṃ tasya syādamṛtopamam ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 24) | snigdhaistadannairmāṃsaiśca bhakṣyaiśca saha sevitam | bhavedāyuḥprakarṣāya balāyopacayāya ca ||5|| kāmyatā manasastuṣṭistejo vikrama eva ca | vidhivatsevyamāne tu madye sannihitā guṇāḥ ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: vidhinopayuktasya phalamāha– vidhinetyādi| kāla iti nityage cāvasthike ca; tadyathā– grīṣme śītamadhuraṃ mādhvīkādi, śīte uṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ gauḍikapaiṣṭikādi; tathā vāte snigdhādi; evaṃ vayasyudāhāryam| hitairannairiti vakṣyamāṇasnigdhādibhirmadyaviparītaguṇaiḥ| snigdhairityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānyairapi madyaviparītaguṇairiti boddhavyam| yaduktaṃ suśrutena “madyamamlaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadameva ca| rūkṣamāśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) iti| amlarasatvaṃ ‘ ... udbhūtatvenoktam’ iti pā.| cāsyodbhūtarasatvenoktaṃ; yaduktamanyatra– “sarveṣāmamlajātīnāṃ madyaṃ mūrdhni vyavasthitam||” iti| mūrdhni vyavasthitamutkṛṣṭam| anye'pyatra rasāḥ santi| yadāha bhojaḥ– “maireyaṃ madirā sīdhu caturthaṃ madhu cocyate| ekaikaṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ tatra ‘rasataścāmlamiṣyate’ iti pā.| rasato madyamīritam||” iti| annabhakṣyaśabdayorupādānena prāyo lehyaṃ dravāntarapānaṃ ca madyapānocitaṃ na bhavatīti darśayati| annabhakṣyābhyāṃ labdhe'pi māṃse māṃsagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa hitatvopadarśanārtham| balaṃ śaktiḥ, upacayaḥ sthaulyam| aparamapi vidhisevāguṇamāha– kāmyatetyādi| kāmyatā kamanīyamūrtitā, manasastuṣṭiḥ santoṣaḥ| ‘athavā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | athavā kāmyatā manasa iti kamanīyavastuni manovṛttiḥ, tuṣṭiśca manasa eveti yojyam| teja utsāhaḥ| vikramaḥ parābhibhavārthaṃ balavatī śarīraceṣṭā||4-6||

vidhinopayuktasya phalamāha– vidhinetyādi| vidhiḥ pūrvoktaḥ, tantrāntaroktaśca– “śuddhakāyaḥ pibetprātaḥ sopadaṃśaṃ paladvayam| madhyāhne dviguṇaṃ tacca snigdhāhāreṇa vai pibet, pradoṣe'ṣṭapalaṃ tadvanmātrā madye rasāyanam| ārogyaṃ dhātusāmyaṃ ca vahnikāntibalapradam|| anena vidhinā sevyaṃ madyaṃ nityamatandritaiḥ|” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| anye, “buddhyādayo guṇā yāvadullasanti niratyayāḥ| mātreyaṃ vihitā madye pāne rogāya cāparāḥ||” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kāla iti tatra kālo dvividho nityagaḥ, āvasthikaśca; tatra nityage ṛtusambandhini, yathā– grīṣme śītamadhuraṃ mādhvīkādi, śīte uṣṇatīkṣṇaṃ gauḍikapaiṣṭikādi; āvasthike kāle vāte snigdhādi, evaṃ vayasyapyudāhāryam| hitairannairiti vakṣyamāṇasnigdhatvādibhirmadyaviparītaguṇaiḥ| yathābalaṃ svaśaktyā| evaṃ hṛṣṭo harṣayukto yo madyaṃ pibettasyāmṛtopamaṃ syāt| kaiḥ saha pītaṃ balopacayāya bhavati tānāha– snigdhairityādi| etairvastubhiḥ sevyamānaṃ madyamāyuḥprakarṣāya bhavati tathā balavardhakamiti| snigdhairityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānyairmadyaviparītaguṇairapi boddhavyaṃ, tena tīkṣṇādidaśaguṇaviparītairmṛdvādiguṇaiḥ saha madyaṃ sevyamiti| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “laghutīkṣṇoṣṇasūkṣmāmlavyavāyyāśugameva ca| rukṣaṃ vikāśi viśadaṃ madyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam” iti| tathā ca suśrute– madyamamlaṃ tathā tīkṣṇaṃ sūkṣmaṃ viśadameva ca| rūkṣamāśukaraṃ caiva vyavāyi ca vikāśi ca” iti| amlarasatvaṃ cāsyodbhūtarasatvenoktam| yaduktamanyatra “sarveṣāmamlajātīnāṃ madyaṃ mūrdhni vyavasthitam” iti| mūrdhni vyavasthitamutkṛṣṭam| anye'pyatra rasāḥ santi| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “madyasyāmlasvabhāvasya catvāro'nurasāḥ smṛtāḥ| madhuraśca kaṣāyaśca kaṭukastikta eva ca” iti| yadāha bhojaḥ– ṣaḍrasā iti”madirāyā rasā vyaktā madhuroṣaṇatiktakāḥ| lavaṇāmlakaṣāyāśca trayaḥ sūkṣmatarāḥ smṛtāḥ|| ‘viparyayeṇaitat’ iti pā.| viparyayeṇaitadevaṃ maireye kathitā rasāḥ| mādhvīke sīdhusañjñe ca vyaktau cāmlakaṭū rasau| vyaktā hi śeṣāścatvāro rasā bhojena kīrtitāḥ” iti| annairiti godhūmādibhiḥ| annabhakṣyābhyāṃ labdhe'pi ‘māṃse'pi’ iti pā.| māṃse māṃsagrahaṇaṃ viśeṣeṇa hitatvopadarśanārtham| balaṃ śaktiḥ, upacayaḥ sthaulyam| aparamapi vidhisevāguṇamāha– kāmyatetyādi| kāmyatā kamanīyamūrtitā, manasastuṣṭiḥ santoṣaḥ, teja utsāhaḥ, vikramaḥ parābhibhavārthaṃ balavatī śarīraceṣṭā||4-6||
buddhismṛtiprītikaraḥ sukhaśca pānānnanidrārativardhanaśca | sampāṭhagītasvaravardhanaśca prokto'tiramyaḥ prathamo mado hi ||7||

uktavidhiviparyayeṇa sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ madātyayāya sampadyate; sa ca trividho bhavati– pūrvo, madhyamo'ntimaśceti; teṣāṃ krameṇalakṣaṇamāha– buddhītyādi| buddhiranubhavaḥ, smṛtiranubhūtārthānusandhānam| pānānnanidrārativardhanaśceti pānādiṣu ratiranurāgastadvardhanaḥ| sampāṭhaḥ samyak pāṭhaḥ| gayadāsastu ‘sampāṭhya’ iti paṭhitvā gītanṛtyavādyāni militāni sampāṭhyamucyate, gītaṃ tu kevalameveti vyācaṣṭe| svaro dhvaniḥ| prokto'tiramya iti| nanu manovikārakāritvāt kathamasyātiramyatā? ucyate– ‘manovikārakāratve'pi tadātvena duḥkhāpahatvāt’ iti pā.| manovikārakāritve'pi tadātvena na duḥkhāvahatvāt ata eva suśrutena mānasavikāreṣu harṣaḥ paṭhitaḥ||7||

uktavidhiviparyayeṇa sevyamānaṃ madyaṃ madātyayāya bhavati| sa ca tridhā bhavati madātyayaḥ pūrvo madhyo'ntima iti| teṣāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇamāha– tatra prathamo yathā– buddhītyādi| buddhiranubhavaḥ, smṛtiḥ pūrvānubhūtasmaraṇaṃ, prītiḥ pareṇa maitrī| sukha iti śokādyasmaraṇena manasaḥ prasādādanupahatendriyavṛttitvāt| pānānnanidrārativardhana iti pānādiṣu viṣaye ratiranurāgaḥ, tadvardhanaḥ| sampāṭhaḥ samyakpāṭhaḥ, gītaṃ gānaṃ, svaro dhvaniḥ| prokto'tiramya iti| nanu manovikārakaratvāt kathamasyātiramyatā? ucyate– manovikārakāritve'pi ‘tadanena’ iti pā.| tadātvena duḥkhāvahatvāt| ata eva suśrutena mānasavikāreṣu harṣaḥ paṭhita iti||7||
avyaktabuddhismṛtivāgviceṣṭaḥ sonmattalīlākṛtirapraśāntaḥ | ālasyanidrābhihato muhuśca madhyena mattaḥ puruṣo madena ||8||
dvitīyamadamāha– avyaktetyādi| viceṣṭo viruddhaceṣṭaḥ| unmattasya līlākṛtibhyāṃ saha vartate iti sonmattalīlākṛtiḥ; unmattaprāya ityarthaḥ| apraśāntaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ||8||

madhyamadamāha– avyaktetyādi| unmattasya līlākṛtibhyāṃ saha vartata iti sonmattalīlākṛtiḥ unmattaprāya ityarthaḥ| apraśāntaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ| muhurvāraṃvāram, ālasyanidrābhyāmabhihataḥ pīḍitaḥ, sa caivaṃvidho'tyanupahatendriyavṛttitvāt||8||
gacchedagamyānna gurūṃśca manyet khādedabhakṣyāṇi ca naṣṭasañjñaḥ | brūyācca guhyāni hṛdi sthitāni made tṛtīye puruṣo'svatantraḥ ||9||

tṛtīyamadamāha– gacchedityādi| nanu carake dvitīyatṛtīyayormadhye madāntaraṃ paṭhitaṃ, yadāha– “madhyamaṃ madamutkramya madamaprāpya cottamam| na kiñcidaśubhaṃ kuryurnarā rājasatāmasāḥ|| ko madaṃ tādṛśaṃ gacchedunmādamiva cāparam|” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti; tat kuto'tra na paṭhitam? ucyate– dvitīyamadānte tṛtīyamadasya pūrvāvasthaivātinindanīyā, sutarāṃ tṛtīyo mada iti pratipādanārthaṃ tatpaṭhitaṃ, na tu tayoḥ paramārthato'ntarāle pṛthaṅmadāntaramasti, yathā– “kumbhamīnarkṣayormadhye yadā carati candramāḥ| nāharettṛṇakāṣṭhāni na gaccheddakṣiṇāṃ diśam||” iti| atra hi kumbhasya śeṣāṃśo mīnasya prathamāṃśa etaddvayaṃ madhyaśabdenocyate ityāhuḥ jejjaṭādayaḥ, haricandravyākhyānaṃ tu vistaratvānna likhitam| agamyān gurudārādīn duṣṭayānādīṃśca| naṣṭasañjña iti sañjñā nāmollekhena ‘sañjñājñānaṃ ’ iti pā.| jñānaṃ, tannaṣṭaṃ yasya sa tathā| guhyāni gopyāni| asvatantro madaparavaśaḥ||9||

tṛtīyaṃ madamāha– gacchedityādi| agamyān gurudārādīn| gurūn jyeṣṭhān, na manyeta avagaṇayedityarthaḥ| abhakṣyāṇi śāstraniṣiddhāni, cakārādduṣṭapānādīṃśca| sañjñā nāmollakhena sañjñājñānaṃ tannaṣṭaṃ yasya sa tathā| hṛdi sthitāni guhyāni gopyāni, brūyāt| tathā asvatantro madaparavaśaḥ| sa caivaṃvidho'tīvopahatendriyatvādbhavati||9||
caturthe tu made mūḍho bhagnadārviva niṣkriyaḥ | kāryākāryavibhāgajño mṛtādapyaparo mṛtaḥ ||10||
ko madaṃ tādṛśaṃ gacchedunmādamiva cāparam | bahudoṣamivāmūḍhaḥ kāntāraṃ svavaśaḥ kṛtī ||11||

caturthamadamāha– caturthe tvityādi| kāryākāryavibhāgajñaḥ kāryamakāryamiti buddhyā jānāti| ‘kāryākāryavibhāgajñaḥ’ iti pāṭhe kāryākāryavibhāgayorajña ityarthaḥ| mṛtādapyaparo mṛta iti mṛtamapekṣyāparo'yaṃ mṛta iva, atyantājñānasādharmyāt| ‘adhama’ iti pā.| ‘avaraḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare mṛtādapyadhama ityarthaḥ, tathāvidhāvasthāyāḥ svayaṃ kṛtatvāt| ka ityādi| kaḥ kṛtī agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kuśalaḥ, sukṛtī vā, kṛtakṛtyo vā; svavaśo'parādhīnaḥ, tādṛśamuktaprakāreṇa ninditaṃ madaṃ gacchet prāpnuyāt; na kaścidevaṃvidhaṃ prāpnuyādityarthaḥ| kamivetyāha– bahudoṣamivāmūḍhaḥ kāntāramiti bahudoṣaṃ hiṃsrādiyuktaṃ, kāntāraṃ dūraśūnyamadhvanam| yaduktaṃ carake– “gacchedadhvānamasvantaṃ bahudoṣamivā'dhvagaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti; evaṃ videhe'pi paṭhitamiti| atrāsvantamaśobhamānamaniṣṭaphalatvena| nanu, carakavidehavāgbhaṭādibhiścaturtho mado na paṭhitastatkathaṃ suśrutena paṭhitaḥ? ucyate– carake yā dvitīyatṛtīyayorantarālāvasthā paṭhitā, saiva suśrutena tṛtīyo mada iti kṛtvā paṭhitaḥ, yastu carake tṛtīyaḥ sa ca suśrute caturthaḥ paṭhita ityāvirodhaḥ| vastugatyā tu traya eva madā ‘ityupapātam’ iti pā.| ityupapāditam| nanu, kiṅkāraṇametattraividhyamiti cet? ucyate– madyaṃ hi vahnitulyaṃ, yathā hyagniḥ suvarṇānāmuttamamadhyamādhamānāmabhivyañjakastathā madyamapi prāṇināṃ sattvarajastamobhūyiṣṭhānāṃ ‘krameṇābhi ... ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | krameṇābhivyañjakamiti| tathāhi carakaḥ– “pradhānādhamamadhyānāṃ rukmāṇāṃ vyaktidarśakaḥ| ‘yathā'gnirevaṃ satvādyairmadyaṃ prakṛtidarśakam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yathā'gnirevaṃ satvādyairmadyaṃ prakṛtidarśakam| tasmāt prathamadvitīyatṛtīyamadāḥ sattvarajastamobhūyiṣṭhānāṃ krameṇa bhavantītyarthaḥ||10-11||

caturthamadamāha-caturthe made puruṣo mūḍho'jñaḥ, bhagnadārviva niṣkriyo bhavati bhagnavṛkṣa iva kriyārahitaḥ, tathā kāryākāryavibhāgajñaḥ kāryamakāryaṃ buddhyā jānāti| ‘kāryākāryavibhāgajñaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare kāryākāryavibhāgayoranabhijña ityarthaḥ| mṛtādapyaparo mṛta iti mṛtamapekṣyāparo'yaṃ mṛta iva, atyantājñānasādharmyāt| ‘avaraḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare mṛtādapyavara ityarthaḥ, tathāvidhāvasthāyāḥ svayaṃ kṛtatvāt| ka iti kaḥ kṛtī sukṛtī kṛtakṛtyo vā svavaśo'parādhīnastādṛśamuktaprakāreṇa ninditaṃ madaṃ gacchet prāpnuyāt na kaścidevaṃvidhaṃ prāpnuyādityarthaḥ| kamivetyāha– bahudoṣamivāmūḍhaḥ kāntāramiti; bahudoṣaṃ hiṃsrā iti yuktaṃ kāntāraṃ śūnyamadhvānaṃ ko mūḍho gacchedapi tu na ko'pi| yaduktaṃ carake “gacchedadhvānamasvantaṃ bahudoṣamivādhvagaḥ” iti| asvantamaśobhanamaniṣṭaphalatvena| nanu carakavidehavāgbhaṭadibhiścaturtho mado na paṭhitaḥ, tatkathaṃ na virodhaḥ? ucyate; carake yā dvitīyatṛtīyayorantarālāvasthā paṭhitā, saiva suśrutena tṛtīyo mada iti kṛtvā paṭhitaḥ| keyamantarālāvasthā? yathoktaṃ jyotiḥśāstre– “kumbhamīnarkṣayormadhye yadā carati candramāḥ| nāharettṛṇakāṣṭhāni na gaccheddakṣiṇāṃ diśam” iti| atra kumbhasya śeṣāṃśo mīnasya prathamāṃśa etaddvayaṃ madhyaśabdenocyate iti saivāntarālāvasthā| yastu carake tṛtīyaḥ suśrute sa caturthaḥ paṭhita ityavirodhaḥ| vastugatyā traya eva madā ityupapāditam| nanu, kiṃ kāraṇakamidaṃ traividhyamiti cet? ucyate– madyaṃ hi vahnitulyaṃ, yathā vahniḥ suvarṇānāmadhamamadhyamottamānāmabhivyañjakaḥ, tathā madyamapi prāṇināṃ sattvarajastamobhūyiṣṭhānāmabhivyañjakam| tathā hi carakaḥ– “pradhānādhamamadhyānāṃ rukmāṇāṃ vyaktidarśakaḥ| yathā'gnirevaṃ sattvānāṃ madyaṃ prakṛtidarśakam” iti| tasmātprathamadvitīyatṛtīyamadāḥ sattvarajastamobhūyiṣṭhānāṃ krameṇa bhavantītyarthaḥ||10-11||

div.ab: nirbhaktamekāntata eva madyaṃ niṣevyamāṇaṃ manujena nityam | āpādayetkaṣṭatamānvikārānāpādayeccāpi śarīrabhedam ||12|| (sa. u. a. 47) |

ab.seg: avidhimadyapānasya vikārāntarahetutvamāha– nirbhaktamityādi| nanu, ayamarthaḥ snigdhaistadannairityādinā yaduktaṃ tadviparyayeṇaiva labdhaḥ, tatkathaṃ punarucyate? naivaṃ, pūrvaṃ madyapānaguṇābhidhānārthamuktam, idaṃ tu kṛcchratamavyādhikartṛtvābhidhānārthamiti bhedaḥ| yatparaḥ śabdaḥ sa śabdārtha ityabhiprāyaḥ| kaṣṭatamān vikārāniti vakṣyamāṇapānātyayādīn| bhedaṃ vināśaṃ śarīrasya||12||

avidhimadyapānasya vikārāntarahetutvamāha– nirbhaktamityādi| nirbhaktamāhārarahitam, ekāntato nairantaryeṇa sevyamānaṃ, kaṣṭatamān vakṣyamāṇān pānātyayādīn janayet| śarīrabhedaṃ śarīravināśam| nanu ‘snigdhaistadannaiḥ’ ityādīnāṃ viparyayeṇaivāyamartho labdhastatkiṃ punaḥ kathanaṃ? naivaṃ, pūrvaṃ madyapānaguṇābhidhānārthamuktam, idaṃ tu kṛcchratamavyādhikartṛtvābhidhānārthamuktamiti bhedaḥ||12||

div.ab: kruddhena bhītena pipāsitena śokābhitaptena bubhukṣitena | vyāyāmabhārādhvaparikṣatena vegāvarodhābhihatena cāpi ||13|| atyambubhakṣāvatatodareṇa sājīrṇabhuktena tathā'balena | uṣṇābhitaptena ca sevyamānaṃ karoti madyaṃ vividhānvikārān ||14|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: annasahitasyāpi madyasya kruddhatvādikāraṇasahitasya vikārakāritvapradarśanārthamāha– kruddhenetyādi| parikṣatena kṣīṇena| avatataṃ vyāptam| vividhān vikārān pānātyayādīniti||13-14||

annasahitasyāpi madyasya kruddhatvādikāraṇasahitasya vikārakāritvapradarśanārthamāha– kruddhenetyādi| vyāyāmabhārādhvabhiḥ parikṣatena kṣīṇena vegāvarodhābhihatena mūtrādīnāṃ vegābhighātapīḍitena| atyambubhakṣaiḥ avatatodareṇa ‘vyāmodareṇa’ iti pā.| vyāptodareṇa| sājīrṇabhuktena sājīrṇaṃ bhuktaṃ yasya sa tathā tena| abalena balarahitena, balam ojaḥ| uṣṇābhitaptena gharmasantaptena| īdṛśena puruṣeṇa sevyamānaṃ vividhān nānāvidhān, vikārān pānātyayādīn karoti||13-14||

div.ab: pānātyayaṃ paramadaṃ pānājīrṇamathāpi vā | pānavibhramamugraṃ ca teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: tāneva vivṛṇoti– pānātyayamityādi| nanu, ayamarthaḥ ‘āpādayet kaṣṭatamān vikārān’ ityanenaivoktatvāt kathaṃ punaruktaḥ? ucyate– pūrveṇa kaṣṭatamavikārakāritvamuktam, anena tu nānāvidhavikārakāritvamiti bhedaḥ||15||
tānatra vikārān vivṛṇoti– pānātyayamityādi| pānātyayamityeko vikāraḥ, pānājīrṇamityekaḥ, ‘pānavibhramamapi vānyaḥ’ iti pā.| pānavibhramamiti cānyaḥ| teṣāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyāmi||15||

div.ab: hikkāśvāsaśiraḥkampapārśvaśūlaprajāgaraiḥ | vidyādbahupralāpasya vātaprāyaṃ madātyayam ||16|| tṛṣṇādāhajvarasvedamohātīsāravibhramaiḥ | vidyāddharitavarṇasya pittaprāyaṃ madātyayam ||17|| chardyarocakahṛllāsatandrāstaimityagauravaiḥ | vidyācchītaparītasya kaphaprāyaṃ madātyayam | jñeyastridoṣajaścāpi sarvaliṅgairmadātyayaḥ ||18|| (ca. ci. a. 24) |

ab.seg: teṣāmuddiṣṭānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha– hikketyādi| prajāgaro nidrāvicchedaḥ| vātaprāyamityanena sarve ‘vātādiprāyā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vātādiprāyā madātyayāstridoṣajāḥ, udbhūtatvena vyapadeśa iti carake darśitam| yadāha– “ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaṇāḥ|” ityārabhya yāvat “sarvaṃ madātyayaṃ vidyāttridoṣaṃ” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti| evaṃ carakasaṃvādāt suśrute'pi bodhyam| vibhramo bhramaḥ| haritavarṇasyetyanena haritavarṇatā'pi lakṣaṇam||16-18||

tatra vātikamadātyayamāha– hikketyādi| sarve madātyayāstridoṣajāḥ, ‘kiṃ tu’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kiṃ tu auddhatyena vyapadeśaḥ| yaduktaṃ carakeṇa– “ye viṣasya guṇāḥ proktāḥ sarvadoṣaprakopaṇāḥ” iti| tathā ca– “sarvaṃ madātyayaṃ vidyāt tridoṣajam” iti| prajāgaro nidrānāśaḥ, śeṣaṃ sugamam| paittikamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| vibhramo vastuviparītajñānam| haritavarṇasya puruṣasyeti haritavarṇatā pittalakṣaṇaṃ, śeṣaṃ sugamam| ślaiṣmikamāha– chardītyādi| staimityaṃ niścalatā| śītaparītasya śītayuktasya| tridoṣajamāha– jñeya ityādi| sarvaliṅgaiḥ sarvadoṣalakṣaṇaiḥ||16-18||

div.ab: śleṣmocchrayo'ṅgagurutā virasāsyatā ca viṇmūtrasaktiratha tandrirarocakaśca | liṅgaṃ parasya ca madasya vadanti tajjñāstṛṣṇā rujā śirasi sandhiṣu cāpi bhedaḥ ||19|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: paramadamāha– śleṣmocchraya ityādi| śleṣmocchrayaścātra nāsāsrāvādinā jñeyaḥ| saktiḥ saṅgaḥ, apravṛttiriti yāvat| tandristandrā| parasya madasyeti paramadasya; chando'nurodhādasamāsanirdeśaḥ||19||

paramadamāha– śleṣmetyādi| śleṣmocchrayo nāsāsrāvādinā jñeyaḥ| aṅgagurutā śarīragauravam| virasāsyatā mukhasya vairasyam| viṇmūtrasaktiḥ viṇmūtrayorapravṛttiḥ| tandristandrā| parasyeti ‘chandonirodhā ... ’ iti pā.| chandonurodhādasamāsanirdeśaḥ, paramadasyeti jñeyam| śirasi rujā pīḍā, sandhiṣu bhedaḥ sphuṭanamiva||19||

div.ab: ādhmānamugramatha codgiraṇaṃ vidāhaḥ pāne'jarāṃ samupagacchati lakṣaṇāni |20| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

pānājīrṇamāha– ādhmānamityādi| udgiraṇaṃ vāntiḥ, udgāro vā| pāne madye, ‘ajarām’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ajarām ajīrṇamupagacchati apakvatvamupagacchatīti pānājīrṇavikāra ityarthaḥ|20|–
pānājīrṇamāha– ādhmānamityādi| udgiraṇaṃ vāntirudgāro vā| pāne madye, ajarāmajīrṇaṃ, samupagacchati prāptavati, pānājīrṇaṃ ityarthaḥ|20|–
hṛdgātratodakaphasaṃsravakaṇṭhadhūmā mūrchāvamijvaraśirorujanapradāhāḥ ||20|| dveṣaḥ surānnavikṛteṣvapi teṣu teṣu taṃ pānavibhramamuśantyakhilena dhīrāḥ | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

pānavibhramamāha– hṛdityādi| kaṇṭhadhūmaḥ kaṇṭhāddhūmanirgamavatpīḍā| śirorujanaṃ śiraḥśūlam| surānnavikṛteṣviti surāvikṛteṣu annavikṛteṣu ca; bhāve ktaḥ| teṣu teṣviti nānāvikāreṣu surāmaireyapiṣṭakalaḍḍukādiṣu| uśanti icchanti| ete ca paramadādayastrayo na carake paṭhitāḥ, sannipātaje'ntarbhūtatvāt; suśrutena tūktatridoṣajamadātyayāt pṛthagete paṭhitāḥ, vikṛtyā pūrvalakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyābhidhānārthamityāhuḥ||20||–

pānavibhramamāha– hṛdityādi| hṛdityādi| hṛdgātrayostodaḥ vyathāviśeṣaḥ, kaṇṭhadhūmaḥ kaṇṭhāddhūmanirgamavatpīḍā, śirorujanaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ, etacca– ‘śirorujanapradehāḥ’ iti pā.| pradehaḥ śleṣmaliptamiva mukham| surāvikṛteṣu annavikṛteṣu ca bhāveṣu dveṣaḥ| teṣu teṣviti nānāprakāreṣu surāmaireyapiṣṭakādiṣu| akhilena lakṣaṇena pānavibhramaṃ uśanti kathayanti| ete paramadādayastrayo na carake paṭhitāḥ, sannipātaje'ntarbhūtatvāt, suśrutena tūktatridoṣajamadātyayāḥ pṛthageva paṭhitāḥ, pūrvoktalakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyāt||20||–
hīnottarauṣṭhamatiśītamamandadāhaṃ tailaprabhāsyamapi pānahataṃ tyajettu ||21|| jihvauṣṭhadantamasitaṃ tvathavā'pi nīlaṃ pīte ca yasya nayane rudhiraprabhe vā | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |
asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– hīnetyādi| hīnottarauṣṭhaṃ pralambamānoparitanauṣṭham| atiśītaṃ bahiḥ, ‘amandadāhamantare|’ iti pā.| amandadāhamabhyantare| tailaprabhāsyaṃ tailāktamukhamiva||21||–

asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– hīnetyādi| hīnottarauṣṭhaṃ pralambamānoparitanauṣṭham| atiśītaṃ bahiḥ, amandadāhamabhyantare; athavā atiśītamamandadāhamiti vikalpena pratyetavyam, ekadaikatra viruddhadharmadvayāsambhavāt; kadācidatiśītaṃ, kadācittīvradāham| ‘ulbaṇamiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ulbaṇamiti| tailaprabhāsyamiti tailāktamukhamiva||21||–
hikkājvarau vamathuvepathupārśvaśūlāḥ kāsabhramāvapi ca pānahataṃ bhajante ||22|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: upadravānāha– hikketyādi| etaiḥ kṛcchrasādhyaṃ bhavati, na tvasādhyam; asādhyalakṣaṇebhyaḥ pṛthakpāṭhāditi jejjaṭaḥ| ‘dhvaṃsakavikṣepakāvapi’ iti pā.| dhvaṃsakavikṣepakākhyau madyavikārau carake ‘pṛthak’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pṛthak paṭhitau; tadyathā– “vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo'timadyaṃ niṣevate| dhvaṃso vikṣepakaścaiva rogastasyopajāyate|| śleṣmaprasekaḥ kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ śabdāsahiṣṇutā| tandrānidrābhiyogaśca jñeyaṃ dhvaṃsakalakṣaṇam|| hṛtkaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaśchardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ| tṛṣṇā kāsaḥ śiraḥśūlametadvikṣepalakṣaṇam||” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti; tau ca suśrutena “vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo'timadyaṃ niṣevate| tasya pānātyayoddiṣṭā vikārāḥ sambhavanti hi||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) ityanena ‘saṅgrahītau’ iti pā.| saṅgṛhītau boddhavyau| na vā cikitsābhedastayoruktaḥ; yataścaraka evoktavān– “tayoḥ karma cikitsā ca vātike yanmadātyaye|” (ca. ci. a. 24) iti||22||

upadravānāha– jihvetyādi| ete upadravāḥ pānahatān puruṣān bhajante| asitaṃ kṛṣṇam, athavā nīlaṃ cāṣapakṣapratimam| rudhiraprabhe atīvarakte| ‘hikketyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | hikketyādi| vamathuśchardiḥ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ| bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva| etaiśca kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ bhavati na tvasādhyatvam, asādhyalakṣaṇebhyaḥ pṛthakpāṭhāditi jejjaṭaḥ| dhvaṃsakavikṣepakākhyau madyavikārau carake paṭhitau| tadyathā– “vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo'ti madyaṃ niṣevate| dhvaṃso vikṣepakaścaiva rogastasyopajāyate|| śleṣmaprasekaḥ ‘kaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaśchardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ|’ etatsthāne ‘kaṇṭhāsyaśoṣaḥ sarvāsahiṣṇutā| nidrātandrātiyogaśca jñeyaṃ dhvaṃsakalakṣaṇam|| hṛtkaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaḥ chardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ|’ iti pā.| kaṇṭharodhaḥ sammohaśchardiraṅgarujā jvaraḥ| tṛṣṇākāsaḥ śiraḥśūlametadvikṣepalakṣaṇam” iti| na vā tayościkitsābheda uktaḥ, yataścaraka evoktavān– “tayoḥ karma cikitsā ca vātike yanmadātyaye” iti||22||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne pānātyayaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānaṃ samāptam ||18||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ pānātyayaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānaṃ samāptam||18||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇākhye rugviniścayavyākhyāne pānātyaparamadapānājīrṇapānavibhramanidānam||18||

div.head: dāhanidānam

ab.seg: atha dāhanidānam| tvacaṃ prāptaḥ sa pānoṣmā pittaraktābhimūrchitaḥ | ‘pittaprakopadhānādi hetubhirjāyate gadaḥ ūṣmātmako'pi dāhākhyaḥ sa ca saptavidho mataḥ’ iti pā. | dāhaṃ prakurute ghoraṃ pittavattatra bheṣajam ||1||

madātyaye'pi dāho bhavatyataḥ saptaprakāraṃ dāhamāha; tatra madyajamāha– tvacamityādi| atra ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| pānoṣmā atra ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| pā.| madyapānakupitapittasyauṣṇyaṃ; samānoṣmeti pāṭhāntaramayuktaṃ, suśrute pānātyaye ślokasyāsya pāṭhāt| ‘pittaja evāyam’ iti pā.| pittajo'pyayaṃ hetubhedāt pṛthak paṭhitaḥ||1||

madātyaye dāho bhavatītyato madātyayānantaraṃ dāhanidānārambhaḥ| madyajadāhamāha– tvacamityādi| pānoṣmā madyapānakupitapittoṣmā, sa tvacaṃ prāpto ghoraṃ dāhaṃ prakarṣeṇa kuruta ityarthaḥ| kīdṛśaḥ pittaraktābhyāmabhivardhitaḥ| anye ‘samānoṣmā’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti| tanna yuktaṃ, suśrute pānātyaye ślokasyāsya pāṭhāt| pittajo'pyayaṃ hetubhedātpṛthak paṭhitaḥ||1||

div.ab: kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktamudriktaṃ dahati dhruvam | sa uṣyate tṛṣyate ca tāmrābhastāmralocanaḥ ||2|| lohagandhāṅgavadano vahninevāvakīryate | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

raktajamāha– kṛtsnetyādi| sa uṣyate samīpastheneva vahninā tapyate, ‘sañcūṣyata’ iti pā.| ‘sandhūpyata’ iti pāṭhāntare ‘ācūṣaṇa ... ’ iti pā.| sandhūpanavadvedanāmanubhavati| tāmrābha iti gātre| lohagandhāṅgavadana iti lohasyeva gandho'ṅge vadane ca yasya sa tathā||2-3||–

raktajamāha– kṛtsnetyādi| udriktaṃ vṛddhaṃ raktaṃ kṛtsnadehānugaṃ sat dhruvaṃ ‘sa dahati’ iti pā.| sandahati, puruṣastena ‘ucyate tathā tṛṣyate’ iti pā.| ūṣyate samīpasthena ‘vahninā’ iti pā.| vahnineva tapyate| sañcūṣyate iti pāṭhāntare ācūṣaṇavadvedanāmanubhavati| tāmrābha iti ‘tāmrābhamātraḥ’ iti pā.| tāmrābhagātraḥ| lohasyeva gandho'ṅge vadane ca yasya sa tathā|2-3|–
pittajvarasamaḥ pittātsa cāpyasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: pittajamāha– pittetyādi| pittajvarasamaḥ pittajvaraliṅgayuktaḥ, ‘pittajvare'ratyāmāśaya ... ’ iti pā.| pittajvare tvāmāśayaduṣṭyādayo'dhikā iti bhedaḥ| sa cāpyasya vidhiriti pittajvaracikitsā||3||
pittajamāha– pittajvaretyādi| pittajvare aratyāmāśayaduṣṭyādayo'dhikā iti bhedaḥ, anyāni samānalakṣaṇāni| sa cāpyasya vidhiriti pittajvaroktacikitsetyarthaḥ||3||

div.ab: tṛṣṇānirodhādabdhātau kṣīṇe tejaḥ samuddhatam | sabāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ pradahenmandacetasaḥ ||4|| saṃśuṣkagalatālvoṣṭho jihvāṃ niṣkṛṣya vepate | (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |
tṛṣṇānirodhajamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| tejaḥsamuddhataṃ pittoṣmā vṛddha ityarthaḥ| niṣkṛṣya niḥsārya||4||–

tṛṣṇānirodhajamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| tṛṣṇāvidhāraṇādabdhātau rase kṣīṇe sati, tejaḥ samutthitaṃ pittoṣmā vṛddha ityarthaḥ| sa ‘bāhyābhyantare’ iti pā.| bāhyābhyantaraṃ dehaṃ pradahet| mandacetasaḥ visañjñasya| niṣkṛṣya niḥsārya kampate||4||–
asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasya dāho'nyaḥ syāt ‘sudustaraḥ’ iti pā. | suduḥsahaḥ ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: avagāḍhaśastraprahārajanitaraktapūrṇakoṣṭhajamāha– asṛja ityādi| na coktaraktajenāsya paunaruktyaṃ, kṛtsnadehānugamiti vacanāt kāraṇabhedācca| asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasyeti ‘pūraṇaguṇasuhitārtha’ ityādinā jñāpakena kartari ṣaṣṭhī, raktena pūritakoṣṭhasyetyarthaḥ| koṣṭhaśabdena hṛdayādayo gṛhyante| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca| hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate||” (su. ci. a. 2) iti||5||

avagāḍhaśastraprahārajanitaraktapūrṇakoṣṭhajamāha– asṛja ityādi| asṛjaḥ rudhirasyeti “pūraṇaguṇasahita” ityādinā jñāpakena kartari ṣaṣṭhī; raktena pūritakoṣṭhasyetyarthaḥ| koṣṭhaśabdena hṛdayādayo gṛhyante| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “sthānānyāmāgnipākvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca| hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate||” iti| na coktaraktaje nāsya paunaruktyaṃ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugam’ iti vacanāt, kāraṇabhedācceti||5||

div.ab: dhātukṣayottho yo dāhastena mūrchātṛḍarditaḥ | kṣāmasvaraḥ kriyāhīnaḥ sa sīdedbhṛśapīḍitaḥ ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: dhātukṣayajamāha– dhātvityādi| dhātavo rasādayaḥ| kriyāhīno niśceṣṭaḥ; kiṃvā bhṛśapīḍito dāhena kriyāhīnaścikitsāhīno yadi bhavettadā sīdenmriyeta ityarthaḥ||6||

dhātukṣayajamāha– ‘dhātvityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dhātvityādi| dhātavo rasādayaḥ, teṣāṃ kṣayeṇa yo dāho bhavati tena dhātukṣayajadāhena| kṣāmasvaro durbalasvaraḥ, kriyāhīno niśceṣṭaḥ, atra ‘kiṃvā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| bhṛśapīḍito dāhena cikitsāhīno yadi bhavettadā sīdenmriyata ityarthaḥ||6||

div.ab: kṣatajo'naśnataścānnaṃ śocato vā'pyanekadhā | tenāntardahyate'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān ||7|| marmābhighātajo'pyasti so'sādhyaḥ saptamo mataḥ | sarva eva ca varjyāḥ syuḥ śītagātrasya dehinaḥ ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 47) |

ab.seg: kṣatajamāha– kṣataja ityādi| marmābhighātajamāha– marmetyādi| marmāṇi śirohṛdayabastyādīni| jejjaṭastu saptatvamanyathā gaṇayati– ‘tvacaṃ prāpta’ ityādinā prathamaḥ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktam’ ityatra raktasthāne pittaṃ paṭhitvā etadādinā ‘sa cāpyasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityantena ‘paittiko’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | paittiko dvitīyaḥ, tṛṣṇānirodhajastṛtīyaḥ, ‘asṛjaḥ ‘pūrṇakoṣṭhajaścaturthaḥ’ iti pā.| pūrṇakoṣṭhasya’ iti caturthaḥ, dhātukṣayajaḥ pañcamaḥ, ṣaṣṭhasya tu kṣatajasya lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhati– “kṣatajo'naśnataścānnaṃ śocataścāpyanekadhā| tenāntardahyate'tyarthaṃ ‘tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān’ pā.| tṛṣṇādāhapralāpavān|” iti, marmābhighātajastu saptama iti||7-8||

marmābhighātajamāha– marmetyādi| marmāṇi hṛdayaśirobastyādīni| ‘sa cāsādhyatamaḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityatrānye ‘so'sādhyaḥ saptamo mataḥ’ iti paṭhanti| jejjaṭastu saptatvamanyathā gaṇayati– tvacaṃ prāpta ityādinā prathamaḥ, ‘kṛtsnadehānugaṃ raktam’ ityatra raktasthāne pittaṃ paṭhitvā etadādinā ‘sa cāpyasya vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityantena paittiko dvitīyaḥ, tṛṣṇānirodhajastṛtīyaḥ, ‘asṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasya’ iti caturthaḥ, dhātukṣayajaḥ pañcamaḥ, ṣaṣṭhasya kṣatajasya lakṣaṇaṃ paṭhati– “kṣatajenāśnataścānnaṃ śocato vā'pyanekadhā| tenāṅgaṃ dahyate'tyarthaṃ tṛṣṇādāhapralāpavān||” iti| asyārthaḥ– pūrvamasṛjaḥ pūrṇakoṣṭhasyetyādinā koṣṭhasthena raktena dāhamabhidhāyedānīṃ prakārāntareṇāha– kṣatajena raktena, anaśnato bhojanaṃ kurvataḥ, śokaṃ kurvato vā'pi narasyānyo dāho raktena bhavatīti sambandhaḥ, tena dāhenābhyantaraṃ dahyate, tṛṣṇāmūrchāpralāpavān ‘naro bhavati’ iti śeṣaḥ| marmābhighātajastu saptamaḥ| sarveṣāmapi dāhānāmavasthāyāṃ ‘varjayannāha’ iti pā.| varjanīyatvamāha– sarva iti| sarva eva hi ‘dāhā’ iti śeṣaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam||7-8||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne dāhanidānaṃ samāptam ||19||
iti śrīvijayarakṣitakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ dāhanidānaṃ samāptam||19||
iti śrīvaidyavācaspatikṛte ātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāne dāhanidānam||19||

div.head: unmādanidānam
div.ab: athonmādanidānam | madayantyudgatā doṣā ‘ ... unmārgamāśritāḥ’ iti pā. | yasmādunmārgamāgatāḥ | mānaso'yamato vyādhirunmāda iti kīrtitaḥ ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) |

ab.seg: madātyaye ‘unmādamiva cāparam’ ityanena unmādasaṅkīrtanamunmādasādṛśyaṃ coktaṃ, tathā madātyaye'pi dāho bhavatīti ‘alpavaktavyatayā’ iti pā.| svalpavaktavyatayā dāhamabhidhāyonmādārambhaḥ, tasya niruktimāha– madayantītyādi| madayanti manovibhramaṃ kurvanti, ‘manovahādhamanīranuprāptāḥ unmārgamāgatā vimārgamāgatā|’ iti pā.| unmārgamāgatā vimārgamāgatā manovahādhamanīranuprāptāḥ| udgatā vṛddhāḥ, athavā ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ, ‘tena tataḥ pūrveṇaiva’ iti pā.| etenotpūrveṇaiva doṣāṇāṃ vṛddhatvaṃ vimārgagatvaṃ ca darśitam||1||

madātyaye ‘unmādamiva cāparam’ ‘ityanyenonmāda ... ’ iti pā.| ityanenonmādasaṅkīrtanamunmādasādṛśyaṃ coktaṃ, tathā madātyaye dāho bhavatīti tulyalakṣaṇatayā dāhamabhidhāyonmādārambhaḥ, tasya niruktimāha– madayantītyādi| yasmāddoṣā madayanti manovibhramaṃ kurvanti, ato'yaṃ mānaso vyādhirunmāda iti kīrtyata iti sambandhaḥ| kīdṛśāḥ? udgatā vṛddhāḥ, athavā ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ gatāḥ, unmārgamāgatā vimārgagāḥ, manovahadhamanīranuprāptāḥ, tena tataḥ pūrveṇaiva doṣāṇāṃ vṛddhatvaṃ vimārgagatvaṃ ca darśitam||1||

div.ab: ekaikaśaḥ sarvaśaśca doṣairatyarthamūrchitaiḥ | mānasena ca duḥkhena sa ca pañcavidho mataḥ ||2|| viṣādbhavati ṣaṣṭhaśca yathāsvaṃ tatra bheṣajam | sa cāpravṛddhastaruṇo madasañjñāṃ bibharti ca ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 62) |

ab.seg: prakārabhedamāha– ekaikaśa ityādi| mānasena ca duḥkheneti śokādinā| sa ceti ṣaḍvidho'pi| atrāpravṛddhapadamupādāyāpi taruṇapadaprayogaṃ kurvatā suśrutena svatantro'pi doṣajanito mado bhavatīti darśitam| ata eva carake vidhiśoṇitīyādhyāye (ca. sū. a. 24) unmādāt pṛthageva paṭhitaḥ sanidānacikitsita iti||2-3||

tasya saṅkhyāmāha– ekaikaśa ityādi| vātena pittena śleṣmaṇā sarvaśa iti sannipātena, atyarthamūrchitaiḥ atipravṛddhaiḥ, mānasena tu duḥkheneti śokādinā, viṣāt ṣaṣṭho bhavati| sa cāpravṛddha iti sa ca vikāraḥ, yāvat pravṛddho vṛddhiṃ gato na bhavati, yāvacca taruṇastāvanmada iti sañjñāṃ bibharti, mada iti kathyata ityarthaḥ| suśrute svatantro'pi doṣajanito mado bhavatīti vyākhyātam| ata eva carake vidhiśoṇitīyādhyāye unmādātpṛthageva paṭhitaḥ sa nidānacikitsita iti||2-3||

div.ab: viruddhaduṣṭāśucibhojanani pradharṣaṇaṃ devagurudvijānām | unmādaheturbhayaharṣapūrvo mano'bhighāto viṣamāśca ceṣṭāḥ ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 9) |

ab.seg: sāmānyahetumāha– viruddhetyādi| duṣṭaṃ garasahitamannādi| pradharṣaṇaṃ ‘dhṛṣa’ pradharṣaṇe, ityasmāt pradharṣaṇamabhibhavaḥ| bhayaharṣapūrvo mano'bhighāta iti bhayaharṣābhyāṃ manaso'bhibhavaḥ; bhayaharṣapūrva iti bhayaṃ harṣo atra ‘dvau’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| dvau vā pūrvaṃ yasya sa tathā; pūrvaśabdo'tra kāraṇavācī, cakāro'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena kāmakrodhalobhādayo'pi kāraṇamiti jejjaṭaḥ; anye tvāhuḥ– krodhādibhirapi bhayaharṣapūrvaka eva bhavatīti tena tau nirdiṣṭau| viṣamāśca ceṣṭā iti viṣamāṅganyāsabalavadvigrahādaya unmādahetava iti yojyam||4||

tasya sāmānyahetumāha– viruddhetyādi| duṣṭaṃ garaduṣṭamannādi, aśuci bhojanaṃ cāṇḍālādispṛṣṭaṃ, pradharṣaṇaṃ nindādyabhibhavanaṃ, manobhighāta iti bhayaharṣābhyāṃ manobhibhavaḥ, bhayaharṣapūrva iti bhayaharṣau pūrvau yasva sa tathā| pūrvaśabdo'tra kāraṇavācī, cakāro'tra luptanirdiṣṭo draṣṭavyaḥ, tena kāmakrodhalobhādayo'pi kāraṇamiti jejjaṭaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ– krodhādibhirapi bhayaharṣapūrvaka eva bhavatīti, tena tau nirdiṣṭāviti| viṣamāśceṣṭā iti viṣamāṅganyāsabalavadvigrahādayaḥ, unmādaheturiti yojyam||4||

div.ab: tairalpasattvasya malāḥ praduṣṭā buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya | srotāṃsyadhiṣṭhāya manovahāni pramohayantyāśu narasya cetaḥ ||5|| (ca. ci. a. 1) |

ab.seg: samprāptimāha– tairityādi| tairuktahetubhiḥ| alpasattvasya alpasattvaguṇasyeti cakraḥ; jejjaṭastvāha– sattvaṃ manaḥ, tasya cālpatvaṃ rajastamobhyāmāvṛtatvenālpajñānajanakatvāt| malā vātādayaḥ| buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayamityanena hṛdayasyāśrayasya duṣṭyā tadāśritajñānasyāpi duṣṭirbhavatīti darśayati| srotāṃsi manovahānīti hṛdayāśritā daśa dhamanyaḥ; etacca viśeṣeṇa bodhyaṃ, nikhiladehasrotasāmeva mano'dhiṣṭhānatvena carake darśitatvāt| adhiṣṭhāya vyāpyetyarthaḥ||5||

samprāptimāha– tairityādi| tairuktahetubhiralpasattvasya narasya malā vātādayaḥ praduṣṭāḥ santo buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya manovahāni srotāṃsi adhiṣṭhāya vyāpya āśu cetaḥ pramohayanti| alpasattvasyālpasatvaguṇasyeti cakraḥ; jejjaṭastvāha– sattvaṃ manaḥ, tasya cālpatvaṃ rajastamobhibhūtatvenālpajñānajanakatvāt| buddhernivāsaṃ hṛdayamityanena hṛdayamāśritā dhamanyaḥ, etacca viśeṣeṇa bodhyaṃ, nikhiladehasrotasāmeva manodhiṣṭhānatvena carake darśitatvāt| adhiṣṭhāya vyāpya||5||

div.ab: dhīvibhramaḥ sattvapariplavaśca paryākulā dṛṣṭiradhīratā ca | abaddhavāktvaṃ hṛdayaṃ ca śūnyaṃ sāmānyamunmādagadasya liṅgam ||6|| (ca. ci. a. 9) |

ab.seg: sāmānyarūpamāha– dhīvibhrama ityādi| etat sāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpamiti jejjaṭaḥ, sāmānyarūpamiti cakraḥ| dhīvibhramo bhrāntajñānatvam| sattvapariplavo manasaścañcalatvam| adhīratā kātaratvam| abaddhavāktvamasambaddhavacanatvam| liṅgyate'neneti liṅga, tena pūrvarūpaṃ rūpaṃ ceti vyākhyātam||6||

pūrvarūpamāha– dhītyādi| dhīvibhramo bhrāntajñānatvaṃ, sattvapariplavo manasaścañcalatvam| anye sattvaguṇasyeti| paryākulā dṛṣṭiriti ākulābalokanam| adhīratā kātaratvam| abaddhavāktvaṃ asambaddhavacanatvam| hṛdayaṃ śūnyamityantaṃ dhīvibhramatvādi sāmānyalakṣaṇamevāha||6||

div.ab: rūkṣālpaśītānnavirekadhātukṣayopavāsairanilo'tivṛddhaḥ | cintādiduṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃ pradūṣya buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ cāpyupahanti śīghram ||7|| ‘asthānahāsyasmita ... ’ iti pā. | asthānahāsasmitanṛtyagītavāgaṅgavikṣepaṇarodanāni | pāruṣyakārśyāruṇavarṇatāśca jīrṇe balaṃ cānilajasya rūpam ||8|| (ca. ci. a. 9) |

ab.seg: vātajamāha– rūkṣetyādi| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | virekaśabdenātra vāntirapyabhidhīyate, virecayati dehānmalaṃ pṛthakkarotīti vyutpattyā| asthānahāsetyādi asthāne'viṣaye ‘hāsyo'sthānahāsyaḥ’ iti pā.| hāso'sthānahāsaḥ; evamasthānaśabdaḥ smitādiṣu prayojyaḥ| smitamīṣaddhāsaḥ| aṅgavikṣepo viruddhaceṣṭā| jīrṇe balamiti jīrṇe āhāre vyādherbalaṃ bhavati||7-8||

vātikamāha– rūkṣetyādi| etadvātikonmādalakṣaṇam| rūkṣālpaśītānnairbhojyaiḥ| virekaśabdenātra vāntirapyabhidhīyate, virecayati dehānmalaṃ pṛthak karotīti vyākhyānāt| dhātukṣayo rasādidhātukṣayaḥ| etairduṣṭo vāyuścintāśokādiduṣṭaṃ hṛdayaṃ manaḥ praviśya buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ ca śīghramupahanti| anubhūtārthasmaraṇaṃ smṛtiḥ| asthānahāsyaṃ aviṣaye hāsyam| evamasthānaśabdaḥ smitādiṣu yojyaḥ| smitamīṣaddhāsaḥ, aṅgavikṣepaṇaṃ viruddhaceṣṭā, pāruṣyaṃ raukṣyaṃ, kārśyaṃ kṛśatā, aruṇavarṇatā īṣadraktavarṇatā, jīrṇe balamiti jīrṇe āhāre vyādherbalaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ||7-8||

div.ab: ajīrṇakaṭvamlavidāhyaśītairbhojyaiścitaṃ pittamudīrṇavegam | unmādamatyugramanātmakasya hṛdi sthitaṃ pūrvavadāśu kuryāt ||9|| amarṣasaṃrambhavinagnabhāvāḥ santarjanātidravaṇauṣṇyaroṣāḥ | pracchāyaśītānnajalābhilāṣaḥ pītā ca bhāḥ pittakṛtasya liṅgam ||10|| (ca. ci. a. 9) |

ab.seg: pittajamāha– ajīrṇetyādi| aśītairiti uṣṇaiḥ| unmādamatyugramiti atyugraṃ tīvravegam, ‘unmādayatyugram’ iti pāṭhāntare ugraṃ yathā bhavati tathā unmādaṃ janayati| anātmakasya anātmavataḥ| pūrvavaditi cintādiduṣṭahṛdayasya buddhyādikamupahatyetyādisamprāptyā| kuryāditi vakṣyamāṇaṃ liṅgamiti śeṣaḥ| atra pakṣe kiṃ talliṅgamityāha– amarṣetyādi– amarṣo'sahiṣṇutvaṃ, na tu roṣaḥ; tasya vakṣyamāṇatvāt| saṃrambha ārabhaṭī; vinagnabhāvo nagnatvam| santarjanaṃ ‘paratrāsanam’ iti pā.| paritrāsanam, atidravaṇaṃ palāyanam, auṣṇyaṃ gātrasya; ‘auṣṭhyam iti pāṭhāntare vikṛtauṣṭhatvam| pracchāyaśītānnajalābhilāṣa iti chāyāyāṃ śītayorannajalayorabhilāṣaḥ||9-10||

paittikamāha– ajīrṇetyādi| ajīrṇādibhiścitaṃ sañcayatāṃ gatam| udīrṇavegaṃ pittaṃ pūrvavat cintādiduṣṭahṛdayasya buddhyādikamupahanti| ajīrṇamavidagdham, aśītaiḥ uṣṇaiḥ, ugraṃ tīvraṃ ‘yadā’ iti pā.| yathā bhavati ‘tadā’ iti pā.| tathā unmādaṃ janayati| anātmakasya anātmavataḥ| amarṣaṃ asahiṣṇutvaṃ, saṃrambha ārabhaṭī, hastapādādivikṣepaṇamityanye| vinagnabhāvo vastrādityāgaḥ| santarjanaṃ paritrāsanaṃ bhartsanamaparasyetyarthaḥ| abhidravaṇaṃ palāyanam| auṣṇyaṃ gātrasya, ‘auṣṭhyam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra vikṛtauṣṭhatvam| coṣo dāhaviśeṣaḥ| pracchāyetyādi chāyāyāḥ śītayoścānnajalayorabhilāṣaḥ| pītā ca bhāḥ pītavarṇatā||9-10||
sampūraṇairmandaviceṣṭitasya soṣmā kapho marmaṇi sampraduṣṭaḥ | buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ cāpyupahatya cittaṃ pramohayan sañjanayedvikāram ||11||
vākceṣṭitaṃ mandamarocakaśca nārīviviktapriyatā'tinidrā | chardiśca lālā ca balaṃ ca ‘bhuṅkte’ iti pā. | bhukte nakhādiśauklyaṃ ca kaphātmake syāt | (ca. ci. a. 9) ||12||

kaphajamāha– sampūraṇairityādi| mandaviceṣṭitasya āyāsaśūnyasya| sampūraṇairbhojanādibhiḥ, kapho duṣṭa iti sambandhaḥ| soṣmā sapittaḥ| kaphenāpi kriyamāṇa unmādo'vaśyaṃ sapittena kriyate vyādhimahimnā, yathā mūrchā| anye tvāhuḥ– kevalakaphenāpi kriyate, soṣmapadena tu dvandvajo'pi bhavatīti sūcyate| anye tvāhuḥ– ūṣmaśabdena śaktirucyate, tenotkṛṣṭaśaktikaḥ kapha ityarthaḥ| marmaṇīti hṛdaye| vikāramunmādam| ‘vāgityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vāgityādi nārīviviktapriyateti nārīpriyatā vijanapriyatā ca| balaṃ ca ‘bhuṅkte’ iti pā.| bhukte iti ‘vyādheḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| nakhādītyādiśabdena tvaṅmūtranetrādīnāṃ grahaṇam||11-12||

ślaiṣmikamāha– sampūraṇairityādi| mandaviceṣṭitasya āyāsaśūnyasya; sampūraṇairatibhojanādibhiḥ kapho duṣṭa iti sambandhaḥ| soṣmā sapittaḥ| kaphenāpi kriyamāṇa unmādo'vaśyaṃ sapittena kriyate vyādhimahimnā, yathā mūrchā| anye tvāhuḥ– kevalenāpi kaphena sa kriyate, soṣmapadena tu dvandvajo'pi bhavatīti sūcyate| anye tvāhuḥ– ūṣmaśabdena śaktirucyate, tenotkṛṣṭaśaktikaḥ kapha ityarthaḥ| marmaṇi hṛdaye| cittaṃ pramohayan buddhiṃ smṛtiṃ copahatya vikāramunmādam| vākceṣṭitaṃ mandam| alpam ‘arocakatā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | arocakatā| nārīviviktapriyatā nārīpriyatā, vijanapriyatā ca| nidrābāhulyaṃ tathā chardiḥ, lālāsrāvaśca balaṃ ca bhuṅkte ‘nāśayati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nāśayati, ‘vyādheḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| nakhanetrādīnāṃ śauklyam||11-12||

div.ab: yaḥ sannipātaprabhavo'tighoraḥ sarvaiḥ samastaiḥ sa ca hetubhiḥ syāt | sarvāṇi rūpāṇi bibharti tādṛgviruddhabhaiṣajyavidhirvivarjyaḥ ||13|| (ca. ci. a. 9) |
