sannipātodaramāha– striya ityādi| strīgrahaṇamavivekisannihitajanopalakṣaṇam| garaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣam| duṣṭamambu sagaraprāṇitṛṇaparṇādikothayutaṃ, viṣamevāgnyādyupahataṃ mandaprabhāvaṃ vā dūṣīviṣamucyate| yaduktam– “jīrṇaṃ viṣaghnauṣadhibhirhataṃ vā dāvāgnivātātapaśoṣitaṃ vā| svabhāvato vā guṇaviprahīnaṃ viṣaṃ hi dūṣīviṣatāmupaiti||” (su. ka. a. 2) iti| tenāśu raktamiti viṣasyāgneyatvena raktaduṣṭiḥ| kupitāśca doṣā iti svabhāvāt doṣatrayaprakopakaṃ viṣaṃ bhavati| tacchītavātādiṣu ‘dūṣīviṣasya tatraiva kopāt| mūrchati viṣayogāt| prasaktaṃ nirantaram|’ iti pā.| kupyatīti| dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitametadeveti etadeva sannipātodaraṃ dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitaṃ, na punaradhikamityarthaḥ| raktaṃ dūṣyaṃ dūṣayitvā bhavatīti dūṣyodaraṃ; kiṃvā parasparaṃ dūṣayantīti doṣā eva dūṣyāstaiḥ kṛtamudaramiti||11-14||–

ślaiṣmikamāha– śleṣmetyādi| aṅgasadanamaṅgasādaḥ, svāpaḥ aṅgānāmeva, anye āsīnapracalāyitam| gauravamaṅgānām| ‘nidrā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidrā nidrābāhulyam| utkleśo hṛllāsaḥ| stimitaṃ niścalam, ‘ ... śirānaddham’ iti pā.| śuklasirānaddham| etacca– ‘cirābhivṛddhiḥ kaṭhinam’ iti pā.| cirābhivṛddhiriti cirapāka ityarthaḥ| guru gauravayuktam| sthiraṃ guḍaguḍāśabdarahitam| sānnipātikamāha– striya ityādi| strīgrahaṇamavivekijanopalakṣaṇaṃ, striyo nakharomādibhiryuktaṃ yasmai annapānaṃ prayacchanti, asādhuvṛttāḥ saubhāgyamicchantyaḥ kāryākāryavicāravimukhāḥ, ārtavaṃ rajaḥ| śatravo vā yasmai garaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣam| duṣṭamambu ‘saviṣamanuṣyatṛṇa ... ’ iti pā.| saviṣakīṭatṛṇaparṇādikothayuktam| dūṣīviṣaṃ viṣameva vāyvagnyādyupahataṃ yadalpaprabhāvaṃ, viṣapītasya vā viṇmūtraṃ, tad dūṣīviṣamucyate; ‘dūṣyambudūṣīviṣayoḥ’ iti pā.| duṣṭāmbudūṣīviṣayoḥ sevanādvā| tenāśu raktaṃ duṣṭaṃ bhavati, viṣasyāgneyatvena raktasya duṣṭiḥ| kupitāśca doṣā iti svabhāvād doṣatrayaprakopakaṃ viṣaṃ bhavati| sughoraṃ bhṛśaṃ kaṣṭakāri| jaṭharamityudaravikāram| tacchītavātādiṣu kupyati kopaṃ gacchati, dūṣīviṣasya tatraiva kopāt| dahyate santapyate| ‘muhyati’ ityatra ‘mūrchati’ iti pā.| mūrchati viṣayogāt| prasaktaṃ nirantaram| dūṣyodaraṃ kīrtitametadeveti etadeva sānnipātodaraṃ kīrtitaṃ, na punaradhikamityarthaḥ| raktaṃ dūṣyaṃ dūṣayitvā bhavatīti dūṣyodaram, athavā parasparaṃ dūṣayantīti doṣā eva dūṣyāstaiḥ kṛtamudaraṃ dūṣyodaram||11-14||-

... plīhodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha ||15|| vidāhyabhiṣyandiratasya jantoḥ praduṣṭamatyarthamasṛk kaphaśca | plīhābhivṛddhiṃ kurutaḥ pravṛddhau plīhotthametajjaṭharaṃ vadanti ||16|| tadvāmapārśve parivṛddhimeti viśeṣataḥ sīdati cāturo'tra | mandajvarāgniḥ kaphapittaliṅgairupadrutaḥ kṣīṇabalo'tipāṇḍuḥ | savyānyapārśve yakṛti pravṛddhe jñeyaṃ yakṛddālyudaraṃ tadeva ||17|| (su. ni. a. 7) |

ab.seg: plīhodaramāha– plīhetyādi| asṛkkaphaścetyasṛgduṣṭyaiva tattulyakāraṇatayā pittaduṣṭirapyucyate, vidāhinā raktaṃ pittaṃ ca dūṣyate; ata eva paścāt vakṣyati– “kaphapittaliṅgairupadrutaḥ” iti| atra pittasya liṅgaṃ mandajvaraḥ, kaphasya liṅgaṃ mandāgnitvamiti gadādharaḥ| plīhodara eva yakṛddālyudarasyāvarodhaṃ darśayannāha– savyānyapārśva ityādi| savyānyapārśve dakṣiṇapārśve| tadeveti tādṛśameva, plīhodarasamameva; na vilakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| yakṛddālayati doṣairbhedayatīti yakṛddālyudaram||15-17||

plīhodaramāha– abhiṣyandītyādi| doṣadhātumalasrotasāṃ kledaprāptijananam| asṛkkaphaśceti asṛkkaphajaiva tulyakāraṇatayā pittaduṣṭirucyate| vidāhinā raktaṃ pittaṃ ca dūṣyati| ata eva vakṣyati– ‘kaphapittaliṅgairupadrutaḥ’ iti| tatra pittasya liṅgaṃ mando jvaraḥ, kaphasya liṅgaṃ mandāgnitvamiti gadādharaḥ| plīhodara eva yakṛddālyudarasyāvarodhaṃ darśayannāha– savyetyādi| savyānyapārśve dakṣiṇe, tadeveti tādṛśameva, tena plīhodareṇa samameva, na vilakṣaṇamityarthaḥ| yakṛddālayati doṣairbhedayatīti yakṛddālyudaram||15-17||

div.ab: udāvartarujānāhairmohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ | gauravārucikāṭhinyairvidyāttatra malān kramāt ||18|| (vā. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg: tatra doṣasambandhamāha– udāvartetyādi| udāvartarujānāhairvātaṃ, mohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ pittaṃ, gauravārucikāṭhinyaiḥ kaphaṃ jānīyāt||18||

tatra doṣasambandhamāha– udāvartetyādi| tatra plīhodarayakṛddālyudarayoḥ pṛthaglakṣaṇalakṣitān malān vātādīn krameṇodāvartādibhirliṅgairvidyāt| tatra udāvartarujānāhairvātaṃ, mohatṛḍdahanajvaraiḥ pittaṃ, gauravārucikāṭhinyaiḥ kaphaṃ jānīyāt||18||

div.ab: yasyāntramannairupalepibhirvā bālāśmabhirvā pihitaṃ yathāvat | sañcīyate tasya malaḥ sadoṣaḥ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ saṅkaravacca nāḍyām ||19|| nirudhyate tasya gude purīṣaṃ nireti kṛcchrādapi cālpamalpam | hṛnnābhimadhye parivṛddhimeti tasyodaraṃ baddhagudaṃ vadanti ||20|| (su. ni. a. 7) |

ab.seg: baddhagudamāha– yasyāntramannairityādi| upalepibhiḥ picchilairannaiḥ śākaśālukādibhiḥ| pihitaṃ vibaddham| yathāvaditi yathārham| malaḥ purīṣam| sadoṣa iti doṣatrayasahitaḥ| nāḍyāmityantranāḍyām| saṅkaravaditi sammārjanīkṣipyamāṇatṛṇādyavakaro yathā cīyate krameṇa tathetyarthaḥ| baddhagudamiti gudopari antrasya baddhatvādbaddhagudam| yaduktaṃ carake– “pakṣmabālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktairbaddhāyane gude|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| purīṣāyatanasya ‘baddhatvāt’ iti pā.| ruddhatvāt hṛnnābhimadhye'nnapākasthāne vṛddhiḥ; gudamātranirodhe tu maladoṣairgudādūrdhvamevodaravṛddhiḥ syāt||19-20||

baddhagudamāha– yasyetyādi| yasya puṃso'ntramupalepibhiḥ picchilairannaiḥ śākādibhirvā, yathāvaditi yathārhaṃ pihitaṃ baddhaṃ bhavati| ‘atra vāntre’ iti pā.| athavā'nne malaḥ purīṣaḥ, sadoṣaḥ doṣatrayasahitaḥ śanaiḥśanaiḥ sañcīyate sammārjanīkṣipyamāṇatṛṇādyavakaro yathā vṛddhiṃ nīyate krameṇa tathaivetyarthaḥ| tasya gude purīṣaṃ nirudhyate kṛcchrāccālpamalpaṃ nireti niḥsarati| baddhagudamiti gudopari antrasya baddhatvādbaddhagudam| yaduktaṃ carake– “pakṣmabālaiḥ sahānnena bhuktairbaddhāyane gude|” iti| purīṣāyatanasya ruddhatvāt| hṛnnābhimadhya iti annapākasthāne vṛddhiḥ, gudamātranirodhe tu maladoṣairgudādūrdhvamevodare vṛddhiḥ syāt||19-20||

div.ab: śalyaṃ tathā'nnopahitaṃ yadantraṃ bhuktaṃ bhinattyāgatamanyathā vā | tasmātsruto'ntrātsalilaprakāśaḥ srāvaḥ sravedvai gudatastu bhūyaḥ ||21|| nābheradhaścodarameti vṛddhiṃ nistudyate dālyati cātimātram | etat parisrāvyudaraṃ pradiṣṭaṃ ... |22| (su. ni. a. 7) |

kṣatodaramāha– ‘śalyaṃ tathā'nnopahitamityādi’ iti pā.| śalyamityādi| śalyaṃ kaṇṭakaśarkarādi| annopahitamannayuktam| bhuktamāgatamiti arthataḥ pākāśayāt; vilomenāgatamantraṃ bhinatti, ṛjvāgataṃ hi śalyamapi nāntrabhedakam| anyathā veti jṛmbhaṇātyaśanābhyāmantraṃ bhidyate| yaduktaṃ carake– “śarkarātṛṇaloṣṭāsthikaṇṭakairannasaṃyutaiḥ| bhidyetāntraṃ yadā bhuktairjṛmbhayā'tyaśanena vā||” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| sruta iti galitaḥ| ‘srāvaḥ sravedvai gudatastu bhūyaḥ’ iti ‘bhūyo’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhūyo bahu yathā bhavati tathā'ntrāt srutaḥ; doṣajeṣu punarupasnehanyāyenālpa eva srāvo bhūyaḥ punaḥ punaḥ gudataśca sravet| tuśabdaścārthe, bhūyaḥśabdo'trāvartanīyaḥ; tenoktā vyākhyā sādhvī bhavati| nanu, bhinnāntrāttiryagatra srāvanirgamaḥ; tat kathaṃ “srāvaḥ sravedvai gudatastu bhūya” ityupapadyate? naivaṃ, sacchidrāntramārgeṇa bahirgatasyātivṛddhasya punarāgamanāt upasnehanyāyādvā gudataḥ srāva upapanna eva| carake'pyuktam– “pūrayan gudamantraṃ ca janayatyudaraṃ nṛṇām|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| ‘tena’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tena srāveṇa dravasya nimnagatvānnābheradho jaṭharaṃ vṛddhimeti; etacchidrodaraṃ jalodaramiti bhaṇyate iti gadādharaḥ| yataścarakeṇoktam– “tadadho nābheḥ prāyo'bhinirvartamānaṃ jalodaraṃ syāt|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| tadanye nānumanyante, yataśchidrodaraṃ śīghraṃ jalodaratāṃ yātītyabhiprāyeṇa carakeṇoktam, anyathā dakodaraṃ pṛthaṅna syāt||21||–

ab.seg: kṣatodaramāha– śalyamityādi| śalyaṃ kaṇṭakaśarkarāsthikāṣṭhādikam| annopahitamannayuktaṃ, bhuktamāgatamityarthataḥ pakvāśayāt, vilomena nirgatamantraṃ bhinatti vidārayati, ṛjvāgataṃ śalyamapi nāntrabhedakam| anyathā veti jṛmbhaṇenātyaśitasyāntraṃ bhidyate| yaduktaṃ carake– “śarkarātṛṇaloṣṭāsthikaṇṭakairannasaṃyutaiḥ| bhidyate'ntraṃ yadā bhuktairjṛmbhayā'tyaśanena ca||” iti| sruta iti galitaḥ| srāvaḥ sravedvai gudatastu bhūya iti bhūyo bahu yathā bhavati tathā'ntrāt sruta iti nanu, bhinnāntrāt tiryagatra srāvo yuktaḥ, tatkathaṃ srāvaḥ sravedvai gudatastu bhūya ityupapadyate? naivaṃ, sacchidrāntramārgeṇa srāvasya nirgamatvādbahiṣkṛtasyātivṛddhasya punargamanādupasnehanyāyādvā gudataḥ srāva upapadyata eva| carake'pyuktam– “pūrayan gudamantraṃ ca janayatyudaraṃ nṛṇām|” iti| tena srāveṇa dravasya nimnagatvānnābheradho jaṭharaṃ vṛddhimeti, nistudyate śūlena dālyata iva| etat parisrāvyudaramanye ‘etasyeva’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | etasyeva chidrodaramāhuḥ||21||

div.ab: ... dakodaraṃ kīrtayato nibodha ||22|| yaḥ snehapīto'pyanuvāsito vā vānto virikto'pyathavā nirūḍhaḥ | pibejjalaṃ śītalamāśu tasya srotāṃsi dūṣyanti hi tadvahāni ||23|| snehopalipteṣvathavā'pi teṣu dakodaraṃ pūrvavadabhyupaiti | snigdhaṃ mahattatparivṛttanābhisamātataṃ pūrṇamivāmbunā ca | yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyati kampate ca śabdāyate cāpi dakodaraṃ tat ||24|| (su. ni. a. 7) |

ab.seg: utpattiviśiṣṭaṃ dakodaramāha– yaḥ snehapīta ityādi| snehapīta iti kartari ktaḥ, tena snehaṃ pītavānityarthaḥ| dūṣyantīti svakarmasu duṣṭāni ‘bhavantīti’ iti pā.| bhavanti| tadvahāni udakavahāni| teṣviti udakavahasrotaḥsu| pūrvavaditi yathā pūrvamuktam| annarasa upasnehanyāyena bahirniḥsṛtyodaraṃ janayatītyartha iti jejjaṭaḥ| gadādharastvāha– kṣatāntrodare yathā adhonābherudarābhivṛddhirgudasrāvaśca tathā jalodare'pi bhavatīti| nanu, sarveṣāmeva upasnehanyāyena bahirniḥsṛtānnarasamūlatvāt kathamanudakatvaṃ? naivaṃ, teṣu hi prathamato nātimandatvādagnerannarasasyālpatvāccānudakatvam, alpatvena tadvyapadeśāt; atra tu prāgeva bhūrijalotpattiriti viśeṣaḥ| samātataṃ vedanayā vistāryamāṇamivodaraṃ bhavati| yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyatīti dṛtiriva jalapūrṇā kṣubhyatīti, antarjalacalanamiva dhatte| śabdāyate guḍaguḍāyate||22-24||

dakodaramāha– dakodaramityādi| snehapīta iti kartari ktaḥ; tena ‘snehapītavānityarthaḥ|’ iti pā.| snehaṃ pītavānityarthaḥ| tasya tadvahāni srotāṃsi dūṣyantīti svakarmaṇyasamarthāni ‘bhavantīti’ iti pā.| bhavanti| tadvahānīti udakavahāni| athavā snehopalipteṣu teṣveva udakavahasrotaḥsu, pūrvavaditi kṣatāntrodare yathā nābheradhaḥ udarābhivṛddhiḥ, gudasrāvastathā jalodare bhavatīti| nanu sarveṣāmeva bahirniḥsṛtānnarasamūlatvātkathamanudakatvaṃ? ucyate– teṣu hi prathamato nātimandatvādagnerannarasasyālpatvāccānudakatvaṃ, svalpatvenāvyapadeśāt; atra tu prāgeva jalaṃ bhavatīti viśeṣaḥ| tadudaraṃ snigdhaṃ bhavati, tathā mahat, tathā parivṛttanābhi ucchalitanābhi, samātataṃ vedanayā vistīrṇamivodaraṃ bhavati| yathā dṛtiḥ kṣubhyatīti dṛtiriva jalapūrṇā kṣubhyatīti, antarjalacālanamiva dhatte, kampate veti kampanamatiśayena calanaṃ, śabdāyate guḍaguḍāyate||22-24||

div.ab: janmanaivodaraṃ sarvaṃ prāyaḥ kṛcchratamaṃ matam | balinastadajātāmbu yatnasādhyaṃ navotthitam ||25|| pakṣādbaddhagudaṃ tūrdhvaṃ sarvaṃ jātodakaṃ tathā | prāyo bhavatyabhāvāya chidrāntraṃ codaraṃ nṛṇām ||26|| (ca. ci. a. 13)0 |27|

ab.seg: udararogasya sādhyatvādilakṣaṇamāha– janmanaivetyādi| janmanaivodaramiti ‘utpattimātreṇaiva’ iti pā.| utpannamātreṇaiva| ajātodakasyodarasya lakṣaṇaṃ carake'vagantavyaṃ; tadyathā– “aśothamaruṇābhāsaṃ saśabdaṃ nātibhārikam| sadā guḍaguḍāyantaṃ ‘śirājālagavākṣitam’ iti pā.| sirājālagavākṣitam|| nābhiṃ viṣṭabhya pāyau tu vegaṃ kṛtvā praṇaśyati| hṛdvaṅkṣaṇakaṭīnābhigudapratyekaśūlinaḥ|| karkaśaṃ sṛjato vātaṃ nātimande ca pāvake| lālayā virase cāsye mūtre'lpe saṃhate viśi|| ajātodakamityetairyuktaṃ vijñāya lakṣaṇaiḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| atra karkaśamiti vegavantam| jātodakalakṣaṇaṃ ca carake yathā– “kukṣeratimātraṃ vṛddhiḥ sirāntardhānagamanam udakapūrṇadṛtisamānakṣobhasparśanaṃ ca bhavati|” (ca. ci. a. 13) iti| pakṣādityādi| baddhagudamudaraṃ pakṣādūrdhvaṃ vināśāya bhavatīti| jātodakaṃ pakṣāt| prāyograhaṇena kadācit pakṣādūrdhvamapi na vināśāya, tathā śalyaśāstrābhimatayā cikitsayā kadācijjātodakaṃ chidrāntraṃ baddhagudaṃ ca sidhyatīti darśayati| jātodakaṃ chidrāntraṃ ca vināśāya pakṣādūrdhvamiti sambandha iti kecit||25-26||

udarasyāsādhyatvamāha– janmanetyādi| utpattimātreṇaiva kaṣṭasādhyaṃ tadudaraṃ balinaḥ puruṣasya ajātāmbu ajātodakaṃ sat yatnataḥ sādhyaṃ kṛcchratvāditi| udarāṇāṃ viśeṣeṇāsādhyatvamāha– pakṣādityādi| baddhagudamudaraṃ pakṣādūrdhvaṃ vināśāya bhavati| jātodakaṃ pakṣāt, ‘jātodakaṃ lakṣaṇam’ iti pā.| jātodakalakṣaṇaṃ carake– “kukṣeratimātraṃ vṛddhiḥ ‘śirāntardhāna ... ’ iti pā.| sirāntardhānamudakapūrṇaṃ sakṣobhasparśanaṃ bhavati” iti| prāyograhaṇena kadācitpakṣādūrdhvamapi chidrāntraṃ baddhagudaṃ ca siddhyatīti||25-26||

div.ab: śūnākṣaṃ kuṭilopasthamupaklinnatanutvacam | balaśoṇitamāṃsāgniparikṣīṇaṃ ca varjayet ||27|| (ca. ci. a. 13) | pārśvabhaṅgānnavidveṣaśothātīsārapīḍitam | viriktaṃ cāpyudariṇaṃ pūryamāṇaṃ vivarjayet ||28|| (su. sū. a. 33) |

ab.seg: sādhyatayā'bhihitānāmapyavasthāviśeṣeṇāsādhyatāmāha– śūnākṣamityādi| ‘udariṇam’ iti śeṣaḥ| kuṭilopasthamiti vakramehanam| upaklinnatanutvacamiti upaklinnā tanvī tvak yasya tam| agniparikṣīṇamiti agnikṣayaśca yadyapyudare pūrvameva bhavati, tathā'pyatra viśeṣeṇāgnikṣayo lakṣaṇāntarayuktaścāsādhyatāliṅgaṃ sambhavatīti jñeyam||27-28||

punarapyasādhyamāha– śūnetyādi| atrodareṇeti śeṣaḥ| kuṭilopasthaṃ kuṭilamehanam| upaklinnatanutvacamiti upaklinnā tanvī tvagyasya tam| tathā'gniparikṣīṇamagnikṣayaścāpyudare pūrvameva bhavati, tathā'pyatra ‘viśeṣeṇāgnikṣayopalakṣaṇāntarayuktamasādhyatāliṅgam’ iti pā.| viśeṣeṇāgnikṣayo lakṣaṇāntarayuktaścāsādhyatāliṅgaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam| punarapyasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– pārśvetyādi| ‘bhagnapārśve’ iti pā.| bhagnaṃ pārśve| viriktamapi pūryamāṇodaramityarthaḥ||27-28||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne udaranidānaṃ samāptam ||35||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmudaranidānaṃ samāptam||35||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāmudaranidānam||35||

div.head: śothanidānam
div.ab: atha śothanidānam | raktapittakaphān vāyurduṣṭo duṣṭān bahiḥsirāḥ | nītvā ruddhagatistairhi kuryāttvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayam ||1|| utsedhaṃ saṃhataṃ śothaṃ tamāhurnicayādataḥ | sarvaṃ hetuviśeṣaistu rūpabhedānnavātmakam ||2|| doṣaiḥ pṛthagdvayaiḥ sarvairabhighātādviṣādapi |3| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

udare śothasyopadravatvenoktatvāttadanantaraṃ śothanidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– raktapittakaphānityādi| raktapittakaphān svahetubhiḥ svātantryeṇa duṣṭān kupitān, duṣṭaḥ svahetukupito vāyurbahiḥsirā bāhyā agambhīrāḥ sirā nītvā gamayitvā, taiḥ raktapittakaphaiḥ ruddhagatirāvṛtamārgo vāyurutsedhamucchrāyaṃ kuryāditi yojanā| bahiḥsirāśabdenātrāgambhīratayoktānāṃ srotasāmapi grahaṇam| tvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayamityanena vraṇaśothādbhedaṃ darśayati, aṣṭasu vraṇavāstuṣu vraṇaśothasya sambhavāt| yaduktaṃ suśrutena– “tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhikoṣṭhamarmāṇītyaṣṭau vraṇavāstūni bhavanti|” (su. sū. a. 22) iti| saṃhataṃ saṃhatātmakam| kutaḥ saṃhatātmakamityata āha– nicayādata iti| ato'smāt pūrvoktāt raktasahitadoṣatrayasamudāyāt; etena raktasahitatridoṣajanyatvamasyoktaṃ bhavati| sarvamityādi sarvamiti pūrveṇa sambadhyate, sarvamutsedhaṃ śothamāhurityarthaḥ| hetuviśeṣairiti doṣatrayābhighātaprabhṛtibhiḥ kāraṇabhedairyo rūpabhedastasmāt sarvaṃ navātmakamāhuriti pūrvakriyayā sambandhaḥ| ‘sarvahetuviśeṣaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare sarveṣāṃ hetuviśeṣairityarthaḥ| dvayairiti dvandvaiḥ, sarvaistribhiḥ||1-2||–

ab.seg: udare ‘śothasya upadravatvena’ iti pā.| śothasyopadravatvenoktatvāt tadanantaraṃ śothanidānam| asya samprāptimāha– raktetyādi| svahetubhiḥ svātantryeṇa duṣṭān kupitān raktapittakaphān svahetuduṣṭaḥ kupito vāyurbahiḥsirāḥ bāhyā agambhīrāḥ sirāḥ nītvā gamayitvā taiḥ raktapittakaphaiḥ ruddhagatirāvṛtamārgo vāyurutsedhamucchrāyaṃ kuryāditi yojanā| bahiḥsirāśabdena agambhīratayā uttānasrotasāmapi grahaṇam| tvaṅmāṃsasaṃśrayamityanena vraṇaśothādbhedaṃ darśayati, ‘pāṭhato’ iti pā.| pacyato vraṇasya vāstūnyaṣṭau, śothasya tvaṅmāṃse, iti bhedaḥ; taduktam– “tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhikoṣṭhamarmāṇītyaṣṭau vraṇavāstūni bhavanti|” iti| aṣṭasu vraṇavāstuṣu vraṇaśothasya sambhavāt| saṃhataṃ saṃhatātmakaṃ, kutaḥ saṃhatātmakamityāha– nicayāt| ataḥ pūrvoktāt raktasahitadoṣatrayasamudāyāt; etena doṣatrayajanyatvamasyoktam| tasya saṅkhyāmāha– sarvamiti pūrveṇa sambadhyate, sarvamutsedhaṃ śophamityāhurityarthaḥ| ‘ ... prabhūtakāraṇabhedairyo’ iti pā.| hetuviśeṣairdoṣatrayābhighātaprabhṛtikāraṇabhedairyo rūpabhedaḥ tasmānnavātmakamāhuriti pūrvakriyayā sambandhaḥ, ‘sarvahetuviśeṣaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare sarveṣāṃ śothānāṃ hetuviśeṣairityarthaḥ| doṣairiti pṛthak tribhirdoṣaistrayaḥ, ‘militairekadvayaistrayaḥ’ iti pā.| militairdvayaistrayaḥ, abhighātenaikaḥ, viṣeṇa caikaḥ||1-2||

div.ab: tatpūrvarūpaṃ davathuḥ sirāyāmo'ṅgagauravam ||3|| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpamāha– tadityādi| davathurupatāpaḥ| sirāyāmaḥ sirāprasaraṇavat pīḍā||3||
pūrvarūpamāha– tadityādi| davathuścakṣurādiṣu tīvradāhaḥ, yaduktaṃ carake– “davathuścakṣurādibhyastīvra ūṣmā pravartate”| sirāyāmaḥ sirāprasāraṇavat pīḍā||3||

div.ab: śuddhyāmayābhuktakṛśābalānāṃ ‘kṣīrāmla...’ iti pā. | kṣārāmlatīkṣṇoṣṇagurūpasevā | dadhyāmamṛcchākavirodhiduṣṭagaropasṛṣṭānnaniṣevaṇaṃ ca ||4|| arśāṃsyaceṣṭā na ca dehaśuddhirmarmopaghāto viṣamā prasūtiḥ | mithyopacāraḥ pratikarmaṇāṃ ca nijasya hetuḥ śvayathoḥ pradiṣṭaḥ ||5|| (ca. ci. a. 12) |

ab.seg: pūrvarūpānantaraṃ kāmacārānnidānamāha– śuddhyāmayetyādi| śuddhirvamanavirecanādiḥ, āmayā jvarādayaḥ; abhuktamabhojanaṃ viguṇaṃ ca bhojanaṃ, taiḥ kṛśānāmabalānāṃ ca kṣārādisevā nijasya śvayathorhetuḥ| dadhyādayaḥ svatantrā eva hetavaḥ, āmamapakvaṃ, duṣṭaṃ doṣajanakaṃ ‘maṇḍakanavodakādi’ iti pā.| mandakanavodakādi, garaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣam| aceṣṭā niṣkriyatvam| na ca dehaśuddhiriti śodhanārhe'pi doṣe dehāśuddhiḥ| marmopaghāta iha doṣakṛta eva jñeyaḥ, bāhyahetujastu marmopaghāta āgantuśothahetureva| viṣamā prasūtirāmagarbhapatanādikā| mithyopacāro'samyakkaraṇamasamyagupacāraḥ| pratikarmaṇāṃ vamanādīnām||4-5||

atha kāraṇamāha– śuddhītyādi| śuddhirvamanādiḥ, āmayā jvarādayaḥ, abhuktamabhojanam, etairye kṛśāstathā abalāśca, teṣāṃ etacca– kṣīrāmleti pāṭha.| kṣīrādisevanaṃ nijasya śvayathoḥ kāraṇaṃ; ‘dadhyādiṣu’ iti pā.| dadhyādi tu svatantrameva kāraṇam| āmamapakvaṃ, duṣṭaṃ doṣajanakaṃ maṇḍakanavodakādi, garaṃ saṃyogajaṃ viṣam, aceṣṭā niṣkriyatvaṃ, na ca dehaśuddhiriti śodhanārhe'pi doṣe tatra dehāśuddhiḥ| marmopaghāta iha doṣakṛta eva jñeyaḥ, bāhyahetujaśca marmopaghāta āgantuśophahetureva| viṣamā prasūtiriti āmagarbhapatanādikā| pratikarmaṇāṃ vamanādīnāṃ, mithyopacāraḥ asamyagupacāraḥ||4-5||
sagauravaṃ syādanavasthitatvaṃ sotsedhamūṣmā'tha sirātanutvam | salomaharṣaśca vivarṇatā ca sāmānyaliṅgaṃ śvayathoḥ pradiṣṭam ||6||
sāmānyaliṅgamāha– ‘setyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | setyādi| sagauravamiti anavasthitatvaviśeṣaṇaṃ, tathā sotsedhamiti ca||6||
tasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– sagauravamityādi| ūṣmasantāpayuktaṃ sirākṛśatvaṃ tāsāmalābhāt||6||

div.ab: calastanutvak paruṣo'ruṇo'sitaḥ suṣuptiharṣārtiyuto'nimittataḥ | praśāmyati pronnamati prapīḍito divābalī ca śvayathuḥ samīraṇāt ||7|| (ca. ci. a. 12) |

ab.seg: vātaśothaliṅgamāha– cala ityādi| tanutvak ‘abahulatvak’ iti pā.| abahalatvak| asitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ| suṣuptiḥ sparśājñatā; harṣo jhiṇijhiṇivadvedanā, kiṃvā romaharṣaḥ| animittataḥ praśāmyatīti vāyoścalatvena kadācinnimittaṃ vinā'pi līno bhavati; ‘nimittata’ iti pāṭhe snehoṣṇamardanādernimittataḥ praśāmyati upaśamaṃ prāpnotīti, upaśayārthametaduktam| pronnamati prapīḍita iti prapīḍitaḥ sannantarunnamatītyarthaḥ| divābalīti divā balavān, natvabalī| snehoṣṇamardanādyaiśca praśāmyet, sa ca vātikaḥ; “yaścāpyaruṇavarṇābhaḥ śotho naktaṃ praṇaśyati|” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti carakavacanāt||7||

atha vātaśothalakṣaṇamāha– caletyādi| calaḥ sthānāt sthānāntaragatiḥ, tanutvak ‘abalatvak’ iti pā.| abahalatvak, paruṣaḥ karkaśaḥ, aruṇaḥ raktavarṇaḥ, asitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, suṣuptiḥ sparśājñānaṃ, harṣo lomaharṣaḥ, atra ‘atiratiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake upalabhyate | animittataḥ praśāmyatīti vāyoścalatvena ca kadācinnimittaṃ vinā'pi vilīno bhavati, pronnamati prapīḍita iti prapīḍitaḥ sannanantaramunnamatītyarthaḥ| divābalī divābalavān, yaduktaṃ carake– “yaścāpyaruṇavarṇābhaḥ śopho naktaṃ praśāmyati|” iti||7||

div.ab: mṛduḥ sagandho'sitapītarāgavān bhramajvarasvedatṛṣāmadānvitaḥ | ya uṣyate spaṣṭarugakṣirāgakṛt sa pittaśotho bhṛśadāhapākavān ||8|| (ca. ci. a. 12) |

ab.seg: paittikamāha– mṛdurityādi| uṣyate iti dahyate||8||
paittikamāha– mṛdurityādi| mṛdusparśaḥ, gandhayuktaḥ, akṣṇo rogakṛt, atiśayadāhapākavān||8||

div.ab: guruḥ sthiraḥ pāṇḍurarocakānvitaḥ prasekanidrāvamivahnimāndyakṛt | sa kṛcchrajanmapraśamo nipīḍito na connamedrātribalī kaphātmakaḥ ||9|| (ca. ci. a. 12) |

ab.seg: kaphajamāha– gururityādi| arocakānvita iti arocakavyādhisahacārī| kṛcchrajanmapraśama iti cirotpattivināśaḥ| rātribalīti rātrau sroto'varodhajena dehakledenāceṣṭayā ca kaphasya vṛddhatvāt tajjaḥ śotho balavān bhavati; divā tu sphuṭasrotasi śarīre saceṣṭe ca na kapho balī bhavati, kiṃ tarhi vāyuḥ, tena tajjaḥ śotho divābalī bhavati||9||

kaphajamāha– gururityādi| sthiraḥ acalaḥ, praseko lālāsrāvaḥ, sa kṛcchrajanmapraśama iti rātrau sroto'varodhajena dehakledena ceṣṭayā ca kaphasya vṛddhyā tajjaḥ śotho balavān bhavati| divā sphuṭasrotasi śarīre ceṣṭāyukte ca kapho na balī vāyustena balī, tajjaḥ śotho divābalī bhavati||9||

div.ab: nidānākṛtisaṃsargācchvayathuḥ syāddvidoṣajaḥ | sarvākṛtiḥ sannipātācchotho vyāmiśralakṣaṇaḥ ||10|| (ca. sū. a. 18) |

ab.seg: vyāmiśrauṣadhavidhānārthaṃ kvāpi kvāpi prakṛtisamasamavetā api śiṣyahitaiṣitayā dvandvasannipātā atideśena ‘gaṇyante’ iti pā.| paṭhyante, ye tu vikṛtiviṣamasamavetāstān kaṇṭharaveṇa ‘paṭhati’ iti pā.| paṭhanti; ato'tideśena dvandvatrayasannipātānāha– nidānākṛtisaṃsargādityādi| vyāmiśralakṣaṇa iti militavātāditrayaliṅgaḥ| anenaiva sarvākṛtirityasyārthe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ vātādipratyekaṃ kṛtsnaliṅganiyamārtham||10||
dvandvajatrayasannipātajamāha– nidānetyādi| dvidoṣayornidānalakṣaṇasaṃsargayoḥ dvidoṣajā jñeyāḥ| sannipātāt sarvākṛtiḥ, vyāmiśralakṣaṇaḥ militavātāditrayaliṅgaḥ||10||

div.ab: abhighātena śastrādicchedabhedakṣatādibhiḥ | himānilodadhyanilairbhallātakapikacchujaiḥ ||11|| rasaiḥ śūkaiśca saṃsparśācchvayathuḥ syādvisarpavān | bhṛśoṣmā lohitābhāsaḥ prāyaśaḥ pittalakṣaṇaḥ ||12|| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

ab.seg: abhighātajaṃ śvayathumāha– abhighātenetyādi| abhighātena yaḥ śothaḥ sa śastrādibhirbhavati| himānilodadhyanilairiti ‘himānilairudadhyanilaiḥ’ iti pā.| himānilairudadhyanilaiśca; udadhiḥ samudraḥ| bhallātakapikacchujai rasaiḥ śūkairiti bhallātakarasaiḥ, kapikacchvā śūkaiśca; kapikacchuḥ śūkaśimbī||11-12||

abhighātajaśothamāha– abhighātenetyādi| ‘śvayathuḥ saśastrādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| sa śvayathuḥ śastrādibhiḥ kṛto bhavati| himānilaḥ śītavāyuḥ, udadhyanilaḥ samudravātaḥ, bhallātakarasaiḥ kapikacchuśūkaiḥ kapikacchuḥ śūkaśimbī, eteṣāṃ sparśāt; prasaraṇaśīlaḥ, bhṛśoṣmā atiśayasantāpakṛt, pittaśvayathulakṣaṇaḥ||11-12||

div.ab: viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇiparisarpaṇamūtraṇāt | daṃṣṭrādantanakhāghātādaviṣaprāṇināmapi ||13|| viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṅkarāt | viṣavṛkṣānilasparśādgarayogāvacūrṇanāt ||14|| mṛduścalo'valambī ca śīghro dāharujākaraḥ |15| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

viṣajamāha– ‘viṣajaḥ saviṣaprāṇītyādi’ iti pā.| viṣaja ityādi| saviṣaprāṇinaḥ sarpādayasteṣāṃ parisarpaṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ tasmāt, saviṣaprāṇināṃ mūtraṇācca| daṃṣṭrādanteti daṃṣṭrā kuṭilā ‘dāḍha’ iti khyātā, tadviparītaśca danto gobalīvardanyāyāt| viṇmūtraśukropahatamalavadvastrasaṅkarāditi saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtrādyupahataṃ malavacca vastraṃ yattasya saṃsparśāt| avalambī adhogamanaśīlaḥ| śīghraḥ śīghrotpattiḥ| ayaṃ cāganturapi viśiṣṭaliṅgacikitsopayogāt pṛthak paṭhitaḥ||13-14||– ‘viṣe śothalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: viṣajaśothalakṣaṇamāha– viṣajetyādi| saviṣaprāṇinaḥ saviṣā ye jantavaḥ śatapadīlūtādayaḥ, teṣāṃ śarīropari sarpaṇaṃ ‘mūtraṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mūtraṇaṃ ca dvayamapi śvayathorhetuḥ| daṃṣṭrādanteti daṃṣṭrā kuṭilākārā ‘dāḍha’ iti loke, dantā agrebhavāḥ, anye daṃṣṭridantanakheti paṭhanti, tatra daṃṣṭriṇo vyāghrādayaḥ, nakhāḥ prasiddhāḥ| aviṣaprāṇināṃ manuṣyādīnāmapyabhighātaḥ śothahetuḥ| viṇmūtretyādi saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtrādyupahatamalavadvastrasya saṃsparśāt; anye ‘malavadvastu’ iti paṭhanti, tatra saviṣaprāṇināṃ viṇmūtraśukropahatatvenaitadyanmalavadvastu tasya samparkādityarthaḥ| saviṣā ye vṛkṣāsteṣāṃ yo'nilaḥ, tasya sparśādapi| ‘garakṛtrimaviṣam’ iti pā.| garaḥ kṛtrimaviṣaṃ tasyāvacūrṇanāt, tasya śarīrasparśādityarthaḥ| ‘mṛduḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mṛduḥ mṛdusparśaḥ, calaḥ sthānāntaragatiḥ, avalambī adhogamanaśīlaḥ, śīghraḥ śīghrotpattiḥ||13-14||

div.ab: doṣāḥ śvayathumūrdhvaṃ hi kurvantyāmāśayasthitāḥ ||15|| pakvāśayasthā madhye tu varcaḥsthānagatāstvadhaḥ | kṛtsnadehamanuprāptāḥ kuryuḥ sarvasaraṃ tathā ||16|| (su. ci. a. 23) |

ab.seg: yatrasthā doṣā yatra deśe śothaṃ kurvanti tamāha– ‘doṣāḥ śvayathumūrdhvamityādi’ iti pā.| doṣā ityādi| ūrdhvamiti uraḥprabhṛtyūrdhvadehe| madhya iti uraḥpakvāśayamadhye| adha iti pakvāśayādadhaḥ| sarvasaraṃ sarvaśarīrasaraṇaśīlam||15-16||

yasmin deśe doṣāḥ śophaṃ kurvanti tamāha– doṣā ityādi| ūrdhvamiti uraḥprabhṛtyūrdhvadehe| madhya iti uraḥpakvāśayamadhye, adha iti pakvāśayādadho varcaḥsthānaṃ purīṣāśayaḥ, sarvaśarīrasaraṇaśīlam||15-16||
yo madhyadeśe śvayathuḥ sa kaṣṭaḥ sarvagaśca yaḥ | ‘adhāṅga’ iti aśuddhaḥ pā. | ardhāṅge riṣṭabhūtaḥ syādyaścordhvaṃ parisarpati ||17||
śvāsaḥ pipāsā chardiśca daurbalyaṃ jvara eva ca | yasya cānne rucirnāsti śvayathuṃ taṃ vivarjayet ||18||
(su. ci. a. 23) | ananyopadravakṛtaḥ śothaḥ pādasamutthitaḥ | puruṣaṃ hanti nārīṃ ca mukhajo guhyajo dvayam | navo'nupadravaḥ śothaḥ sādhyo'sādhyaḥ pureritaḥ ||19||
(vā. ni. a. 13) | vivarjayet kukṣyudarāśritaṃ ca tathā gale marmaṇi saṃśritaṃ ca | sthūlaḥ kharaścāpi bhavedvivarjyo yaścāpi bālasthavirābalānām ||20||

ataḥ paraṃ kṛcchrādibhedamāha– yo madhyadeśa ityādi| madhyadehagasya kaṣṭatvaṃ taddeśagaśothaprabhāvāt| sarvaga iti sarvadehagāmī| sarvaja iti pāṭhāntare sarvajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ| riṣṭabhūta iti riṣṭatulyaḥ, bhūtaśabda upamāne; yathā– mātṛbhūtaḥ, pitṛbhūta iti| vyādherevātra riṣṭabhūtatvaṃ, tasya ca nimittakṛtatvāt bhūtaśabda upātta iti kārtikaḥ| anye tu bhūtaśabdaṃ svarūpavacanamāhuḥ| yaścordhvaṃ parisarpatīti puruṣaviṣayakametat; cakārāt striyāśca uparijo yo'dho yāti sa gṛhyate, tathā guhyajo yaḥ sarvagaḥ| vacanaṃ hi– “yastu pādābhinirvṛttaḥ śothaḥ sarvāṅgago bhavet| puruṣaṃ hanti, nārīṃ ca mukhajo, guhyajo dvayam||” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti| ananyopadravakṛta iti anyasya upadravā anyopadravāstadviparītā ananyopadravāḥ; etenāyamarthaḥ– śothasyaiva ye upadravāstaiḥ kṛtaḥ| te ca– “śvāsaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ jvaraśchardirarocakaḥ| hikkātīsārakāsāśca śothinaṃ kṣapayanti hi||” (su. ci. a. 23) iti suśrutoktāḥ| carake'pyuktam– “chardistṛṣṇā'ruciḥ śvāso jvaro'tīsāra eva ca| saptako'yaṃ sadaurbalyaḥ śothopadravasaṅgrahaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 18) iti| athavā anyamupadravaṃ karotīti anyopadravakṛnnidānam| nānyopadravakṛdananyopadravakṛt, tataḥ svanidānāt ‘jātaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tena śothajanakanidānādeva utpanna ityarthaḥ| pāṇḍurogādau tu yaḥ śothaḥ pādasamutthitaḥ so'nyopadravakṛto nidānāntarājjātaḥ sādhya eva| ‘ānanopadravagata’ iti pāṭhāntare ayamarthaḥ– pādayorutthitaḥ pūrvaṃ paścādānanamupadraveṇa prasāreṇa upadravatvena vā gataḥ| tathāca tantrāntaram– “ ‘pādapravṛttaśvayathurnṛṇām’ iti pā.| pādapravṛttaḥ śvayathurnṛṇāṃ yaḥ prāpnuyānmukham| strīṇāṃ vaktrādadho yāti, bastijaśca na sidhyati||” iti| ‘kṣīrapāṇinā ... ’ iti pā.| kṣārapāṇinā'pyuktam– “ūrdhvagāmī naraṃ padbhyāmadhogāmī mukhāt striyam| ubhayaṃ bastisañjātaḥ śotho hanti na saṃśayaḥ||” iti| guhyaja iti bastijātaḥ| dvayamiti naraṃ nārīṃ ca| asādhyaḥ purerita iti “ardhāṅge riṣṭabhūta” ityādinā||17-20||

ataḥ sthānāśrayatve kṛcchrādibhedamāha– ya ityādi| madhyagaśvayathoḥ kaṣṭasādhyatvaṃ taddeśaprabhāvāt| sarvaga iti sarvadehagāmī, ‘sarvaja’ iti ‘pāṭhāntare’ iti pā.| pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra sānnipātikaḥ| riṣṭabhūta iti riṣṭatulyaḥ; bhūtaśabdo hyupamāne, yathā mātṛbhūtaḥ pitṛbhūta iti| yaścordhvaṃ parisarpatīti puruṣaviṣayametat, cakārāt striyāścoparijo yo'dho yāti sa gṛhyate, tathā guhyajo yaḥ sa sarvagaḥ| upadravaviśeṣasyāsādhyatvamāha– śvāsa iti| yasyaitāni santi śvayathau sati, taṃ parivarjayet| sthānabhedenāsādhyatvamāha– ananyetyādi| na anyopadravāḥ ananyopadravāḥ śophasyopadravāstaiḥ kṛtaḥ, te ca suśrutoktāḥ– “śvāsaḥ pipāsā daurbalyaṃ jvaraśchardirarocakaḥ| hikkātīsārakāsāśca śothinaṃ kṣapayanti hi|” iti| carake'pyuktam– “chardiḥ śvāso'rucistṛṣṇā jvaro'tīsāra eva ca| ‘saptakopam’ iti pā.| saptako'yaṃ sadaurbalyaḥ śothopadravasaṅgraha||” iti| athavā anyamupadravaṃ karotīti anyopadravakṛt nidānaṃ, na anyopadravakṛt ananyopadravakṛt, tato nidānājjāta ityanena śophajanakanidānādevotpanna ityarthaḥ| pāṇḍurogādau tu yaḥ śophaḥ so'nyopadravakṛto nidānājjātaḥ sādhya eva| pādasamutthitaḥ puruṣaṃ hanti nārīṃ tu mukhajo hanti, guhyajo bastisañjātaḥ, atra ‘sarpan’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| dvayamiti naraṃ nārīṃ ca| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “pādapravṛttaḥ śvayathurnṛṇāṃ yaḥ prāpnuyānmukham| vakrādadhastādyo yāti bastijaśca na siddhyati|” kṣīrapāṇinā'pyuktam– “ūrdhvagāmī naraṃ padbhyāmadhogāmī mukhātstriyam| ubhayorbastisañjātaḥ śotho hanti na saṃśayaḥ||” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| sādhyāsādhyalakṣaṇamāha– nava iti| navo navotthānaḥ, upadravarahitaḥ, upadravāḥ pūrvoktāḥ śvāsādayaḥ, tairmuktaḥ sa sādhyaḥ, asādhyaḥ ‘pūrverita ūrdhvāṅge iti bhūtaḥ’ iti pā.| pūrvairita ūrdhvāṅge riṣṭabhūtaḥ||17-20||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śothanidānaṃ samāptam ||36||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śothanidānaṃ samāptam||36||
ityātaṅkadarpaṇe nidānavyākhyāyāṃ śothanidānam||36||

div.head: vṛddhinidānam
div.ab: atha vṛddhinidānam | kruddho'nūrdhvagatirvāyuḥ śothaśūlakaraścaran | muṣkau vaṅkṣaṇataḥ prāpya phalakoṣābhivāhinīḥ ||1|| prapīḍya dhamanīrvṛddhiṃ karoti phalakoṣayoḥ | doṣāsramedomūtrāntraiḥ sa vṛddhiḥ saptadhā gadaḥ ||2|| mūtrāntrajāvapyanilāddhetubhedastu kevalam |3| (vā. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: śothatvasāmānyāt śothānantaraṃ vṛddhirabhidhīyate| vṛddheḥ samprāptimāha– kruddho'nūrdhvagatirvāyurityādi| anūrdhvagatiradhogatirvāyuḥ muṣkau prāpya caran gacchan vaṅkṣaṇato meḍhrorusandherityarthaḥ| meḍhrajaṅghāsandheḥ sakāśāt; phalakoṣābhivāhinīriti phalaṃ ca koṣaśca phalakoṣau, athavā phalayoḥ koṣau, tadvahā dhamanīśca prapīḍya sandūṣya, vṛddhiṃ karoti| phalakoṣayoriti dvivacanamupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenaikakoṣe'pi dṛśyamānā vṛddhiḥ saṅgatā| sa vṛddhiriti “kticktau ca sañjñāyām” ityanena ktijanto vṛddhiśabdaḥ puṃliṅgaḥ, ktinnantastu strīliṅgaḥ| vṛddhiḥ kuraṇḍo'bhidhīyate| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ saptadheti vacanaṃ nyūnādhikasaṅkhyānirāsārthaṃ, tena dvandvajādivṛddheradhikāyā nirāsaḥ, asambhavastu tasyā vyādhisvabhāvāt; mūtrāntravṛddhyorvātavṛddhyantarbhāvāt nyūnasaṅkhyānirāsārtham anayorvātajatve'pi nimittacikitsābhedāt pṛthagabhidhānaṃ, nimittabhedanibandhana eva vyādhibhedaḥ| yaduktam– “doṣadūṣyasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittataścaiṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ bhedaḥ|” (su. sū. a. 24) iti| ata āha– mūtrāntrajāvapyanilāddhetubhedastu kevalamiti||1-2||

śothādhikārāt vṛddhirabhidhīyate| vṛddheḥ samprāptimāha– kruddha ityādi| anūrdhvagatirvāyuḥ adhogatirvāto muṣkau prāpya caran gacchan, vaṅkṣaṇato meḍhrajaṅghāsandheḥ sakāśāt, phalakoṣābhivāhinīriti phalaṃ ca kośaśca phalakośau, athavā phalayoḥ kośau phalakośau, tadvahā dhamanīḥ prapīḍya sandūṣya vṛddhiṃ karoti, phalakoṣayoriti dvivacanamupalakṣaṇaṃ, tenaikaphalakoṣe'pi dṛśyamānā vṛddhiḥ sammatā| vṛddhiḥ ‘kuraṇḍa’ iti loke| vṛddheḥ saṅkhyāmāha– doṣetyādi| doṣatrayaistrayaḥ, raktenaikaḥ, medasā caikaḥ, mūtreṇaikaḥ, evaṃ ‘sapta saṅkhyeyaiva nirdeśādeva’ iti pā.| sapta| saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva saṅkhyāyāṃ labdhāyāṃ punaḥ saptadheti vacanaṃ nyūnādhikasaṅkhyānirāsārthaṃ, dvandvajāyā api vṛddhernirāsaḥ, dvandvajāyāstvasambhavo vyādhisvabhāvāt; mūtrāntravṛddhyorvātavṛddhyantarbhāvāt nyūnasaṅkhyānirāsaḥ, anayorvātajatve'pi nidānacikitsābhedāt pṛthagabhidhānaṃ, nidānabhedanibandhana eva vyādhibhedaḥ| uktaṃ ca– “doṣadūṣyasaṃsargādāyatanaviśeṣānnimittataścaiṣāṃ vyādhīnāṃ bhedaḥ” iti| ata eva mūtrāntrajāvapi vātāt, tatra hetubhedata eva bhedaḥ kevala iti| vṛddhiśabdaḥ pulliṅgo vā||1-2||

div.ab: vātapūrṇadṛtisparśo rūkṣo vātādaheturuk ||3|| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pittāddāhoṣmapākavān kaphācchīto guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino'lparuk ||4|| kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaśca raktajaḥ | kaphavanmedasā vṛddhirmṛdustālaphalopamaḥ ||5|| mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajaḥ sa tu gacchataḥ | ambhobhiḥ pūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti saruṅmṛduḥ ||6|| mūtrakṛcchramadhaḥ syācca cālayan phalakoṣayoḥ |7| (vā. ni. a. 11) |

vātajādīnāṃ mūtrajāntānāṃ vṛddhīnāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇānyāha– vātetyādi| aheturugiti animittato dāhādiruk| raktaje ‘kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛta’ iti pittajavṛddhiliṅgādadhikaṃ; tena hetuliṅgacikitsābhedādraktajavṛddhiḥ pṛthaggaṇyate| medoje tālaphalopama iti pakvatālaphalamiva nīlavartulaḥ| mūtraje mūtrakṛcchramiti mūtrakṛcchravat vedanā| cālayan phalakoṣayoriti phalakoṣayoścālayan calo bhavannitastato gacchan so'dhaḥ syāt| cālayanniti svārthiko ṇic||3-6||–

vātajamāha– vātetyādi| dṛtiścarmakhalliḥ| animittato bhedatodādiruk| pittajamāha– pakvetyādi| pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ pakvodumbaraphalābhaḥ, tathā dāhādiyuktaḥ| kaphavṛddhimāha– kaphādityādi| kaphād vṛddhiḥ śītaḥ śītasparśaḥ, tathā guruḥ snigdhaḥ kaṇḍūmān kaṭhino'śmavat, alparuk mandavedanaḥ| raktajamāha– raktetyādi| raktajo vṛddhiḥ, atra tu kṛṣṇasphoṭaiścitaḥ pittavṛddhiliṅgaiśca pakvodumbarasaṅkāśādibhiryuto bhavet| atra tu kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛta iti pittavṛddhiliṅgādadhikaṃ, tena hetubhedacikitsābhedādraktajo vṛddhiḥ pṛthaggaṇyate| medojamāha– ‘ ... lakṣaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| kaphavatkaphavṛddhilakṣaṇaṃ tālaphalopama iti pakvatālavannīlavartulaḥ| mūtrajamāha– mūtretyādi| mūtradhāraṇaśīlasya mūtrajo bhavati, gacchataḥ puṃsaḥ jalapūrṇadṛtivat kṣobhaṃ yāti pūrito bhavati, saruk savyathaḥ, mṛduḥ mṛdusparśaḥ| mūtrakṛcchramiti mūtrakṛcchravedanaḥ| phalakośayoriti phalakośayoścālayan calo bhavannitastato gacchan so'dhaḥ syāt| cālayanniti svārthiko ṇic| ‘valayaṃ phalakośayoḥ’ iti pāṭhe phalakośayoradhastādvalayaṃ kaṅkaṇaṃ syāt||3-6||–

vātakopibhirāhāraiḥ śītatoyāvagāhanaiḥ ||7|| dhāraṇeraṇabhārādhvaviṣamāṅgapravartanaiḥ | kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣobhito'nyaiśca kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ yadā ||8|| pavano viguṇīkṛtya svaniveśādadho nayet | kuryādvaṅkṣaṇasandhistho granthyābhaṃ śvayathuṃ tadā ||9|| upekṣyamāṇasya ca muṣkavṛddhimādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ sa vāyuḥ | ‘pīḍito ... ’ iti pā. | prapīḍito'ntaḥsvanavān prayāti pradhmāpayanneti punaśca muktaḥ ||10|| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate yasyāntrāvayavāśleṣānmuṣkayorvātasambhavāt | antravṛddhirasādhyo'yaṃ vātavṛddhisamākṛtiḥ ||11|| (vā. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: antravṛddhimāha– vātakopibhirityādi| dhāraṇaṃ vegasyopasthitasya, īraṇamaprāptasya| kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣubhito'nyairiti balavadvigrahadhanurākarṣaṇādibhiḥ| kṣudrāntrāvayavamiti bṛhadantravyudāsārtham| viguṇīkṛtyeti saṅkucīkṛtya| dviguṇīkṛtyeti pāṭhāntare saṅkocena dviguṇīkṛtya| svaniveśāt svasthānāt| tadā vaṅkṣaṇasandhisthaḥ san vaṅkṣaṇasandhau granthirūpaṃ sādhyaṃ śvayathuṃ karoti, tatra granthirūpeṇa sthitvā kālāntareṇa phalakoṣaṃ gacchatīti| tāṃ muṣkavṛddhimādhmānarukstambhavatīmupekṣyamāṇasya ‘acikitsitaḥ puruṣasya’ iti pā.| acikitsitapuruṣasya| atra bhojaḥ– “antraṃ dviguṇamādāya jantornayati vaṅkṣaṇam| vaṅkṣaṇāttadrujāyuktaṃ phalakoṣaṃ prapadyate||” iti| pradhmāpayanniti ucchūnayan| asādhyo'yamiti kathaṃ? yato'sya cikitsā'bhihitā; naivam, aprāptaphalakoṣāyāmayaṃ cikitsāvidhiḥ; prāptaphalakoṣā tvasādhyā; yāpyāyāṃ vā tasyāṃ cikitsāvidhiḥ| yaduktaṃ bhoje– “yāpyāṃ tāmantrajāṃ viduḥ|” iti| bradhnanidānaṃ tu tantrāntare paṭhyate| tadyathā– “atyabhiṣyandigurvannasevanānnicayaṃ gataḥ| karoti granthivacchothaṃ doṣo vaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu|| jvaraśūlāṅgasādāḍhyaṃ taṃ bradhnamiti nirdiśet||” iti||7-10||

antravṛddhimāha– vātetyādi| vātakopibhirāhārai rūkṣatiktakaṣāyādibhirāsevitaistathā śītatoyāvagāhanaistathā dhāraṇeraṇabhārādibhiranyaiśca kṣobhaṇaiḥ kṣobhitaḥ kupitaḥ pavano vāyuryadā yasmin kāle kṣudrāntrāvayavaṃ (mūtraśakṛdgātraikadeśaṃ?) svaniveśāt svasthānāt, dviguṇīkṛtyā'dho nayediti piṇḍārthaḥ| kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekapaṅktipaścāt upalabhyate | anye viguṇīkṛtyeti paṭhanti| dhāraṇamupasthitavegasya atra ‘iti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|, īraṇamaprāptavegasya, kṣobhaṇaiḥ pūrvoktaiḥ, anyairiti balavadvigrahaiḥ dhanurākarṣaṇādibhiḥ, viṣamāṅgapravartanaiḥ viṣamatvena śarīramoṭanaiḥ| kvacitpustake ‘anye viguṇīkṛtyeti paṭhanti|’ iti paṅktiḥ atra upalabhyate | pavano vaṅkṣaṇasandhisthaḥ san, vaṅkṣaṇasandhau granthirūpamasādhyaṃ śvayathuṃ karoti| tatra granthirūpeṇa sthitvā kālāntareṇa phalakośaṃ gacchati| tāṃ muṣkavṛddhimādhmānarukstambhavatīṃ tadopekṣamāṇasyācikitsataḥ puruṣasya| yadāha bhojaḥ– “antraṃ dviguṇamādāya jantornayati vaṅkṣaṇam| vaṅkṣaṇāttadrujāyuktaṃ phalakośaṃ prapadyate||” iti| sa ca śvayathuḥ kareṇa pīḍitaḥ saśabdaṃ prayāti, muktaḥ sannādhmāpayan pūrayan punarāyāti| asādhyamāha– yasyetyādi| āśleṣāt saṃyogāt, vātasañcayāt muṣkayorantravṛddhirbhavati| ayamasādhyaḥ, kathaṃ tarhi cikitsā? aprāptaphalakośayościkitsāvidhiḥ, prāptaphalakoṣā tvasādhyā| yāpyāyāṃ ‘vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vā cikitsāvidhiḥ| yaduktaṃ bhoje– ‘yāpyāṃ tāmantrajāṃ viduḥ’ iti| bradhnanidānaṃ tu tantrāntare paṭhyate, tadyathā– “atyabhiṣyandigurvannasevanānnicayaṃ gataḥ| karoti granthivacchothaṃ doṣo vaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| jvaraśūlāgnisādāḍhyaṃ taṃ bradhnamiti nirdiśet||” iti||7-10||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vṛddhinidānaṃ samāptam ||37||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vṛddhinidānaṃ samāptam||37||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vṛddhinidānam||37||

div.head: galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānam
div.ab: atha galagaṇḍa-gaṇḍamālāpacī-granthyarbudanidānam | nibaddhaḥ śvayathuryasya muṣkavallambate gale | mahān vā yadi vā hrasvo galagaṇḍaṃ tamādiśet ||1|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: vṛddhiyuktamuṣkasamānaliṅgatvāttadanantaraṃ galagaṇḍanidānam| tasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– nibaddhaḥ śvayathurityādi| nibaddho'nubandhavān| muṣkavadaṇḍavat| bhoje'pyuktam– “mahāntaṃ śothamalpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam| lambantaṃ muṣkavaddṛṣṭvā galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||1||

vṛddhiyuktamuṣkasādharmyāttadanantaraṃ galagaṇḍanidānam| tasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– nibaddha ityādi| nibaddho'nubandhavān, muṣkavat aṇḍavat| yaduktaṃ bhojena– “mahāntaṃ śothamalpaṃ vā hanumanyāgalāśrayam| lambantaṃ muṣkavaddṛṣṭvā galagaṇḍaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||1||

div.ab: vātaḥ kaphaścāpi gale praduṣṭo manye ca saṃśritya tathaiva medaḥ | kurvanti gaṇḍaṃ kramaśaḥ svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitaṃ taṃ galagaṇḍamāhuḥ ||2|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: tasya samprāptimāha– vāta ityādi| vātakaphamedāṃsi pṛthak galagaṇḍakāraṇāni, tena traya eva galagaṇḍāḥ; paittikastu na bhavatyeva, vyādhisvabhāvāt; cāturthakajvaravat| cāturthake hi vacanam– “cāturthako darśayati prabhāvaṃ dvividhaṃ jvaraḥ| jaṅghābhyāṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ pūrvaṃ śirasto'nilasambhavaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| kramaśa ityanena śanaireva vardhanaṃ darśayati| svaliṅgaiḥ samanvitamiti “nibaddhaḥ śvayathuḥ” ityādinā uktagalagaṇḍaliṅgairanvitam||2||

tasya samprāptimāha– vāta ityādi| vātakaphamedāṃsi pṛthaggalagaṇḍakāraṇāni, tena traya eva galagaṇḍāḥ paittikastu na bhavatyeva, vyādhisvabhāvāt| manye ubhe ‘kaṇṭhasandhī’ iti pā.| kaṇṭhasandhau| kramaśa iti śanairvṛddhirdarśitā| svaliṅgaiḥ ‘samanvitamiti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | samanvitamiti vātakaphamedolakṣaṇaiḥ samanvitamiti||2||

div.ab: todānvitaḥ kṛṣṇasirāvanaddhaḥ śyāvo'ruṇo vā pavanātmakastu | pāruṣyayuktaściravṛddhyapāko yadṛcchayā pākamiyātkadācit ||3|| kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekaślokapūrvaṃ upalabhyate vairasyamāsyasya ca tasya jantorbhavettathā tālugalapraśoṣaḥ |4| (su. ni. a. 11) |

vātajamāha– todānvite ityādi| ciravṛddhiriti vikāraprabhāvāt vātajo'pi cireṇa vardhate| yadṛcchayā pākamiyāditi kāraṇāpratiniyamena kadācit pākaṃ yāti, kāraṇāpratiniyamaśca bāhyo'bhipretaḥ, ābhyantarastu pākakāraṇaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ ca niyatameva| kadāciditi na sarvakālam| “yadṛcchayā caiva bhavet kadācit” iti pāṭhāntare ‘pāka’ iti śeṣaḥ||3||–

vātikamāha– todānvita ityādi| todaḥ pīḍāviśeṣaḥ, kṛṣṇasirāvṛtaḥ, pāruṣyayuktaḥ sparśanakarkaśaḥ| ciravṛddhiriti vyādhiprabhāvāt vātajo'pi cireṇa vardhate| kāraṇāpratiniyamena kadācit pākaṃ gacchati| kāraṇāpratiniyamaśca bāhyo'bhimataḥ, ‘ābhyantaraśca’ iti pā.| ābhyantaraṃ tu pākakāraṇaṃ pittaṃ raktaṃ ca niyatameva| kadāciditi na sarvakālam| ‘yadṛcchayā ‘caiṣa’ iti pā.| caiva bhavet’ iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra ‘pāka’ iti śeṣaḥ||3||–

sthiraḥ savarṇo gururugrakaṇḍūḥ śīto mahāṃścāpi kaphātmakastu ||4|| cirābhivṛddhiṃ bhajate cirādvā prapacyate mandarujaḥ kadācit | mādhuryamāsyasya ca tasya jantorbhavettathā tālugalapralepaḥ ||5|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: śleṣmajamāha– sthira ityādi| savarṇa iti prakṛtisamavarṇaḥ||4-5||

ślaiṣmikamāha– sthira ityādi| sthiro niścalaḥ, ‘savarṇaṃ prakṛtiḥ samavarṇaḥ’ iti pā.| savarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, mahān sthūlaḥ| mandaruja ityādi kadācidyadā prapacyate tadā mandaruja eva prapacyate, pākakāle pīḍā na bhavatītyarthaḥ| pralepa iti śleṣmaṇā lipta iva||4-5||

div.ab: snigdho guruḥ pāṇḍuraniṣṭagandho medobhavaḥ kaṇḍuyuto'lparuk ca | pralambate'lābuvadalpamūlo dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyuktaḥ ||6|| snigdhāsyatā tasya bhavecca jantorgale'nuśabdaṃ kurute ca nityam |7| (su. ni. a. 11) |
medojamāha– snigdha ityādi| dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiyukta iti dehakṣaye kṣayaṃ, dehavṛddhau ca vṛddhiṃ yātītyarthaḥ| gale'nuśabdamiti anunādaṃ karoti| ‘gale tu śabdam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam||6||–

medojamāha– snigdha ityādi| ‘aniṣṭagandhī’ iti pā.| aniṣṭagandho, alābuvat tumbīphalavat, alpamūlastanumūlaḥ| dehānurūpakṣayavṛddhiḥ– dehakṣaye kṣayaṃ kārśyaṃ, dehavṛddhau vṛddhiṃ, yātītyarthaḥ| gale'nuśabdamiti anunādaṃ pratiśabdaṃ karoti; “galena śabdam” iti pāṭhāntaraṃ sugamam||6||–
kṛcchrācchvasantaṃ mṛdusarvagātraṃ saṃvatsarātītamarocakārtam ||7|| kṣīṇaṃ ca vaidyo galagaṇḍayuktaṃ bhinnasvaraṃ cāpi vivarjayecca |8| (su. ni. a. 11) |
asādhyatāmāha– kṛcchrācchvasantamityādi| kṛcchrācchvasantaṃ duḥkhena śvāsavimokṣakāriṇam| bhinnasvaraṃ svarabhedavantam||7||–
asādhyamāha– kṛcchrādityādi| duḥkhena śvāsavimokṣakārakaṃ, mṛdusarvagātraṃ śithilasarvagātram, atikrāntavatsaraṃ, bhinnasvaraṃ svarabhedavantam||7||–
karkandhukolāmalakapramāṇaiḥ kakṣāṃsamanyāgalavaṅkṣaṇeṣu ||8|| medaḥkaphābhyāṃ ciramandapākaiḥ syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhiśca gaṇḍaiḥ |9| (su. ni. a. 11) |

sthānatulyatayā gaṇḍamālāmihaivāha– karkandhukolāmalakapramāṇairityādi| karkandhuḥ śṛgālakoliḥ, kolaṃ bṛhadbadaram| medaḥkaphābhyāmiti medo dūṣyaṃ, kapho doṣo'trārambhakaḥ, medaḥkaphau prādhānyenoktau; tena vātapittasambandho'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ| yadāha bhojaḥ– “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśān bahūn|| kurvanti ‘granthayastebhyaḥ’ iti pā.| granthitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| tān doṣānūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣamanyāgalāśritaḥ|| nānāprakārān kurute granthīn sā tvapacī matā| ‘apacīkaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣavaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu||’ iti pā.| tāṃ tu mālākṛtiṃ vidyāt kaṇṭhahṛddhanusandhiṣu|| gaṇḍamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇām|” iti| syādgaṇḍamāleti mālātulyagaṇḍayogāt gaṇḍamālā| galamātra eva gaṇḍamālā carake paṭhitā| yathā– “medaḥkaphācchoṇitasañcayottho galasya madhye galagaṇḍa ekaḥ syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhiśca gaṇḍaiḥ” (ca. ci. a. 12) iti||8||–

sthānatulyatayā ‘galagaṇḍamālāmihaivāha’ iti pā.| gaṇḍamālāmihaivāha– karkandhvityādi| karkandhurlaghubadaraṃ, kolaṃ bṛhadbadaram| aṃsau bāhumūle, manyā ‘śirodhiḥ’ iti pā.| śirodhaḥ, vaṅkṣaṇaṃ jānūrusandhiḥ| medaḥkaphābhyāmityādi| medo dūṣyaṃ, kapho doṣo'trārambhakaḥ, medaḥkaphau ca prādhānyenoktau, tena ‘vātapittasañcayo'pyevam’ iti pā.| vātapittasañcayo'pyatra draṣṭavyaḥ| yadāha bhojaḥ– “vātapittakaphā vṛddhā medaścāpi samācitam| jaṅghayoḥ kaṇḍarāḥ prāpya matsyāṇḍasadṛśānbahūn|| kurvanti granthitāṃstebhyaḥ punaḥ prakupito'nilaḥ| tāndoṣānūrdhvago vakṣaḥkakṣamanyāgalāśritaḥ| nānāprakārānkurute granthīn sā tvapacī matā| vyāmiśradoṣasañjātā kṛcchrasādhyā prakīrtitā|| tāsāṃ vātottarā rūkṣā vātavedanayā'nvitā| kṣiprapākasamutthānā dāhayuktā ca paittikī|| gūḍhapākā ca kaṭhinā kaphāt snigdhā'lparukkarā| medovikārā ślaiṣmikī ca viśeṣādatimārdavā|| apacī kaṇṭhamanyāsu kakṣavaṅkṣaṇasandhiṣu| tāṃ tu mālākṛtisamāṃ kaṇṭhahṛddantasandhiṣu| kaṇṭhamālāṃ vijānīyādapacītulyalakṣaṇam||” iti| syādgaṇḍamāleti mālātulyagaṇḍāśrayā gaṇḍamālā| galamātra eva carake gaṇḍamālā paṭhitā, yathā– “medaḥkaphācchoṇitasañcayottho galasya ‘manye’ iti pā.| pārśve galagaṇḍa ekaḥ| syādgaṇḍamālā bahubhiśca gaṇḍaiḥ” iti||8||–

ab.seg: te granthayaḥ kecidavāptapākāḥ sravanti naśyanti bhavanti cānye ||9||
kālānubandhaṃ ciramādadhāti saivāpacīti pravadanti tajjñāḥ | sādhyāḥ smṛtāḥ pīnasapārśvaśūlakāsajvaracchardiyutāstvasādhyāḥ ||10||

gaṇḍamālātulyatayā apacīmāha– te granthaya ityādi| te iti gaṇḍamālārambhakadoṣadūṣyakṛtā ye granthayasta evetyarthaḥ| kālānubandhaṃ ciramiti carakalānubandham| saivāpacīti tādṛśī ‘analparūpā’ iti pā.| amālārūpā apacī bhaṇyate| saivāpacīti itiśabdenābhihitatvāt pravadantīti kriyāyoge'pi na dvitīyā| apacīniruktiścāparāparopacīyamānatayā| ata eva “cayaprakarṣādapacīṃ vadanti|” (su. ni. a. 11) iti suśrutaḥ| cayaprakarṣaścāparāparabhavanenaiva, sādhutvaṃ ca nairuktyena vidhinā| yaduktam– “varṇāgamo varṇaviparyayaśca dvau cāparau varṇavikāranāśau| dhātostadarthātiśayena yogastaducyate pañcavidhaṃ niruktam||” iti| ata evoktam– naśyanti bhavanti cānya iti| sādhyāḥ smṛtā iti chedaḥ| pīnasādibhirupadravairasādhyāḥ| ayaṃ tu granthiḥ carake gaṇḍamālāyāmasti; saṅgrahakāreṇa tu gaṇḍamālayā saha tulyatvādapacyā apacyāmeva granthiḥ paṭhitaḥ||9-10||

gaṇḍamālātulyatayā'pacīmāha– ta ityādi| gaṇḍamālārambhakadoṣadūṣyakṛtā ye granthayasta evetyarthaḥ| avāptapākāḥ labdhapākāḥ, kālānubandhamiti carakalasambandham| saivāpacīti tādṛśī āmalakarūpā apacī bhaṇyate| saivāpacīti– itiśabdenābhihitatvātpravadantītyādikriyāyoge'pi na dvitīyā| tasya sādhyatvamāha– sādhyetyādi| sādhyāḥ smṛtā iti pūrvagranthena sambandhaḥ, ‘sravanti naśyanti atra ‘bhavanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhavanti cānye’ ityādipīnasādibhirupadravairyutā asādhyāḥ||9-10||

div.ab: vātādayo māṃsamasṛk praduṣṭāḥ sandūṣya medaśca tathā sirāśca | vṛttonnataṃ vigrathitaṃ ca śothaṃ kurvantyato granthiriti pradiṣṭaḥ ||11|| (su. ni. a. 11) | ‘ ... gaṇḍakatulyatayā’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: anantaramapacīguḍakatulyatayā granthimāha– vātādaya ityādi| vātapittakaphāḥ pratyekaṃ duṣṭāḥ; duṣṭiścātra vṛddhireva na kṣayaḥ, kṣīṇānāṃ vikārakaraṇākṣamatvāt| yadyevaṃ tarhi kathaṃ vātādikṣaye mandaceṣṭādayaḥ? ucyate– tatkṣaye virodhidoṣakopāt; yathā– madhurasnigdhādibhirvāte kṣīṇe tatsamānatvāt śleṣmā prakupyati| vacanaṃ hi– “vṛddhiścāpi virodhinām|” iti| sandūṣya medaśca māṃsamasṛk sirāścetyanena medojaḥ kaphasambandhādyo bhavati tathā sirājo'pi vāyunā sirāduṣṭyā yo janyate sa ucyate| evaṃ pañca granthayaḥ| tatheti sandūṣya| māṃsamasṛgiti atrāsṛjaḥ kramollaṅghanena pāṭho'prādhānyapratipādanārthaḥ, visarpe tu śoṇitameva pradhānam| ata eva kvacit cakāramaprādhānyasūcakaṃ niveśya ‘asṛk ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ| carake tu granthiḥ vātakaphaja eva granthivisarpaśabdenoktaḥ| vṛttonnatamiti vṛttaṃ vartulam, unnatam ucchūnam| vigrathitaṃ kaṭhinaṃ, ‘karkaśam’ iti pā.| kakakhaṭaṃ vā; vigrathitatvādeva granthiriti sañjñā||11||

apacīgaṇḍakarūpatayā granthikāmāha– vātādayetyādi| vātādayo vātapittakaphāḥ, pratyekaṃ duṣṭāḥ māṃsamasṛk sandūṣya śophaṃ kurvantīti sambandhaḥ| etena trayo granthaya uktāḥ, duṣṭiścātra vṛddhireva, na kṣayaḥ, kṣīṇānāṃ vikārakaraṇākṣamatvāt, sandūṣya medaśca tathā sirāścetyanena medojaḥ sirājaścaivaṃ dvau, sandūṣya māṃsamasṛgityatrāsṛjaḥ kramollaṅghanena pāṭho'prādhānyapratipādanārthaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulam, unnataṃ ucchūnaṃ, vigrathitaṃ vicchidya grathitam, ato vigrathitatvādeva granthisañjñā||11||

div.ab: āyamyate vṛścyati tudyate ca pratyasyate mathyati bhidyate ca | kṛṣṇo mṛdurbastirivātataśca bhinnaḥ sraveccānilajo'sramaccham ||12|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: anilagranthimāha– āyamyata ityādi| āyamyate ākṛṣya dīrghīkriyate| vṛścyatīti chinattīva, atra divāderākṛtigaṇatvāt ‘śyan’ pratyayaḥ| pratyasyate kṣipyate| mathyati āloḍayatīva, atrāpi pūrvavat samādhānam| bhidyate vidīryata iva| asraṃ srāvam||12||
vātikamāha– āyamyata ityādi| ākṛṣya dīrghīkriyata iva, vṛścyati chinattīva, tudyate śūleneva, pratyasyate kṣipyate, mathyati āloḍayatīva, bhidyate vidāryata iva||12||

div.ab: dandahyate dhūpyati vṛścyate ca pāpacyate prajvalatīva cāpi | raktaḥ sapīto'pyathavā'pi pittādbhinnaḥ sraveduṣṇamatīva cāsram ||13|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: pittagranthimāha– dandahyata ityādi| dandahyate atyarthaṃ dahyate agnineva| pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyata iva kṣāreṇa, kiṃvā utkvathyata iva| prajvalatīva jvalan bhasmībhavatīva||13||

paittikamāha– dandahyata ityādi| agninā ‘atyarthaṃ dahyata iva’ iti pā.| dahyata eva, dhūpyati dhūmāyata iva, ‘vṛścyate’ ityatra ‘cūṣyate’ iti pā.| cūṣyate śṛṅgeṇeva, pāpacyate bhṛśaṃ pacyata iva kṣāreṇa, ‘kiñca’ iti pā.| kiṃvā utkvathyata iva| jvalatīva jvalaneneva bhasmībhavati, varṇena raktaḥ athavā pītaḥ, bhinnaḥ san atīvātiśayena etacca– ‘bhinnaḥ sravedduṣṭamatīva cāsram’ iti pā.| duṣṭaṃ raktaṃ sravati||13||

div.ab: śīto'vivarṇo'lparujo'tikaṇḍuḥ pāṣāṇavat saṃhananopapannaḥ | cirābhivṛddhaśca kaphaprakopādbhinnaḥ sravecchuklaghanaṃ ca pūyam ||14|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: kaphagranthimāha– śīta ityādi| avivarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, īṣadvivarṇa iti kaścit| pāṣāṇavat saṃhananopapanna iti pāṣāṇavat kaṭhina ityarthaḥ; kiṃvā pāṣāṇavat bhavati, saṃhananopapanna iti ‘saṅghātānvito’ iti pā.| saṃhatānvito mahānityarthaḥ||14||
ślaiṣmikamāha– śīta ityādi| avivarṇaḥ prakṛtivarṇaḥ, pāṣāṇavat saṅghātānvito mahānityarthaḥ| bhinnaḥ san śuklaṃ ghanaṃ pūyaṃ sravet ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca||14||

div.ab: śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniḥ snigdho mahān kaṇḍuyuto'rujaśca | medaḥkṛto gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu medaḥ ||15|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: medojagranthimāha– śarīretyādi| śarīravṛddhikṣayavṛddhihāniriti śarīravṛddhikṣayābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ vṛddhihānī yasya sa tathā| medojeṣvevaṃ yuktiḥ dhātusvabhāvāt cirasthāyitvādvā| gacchati cātra bhinne piṇyākasarpiḥpratimaṃ tu meda iti bhinne sati piṇyākastilakalkaḥ, sarpiratra styānaṃ, tatsadṛśaṃ medaḥ sravati| bhojena tu medograntheḥ samprāptiḥ paṭhyate| yathā– “medo vāyuryadā māṃse nikṣipedathavā tvaci| tatra medobhavagranthiḥ śyāvo bhavati pāṇḍuraḥ|| kṛśaḥ kṛśe, mahān sthūle, granthirbhinnaśca pīḍitaḥ| tilakalkanibhaḥ srāvo ghṛtavaccāsya jāyate||” iti||15||

medojamāha– śarīravṛddhikṣayābhyāṃ yathākramaṃ vṛddhihānī yasya sa tathā| bhinne sati piṇyākasarpiḥsadṛśaṃ medo gacchati sravatītyarthaḥ| piṇyākastilakalkaḥ, sarpiratra styānam, tatsadṛśaṃ medo gacchati| uktañca bhoje– “medo vāyuryadā māṃse nikṣipedatha vā tvaci| tatra medobhavo granthiḥ śyāvo bhavati pāṇḍuraḥ|| kṛśaḥ kṛśe mahān sthūle granthiśchinnaśca pīḍitaḥ| tilakalkanibhaḥ srāvo ghṛtavaccāsya jāyate||” iti||15||

div.ab: vyāyāmajātairabalasya taistairākṣipya vāyustu sirāpratānam | saṅkucya ‘sampīḍya’ iti pā. | sampiṇḍya viśoṣya cāpi granthiṃ karotyunnatamāśu vṛttam ||16|| granthiḥ sirājaḥ sa tu kṛcchrasādhyo bhavedyadi syāt sarujaścalaśca | ‘aruk sa evāpyacalo’ iti pā. | sa cāruja ścāpyacalo mahāṃśca marmotthitaścāpi vivarjanīyaḥ ||17|| (su. ni. a. 11) | ‘śirāja ... ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: sirājagrantheḥ samprāptimāha– vyāyāmajātairityādi| saṅkucyeti ‘ ... 'tra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | antarbhāvito'tra ṇyarthaḥ, tena saṅkocyetyarthaḥ| sampiṇḍyeti saṃhatīkṛtya| unnatamāśu vṛttamiti asya sāmānyalakṣaṇenaiva siddhe punastaduktiratiśayārtham| sa ca sirājo granthiryadi sarujaścalaśca syāttadā kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| sa cārujaścāpītyādinā na sādhyaḥ| sa ceti cakāreṇārujatvādidharmayogādapare'pi granthayo'sādhyā iti sūcayati| yaduktaṃ bhoje– “pañcaitānarujo granthīn marmajānacalāṃstyajet| kapolagalamanyāsu duścikitsyāśca sandhiṣu||” iti| anye tu māṃsāsṛgbhyāṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ granthiṃ vadanta evaṃ paṭhanti– “ ‘māṃsāsrajam’ iti pā.| māṃsāsṛjaṃ cārbudalakṣaṇena tulyaṃ hi dṛṣṭaṃ tvatha lakṣaṇajñaiḥ|” iti kintvanārṣo'yaṃ pāṭhaḥ, bhojādisamānatantreṣvadṛṣṭatvāt||16-17||

sirājagrantheḥ samprāptimāha– vyāyāmetyādi| taistairiti balavadvigrahādibhiḥ ‘śirāpratānaṃ ... ’ iti pā.| sirāpratānaṃ ‘śirābhyo’ iti pā.| sirābhyo nirgataṃ ‘ ... śirājālam’ iti pā.| sūkṣmasirājālam| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito'tra ṇyarthaḥ, tena saṅkocyetyarthaḥ| sampīḍya saṃhatīkṛtya, unnatamuccaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulam| sa tu ‘śirājo’ iti pā.| sirājo granthiḥ yadi sarujaścalaḥ syāttadā kṛcchrasādhyaḥ| tasyāsādhyatvamāha– sa iti| cakāreṇārujādidharmayogād apare'pi granthayaḥ asādhyā iti sūcayanti| yaduktaṃ bhojena– “pañcaitānarujo granthīnmarmajāṃśca calāṃstyajet| kapolagalamanyāsu duścikitsyāśca sandhiṣu||” iti||16-17||

div.ab: gātrapradeśe kvacideva doṣāḥ sammūrchitā māṃsamasṛk pradūṣya | etacca– ‘vṛttaṃ mṛduṃ mandarujam’ iti pā. | vṛttaṃ sthiraṃ mandarujaṃ mahāntamanalpamūlaṃ ciravṛddhyapākam ||18|| kurvanti māṃsocchrayamatyagādhaṃ tadarbudaṃ śāstravido vadanti | vātena pittena kaphena cāpi raktena māṃsena ca medasā vā ||19|| tajjāyate tasya ca lakṣaṇāni grantheḥ samānāni ‘sadā’ iti pā. | tadā bhavanti |20| (su. ni. a. 11) |

māṃsaśoṇitadūṣyasāmyādarbudābhidhānam| tasya samprāptimāha– gātrapradeśe kvacidityādi| kvacidevetyanenāniyatadeśe, na punarapacīvanniyatadeśe| “sammūrchitā” iti pāṭhāntare sammūrchitā vṛddhāḥ, dūṣyasaṃsṛṣṭā iti kārtikaḥ| māṃsamasṛk pradūṣyeti sarvārbudasādhāraṇaṃ dūṣyaṃ, māṃsārbudamedo'rbudayostu viśeṣeṇa māṃsaduṣṭiḥ; māṃsārbudamedo'rbudayorapi taddūṣako doṣo'sti, tena tatrāpi doṣakartṛtayā samprāptiriyaṃ bhavati| māṃsocchrayamiti māṃsocchrayatayā pratīyamānam| medoje'pi māṃsamudgataṃ bhavati| atyagādhamiti dūrānupraviṣṭam; ata evānalpamūlamityuktam| vātādibhistadarbudaṃ jāyate ‘bhavati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhavati, tena ṣaḍarbudāni bhavanti| grantheḥ samānānīti vātapittakaphamedogranthibhirvātapittakaphamedo'rbudānāṃ lakṣaṇāni samānāni, śoṇitajamāṃsajayostu lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthak vakṣyati||18-19||–

athārbudānyāha| tasya samprāptimāha– gātretyādi| kvacideveti aniyatadeśe na punarapacīvat niyatapradeśe| sammūrchitā iti pāṭhāntare vṛddhāḥ| māṃsamasṛk pradūṣyeti sarvārbudeṣu sādhāraṇaṃ dūṣyaṃ, māṃsārbudamedo'rbudayośca viśeṣeṇa māṃsamedoduṣṭiḥ, etacca– ‘vṛttaṃ mṛduṃ mandarujam’ iti pā.| vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, mṛduṃ mṛdusparśaṃ, māṃsamedaāśrayatvāt| atyagādhaṃ dūrānupraviṣṭam, ata evānalpamūlamityuktam| tasya saṅkhyāmāha– vātenetyādi| vātādibhistadarbudaṃ jāyate bhavati; tena ṣaḍarbudāni bhavanti| grantheḥ samānānīti vātapittakaphamedojagranthibhirvātapittakaphamedojārbudānāṃ lakṣaṇāni samānāni| śoṇitajamāṃsajayostu lakṣaṇaṃ pṛthakpaṭhyate||18-19||–

doṣaḥ praduṣṭo rudhiraṃ sirāśca saṅkucya sampiṇḍya tatastvapākam ||20|| sāsrāvamunnahyati māṃsapiṇḍaṃ māṃsāṅkurairācitamāśuvṛddham | karotyajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttimasādhyametadrudhirātmakaṃ tu ||21|| raktakṣayopadravapīḍitatvāt pāṇḍurbhavedarbudapīḍitastu | (su. ni. a. 11) |

raktārbudamāha– doṣaḥ praduṣṭa ityādi| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito'tra ṇyarthaḥ| apākamīṣatpākaṃ, tena sāsrāvamityupapannaṃ bhavati| doṣa unnahyati ucchrito bhavati| sāsrāvamīṣatsrāvam| māṃsapiṇḍamāśuvṛddhaṃ śīghravardhanaṃ, māṃsāṅkurairācitaṃ karoti, tathā ajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttimapi karoti; rudhiraṃ ‘cātrādhiṣṭhānapūrvabhūtaśirāgatam’ iti pā.| cātrādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ sirāgataṃ pravartate na tu pākāt, īṣadeva srāvasya kledarūpasyoktatvāt| kiṃvā unnahyatītyantarbhāvitaṇyarthaḥ, tena māṃsapiṇḍamunnāhayati udgataṃ karoti| “doṣāḥ praduṣṭā” iti atra ‘vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| pāṭhapakṣe “ ‘sāsrāvamunnahyati’ iti pā.| sāsrāvamunnahya hi” iti pāṭhaḥ| unnahya unnāhya, antarbhāvitaṇyarthatvāt| hi pādapūraṇe||20-21||–

raktārbudamāha– doṣa ityādi| saṅkucyeti antarbhāvito'tra ṇyarthaḥ| apākamiti īṣatpākaṃ, tena sāsrāvamityupapannaṃ bhavati| doṣaḥ praduṣṭaḥ unnahyati ucchrito bhavati| ajasraṃ rudhirapravṛttimatirudhiraṃ cādhiṣṭhānabhūtaṃ pravartate, na tu pākāt, īṣadeva srāvasya kledarūpasyoktatvāt| suśrutoktaiḥ raktakṣayopadravaiḥ pāṇḍuḥ syāt||20-21||–

muṣṭiprahārādibhirardite'ṅge māṃsaṃ praduṣṭaṃ janayeddhi śotham ||22|| avedanaṃ snigdhamananyavarṇamapākamaśmopamamapracālyam | praduṣṭamāṃsasya narasya gāḍhametadbhavenmāṃsaparāyaṇasya ||23|| māṃsārbudaṃ tvetadasādhyamuktaṃ... | (su. ni. a. 11) |

māṃsajanyasamprāptimāha– muṣṭiprahārādibhirityādi| aśmopamaṃ pāṣāṇavat kaṭhinam| apracālyaṃ sthiram| yadyapi ‘raktamāṃsārbude'pyatiraktamāṃsayorhetu ... ’ iti pā.| raktamāṃsārbudayo raktamāṃsayorhetutvenoktistathā'pi raktaje pittaṃ, māṃsaje vāyurārambhakaḥ, evamapi tābhyāṃ ghṛtadugdhanyānena vyapadeśaḥ| māṃsaparāyaṇasya māṃsāśanaśīlasya| tasya cātimātraṃ māṃsavṛddhiḥ, “māṃsaṃ māṃsena vardhate” ityabhidhānāt||22-23||–

māṃsajasya samprāptimāha– muṣṭītyādi| muṣṭiprahārādibhirardite'ṅgapradeśe, ananyavarṇam, apākaṃ pākarahitam, aśmopamaṃ pāṣāṇavatkaṭhinam, apracālyaṃ sthiram| yadyapi raktamāṃsārbudayoḥ raktamāṃsayorhetutvenoktiḥ, tathā'pi raktaje pittaṃ, māṃsaje vāyurārambhakaḥ, evamapi tābhyāṃ ghṛtadugdhanyāyena vyapadeśaḥ| māṃsaparāyaṇasya māṃsabhakṣaṇaśīlasya, tasya cātimātraṃ māṃsavṛddhiḥ “māṃsaṃ māṃsena vardhate” iti vacanāt| etanmāṃsārbudamasādhyam||22-23||–
...sādhyeṣvapīmāni tu varjayecca | ‘saprasrutam’ iti pā. | samprasrutaṃ marmaṇi yacca jātaṃ srotaḥsu vā yacca bhavedacālyam ||24|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: sādhyeṣvapyasādhyaprakārānāha– sādhyeṣvapītyādi| samprasrutaṃ srāvayuktaṃ, srāvaścātrāpākitve'pi tvagavadaraṇāt manāgavagantavyaḥ| srotaḥsu nāsādiṣu| acālyaṃ sthiram||24||

sādhyeṣvapyasādhyaprakārānāha– sādhyeṣvityādi| sādhyeṣvapi imāni arbudāni varjayet| ‘samprastutam’ iti pā.| samprasrutaṃ srāvayuktam| srāvaścātrāpākitve'pi tvagdāraṇāt manāgavagantavyaḥ| srotassu sirādiṣu, acālyaṃ sthiram||24||

div.ab: yajjāyate'nyat khalu pūrvajāte jñeyaṃ ‘tadadhyarbuda ... ’ iti pā. | tadaddhyarbudamarbudajñaiḥ | yaddvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramādvā dvirarbudaṃ tacca bhavedasādhyam ||25|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: adhyarbudamāha– yajjāyata ityādinā| adhikamarbudam adhyarbudam, etaddvirarbudameva| yaddvandvajātaṃ yugapat kramādveti dvandvajātaṃ yugmena jātaṃ, yugapadekadā krameṇa vā, taddvirarbudaṃ na sādhyam| tathāca bhojaḥ– “arbude tvarbudaṃ jātaṃ dvandvajaṃ cānujaṃ ca yat| ‘taddvirarbudamiti’ iti pā.| dvirarbudamiti jñeyaṃ taccāsādhyaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||25||

adhyarbudamāha– yadityādi| adhikamarbudamadhyarbudaṃ, ‘etaddvirbudameva|’ iti pā.| etaddvirarbudameva| yad dvandvajātaṃ yugapadekadā krameṇa vā tat dvirarbudaṃ na sādhyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “arbudaṃ tvarbude jātaṃ dvandvajaṃ cānujaṃ ca yat| dvirarbudamiti jñeyaṃ taccāsādhyaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||25||

div.ab: na pākamāyānti kaphādhikatvānmedobahutvācca viśeṣatastu | doṣasthiratvādgrathanācca teṣāṃ sarvārbudānyeva nisargatastu ||26|| (su. ni. a. 11) |

ab.seg: arbudānāṃ pākābhāve hetumāha– na pākamāyāntītyādi| sarvārbudāni pittaraktajānyapi na pākamāyānti, kutaḥ ityata āha– ‘kaphādhikatvāt medobahutvācca’ iti pā.| kaphādhikatvānmedobahutvācca| nanu, apacyāmapi viśeṣataḥ kaphamedasī adhike, atha ca tasyāḥ pāko'styeva, ityata āha– doṣasthiratvāditi| apacyāṃ kālāntareṇa hi raktapittamadhikaṃ pākamārabhate, tacceha doṣasthiratvāt sadā sadṛśadoṣatvāt grathitatvācca na pākārambhakam| anye tu doṣasthiratvāditi doṣocchrāyarūpaśothakāṭhinyādityāhuḥ; tadaprayojanakam, anyatra doṣocchrāyaśothakāṭhinye'pi pākadarśanāt| atha kuto yathoktahetusampadityāha– nisargatastviti| nisargato vyādhisvabhāvāt| bhoje'pyuktam– “na pacyate sthiratvācca grathitatvāt svabhāvataḥ|” iti||26||

arbudānāṃ pākābhāve hetumāha– netyādi| sarvārbudāni pittaraktajānyapi na pākamāyānti, kuta ityāha– kaphādhikatvānmedobahutvācca| nanu, apacyāmapi kaphamedasī adhike, atha ca tasyāḥ pākaḥ kālato'styevetyāha– doṣasthiratvāditi kālāntareṇa hi raktapittamadhikaṃ pākamārabhate| nanu, iha doṣasthiratvāt sadṛśadoṣatvāt granthitatvācca na pākārambhakatvam, atha kuto yathoktahetusampadityāha– nisargatastviti| nisargato vyādhisvabhāvāt| bhoje'pyuktam– “na pacyate sthiratvācca grathitatvātsvabhāvataḥ” iti| teṣāmarbudānāmiti||26||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānaṃ samāptam ||38||
iti ‘ ... kṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālāpacīgranthyarbudanidānaṃ samāptam||38||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ galagaṇḍagaṇḍamālā'pacīgranthyarbudanidānam||38||

div.head: ślīpadanidānam

ab.seg: atha ślīpadanidānam | yaḥ sajvaro vaṅkṣaṇajo bhṛśārtiḥ śotho nṛṇāṃ pādagataḥ krameṇa | tacchlīpadaṃ syāt karakarṇanetraśiśnauṣṭhanāsāsvapi kecidāhuḥ ||1||
vātajaṃ kṛṣṇarūkṣaṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ tīvravedanam | animittarujaṃ tasya bahuśo jvara eva ca ||2||
pittajaṃ pītasaṅkāśaṃ dāhajvarayutaṃ mṛdu | ślaiṣmikaṃ snigdhavarṇaṃ ca śvetaṃ pāṇḍu guru sthiram ||3||

utsedhasādharmyādarbudena saha kaphasambandhāvyabhicārasāmyāccātha ślīpadanidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– ‘yaḥ sajvara’ iti pā.| ya ityādi| vaṅkṣaṇāvasthānamevāsya pūrvarūpam| krameṇeti śanaiḥ śanaiḥ| tat ślīpadaṃ syādityanena nirupādhireveyaṃ sañjñeti darśayati; anye śilāvat padaṃ ślīpadamiti vadanti, nairuktyena ca vidhinā sādhutvam| karakarṇādigataślīpadānāṃ yathoktasamprāptyabhāvāt kecidāhuriti paramatenoktiḥ||1-3||

utsedhasādharmyādarbudena saha ‘kaphasambandhasaṃvādatvādavyabhicārasāmyāccātha’ iti pā.| kaphasambandhāvyabhicārasādharmyācca ślīpadanidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– ya ityādi| vaṅkṣaṇādyavasthānamevāsya pūrvarūpam| krameṇeti śanaiḥ| vaṅkṣaṇamūrumeḍhrasandhiḥ, vaṅkṣaṇasthaḥ śvayathuḥ bhṛśārtisahitaḥ caraṇaṃ gacchatītyarthaḥ, tat ślīpadaṃ syādityanena pāribhāṣikī nirupādhireveyaṃ sañjñeti| anye śilāvat ‘padaṃ ślīpadamiti vadanti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | padaṃ ślīpadamiti vadanti| kecidāhuriti paramatenoktiḥ| vātajamāha– animittamityādi| akāraṇenaivaṃ pīḍā| bahuśo vāraṃvāraṃ jvaraḥ, śeṣaṃ sugamam| pittajamāha– pītasaṅkāśaṃ pītāvabhāsaṃ, mṛdu mṛdusparśam| śleṣmajamāha– snigdhavarṇamiti| ‘snigdhavad varṇam’ iti pā.| snigdhavadvarṇo yasya, cikkaṇamityarthaḥ| pāṇḍu pītaśvetam||1-3||
valmīkamiva sañjātaṃ kaṇṭakairupacīyate | abdātmakaṃ mahattacca varjanīyaṃ viśeṣataḥ ||4||

eṣāmasādhyatāmāha– ‘valmīkamiva sañjātaṃ kaṇṭakairupacīyate iti|’ iti pā.| valmīkamivetyādi| sañjātaṃ pravṛddhaṃ sat valmīkavadbahuśikharākāraṃ granthibhirupacitaṃ yadbhavati tadasādhyam| anye tu punaramuṃ granthiṃ kaphajalakṣaṇatvena varṇayanti; tanna mano dhinoti, suśrute valmīkavajjātasyāsādhyatvenābhidhānāt| tadyathā– “tatra saṃvatsarātītamatimahadvalmīkamiva sañjātaṃ samprasrutamiti varjanīyāni bhavanti|” (su. ni. a. 12) iti| abdātmakamityādi| abdātmakaṃ saṃvatsarātītam, abdamekamiti pāṭhe tu ‘atikrāntam’ iti śeṣaḥ| mahaditi atyantamucchūnam| varjanīyaṃ viśeṣata iti pratyākhyeyam||4||

eṣāmasādhyatāmāha– valmīkamityādi| valmīkavadbahuśikharākāragranthibhirupacitaṃ yad bhavati tadasādhyam| anye punaramuṃ granthiṃ kaphajalakṣaṇatvena varṇayanti; tanna mano dhinoti, suśrute valmīkavajjātasyāsādhyatvenābhidhānāt| tadyathā– “tatra ‘ ... valmīkajātam’ iti pā.| saṃvatsarātītamatimahadvalmīkavajjātaṃ ‘prasṛtamiti’ iti pā.| samprasrutamiti varjanīyāni bhavanti” iti| sarvātmakaṃ tridoṣajam| anye abdātmakamiti paṭhanti, tatrātikrāntavatsaramityarthaḥ| mahat atyantamucchūnam| varjanīyaṃ viśeṣata iti pratyākhyeyam||4||

div.ab: trīṇyapyetāni jānīyācchlīpadāni kaphocchrayāt | gurutvaṃ ca mahattvaṃ ca yasmānnāsti kaphaṃ vinā ||5|| (su. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg: ślīpadeṣu kaphasyāvyabhicāreṇa prādhānyamāha– trīṇyapyetānītyādi| nanu, yadyavyabhicārī sarvatra kaphaḥ kathaṃ tarhi ekadoṣajatvavyapadeśaḥ, sarvasya dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅgāt? ucyate– anubandho'tra kaphaḥ, na tvanubandhyaḥ; etenātra na dvidoṣajaprasaṅga ityabhiprāyaḥ||5||

ślīpadeṣu kaphasyāvyabhicāreṇa prādhānyamāha– ‘trīṇi trīṇi vātajādīni vātajādīni’ iti pā.| trīṇītyādi| trīṇi vātajādīni, yato gurutvaṃ ca śleṣmaṇā vinā na syāt| nanu, yadyevaṃ tarhi kathamekadoṣajavyapadeśaḥ, sarvasya ‘dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅgāt’ iti pā.| dvidoṣatvaprasaṅgāt; ucyate– kapho'trānubandharūpaḥ, na tvanubandhyaḥ| tena, na dvidoṣajatvaprasaṅga ityabhiprāyaḥ||5||

div.ab: purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhāḥ sarvartuṣu ca śītalāḥ | ye deśāsteṣu jāyante ślīpadāni viśeṣataḥ ||6|| (su. ni. a. 12) |

ab.seg: ślīpadasambhavahetuṃ deśamāha– purāṇodaketyādi| ‘ānūpadeśe’ iti pā.| anūpadeśe hi salilaṃ patitaṃ bahūdakaṃ nimnatayā na śoṣamupayāti; jāṅgale tu āgneyonnatabhūbhāgatvāt na purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā| stimitasyānūpasya mandātapatvenoṣṇartāvapi śītateti ata uktam– “sarvartuṣu ca śītalāḥ” iti| karakarṇādigataślīpadasandehe kopadvāreṇa jvareṇa ślīpadāvadhāraṇaṃ karaṇīyam||6||

ślīpadasambhave hetunirdeśamāha– purāṇodaketyādi| purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhā iti anūpadeśe salilaṃ patitaṃ bahūdakaṃ nimnabhūbhāgatayā na śoṣamupayāti, ato'nūpadeśasya purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā; jāṅgale tvāgneyonnatabhūbhāgatayā salilaṃ patitaṃ na tiṣṭhati, sthitamapi rūkṣoṣṇaśuṣkadeśasya śoṣamupayāti, iti jāṅgaladeśasya na purāṇodakabhūyiṣṭhatā| sarveṣvapi ṛtuṣu śītalā ye deśāḥ himavatpradeśāḥ||6||
yacchleṣmalāhāravihārajātaṃ puṃsaḥ prakṛtyā'pi kaphātmakasya | sāsrāvamatyunnatasarvaliṅgaṃ sakaṇḍuraṃ śleṣmayutaṃ vivarjyam ||7||

aparamasādhyalakṣaṇamāha– ‘sāsrāvamityādi|’ iti pā.| yadityādi| atyunnatasarvaliṅgamiti yena doṣeṇārabdhaṃ ślīpadaṃ tasyātyunnatāni ativṛddhāni sarvāṇi liṅgāni yatra tattathā| sakaṇḍuramiti atyantakaṇḍumat| śleṣmayutamiti śleṣmānugam||7||

punarasādhyatāmāha– yadityādi| śleṣmalāhāro madhurādiḥ, vihāro divāsvapnādiḥ, kaphaprakṛtikasya sāsrāvam āsrāvayutam| atyunnatasarvaliṅgaṃ yena doṣeṇārabdhaṃ ślīpadaṃ, tasyātyunnatāni imānyatipravṛddhāni sarvāṇi tridoṣaliṅgāni yatra tat, sakaṇḍuraṃ kaṇḍūyutaṃ, śleṣmayutaṃ śleṣmaṇopagatam||7||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne ślīpadanidānaṃ samāptam ||39||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ ślīpadanidānaṃ samāptam||39||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ ślīpadanidānam||39||

div.head: vidradhinidānam
div.ab: atha vidradhinidānam | tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsi sandūṣyāsthisamāśritāḥ | doṣāḥ śothaṃ śanairghoraṃ janayantyucchritā bhṛśam ||1|| mahāmūlaṃ rujāvantaṃ vṛttaṃ vā'pyathavā''yatam | sa vidradhiriti khyāto vijñeyaḥ ṣaḍvidhaśca saḥ ||2|| pṛthagdoṣaiḥ samastaiśca kṣatenāpyasṛjā tathā | ṣaṇṇāmapi hi teṣāṃ tu lakṣaṇaṃ sampravakṣyate ||3|| (su. ni. a. 9) |

ab.seg: śothatvasāmānyāt vidradhinidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– tvagraktamāṃsamedāṃsītyādi| ghoramityanyebhyo'pi śothasamutthānebhyo granthyādibhya āśukāritvāddāruṇam| ucchritā bhṛśamiti atyarthaṃ vṛddhāḥ| asthisamāśritā ityanena sthānasaṃśrayo'bhihitaḥ| ucchritā bhṛśamityanena prakopa āviṣkṛtaḥ, etenaivāntarīyakatayā cayaprasarāvapyākṣiptau mantavyau| mahāmūlamasthyādisamāśrayaṇādgambhīramūlam| rujāvantamiti utpattāveva rujāprakarṣavantam, atiśāyane matup| vṛttamityādi vṛttaṃ vartulam| āyataṃ dīrgham| vṛttāyatābhyāṃ granthyādivilakṣaṇatā| vidradhiriti khyāta iti, itiśabdena nirupādhisaṅketamātrā vidradhisañjñeti darśayati| carake tu vidāhaprakarṣādvidradhisañjñā| yaduktam– “sa vai śīghravidāhitvādvidradhītyabhidhīyate|” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti||1-3||

śothasāmānyādvidradhinidānam| tasya samprāptimāha– tvagityādi| ghoramanyebhyaḥ śothasamutthānebhyo granthyādibhyaḥ āśukāritvāddāruṇam| ucchritā bhṛśamiti atyarthaṃ vṛddhāḥ, asthisamāśritā iti sthānasaṃśrayo'rtho'bhihitaḥ| ucchritā bhṛśamityanena prakopa āviṣkṛtaḥ| mahāmūlam asthyādisamāśrayaṇād gambhīramūlam| rujāvantamutpattāveva rujāprakarṣavantam| vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, ‘āyatanadīrghavṛttatvāyatatvābhyām’ iti pā.| āyataṃ dīrghaṃ vṛttatvāyatatvābhyāṃ granthyādivilakṣaṇatā kathitā, vidradhiriti khyāta iti| itiśabdena nirupādhisaṅketamātrā vidradhiriti sañjñeti darśayati, carake tu vidāhaprakarṣādvidradhisañjñā| yaduktam– “sarvaiḥ ‘ ... vidradhiriti’ iti pā.| śīghravidāhitvādvidradhīti nirūpyate|” iti| sa atra ‘ca’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| ṣaṭprakāraḥ; tribhirdoṣaistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, kṣatenaikaḥ, asṛjā'pyeka iti ṣaṭ| ṣaṇṇāmapi lakṣaṇaṃ kathyate||1-3||

div.ab: kṛṣṇo'ruṇo vā viṣamo bhṛśamatyarthavedanaḥ | citrotthānaprapākaśca vidradhirvātasambhavaḥ ||4|| (su. ni. a. 9) |

ab.seg: vātikamāha– kṛṣṇa ityādi| viṣamo bhṛśamiti kadācidalpaḥ, kadācinmahān| citrotthānaprapāka iti| citrau nānāvidhau vāyorviṣamakriyatvāt udgamaprapākau yasya sa tathā||4||
vātikavidradhilakṣaṇamāha– kṛṣṇa ityādi| viṣamo bhṛśamiti kadācidalpaḥ, kadācinmahān, bhṛśamatiśayena| citrotthānaprapāka iti citrau nānāvidhau vāyorviṣamakriyatvādudgamaprapākau yasya sa tathā||4||
pakvodumbarasaṅkāśaḥ śyāvo vā jvaradāhavān | kṣiprotthānaprapākaśca vidradhiḥ pittasambhavaḥ ||5||
paittikamāha– pakvetyādi| jvaradāhāvutthānakāla eva, pākakāle tu prakarṣavantau tāviti viśeṣaḥ||5||
paittikamāha– pakvetyādi| pakvodumbarasadṛśaḥ, śyāvaḥ śyāmavarṇaḥ, jvaradāhau utthānakāla eva syātāṃ, pākakāle tu tāveva prakarṣavantau, kṣipramutthānaprapākau yasya sa tathā||5||

div.ab: śarāvasadṛśaḥ pāṇḍuḥ śītaḥ snigdho'lpavedanaḥ | cirotthānaprapākaśca vidradhiḥ kaphasambhavaḥ ||6|| (su. ni. a. 9) |

ab.seg: kaphajamāha– śarāvetyādi| śarāvasadṛśa iti mahattvasūcanaparam||6||
śleṣmajamāha– śarāvetyādi| śarāvasadṛśa iti ‘mahattvasūcanam’ iti pā.| mahattvasūcanaparam| ciramutthānaprapākau yasya sa tathā||6||

div.ab: tanupītasitāścaiṣāmāsrāvāḥ kramaśaḥ smṛtāḥ |7|
pākānantaraṃ sambhūtāsrāvaliṅgamāha– tanupītasitāścaiṣāmityādi| kramaśa iti yathākramaṃ; tena vātena tanuḥ, pittena pītaḥ, kaphena sitaḥ; tanusrāve vātānurūpo varṇo jñeyaḥ|7|–
teṣāṃ doṣabhedena srāvānāha– tanvityādi| kramaśa iti krameṇa; vātena tanuḥ, pittena pītaḥ, śleṣmaṇā sitaḥ, tanusrāve vātānurūpo varṇo jñeyaḥ|7|–
nānāvarṇarujāsrāvo ghāṭālo viṣamo mahān ||7|| viṣamaṃ pacyate cāpi vidradhiḥ sānnipātikaḥ | (su. ni. a. 9) |

sannipātajamāha– nānetyādi| nānāvarṇarujāsrāva iti nānāśabdo ‘varṇādibhiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | varṇādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate; nānā bahuvidhā varṇāḥ kṛṣṇapītaśuklavarṇāḥ, rujāḥ todadāhakaṇḍvādikāḥ, tanupītasitā āsrāvāśca yasya sa tathā| anyatra śothe pākakāle nānārujā, atra tu sarvadā| ghāṭāla iti ghāṭā asyāsti sa ghāṭāla iti matvarthīyo lac, atyucchritāgratvena ghāṭāla iva| viṣamo'sādhyatvāt| viṣamaṃ pacyate iti cirāciragambhīrottānordhvānūrdhvabhedena viṣamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pacyata iti; viṣamam asamam| nanu, viṣamapākitvaṃ vātike vidradhāvuktaṃ, tathā'nupakrānte ca śothe; yathā– “yo'bhyutthito'lpo yadi vā mahān syāt kriyāṃ vinā pākamupaiti śothaḥ| viśālamūlo viṣamo vidagdhaḥ sa kṛcchratāṃ yātyavagāḍhadoṣaḥ||” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| ataḥ saṃśaye kathaṃ mitho bhedapratītiḥ? ucyate– vātike apratīkāreṇaiva viṣamapākitvam, ‘pratīkāreṇaiva bheditam|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pratīkāreṇaiva bheditam| iha punaḥ pratīkāre'pi vaiṣamyaṃ; vātike tu pākamātravaiṣamyaṃ, na tu gāmbhīryādinā; ‘ata evāyaṃ sādhyaḥ’ iti pā.| ato vātikaḥ sādhyaḥ||7||–

ab.seg: sānnipātikamāha– nānetyādi| nānā bahuvidhāḥ ‘kṛṣṇapītaśuklavarṇāḥ’ iti pā.| kṛṣṇapītaśuklā varṇāḥ, todadāhakaṇḍvādirujāḥ, tanupītasitāḥ srāvā yasya sa tathā| anyatra śothe pākakāle nānārujāḥ, atra tu sarvadā| ghāṭāla iti ghāṭā asyāstīti ghāṭālaḥ, matvarthīyo lac, atyucchritākṛtitvena ghāṭāla iva| viṣamo'sādhyatvāt| viṣamaṃ pacyata iti cirāciragambhīrottānordhvānūrdhvabhedena viṣamaṃ yathā bhavati tathā pacyate||7||

div.ab: taistairbhāvairabhihate kṣate vā'pathyakāriṇaḥ ||8|| kṣatoṣmā vāyuvisṛtaḥ saraktaṃ pittamīrayet | jvarastṛṣṇā ca dāhaśca jāyate tasya dehinaḥ ||9|| āganturvidradhirhyeṣa pittavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ |10| (su. ni. a. 9) |

abhighātajasyāgantoḥ samprāptimāha– taistairityādi| taistairiti kāṣṭhaloṣṭapāṣāṇādibhiḥ| abhihata iti asrutaraktasya mathitapiccitāderupalakṣaṇaṃ, kṣata iti srutaraktasya chinnabhinnādeḥ; dvayorabhihatayorapathyakāriṇa iti viśeṣaṇam| kṣatoṣmeti kṣataśabdasya hiṃsāmātraparigrahāt kṣatābhihatayorapyūṣmā kṣatoṣmaśabdenocyate| vāyuvisṛta iti kṣate raktakṣayāt abhihate abhighātādeva vātakopaḥ, kupitena vātena hetubhūtena visṛtaḥ prasṛto vāyuvisṛtaḥ| yadyapyayaṃ vātapittaraktajastathā'pi prāgabhighātasambhavatvenāgantuḥ, vātapittaraktajānāṃ janakatvenaiva vilakṣaṇā'sya samprāptiḥ| pittavidradhilakṣaṇa iti atroktajvarādivyatiriktasaṃsthānavarṇavedanādipittavidradhiliṅgayukta ityarthaḥ||8-9||–

ab.seg: abhighātajasyāgantorvidradheḥ samprāptimāha– taistairityādi| kāṣṭhalaguḍapāṣāṇādibhiḥ, mūlaśloke ‘abhihata’ iti pā.| abhihita iti asrutaraktasya mathitapiccitāderupalakṣaṇam| dvayorabhihatakṣatayorapathyakāriṇa iti yojyam| kṣatoṣmetyādi kṣatasya hiṃsātvamātraparigrahāt kṣatābhihatayorapyūṣmā kṣatoṣmaśabdenocyate| vāyuvisṛta ityādi| vātena vistāritaḥ kṣatena raktakṣayāt, abhihate abhighātādeva vātakopaḥ, kupitena ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vātena hetubhūtena visṛtaḥ prasṛtaḥ raktaṃ pittaṃ īrayet kopayet| yadyapyayaṃ vātapittaraktajastathā'pi prāgabhighātasambhavatvenāgantuḥ| pittavidradhilakṣaṇa iti atra jvaradāhavyatiriktasaṃsthānavarṇavedanādipittalakṣaṇa ityarthaḥ||8-9||

div.ab: kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ śyāvastīvradāharujākaraḥ ||10|| pittavidradhiliṅgastu raktavidradhirucyate |11| (su. ni. a. 9) |

raktajamāha– kṛṣṇetyādi| pittavidradhiliṅgātideśena labdhāvapi dāhajvarau tīvratāviśeṣārthamuktau| śyāva iti pittavidradhiliṅgātideśena prasaktasya pakvodumbarasaṅkāśasyāpavādaḥ| bhojaprabhṛtayastu dhāturaktajaṃ vidradhiṃ parityajya makkallasañjñayā''rtavalakṣaṇaraktajaṃ paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate ārtavajena saha ṣaḍvidradhayaḥ, suśrute tu dhāturaktajo'pi tathā makkallasañjñako'pi vidradhiḥ sāmānyena raktaja eveti ṣaḍvidradhaya iti boddhavyam||10||–

raktajavidradhimāha– kṛṣṇetyādi| kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ, sphoṭāvṛtaḥ piḍakāyuktaḥ, śyāvaḥ śyāvavarṇaḥ; anye ‘kṛṣṇasphoṭāvṛtaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭairāvṛtaḥ pittavidradhilakṣaṇanirdeśena yadyapi dāhajvarau labdhau, tathā'pyatrātidāhajvarakhyāpanārthamuktam| bhojaprabhṛtayastu dhāturaktajaṃ vidradhiṃ parityajya ‘makkallasañjñārtavalakṣaṇaṃ raktajam’ iti pā.| makkallasañjñamārtavalakṣaṇaraktajaṃ paṭhanti| teṣāṃ mate ārtavajena saha ṣaḍ vidradhayaḥ, suśrute tu dhāturaktajo'pi tathā makkallajo'pi vidradhiḥ sāmānyena raktaja eveti ṣaḍ vidradhaya iti boddhavyam||10||–

pṛthak sambhūya vā doṣāḥ kupitā gulmarūpiṇam ||11|| valmīkavat samunnaddhamantaḥ kurvanti vidradhim | gude bastimukhe nābhyāṃ kukṣau vaṅkṣaṇayostathā ||12|| vṛkkayoḥ plīhni yakṛti hṛdi vā klomni vā'pyatha | teṣāmuktāni liṅgāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ ||13|| adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaṃ śṛṇu viśeṣataḥ | gude vātanirodhaśca bastau kṛcchrālpamūtratā ||14|| nābhyāṃ hikkā tathā''ṭopaḥ kukṣau mārutakopanam | kaṭīpṛṣṭhagrahastīvro vaṅkṣaṇotthe tu vidradhau ||15|| vṛkkayoḥ pārśvasaṅkocaḥ plīhnyucchvāsāvarodhanam | sarvāṅgapragrahastīvro hṛdi kāsaśca jāyate | śvāso yakṛti hikkā ca klomni pepīyate payaḥ ||16|| (su. ni. a. 9) |

ab.seg: adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaviśeṣaṃ sādhyatāmasādhyatāṃ ca pratipādayitumābhyantaravidradhimāha– ‘pṛthak sambhūya vā ityādi’ iti pā.| pṛthagityādi| iyamadhikavidhānārthamuktā'pi samprāptirvidradheḥ punarucyate| ābhyantarasya raktajasya tathā''gantośca vidradherdoṣeṇa vyapadeśādiyameva tatrāpi samprāptirjñeyeti kaścit| bāhyāgantuvadābhyantarāgantusamprāptirityarthaḥ| ‘kṣatasyāntarabhāvānna’ iti pā.| kṣatajasyābhyantarābhāvānna nirdiṣṭaḥ kṣataja iti tu jejjaṭaḥ| gulmarūpiṇamiti gulmavat saṃhatam| etadābhyantaravidradhīnāṃ sāmānyarūpaṃ; viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ tu bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaireva jñeyam| valmīkavat atra ‘iti valmīka “uyeraḍipi” tadvat’ iti adhikaḥ pā., ‘unchūnattvaṃ,’ iti vā kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| samunnaddhaṃ samantādunnatam; etadapi pacyamānāvasthāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ samānam| bastimukha iti bastimukha eva, vidradhyādhārabhūtamāṃsādisambhavāt; na bastau, tasya tanutvāt| āṭopo rujāpūrvakakṣobhaḥ| mārutakopanamiti mārgāvarodhādvāyoḥ kopaḥ| vṛkkayoriti vṛkkamagramāṃsam| sarvāṅgapragrahaḥ pratyaṅgavyathā, ‘sarvaśirādhiṣṭhānatvāt’ iti pā.| sarvasirādhiṣṭhānatvāt hṛdayasya| klomnīti kloma vṛkkādūrdhvaṃ pipāsāsthānam| pepīyate payaḥ iti punaḥ punarjalaṃ pātumicchatītyarthaḥ||11-16||

adhiṣṭhānaviśeṣeṇa liṅgaviśeṣaṃ ‘sādhyatām’ iti pā.| sādhyāsādhyatāṃ ca jñāpayitumantaravidradhīnāha– pṛthagityādi| doṣā vātādayaḥ, pṛthag bhinnāḥ, sambhūya militvā vā, antarmadhye, gulmarūpiṇaṃ gulmavatsaṃhataṃ, valmīkavatsamunnataṃ, valmīkaṃ bhūmau kṛmiviśeṣaiḥ kṛtaṃ, tadvatsamantāt unnatam| sthānasaṃśrayamāha– guda ityādi| bastimukha iti bastimukhāśritamāṃsādau; na ca bastau, tanutvāt| kukṣau pārśvayoradhobhāge, vaṅkṣaṇayoḥ ūrumeḍhrasandhyoḥ| vṛkkau māṃsapiṇḍadvayam, eko vāmapārśve sthitaḥ, dvitīyo dakṣiṇapārśve sthitaḥ, plīhā udarasya vāmapārśve sthitaḥ, yakṛt kālakhaṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ, hṛdayaṃ kamalamukulākāramadhomukhaṃ, kloma kālakhaṇḍādhastāt sthitaṃ dakṣiṇapārśvasthaṃ tilakaṃ prasiddham| teṣāmābhyantarāṇāṃ vidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni ‘bāhyavidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bāhyavidradhīnāṃ liṅgāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇairuktāni| pratyekaṃ sthānasaṃśrayatvena rūpamāha– guda ityādi| gudenārte vidradhau vātanirodho bhavati, tathā bastau kṛcchramūtratā alpamūtratā ca| tābhyāṃ hikkā tathā āṭopo rujāpūrvakaḥ kṣobhaḥ, kukṣau mārutakopanamiti mārgarodhāt vāyoḥ prakopaḥ, vaṅkṣaṇotthe vidradhau tīvraḥ kaṭīpṛṣṭhagraho bhavati vṛkkayorityādi| vṛkkamagramāṃsaṃ, pārśvasaṅkocaḥ pārśvotpāṭanamiva, plīhni ucchvāsāvarodhanaṃ bhavati| tathā hṛdīti hṛdayotthe vidradhau sarvāṅgapragrahādaya upadravā bhavantītyarthaḥ| tīvro duḥsahaḥ, sarveṣāmaṅgānāṃ prakarṣeṇa grahaṇamiva sarvāṅgapragrahaḥ pratyaṅgavyathā, sarvādhiṣṭhānatvāt hṛdayasya, yakṛti jāte vidradhau śvāsastathā hikkā ca bhavati| klomnītyādi| vṛkkādūrdhvaṃ pipāsāsthānaṃ kloma, pepīyate paya iti punaḥpunarjalaṃ pātumicchati||11-16||

div.ab: nābheruparijāḥ pakvā yāntyūrdhvamitare tvadhaḥ |17| (su. ni. a. 9) |

srāvanirgamamārgamāha– ‘nābheruparijā ityādi|’ iti pā.| nābherityādi| uparijā vṛkkaplīhādijāḥ| yānti sravanti| nābhijastūbhayamārgasrāvī, ūrdhvādhaḥsrāvaśca tathāgatitvāt vātasya| yadāha hārītaḥ– “ūrdhvaṃ prabhinneṣu mukhānnarāṇāṃ pravartate'sṛksahito'pi pūyaḥ| adhaḥprabhinneṣu ca pāyumārgāt, dvābhyāṃ pravṛttistviha nābhijeṣu||” iti| itara iti nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ|17|–

srāvanirgamamāha– nābherityādi| uparijātāḥ vṛkkaplīhādijāḥ pakvāḥ santa ūrdhvaṃ yānti sravanti, nābhijastūbhayamārgasrāvī, ūrdhvādhaḥsrāvaśca tathā gatitvādvātasya| tathā ca hārītaḥ– “ūrdhvaṃ prabhinneṣu mukhānnarāṇāṃ pravartate'sṛksahitaśca pūyaḥ| adhaḥprabhinneṣu tu pāyumārgād dvābhyāṃ pravṛttistviha nābhijeṣu||” iti| ‘itare nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ sravanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | itare nābhibastivaṅkṣaṇajāḥ sravanti|17|–

adhaḥsruteṣu jīvettu sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvati ||17|| hṛnnābhibastivarjyā ye teṣu bhinneṣu bāhyataḥ | jīvet kadācit puruṣo netareṣu kadācana ||18|| (su. ni. a. 9) | sādhyā vidradhayaḥ pañca vivarjyaḥ sānnipātikaḥ | āmapakvavidagdhatvaṃ teṣāṃ śothavadādiśet ||19|| (vā. ni. a. 11) | ādhmātaṃ baddhaniṣyandaṃ chardihikkātṛṣānvitam | rujāśvāsasamāyuktaṃ vidradhirnāśayennaram ||20|| (su. sū. a. 33) |

ab.seg: sādhyatvādikamāha– adha ityādi| adhaḥsruteṣviti svayameva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravanti tadā jīvati| sruteṣūrdhvaṃ na jīvatīti ūrdhvaṃ pūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamānna jīvanam| hṛnnābhibastivarjyā iti plīhaklomādijāḥ| bhinneṣu bāhyata iti vaidyavyāpāreṇa bhinneṣu; anye marmādyāśayajeṣu svayameva bhinneṣviti vyācakṣate, antarbhinneṣvapyadhaḥsrāviṣu jīvanokteḥ| netareṣviti hṛnnābhibastijeṣu bhinneṣu teṣāṃ marmatvād bāhyā ābhyantarā vā varjyāḥ| kadācaneti pāke apāke vā| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “asādhyo marmajo jñeyaḥ pakvo'pakvaśca vidradhiḥ| sannipātotthito'pyevaṃ pakva eva tu bastijaḥ|| tvagjo nābheradho yaśca sādhyo marmasamīpajaḥ| apakvaścaiva pakvaśca sādhyo nopari nābhijaḥ||” iti| atra marmajaśabdena hṛdayanābhijāvucyete| baddhaniṣyandamiti baddhamūtram| etadbastije prāyaḥ||17-20||
