srāvaviṣayasādhyāsādhyatvamāha– ‘svayameva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravantīti tadā jīvati, sruteṣūrdhvamityādi, ūrdhvasruteṣu na jīvati| ūrdhvapūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamānna jīvanam||’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | svayameva yadā nābhyādijā bhinnā adhaḥ sravantīti tadā jīvati, sruteṣūrdhvamityādi, ūrdhvasruteṣu na jīvati| ūrdhvapūyasyāsamyaṅnirgamānna jīvanam|| hṛdityādi| bhinneṣu bāhyata iti vaidyavyāpāreṇa bhinneṣu kadāciddaivavaśāt puruṣo jīvet| anye marmādyāśayajeṣu svayameva bhinneṣviti vyācakṣate| antarbhinneṣvapyadhaḥsrāviṣu jīvanokteḥ| netareṣviti hṛnnābhibastijeṣu bhinneṣu, teṣāṃ marmatvāt bāhyā ābhyantarā vā varjyāḥ| kadācaneti pāke apāke ca| tathāca bhojaḥ– “asādhyo marmajo jñeyaḥ pakvo'pakvaśca vidradhiḥ| sannipātotthito'pyevaṃ pakva eva tu bastijaḥ|| tvagjo nābheradho yaśca sādhyo marmasamīpajaḥ| apakvaścaiva pakvaśca sādhyo noparinābhijaḥ||” iti| atra marmaśabdena hṛdayanābhijāvucyete| sādhyāsādhyatvamāha– pañca iti| vātikapaittikaślaiṣmikāganturaktajā iti| ayaṃ bāhyeṣu viṣayaḥ tridoṣajastvasādhyaḥ| ‘teṣāṃ viṣayamāha– āmeti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | teṣāṃ viṣayamāha– āmeti| teṣāṃ vidradhīnāmābhyantareṣvasādhyatvamāha– ādhmātamityādi| mūlaśloke ‘baddhaniṣyandam’ iti pā.| baddhaniṣpandaṃ baddhamūtram, etadbastije prāyaḥ| śeṣaṃ sugamam| atra kecit tantrāntaroktaṃ stanavidradhilakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti, tadyathā– “evameva ‘stanaśirā’ iti pā.| stanasirā vikṛtāḥ prāpya yoṣitām| sūtānāṃ garbhiṇīnāṃ ca sambhavecchvayathurghanaḥ|| stane sadugdhe cāptāsṛgbāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaḥ| nāḍīnāṃ sūkṣmarandhratvātsa kanyānāṃ na jāyate||17-20||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vidradhinidānaṃ samāptam ||40||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vidradhinidānaṃ samāptam||40||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vidradhinidānam||40||

div.head: vraṇaśothanidānam

ab.seg: atha vraṇaśothanidānam | ekadeśotthitaḥ śotho vraṇānāṃ pūrvalakṣaṇam | ṣaḍvidhaḥ syāt pṛthaksarvaraktāgantunimittajaḥ ||1||
śothāḥ ṣaḍete vijñeyāḥ prāguktaiḥ śothalakṣaṇaiḥ | viśeṣaḥ kathyate caiṣāṃ pakvāpakvādiniścaye ||2||

prāyeṇa cikitsāsādharmyād bhāvivraṇatvasambandhatulyatvācca vraṇaśothanidānamāha– ekadeśotthita ityādi| ṣaḍvidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ dvandvajaniṣedhārtham| prāguktairiti āmapakvaiṣaṇīyoktaiḥ; tatra hi “vātaśvayathuraruṇaḥ kṛṣṇo vā paruṣo mṛduranavasthitaḥ” (su. sū. a. 17) ityādinā ṣaṭśothalakṣaṇānyuktāni| viśeṣaḥ kathyate caiṣāmiti tatrānukto viśeṣaḥ kathyata ityarthaḥ| pakvāpakvādiniścaya iti atrādiśabdena pacyamānasya parigrahaḥ||1-2||

vraṇacikitsāsāmānyādbhāvivraṇatvasambandhatulyatvācca vraṇaśothanidānārambhaḥ| teṣāṃ prāgrūpeṇa saṅkhyāmāha– eketyādi| ekadeśe śothaḥ etadvraṇapūrvarūpaṃ; sa ca ṣaḍvidhaḥ– tribhirdoṣaistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, ‘raktenaikaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | raktenaikaḥ, anya āgantukaḥ abhighātajaḥ, evaṃ ṣaṭ, ṣaḍvidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ dvandvajaniṣedhārtham| teṣāṃ lakṣaṇanirdeśaṃ darśayannāha– ‘śothā iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śothā iti| prāguktairiti| śothanidānoktaiśca, ‘rasastanutvakparuṣāruṇādikaiḥ’ ityādi| sāmprataṃ pakvāpakvādiniścaya ‘iti atrādiśabdena pacyamānasya parigrahaḥ’ iti pā.| ityatrādiśabdena pacyamānāvasthāyāḥ ‘grahaṇam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | grahaṇam||1-2||
viṣamaṃ pacyate vātāt pittotthaścācirācciram | kaphajaḥ pittavacchotho raktāgantusamudbhavaḥ ||3||
vātādibhedena viśeṣalakṣaṇamāha– viṣamamityādi| pittavaditi pittaśothavadaciraṃ pacyate||3||
tameva viśeṣamāha– viṣamamityādi| śvayathorekadeśe ardhe vā, pittottho'ciraṃ śīghraṃ, kaphajaściraṃ carakalaṃ, raktāgantujayoḥ pittavat pittaśophavadaciraṃ pacyate||3||
mandoṣmatā'lpaśothatvaṃ kāṭhinyaṃ tvaksavarṇatā | mandavedanatā caitacchothānāmāmalakṣaṇam ||4||
āmaśothalakṣaṇamāha– mandeti| mandoṣmatā īṣaduṣṇatā, tvaksavarṇatā tvaksadṛśa eva varṇaḥ||4||
dahyate dahaneneva kṣāreṇeva ca pacyate | pipīlikāgaṇeneva daśyate chidyate tathā ||5||
bhidyate caiva śastreṇa daṇḍeneva ca tāḍyate | pīḍyate pāṇinevāntaḥ sūcībhiriva tudyate ||6||
soṣācoṣo vivarṇaḥ syādaṅgulyevāvaghaṭyate | āsane śayane sthāne śāntiṃ vṛścikaviddhavat ||7||
na gacchedātataḥ śotho bhavedādhmātabastivat | jvarastṛṣṇā'ruciścaiva pacyamānasya lakṣaṇam ||8||

pacyamānalakṣaṇamāha– dahyata ityādi| pacyamānaśothe pittaliṅgānyeva bhūyasā bhavanti, vidāhasya pittaprakopajatvāt; vidāhaścātra doṣādīnāmeva| tena jvaratṛṣṇārucyādayo'tra pittaliṅgāni| chidyata iti dvidhā kriyata iva| bhidyata iti vidāryate| soṣācoṣa iti uṣā dāhaḥ, coṣaḥ pārśvasthāgnisantāpavadvyathā, tābhyāṃ saha vartate yaḥ sa tathā||5-8||

vraṇaśophasya pacyamānāvasthāmāha– dahyata ityādi| pacyamānaśophe pittaliṅgānyeva bhūyasā bhavanti, vidāhaḥ pittaprakopāt, jvaratṛṣṇārucyādayo'pi pittaliṅgāni, agninā dahyata iva, kṣāreṇa pacyata iva, pipīlikābhirdaśyata iva, chidyate dvidhākriyata iva śastreṇa, bhidyata iva, daṇḍena tāḍyata iva, antarmadhye, hastena pīḍyata iva, sūcībhirvidhyata iva| uṣā ekadeśiko dāhaḥ, coṣaḥ pārśvasthitāgnisantāpavadvyathā, tābhyāṃ saha vartate yaḥ sa tathā, vivarṇaḥ mlānaḥ, aṅgulyā ivāvaghaṭyate cālyate| āsane tathā śayane tathā sthāne ūrdhvabhavane vṛścikaviddhavat śāntiṃ na gacchet| ādhmātabastivat ‘vāyupūrṇabastyādisūtrakośavat’ iti pā.| vāyupūrṇabastyākhyamūtrakośavat, śvayathuḥ satato bhavati, tvaksaṅkocarahita ityarthaḥ| jvaratṛṣṇādayaścopadravā bhavanti pacyamānavraṇaśophe||5-8||
vedanopaśamaḥ ‘śotho lohito'lpo’ iti pā. | śotho'lohito'lpo na connataḥ | prādurbhāvo valīnāṃ ca todaḥ kaṇḍūrmuhurmuhuḥ ||9||
upadravāṇāṃ praśamo nimnatā sphuṭanaṃ tvacām | bastāvivāmbusañcāraḥ syācchothe'ṅgulipīḍite ||10||
pūyasya pīḍayatyekamantamante ca pīḍīte | bhaktākāṅkṣā bhaveccaitacchothānāṃ pakvalakṣaṇam ||11||

pakvalakṣaṇamāha– vedanopaśama ityādi| dāhādivedanopaśāntiḥ, vidāhopaśamena pittasyābalavattvāt| todaḥ kaṇḍūścātra vātakaphaliṅgam| prādurbhāvo valīnāmiti māṃsaśaithilyādvalīsambhavaḥ| upadravāṇāṃ praśama iti pittakopajanitā uṣācoṣatṛṣṇārucyādayo rogā eva upadravāsteṣāṃ praśamaḥ| nimnatā svarūpataḥ, aṅgulipīḍanādvā| sphuṭanaṃ tvacāmiti ‘kiñcittvagavadāraṇam’ iti pā.| kiñcittvagavadaraṇam| bastāvivetyādi| bastiścarmapuṭakam, pūyasyetyatra ‘sañcāra’ iti śeṣaḥ| ayamarthaḥ– bastau yathā'mbusañcārastathā ‘śothe'ṅgulīpīḍite’ iti pā.| śothe'ṅgulipīḍite sati pūyasya sañcāraḥ| pīḍayatyekamantamante ca pīḍita iti ekamantaṃ deśam, ante avayave pīḍite pīḍayati avagāhate, ‘pūya’ iti śeṣaḥ||9-11||

pakvāvasthasya śophasya lakṣaṇamāha– vedanopaśama ityādi| vidāhopaśamena pittasyābalatvāt| alohitaḥ pāṇḍuḥ dhūsaro vā, yaduktaṃ suśrute– “ ‘pāṇḍutā'lpaśothā’ iti pā.| pāṇḍutā'lpaśothatā” iti ‘alpavedanayā iti īṣat pīḍā vedanopaśamaḥ, iti| yaduktam– uktaḥ vedanāpekṣayā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | alpavedanayā iti īṣat pīḍā vedanopaśamaḥ, iti| yaduktam– uktaḥ vedanāpekṣayā prādurbhāvo valīnāmiti māṃsaśaithilyādvalīsambhava iti| todaḥ kaṇḍuścātra vātakaphaliṅgam| upadravāṇāmityādi| pittakopajanitā uṣācoṣatṛṣṇā'rucyādaya upadravāsteṣāmupaśamaḥ| nimnatā svarūpato'ṅgulinipīḍanādvā| sphuṭanaṃ tvacāmiti kiñcittvagavadaraṇam| bastāvivetyādi– bastiścarmapuṭakam| pūyasyetyatra ‘sañcāra’ iti śeṣaḥ| ayamarthaḥ– bastau yathā'mbusañcāraḥ, tathā'ṅgulipīḍite śothe'pi pūyasya sañcāraḥ| ekamantaṃ deśam, ante avayave pīḍite pīḍayati avagāhate ‘pūya’ iti śeṣaḥ| bhaktākāṅkṣeti vedanāpagamādeva||9-11||

div.ab: narte'nilādruṅna vinā ca pittaṃ pākaḥ kaphaṃ cāpi vinā na pūyaḥ | tasmāddhi sarve paripākakāle pacanti ‘śothāstribhireva doṣaiḥ’ iti pā. | śothāṃstraya eva doṣāḥ ||12|| (su. sū. a. 17) |

ab.seg: ekadoṣārabdhe'pi śothe pākakāle sarvadoṣasambandhamāha– narte'nilādrugityādi| rugrujā todādirūpā| suśrute– “tribhiretaiḥ śoṇitacaturthaiśca śarīramidaṃ dhāryate” (su. sū. a. 21) iti dvitīyaṃ darśanaṃ śoṇitaprādhānyākhyāpakamāśrityoktam– “kālāntareṇābhyuditaṃ tu pittaṃ kṛtvā vaśe vātakaphau prasahya| pacatyataḥ śoṇitameṣa pāko mataḥ pareṣāṃ viduṣāṃ dvitīyaḥ||” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| atra darśane pittaṃ vidāhakupitaṃ śoṇitaṃ dūṣyaṃ karmabhūtaṃ pacati, vātakaphau vaśe kṛtvā kroḍīkṛtya; hīnārtho vā vaśeśabdaḥ, vātakaphau hīnau kṛtvetyarthaḥ; śoṇitaṃ kartṛbhūtaṃ vā, tena paktyanukūlatvādvivakṣitaṃ; pūrvadarśane kaphāt pūyaḥ, atra darśane śoṇitāt pūya iti viśeṣaḥ| gambhīrapāke śothe sakalāmapacyamānalakṣaṇānudayādajñāyamāne lakṣaṇāntaramuktaṃ suśrutena| tadyathā– “kaphajeṣu khalu śotheṣu gambhīragatitvādabhighātajeṣu vā keṣucidasamastaṃ pakvalakṣaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā pakvamapakvamiti bhiṣaṅmohamupaiti, yatra hi tvaksavarṇatā śītaśothatā alparujatā aśmavadghanatā ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca, na tatra mohamupeyāt|” (su. sū. a. 17) iti| asyārthaḥ– yadā rāgadāhādivedanāsamudāyānantaraṃ tvaksavarṇatādīni bhavanti tadā na mohamajñānatāmupeyāt pakvameveti niścinuyāt| gadādhareṇa tu tvaksavarṇatādīni saṃśayahetūnyuktāni; yatastena “gambhīrapākitvādantaḥ pāko bahiḥ punastvaksāvarṇyaṃ, gambhīrapākitvādeva bahiḥ śītatā, kaphārabdhatvānmandarujatā'śmavacca ghanatā” ityabhidhāya “śeṣaṃ pakvalakṣaṇairjānīyāt” ityuktam||12||

ekadoṣārabdhe'pi śothe pākakāle sarvadoṣasambandhamāha– netyādi| anilādvātādṛte ruṅ na bhavati, pittaṃ vinā pāko na bhavati, kaphaṃ vinā pūyo na bhavati, tasmāddhetoḥ sarve śophāḥ paripākakāle tribhireva doṣaiḥ pākaṃ gacchanti, ruk rujā todādirūpā, śeṣaṃ sugamam| suśrute– ‘tribhiretaiḥ śoṇitacaturthaiḥ śarīramidaṃ dhāryate|’ iti dvitīyaṃ nidarśanaṃ śoṇitaprādhānyākhyāpakamāśrityoktaṃ matāntaramāha– kālāntareṇetyādi| pittaprakopaprasarasthānasaṅgrahakālāvadhinā abhi samantato bhāvenābhyuditaṃ kupitaṃ pittaṃ, pittamatra doṣo jñeyaḥ, śoṇitaṃ dūṣyaṃ, tuśabdo'tra punararthe, vātakaphau vaśe kṛtvā ātmasāt kṛtvā, pākakriyāyāṃ pittasya prādhānyāt| pūrvamate kaphāt pūyaḥ, atra tu ‘śoṇitādibhistātparyārthaḥ’ iti pā.| śoṇitādibhiriti tātparyārthaḥ||12||

div.ab: kālāntareṇābhyuditaṃ tu pittaṃ kṛtvā vaśe vātakaphau prasahya | pacatyataḥ śoṇitameṣa pāko mataḥ pareṣāṃ viduṣāṃ dvitīyaḥ ||13|| kakṣaṃ samāsādya yathaiva vahnirvāyvīritaḥ sandahati prasahya | tathaiva pūyo hyaviniḥsṛto hi māṃsaṃ ‘śirāḥ’ iti pā. | sirāḥ snāyu ca khādatīha ||14|| (su. sū. a. 17) |

ab.seg: aviniḥsṛtasya pūyasya doṣamāha– kakṣamityādi| kakṣaṃ samāsādyeti kakṣaṃ tṛṇādigahanam||13-14||
ab.note: ‘anirhṛtya pūyasya doṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā darśayannāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: anirhṛtasya pūyasya doṣaṃ darśayannāha– kakṣamityādi| kakṣaṃ tṛṇādīnāṃ samūhaṃ, snāyumūlāḥ ‘śirāḥ’ iti pā.| sirāḥ, vāyvīritaḥ vāyupreritaḥ||13-14||

div.ab: āmaṃ vidahyamānaṃ ca samyak pakvaṃ ca yo bhiṣak | jānīyāt sa bhavedvaidyaḥ śeṣāstaskaravṛttayaḥ ||15|| yaśchinattyāmamajñānādyo vā pakvamupekṣate | śvapacāviva mantavyau tāvaniścitakāriṇau ||16|| (su. sū. a. 17) |

ab.seg: śvapacāviva caṇḍālāviva, mantavyau jñātavyau| śeṣāstaskaravṛttaya iti lobhamātraprayuktatvāttaskarā iva śeṣāḥ||15-16||

āmādilakṣaṇajñāne guṇamajñāne ca doṣaṃ darśayannāha– āmamityādi| āmamapakvaṃ, vidahyamānaṃ pacyamānaṃ, samyak pakvaṃ ca, yo bhiṣak jānīyāt, sa vaidyo bhavet āyurvedavit syāt, śeṣā anye āmādijñānavarjitāḥ lobhamātraprayuktatvāttaskarā eva| pakvāpakvayośchedanāchedanena vaidyadoṣamāha– ya ityādi| śvapacaścāṇḍālaḥ, sa hi sarvabhakṣitvāt śvānamapi pacati| śeṣaṃ sugamam||15-16||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne vraṇaśothanidānaṃ samāptam ||41||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ vraṇaśothanidānaṃ samāptam||41||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ vraṇaśothanidānam||41||

div.head: śārīravraṇanidānam
div.ab: atha śārīravraṇanidānam | dvidhā vraṇaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ śārīrāgantubhedataḥ | doṣairādyastayoranyaḥ śastrādikṣatasambhavaḥ ||1|| stabdhaḥ kaṭhinasaṃsparśo mandasrāvo mahārujaḥ | tudyate sphurati śyāvo vraṇo mārutasambhavaḥ ||2|| tṛṣṇāmohajvarakledadāhaduṣṭyavadāraṇaiḥ | vraṇaṃ pittakṛtaṃ vidyādgandhaiḥ srāvaiśca pūtikaiḥ ||3|| bahupiccho guruḥ snigdhaḥ stimito mandavedanaḥ | pāṇḍuvarṇo'lpasaṅkledaścirapākī kaphavraṇaḥ ||4|| (ca. ci. a. 25) | rakto raktasrutī raktāddvitrijaḥ syāttadanvayaiḥ |5|

śothānāmanupakrāntānāṃ vraṇabhāvāpattervraṇanidānamāha– dvidhetyādi| ‘vraṇa gātravicūrṇane’ ityasmāddhātorvraṇasya sādhutvamuktam| vraṇaniruktiśca suśrutena kṛtā| yathā– “vṛṇoti yasmādrūḍhe'pi vraṇavāstu na naśyati| ādehadhāraṇājjantorvraṇastasmānnirucyate||” (su. sū. a. 21) iti| anya ityāgantuḥ| āgantuvraṇe yadyapi doṣastatkālaṃ tadātvena sañcayakopaprasaraṇaśālī vikārakaraṇasamarthaḥ kalpayituṃ śakyate, tathā'pi saptarātraṃ kṣatoṣmanirvāpaṇāya madhusarpirupayogāt śītakriyāvidhānācca nijavraṇavilakṣaṇacikitsārthaṃ vyapadiśyate| raktasyaikaikasmin doṣe dvandve ca prasaramāha– dvitrijaḥ syāttadanvayairityādi| raktānvayaiḥ ekaikadoṣairdvandvaiśca; raktānvitairekaikadoṣairdvijo vraṇaḥ, raktānvitairdvandvatrayaistrijaḥ; evaṃ doṣatraye'pi raktasambandha ūhanīyaḥ; evaṃ pañcadaśadhā prasaro doṣāṇāmupagṛhīto bhavati| athavā'yamarthaḥ– tadanvayairdoṣadvandvatrayānvayaiḥ, tena doṣadvayānvayena dvijo dvandvajo vraṇaḥ, doṣatrayānvayena trijaḥ sannipātajaḥ||1-4||–

vraṇaśophānāmanupakrāntānāṃ vraṇabhāvāpattervraṇanidānam| teṣāṃ bhedamāha– dvidhetyādi| ‘vraṇa gātravicūrṇane’ ityasmāddhātoḥ vraṇasya niruktiḥ| vraṇaniruktiśca suśrute kṛtā| yathā– “vṛṇoti yasmādrūḍhe'pi vraṇavāstu na naśyati| ādehadhāraṇājjantorvraṇastasmānnirucyate||” iti| śārīrāgantubhedato vraṇo dvidhā jñeyaḥ, tayordvayormadhye ādyaḥ śārīraḥ, sa ca doṣaiḥ pavanakaphapittaśoṇitasannipātaiḥ syāt, anya ityāgantuḥ śastrādikṣatasambhavo bhavati| vātikamāha– stabdha ityādi| stabdhaḥ acalaḥ, tudyate śūleneva, śyāvaḥ śāvavarṇaḥ| paittikamāha– tṛṣṇetyādi| etairliṅgaiḥ pittakṛtaṃ jānīyāt| kleda ārdratā, dāhaduṣṭiḥ dāhavān, avadāraṇaṃ tvaksphoṭanaṃ, pūtikairdurgandhaiḥ| kaphajamāha– bahvityādi| bahupicchaḥ ‘bhūyaḥ picchaḥ picchilaḥ’ iti pā.| bhūyaḥ picchilaḥ, stimito niścalaḥ, alpasaṅkledaḥ īṣadārdraḥ| raktasyaikasmin doṣe dvandve ca prasaramāha– rakta ityādi| raktavarṇo bhavati, raktasrāvo vā| dvitrijaḥ syāttadanvayairiti raktānugaiḥ pṛthagdoṣaiḥ dvandvaiśca, tena pṛthagdoṣaiḥ saraktaiḥ dvijaḥ, dvandvajaiḥ saraktaistrijaḥ, evaṃ tridoṣaje'pi raktaḥ sambandhanīyaḥ| tadyathā– vātajaḥ, pittajaḥ, śleṣmajaḥ, saṅghātajaḥ, raktajaḥ, vātapittajaḥ, vātaśleṣmajaḥ, pittaśleṣmajaḥ, evamaṣṭau; śoṇitasambandhāt sapta, vātaśoṇitasambandhāttajjaḥ, ‘śleṣmaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śleṣmaḥ pittaśoṇitajaḥ, śleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, vātapittaśoṇitajaḥ, vātaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, ‘vātapittaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ’ iti pā.| pittaśleṣmaśoṇitajaḥ, sannipātakṣatajaḥ iti; evaṃ doṣāṇāṃ bhedena pañcadaśadhā prasara uktaḥ| athavā tadanvayaiḥ doṣatrayānvayaiḥ, tena doṣadvayānvayena dvijaḥ dvandvajo vraṇaḥ, doṣatrayānvayena trijaḥ sānnipātiko vraṇa ityarthaḥ||1-4||–

tvaṅmāṃsajaḥ sukhe deśe taruṇasyānupadravaḥ ||5|| dhīmato'bhinavaḥ kāle sukhe sādhyaḥ sukhaṃ vraṇaḥ | guṇairanyatamairhīnastataḥ kṛcchro vraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||6|| sarvairvihīno vijñeyastvasādhyo bhūryupadravaḥ | (ca. ci. a. 25) |

sādhyatvādikamāha– tvagityādi| sukhe deśa iti marmarahite dehāvayave| anupadrava iti jvaratṛṣṇādyupadravarahitaḥ| dhīmata iti hitāhitajñasya| kāle sukhe iti hemante śiśire ca| anyatamairiti uktānāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye ekatamairguṇaiḥ||5-6||–

vraṇasya sukhasādhyatvamāha– tvagityādi| tvaṅmāṃsajaḥ, sukhe deśe marmarahite dehāvayave, anupadravaḥ jvaratṛṣṇādyupadravarahitaḥ, dhīmataḥ ataralabuddheḥ, sukhe kāle hemante śiśire ca| vraṇasya ‘kaṣṭasādhyatvamāha’ iti pā.| kaṣṭasādhyamāha– guṇairityādi| prāguktānāṃ guṇānāṃ madhye anyatamairguṇairhīnaḥ rahitaḥ, tvaṅmāṃsajādīnāmityarthaḥ| sa vraṇaḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ| asādhyamāha– sarvairityādi| sarvaistvagmāṃsajādikairguṇaiḥ rahitaḥ, ‘bhūryupadravaḥ’ ityatra ‘nirupakramaḥ’ iti pā.| ‘sarvairvihīno'sādhyastu tathaivopadravānvitaḥ’ iti ca pā.| nirupakramaḥ anupakrāntaḥ||5-6||–
pūtiḥ pūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvyutsaṅgī cirasthitiḥ ||7|| duṣṭo vraṇo'tigandhādiḥ śuddhaliṅgaviparyayaḥ |8|

duṣṭavraṇaliṅgamāha– pūtirityādi| pūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvīti pūyayuktamatiduṣṭaṃ raktaṃ satataṃ sravatītyarthaḥ| utsaṅgī koṭaravān| cirasthitirityanena bahuladoṣasambandhaṃ darśayati| tathā coktam– “anātmavatāmajñaiścopakrāntā vraṇāḥ pradūṣyanti, vṛddhatvāddoṣāṇām||” (su. sū. a. 22) iti| duṣṭavraṇa ityatra ‘paribhāṣita’ iti śeṣaḥ| atigandhādiriti ādiśabdena varṇasrāvavedanākṛtayo gṛhītāḥ, atiśabdena ca viśiṣyante| śuddhaliṅgaviparyaya iti vakṣyamāṇaśuddhaliṅgaviparītaḥ pūtitvādiyogādeva| ‘pūtipūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvi’ iti kvacit pāṭhe pūtiśabdaḥ pūyaduṣṭāsṛgviśeṣaṇam||7||–

duṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– pūtirityādi| pūtiḥ śaṭitaḥ, “pūtipūyātiduṣṭāsṛksrāvī” iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ, tatra pūtiśabdaḥ pūyaduṣṭāsṛgviśeṣaṇaṃ, pūyayuktamatiduṣṭaraktaṃ satataṃ sravatītyarthaḥ| cirasthitirityanena bahudoṣasambandhaṃ darśayati| tathā coktam– “anātmavatāmajñaiścopakrāntā vraṇā vṛddhatvāddoṣāṇāṃ praduṣyanti” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| ‘duṣṭe’ iti pā.| duṣṭo vraṇa iti kathitaḥ atigandhādiḥ, ādiśabdena varṇāsrāvavedanākṛtayo gṛhyante| śuddhaliṅgaviparyaya iti vakṣyamāṇaśuddhalakṣaṇaviparītaḥ||7||–
jihvātalābho'timṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdho'lpavedanaḥ ||8|| suvyavastho nirāsrāvaḥ śuddho vraṇa iti smṛtaḥ |9|

śuddhavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– jihvetyādi| jihvātalābha iti jihvātalavadābhā prabhā yasya sa tathā; talaśabdaḥ svarūpavacanaḥ| jihvātalābhaśabdaścātra mṛduślakṣṇasnigdhaśabdaiḥ pratyekamabhisambadhyate; tena jihvātalābho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhaścetyāhuḥ| ‘suvyavasthita’ iti pā.| suvyavastha iti utsannotsaṅgitvarahitaḥ| nirāsrāva iti doṣakṛtasrāvarahitaḥ| carake tu paṭhyate– “nātirakto nātipāṇḍurnātisrāvo na cātiruk| na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 25) iti, taddarśanādatra nirāsrāvatvaṃ doṣakṛtasrāvahīnatvaṃ, vigatavedanatvaṃ ca vātādyuktavedanārahitatvam| vraṇasrāvakṛtavedanāyuktatvaṃ punarastyeva, ata eva rūḍhaliṅge arujamityuktam||8||–

śuddhavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– jihvetyādi| jihvātalavadābhā prabhā yasya sa tathā| talaśabdaḥ svarūpavacanaḥ, ‘jihvātalaśabdaścātra’ iti pā.| jihvātalābhaśabdaścātra mṛduślakṣṇasnigdhaśabdaiḥ saha pratyekamabhisambadhyate; tena jihvātalābho mṛduḥ ślakṣṇaḥ snigdhaśceti prāhuḥ| suvyavastha iti śobhanākṛtiḥ, tena utsannotsaṅgitvarahitaḥ, kintu sama ityarthaḥ| nirāsrāva iti doṣakṛtāsrāvahīnaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “nātirakto nātipāṇḍurnātisrāvo na cātiruk| na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ||” ‘iti darśanāt’ iti pā.| iti||8||–
kapotavarṇapratimā yasyāntāḥ kledavarjitāḥ ||9|| sthirāśca piḍakāvanto rohatīti tamādiśet | (su. sū. a. 23) | ‘ruhyamāna ... ’ iti pā.|
ruhyamāṇalakṣaṇamāha– kapotetyādi| kapotavarṇapratimā iti pāṇḍudhūsarāḥ, sthirāḥ adaraṇāḥ| ‘cipiṭikāvarṇa’ iti pāṭhāntare cipiṭikā māṃsacelī, tadvarṇaḥ||9||–

rohaṇonmukhavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– kapotetyādi| yasya vraṇasyāntāḥ prāntāḥ kapotavarṇapratimāḥ, pāṇḍudhūsarā ityarthaḥ| kledena varjitāḥ| sthirā acalāḥ kaṭhinā ityarthaḥ| “cipiṭikāvantaḥ” iti pāṭhe cipiṭikā māṃsacelī carmavalīti yāvat, ‘karocaḍī’ iti loke, tā vidyante yeṣāṃ te cipiṭikāvantaḥ||9||–
rūḍhavartmānamagranthimaśūnamarujaṃ vraṇam ||10|| tvaksavarṇaṃ samatalaṃ samyagrūḍhaṃ vinirdiśet | (su. sū. a. 23) |

samyagrūḍhalakṣaṇamāha– rūḍhavartmānamityādi| rūḍhavartmānamiti vartma vraṇamārgo vraṇavāstu rūḍho yasya tam| antaḥpūyābhāvādaśūnamarujaṃ ca| tvaksavarṇaṃ tvacāsamānavarṇam| samatalamiti samaṃ talena jihvātalena karatalena vā| agranthimityanena upari ucchūnatāyā niṣedhaḥ, samatalena tvadhonimnatāyā niṣedhaḥ||10||–

rūḍhavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– rūḍhavartmānamityādi| vartma vraṇamārgo vraṇavāstu sa rūḍho yasya tam, agranthiṃ granthirahitam, etena upari utsannatāyā niṣedhaḥ| aśūnaṃ śvayathurahitam, arujaṃ pīḍārahitaṃ, tvaksavarṇaṃ tvacāsamānavarṇam| samatalamiti samaṃ talena jihvātalena karatalena vā, samatalaśabdena tvadho nimnatāyā niṣedhaḥ||10||–

kuṣṭhināṃ viṣajuṣṭānāṃ śoṣiṇāṃ madhumehinām ||11|| vraṇāḥ kṛcchreṇa sidhyanti yeṣāṃ cāpi vraṇe vraṇāḥ | vasāṃ medo'tha majjānaṃ mastuluṅgaṃ ca yaḥ sravet ||12|| āgantujo vraṇaḥ siddhyenna siddhyeddoṣasambhavaḥ | (su. sū. a. 23) |

ab.seg: vyādhiviśeṣeṇa vraṇasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha– kuṣṭhināmityādi| kuṣṭhaviśeṣeṇātyantadoṣadūṣitaraktādidūṣyatvena sarvadā duṣṭiradhiketi kṛcchrasādhyatvam| viṣajuṣṭānāmiti dūṣīviṣārtānām| śoṣe madhumehe ca dhātukṣayāt, vraṇe ca ‘raktasrāvāccāhāra ... ’ iti pā.| raktasrāvādāhārasaṃyamanādadhikā duṣṭiḥ| vasāṃ medo'tha majjānaṃ mastuluṅgaṃ ca yaḥ sravediti majjā asthisnehaḥ, mastuluṅgaṃ ghṛtikā| na sidhyeddoṣasambhava iti doṣairatidūṣitānāṃ vasādīnāṃ srāvasya bahuvyāpattikaratvāt||11-12||

div.ab: vyādhiviśeṣeṇa vraṇasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha– kuṣṭhināmityādi| kuṣṭhaviśeṣeṇātyantadoṣadūṣitaraktādidūṣyatvena sarvadā duṣṭiradhiketi kṛcchratvam| viṣajuṣṭānāṃ dūṣīviṣārtānāṃ, śoṣe madhumehe ca dhātukṣayād vraṇe raktasrāvāccāhārasaṃyamāccādhikaduṣṭiḥ| punaḥ kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha– vasetyādi| vasā māṃsasnehaḥ, majjā'sthisnehaḥ, mastuluṅgo mastakābhyantarasnehaḥ, vasādīnāṃ srāvādāgantuje vraṇe kṛcchratvaṃ vā, kintu doṣaje ‘vraṇe'kṛcchratvam’ iti pā.| vraṇe'sādhyatvaṃ, doṣairatiśayadūṣitānāṃ vasādīnāṃ srāvasya bahuvyāpattikaratvāt||11-12||– ubhayoḥ vyākhyayoḥ ‘ ... sumanā ... ’ iti pā. |
madyāgurvājyasumanaḥpadmacandanacampakaiḥ ||13|| sagandhā divyagandhāśca mumūrṣūṇāṃ vraṇāḥ smṛtāḥ | (su. sū. a. 28) |
riṣṭarūpāṃ gandhavikṛtimāha– madyāgurvājyetyādi| sumanā jātī, sagandhāḥ samānagandhāḥ, divyagandhā aparikalpitādbhutapārijātādigandhāḥ||13||–
riṣṭarūpāṃ gandhavikṛtimāha– madyetyādi| madyaṃ prasiddham, aguru gandhadravyam, ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ, sumanā jātī, padmaṃ kamalaṃ, madyādibhiḥ samānagandhāḥ||13||–

ye ca marmasvasambhūtā bhavantyatyarthavedanāḥ ||14|| dahyante cāntaratyarthaṃ bahiḥśītāśca ye vraṇāḥ | dahyante bahiratyarthaṃ bhavantyantaśca śītalāḥ ||15|| prāṇamāṃsakṣayaśvāsakāsārocakapīḍitāḥ | pravṛddhapūyarudhirā vraṇā yeṣāṃ ca marmasu ||16|| kriyābhiḥ samyagārabdhā na sidhyanti ca ye vraṇāḥ | asyāgre “vraṇe śvayathurāyāsāt sa ca rāgaśca jāgarāt tau ca rukca divāsvāpāt, tāśca mṛtyuśca maithunāt” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaṃ paṭhyate varjayedapi tān vaidyaḥ saṃrakṣannātmano yaśaḥ ||17|| (su. sū. a. 28) |

ab.seg: ye ca marmasvasambhūtā iti| marmasu na jātā api bhṛśavedanāḥ, marmajātatvena hi bhṛśavedanāvattvaṃ yuktam| prāṇamāṃsakṣaya iti prāṇakṣayeṇa śaktikṣayaḥ, māṃsakṣayeṇa copacayakṣayaḥ| anuktamapyaśeṣaṃ riṣṭaṃ saṅgṛhṇannāha– kriyābhirityādi||14-17||

punaścāsādhyatvamāha– ya ityādi| marmasu na jātā api bhṛśavedanāḥ syuḥ, ‘marmajā tattvena hi bhṛśavedanatvayuktam|’ iti pā.| marmajātatvena hi bhṛśavedanatvaṃ yuktam| ye bahiḥ śītalāḥ, ‘antarmadhyam’ iti pā.| antarmadhye atyarthaṃ dahyante| punaścāsādhyaliṅgatvamāha– prāṇetyādi| prāṇakṣayaḥ śaktikṣayaḥ, māṃsakṣayaḥ upacayakṣayaḥ, marmasu pāyunābhihṛdayādiṣu| punaścāsādhyatvamāha– kriyābhirityādi| pādacatuṣṭayānvitābhiḥ||14-17||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śārīravraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||42||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śārīravraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||42||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śārīravraṇanidānam||42||

div.head: sadyovraṇanidānam
div.ab: nānādhāramukhaiḥ śastrairnānāsthānanipātitaiḥ | bhavanti nānākṛtayo vraṇāstāṃstānnibodha me ||1|| chinnaṃ bhinnaṃ tathā viddhaṃ kṣataṃ piccitameva ca | ghṛṣṭamāhustathā ṣaṣṭhaṃ teṣāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam ||2|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: śārīravraṇamabhidhāyāgantuvraṇamāha– nānādhāramukhairityādi| nānā dhārā mukhāni ca yeṣāṃ tāni tathā| sthānaviśeṣo'pi śastranipātatulyatvenākṛtiviśeṣe heturityata uktaṃ– nānāsthānanipātitairiti||1-2||

atha śārīravraṇamabhidhāyāgantumāha– nānetyādi| nānādhārāmukhaiḥ śastraiḥ, nānāsthānanipātitaiḥ, ebhirnānākṛtayo vraṇā bhavanti, me matsakāśāttān vraṇān nibodha jānīhi| tatṣāḍvidhyamāha– chinnamityādi| evaṃ chinnādibhedena āgantavaḥ ṣaḍvidhā bhavanti||1-2||

div.ab: tiryak chinna ṛjurvā'pi yo vraṇastvāyato bhavet | gātrasya pātanaṃ taddhi chinnamityabhidhīyate ||3|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: chinnalakṣaṇamāha– tiryagityādi| tiryagiti tiryagvyavasthitaḥ| chinnaḥ chedasampannaḥ| ṛjuravakraḥ| gātrasya pātanamiti gātrāvayavasya tadekadeśarūpasya vā gātrasya pātanam||3||

tatra chinnalakṣaṇamāha– tiryagityādi| yo vraṇastiryak chinno'thavā ṛjuśchinnaḥ sannāyato bhavet, tiryagiti tiryagvyavasthitaḥ, chinnaḥ chedasampannaḥ| ‘tiraścīnaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ, ṛjuravakraḥ, anayordvayorapyāyata iti viśeṣaṇam| ‘atra pātanaṃ nirdiśannāha-’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate| atra pātanaṃ nirdiśannāha– gātrasya pātanamiti gātrasyāvayavasya tadekadeśarūpasya vā gātrasya pātanam| ḍallanastu vyācaṣṭe– śastrādiprahāreṇa gātrasya hastādeḥ pātanaṃ, cakārādapātanaṃ ca||3||

div.ab: śaktidanteṣu khaḍgāgraviṣāṇairāśayo hataḥ | yatkiñcit prasravettaddhi bhinnalakṣaṇamucyate ||4|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: bhinnalakṣaṇamāha– śaktītyādi| viṣāṇaṃ dantaḥ śṛṅgaṃ ca| etadbhinnalakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ; tena vyadha evāśayadeśe bheda ucyate, āśayadeśarahite tu vyadhaḥ| yatkiñcidityādi| yasya mūtrarudhirāderya āśayo bhinnaḥ sa tat prasravet; tena bastirbhinno mūtraṃ, rudhirāśayo rudhiramityādi||4||

bhinnalakṣaṇamāha– śaktītyādi| śaktyādibhirāśayo hataḥ san yatkiñcit prasravet, tadbhinnalakṣaṇamucyate| kunto bhallaḥ, viṣāṇaṃ dantaḥ śṛṅgaṃ ca, etadbhinnalakṣaṇaṃ pāribhāṣikaṃ, tena vyadha evāśayadeśe bheda ucyate, āśayarahite tu deśe vyadhaḥ| yatkiñcit prasravediti kimapi nirdeṣṭavyamityarthaḥ| yasya mūtrarudhirāderyaścāśayo bhinnaḥ sa tat prasravet; tena bastirbhinno mūtraṃ, udaraṃ medaḥ, purīṣāśayaḥ purīṣaṃ, rudhirāśayo rudhiramiti||4||

div.ab: sthānānyāmāgnipakvānāṃ mūtrasya rudhirasya ca | hṛduṇḍukaḥ phupphusaśca koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate ||5|| tasmin bhinne raktapūrṇe jvaro dāhaśca jāyate | mūtramārgagudāsyebhyo raktaṃ ghrāṇācca gacchati ||6|| mūrchā śvāsastṛṣā''dhmānamabhaktacchanda eva ca | viṇmūtravātasaṅgaśca svedāsrāvo'kṣiraktatā ||7|| lohagandhitvamāsyasya gātradaurgandhyameva ca | hṛcchūlaṃ pārśvayoścāpi viśeṣaṃ cātra me śṛṇu ||8|| āmāśayasthe rudhire rudhiraṃ chardayatyapi | ādhmānamatimātraṃ ca śūlaṃ ca bhṛśadāruṇam ||9|| pakvāśayagate cāpi rujā gauravameva ca | adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītatā ca bhavediha ||10|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: yatra bhūyasā''māśayānāṃ sthāne bhedavyapadeśastamāha– sthānānītyādi| āmasya sthānamāmāśayaḥ agneḥ pacyamānāśayaḥ, ‘pakvasya’ iti pā.| malasya pakvāśayaḥ, mūtrasya bastiḥ, rudhirasya yakṛtplīhānau, hṛt hṛdayaṃ, uṇḍuka ikṣurasapākamalavadyaḥ śoṇitamalastajja uṇḍukaḥ, sa cāntradeśe vyavasthitaḥ purīṣādhānamiti, phupphusa iti hṛdayasya vāmapārśve raktādhāraḥ ‘phupphusa’ iti khyātaḥ| mūtramārgagudāsyebhyo raktaṃ ghrāṇācca gacchatīti bastyādau bhinne mehanagudābhyāṃ raktaṃ niḥsarati, āmāśayādibhede tu mukhaghrāṇābhyāṃ raktanirgamaḥ| svedāsrāva iti svedasyātyantasrutiḥ| pārśvayoścāpīti śūlamiti sambandhaḥ| me ityavyayaṃ matta ityarthaḥ| āmāśayastha ityādi ādhmānaṃ raktāvatatatvādvāyoḥ| rujā śūlam| gauravaṃ raktabahutvāt| adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītateti vyādhiprabhāvāt||5-10||

yatra bhūyasāmāśayānāṃ ‘sthānabhedavyapadeśastamāha’ iti pā.| sthāne bhedavyapadeśastamāha– sthānānītyādi| sthānaśabdaḥ āmādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate, āmasya sthānamāmāśayaḥ, agneḥ pacyamānāśayaḥ, pakvasya pakvāśayaḥ, mūtrasya bastiḥ, rudhirasya yakṛtplīhānau, hṛt hṛdayaṃ, uṇḍuka ikṣurasapākamalavacchoṇitamalaḥ, tajja uṇḍukaḥ, sa cāntradeśe vyavasthitaḥ purīṣādhānaṃ, phupphusa iti hṛdayasya vāmapārśve ‘phusphusa’ iti pā.| phupphusa iti khyātaḥ| āmādīnāṃ sthānāni koṣṭha ityabhidhīyate| bhinnakoṣṭhasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– tasminnityādi| tatra bastyādau bhinne mehanagudābhyāṃ raktaṃ niḥsarati, āmāśayādibhede tu mukhaghrāṇābhyāṃ raktanirgamaḥ, jvaramūrchādaya upadravā bhavanti, viṇmūtravātānāṃ saṅgo'pravṛtiḥ, svedāsrāvaḥ svedasyāsrutiḥ| mukhasya lohagandhatā, hṛtpārśvayoḥ śūlamiti sambandhaḥ| atrāpi me matto viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu| raktapūrṇabhedalakṣaṇamāha– āmāśayastha ityādi| atimātramādhmānaṃ ādhmātabastirivodarapūrṇatā, dāruṇaṃ māraṇātmakam| pakvāśayasthitasya raktasya lakṣaṇamāha– pakvetyādi| rujā śūlam| gauravamiti nābheradho boddhavyam| adhaḥkāye viśeṣeṇa śītateti vyādhiprabhāvāt||5-10||

div.ab: sūkṣmāsyaśalyābhihataṃ yadaṅgaṃ tvāśayaṃ vinā | uttuṇḍitaṃ nirgataṃ vā tadviddhamiti nirdiśet ||11|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: viddhalakṣaṇamāha– sūkṣmāsyaśalyetyādi| āśayaṃ vineti uktāmādyāśayaṃ vinā| uttuṇḍitamanirgataśalyopalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānuttuṇḍitamuttuṇḍitaṃ ca viddhaṃ gṛhyate| nirgatena ca nirgatamukhaṃ viddhaṃ sarvathā nirgataṃ ca gṛhyate; tena tantrāntare “viddhamuttuṇḍitamanuttuṇḍitaṃ bhinnaṃ nirbhinnam” iti ‘yaccatuḥprakāramabhihitaṃ’ iti pā.| yaccatuṣprakāramabhihitaṃ tat sarvaṃ saṅgṛhītam||11||

viddhalakṣaṇamāha– sūkṣmetyādi| āśayaṃ vinā sūkṣmāsyena śalyena yadaṅgamabhihatam uttuṇḍitaṃ unnamitatvaṅmāṃsam īṣaddṛṣṭamukhaṃ vā, nirgataṃ nirgataśalyam, uttuṇḍitamanirgataśalyopalakṣaṇam| tenānuttuṇḍitaṃ ca viddhaṃ gṛhyate, nirgatena ca vinirgatamukhaṃ viddhaṃ sarvadā nirgataṃ ca gṛhyate, tena tantrāntare viddhamuttuṇḍitamanuttuṇḍitaṃ bhinnaṃ nirbhinnamiti catuḥprakāramabhihitaṃ tatsaṅgṛhītam||11||

div.ab: nāticchinnaṃ nātibhinnamubhayorlakṣaṇānvitam | viṣamaṃ vraṇamaṅge yattat kṣataṃ tvabhidhīyate ||12|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: kṣatamāha– nāticchinnamityādi| ‘nāticchinnamiti’ iti pā.| nāticchinnaṃ nāvagāḍhacchedam| nātibhinnamiti nātividīrṇāśayam| ubhayorlakṣaṇānvitamiti stokacchedastokāvadaraṇayogādubhayalakṣaṇayuktam| viṣamaṃ vraṇamaṅge yaditi aṅgavaiṣamyakaraṃ vraṇaṃ yattat kṣatam||12||

kṣatalakṣaṇamāha– netyādi| nāticchinnamiti nāvagāḍhacchinnaṃ, nātibhinnamiti nātividīrṇāśayam| ubhayoriti chinnabhinnayorityarthaḥ| tena stokacchedastokāvadaraṇayogādubhayalakṣaṇayuktam| viṣamaṃ vraṇamaṅge iti aṅge vaiṣamyakaraṃ vraṇaṃ yattatkṣatamiti||12||

div.ab: prahārapīḍanābhyāṃ tu yadaṅgaṃ pṛthutāṃ gatam | sāsthi tat piccitaṃ vidyānmajjaraktapariplutam ||13|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: piccitalakṣaṇamāha– prahāretyādinā| prahāro mudgarādinā, pīḍanaṃ kapāṭādinā| pṛthutāmiti cippiṭatām| majjaraktapariplutamityanena vraṇabhāvāt majjaraktāgamaṃ darśayati| tena yat vraṇaṃ piccitaṃ, tadbhagnasya tathā sadyovraṇasya ca cikitsāviṣayam||13||

piccitalakṣaṇamāha– ‘prahāretyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate| prahāretyādi| prahāro mudgarādinā, pīḍanaṃ karādinā, pṛthutāṃ vipulatāṃ, sāsthi asthikhaṇḍānvitaṃ, majjaraktapariplutamityanena vraṇabhāvānmajjaraktāgamaṃ darśayati, tena yadvraṇaṃ piccitaṃ tadbhagnasya tathā sadyovraṇasya cikitsāviṣayam||13||

div.ab: gharṣaṇādabhighātādvā yadaṅgaṃ vigatatvacam | uṣāsrāvānvitaṃ tacca ghṛṣṭamityabhidhīyate ||14|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: ghṛṣṭalakṣaṇamāha– gharṣaṇādityādi| gharṣaṇāt karkaśavastrādinā| vigatatvacamiti pāṭhaṃ tyaktvā ‘vigatatvacā’ iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ, vigatatvacopalakṣitamaṅgam| uṣā ‘ūṣmānirgamavadvyathā’ iti pā.| ūṣmanirgamavadvyathā||14||

ghṛṣṭalakṣaṇamāha– gharṣaṇādityādi| yadaṅgaṃ gharṣaṇāt karṣaṇāt karkaśavastrādinā abhighātādvā vigatatvacaṃ bhavati, anye ‘vigatatvacā’ iti pāṭhaṃ paṭhanti, vigatatvacā lakṣitamaṅgam| uṣā ūṣmānirgamavadvyathā||14||

div.ab: śyāvaṃ saśothaṃ piḍakācitaṃ ca muhurmuhuḥ śoṇitavāhinaṃ ca | mṛdūdgataṃ budbudatulyamāṃsaṃ vraṇaṃ saśalyaṃ sarujaṃ vadanti ||15|| tvaco'tītya ‘śirādīni’ iti pā. sirādīni bhittvā vā parihṛtya vā | koṣṭhe pratiṣṭhitaṃ śalyaṃ kuryāduktānupadravān ||16|| (su. ci. a. 2) |

ab.seg: koṣṭhabhedamāha– tvaca ityādi| tvaca iti sapta tvacaḥ| ‘śirādīnīti’ iti pā.| sirādīnīti māṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni| parihṛtya veti parihārapakṣe'pi koṣṭhabhedasya saṅgatatvāt; ‘śirāvyadhaliṅgaṃ’ iti pā.| sirāvyadhaliṅgaṃ cātraiva ‘surendragopapratimaṃ’ ityādinā vyaktībhaviṣyati| uktāniti pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīye| tatra hyuktaṃ– “koṣṭhagate tvāṭopānāhau mūtrapurīṣāhāradarśanaṃ ca vraṇamukhādbhavati|” (su. sū. a. 26) iti||15-16||

saśalyavraṇalakṣaṇamāha– śyāvamityādi| śyāvaṃ śāvavarṇam| muhurvāraṃvāraṃ, śoṇitasrāvayuktaṃ, mṛdu komalaṃ, udgataṃ tumbyākārāvasthitabudbudena sadṛśaṃ māṃsaṃ yasya taṃ, sarujaṃ pīḍāyuktam| koṣṭhabhedamāha– tvaca ityādi| sapta tvacaḥ, sirādīni ‘śirāmāṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni’ iti pā.| sirāmāṃsasnāyvasthisandhīni bhittvā, parihṛtya veti santyajya vā| uktāniti pranaṣṭaśalyavijñānīye| tatra hyuktaṃ, “koṣṭhagate tvāṭopānāhau mūtrapurīṣāhāradarśanaṃ ca vraṇamukhādbhavati” iti||15-16||
tatrāntarlohitaṃ pāṇḍuśītapādakarānanam | śītocchvāsaṃ raktanetramānaddhaṃ ca vivarjayet ||17||
asādhyakoṣṭhabhedaliṅgamāha– tatretyādi| tatra koṣṭhe| antarlohitamiti abhyantarasthitaraktam, aniḥsṛtaraktamiti yāvat| ānaddhamityānāhavantam||17||
asādhyakoṣṭhāntarbhedaliṅgamāha– tatretyādi| koṣṭhe antarlohitam abhyantarasthitaraktam, aniḥsṛtaraktamiti| pāṇḍūni śītāni pādakarānanāni yasya taṃ, tathā| ānaddhaṃ ānāhayuktam||17||

div.ab: bhramaḥ pralāpaḥ patanaṃ pramoho viceṣṭanaṃ glānirathoṣṇatā ca | srastāṅgatā mūrchanamūrdhvavātastīvrā rujā vātakṛtāśca tāstāḥ ||18|| māṃsodakābhaṃ rudhiraṃ ca gacchet sarvendriyārthoparamastathaiva | daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣvatha vikṣateṣu sāmānyato marmasu liṅgamuktam ||19|| (su. sū. a. 25) |

ab.seg: māṃsasirāsnāyvasthisandhimarmasu pañcasu kṣateṣu sāmānyaliṅgamāha– bhrama ityādi| viceṣṭanaṃ viruddhaceṣṭanaṃ karacaraṇādikṣepādikam| glānirbalakṣayaḥ| srastāṅgatā aṅgasandhivisraṃsavadvyathā| mūrchanamindriyamohaḥ| indriyārthoparama indriyāṇāṃ svaviṣayeṣu rūpādiṣu uparamo grahaṇāśaktiḥ| daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣu pañcasu||18-19||

māṃsasandhisirāsnāyvasthimarmasu pañcasu kṣateṣu sāmānyaliṅgamāha– bhrama ityādi| bhramaścakrārūḍhasyeva, patanaṃ bhūmau, pramohaḥ manomohaḥ, viceṣṭanaṃ viruddhaceṣṭanaṃ caraṇakṣepaṇādikaṃ, glāniḥ balakṣayaḥ, srastāṅgatā aṅgasandhivisraṃsavadvyathā, śarīraśaithilyaṃ vā, mūrchanamindriyasammohaḥ, pramohastu manomohaḥ, ūrdhvavāta iti udgārabāhulyaṃ, vātakṛtā rujastāstā daṇḍāpatānakākṣepakādyāḥ| sarvendriyārthoparamaḥ svaviṣayeṣu rūpādiṣu uparamo grahaṇe'śaktiḥ, daśārdhasaṅkhyeṣu pañcasu||18-19||

div.ab: surendragopapratimaṃ prabhūtaṃ raktaṃ ‘sravettatkṣatajaśca’ iti pā. sravettatkṣayajaśca vāyuḥ | karoti rogān vividhān ‘yathoktāñchirāsu’ iti pā. yathoktān sirāsu viddhāsvatha vā kṣatāsu ||20|| kaubjyaṃ śarīrāvayavāvasādaḥ kriyāsvaśaktistumulā rujaśca | cirādvraṇo rohati yasya cāpi taṃ snāyuviddhaṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasyet ||21|| ‘śoṣābhivṛddhistumulā’ iti pā. śophābhivṛddhistumulā rujaśca balakṣayaḥ sarvata eva śothaḥ | kṣateṣu sandhiṣvacalācaleṣu syāt sarvakarmoparamaśca liṅgam ||22|| ghorā rujo yasya niśādineṣu sarvāsvavasthāsu ca naiti śāntim | bhiṣagvipaścidviditārthasūtrastamasthividdhaṃ puruṣaṃ vyavasyet ||23|| (su. sū. a. 25) | ‘śirādayo’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: sirādayo marmarūpā amarmarūpāśca santi, tatra pūrvaṃ marmarahitānāṃ ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| sirādīnāṃ viddhaliṅgamāha– surendragopetyādi| yathoktāniti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktān| tatra coktaṃ– “tadatipravṛttaṃ śirobhitāpamāndhyamākṣepādīṃśca karoti|” iti| viddhāsu bāṇādinā| kṣatāsu khaḍgādinā| kaubjyaṃ kubjatā| tumulā gahanāḥ| sandhiṣvacalācaleṣviti acaleṣu niśceṣṭeṣu, ‘ācaleṣu’ iti pā.| caleṣu ceṣṭāvatsu; sandhayaścalācalabhedena dvividhāḥ| tathāca suśrutaḥ– “śākhāsu hanvoḥ kaṭyāṃ ca ceṣṭāvantaśca sandhayaḥ| śeṣāstu sandhayaḥ sarve vijñātavyāḥ sthirā budhaiḥ||” (su. śā. a. 5) iti||20-23||

sirādayo marmarūpā amarmarūpāśca santi, tatra ‘marmarahitaśirādividdhaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.| marmarahitasirādividdhaliṅgamāha– surendretyādi| indragopo vārṣikaḥ kīṭaḥ, ‘tatkṣatajaḥ’ iti pā.| tatkṣayajaḥ tasya rudhirasya kṣayājjāto vāyuḥ, yathoktāniti śoṇitavarṇanīyoktān, tathā coktam– “tadatipravṛttaṃ śirobhitāpamāndhyamākṣepakādīṃśca karoti” iti| viddhāsu bāṇādinā, kṣatāsu khaḍgādinā| snāyuviddhamāha– kaubjyamityādi| yasya kaubjyādicihnaṃ bhavati, taṃ puruṣaṃ snāyuviddhaṃ vyavasyet jānīyāt| kaubjyaṃ kubjatā, tacca antarbahirāyāmajaṃ dvidhā, avayavāvasādaḥ avayavānāṃ svakarmaṇyasāmarthyaṃ, kriyāsvaśaktiḥ sarvaśarīrasyotkṣepaṇāpakṣepaṇaprasāraṇākuñcanakriyāṇāmaśaktiḥ| tumulā gahanāḥ, anye tu vātapittakaphajanitā ekatra vyākulībhūtavedanāstumulā ucyante iti vadanti| sandhividdhamāha– śophetyādi| acalācaleṣu sandhiṣu kṣateṣu satsu śophātivṛddhyādiliṅgaṃ syāt| sandhayastu calācalabhedāt dvividhāḥ| tathā coktaṃ suśrute– “śākhāsu hanvoḥ kaṭyāṃ ca ceṣṭāvantaśca sandhayaḥ| śeṣāstu sandhayaḥ sarve vijñātavyāḥ sthirā budhaiḥ” iti| karmoparamaḥ karmoparatiḥ| asthividdhamāha– ghorā ityādi| tamasthividdhaṃ jānīyāt, sarvāsvavasthāsu ‘upaśayanāsanādikāsu’ iti pā.| śayanāsanādikāsu, viditārthasūtraḥ adhigataśalyatantraḥ||20-23||

div.ab: yathāsvametāni vibhāvayecca liṅgāni marmasvabhitāḍiteṣu |24| (su. sū. a. 25) |

marmarahitānāṃ ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| sirādīnāṃ viddhalakṣaṇamabhidhāya ‘śirādimarmaviddhaliṅgamatideśayannāha’ iti pā.| sirādimarmaviddhaliṅgamatideśayannāha– yathāsvametānītyādi| vibhāvayecceti cakāro bhinnakrame; tena etāni liṅgāni tathā sāmānyaliṅgāni ca jānīyādityarthaḥ|24|–

marmarahitānāṃ ‘śirādīnāṃ’ iti pā.| sirādīnāṃ viddhaliṅgamabhidhāya ‘śirādimarmaliṅgamatideśenāha’ iti pā.| sirādimarmaviddhaliṅgamatideśenāha– yathāsvamityādi| vibhāvayecceti cakāro'tra bhinnakrame, tenaitāni ‘marmaviddhaśirāliṅgāni’ iti pā.| marmaviddhasirāliṅgāni tathā sāmānyaliṅgāni bhramapralāpādīni pūrvoktāni ca yathāsvaṃ jānīyādityarthaḥ|24|–
pāṇḍurvivarṇaḥ spṛśitaṃ na vetti yo māṃsamarmaṇyabhipīḍitaḥ syāt ||24|| (su. sū. a. 25) |

ab.seg: anuktamāṃsamarmaṇo viddhasya liṅgamāha– pāṇḍurvivarṇa ityādi| nanu, ‘śirādividdhaliṅgavat’ iti pā.| sirādividdhaliṅgavat māṃsaviddhaliṅgamapi pūrvaṃ kuto nopadiṣṭam? ucyate– kevalamāṃsaviddhasyābahuvyāpatkaratvāt pūrvamanupādānam||24||

māṃsamarmaviddhaliṅgamāha– pāṇḍurityādi| vivarṇo vicchāyaḥ| nanu, ‘śirādividdhaliṅgavanmāṃsaviddhaliṅgamapi’ iti pā.| sirādividdhaliṅgavanmāṃsaviddhaliṅgamapi pūrvaṃ kuto nopadiṣṭaṃ? ucyate– kevalamāṃsaviddhasyābahuvyāpatkaratvāt pūrvamanupādānam||24||

div.ab: visarpaḥ pakṣaghātaśca ‘śirāstambho'patānakaḥ’ iti pā. sirāstambho'patānakaḥ | mohonmādavraṇarujo jvarastṛṣṇā hanugrahaḥ ||25|| kāsaśchardiratīsāro hikkā śvāsaḥ savepathuḥ | ṣoḍaśopadravāḥ proktā vraṇānāṃ vraṇacintakaiḥ ||26|| (ca. ci. a. 25) |

ab.seg: sarvavraṇānāmupadravānāha– visarpa ityādi||25-26||
sarvavraṇānāmupadravānāha– visarpa ityādi| vraṇarujo vraṇapīḍāḥ, vepathuḥ kampaḥ||25-26||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne sadyovraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||43||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ sadyovraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||43||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ sadyovraṇanidānam||43||

div.head: bhagnanidānam

ab.seg: atha bhagnanidānam | bhagnaṃ samāsāddvividhaṃ hutāśa kāṇḍe ca sandhau ca hi tatra sandhau | utpiṣṭaviśliṣṭavivartitaṃ ca tiryaggataṃ kṣiptamadhaśca ‘ṣoḍhā’ iti pā. | ṣaṭ ca ||1||

āgantusāmānyāt bhagnanidānam| dvividhaṃ hi bhagnaṃ savraṇamavraṇaṃ ca, tatra savraṇamabhidhāyāvraṇamāha– bhagnaṃ samāsādityādi| hutāśa iti agniveśasambodhanaṃ, sampratyupalabhyamāne carakatantre bhagnanidānaṃ na paṭhyate| carake hutāśaśabdenāgniveśo'bhidhīyate, ekadeśenāpi samudāyapratīteḥ| kāṇḍe ca sandhau ceti sandhivicchinnamekaṃ, ‘dvitīyaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ;’ iti pā. kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dvitīyaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ; kāṇḍamasthikāṇḍaḥ, kāṇḍena ca nalakakapālavalayataruṇarucakānāṃ ‘grahaṇam’ iti pā.| grahaḥ, tatra bhagnaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ; dvayorasthnoḥ, sandhānaṃ sandhiḥ, tadviśleṣaḥ sandhimuktam| tatra sandhāviti sandhau mukte ‘liṅgamabhidhīyate’ iti śeṣaḥ| nanu kathaṃ sandhimuktaṃ bhagnamucyate? asthnāṃ hi bhaṅgo yuktaḥ| ucyate– asthiviśleṣo'tra bhagno'bhipretaḥ, sa ca kāṇḍabhagne sandhimukte cāstīti na doṣaḥ||1||

āgantutvasāmānyādbhagnamāha– bhagnamityādi| taṃ cāgantuvraṇaṃ samāsāt dvividhamāhuḥ, kathamityāha– kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ tathā sandhau ceti; sandhivicchinnamekaṃ, kāṇḍamasthikāṇḍaḥ, kāṇḍena ca nalakakapālavalayataruṇarucakānāṃ grahaṇaṃ, tatra bhagnaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnam| dvayorasthnoḥ sandhānaṃ sandhiḥ, tadviśleṣaḥ sandhimuktam| sandhimuktasya ṣāḍvidhyamāha– utpiṣṭetyādi| tatra sandhāviti tatra tayoḥ kāṇḍabhagnasandhibhagnayormadhye, sandhau mukte'pi ‘liṅgamabhidhīyata’ iti śeṣaḥ| utpiṣṭādibhedena ṣoḍhā bhavati| nanu, kathaṃ sandhimuktaṃ bhagnamucyate? asthnāṃ bhaṅgo yuktaḥ; ucyate asthiviśleṣo'tra bhagno'bhipretaḥ, sa ca kāṇḍabhagne sandhimukte cāstīti na doṣaḥ||1||

div.ab: prasāraṇākuñcanavartanogrā ruk sparśavidveṣaṇametaduktam | sāmānyataḥ sandhigatasya liṅgam... |2|
sandhibhagnasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– prasāraṇetyādi| prasāraṇākuñcanavartanogrā rugiti prasāraṇādiṣu ugrā ruk| vartanaṃ niṣkriyatayā'vasthānam|1|–
tatra sandhimuktasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– prasāraṇetyādi| prasāraṇādiṣu ugrā ruk vyathā, vartanamiti niṣkriyatayā'vasthānam| etatsāmānyaliṅgam|1|–

...utpiṣṭasandheḥ śvayathuḥ samantāt ||2|| viśeṣato rātribhavā rujā ca, viśliṣṭaje tau ca rujā ca nityam | vivartite pārśvarujaśca tīvrāstiryaggate tīvrarujo bhavanti ||3|| kṣipte'tiśūlaṃ ‘viṣamā rugasthnoḥ’ iti pā. | viṣamatvamasthnoḥ kṣipte tvadho rugvighaṭaśca sandheḥ |

utpiṣṭādiliṅgamāha– utpiṣṭasandherityādi| utpiṣṭaṃ dvābhyāmasthibhyāṃ sandhau gharṣaṇam| śvayathuḥ samantāditi ubhayabhāge śothaḥ, ubhayataḥ sandhyasthnorgharṣitatvāt| viśeṣato rātribhavā rujā ceti abhighātakupita eva rātrau śaityenātyantaṃ vṛddho vāyuḥ rujāṃ karoti| ‘rātrighūrṇitatvena’ iti pā.| atra cūrṇitatvena mārgāvaraṇāt vātakopa ityarthaḥ| viśliṣṭaje iti viśliṣṭajāte sandhimukte, viśliṣṭaṃ manāk sandhiviśleṣaḥ śithilatāmātraṃ, viśliṣṭamiti bhāve ktaḥ| tau ceti viśliṣṭe rātrirujāsamantācchothau; samantācchotho'pyatrālpo bodhyaḥ, sandheranabhighātāt| sandhivikriyayā asthnorapasṛtatvāt madhyanimnatvaṃ, “utpiṣṭamatha viśliṣṭaṃ sandhiṃ vaidyo ‘vighaṭṭayet’ iti pā.| na ghaṭṭayet|” (su. ci. a. 2) iti vacanāt; manāgvikriyayā vā| rujā ca nityamiti sarvadā rujā balavatī bhavatītyutpiṣṭādviśeṣaḥ| vivartite iti ‘sandhau’ iti śeṣaḥ, vivartite viparītaṃ vartite; vivartanaṃ sandhau ‘ ... rvibhramaṇamārjavatā’ iti pā.| dvayorasthnorvivṛtirvibhramaṇamanārjavatā| pārśvarujaśca tīvrā iti ‘atyaktasandhisthānayoḥ’ iti pā.| ābhyantarasandhisthānayoḥ pārśvasandhyasthnoḥ ‘pārśvagatatvāttīvrāḥ’ iti pā.| pārśvagamanāttīvrāḥ pārśvarujaḥ| tiryaggata iti tiryakkṣipte| atra hyekaṃ sandhyasthi sandhisthānaṃ tyaktvā tiryagyāti| kṣipte'tīti atikṣipte; ‘ūrdhvam’ iti śeṣaḥ| atra hyekāsthivikriyayā ubhayāsthivikriyayā vā dvayorapyasthnoḥ parasparātikramaṇaṃ dūragamanaṃ vā; viśliṣṭe tu manāk śithilatāmātram; adhaḥkṣipte tu kiñcidadhogamanamiti viśeṣaḥ| “viṣamāśca sakthnoḥ” iti pāṭhe tu ‘ruja’ iti śeṣaḥ| kṣipte tvadhorugvighaṭaśca sandheriti adhaḥkṣipte ruk rujā, sandhervighaṭaśca vighaṭanam| ‘viruddhaceṣṭā vighaṭasya’ iti pāṭhāntare vighaṭitasya sandherityarthaḥ| atra adho'sthigamanam| adhaḥ kṣiptavadūrdhvaṃ kṣiptasyāpyabhidhāne prāpte anuktiratikṣipte'varodhāt||2-3||–

viśiṣṭaliṅgamāha– utpiṣṭasandherityādi| utpiṣṭaṃ dvābhyāmasthibhyāṃ sandhau gharṣaṇaṃ, śvayathuḥ samantāditi ubhayabhāge śophaḥ, ubhayataḥ ‘sandhyasthnorgharṣaṇatvāt|’ iti pā.| sandhyasthnorgharṣaṇāt| viśeṣata ityādyabhighātakupita eva rātrau śaityenātyantaṃ vṛddho vāyuḥ rujaṃ karoti, atra cūrṇitatvena mārgāvaraṇādvātaprakopa ityarthaḥ| viśliṣṭamāha– viśliṣṭaja ityādi| viśliṣṭe sandhimukte tau ca nityaṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca rujā ca bhavati| viśliṣṭaṃ manāksandhiviśleṣaḥ, śithilatāmātraṃ; viśliṣṭamiti bhāve ktaḥ| tenālpaḥ śopho boddhavyaḥ| tau ceti ‘viśliṣṭarātrirujāsamantācchothau’ iti pā.| rātrirujāsamantācchothau, samantācchotho'pyatrālpo bodhyaḥ, sandheranabhighātāt| sandhivikriyayā asthnorapasṛtatvānmadhyanimnatvam| “utpiṣṭamatha viśliṣṭaṃ sandhimuktaṃ tathā cyutam| ‘saghanam’ iti pā.| jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ca bhagnaṃ yattadvivarjayet||” iti| manāk vikriyayā vā| rujā ca nityamiti sarvadā rujā balavatī bhavatītyutpiṣṭādviśeṣaḥ| vivartitamiti, sandhāviti śeṣaḥ| vivartite viparītaṃ vartite, vivartanaṃ sandhau dvayorasthnorvivṛtirvibhramaṇamanārjavatā| pārśve rujāśca tīvrāḥ santi, atyantasandhisthānayoḥ pārśvasandhyasthnoḥ pārśvagatatvāttīvrāḥ pārśvarujaḥ, cakārāt sandhisaṃśrayayorapyasthnorvyāvartanena pārśvopagamanādviṣamāṅgateti ḍallaṇaḥ| tiryagityādi– tiryak kṣipte, sandhāviti śeṣaḥ| atra hyekasandhyasthi sandhisthānaṃ tyaktvā tiryagyāti| atikṣiptamāha– kṣipta ityādi| kṣipte ūrdhvamiti śeṣaḥ| atra tu dvayorapi ‘śakthnoḥ’ iti pā.| asthnoḥ parasparātikramaṇaṃ, dūragamanaṃ vā, viśliṣṭe tu manāk śithilatāmātramiti bhedaḥ| adhaḥkṣipte tu kiñcidadhogamanamiti viśeṣaḥ| ayaṃ paṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sakthnorūrukaṭisandhyorviṣamamiti| ‘śūlaviṣamamiti’ iti pā.| śūlaṃ viṣamamiti kadāciddhīnaṃ kadācidvivṛddham| ‘viṣamāśca sakthnoḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram| atra ‘tatra’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| tatra rujā iti śeṣaḥ| adhaḥkṣiptamāha– kṣipte tvityādi| adhaḥkṣipte'dhogate sandhau ruk rujā, sandhervighaṭaśca, vighaṭo vighaṭanam| ‘viruddhaceṣṭā vighaṭasya’ iti pāṭhāntare vighaṭitasya sandherityarthaḥ| atrādho'sthigamanam| adhaḥkṣiptavadūrdhvakṣiptasyāpyabhidhāne ‘prāpte'nuktamapi ūrdhvakṣiptābhidhānam’ iti pā.| prāpte'nuktiratikṣipte'varodhāt||2-3||–

ab.seg: kāṇḍe tvataḥ karkaṭakāśvakarṇavicūrṇitaṃ piccitamasthichallikā ||4||
kāṇḍeṣu bhagnaṃ hyatipātitaṃ ca majjāgataṃ ca sphuṭitaṃ ca vakram | chinnaṃ dvidhā dvādaśadhā'pi kāṇḍe srastāṅgatā śotharujātivṛddhiḥ ||5||
sampīḍyamāne bhavatīha śabdaḥ sparśāsahaṃ spandanatodaśūlāḥ | sarvāsvavasthāsu na śarmalābho bhagnasya kāṇḍe khalu cihnametat ||6||

ataḥ paraṃ kāṇḍe bhagnamabhidhīyate– kāṇḍe tvata ityādi| kāṇḍe ityatra bhagnamiti śeṣaḥ| ata iti ataḥ param| karkaṭaketi ubhayoḥ pārśvayornipīḍanenāvanatam, ata eva madhye granthirivonnataṃ karkaṭatulyatvāt karkaṭakam| aśvakarṇeti aśvakarṇavat vipulāsthinirgamādaśvakarṇam| vicūrṇitamiti kṣuṇṇamasthi, tacca śabdasparśābhyāmavagantavyam| piccitamiti yantritaṃ bahuśotham| asthichalliketi challaṃ valkalaṃ tadatrāstīti asthichallikā, atra ‘matvarthīyaṣṭikaṇ’ iti pā.| matvarthīyaṣṭhikan| atra tu ā na bhavati, vṛddheranityatvāt| eṣā ‘pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśleṣādbhavati’ iti pā.| pārśvagatastokāsthiviśleṣādbhavati| ‘asthichallitam’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ, challamasya ‘jātam’ iti pā.| sañjātamiti challitam| kāṇḍeṣu bhagnamityanena kāṇḍabhagnamabhidhīyate, prasāraṇe kampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam| yadyapi ‘kāṇḍabhagnam’ iti pā.| kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ sarvameva karkaṭādi, tathā'pi viśiṣṭe kāṇḍabhagne kāṇḍabhagnasañjñeyaṃ boddhavyā| yathā– jāṅgalaśabdo ‘bileśayādau’ iti pā. ‘jāṅgalādyaṣṭavidhamāṃsavarge’ iti vā pā.| jaṅghālādyaṣṭavidhamāṃsavarge ‘sāmānye'pi ṣaḍvidhamāṃsavarge bileśayādau, punareṇādāveva viśeṣe ca vartate|’ iti pā.| sāmānye, viśeṣe punareṇādāveva ca vartate| atipātitamiti ‘asthiniḥśeṣitacchinna ... ’ iti pā.| asthiniḥśeṣataśchinnamatipātitam| majjāgatamiti asthyavayavo'sthimadhyamanupraviśya majjānaṃ niḥsārayatīti majjāgatam| sphuṭitaṃ stokaṃ ‘bahudhā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bahudhā vidīrṇaṃ śūkapūrṇamiva vedanāvat| vakramiti avimuktāsthi kubjībhūtaṃ vakram| vakratā'pi bhagnatvaṃ jñeyam| chinnaṃ dvidheti ekamaṇuvidīrṇaṃ, bahuvidīrṇamanyat; ‘ekatarapārśvalagnamekam’ iti pā.| ekaṃ vidīrṇaṃ, saṃlagnamaparaṃ vidīrṇaṃ dvidhābhūtam; anyastu vipulaikavidaraṇamityāha; suśrute etat pāṭitasañjñam| kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśavidhatvaṃ niyamayati– kāṇḍa iti| atra bhagnamiti śeṣaḥ| apiśabdo'tra bhinnakramaḥ, sa cāvadhāraṇārthaṃ, tena chinnamityatra sambadhyate| chinnameva dvidhā, na karkaṭādi||4-6||

div.ab: ataḥ paraṃ kāṇḍe bhagnamāha– kāṇḍe tvityādi| chinnaṃ dvidhā kāṇḍe ityatra bhagnam iti śeṣaḥ| ata iti ataḥ param| karkaṭaketi ubhayoḥ pārśvayoḥ nipīḍanenāvanatam, ata eva madhye granthirivonnataṃ karkaṭatulyatvātkarkaṭakam| aśvakarṇeti aśvakarṇavadvipulāsthinirgamādaśvakarṇam| vicūrṇitamiti kṣuṇṇamasthi, tacca śabdasparśābhyāmavagantavyam| piccitamiti yantritaṃ bahuśotham| asthicchalliketi– challaṃ valkalaṃ, tadatrāstīti asthicchallikā, eṣā ‘pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśeṣādbhavati’ iti pā.| pārśvagatastokāsthyavayavaviśleṣādbhavati| “asthicchallitam” iti vā pāṭhaḥ| challamasya jātaṃ challitam| kāṇḍeṣu bhagnamityādi| anena kāṇḍabhagnamityabhidhīyate| prasāraṇe kampamānaṃ kāṇḍabhagnam| yadyapi kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ sarvameva karkaṭakādi, tathā'pi viśiṣṭe kāṇḍe bhagne sañjñeyaṃ boddhavyā| atipātitamiti ‘asthiniḥśeṣitacchinnamatipātitam’ iti pā.| asthi niḥśeṣataśchinnamatipātitam| majjāgatamiti asthyavayavo'sthimadhyamanupraviśya majjānaṃ niḥsārayatīti majjāgatam| ‘sphuṭitastokam’ iti pā.| sphuṭitaṃ stokaṃ bahudhā vidīrṇaṃ śūkapūrṇamiva vedanāvat| vakramiti avimuktāsthi ‘kubjībhūtavakram’ iti pā.| kubjībhūtaṃ vakraṃ, vakratā'pi bhagnatvaṃ jñeyam| chinnaṃ dvidheti ekamaṇuvidīrṇaṃ, bahuvidīrṇamanyat| kaścidekatarapārśvalagnamaparatra vidīrṇamityāha, ‘anyacca’ iti pā.| anyaśca vipulaikavidaraṇam, etacca suśrute pāṭitasañjñam| kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśavidhatvaṃ niyamayati– dvādaśadhā'pi kāṇḍa iti kāṇḍe; ityatra bhagnamiti śeṣaḥ| apiśabdo'tra bhinnakramaḥ, sa cāvadhāraṇārthaḥ, tena chinnamityatra sambadhyate, chinnameva dvidhā na karkaṭakādi| sāmānyena kāṇḍabhagnalakṣaṇamāha– srastāṅgatetyādi| ‘kāṇḍabhagnasya etaccihnam’ iti pā.| kāṇḍe bhagnasyaitaccihnaṃ srastāṅgatā śopharujayorativṛddhiḥ| sampīḍyamāne hastādinā mṛdite sati śabdaḥ, sparśāsahaśca, tathā spandanatodaśūlā bhavanti| sarvāsu śayanāsanādikāsvavasthāsu śarmalābho na bhavati||4-6||–

ab.seg: bhagnaṃ tu kāṇḍe bahudhā prayāti samāsato nāmabhireva tulyam ||7||
kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśaprakārādapyadhikatvamāha– bhagnamityādi| samāsato nāmabhireva tulyamiti saṅkṣepato nāmānurūpametadavagantavyamityarthaḥ||7||
kāṇḍe bhagnasya dvādaśaprakārādapyadhikatvamāha– bhagnamityādi| saṅkṣepato nāmānurūpametadevāvagantavyaṃ, yasyedṛśāsthi bhagnaṃ tasyaiva nāmetyarthaḥ||7||

div.ab: alpāśino'nātmavato jantorvātātmakasya ca | upadravairvā juṣṭasya bhagnaṃ kṛcchreṇa sidhyati ||8|| (su. ci. a. 3) |

ab.seg: kaṣṭasādhyatāmāha– alpetyādi| vātātmakasyeti vātaprakṛteḥ| upadravairiti upadravā jvarādhmānamūtrapurīṣasaṅgādayaḥ||8||
bhagnasya kṛcchrasādhyatvamāha– alpāśina iti| āhārarahitasya, anātmavato'pathyāśinaḥ, vātātmakasya vātaprakṛteḥ| upadravairityādi upadravā jvaramohamūtrapurīṣasaṅgādayaḥ||8||

div.ab: bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāṃ tu sandhimuktaṃ tathā cyutam | jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ca varjayeddhi vicakṣaṇaḥ ||9|| asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat | bhagnaṃ stanāntare pṛṣṭhe śaṅkhe mūrdhni ca varjayet ||10|| (su. ni. a. 15) |

ab.seg: asādhyatāmāha– bhinnaṃ kapālamityādi| bhagnamiti vācye bhinnamiti yat kṛtaṃ, tat kapālānāṃ prāyaśo bhedāt| ata evoktam– “kapālāni vibhajyante” (su. śā. a. 5) iti| nanu, kaṭyasthnaḥ kapālasañjñāyā abhāvāt kathamucyate bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāmiti? ‘yaduktam’ iti pā.| taduktaṃ suśrute– “jānunitambāṃsagaṇḍatāluśaṅkhavaṅkṣaṇaśiraḥsu kapālāni|” (su. śā. a. 5) iti; ucyate– nitambagrahaṇena tatra kaṭīgrahaṇādadoṣaḥ; athavā sarvaṃ kapālasañjñitam asthibhinnaṃ, tathā kaṭyāṃ cāsthibhinnaṃ varjayet| asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ceti tu niyamārthaṃ; tena lalāṭe kapālasyāsaṃśliṣṭasyāsādhyatvaṃ, nānyathā bhinnasyeti| bhinnaṃ kapālamiti kāṇḍabhagnametat| sandhimuktamiti nānāvidhamapi sandhimuktaṃ kaṭyāṃ na sidhyatīti| cyutamiti adhaḥkṣiptam, anyastu viśliṣṭamāha; athavā kaṭyāṃ sandhimuktaṃ cyutalakṣaṇaṃ na sarvam| jaghanaṃ pratipiṣṭaṃ ceti jaghanasthāne piṣṭamutpiṣṭametattathā cyutamiti ca| sandhimuktaṃ punarviśeṣārthamuktaṃ, viśeṣābhidhānādanyasya kaṭīsandhimuktasya kadācit sādhyatā sūcyate, ata eva cikitsite “tataḥ sthānasthite sandhau” (su. ci. a. 3) iti vakṣyati| asaṃśliṣṭakapālaṃ ca lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yaditi yathā avidyamānasaṃśleṣaṃ yat kapālaṃ, tathā lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ ca yat vighaṭitasandhi tadasādhyam| bhagnamiti sāmānyena sandhimuktaṃ kāṇḍabhagnaṃ ca gṛhyate| anye tu bhagnamityanena kāṇḍabhagnaviśeṣaṃ ‘prasāraṇe kampamānam’ ityanenoktaṃ vadanti| uktaṃ ca bhālukinā– “śaṅkhe mūrdhni stanāntare vā kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ maraṇāya|” iti| stanāntare urasi, mūrdhni cūḍāsthāne||9-10||

asādhyatāmāha– bhinnamityādi| bhagnamiti vācye bhinnamiti yatkṛtaṃ, tatkapālānāṃ prāyaśo bhedāt| yaduktamihaiva– ‘kapālāni vibhidyante’ ityādi| nanu, ‘kaṭyasthikapālasañjñāyā’ iti pā.| kaṭyasthnaḥ kapālasañjñāyā abhāvāt kathamucyate bhinnaṃ kapālaṃ kaṭyāmiti? yaduktaṃ suśrute– “jānunitambāṃsagaṇḍatāluśaṅkhavaṅkṣaṇaśirassu kapālāni” iti| ucyate– nitambagrahaṇena tatra kaṭīgrahaṇādadoṣaḥ, athavā sarvaṃ kapālasañjñitamasthibhinnaṃ, chedāttathā kaṭyāṃ cāsthibhinnaṃ ca varjayet| sandhimuktamityādi nānāvidhamapi sandhimuktaṃ kaṭyāṃ na siddhyati| tathā kaṭyāṃ cyutamiti adhaḥkṣiptaṃ, sañjñeyam| piṣṭamutpiṣṭamasañjñaṃ ca, jaghanaṃ ‘prati’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prati lakṣīkṛtaṃ na siddhyati| punarvarjyaṃ bhagnamāha– asaṃśliṣṭamityādi| yathā tathā avidyamānasaṃśleṣaṃ yat kapālaṃ tathā lalāṭe cūrṇitaṃ yat vighaṭitasandhi tadasādhyam| bhagnamiti sāmānyena sandhimuktaṃ kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ ca gṛhyate, anye tu bhagnamiti kāṇḍe bhagnamāhuḥ| yaduktaṃ bhālukinā– “śaṅkhe mūrdhni stanāntare vā kāṇḍe bhagnaṃ maraṇāya|” iti| ‘adhastanāntare’ iti pā.| stanāntare urasi, stanagrahaṇena stanāntaraṃ boddhavyam||9-10||

div.ab: samyak sandhitamapyasthi durnikṣepanibandhanāt | saṅkṣobhādvā'pi yadgacchedvikriyāṃ tacca varjayet ||11|| (su. ni. a. 15) |

ab.seg: sarveṣāmanavadhānato'sādhyatvamāha– samyagityādi| sandhitaṃ saṃyamitam| durnikṣepanibandhanāditi duḥsthāpanāttathā duṣṭabandhanāt| saṅkṣobhādveti abhighātabhayādisaṅkṣobhāt| ayamarthaḥ– samyaksaṃyamitamapi duḥsthāpanāt, sunyastamapi duṣṭabandhanāt, sunyastaṃ ‘subandhamapi’ iti pā.| subaddhamapi saṅkṣobhādvikṛtamasādhyam||11||

sarveṣāmanavadhānato'sādhyatvamāha– samyagityādi| durnikṣepanibandhanāt duḥsthāpanāt ‘tathā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā duṣṭabandhanāt| saṅkṣobhādveti abhighātabhayādisaṅkṣobhāt| ayamarthaḥ– samyaksaṃyamitamapi duṣṭabandhanāttathā sunyastaṃ subaddhamapi saṅkṣobhāt vikṛtamasādhyam||11||

div.ab: taruṇāsthīni namyante bhidyante nalakāni ca | kapālāni vibhajyante sphuṭanti rucakāni ca ||12|| (su. ni. a. 15) |

ab.seg: asthiviśeṣeṇa bhagnaviśeṣamāha– taruṇāsthīnītyādi| namyante vakrībhavanti, tenātra vakralakṣaṇaṃ bhagnam| ghrāṇakarṇākṣipuṭeṣu taruṇaṃ komalamasthi| bhidyante nalakāni ceti asthyantarānupraveśādbhidyante, atipātitalakṣaṇena ca bhagnena nalakāni yujyante; anye tu dvādaśavidhamapi bhagnamatrecchanti| kapālāni vibhajyanta iti kapāleṣu vidaraṇalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| ‘vibhidyante’ iti pāṭhāntaram, arthastu sa eva| rucakāni dantāḥ, teṣu sphuṭitalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| asthīni pañcavidhāni taruṇanalakakapālavalayarucakabhedāt| rucakāni ceti cakārāt valayānyapi sphuṭitāni bhavantīti| etat suśrute sphuṭitaṃ bhagnam||12||

asthiviśeṣeṇa bhagnaviśeṣamāha– taruṇetyādi| ghrāṇakarṇākṣikūṭeṣu taruṇāsthīni komalāsthīni, namyante vakrībhavanti| atra vakralakṣaṇaṃ bhagnam| bhidyante nalakānītyādi| asthyantarānupraveśādbhidyante, atipātitalakṣaṇena ca bhagnena nalakāni yujyante| anye tu dvādaśavidhamapi bhagnamātramicchanti| kapāleṣu vidaraṇalakṣaṇo bhagnaḥ| rucakāni dantāḥ, teṣu sphuṭitalakṣaṇo bhaṅgaḥ| asthīni pañcavidhāni, taruṇanalakakapālavalayarucakabhedāt| cakārād valayānyapi sphuṭantīti jñeyam| etacca suśrute sphuṭitaṃ bhagnam||12||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne bhagnanidānaṃ samāptam ||44||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ bhagnanidānaṃ samāptam||44||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ bhagnanidānam||44||

div.head: nāḍīvraṇanidānam
div.ab: atha nāḍīvraṇanidānam | yaḥ śothamāmamatipakvamupekṣate'jño yo vā vraṇaṃ pracurapūyamasādhuvṛttaḥ | abhyantaraṃ praviśati pravidārya tasya sthānāni pūrvavihitāni tataḥ sapūyaḥ ||1|| (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: bhagnasyāpi vraṇasyopekṣayā nāḍī bhavati, ato'nantaraṃ nāḍīmāha– yaḥ śothamityādi| upekṣata iti pīḍanaśodhanādikaṃ na karoti| pracurapūya ityanena gambhīrapākitvamuktam| asādhuvṛttaḥ ahitāhārācāraḥ| sthānāni pūrvavihitānīti vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyoktāni ‘tvaṅmāṃsaśirā ... ’ iti pā.| tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusandhyasthikoṣṭhamarmāṇi||1||

bhagnasyāpi vraṇasyopekṣayā ‘nāḍībhavā ... ’ iti pā.| nāḍīsambhavāttadanantaraṃ nāḍīmāha– ya ityādi| ‘yo'jñaḥ pakvam’ iti pā.| yo'pakvaṃ śophamāmamityupekṣate pīḍanaśodhanādīni na karoti, athavā yaḥ yuruṣaḥ pracurapūyaṃ vraṇamupekṣate iti sambandhaḥ| pracurapūyamityanena gambhīrapākitvaṃ darśayati| asādhuvṛttaḥ ahitāhārācāraḥ| sapūyaḥ tasya pūrvoktāni ‘vraṇasrāva ... ’ iti pā.| vraṇāsrāvavijñānīyoktāni ‘tvaṅmāṃsaśirā ... ’ iti pā.| tvaṅmāṃsasirāsnāyusandhyasthikoṣṭhamarmāṇi sthānāni vidāryāntaḥ praviśati||1||

div.ab: tasyātimātragamanādgatiriṣyate ‘ca’ iti pā. | tu nāḍīva yadvahati tena matā tu nāḍī |2| (su. ni. a. 10) |
tasyeti pūyasya| nāḍīveti antaḥśuṣiralatādināḍīvat|2|–

tasyetyādi| pūyasyātimātragamanādgatiriṣyate, iṣyate ceti caśabdo nāḍīniruktipakṣāntarasamuccaye, tāmeva nāḍīniruktimāha– nāḍītyādi| yena hetunā nāḍīva ‘praṇālī vodvahati’ iti pā.| praṇālīva yadvahati, tena hetunā nāḍī matetyarthaḥ| ‘ataḥ śuṣiranālā’ iti pā.| antaḥśuṣiranālā nāḍī|2|–
doṣaistribhirbhavati ‘sa’ iti pā. | sā pṛthagekaśaśca sammūrchitairapi ca śalyanimittato'nyā ||2|| (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: tāsāṃ kālāntarasambhavena doṣānubandhena saṅkhyāmāha– doṣaistribhirityādi| doṣaiḥ pṛthak tisraḥ| ekaśaśca sammūrchitairiti pratyekaṃ vṛddhyā miśrībhūtaistribhiścaturthī; kārtikastu sannipatitairityadhyāhārya ekaśaśca sannipatitairanyā| sammūrchitaiḥ saṃśliṣṭairaparāstisraḥ| ata evoktaṃ ‘cikitsite’ iti pā.| suśrute– “doṣadvayābhihitalakṣaṇadarśanena tisro gatīrvyatikaraprabhavāstu vidyāt|” (su. ni. a. 10) iti| vyatikaraprabhavā dvandvaprabhavāḥ; api cakārau sārthakāvityāhuḥ| na coktapañcasaṅkhyāhāniḥ, asmin pakṣe'tideśenoktayordvandvasannipātayoḥ sarvatrāgaṇanāt| śalyanimittato'nyeti āganturaparetyarthaḥ| iti pañca nāḍyaḥ||2||
tāsāṃ kālāntarasambhavena doṣānubandhena saṅkhyāmāha– doṣairityādi| tribhirdoṣaistisraḥ, śalyanimittato'nyeti āganturityarthaḥ| evaṃ pañca nāḍyaḥ||2||

div.ab: tatrānilāt paruṣasūkṣmamukhī saśūlā phenānuviddhamadhikaṃ sravati kṣapāsu |3| (su. ni. a. 10) |
vātajāmāha– tatretyādi| adhikaṃ sravati kṣapāsviti ‘śaityādvātavṛddhau’ iti pā.| śaityena vātavṛddhe rātrāvadhikaṃ sravaṇam|3|–
tatra vātajāmāha– tatretyādi| paruṣaṃ karkaśaṃ sūkṣmaṃ mukhaṃ yasyāḥ sā tathā, śaityena vātavṛddhirato rātrāvadhikaṃ sravati|3|–
pittāttṛṣājvarakarī paridāhayuktā pītaṃ sravatyadhikamuṣṇamahaḥsu cāpi ||3|| (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: pittajāmāha– pittādityādi| adhikamuṣṇamahaḥsu ceti divā auṣṇyena pittakopāt||3||
pittajāmāha– pittādityādi| paridāhaḥ samantāddāhaḥ, adhikamuṣṇam, ahaḥsviti divaseṣu, auṣṇyena pittaprakopāt||3||

div.ab: jñeyā kaphādbahughanārjunapicchilāsrā stabdhā sakaṇḍurarujā rajanīpravṛddhā |4| (su. ni. a. 10) |

kaphajāmāha– jñeyetyādi| bahughanārjunapicchilāsrā iti atrārjunaḥ śvetaḥ, ghanaḥ sāndraḥ, āsraśabda āsrāvaśabdaikadeśapāṭhaḥ, pade'pi padaikadeśaprayogāt| yathā “je proṣṭhapadānām” ityatra je ityanenaiva jāta ityucyate| picchilāsruriti pāṭhe'pyayamevārthaḥ| āsruśabdaḥ sampadādiṣu pāṭhāt kvibantaḥ, tugabhāvastvāgamānityatvāt|4|–

śleṣmajāmāha– jñeyā ityādi| bahuradhikaḥ, ghanaḥ sāndraḥ, arjunaḥ śvetaḥ, picchilaḥ āsraḥ āsrāvo yasyāṃ sā tathā| āsraśabdena āsrāva ucyate| anye ‘picchilāsruḥ’ iti paṭhanti| atrāpyayamevārthaḥ| āsruśabdaḥ sampadāditvātkvibantaḥ, tugabhāvastvāgamānityatvāt| rajanīpravṛddheti śaityena śleṣmaṇaḥ prakopāt|4|–
dāhajvaraśvasanamūrchanavaktraśoṣā yasyāṃ bhavantyabhihitāni ca lakṣaṇāni ||4|| tāmādiśet pavanapittakaphaprakopādghorāmasukṣayakarīmiva kālārātrim | (su. ni. a. 10) |
tridoṣajāmāha– dāhetyādi| abhihitānīti pratyekaṃ vātādijanāḍīkathitāni| asukṣayakarīmiti māraṇātmikāṃ, kālarātriṃ maraṇakāriṇīṃ yamabhaginīmiva| ‘gatiṃ tvasuharām’ iti pāṭhāntaram||4||–
tridoṣajāmāha– dāhetyādi| abhihitānīti pūrvoktadoṣatrayalakṣaṇāni asukṣayakarīmiti māraṇātmikām| kālarātrimiveti mṛtyurūpāmiva||4||–
naṣṭaṃ kathañcidanumārgamudīriteṣu sthāneṣu śalyamacireṇa gatiṃ karoti ||5|| sā phenilaṃ mathitamuṣṇamasṛgvimiśraṃ srāvaṃ karoti sahasā sarujā ca nityam | (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: śalyanimittāmāha– naṣṭamityādi| naṣṭamadṛśyamānam| kathañciditi vegakṣayādikāraṇānāmaniyamārthamuktam| anumārgaṃ mārgaṃ lakṣīkṛtya| kecit ‘aṇumārgam’ iti paṭhitvā śalyaviśeṣaṇatayā yojayanti| kintvasmin pakṣe'ṇumārgatvenaiva śalyasyādarśane prayukte kathañciditi nirarthakaṃ syāt| udīriteṣviti tvagādiṣu| phenilaṃ phenavantam| mathitamunmathitam| uṣṇamuṣṇasparśam| ete ca dharmāḥ prasāraṇākuñcanādau calatā śalyena māṃsādikṣobheṇa bhavanti||5||

div.ab: śalyanimittāmāha– naṣṭamityādi| ‘naṣṭam adṛśyamānam’ iti pā.| naṣṭadṛśyamānaṃ, kathañcit pramādāt, anumārgaṃ ‘mārgam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mārgaṃ lakṣīkṛtya| kecid ‘aṇumārgam’ iti paṭhanti| tatra śalyaviśeṣaṇatayā yojayanti| udīriteṣviti tvaṅmāṃsādiṣu pūrvokteṣu| sā nāḍī, phenilaṃ phenavarṇam, unmathitam, uṣṇamuṣṇasparśam, ete ca dharmāḥ prasāraṇādau calatā śalyena māṃsādikṣobheṇa bhavanti||5||–
nāḍī tridoṣaprabhavā na sidhyeccheṣāścatasraḥ khalu yatnasādhyāḥ ||6|| (su. ci. a. 17) |

ab.seg: asādhyatvādikamāha– nāḍītyādi| nanu, nāḍī tridoṣaprabhavā na sidhyediti punaruktam, asukṣayakarīmityanenaivāsādhyatvasyoktatvāt| naivam, ayaṃ granthaḥ suśrutena nidānasthānoktameva tridoṣanāḍyā asādhyatvamanūdya tadanyāsāṃ śeṣatvaniścayena yatnasādhyatvapratipādanāya cikitsite paṭhitaḥ, sa evātra mādhavakareṇa likhita ityadoṣaḥ||6||
asādhyāmāha– nāḍītyādi| śeṣā vātapittakaphaśalyajā iti||6||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam ||45||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||45||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ nāḍīvraṇanidānaṃ samāptam||45||

div.head: bhagandaranidānam

ab.seg: atha bhagandaranidānam | gudasya dvyaṅgule kṣetre pārśvataḥ piḍakā''rtikṛt | bhinnā bhagandaro jñeyaḥ sa ca pañcavidho mataḥ etacchlokānantaraṃ “kaṭīkapālanistodadāhakaṇḍūrujādayaḥ bhavanti pūrvarūpāṇi bhaviṣyati bhagandare” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaṃ paṭhyate|||1||

nāḍīviśeṣatvāt saṅkhyāsāmyācca bhagandaranidānam| bhagandarapūrvarūpapiḍakāmāha– gudasyetyādi| kṣetre deśe| “saiva bhinnā bhagandaraḥ|” niruktirasya suśrutena kṛtā| tadyathā– “gudabhagabastipradeśadāraṇāt ‘bhagandaraḥ’ iti pā.| bhagandarāḥ|” (su. ni. a. 4) iti| bhagaśabdo gudādyupalakṣaṇam| bhoje'pyuktam– “bhagaṃ parisamantācca gudaṃ bastiṃ tathaiva ca| bhagavaddārayedyasmāttasmājjñeyo bhagandaraḥ||” iti| pūrvarūpaṃ tvasya suśrute paṭhyate; yathā– “kaṭīkapālavedanā gudakaṇḍurdāhaḥ śothaśca gudasya bhavati|” (su. ni. a. 4) iti| etat sāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpam| kaṭīkapālamatra kaṭīphalakam| pañcavidha iti saṅkhyākathanaṃ raktajadvandvajabhagandarasambhāvanānirāsārtham||1||

nāḍīviśeṣasaṅkhyāsāmānyād vraṇavadupakramādvā'to'nantaraṃ bhagandaranidānam| tasyāvasthānasaṃśrayatvena lakṣaṇamāha– gudasyetyādi| kṣetre deśe, pārśvataḥ samīpataḥ, piḍakā, saiva bhinnā bhagandarārtikṛt, tasya ca niruktiḥ suśrutena kṛtā– “gudabhagabastipradeśadāraṇādbhagandaraḥ” iti| bhagandaraśabde bhagaśabdo gudādyupalakṣaṇaḥ, bhoje'pyuktam– “bhagaṃ parisamantācca gudaṃ basti tathaiva ca| bhagavaddārayedyasmāttasmājjñeyo bhagandaraḥ||” iti| pūrvarūpaṃ tvasya suśrute paṭhitam, yathā– “kaṭīkapālavedanā gudakaṇḍurdāhaḥ śothaśca gudasya bhavati” iti| etatsāmānyaṃ pūrvarūpamiti| kaṭīkapālamatra kaṭīphalakam| sa ca pañcavidhaḥ– doṣaistrayaḥ, sannipātenaikaḥ, śalyena cāparaḥ, evaṃ pañcavidhasaṅkhyākathanaṃ raktajadvandvajabhagandarasambhāvanānirāsārtham||1||

div.ab: kaṣāyarūkṣaistvatikopito'nilastvapānadeśe piḍakāṃ karoti yām | upekṣaṇātpākamupaiti dāruṇaṃ rujā ca bhinnā'ruṇaphenavāhinī ||2|| tatrāgamo mūtrapurīṣaretasāṃ vraṇairanekaiḥ śataponakaṃ vadet |3|

ab.seg: śataponakamāha– kaṣāyetyādi| apānadeśa iti gudadeśe| upekṣaṇāditi vimlāpanādyakaraṇāt| rujā ca bhinneti rujā rujānvitā, arśaāderākṛtigaṇatvādac, bhinnā vidīrṇā| vraṇairanekaiḥ śataponakaṃ vadediti śataponakatulyatvāt śataponakaḥ; śataponakaścālanikā, sahasradhārā ityanye; kiṃvā śataponakaḥ śūkadoṣe paṭhito vikāraḥ ‘chidrairaṇumukhaiḥ’ ityādinā, kintu yadi śūkadoṣapaṭhitaśataponakatulyatvamasya tadā ‘chidrairaṇḍamukhai ... ’ iti pā.| chidrairaṇumukhairityādinimittasyobhayatra paṭhitatvāt kiṃ tatsādṛśyapravṛtteyaṃ sañjñā, sā vā etatsādṛśyapravṛtteti durvijñānāttatrāpi cālanikātulyatvameva pravṛttinimittamiti manyamānena jejjaṭena cālanikātulyatvamatra varṇitam| śataponakavadanekamukhatve vātikabhagandarasvabhāva eva hetuḥ||2||

div.ab: vātikaśataponakamāha– kaṣāyetyādi| upekṣaṇāditi vimlāpanādyakaraṇāt| rujā ca bhinneti rujā rujānvitā, bhinnā vidīrṇā| śataponakatulyatvācchataponakaḥ śūkadoṣapaṭhito vikāraḥ, cālanikātulyatvamasya śataponakavadanekamukhatvena| tatra ca vātikabhagandarasvabhāva eva hetuḥ, śataponako'sya nāma||2||–

ab.seg: prakopaṇaiḥ pittamatiprakopitaṃ karoti raktāṃ piḍakāṃ gudāśritām ||3||
tadā''śupākā'himapūtivāhinīṃ bhagandaraṃ tūṣṭraśirodharaṃ vadet ||4||

uṣṭragrīvalakṣaṇamāha– prakopaṇairityādi| tadāśupākāhimapūtivāhinīmiti tadeti tatkāle, pittajatvenāśupākā ca sā ahimapūtivāhinī uṣṇapūtivāhinī ca sā āśupākāhimapūtivāhinī tām| atra piḍakāvasthāgatagalavakratvena uṣṭragrīvākāratvaṃ, tenoṣṭragrīvasañjñā||3-4||
pittajamuṣṭragrīvamāha– prakopaṇairityādi| uṣṇapūtidurgandhavāhinīm| atrāpi piḍakāvasthāgatagalavakratve uṣṭragrīvākāratvaṃ, tenoṣṭragrīvasañjñā||3-4||
kaṇḍūyano ghanasrāvī kaṭhino mandavedanaḥ | śvetāvabhāsaḥ kaphajaḥ parisrāvī bhagandaraḥ ||5||
parisrāviṇamāha– kaṇḍūyana ityādi| parisrāvī kaphajaḥ, sa ca ghanasrāvayogāt parisrāvī||5||
parisrāvisañjñaṃ kaphajaṃ bhagandaramāha– kaṇḍūyana ityādi| parisrāvī bhagandaraḥ kaphajaḥ, sa ca ghanaparisrāvayogātparisrāvī| kaṇḍūyanaḥ kaṇḍubahulaḥ||5||
bahuvarṇarujāsrāvā piḍakā gostanopamā | śambūkāvartavannāḍī śambūkāvartako mataḥ ||6||

sannipātajaṃ śambūkāvartamāha– bahuvarṇarujāsrāvetyādi| pratyekadoṣajabhagandarapaṭhitavarṇavedanāḥ ‘srāvāśca’ iti pā.| srāvaśca| śambūkāvartavat pūrṇanadyāḥ ‘śambūkāvartavadāvartena’ iti pā.| śambūkāvartavadāvartanaṃ vedanā doṣagativiśeṣādbhavatīti śambūkāvartaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “nadīnāṃ paripūrṇānāṃ śambūkāvartakā yathā| samuttiṣṭhanti vegena toyavegasamīritāḥ||” iti||6||

sannipātajaṃ śambūkāvartamāha– bahvityādi| bahuvarṇeti pratyekadoṣajabhagandarapaṭhitavarṇavedanāsrāvī, śambūkāvartavat laghuśaṅkhavat, pūrṇanadyāḥ śambūkāvarto yathā āvartena ca vedanā doṣagativiśeṣādbhavatīti śambūkāvartaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “nadīnāṃ paripūrṇānāṃ śambūkāvartakā yathā| abhyuttiṣṭhanti vegena toyavegasamīritāḥ||” iti||6||
kṣatādgatiḥ pāyugatā vivardhate hyupekṣaṇāt syuḥ krimayo vidārya te | prakurvate mārgamanekadhā mukhairvraṇaistadunmārgibhagandaraṃ vadet ||7||

unmārgibhagandaramāgantumāha– kṣatādgatirityādi| kṣatāditi kaṇṭakādighātāt| vidārya ta iti te krimayo vidārya mārgaṃ kurvata iti yojanā| anekadhā mukhairanekamukhaiḥ| atronmārgeṇa krimikṛtavimārgeṇa purīṣādigamanādunmārgisañjñā jñeyā| tantrāntare tvarśobhagandaraḥ paṭhitaḥ| tadyathā– “kaphapitte tu pūrvotthe durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ| arśomūle tataḥ śothaḥ kaṇḍūdāhārtimān bhavet|| sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno'sya kledayan mūlamarśasaḥ| sravatyajasraṃ gatibhirayamarśobhagandaraḥ||” iti| ayamanyatamasmin śataponakādīnāṃ doṣalakṣaṇadarśanādantarbhāvyaḥ||7||

unmārgibhagandaramāgantumāha– kṣatādityādi| kṣatāt kaṇṭakādighātāt, ye kṛmayo vidārya mārgaṃ prakurvata iti yojanā| anekadhā mukhairanekamukhairvraṇaiḥ| atronmārgeṇa kṛmikṛtavimārgeṇa purīṣādinirgamādunmārgisañjñā pratītā| tantrāntare tvarśobhagandaraḥ paṭhitaḥ, yathā– “kaphapitte tu pūrvotthe durnāmāśritya kupyataḥ| arśomūle tataḥ śophaḥ kaṇḍudāhārtimānbhavet|| sa śīghraṃ pakvabhinno'sya kledayanmūlamarśasaḥ| sravatyajasraṃ gatibhirayamarśobhagandaraḥ||” iti| ayaṃ śataponakādīnāṃ ‘doṣalakṣaṇadarśanādabhāvaḥ’ iti pā.| doṣalakṣaṇadarśanādantarbhāvyaḥ||7||

div.ab: ghorāḥ sādhayituṃ duḥkhāḥ sarva eva bhagandarāḥ | teṣvasādhyastridoṣotthaḥ kṣatajaśca viśeṣataḥ ||8|| (su. ni. a. 4) | ‘pratīkāraprayatnopāyamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: pratīkāraprayatnāyāha– ghorā ityādi| duḥkhā iti duḥkhapradāḥ| kṣatajaśca viśeṣata iti kṣatajo'pi ‘...vraṇayogāt’ iti pā.| viśeṣamanekavraṇayogaṃ krimisambhavādikaṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vīkṣyāsādhyaḥ, ata eva cikitsite asādhyatāṃ pratijñāya kriyāṃ vakṣyati| viśeṣata iti lyablope pañcamī; viśeṣato'tiśayādasādhya ityarthaḥ, yāpanārthaṃ kriyāvidhiriti| kvacit “kṣatajaśca bhagandaraḥ” iti pāṭhaḥ| kṣatajo viśeṣataḥ sādhayituṃ ghoraḥ asādhya eva, srāvarūpaviśeṣasya yuktatvāditi gadādharaḥ||8||
asādhyalakṣaṇamāha– ghorā ityādi| kṣatajo'pi viśeṣamanekavraṇayogyaṃ krimisambhavādikaṃ vīkṣyāsādhyaḥ||8||

div.ab: vātamūtrapurīṣāṇi krimayaḥ śukrameva ca | bhagandarāt sravantastu nāśayanti tamāturam ||9|| (su. sū. a. 33) |

ab.seg: avasthāyāmasādhyatāmāha– vātamūtrapurīṣāṇītyādi| bhagandarāt sravanta ityatra ‘amī viśeṣā’ iti śeṣaḥ||9||
avasthāyāmasādhyatāmāha– vātetyādi| bhagandarātsravanta ityatra ‘amī viśeṣā’ iti śeṣaḥ| amī vātādyā viśeṣā bhagandarātsravantastamāturaṃ vināśayanti||9||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne bhagandaranidānaṃ samāptam ||46||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ bhagandaranidānaṃ samāptam||46||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ bhagandaranidānam||46||

div.head: upadaṃśanidānam

ab.seg: athopadaṃśanidānam | ‘ ... dhāvanādatyupasevanādvā’ iti pā. | hastābhighātānnakhadantapātādadhāvanādratyatisevanādvā | yonipradoṣācca bhavanti śiśne pañcopadaṃśā vividhāpacāraiḥ ||1||

sthānapratyāsatterupadaṃśanidānamāha– hastetyādi| nakhadantapātāditi balavadanurāgodayāt nakhadantacchedasthānatvenānukte'pi mehane nakhadantapātaḥ; yaduktaṃ kāmaśāstre– “śāstrasya viṣayastāvadyāvanmandarasā narāḥ| pravṛtte raticakre tu na śāstraṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ||” (kā. sū. sāṃ. a. 2) iti| kalahādivaśādvā mehane nakhadantapātaḥ| adhāvanādaprakṣālanāt| ratyatisevanāditi vyavāyasyātyantasevanāt| yonipradoṣāditi dīrghakarkaśaromādiyogādyoniduṣṭeḥ| śiśne mehane| vividhāpacārairiti aśuddhasalilaprakṣālanabrahmacāriṇīgamanādibhiḥ| upadaṃśasañjñā ca daṃśanopādhimantareṇāpi rūḍhā boddhavyā| yadyapyabhighātakṣate mehane upadaṃśa āgantuḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sambhāvyate, tathā'pi tasya doṣaliṅgayuktatayā doṣaja evāntarbhāvaḥ||1||

vraṇatvasāmānyātsthānapratyāsannatvādupadaṃśanidānam| tasya hetumāha– hastetyādi| nakhadantapātāditi balavadanurāgodayātprabalakāmarāgavaśāt kāmināṃ mehane dantanakhapāto bhavati| yaduktaṃ kāmaśāstre– “śāstrasya viṣayastāvadyāvanmandarasā narāḥ| raticakre pravṛtte ca na śāstraṃ nāpi ca kramaḥ||” iti| kalahādivaśādvā mehane nakhadantapātaḥ| adhāvanādaprakṣālanāt, atyupasevanāditi vyavāyasyātyantasevanāt, yonipradoṣāt alpamahādvāradīrghakarkaśaromasaṅkīrṇadeśatvādiyonidoṣāt, rogaprabhṛtervā yoniduṣṭeḥ| vividhopacārairiti kṣāroṣṇamalināmbhaḥprakṣālanabrahmacāriṇīgamanādibhiḥ| pañcopadaṃśā iti vātena, pittena, śoṇitena, kaphena, sannipātena; evaṃ pañca| yadyapyabhighātakṣate mehane upadaṃśa āgantuḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ sambhavati, tathā'pi tasya doṣaliṅgayuktatayā doṣaja evāntarbhāvaḥ||1||

div.ab: satodabhedaiḥ sphuraṇaiḥ sakṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭairvyavasyet pavanopadaṃśam | pītairbahukledayutaiḥ sadāhaiḥ pittena... |2|
paittikamāha– pītairityādi| ‘ ... ṣañjanīyam’ iti pā.| sphoṭairityanusañjanīyam| evamuttaratrāpi|2|–

vātajopadaṃśalakṣaṇamāha– satodetyādi| ‘bhedo’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | bhedo dvidhā kriyata iva| vyavasyet jānīyāt| pittajamāha– pītairityādi| pittai raktairveti vikalpaḥ, pittena bahukledayutaiḥ ārdratābahulaiḥ, sphoṭairiti śeṣaḥ|2|

ab.seg: ...raktāt piśitāvabhāsaiḥ ||2||
sphoṭaiḥ sakṛṣṇai rudhiraṃ sravantaṃ raktātmakaṃ pittasamānaliṅgam | sakaṇḍuraiḥ śothayutairmahadbhiḥ śuklairghanaiḥ srāvayutaiḥ kaphena ||3||
raktajamāha– raktādityādi| raktāt piśitāvabhāsairiti māṃsavattāmraiḥ sphoṭaiḥ raktācchoṇitāt upadaṃśaṃ vyavasyet| ‘raktaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare raktaiḥ śoṇitaiḥ||2-3||

raktajamāha– piśitāvabhāsairityādi| māṃsavattāmraiḥ sphoṭaiḥ raktāt śoṇitāt upadaṃśaṃ vyavasyet| ‘raktaiḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram, tatra raktaiḥ śoṇitaiḥ| kaphajamāha– sakaṇḍuraiḥ kaṇḍūyutaiḥ, mahadbhiḥ mahatparigrahaiḥ, ghanairnibiḍaiḥ, sphoṭairiti śeṣaḥ||2-3||

div.ab: nānāvidhasrāvarujopapannamasādhyamāhustrimalopadaṃśam |4|
sannipātajamāha– nānāvidhetyādi| nānāvidhasrāvarujopapannamiti pratyekadoṣoktasrāvavedanāyuktam| trimalopadaṃśamiti tridoṣopadaṃśam|4|–
sannipātajamāha– nānetyādi| pratyekadoṣoktasrāvavedanāyuktam| trimalopadaṃśamiti tridoṣopadaṃśamasādhyamāhuḥ|4|–

ab.seg: viśīrṇamāṃsaṃ krimibhiḥ prajagdhaṃ muṣkāvaśeṣaṃ parivarjayecca ||4||
asādhyatāmāha– viśīrṇetyādi| muṣkāvaśeṣamiti viśīrṇasamastamehanamāṃsatvenāvaśiṣṭaphalakoṣamātram||4||

varjyamāha– viśīrṇetyādi| viśīrṇamāṃsaṃ śaṭitamāṃsaṃ, kṛmibhiḥ prajagdhaṃ bhakṣitaṃ, muṣkāvaśeṣamiti śīrṇasamastamehanamāṃsatvenāvaśiṣṭaphalakośamātraṃ, ‘ ... lakṣaṇamupadaṃśam’ iti pā.| evamuktalakṣaṇopadaṃśaṃ parivarjayet||4||
sañjātamātre na karoti mūḍhaḥ kriyāṃ naro yo viṣaye prasaktaḥ | kālena śothakrimidāhapākairviśīrṇaśiśno mriyate sa tena ||5||
upakrame cikitsākaraṇārthamāha– sañjātetyādi| viṣaye prasakta iti ‘ativyavāyādirataḥ’ iti pā.| ativyavāyarataḥ| kālena cirakālena||5||
upakrame cikitsākaraṇārthamāha– sañjātetyādi| yo mūḍho viṣaye prasaktaḥ vyavāyāditatparaḥ, sa tenopadaṃśena kālena kālāntareṇa mriyate śothādibhirupadravaiḥ praśīrṇaśiśnaḥ galitamehanaḥ||5||
aṅkurairiva saṅghātairuparyuparisaṃsthitaiḥ | krameṇa jāyate vartistāmracūḍaśikhopamā ||6||
koṣasyābhyantare sandhau sarvasandhigatā'pi vā | (savedanā picchilā ca duścikitsyā tridoṣajā) | liṅgavartirabhikhyātā liṅgārśa iti cāpare ||7||

ekasthānatvenātra liṅgārśa āha– aṅkurairityādi| aṅkurairaṅkurasadṛśairīṣaddīrghaiḥ, ‘saṅghātairmāṃsasampratānaiḥ’ iti pā.| saṅghātairmāṃsapratānaiḥ, ‘sañjātaiḥ’ iti pāṭhe ‘māṃsaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| tāmracūḍaśikhopamā iti tāmracūḍaḥ, kukkuṭaḥ, taccūḍātulyā| sandhāviti meḍhrarandhrasandhau, sarvasandhigatetyanena sarvasandheruktatvāt| eṣā tridoṣajā, ‘vartiriti yojyam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vartiriti yojyam; ata eva ‘savedanā picchilā ca duścikitsyā tridoṣajā|’ iti kvacit pāṭhaḥ| suśrute kvacit strīṇāmapyupadaṃśaḥ paṭhyate| yathā– “meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecit kecit sarvāśrayāstathā| kulatthākṛtayaḥ kecit kecit padmadalopamāḥ|| rujādāhārtibahulāḥ kṛṣṇāstodasamanvitāḥ| śīghraṃ kecidvisarpanti śanaiḥ kecittathā'pare| strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca jāyante upadaṃśāḥ sudāruṇāḥ||” iti| kintu samānatantreṣvadarśanādetadanārṣamāhuḥ||6-7||

ekasthānatvenātra liṅgārśa āha– aṅkurairityādi| aṅkurasadṛśairīṣaddīrghasaṅghātaiḥ māṃsapratānaiḥ| anye sandhāviti ‘randhrasandhau’ iti pā.| meḍhrarandhrasandhau, sarvasandhigatetyanena sarvasandheruktatvāt, eṣā tridoṣajā, ata eva “savedanā picchilā ca duścikitsyā tridoṣajā” iti kvacitpaṭhyate| suśrute tu kvacit strīṇāmapyupadaṃśāḥ paṭhyante| tadyathā– “meḍhrasandhau vraṇāḥ kecitkecitsarvāśrayāstathā| kulatthākṛtayaḥ kecitkecitpadmadalopamāḥ|| rujādāhārtibahulāḥ kṛṣṇāstodasamanvitāḥ| strīṇāṃ puṃsāṃ ca jāyante upadaṃśāḥ sudāruṇāḥ||” iti| kintu samānatantreṣvadarśanādetadanārṣamāhuḥ||6-7||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne upadaṃśanidānaṃ samāptam ||47||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmupadaṃśanidānaṃ samāptam||47||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāmupadaṃśanidānam||47||

div.head: śūkadoṣanidānam

ab.seg: atha śūkadoṣanidānam | akramācchephaso vṛddhiṃ yo'bhivāñchati mūḍhadhīḥ | vyādhayastasya jāyante daśa cāṣṭau ca śūkajāḥ ||1||

samānasthānatvācchūkadoṣanidānamāha– akramādityādi| śūko jalaśūkaḥ, sa tu viṣajanturjalamalodbhavaḥ saśūkaḥ, tathā śūkapradhāno liṅgavṛddhikaro vātsyāyanādyukto yogaḥ śūka ucyate; tasya doṣo vaikṛtamasamyakkaraṇāt, tato vā doṣo vātādiḥ, tatkṛto vā vikāraḥ, “doṣā api vyādhyākhyāṃ labhante” ityāgamāt; ata eva śūkadoṣavivaraṇe śūkadoṣanimittā vyādhaya eva boddhavyāḥ| evaṃ ca ‘yatra kumbhikādau raktapittotthetyādi ... ’ iti pā.| yadatra ‘kumbhikā raktapittotthā’ ityādikāraṇāntaropavarṇanaṃ tat śūkakṛtaraktapittādirūpaṃ jñeyam| anye ‘tvādiśabdalābhāt’ iti pā.| tvādiśabdalopāt śūkādidoṣanidānamāhuḥ| ādiśabdena duṣṭayonigūḍhāntarlomadurbhagāgamanādi gṛhyate; tanna manoharaṃ, “vṛddhiṃ yo'bhivāñchati” ityanena viśeṣaṇena ‘duṣṭayonyāderayogasya’ iti pā.| duṣṭayonyāderayogyasya grahītumanarhatvāt| anye tu duṣṭayonyādīnyupadaṃśahetutvenoktatvāt nānumanyante; tadanaikāntikam, ekajātīyahetūnāmanekarogakaraṇadarśanāt| akramādityanucitavṛddhikramāt; anucitā ca ‘ ... śūkayogānāmavacāraṇāt’ iti pā.| vṛddhirbhūrivikārakarajalaśūkayogānāmācāraṇāt, jalaśūkayogānāṃ vātsyāyanādau vistaraḥ| yathā– “bhallātakāsthijalaśūkamathābjapatramantarvidahya matimān saha saindhavena| etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalatoyapiṣṭamālepanaṃ ‘mahiṣaviḍimalīkṛte'ṅge’ iti pā.| mahiṣaviḍvimalīkṛte'ṅge|| sthūlaṃ mahattaraturaṅgamatulyamāśu ‘śephaḥ’ iti pā.| śephaṃ karotyabhimataṃ na hi saṃśayo'sti||” ityādi| yacca jalaśūkarahitamaśvagandhāditailaṃ taducitameva liṅgavardhanam| yaduktam– “aśvagandhāvarīkuṣṭhamāṃsīsiṃhīphalānvitam| caturguṇena dugdhena tilatailaṃ vipācayet|| stanaliṅgakarṇapālivardhanaṃ mrakṣaṇādidam||” iti| gadādharastvāha– liṅgavṛddhireva kāmaparāyaṇaninditapuruṣaiḥ kriyamāṇā akramaḥ| daśa cāṣṭau ceti aṣṭādaśa; saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva labdhāyāṃ saṅkhyāyāṃ punastaduktiḥ sammūḍhapiḍakādau dvitvaśaṅkānirāsārtham||1||

samānasthānatvācchūkadoṣanidānārambhaḥ| tasya samprāptimāha– akramādityādi| śūko jalaśūkaḥ, sa tu ‘viṣajanturjalamalodbhavaḥ saśūkaḥ,’ iti pā.| viṣajanturjalamalodbhavo jīvaviśeṣaḥ saśūkaḥ, tatpradhāno liṅgavṛddhau vātsyāyanādiśāstrokto yogaḥ ‘śūka’ iti pā.| śūkadoṣa ucyate, tanmukhyatvāt liṅgavṛddhau anye'pi yogāḥ śūkāḥ kathyante, tasya doṣo vikāraḥ, śūkasya kāraṇatvāt “kvaciddoṣā api vyādhyākhyāṃ labhante” ityāgamāt, ata eva śūkadoṣavivaraṇe śūkadoṣanimittatvāt vyādhaya eva vaktavyāḥ| atra śūkajā iti śūkadoṣajā vyādhayaḥ| akramāditi anucitavṛddhikramāt, anucitā vṛddhiḥ ‘bhūrivikārajalaśūkayogānāmācaraṇāt’ iti pā.| bhūrivikārakarajalaśūkayogānāmācaraṇāt, jalaśūkayogānāṃ vātsyāyanādau vistaraḥ| yathā– “bhallātakāsthijalaśūkamathābjapatramantarvidahya matimānsaha saindhavena| ‘etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalatoyapiṣṭamālepanam’ iti pā.| etadvirūḍhabṛhatīphalajopapiṣṭamālepanaṃ mahiṣaviḍvimalīkṛte'ṅge|| sthūlaṃ mahattaraturaṅgamatulyamāśu śephaṃ karotyabhimataṃ na hi saṃśayo'sti|” ityādi| yacca jalaśūkarahitamaśvagandhāditailaṃ, taducitameva liṅgavardhanam| yaduktam– “ ‘ ... siṃhīda(pha)lānvitam’ iti pā.| aśvagandhāvacākuṣṭhamāṃsīsiṃhīphalānvitam| caturguṇena dugdhena tilatailaṃ vipācayet| stanaliṅgakarṇapālivardhanaṃ mrakṣaṇādidam||” iti| śephaso liṅgasya| gadādharastvāha– liṅgavṛddhireva kāmaparāyaṇaninditapuruṣaiḥ kriyamāṇā akramaḥ| daśa ca aṣṭau ceti aṣṭādaśa, saṅkhyeyanirdeśādeva labdhāyāṃ saṅkhyāyāṃ punastaduktiḥ sammūḍhapiḍakādau dvitvasaṅkhyānirāsārtham||1||

div.ab: gaurasarṣapasaṃsthānā śūkadurbhugnahetukā | piḍakā śleṣmavātābhyāṃ jñeyā sarṣapikā tu sā ||2|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: sarṣapikāmāha– gauretyādi| śūkadurbhugnahetuketi durbhugnaśūkahetuketyarthaḥ| piḍakādiṣu ubhayavacanamiti(?) paranipātaḥ durbhugno duravacāritaḥ| ‘śūkadurbhagahetukā’ iti pāṭhāntare śūkanimittā, duṣṭayoninimittā cetyarthaḥ||2||

vātaśleṣmajanitāṃ sarṣapikāmāha– gauretyādi| gaurasarṣapatulyā| śūkadurbhugnahetuketi durbhugnaśūkahetuketyarthaḥ| ‘piḍakādiṣu ubhayavacanam’ iti paranipātaḥ| durbhugno duravacāritaḥ| “śūkadurbhagahetukī” iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra śūkanimittā duṣṭayoninimittā cetyarthaḥ||2||

div.ab: kaṭhinā viṣamairbhugnairvāyunā'ṣṭhīlikā bhavet |3| (su. ni. a. 14) |
aṣṭhīlikāmāha– kaṭhinetyādi| viṣamairbhugnairiti vakṣyamāṇaśūkairityanena sambadhyate| viṣamairiti apraśastaiḥ| aṣṭhīlikā lauhakārasya bhāṇḍīviśeṣa, tattulyatvādaṣṭhīlikā|3|–
aṣṭīlikāmāha– kaṭhinetyādi| viṣamairbhugnairiti vakṣyamāṇaśūkairityanena sambadhyate| viṣamaiḥ apraśastaiḥ, bhugnairvakraiḥ| aṣṭhīlikā lohakārabhāṇḍaviśeṣaḥ, tattulyatvādaṣṭhīlikā; sā ca vātena|3|–

ab.seg: śūkairyat pūritaṃ śaśvadgrathitaṃ nāma tat kaphāt ||3||
grathitamāha– śūkairityādi| śūkairyat pūritaṃ śaśvadgrathitamiti śūkaiḥ sarvadā pūritaṃ liṅgaṃ yat granthilaṃ tat grathitamityarthaḥ; granthitulyatvāt grathitasañjñā||3||

kaphādgrathitamāha– śūkairityādi| śūkaiḥ sarvadā pūritaṃ liṅgaṃ yattadgrathitamityarthaḥ| grathitatvād grathitasañjñā| śaśvaditi aharahaḥ| śūkapūraṇaṃ śephasi, etenaikadināntarapūraṇaṃ praśastamicchanti kāmatantrācāryāḥ| nityapūraṇād grathitanāmno rogasyotpattiḥ||3||

div.ab: kumbhikā raktapittotthā jāmbavāsthinibhā'śubhā |4| (su. ni. a. 14) |

kumbhikāmāha– kumbhiketyādi| kumbhī ‘kumbhīḍulatā’ iti pā., ‘kumbhāḍulatā’ iti ca pā.| kumbhīlatā, tasyāḥ phalaṃ kumbhī; taddhitasya luk; ‘ive pratikṛtau’ ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti kan kumbhīphalavat kumbhikā| aśubheti śubhaṃ śuklaṃ tadvirodhe nañ, kṛṣṇetyarthaḥ| ‘āśujā’ iti pāṭhāntaram|4|–

raktapittābhyāṃ kumbhikāmāha– kumbhiketyādi| kumbhikā kumbhakārī, tasyāḥ phalaṃ kumbhī, taddhitasya luk “ive pratikṛtau” ‘iti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti kan, kumbhīphalavat kumbhikā, tathā jāmbavāsthirūpā jambūphalāsthisadṛśī, aśubhā śubhaṃ śuklaṃ na ‘śubham aśubham’ iti pā.| śubhā aśubhā kṛṣṇetyarthaḥ| sā ca raktapittajanitā| ‘āśujā’ iti pāṭhāntaram|4|–
tulyajāṃ tvalajīṃ vidyādyathāproktāṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ ||4|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: alajīmāha– tulyajāmityādi| tulyajāmiti pramehapiḍakā alajī tattulyasambhavā, sā ca raktā'sitā sphoṭacitā| tulyatvameva vivṛṇoti– yathāproktāmiti| alajī yathāproktā yādṛśalakṣaṇā tatheyamapītyarthaḥ| eṣā ca kāraṇacikitsābhedāt pramehaṃ vinā liṅga eva sambhavācca tataḥ pṛthagbhūtā jñeyā||4||
