alajīmāha– tulyajāmityādi| vicakṣaṇaḥ alajīpiḍakāṃ vidyāt| kimbhūtāṃ? tulyajāmiti| pramehapiḍakā alajī, tattulyasambhavā| sā ca raktāsitasphoṭacitā| tulyatvameva vivṛṇoti– yathāproktāmityādi| sā alajī yathāproktā yādṛśalakṣaṇā tatheyamapītyarthaḥ| eṣā ca kāraṇacikitsābhedāt pramehaṃ vinā liṅga eva sambhavācca tataḥ pṛthagbhūtā jñeyā| iyamapi ‘duṣṭaśūkāvadhāraṇājjñeyā’ iti pā.| duṣṭaśūkāvacāraṇājjñeyā||4||

div.ab: mṛditaṃ pīḍitaṃ yacca saṃrabdhaṃ vātakopataḥ |5| (su. ni. a. 14) |
mṛditamāha– mṛditamityādi| pīḍitamiti adhikṛtatvāt śūkapātānantaraṃ pīḍitamiti jñeyaṃ, pīḍitaṃ ‘liṅgam’ iti śeṣaḥ| saṃrabdhaṃ saśotham|5|–
mṛditamāha– mṛditamityādi| saṃrabdhaṃ saśophaṃ tanmṛditaṃ mṛditākhyaṃ rogākrāntaṃ jñeyaṃ, pīḍitamityadhikṛtatvāt śūkapātānantaraṃ pīḍitamiti jñeyam|5|–
pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe sammūḍhapiḍakā bhavet ||5|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: sammūḍhapiḍakāmāha– pāṇibhyāmityādi| pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe ityadhikārāt pātitaśūke liṅge pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe piccitāvanate, atrāpi ‘vātakopāt’ ityanuvartate||5||

sammūḍhapiḍakāmāha– pāṇibhyāmityādi| pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe ityatrādhikārāt ‘pīḍitaśūkaliṅge’ iti pā.| pātitaśūke liṅge pāṇibhyāṃ bhṛśasammūḍhe atyarthaṃ piccitāvanate sammūḍhapiḍakā syāt, atrāpi vātaprakopa ityanuvartate||5||

div.ab: dīrghā bahvyaśca piḍakā dīryante madhyatastu yāḥ | so'dhimanthaḥ kaphāsṛgbhyāṃ vedanāromaharṣakṛt ||6|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: adhimanthamāha– dīrghā ityādi| kaphāsṛgbhyāmiti śūkapātakṛtābhyām| evamanyatrāpi sāmānyena śūkadoṣābhihite śūkapāto'nukto'pi jñeyaḥ| vedanāromaharṣakṛditi vedanayā romaharṣaṃ karoti||6||

avamanthamāha– dīrghā ityādi| dīrghā vistīrṇāḥ, bahvyaḥ bahulāḥ| kaphāsṛgbhyāmiti śūkapātakṛtābhyām| evamanyatra sarveṣvapi sāmānyena śūkadoṣeṣu śūkapāto'nukto'pi jñeyaḥ| vedanayā romaharṣaṃ karoti iti vedanāromaharṣakṛt| adhimantha iti sañjñā||6||

div.ab: piḍakā piḍakāvyāptā pittaśoṇitasambhavā | padmakarṇikasaṃsthānā jñeyā puṣkarikā tu sā ||7|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: puṣkarikāmāha– piḍeketyādi||7||
puṣkarikāmāha– etacca– ‘piḍakāmiśritā yā ca’ iti pā.| piḍakābhiścitetyādi| yā piḍakaiva piḍakābhiścitā vyāptā| padmakarṇikasaṃsthāneti kamalakośatulyā, puṣkariketi sañjñā pittaśoṇitādvijñeyā||7||

div.ab: sparśahāniṃ tu janayecchoṇitaṃ śūkadūṣitam |8| (su. ni. a. 14) |
sparśahānimāha– sparśahāniṃ tvityādi|8|–
sparśahānimāha– sparśahānimityādi| sparśahānināmānaṃ vyādhiviśeṣaṃ, śūkadūṣitaṃ śūkena duṣṭiṃ nītaṃ raktaṃ janayet|8|–
mudgamāṣopamā raktā raktapittodbhavā tu yā ||8|| vyādhireṣottamā nāma ‘śūkājīrṇanimittataḥ’ iti pā. | śūkājīrṇanimittajā | (su. ni. a. 14) |

uttamāmāha– mudgamāṣetyādinā| eṣottamā vyādhiḥ śūkājīrṇanimittajā bhavati, śūkājīrṇaṃ punaḥ punarduravacāritaśūkavikṛtirūpameva| “vyādhireṣottamo nāma” iti pāṭhāntare eṣottama iti nirdeśaḥ pūrvatrāsiddhavidheranityatvāt sādhuḥ||8||–

ab.seg: uttamamāha– vyādhirityādi| eṣa ‘eṣā uttamā’ iti pā.| uttamo nāma vyādhiḥ śūkājīrṇanimittajo bhavati, śūkājīrṇaṃ punaḥ punarduravacāritaśūkavikṛtirūpameva, tadeva nimittaṃ tato jāyata iti| ‘ ‘vyādhireṣottamā’ iti pā.| vyādhireṣottama’ iti nirdeśaḥ| ‘pūrvatrāsandhividhe ... ’ iti pā.| pūrvatrāsiddhavidheranityatvātsādhuḥ||8||
chidrairaṇumukhairliṅgaṃ ‘cittam’ iti pā. | citaṃ yasya samantataḥ ||9||
vātaśoṇitajo vyādhiḥ sa jñeyaḥ śataponakaḥ | (su. ni. 14) ||11||

div.ab: śataponakamāha– chidrairaṇumukhairityādinā| chidrairiti duravacāritaśūkadoṣajanitavātaśoṇitajaiḥ, citamupacitam, ata eva cikitsāyāṃ lekhanopadeśaḥ| śataponakaścālanikā, tattulyatvāt śataponakaḥ||9||–

śataponakamāha– chidrairityādi| yasya liṅgaṃ chidraiḥ sūkṣmamukhaiḥ samantataḥ sarvataścitaṃ vyāptaṃ, sa vyādhiḥ śataponako jñeyaḥ| chidrairiti duravacāritaśūkajanitavātaśoṇitajaiḥ| śataponakaścālanikā, tattulyaḥ śataponakaḥ||9||–
vātapittakṛto jñeyastvakpāko jvaradāhakṛt ||10|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: tvakpākamāha– vātapittakṛta ityādi| śūkadoṣeṣu kvacit kasyacit doṣasyābhidhānaṃ śūkaviśeṣādāhārācārabhedācca ‘pūrvaṃ sambandhanīyam’ iti pā.| samarthanīyam||10||

tvakpākamāha– vātetyādi| vātapittakṛtaḥ tvakpākanāmā vyādhirjñeyaḥ| sa ca jvaradāhau karoti| ayaṃ ca duravacāritaśūkadūṣitavātapittaja ityarthaḥ| ‘śūkaṃ doṣeṣu’ iti pā.| śūkadoṣeṣu kvacitkasyaciddoṣasyābhidhānaṃ śūkaviśeṣādāhārādibhedācca samarthanīyam||10||

div.ab: kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ saraktābhiḥ piḍakābhirnipīḍitam | yasya vāsturujaścogrā jñeyaṃ tacchoṇitārbudam ||11|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: śoṇitārbudamāha– kṛṣṇaiḥ sphoṭairityādinā| piḍakābhiriti svalpābhirnipīḍitaṃ liṅgamiti boddhavyam| yasya vāsturuja iti vāstu vraṇādhiṣṭhānaṃ, tatra rujaḥ, agādhocchritamāṃsaśothatvāt| ‘bastirujaścogrā’ iti pāṭhāntaram| arbudaṃ duravacāritaśūkajaśoṇitakṛtam||11||

śoṇitārbudamāha– kṛṣṇairityādi| piḍakābhiriti svalpābhiḥ nipīḍitaṃ liṅgamiti boddhavyam| yasya vāsturuja iti vāstu vraṇādhiṣṭhānam| ‘tatra rujaḥ’ iti pā.| tatra ugrā rujaḥ, ‘ ... māṃsaśoṣatvāt’ iti pā.| agādhocchritamāṃsaśothatvāt| ‘bastirujaścogrāḥ’ iti pāṭhāntaram| sarvadā duravacāritaśūkajaśoṇitakṛtam||11||

div.ab: māṃsadoṣeṇa jānīyādarbudaṃ māṃsasambhavam |12| (su. ni. a. 14) |
māṃsārbudamāha– māṃsadoṣeṇetyādi| māṃsadoṣeṇeti śūkapātānantaraṃ prahārādinā kṛtena māṃsadoṣeṇa|12|–
māṃsārbudamāha– māṃsadoṣeṇetyādi| śūkapātānantaraṃ ‘pramehādinā’ iti pā.| prahārādinā kṛtena māṃsadoṣeṇa, atrāpi śoṇitaṃ hetuḥ, māṃsārbudasañjñā|12|–
śīryante yasya māṃsāni yasya sarvāśca vedanāḥ ||12|| vidyāttaṃ māṃsapākaṃ tu sarvadoṣakṛtaṃ bhiṣak | (su. ni. a. 14) |
māṃsapākamāha– śīryante yasyetyādi| śīryante galanti, sarvāśca vedanā iti vātapittakaphajāḥ||12||–
māṃsapākamāha– śīryanta ityādi| śīryante galanti| sarvāśca vedanāḥ iti vātapittakaphajāḥ, ayaṃ tridoṣajaḥ||12||–
vidradhiṃ sannipātena yathoktamiti nirdiśet ||13|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: vidradhimāha– vidradhimityādi| sannipātena yathoktamiti ‘nānāvarṇarujāsrāvaḥ’ ityādinā sannipātajavidradhilakṣaṇaṃ vidradhimiha jānīyādityarthaḥ||13||
vidradhimāha– yathoktamityādi| sannipātavidradhilakṣaṇena jānīyāt| vidradhinidānoktaṃ ‘nānāvarṇarujāsrāvaḥ’ ityādinā||13||

div.ab: kṛṣṇāni citrāṇyathavā śūkāni saviṣāṇi vā | pātitāni pacantyāśu meḍhraṃ niravaśeṣataḥ ||14|| kālāni bhūtvā māṃsāni śīryante yasya dehinaḥ | sannipātasamutthāṃstu tān vidyāttilakālakān ||15|| (su. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: tilakālakamāha– kṛṣṇānītyādi| citrāṇīti nānāvarṇāni| saviṣāṇīti śūkānāṃ saviṣatve'pi viśeṣārthamuktam| kālānīti kṛṣṇāni, kṛṣṇatilatulyatvāt tilakālakasañjñā| śīryante galanti||14-15||

tilakālakamāha– kṛṣṇānītyādi| yasya puṃsaḥ śūkāni kṛṣṇāni, athavā citrāṇi, athavā saviṣāṇi, tāni saṃhatyāśu śīghraṃ niravaśeṣataḥ samagraṃ meḍhraṃ pacanti, kṛṣṇāni kṛṣṇavarṇāni, citrāṇīti śuklapītanīlādinānāvarṇāni, saviṣāṇīti śūkānāṃ saviṣatve'pi viśeṣārthamuktaṃ, tathā kālānīti kṛṣṇāni pariṇatatilaphalavarṇāni bhūtvā śīryanti galanti, tān sannipātajān tilakālakān vidyāt, kṛṣṇatilatulyavarṇatvāttilakālakasañjñā||14-15||

div.ab: tatra māṃsārbudaṃ yacca māṃsapākaśca yaḥ smṛtaḥ | vidradhiśca na siddhyanti ye ca syustilakālakāḥ ||16|| (su. ni. a. 14) | ‘śūkadoṣeṣvasādhyatāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: śūkadoṣeṣvasādhyānāha– tatra māṃsārbudamityādi| yacceti cakāro'yaṃ bhinnakramaḥ, sa ca na siddhyatītyanantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ; tena sādhyatā'pyeṣāmaciratvādinā bhavati, ata eva pratyākhyāya cikitsāvidhānamupapannamiti gadādharaḥ| durjñānāt sādhye eva asādhyatāropādasampūrṇāvasthāyāmasādhye'pi kriyāsiddheśca mā nivartatāṃ bhiṣagiti pratyākhyāya cikitsāṃ kāruṇikatayā ācārya upadiśatīti mantavyam||16||

śūkadoṣeṣvasādhyatāmāha– tatretyādi| tatra teṣu śūkadoṣeṣu madhye yanmāṃsārbudaṃ, ‘tathā yo māṃsapākaḥ’ iti pā.| tathā yo māṃsapākaḥ, tathā vidradhiḥ, tathā ye ca tilakālakāḥ syuḥ, ete na sidhyanti| ye ceti cakāro bhinnakramaḥ, sa ca na siddhyatītyanantaraṃ draṣṭavyaḥ| tena sādhyatā'pyeṣāmaciratvādinā bhavati, ata eva pratyākhyāya cikitsāvidhānamupapannamiti gadādharaḥ||16||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam ||48||
iti ‘śrīkaṇṭhadattaviracitāyām’ iti pā.| śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam||48||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śūkadoṣanidānaṃ samāptam||48||

div.head: kuṣṭhanidānam
div.ab: atha kuṣṭhanidānam | virodhīnyannapānāni dravasnigdhagurūṇi ca | bhajatāmāgatāṃ chardiṃ vegāṃścānyān pratighnatām ||1|| vyāyāmamatisantāpamatibhuktvā niṣeviṇām | gharmaśramabhayārtānāṃ drutaṃ śītāmbusevinām ||2|| ajīrṇādhyaśināṃ caiva pañcakarmāpacāriṇām | navānnadadhimatsyātilavaṇāmlaniṣeviṇām ||3|| māṣamūlakapiṣṭānnatilakṣīraguḍāśinām | vyavāyaṃ cāpyajīrṇe'nne nidrāṃ ca bhajatāṃ divā ||4|| viprān gurūn dharṣayatāṃ pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatām | vātādayastrayo duṣṭāstvagraktaṃ māṃsamambu ca ||5|| dūṣayanti sa kuṣṭhānāṃ saptako dravyasaṅgrahaḥ | ataḥ kuṣṭhāni jāyante sapta caikādaśaiva ca ||6|| (ca. ci. a. 7) |

ab.seg: aṣṭādaśasaṅkhyārūpeṇa tulyatvāt kuṣṭhanidānamucyate| viśeṣeṇa kuṣṭhajanakaṃ nidānamāha– virodhīnītyādi| virodhīni “na matsyān payasā'bhyavaharet” (ca. sū. a. 26) ityādinoktāni| bhajatāmiti pūrveṇa sambadhyate| āgatāmiti upasthitavegām| vegāṃścānyāniti mūtrapurīṣādivegān| vyāyāmamatisantāpamatibhuktveti bhuktvā vyāyāmamatiyujya santāpamatiyujya ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca niṣeviṇāmiti etayoreva sevanaśīlānāṃ; niṣeviṇāmityanena saha prathamataḥ sambandhe kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt, tataśca vyāyāmasyātisantāpasyātiniṣeviṇāmiti prayogaḥ ‘prasajjeta’ iti pā.| prasajyeta| “śītoṣṇalaṅghanāhārān kramaṃ muktvā niṣeviṇām” iti pāṭhāntare śītoṣṇādīnāṃ ‘yadā yena krameṇa’ ityasya sthāne ‘yathākrameṇa’ iti pā.| yadā yena krameṇa sevyatvamuktaṃ, tadvaiparītyena tān sevyamānān| śītoṣṇalaṅghanāhārānityanantaraṃ pratīti draṣṭavyaṃ, tena śītoṣṇādīn prati yaḥ kramastaṃ muktvā eteṣāmeva niṣeviṇām| gharmaśramabhayārtānāmiti gharmādibhirārtatve sati drutamaviśramya śītāmbusevinām| gharma ātapaḥ| ajīrṇādhyaśināmiti ajīrṇamāmamannam, apakvamiti yāvat, tadbhuñjānānām; adhyaśināmāhāre evāpariṇate bhuñjānānām| aśināmiti ajīrṇādhiśabdābhyāṃ saha ‘sambadhyate’ iti pā.| sambandhyate| pañcakarmāpacāriṇāmiti pañcakarmaṇi kriyamāṇe apacāriṇām| navānnadadhimatsyānīti atiśabdo navānnādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ sambadhyate| vyavāyaṃ cāpyajīrṇa iti ‘vidagdhādirūpe'nne’ iti pā.| vidagdhādirūpe ajīrṇe| dharṣayatāmiti abhibhavatām| pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatāmityanenaiva viprādidharṣaṇe labdhe punastadvacanaṃ viśeṣārtham| doṣadūṣyasaṅgrahamāha– vātādaya ityādinā| vātādīnāṃ tritve pratīte'pi traya iti vacanaṃ sarvakuṣṭheṣu militānāmeva trayāṇāṃ duṣṭipradarśanārtham| dravyasaṅgraha iti dravyamārambhakaṃ kāraṇamucyate; yathā– “rasanārtho rasastasya dravyamāpaḥ kṣitistathā|” (ca. sū. a. 1) iti| arthalabdhamapi saptakamiti padaṃ sarvatra saptakaniyamārthaṃ punaruktam| nanu, visarpāṇāṃ samutpāde etāvatyeva sāmagrī, yaduktam– “raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣāstrayo malāḥ| visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti| ‘lasīkāvacca’ iti pā.| lasīkayā ca tatrodakamucyate, tat kinnibandhanaḥ kuṣṭhavisarpayorbhedaḥ? ucyate– kuṣṭhaṃ cirakriyaiḥ sthirairaprabalaraktapittairdoṣairjanyate, visarpastvaciravisarpaṇaśīlaiḥ prabalaraktapittaiḥ; kuṣṭhe gurupradharṣaṇaparadravyāpahārādayo nimittaṃ, na visarpe| anye tvāhuḥ– visarpā vātādibhirekaikaśo'pi bhavanti, yaduktam– “pṛthak trayastribhiścaiko visarpā dvandvajāstrayaḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti, kuṣṭhaṃ tu tridoṣajameveti| kiṃ tvetatsamādhānaṃ tridoṣajatve'pi visarpāṇāmekadoṣajakuṣṭhavadekadoṣajatvakīrtanaṃ saṅgatamiti na manoharam| ataḥ kuṣṭhānīti ata ityasmāt doṣadūṣyasamudāyāt| sapta caikādaśaiva ceti vicchedapāṭhena saptānāṃ mahākuṣṭhatvamekādaśānāṃ kṣudratvamiti bodhayati||1-6||

aṣṭādaśarūpasaṅkhyātulyatvātkuṣṭhanidānamucyate| viśeṣeṇa kuṣṭhajanakaṃ nidānamāha– virodhīnītyādi| etadācaratāṃ nṛṇāṃ kuṣṭhāni jāyante iti sambandhaḥ| virodhīni kṣīramatsyādīni bhajatāmiti sambadhyate| āgatāmiti upasthitavegāṃ chardiṃ, tathā vegāṃścānyāniti mūtrapurīṣādivegān, pratighnatāṃ pratighātaṃ kurvatām| vyāyāmamatisantāpamatibhuktveti bhuktvā vyāyāmamatiyujya santāpamatiyujya niṣeviṇāmiti| etayoreva sevanaśīlānāṃ, niṣeviṇāmityanena prathamataḥ sambandhe kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī syāt; tatra vyāyāmasyātisantāpasyātiniṣeviṇāmiti prayogaḥ prayujyate| śītetyādi śītoṣṇādīnāṃ tu yadā yena krameṇa sevyatvamuktaṃ, tadvaiparītyena tān sevamānānām| gharma ātapaḥ| ajīrṇādhyaśināmityādi| ajīrṇamanagnipakvamannaṃ, carvaṇamiti yāvat, tadbhojinām| adhyaśinām, āhāra evāpariṇate bhuñjānānām| aśināmiti ajīrṇādhibhyāṃ saha sambadhyate| pañcakarmāpacāriṇāmiti pañca karmāṇi vamanavirekādīni, teṣāmapacāriṇāṃ vyāpattvayoginām| navānnadadhimatsyātīti, atiśabdo navānnādiguḍāntaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| vyavāyaṃ cāpyajīrṇe'nne ityādi| vyavāyaṃ maithunaṃ, vidagdharūpe ajīrṇe; divā ca nidrāṃ bhajatām| dharṣayatāmiti abhibhavatām| pāpaṃ karma ca kurvatāmityanenaiva viprādidharṣaṇe labdhe punastadvacanaṃ viśeṣārthapratipādakam| doṣadūṣyasaṅgrahamāha– vātādaya ityādi| vātādīnāṃ tritve pratīte'pi traya iti vacanaṃ sarvakuṣṭheṣu militānāmeva trayāṇāṃ duṣṭipradarśanārtham| dravyasaṅgraha iti dravyamārambhakaṃ kāraṇamucyate| yathā– “rasanārtho rasastasya dravyamāpaḥ kṣitistathā|” iti| arthalabdhamapi saptakamiti padaṃ sarvatra saptakaniyamārthaṃ punaruktam| nanu, visarpāṇāmapyutpattyādau etāvatyeva sāmagrī| yaduktam– “raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣāstrayo malāḥ| visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ||” iti| tatkuṣṭhavisarpayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate– kuṣṭhaṃ cirakriyaiḥ sthirairaprabalaraktapittairdoṣairjanyate, visarpastvaciravisaraṇaśīlaiḥ prabalaraktapittaiḥ, kuṣṭhe gurupradharṣaṇaparadravyāpahārādayo nimittaṃ, na visarpe| anye tvāhuḥ– visarpā vātādibhirekaikaśo'pi bhavanti, yaduktam– “pṛthaktrayastribhiścaiko visarpā dvandvajāstrayaḥ|” iti; kuṣṭhaṃ tridoṣajameveti| kintvayaṃ samādhiḥ tridoṣajatve'pi visarpāṇāmekadoṣakuṣṭhavadekadoṣajatvakīrtanaṃ saṅgatamiti na manoharam| kuṣṭhasaṅkhyāmāha– ata ityādi| ata ityasmāddoṣadūṣyasamudāyātsapta tathā ekādaśa kuṣṭhāni jāyante| sapta caikādaśaiveti vicchedapāṭhena saptānāṃ mahākuṣṭhatvamekadaśānāṃ kṣudratvamiti bodhayati||1-6||

div.ab: kuṣṭhāni saptadhā doṣaiḥ pṛthagdvandvaiḥ samāgataiḥ | sarveṣvapi tridoṣeṣu vyapadeśo'dhikastvataḥ ||7|| (vā. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: kuṣṭhānāṃ tridoṣajatve'pi ulbaṇadoṣeṇa saptaprakāratāmāha– kuṣṭhānītyādi| doṣaiḥ pṛthak trayaḥ, dvandvaistrayaḥ, samāgataiḥ sannipātaireka iti saptatvam| vyapadeśo'dhikaṃ tvataḥ iti yathā– vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālamityādi||7||

kuṣṭhānāṃ tridoṣajatve'pyudrekadoṣeṇa saptaprakāratvamāha– kuṣṭhānītyādi| kuṣṭhāni saptadhā saptaprakārāṇi, kathamityāha pṛthagdoṣaiḥ vātena, pittena, śleṣmaṇā, trīṇi; tathā taireva doṣairdvandvairvātapittābhyāṃ, vātakaphābhyāṃ, kaphapittābhyāṃ trīṇi, tathā taireva doṣaiḥ samāgataiḥ sannipatitairekam, iti saptatvam| nanvevaṃ satyekadoṣajaṃ dvidoṣajaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tatsarvaṃ tridoṣajaṃ syādityāha– sarveṣvityādi| sarveṣvapi kuṣṭheṣu tridoṣajeṣu ayamevameva pāṭhamūrīkaroti| satsvadhikatvataḥ adhikatvādvyapadeśo nirdeśaḥ kāryaḥ, sannipātasya samaviṣamatvāt; yathā– vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālamityādi||7||

div.ab: atiślakṣṇakharasparśasvedāsvedavivarṇatāḥ | dāhaḥ kaṇḍūstvaci svāpastodaḥ koṭhonnatirbhramaḥ ||8|| vraṇānāmadhikaṃ śūlaṃ śīghrotpattiścirasthitiḥ | rūḍhānāmapi rūkṣatvaṃ nimitta'lpe'tikopanam ||9|| romaharṣo'sṛjaḥ kārṣṇyaṃ kuṣṭhalakṣaṇamagrajam | (vā. ni. a. 14) |

pūrvarūpamāha– atiślakṣṇetyādinā| atiślakṣṇaḥ atimasṛṇaḥ| kharo rūkṣaḥ ‘atiślakṣṇo vā kharo vā sparśaḥ (kharaḥ karkaśaḥ)|’ iti pā.| (kharaḥ karkaśaḥ), atiślakṣṇo vā kharo vā sparśaḥ| svedāsvedau svedavahasroto'varodhānavarodhakṛtau| svāpaḥ sparśājñānam| koṭhonnatiḥ varaṭīdaṣṭasaṅkāśaḥ śothaḥ koṭhaḥ, tasyonnatiḥ| śīghrotpattiścirasthitiśca vraṇānāmeva| nimitte'lpe'tikopanamiti anyathā'pi duṣṭaśoṇitatvādvraṇānāṃ dehagatānāmalpe'pi hetau kopaḥ| kuṣṭhalakṣaṇamagrajamiti kuṣṭhānāṃ pūrvarūpamityarthaḥ||8-9||–

pūrvarūpamāha– atītyādi| atiślakṣṇādikaṃ kuṣṭhalakṣaṇamaprajamiti kuṣṭhānāṃ pūrvarūpamityarthaḥ| atiślakṣṇa iti atimasṛṇaḥ, kharo rūkṣaḥ, atra ‘atha vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| atiślakṣṇo vā kharaḥ sparśaḥ| svedā'svedāviti svedavahasrotovarodhānavarodhakṛtau| vivarṇatā vaivarṇyaṃ, dāhaḥ sarvāṅgīṇaḥ, kaṇḍūḥ tvaci, svāpaḥ sparśājñatvaṃ, koṭhonnatiḥ varaṭīdaṃśasaṅkāśaḥ śophaḥ koṭhaḥ tasyonnatiḥ, ‘bhramaḥ’ ityatra ‘śramaḥ’ iti pā.| śramo'nāyāsajaḥ| śīghrotpattiścirasthitiḥ vraṇānāmeva| alpe'pi nimitte kopo vraṇānām||8-9||–

kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ yadrūkṣaṃ paruṣaṃ tanu ||10|| kāpālaṃ todabahulaṃ tatkuṣṭhaṃ viṣamaṃ smṛtam | rugdāharāgakaṇḍūbhiḥ parītaṃ romapiñjaram ||11|| udumbaraphalābhāsaṃ kuṣṭhamaudumbaraṃ vadet | śvetaṃ raktaṃ sthiraṃ styānaṃ snigdhamutsannamaṇḍalam ||12|| kṛcchramanyonyasaṃyuktaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalamucyate | karkaśaṃ raktaparyantamantaḥśyāvaṃ savedanam ||13|| yadṛṣyajihvasaṃsthānamṛṣyajihvaṃ taducyate | saśvetaṃ raktaparyantaṃ puṇḍarīkadalopamam ||14|| sotsedhaṃ ca sarāgaṃ ca puṇḍarīkaṃ taducyate | śvetaṃ tāmraṃ tanu ca yadrajo ghṛṣṭaṃ vimuñcati ||15|| prāyaścorasi tat sidhmamalābukusumopamam | yat kākaṇantikāvarṇaṃ sapākaṃ tīvravedanam ||16|| tridoṣaliṅgaṃ tat kuṣṭhaṃ kākaṇaṃ naiva sidhyati | (ca. ci. a. 7) |

saptamahākuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha– kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhamityādi| kṛṣṇāruṇakapālābhaṃ kṛṣṇāruṇakapālavarṇaṃ, kapālaṃ ‘śarkarāśakalam’ iti pā., ‘karkarāśakalam’ iti ca pā.| kharparaśakalam| paruṣaṃ kharasparśam| tanu tanutvak, viṣamaṃ duścikitsyam| ‘audumbaramāha– rugityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | audumbaramāha– rugityādi| romapiñjaramiti romabhiḥ piñjaraṃ kapilaromamityarthaḥ| ‘maṇḍalakuṣṭhamāha– śvetetyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | maṇḍalakuṣṭhamāha– śvetetyādi| sthiraṃ kaṭhinaṃ, ‘styānaṃ sāndraṃ sadalaṃ vā|’ iti pā.| styānamārdraṃ sajalaṃ vā| utsannamaṇḍalamudgatamaṇḍalam| kṛcchraṃ kṛcchrasādhyam| anyonyasaṃyuktamiti aparāparairmilitam| ‘ṛṣyajihvamāha– karkaśamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ṛṣyajihvamāha– karkaśamityādi| ṛṣyajihvasaṃsthānamiti ṛṣyo nīlāṇḍo hariṇaḥ, ‘‘robhu’ iti prasiddhaḥ,’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ‘robhu’ iti prasiddhaḥ, tasya jihvākāram| ‘puṇḍarīkamāha– saśvetamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | puṇḍarīkamāha– saśvetamityādi| puṇḍarīkadalopamamiti puṇḍarīkaṃ raktapadmaṃ tatpatropamaṃ, tena saśvetaṃ raktaparyantam| sarāgamiti salohitaṃ, madhye ‘saśvetalohitamityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| śvetalohitamityarthaḥ| ‘sidhmalakṣaṇamāha– śvetamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sidhmalakṣaṇamāha– śvetamityādi| śvetaṃ tāmramiti śvetalohitātmakam| prāyaścorasītyurasi tadbāhulyena bhavati, kaphapradhānatvāt| prāyograhaṇādanyatrāpi bhavati| ‘kākaṇamāha– yadityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kākaṇamāha– yadityādi| yat kākaṇantikāvarṇamiti kākaṇantikā guñjā| guñjāsavarṇatvena ca madhye kṛṣṇamante raktam, athavā madhye raktamante kṛṣṇam| kuṣṭhatvenaiva ‘tridoṣajalakṣaṇatve’ iti pā.| tridoṣalakṣaṇatve siddhe tridoṣaliṅgamiti punaruktaṃ prabaladoṣatrayaliṅgatvopadarśanārtham| iti saptamahākuṣṭhāni| mahattvaṃ caiṣāṃ śīghramuttarottaradhātvavagāhanabahudoṣajatvakriyābhūyastvayogāt||10-16||–

saptamahākuṣṭhānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha– kṛṣṇetyādi| kṛṣṇāruṇā ye sphuṭitaghaṭyāḥ khaṇḍāstadvarṇam, anye kṛṣṇāruṇakapālaśarkarāvarṇamāhuḥ| rūkṣaṃ rūkṣasparśaṃ, paruṣaṃ kharasparśam| tanu tanutvak, todabahulaṃ todāḍhyaṃ, viṣamaṃ duścikitsyam| audumbaraṃ kuṣṭhamāha– rugityādi| rugdāharāgakaṇḍūbhiryuktaṃ, romapiñjaramiti romabhiḥ piñjaraṃ kapilaroma ityarthaḥ| udumbaraphalābhāsaṃ pakvodumbaravarṇam| maṇḍalakuṣṭhamāha– śvetamityādi| evaṃvidhaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ maṇḍalasañjñayocyate, śvetaṃ raktaṃ tadābhāsaṃ, sthiraṃ kaṭhinaṃ, styānaṃ sāndraṃ sadalaṃ vā, utsannamaṇḍalaṃ unnatamaṇḍalaṃ, kṛcchraṃ kṛcchrasādhyaṃ, ayamevameva pāṭhamūrīkaroti| anyonyasaṃsaktamiti, ‘aparāparairmilitam’ iti pā.| parasparairmilitam| ‘yadṛkṣajihvasaṃsthānamṛkṣajihvam’ iti pā.| ṛkṣajihvamāha– karkaśamityādi| karkaśaṃ kharasparśam| ṛkṣo nīlāṇḍo hariṇa iti, anye ṛkṣaḥ ‘rīcha’ ityāhuḥ, tajjihvākāram| puṇḍarīkamāha– saśvetamiti| puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, tasyopamaṃ, tena saśvetaṃ raktaparyantaṃ madhye śvetaṃ prānteṣu raktam| sotsedhamunnatam| sarāgamiti prānte'dhikarāgapratipādakaṃ, sarāgamityatra ‘sadāham’ iti kvacitpāṭhaḥ| sidhmalakṣaṇamāha– śvetamityādi| śvetaṃ tāmramiti śvetalohitātmakaṃ, tanu aghanaṃ, yat ghṛṣṭaṃ sadrajaścūrṇaṃ muñcatīti| prāyaścorasītyādi| urasi bāhulyena bhavati, kaphapradhānatvāt| prāyograhaṇādanyatrāpi boddhavyam| kākaṇamāha– yadityādi| kākaṇantikā guñjā, tatsamavarṇatvena madhye kṛṣṇamante'tiraktam, athavā raktamante kṛṣṇaṃ, tathā sapākaṃ, tathā tīvravedanaṃ, tathā tridoṣaliṅgaṃ, tat kākaṇākhyaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ naiva sidhyati| kuṣṭhatvenaiva tridoṣaliṅgatve siddhe tridoṣaliṅgamiti punaruktaṃ ‘tat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tat prabaladoṣatrayaliṅgopadarśanārtham| iti sapta mahākuṣṭhāni| mahattvaṃ caiṣāṃ śīghramuttarottaradhātvavagāhanabahuladoṣajanyatvakriyābhūyastvayogāt||10-16||–

asvedanaṃ mahāvāstu yanmatsyaśakalopamam ||17|| tadekakuṣṭhaṃ, carmākhyaṃ bahalaṃ hasticarmavat | śyāvaṃ kiṇakharasparśaṃ paruṣaṃ ‘kiṭṭibham’ iti pā., ‘kiṭṭimam’ iti pā., ‘kiṭimam’ iti vā pā. | kiṭibhaṃ smṛtam ||18|| vaipādikaṃ pāṇipādasphuṭanaṃ tīvravedanam | kaṇḍūmadbhiḥ sarāgaiścaḥ gaṇḍairalasakaṃ citam ||19|| sakaṇḍūrāgapiḍakaṃ dadrumaṇḍalamudgatam | raktaṃ saśūlaṃ kaṇḍūmat sasphoṭaṃ ‘dalayatyapi’ iti pā. | yadgalatyapi | taccarmadalamākhyātaṃ saṃsparśāsahamucyate ||20|| (ca. ci. a. 7) | sūkṣmā bahvyaḥ piḍakāḥ srāvavatyaḥ pāmetyuktāḥ kaṇḍumatyaḥ sadāhāḥ | saiva sphoṭaistīvradāhairupetā jñeyā pāṇyoḥ kacchurugrā sphicośca ||21|| sphoṭāḥ śyāvāruṇābhāsā visphoṭāḥ syustanutvacaḥ | raktaṃ śyāvaṃ sadāhārti śatāruḥ syādbahuvraṇam ||22|| sakaṇḍūḥ piḍakā śyāvā bahusrāvā vicarcikā | (ca. ci. a. 7) |

ataḥ paramekādaśakṣudrakuṣṭhānyucyante– asvedanamityādi| mahāvāstu mahāsthānam| matsyaśakalopamamiti matsyasya tvaksadṛśam| carmākhyaṃ carmakuṣṭham| ‘bahulamapattalam’ iti pā.| bahalamapattalam| ‘kiṭibhamāha– śyāvamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kiṭibhamāha– śyāvamityādi| kiṇakharasparśamiti kiṇo vraṇasthānam| paruṣaṃ rūkṣam| vaipādikamiti vipādikāyāḥ svārthe'ṇ| ‘alasakamāha– kaṇḍūmadbhirityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | alasakamāha– kaṇḍūmadbhirityādi| gaṇḍairiti sphoṭaiḥ| ‘dadrumaṇḍalamāha– kaṇḍvityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | dadrumaṇḍalamāha– kaṇḍvityādi| dadrumaṇḍalamiti maṇḍalarūpatayotpādāt dadrumaṇḍalamiti kīrtanam| nanu, kathamasya carake kṣudratvenābhidhānaṃ, suśrute mahākuṣṭhe dadroruktatvāt; tathā sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhe, suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭhe darśitam| ucyate– asitā dadruravagāḍhamūlā suśrute mahākuṣṭham, asitetaradadruścarake'navagāḍhamūlā kṣudrakuṣṭhaṃ, suśrute asitetaradadrvā visarpakuṣṭhe'ntarbhāvaḥ, visarpaṇayogāt; tathā'vagāḍhaṃ sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhaṃ, sidhmapuṣpikā tu tvaṅmātragatā suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭham; asitadadrau asitasidhmano'varodha iti gadādharaḥ| jejjaṭastvāha– carakoktaṃ sidhmaiva suśrute dadruśabdābhihitaṃ, nāmabhedaḥ kevalaṃ paraṃ na vastubhedaḥ, santi hyarthāntarāṇi samānaśabdābhihitānītyavirodhaḥ| kintviyamasādhvī vyākhyā, lakṣaṇavailakṣaṇyāt; kiñca carakasuśrutayoḥ kuṣṭhaṃ prati bahuprakāro virodhaḥ, tathāhi suśrutoktamaruṇaṃ na carake paṭhyate, maṇḍalaṃ carakoktaṃ na suśrute, kṣudrakuṣṭhe carakoktacarmākhyālasakaśatāruprabhṛtīni na suśrute, ‘suśrutoktakṣudrakuṣṭhārakasādayaśca’ iti pā.| suśrutoktakṣudrakuṣṭhālasakādayaśca na carake; tasmādayaṃ samādhirucitaḥ– kuṣṭhānāmasaṅkhyeyatvamiti kecit carake, kecit suśrute kuṣṭhaprakārā ucyante| uktaṃ hi carake– “kuṣṭhaṃ saptavidham, aṣṭādaśavidham, asaṅkhyeyaṃ vā|” (ca. ni. a. 5) iti| ‘carmadalamāha– raktamityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | carmadalamāha– raktamityādi| yadgalatyapīti galati vidīryate| ‘śatārumāha– raktetyādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śatārumāha– raktetyādi| śatāruriti bahuvraṇayogānvitaṃ nāma| ‘vicarcikāmāha– sakaṇḍvityādi|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vicarcikāmāha– sakaṇḍvityādi| sakaṇḍūḥ piḍakā śyāvā bahusrāvā vicarciketi atra kaphakāryaṃ kaṇḍūḥ, bahusrāvatvaṃ pittāt, śyāvatvaṃ vātāt; evaṃ sarvatra doṣatrayaliṅgamūhyam| nanu, ekakuṣṭhamārabhya vicarcikāparyantena dvādaśakṣudrakuṣṭhāni bhavanti, tat kathamekādaśeti? ucyate– vicarcikaiva pādayorbhavantī vidāraṇayogādvipādikā bhavati, tena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “doṣāḥ pradūṣya tvaṅmāṃsaṃ pāṇipādasamāśritāḥ| piḍakāṃ janayantyāśu dāhakaṇḍūsamanvitām|| dālyate tvak kharā rūkṣā pāṇyorjñeyā vicarcikā| pāde vipādikā jñeyā sthānānyatvādvicarcikā||” iti gadādharaḥ| anye tvāhuḥ– saiva sphoṭaistīvradāhairityabhidhānena pāmaiva tīvradāhabṛhatsphoṭayuktā ‘kacchurna’ iti pā.| kacchūḥ, na tato bhinneti||17-22||–

ab.seg: ataḥ prabhṛtyekādaśa kṣudrakuṣṭhānyāha– ‘tatraiva kuṣṭhamāha’ iti pā.| tatra carmakuṣṭhamāha– asvedanamityādi| tadekakuṣṭhaṃ nāma, atra ‘yad’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| asvedanaṃ svedarahitaṃ, mahāvāstu ‘mahāsthānam’ iti pā.| mahādhiṣṭhānam| matsyaśakalopamamiti matsyatvakkhaṇḍasadṛśam| carmakuṣṭhamāha– hasticarmavat, bahulamapattalam| kiṭṭibhamāha– śyāvamitvādi| tat kiṭṭibhanāma kuṣṭhaṃ smṛtam| śyāvaṃ śyāvavarṇaṃ, kiṇakharasparśamiti kiṇo vraṇasthānaṃ, tadvat kharasparśaṃ karkaśaṃ, paruṣaṃ rūkṣaṃ, kiṭṭibhākhyaṃ kuṣṭham| vaipādikamāha– pāṇipādayoḥ sphuṭanaṃ vidāraṇaṃ, vaipādikaṃ kuṣṭham| alasakuṣṭhamāha– kaṇḍūmadbhiriti| gaṇḍaiḥ sphoṭaiḥ, citaṃ yuktam, alasakākhyaṃ kuṣṭham| dadrumaṇḍalamāha– sakaṇḍūrāgāḥ kaṇḍūrāgasaṃyuktāḥ piḍakā yatra tat sakaṇḍūrāgapiḍikaṃ, tathā udgatamutsannam, evaṃvidhaṃ maṇḍalaṃ yat, tad dadrunāma kuṣṭham| nanu, kathamasyāścarake kṣudratvenābhidhānaṃ, suśrute mahākuṣṭhatveneti, tathā sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhe, suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭhe darśitaṃ? ucyate– asitā dadruravagāḍhamūlā suśrute mahākuṣṭham, asitetaradadvrā visarpakuṣṭhe'ntarbhāvaḥ, visarpaṇayogāt| tathā sidhma carake mahākuṣṭhe, sidhmapuṣpikā tu tvaṅmātragatā suśrute kṣudrakuṣṭhamityādi| carmadalamāha– raktamiti| dalayati vidārayati, etādṛśapāṭhābhiprāyeṇa| asparśasahaṃ ca vastrādisparśanākṣamaṃ, taccarmadalanāma| pāmāmāha– sūkṣmā iti| evaṃvidhāḥ piḍakāḥ pāmā ityuktā vaidyairityarthaḥ| bahvyaḥ prabhūtāḥ, srāvavatyaḥ srāvayuktāḥ, kaṇḍūmatyaḥ kaṇḍūyuktāḥ| kacchumāha– saiveti| saiva pāmā pāṇyoḥ hastayoḥ| sphicoḥ kaṭiprothayośca kacchuḥ kathyate| tīvradāhaiḥ tīvrasantāpaiḥ, sphoṭairityarthaḥ| sphoṭamāha– sphoṭā iti| sugamam| śatārumāha– raktamiti| śatāruriti bahuvraṇayogādanvitaṃ nāma| vicarcikāmāha– sakaṇḍūriti| sakaṇḍūḥ piḍakā bhavet| śyāvā varṇataḥ, bahusrāvā bhūriprasrāvā| atra kaphakāryaṃ kaṇḍūḥ, bahusrāvatvaṃ pittāt, śyāvatvaṃ vātāt, evaṃ sarvatra doṣatrayaliṅgamūhyam| nanvekakuṣṭhamārabhya vicarcikāparyantena dvādvaśa kuṣṭhāni bhavanti, tat kathamekādaśetyucyate– vicarcikaiva ‘pādayorbhavati’ iti pā.| pādayorbhavantī vidāraṇayogād vipādikā ‘bhavati’ iti pā.| kathyate, tena ‘na’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “doṣāḥ pradūṣya tvaṅmāṃsaṃ pāṇipādasamāśritāḥ| piḍakā janayantyāśu dāhakaṇḍūsamanvitām|| dahyate tvak kharā rūkṣā pāṇyorjñeyā vicarcikā| pāde vipādikā jñeyā sthānānyatvādvicarcikā||” iti||17-22||

div.ab: kharaṃ śyāvāruṇaṃ rūkṣaṃ vātāt kuṣṭhaṃ savedanam ||23|| pittāt ‘prakuthitam’ iti pā. | prakvathitaṃ dāharāgasrāvānvitaṃ matam | kaphāt kledi ghanaṃ snigdhaṃ sakaṇḍūśaityagauravam ||24|| dviliṅgaṃ dvandvajaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ, triliṅgaṃ sānnipātikam |25|

doṣatrayaniyataṃ kuṣṭhaliṅgamāha– kharaṃ śyāvāruṇamityādi| śyāvāruṇamiti śyāvaṃ vā aruṇaṃ vā bhavati| carake kuṣṭhamadhikṛtya doṣaviśeṣakuṣṭhajanakahetūnāṃ parasparaṃ jñāpyajñāpakatvamuktaṃ; yathā– “kuṣṭhaviśeṣairdoṣāḥ doṣaviśeṣaiḥ upalabdhacarakasaṃhitāmūle ‘punaśca’ iti pā.| punaḥ kuṣṭhāni| jñāyante upalabdhacarakasaṃhitāmūle ‘tairheturhetustāṃśca’ iti pā., madhukośavyākhyāpratiṣu tu ‘tairhetubhistāṃśca’ iti pā., ‘te hetuṃ hetustāṃśca’ iti ca pā.| te hetuṃ hetustāṃśca prakāśayati||” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti||23-24||–

doṣatrayaniyataṃ kuṣṭhaliṅgamāha– kharamityādi| śyāvaṃ atra ‘vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| aruṇaṃ vā bhavati, savedanaṃ vedanāyuktam, etadvātakuṣṭhaṃ jānīyāt| pittācca prakvathitaṃ śaṭitamiva| ‘yuktaṃ ca kaphāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yuktaṃ ca kaphāt kledi klinnatāyuktaṃ, ghanaṃ nibiḍam| dvandvaje kuṣṭhe dvidoṣaliṅgaṃ, sānnipātike tridoṣaliṅgam||23-24||–

tvaksthe vaivarṇyamaṅgeṣu kuṣṭhe raukṣyaṃ ca jāyate ||25|| tvaksvāpo romaharṣaśca svedasyātipravartanam | kaṇḍūrvipūyakaścaiva kuṣṭhe śoṇitasaṃśrite ||26|| bāhulyaṃ vaktraśoṣaśca kārkaśyaṃ piḍakodgamaḥ | todaḥ sphoṭaḥ sthiratvaṃ ca kuṣṭhe māṃsasamāśrite ||27|| kauṇyaṃ gatikṣayo'ṅgānāṃ sambhedaḥ kṣatasarpaṇam | medaḥsthānagate liṅgaṃ prāguktāni tathaiva ca ||28|| nāsābhaṅgo'kṣirāgaśca kṣateṣu krimisambhavaḥ | svaropaghātaśca bhavedasthimajjasamāśrite ||29|| dampatyoḥ kuṣṭhabāhulyādduṣṭaśoṇitaśukrayoḥ | yadapatyaṃ tayorjātaṃ jñeyaṃ tadapi kuṣṭhitam ||30|| (su. ni. a. 5) |

ab.seg: idānīmuttarottarasaptadhātugatakuṣṭhasya lakṣaṇaṃ krameṇāha– tvaksthe vaivarṇyamityādi| tvakśabdenātra raso'bhidhīyate, dhātuprastāvāt; tvakśabdena rasasyābhidhānaṃ tātsthyāt; jejjaṭastu tvacamevāha| bāhyāyāstvacaścarake udakadharatvenokte rasagrahaṇasyānarhatvāddvitīyā'sṛgdharā'troktā, udakācca raso bhinnaḥ; tathāhyuktam– “udakaṃ daśāñjalimitaṃ, raso navāñjalimitaḥ|” (ca. śā. a. 7) iti| rasaṃ vihāya raktādyuktiśca prāgeva rasaṃ kroḍīkṛtya tiryaksirāgatairdoṣaiḥ kuṣṭhajananāt, sirāsu raktavyavasthiteśceti tasyāśayaḥ| sākṣādrasa ityanabhidhānādbṛhatkuṣṭhaṃ rasagataṃ na bhavatīti nāśaṅkanīyam| yataḥ suśrutenaivoktam– “teṣāṃ tu mahattvaṃ sarvadhātvanusāritvāt|” (su. ni. a. 5) iti, sarvaśabdena ca rasasyāpi grahaṇam| bhoje'pyuktam– “praduṣṭāḥ pracyutā doṣā rasāsṛṅmāṃsasaṃśritāḥ| kuṣṭhāni janayantyāśu śarīreṣu śarīriṇām||” iti| “tvaksrāvo romaharṣaśca svedasyātipravartanam|” iti| etat kecit śoṇitagatasyaiva liṅgaṃ manyante, anye rasagatasyeti| iha raukṣyaṃ svedātipravṛttirlomaharṣaśca kuṣṭhārambhakadoṣaiḥ svedavahasrotoduṣṭyā bhavati| yaduktam– “svedavāhiṣu duṣṭeṣu pāruṣyaṃ romaharṣaṇam| atisvedanamasvedaḥ paridāhaśca jāyate||” iti| vipūyaka iti ‘viśeṣaṇam’ iti pā.| viśeṣeṇa pūyayogitvam| kauṇyaṃ karabhaṅgaḥ| aṅgānāṃ sambheda iti aṅgānāṃ bhaṅgaḥ| prāguktāni tathaiva ceti rasaraktamāṃsadhātugatakuṣṭhaliṅgānītyarthaḥ; etaccaikatrābhihitamapi krameṇa parāparadhātuduṣṭau pūrvapūrvadhātuduṣṭiliṅgakhyāpanaparaṃ, nyāyasya samānatvāt| yaducyate– “samāneṣvartheṣvekatrābhihito vidhiranyatrāpyāsañjanīyaḥ|” iti śukragatakuṣṭhaliṅgamāha– dampatyorityādi| kuṣṭhaṃ śukragatamapatyena vyajyata ityarthaḥ| atra śukraduṣṭilakṣaṇaprastāvena tattulyakāryā strīgatā''rtavaduṣṭirapyuktā| tadapītyapiśabdāt pūrvoktānyapi rasādimajjāntargatakuṣṭhaliṅgāni bhavanti| kuṣṭhitamiti sañjātaṃ kuṣṭhamasyeti tārakāditvāditac| atra duṣṭaṃ śukramārtavaṃ vā sarvathā bījatvānupaghātādapatyajanakaṃ, parantu vikṛtaṃ janayatīti draṣṭavyam||25-30||

idānīmuttarottarasaptadhātugatakuṣṭhalakṣaṇaṃ krameṇocyate– tvagityādi| tvakśabdenātra raso vācyaḥ, dhātuprastāvāt; tvakśabdena rasasyābhidhānaṃ, tātsthyāt| bṛhatkuṣṭhaṃ rasagataṃ na bhavatīti na śaṅkanīyaṃ, yataḥ suśrutenoktam– “teṣāṃ tu mahattvaṃ sarvadhātvanusāritvāt|” iti| ataḥ sarvaśabdena rasasyāpi grahaṇam| bhoje'pyuktam– “praduṣṭāḥ pracyutā doṣā rasāsṛṅmāṃsasaṃśritāḥ| kuṣṭhāni janayantyāśu śarīreṣu śarīriṇām||” iti| vaivarṇyamaṅgānāṃ vivarṇatā| raukṣyaṃ ca svedātipravṛttirlomaharṣaśca kuṣṭhārambhakairdoṣaiḥ svedavahasrotoduṣṭyā bhavati| yaduktam– “svedavāhiṣu duṣṭeṣu pāruṣyaṃ romaharṣaṇam| atisvedanamasvedaḥ paridāhaśca jāyate||” iti| raktagatamāha– kaṇḍūrityādi| vipūyaka iti viśeṣeṇa pūyayogitvam| māṃsagatamāha– bāhulyamityādi| bāhulyaṃ sthūlamaṇḍalatā, sphoṭaḥ tvacaḥ sphuṭanaṃ, sthiratvamacalatvam| medogatamāha– kauṇyamityādi| kauṇyaṃ karabhaṅgaḥ, gatikṣayo gamanāśaktiḥ, aṅgānāṃ sambhedaḥ aṅgabhaṅgaḥ, kṣataprasaraṇaṃ, prāguktāni rasaraktamāṃsagataliṅgāni, etaccaikatrābhihitamapi krameṇa parāparadhātuduṣṭau pūrvadhātuduṣṭiliṅgakhyāpanaparaṃ, nyāyasya samānatvāt| yaducyate– “samāneṣvartheṣvekatrābhihito ‘vidhiranyatrāpyāśaṅkanīyaḥ’ iti pā.| vidhiranyatrāpyāsañjanīyaḥ” iti| asthimajjagatamāha– nāsetyādi| nāsāyā bhaṅgo'vadaraṇam, akṣirāgo netralauhityaṃ, kṣateṣu kṛmisambhūtiḥ, svarahāniśca| śukragatakuṣṭhaliṅgamāha– dampatyorityādi| dampatyoḥ strīpuruṣayoḥ, kuṣṭhabāhulyāt śukrārtavayorduṣṭiḥ, śukragatakuṣṭhamapatyena vyajyata ityarthaḥ| atra śukraduṣṭilakṣaṇaprastāvena ca tattulyakāryā strīgatārtavaduṣṭirapyuktā| tadapītyapiśabdāt pūrvoktānyapi rasādimajjāntargatakuṣṭhaliṅgāni bhavanti, anye kuṣṭhilamiti paṭhanti; tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ| tatra duṣṭaṃ śukramārtavaṃ vā sarvathā bījatvānupaghātādapatyajanakaṃ, paraṃ tu vikṛtaṃ janayatīti draṣṭavyam||25-30||

div.ab: sādhyaṃ tvagraktamāṃsasthaṃ vātaśleṣmādhikaṃ ca yat | medasi dvandvajaṃ yāpyaṃ varjyaṃ majjāsthisaṃśritam ||31|| krimitṛḍdāhamandāgnisaṃyuktaṃ yattridoṣajam | prabhinnaṃ prasrutāṅgaṃ ca raktanetraṃ hatasvaram ||32|| pañcakarmaguṇātītaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ hantīha mānavam | (su. sū. a. 33) |

sādhyādibhedamāha– sādhyaṃ tvagraktamāṃsasthamityādi| vātaśleṣmādhikaṃ ca yaditi ‘carmaikakuṣṭhaṃ kiṭibhādi varjyam’ iti pā.| ekakuṣṭhakiṭibhādivarjyam| majjāsthisaṃśritamiti atra majjāsthipratyāsattyā ‘śukrasya tadgatasya ... ’ iti pā.| śukragatasyāpyasādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam| prabhinnamiti vidīrṇam| pañcakarmaguṇātītamiti pūrvarūpakriyayā saha rasādidhātūnāṃ caturṇāṃ kriyākalāpāḥ pañcakarmāṇi, teṣāṃ guṇā vīryāṇi, tānyatīto yaḥ sa tathā, asthimajjāgata ityarthaḥ; tāśca kriyāḥ pūrvarūpe śodhanamubhayataḥ; tvakprāpte śodhanālepanādi, raktaprāpte śodhanālepanakaṣāyapānaśoṇitāvasekādi, evaṃ māṃsamedasorapi draṣṭavyamiti| athavā yaduktam– “kuṣṭheṣu caiva sarveṣu pañcakarmāṇi kārayet| pakṣe pakṣe ca vamanaṃ, māsi māsi virecanam| ṣaṇmāsena sirāmokṣo, nasyaṃ saptadināntaram||” iti kvacitpustake'dhikaḥ pāṭha upalabhyate | pañcakarmāṇi vamanādīni, teṣāṃ guṇāḥ phalāni, tānyatītam||31-32||–

idānīṃ dhātvanukrame'pi sādhyādibhedamāha– sādhyamityādi| tvagraktamāṃsasthaṃ vātaśleṣmādhikaṃ ca yattat sādhyaṃ, vātaśleṣmādhikaṃ ca yaditi ‘carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭṭibha ... ’ iti pā.| carmaikakuṣṭhakiṭibhasidhmālasavipādikā vātaśleṣmajāḥ sādhyāḥ, medogataṃ dvandvajaṃ yāpyam, asthimajjāsaṃśrayaṃ varjyam| atra majjāsthipratyāsattyā śukrasya tadgatasyāpyasādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam| punaścāsādhyalakṣaṇamāha– kṛmītyādi| prabhinnaṃ vidīrṇaṃ, prasrutāṅgaṃ ‘prasrāvayuktaṃ śarīram’ iti pā.| prasrāvayuktaśarīraṃ, hatasvaraṃ ghargharasvaraṃ, pañcakarmaguṇātītaṃ pañcakarmāṇi vamanādīni teṣāṃ guṇāḥ phalāni, tāni niṣphalīkṛtya jātam||31-32||–

vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālaṃ pittenaudumbaraṃ kaphāt ||33|| maṇḍalākhyaṃ vicarcī ca ṛṣyākhyaṃ vātapittajam | carmaikakuṣṭhaṃ kiṭibhaṃ sidhmālasavipādikāḥ ||34|| vātaśleṣmodbhavāḥ śleṣmapittāddadruśatāruṣī | puṇḍarīkaṃ savisphoṭaṃ pāmā carmadalaṃ tathā ||35|| sarvaiḥ syāt kākaṇaṃ pūrvatrikaṃ dadru sakākaṇam | puṇḍarīkarṣyajihve ca mahākuṣṭhāni sapta tu ||36|| (vā. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: kuṣṭheṣu cikitsārthaṃ pradhānaṃ doṣamāha– vātena kuṣṭhaṃ kāpālamityādi| vicarcyapi kaphāttatheti śleṣmapittāt, tena dadruprabhṛti carmadalāntaṃ śleṣmapittajamityarthaḥ| pūrvatrikamiti kāpālodumbaramaṇḍalākhyam| ataḥ saptamahākuṣṭhādanyat kṣudrakuṣṭham||33-36||

div.ab: kuṣṭheṣu cikitsārthaṃ doṣaprādhānyamāha– vātenetyādi| sugamam| anyadapi doṣaprādhānyamāha– carmeti| dadruśatāruṣī dve kuṣṭhe na kevalaṃ śleṣmapittāt, yāvatpuṇḍarīkaṃ tathā visphoṭaṃ tathā pāmā tathā carmadalaṃ jāyate, tatheti śleṣmapittāt; tena dadruprabhṛti carmadalāntaṃ śleṣmapittādhikasannipātajamityarthaḥ| sarvairiti sarvaistribhireva samairdoṣaiḥ kākaṇaṃ nāma kuṣṭhamutpadyate| etāni aṣṭādaśa kuṣṭhāni bhavanti teṣāṃ madhye pūrvaṃ trikamiti kāpālodumbaramaṇḍalākhyaṃ dadru kākaṇaṃ puṇḍarīkamṛkṣajihvaṃ ceti mahākuṣṭhāni syuḥ| ataḥ saptamahākuṣṭhādanyat kṣudrakuṣṭhaṃ boddhavyam||33-36||–

kuṣṭhaikasambhavaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ vāruṇaṃ bhavet | nirdiṣṭamaparisrāvi tridhātūdbhavasaṃśrayam ||37|| vātādrūkṣāruṇaṃ, pittāttāmraṃ kamalapatravat | sadāhaṃ romavidhvaṃsi kaphācchvetaṃ ghanaṃ guru ||38|| sakaṇḍūraṃ kramādraktamāṃsamedaḥsu cādiśet | varṇenaivedṛgubhayaṃ kṛcchraṃ taccottarottaram ||39|| (vā. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: tvagduṣṭitulyatvādatraiva kilāsamāha– kuṣṭhaikasambhavamityādi| kuṣṭhena saha ekaṃ samānaṃ viruddhāśanapāpakarmādi sambhavo nidānaṃ yasya tattathā, kuṣṭhena saha samānacikitsitatvaṃ ca boddhavyaṃ, “kuryāccāsmai kuṣṭhoktaṃ vidhānam” iti vacanāt| carake tvasya hetuviśeṣo'pi paṭhyate, yathā– “vacāṃsyatathyāni kṛtaghnabhāvo nindā gurūṇāṃ gurudharṣaṇaṃ ca| pāpakriyā pūrvakṛtaṃ ca karma hetuḥ kilāsasya virodhi cānnam||” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti| kilāsameva māṃsamedaḥsamāśrayaṇayogatvādaruṇaṃ śvitraṃ ca bhaṇyate| tvaggatameva kilāsaṃ, tasya lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiṣṭamaparisrāvīti| srāvo hi raktādiduṣṭyā bhavati, tenāsya tvaggatatvena srāvābhāvaḥ| uktaṃ ca– “tvaggataṃ ca yadasrāvi tat kilāsaṃ prakīrtitam|” iti| tridhātūdbhavasaṃśrayamiti tridhātustrayo doṣāstathā raktamāṃsamedāṃsi saṃśrayo'dhiṣṭhānaṃ yasya tattathā; athavā tridhātuḥ raktamāṃsamedāṃsi udbhavāya saṃśrayo yasya tattathā, doṣāstu sarvasādhāraṇatvāt labhyanta eva| nanu, yadi dhātutrayāśritaṃ kilāsaṃ, tat kathaṃ “yadā tvacamatikramya taddhātūnavagāhate| hitvā kilāsasañjñāṃ ca kuṣṭhasañjñāṃ labhettadā||” iti viśvāmitravacanaṃ kilāsasañjñāpratikṣepakaṃ na virudhyate? tathā “tvaggatameva kilāsaṃ” (su. ni. a. 5) iti suśrute'vadhāraṇaṃ viruddham? ucyate– viśvāmitravacanasya tāvadayamarthaḥ pratyetavyaḥ– yadoktaraktādigatasamastakuṣṭhalakṣaṇajanakatayā dhātūnavagāhate tadā na tat kilāsaṃ, kiṃ tarhi kuṣṭhajanakahetvantarabṛṃhitadoṣopaplavāt dhātūn dūṣayet, tathā ‘hetulabdhalakṣaṇa ... ’ iti pā.| hetulakṣyalakṣaṇamaruṇādikuṣṭhaṃ tat; anyaditararaktādigatakuṣṭhaliṅgavyatiriktamutpādasamakālabhāviraktatāmrādi-varṇatāmātrakārakaṃ raktādigatadoṣajanyaṃ kilāsameva, anyathā raktādigatakilāsalakṣaṇena carakoktena virodhaḥ syāt| sa yadāha– “doṣe raktāśrite raktaṃ, tāmraṃ māṃsasamāśrite| śvetaṃ medaḥsthite śvitraṃ, guru taccottarottaram||” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti| carake hi kilāsasyaiva dhātutrayasambandhakṛtavarṇena dāruṇādisañjñāntaramātraṃ kṛtaṃ, suśrute'pi tvaggatamevetyanena raktādiduṣṭyā viśiṣṭaraktādigatamahākuṣṭhaliṅgarahitatvaṃ, tathā kṣudrakuṣṭhavadyugapadraktalasīkātvaṅmāṃsasandūṣakatvavirahaḥ khyāpyate; athavā evakāro'yogavyavacchede, yathā– nīlaṃ sarojaṃ bhavatyeveti| uktaprakāreṇa ‘dhātutrayamātratvenaikadoṣajatvena’ iti pā.| dhātutrayamātragatatvenaikadoṣajatvena cāsya kuṣṭhādbhedaḥ; “śvitrasañjñāṃ labhettadā” iti jejjaṭapāṭhe tu śvitrasañjñāmātravyavahāraḥ kilāsasya, na punararthabhedaḥ kaściditi| bhālukinā tu dhātubhedena kilāsasya sañjñāntaraṃ darśitam– “vāruṇaṃ tattu vijñeyaṃ māṃsadhātusamāśrayam| medaḥśritaṃ bhavecchvitraṃ, dāruṇaṃ raktasaṃśrayam||” iti| tathā carake'pi– “dāruṇaṃ vāruṇaṃ śvitraṃ kilāsaṃ nāmabhistribhiḥ|” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti| tenehāpi tathā boddhavyam| kramādraktamāṃsamedaḥsu cādiśedvarṇenaivedṛgubhayamiti īdṛśameva ‘varṇenāruṇatāmraśvetena’ iti pā.| varṇenāruṇaṃ tāmraṃ śvetaṃ ca kilāsaṃ raktamāṃsamedaḥsu yathākrameṇādiśet| ubhayamiti vraṇajaṃ doṣajaṃ ca tacchvitraṃ bhavati, tathāca bhojaḥ– “śvitraṃ tu dvividhaṃ vidyāddoṣajaṃ vraṇajaṃ tathā| tatra mithyopacārāddhi vraṇasya vraṇajaṃ smṛtam|| doṣajaṃ ca dvidhā proktamātmajaṃ parajaṃ tathā| parasaṃskārasaṃsparśādyattat parajamucyate| tadātmajaṃ vijānīyādyaddeheṣvanilādijam||” iti| raktādidhātutrayagatasya ca kilāsasya dūṣyaprabhāvādyasya kasyāpi doṣasya sambandhaniyatā evāruṇādayo varṇā boddhavyāḥ, yadi tu tatra doṣaniyato varṇaḥ kalpyate tadā varṇātideśo vyarthaḥ syāt, vātādrūkṣāruṇamityādinaiva siddhatvāt| yadyevaṃ doṣeṇātra varṇābhidhānaṃ viphalaṃ, nirviṣayatvāt; naivaṃ, tvaṅmātragate kilāse doṣavarṇasya caritārthatvāt| hanta tarhi kathaṃ raktādigatatvamasya niścetavyaṃ? tvaggate svabhāvenāruṇādivarṇasya sadbhāvena sandigdhatvāt| ucyate– krameṇāruṇādivarṇotpādādraktādigatatvaṃ niścetavyam, utpattimātre tvaruṇādiyogāttvaggatatvamiti||37-39||

tvagduṣṭitulyatvādatraiva kilāsamāha– kuṣṭhaikasambhavamiti| kuṣṭhena saha ekaḥ samānaḥ viruddhāśanapāpakarmādi sambhavo nidānaṃ yasya tattathā, kuṣṭhatulyanidānamityarthaḥ| kuṣṭhena saha samānacikitsitatvaṃ ca boddhavyam| “kuryāccāsmai kuṣṭhaduṣṭaṃ vidhānam|” iti vacanāt| carake tvasya hetuviśeṣo'pi paṭhyate| yathā– “vacāṃsyatathyāni kṛtaghnabhāvo nindā gurūṇāṃ gurudharṣaṇaṃ ca| pāpakriyā pūrvakṛtaṃ ca karma hetuḥ kilāsasya virodhi cānnam||” iti| kilāsameva māṃsamedaḥsamāśrayeṇa yogitvāddāruṇaṃ śvitramiti bhaṇyate| tvaggatameva kilāsaṃ, tasya lakṣaṇaṃ nirdiṣṭam– aparisrāvīti| srāvo hi raktādiduṣṭyā bhavati, tenāsya tvaggatatvena srāvābhāvaḥ| uktañca– “tvaggataṃ tu yadasrāvi tatkilāsaṃ prakīrtitam|” iti| tridhātūdbhavasaṃśrayamiti tridhātuśabdena pṛthagdoṣāḥ, atra ‘śukravidhāḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| tridhātuḥ saṃśrayo yasya tattathā, athavā tridhātuḥ raktamāṃsamedāṃsi, tena vātādinā pṛthagudbhava utpādastathā raktamāṃsamedāṃsi saṃśrayo'dhiṣṭhānaṃ yasya tattathā| vātādinā dhātusaṃśrayabhedena varṇabhedamāha– vātādityādi| vātāt śvitraṃ rūkṣaṃ sparśataḥ, aruṇaṃ raktaṃ varṇataḥ| pittādityādi| pittāt śvitraṃ kamalapatravat padmadalamiva tāmraṃ varṇena bhavet| tathā sadāhaṃ dāhayuktam| romavidhvaṃsi romaghāti| kaphāditi kaphāt śvitraṃ śvetaṃ śuklaṃ, ghanaṃ sāndraṃ, tathā guru aṅgenānubhūyate, tathā saha kaṇḍvā vartate iti ‘sakaṇḍu ca’ iti pā.| sakaṇḍu kaṇḍuyuktam| kramādraktamāṃsamedassu cādiśet varṇenaivedṛgubhayamiti īdṛśameva varṇenāruṇatāmraśvetena kilāsaṃ raktamāṃsamedassu yathākrameṇādiśet| ubhayamiti vraṇajaṃ doṣajamiti tat śvitraṃ bhavati| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “śvitraṃ taddvividhaṃ vidyāddoṣajaṃ vraṇajaṃ tathā| tatra mithyopacārāddhi vraṇasya vraṇajaṃ smṛtam|| doṣajaṃ dvividhaṃ proktamātmajaṃ parajaṃ tathā| parasaṃskārasaṃsparśādyattatparajamucyate|| tadātmajaṃ vijānīyādyaddeheṣvanilādijam|” iti||37-39||

div.ab: aśuklaromā'bahulamasaṃśliṣṭamatho navam | anagnidagdhajaṃ sādhyaṃ śvitraṃ varjyamato'nyathā ||40|| guhyapāṇitalauṣṭheṣu jātamapyacirantanam | varjanīyaṃ viśeṣeṇa kilāsaṃ siddhimicchatā ||41|| (a. saṃ. ni. a. 14) |

ab.seg: tasya sādhyatvamasādhyatvaṃ cāha– aśukletyādi| aśuklaroma kṛṣṇaroma, abahulaṃ tanu, asaṃśliṣṭaṃ parasparamasaṃyuktam, anagnidagdhajaṃ agnidagdhajaṃ yanna bhavati, etat sādhyam| ato'nyathā ‘anyathokta ... ’ iti pā.| ato'nyathoktasarvaprakāramasādhyaṃ, carake'pyevaṃvidhasyāsādhyatvamuktam| yathā– ‘yatparasparato'bhinnaṃ bahu yadraktalomavat’ iti vartamānacarakapratiṣu pāṭhaḥ| “yacchuklaroma bahulaṃ yat saṃlagnaṃ parasparam| yacca varṣagaṇopetaṃ tacchvitraṃ naiva sidhyati||” (ca. ci. a. 7) iti| guhyapāṇitalauṣṭheṣviti talamatra pādatalaṃ suśrute ‘ante jātam’ iti sāmānyena nirdeśāt||40-41||

tasya sādhyā'sādhyatvamāha– aśukletyādi| aśuklaroma yāvanna romāṇi śuklāni bhavanti, abahulaṃ tanu, asaṃśliṣṭaṃ mithaḥ parasparamasaṃyuktam, agnidagdhajaṃ yanna bhavati; etatsādhyam| ato'nyathā uktaprakāraviparītamasādhyam| yaduktaṃ carake– “yat śuklaroma bahulaṃ yatsaṃlagnaṃ parasparam| yacca varṣagaṇopetaṃ tacchvitraṃ naiva siddhyati||” iti| asādhyamāha– guhyetyādi| eṣu sthāneṣvanavamapi tyājyam| guhyaṃ liṅgaṃ, talamatra pādatalam||40-41||

div.ab: prasaṅgādgātrasaṃsparśānniḥśvāsāt sahabhojanat | ekaśayyāsanāccaiva vastramālyānupalenāt ||42|| kuṣṭhaṃ jvaraśca śoṣaśca netrābhiṣyanda eva ca | aupasargikarogāśca saṅkrāmanti narānnaram ||43|| (su. ni. a. 5) |

ab.seg: kuṣṭhasya saṃsargajaprasaṅgena sarvāneva saṃsargajān rogānāha– prasaṅgādityādi| prasaṅgo maithunam, athavā prasaṅgaḥ sātatyaṃ; tena kṛtāt gātrasaṃsparśādeḥ| aupasargikarogā iti ‘aupasargikaromāḥ śītalikādayaḥ’ iti ḍalhaṇaḥ| aupasargikāḥ pāparogādayo bhūtopasargajāśca| saṅkrāmanti āviśanti| rogasaṅkrāntiśca kuṣṭhiprabhṛtipāpijanasaṃsargeṇa pāpasaṅkrāntervikāraprabhāvādvā boddhavyā||42-43||

kuṣṭhasya saṃsargajatvaprasaṅgenaiva saṃsargajān rogānāha– prasaṅgādityādi| prasaṅgo maithunam, athavā prasaṅgo nairantaryaṃ, tena kṛtāt gātrasparśādeḥ| aupasargikarogādayo bhūtopasargajā rogāḥ| saṅkrāmanti āviśanti| rogasaṅkrāntiśca kuṣṭhiprabhṛtipāpijanasaṃsargeṇa pāpasaṅkrāntervikāraprabhāvādvā boddhavyā||42-43||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne kuṣṭhanidānaṃ samāptam ||49||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ kuṣṭhanidānaṃ samāptam||49||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyapraṇītāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ kuṣṭhanidānam||49||
atha śītapittodarda-koṭhanidānam | śītamārutasaṃsparśāt praduṣṭau kaphamārutau | pittena saha sambhūya bahirantarvisarpataḥ ||1||

tvagduṣṭidoṣatrayajanyatvasāmānyāt kuṣṭhānantaraṃ śītapittodardādinidānam| tasya doṣatrayajanyatvamāha– śītamārutasaṃsparśādityādi| pittena saha sambhūyeti svahetūpacitena pittena sambhūya militvā| bahirantariti bahistvaci, antaḥ śoṇitādau; visarpataḥ prasarataḥ||1||

tvagduṣṭidoṣatrayajanyatvasāmānyātkuṣṭhānantaraṃ śītapittādinidānam| tasya doṣatrayajanyatvamāha– śītetyādi| praduṣṭau kupitau kaphamārutau svahetūpacitena pittena saha militvā, bahistvaci, antaḥ śoṇitādau, visarpataḥ prasarataḥ||1||
pipāsārucihṛllāsadehasādāṅgagauravam | raktalocanatā teṣāṃ pūrvarūpasya lakṣaṇam ||2||
pūrvarūpamāha– pipāsetyādi| raktalocanatā prabhāvāt| pūrvarūpasya lakṣaṇamiti pūrvarūpasya svarūpamityarthaḥ; na tu lakṣaṇamatra liṅgaṃ, pipāsādivyatiriktasya pūrvarūpasyābhāvāt||2||

tasya pūrvarūpamāha– pipāsetyādi| atra raktalocanatā prabhāvāt| pūrvarūpasya lakṣaṇamiti pūrvarūpasyopalambhanaṃ, na tu lakṣaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ; ‘pipāsādervyatiriktasya’ iti pā.| pipāsādivyatiriktasya pūrvarūpasyābhāvāt||2||
varaṭīdaṣṭasaṃsthānaḥ śothaḥ sañjāyate bahiḥ | sakaṇḍūstodabahulaśchardijvaravidāhavān ||3||
udardamiti taṃ vidyācchītapittamathāpare | vātādhikaṃ śītapittamudardastu kaphādhikaḥ ||4||

udardalakṣaṇamāha– varaṭītyādi| sakaṇḍūstodabahulaśchardijvaravidāhavāniti atra kaṇḍūḥ kaphāt, todo vātāt, chardijvaravidāhāḥ pittāditi doṣatrayaliṅgam| anayoḥ śītapittodardayoḥ samānasaṃsthānatve'pi vātādhikaṃ śītapittaṃ, kaphādhika udardaḥ||3-4||

udardalakṣaṇamāha– varaṭītyādi| varaṭī kīṭaviśeṣaḥ, taddaṣṭasadṛśākāraḥ, bahiḥ śarīre śotho jāyate| atra kaṇḍūḥ kaphāt, todo vātāt, chardijvaravidāhāḥ pittāditi doṣatrayaliṅgam; apare śītapittamityāhuḥ| anayordoṣadvayādhikatvamāha– vātādhikamityādi| anayoḥ śītapittodardayoḥ samānasaṃsthānatve'pi vātādhikaṃ śītapittaṃ, kaphādhika udardaḥ||3-4||
sotsaṅgaiśca sarāgaiśca kaṇḍūmadbhiśca maṇḍalaiḥ | śaiśiraḥ kaphajo vyādhirudarda iti kīrtitaḥ ||5||
udardasya dharmāntaramāha– sotsaṅgairityādi| utsaṅgaiḥ madhyanimnaiḥ| śaiśira iti śiśirasambhavaḥ||5||
udardasya dharmāntaramāha– sotsaṅgairityādi| madhyanimnaiḥ, śaiśiraḥ śiśirasambhavaḥ||5||
asamyagvamanodīrṇapittaśleṣmānnanigrahaiḥ | maṇḍalāni sakaṇḍūni rāgavanti bahūni ca | utkoṭhaḥ sānubandhaśca koṭha ityabhidhīyate ||6||

tvagduṣṭisāmyādatraiva koṭho'bhidhīyate– asamyagvamanetyādi| asamyaktvaṃ vamanasyāyogamithyāyogādinā, tathodīrṇānāṃ pittaśleṣmānnānāṃ nigraho vegavidhāraṇaṃ, tairmaṇḍalāni jāyante, sa koṭhaḥ| athavā'yamarthaḥ– asamyagvamanodīrṇau pittaśleṣmāṇau, tathā'nnanigraha upasthitavegasyānnasya nigrahaḥ chardinigrahaḥ iti yāvat, tairhetubhirbhavanti| vamanasya cāsamyaktvamayogamithyāyogābhyāṃ jñeyam, atiyogasya tu ‘pittaśleṣmakopakatvāt’ iti pā.| pittaśleṣmakoṭhākaratvāt| etena hetulakṣaṇabhedādbhinnaḥ koṭha udardāt| koṭho niranubandhaḥ| tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ|” iti sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate| sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavanena||6||

tvagdoṣasāmānyādatraiva koṭhaḥ procyate| sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate| atra ‘sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavatveneti| tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate|’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| asamyaktvaṃ vamanasyāyogamithyāyogādinā, udīrṇāni preritāni pittaśleṣmānnāni, teṣāṃ nigrahaiḥ śarīre maṇḍalāni vartulakamalādīni atikaṇḍumanti lauhityayuktāni bahūni ca jāyante, athavā'yamevārthaḥ– asamyagvamanenodīrṇau pittaśleṣmāṇau, tathā'nnanigrahaḥ upasthitavegasyānnasya nigrahaḥ chardinigraha iti yāvat, tairbhavanti| vamanasya cāsamyaktvamayogamithyāyogābhyāṃ jñeyam, atiyogasya pittaśleṣmakopakatvāt, etena hetulakṣaṇabhedādbhinnaḥ koṭha udardāditi| koṭho niranubandhaḥ, agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tathā coktam– “kṣaṇikotpādavināśaḥ koṭha iti nigadyate tajjñaiḥ” iti| sānubandha utkoṭho'bhidhīyate| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sānubandhatā ca punaḥpunarbhavaneneti||6||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne śītapittodardakoṭhānidānaṃ samāptam ||50||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śītapittodardakoṭhanidānaṃ samāptam||50||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śītapittodardakoṭhanidānam||50||
athāmlapittanidānam | viruddhaduṣṭāmlavidāhipittaprakopipānānnabhujo vidagdham | pittaṃ svahetūpacitaṃ purā yattadamlapittaṃ pravadanti santaḥ ||1||

koṭhahetau pittaśleṣmollekhāt pittaśleṣmamilanarūpasyāmlapittasya nidānam| nidānapūrvakamamlapittasya svarūpamāha– viruddhetyādi| viruddhaṃ kṣīramatsyādi, duṣṭaṃ vyāpannamannaṃ; vidāhisthāne vidagdheti pāṭhāntare vidagdhaṃ bharjitaṃ; pittaprakopipānānnabhuja iti pittaprakopi pānaṃ takrasurādi, annamāśudhānyamāṣādi; pittaprakopipānānnagrahaṇenaivāmlavidāhino grahaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣārthaṃ; ‘pittaprakopaṇādyannabhuja’ iti pāṭhāntare ādiśabdāt kaphādiprakopaṇamannaṃ gṛhyate| evaṃvidhapānānnamupabhuñjānasya vidagdhaṃ kupitaṃ, svahetūpacitaṃ purā yaditi varṣāsu jalauṣadhigatavidāhādibhiḥ svahetubhirupacitaṃ sañcayamāpannam| yaduktam– “varṣāsvamlavipākitvādadbhirauṣadhibhistathā|” (ca. ci. a. 3) iti| vidāhādyamlaguṇodriktaṃ pittamamlapittam||1||

koṭhahetau pittakaphollekhāt pittakaphamilitarūpasyāmlapittasyāto'nantaraṃ nidānam| tatra nidānapūrvakamamlapittasya svarūpamāha– viruddhetyādi| viruddhaṃ kṣīramatsyādi, duṣṭaṃ vyāpannamannam| vidāhisthāne ‘vidagdha’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra vidagdhaṃ bharjitam| pittaprakopipānānnabhuja iti pittaprakopi pānaṃ takrasurādi, annamāśudhānyamāṣādi, ‘pittaprakopaṇādyannabhujaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare ādiśabdāt kaphādiprakopaṇamannaṃ gṛhyate, evaṃvidhapānānnaṃ bhuñjānasya vidagdhaṃ kupitaṃ, svahetūpacitaṃ purā yaditi varṣāsu jalauṣadhigatavidāhādibhirhetubhiḥ upacitaṃ sañcayamāpannaṃ, yaduktam– “varṣāsvamlavipākitvādadbhiroṣadhibhistathā” iti| pittaprakopipānānnagrahaṇenaivāmlavidāhino grahaṇe siddhe tadabhidhānaṃ viśeṣārtham||1||
avipākaklamotkleśatiktāmlodgāragauravaiḥ | hṛtkaṇṭhadāhārucibhiścāmlapittaṃ vadedbhiṣak ||2||
tasya liṅgamāha– avipāketyādi| avipāka ityāhārāpākaḥ, klamo'nāyāsajaḥ śramaḥ| amlapitte pittaṃ pradhānaṃ, vātakaphāvapyatrānugau gauravodgārakampādinā jñeyau||2||
tasya liṅgamāha– avipāketyādi| avipākaḥ āhārāpākaḥ, klamo'nāyāsajaḥ śramaḥ, amlapitte pittaṃ pradhānaṃ, vātakaphāvapyatrānugau gauravodgārakampādinā jñeyau||2||
tṛḍdāhamūrchābhramamohakāri prayātyadho vā vividhaprakāram | hṛllāsakoṭhānalasādaharṣasvedāṅgapītatvakaraṃ kadācit ||3||

tasya kadācidadha-ūrdhvagamanabhedāddvividhasyādhogatiṃ tāvadāha– tṛḍdāhetyādi| mūrchā sarvathā jñānaśūnyatvaṃ, moho viparītajñānam| prayātyadho vetyatra vāśabdo bhāvyūrdhvagamanāpekṣayā| vividhaprakāramiti haritpītakṛṣṇaraktādibahuvarṇatvadurgandhitvayogānnānāvidham| kadāciditi na sarvakālam||3||

tasya kadācit kāyordhvādhogamanabhedādvividhasyādhogatiṃ tāvadāha– tṛḍityādi| adho vividhaprakāraṃ kadācitprayāti, tathā tṛḍdāhādikāri, tathā hṛllāsādikaraṃ, mūrchā sarvathā jñānaśūnyatvaṃ, moho'tra viparītaṃ jñānam| prayātyadho vetyatra vāśabdo bhāvyūrdhvagamanāpekṣayā; vividhaprakāramiti haritapītakṛṣṇaraktādibahuvarṇatvadurgandhitvayogānnānāvidham| kadāciditi na sarvakālam||3||
vāntaṃ haritpītakanīlakṛṣṇamāraktaraktābhamatīva cāmlam | māṃsodakābhaṃ tvatipicchilācchaṃ śleṣmānujātaṃ vividhaṃ rasena ||4||
bhukte vidagdhe tvathavā'pyabhukte karoti tiktāmlavamiṃ kadācit | udgāramevaṃvidhameva kaṇṭhahṛtkukṣidāhaṃ śiraso rujaṃ ca ||5||
karacaraṇadāhamauṣṇyaṃ mahatīmaruciṃ jvaraṃ ca kaphapittam | janayati ‘ ... roganicayam’ iti pā. | kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakāśatanicitagātrarogacayam ||6||

ūrdhvagatimāha– vāntamityādi| nīlaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇaṃ mardanāñjanavadrūkṣakṛṣṇam, āraktamīṣallohitaṃ, ‘raktābhamantarlohitam’ iti pā.| raktamantarlohitam| māṃsodakābhamiti māṃsadhāvanatoyābhaṃ kṛṣṇalohitamityarthaḥ| vividhaṃ raseneti rasena lavaṇakaṭutiktākhyena nānārūpam| karoti tiktāmlavamimiti tiktasya amlasya vā vamiṃ ‘vāntim’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vāntiṃ karoti| udgāramevaṃvidhameveti atra karotīti sambadhyate, evaṃvidhamiti ‘amlapittam’ iti pā.| amlatiktam| kaṇṭhahṛtkukṣidāhaṃ śiraso rujaṃ ceti atrāpi karotīti sambadhyate| karacaraṇetyādi– kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakāśatanicitagātrarogacayamiti kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ca rogacayaṃ ceti dvandvaḥ, tena kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ‘roganicayam’ iti pā.| rogacayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ; ‘roganicayo ... ’ iti pā.| rogacayo'vipākotkleśādiḥ||4-6||

ūrdhvagatimāha– vāntamityādi| harit śākapatrābham, nīlaṃ cāṣapakṣaprabhaṃ snigdhakṛṣṇaṃ, kṛṣṇam añjanābham, āraktam īṣallohitaṃ, raktam atyantalohitaṃ, māṃsodakābhaṃ māṃsadhāvanatoyābham, acchaṃ nirmalam| vividhaṃ rasena lavaṇakaṭutiktākhyenānurūpaṃ karoti| āhārasyāvasthāmāha– bhukta ityādi| bhukte āhāre vidagdhe athavā kadācidabhukte'pi sati tiktāmlavamiṃ karotīti sambadhyate| amlapitte kaphapittavatsāmānyamāha– karetyādi| kaphapittaṃ karacaraṇadāhādikaṃ janayati, tathā kaṇḍūmaṇḍalapiḍakācitagātraroganicayamiti kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ca roganicayaśceti dvandvaḥ| tena kaṇḍvādinicitagātraṃ ‘roganicayaḥ ... ’ iti pā.| rogacayaṃ karotītyarthaḥ| ‘roganicayaḥ ... ’ iti pā.| rogacayaḥ avipākotkleśādiḥ||4-6||
rogo'yamamlapittākhyo yatnāt saṃsādhyate navaḥ | cirotthito bhavedyāpyaḥ, kṛcchrasādhyaḥ sa kasyacit ||7||
sādhyatvādikamāha– roga ityādi| kṛcchrasādhyaḥ sa kasyaciditi ahitāhārācāraśīlinaḥ kasyaciccirotthito'pi kṛcchrasādhyaḥ||7||
sādhyatvādikamāha– roga ityādi| ayamamlapittākhyo rogo navaḥ san yatnātsaṃsādhyate, cirotthito yāpyo bhavet| kasyacidityādi| ahitāhārācāraśīlinaḥ kasyaciccirotthito'pi kṛcchrasādhya ityarthaḥ||7||
sānilaṃ sānilakaphaṃ sakaphaṃ tacca lakṣayet | doṣaliṅgena matimān bhiṣaṅmohakaraṃ hi tat ||8||

kampapralāpamūrchācimicimigātrāvasādaśūlāni | tamaso ‘darśanavibhramapramohaharṣāṇyanilakopāt’ iti pā., ‘darśanavibhramaharṣaṇamohāśca vātayute’ iti vā pā. | darśanavibhramavimohaharṣāṇyanilakopāt ||9||
kaphaniṣṭhīvanagauravajaḍatāruciśītasādavamilepāḥ | dahanabalasādakaṇḍūnidrāścihnaṃ kaphānugate ||10||
ubhayamidameva cihnaṃ mārutakaphasambhave bhavatyamle | tiktāmlakaṭukodgārahṛtkukṣikaṇṭhadāhakṛt ||11||
bhramo mūrchāruciśchardirālasyaṃ ca śirorujā | praseko mukhamādhuryaṃ śleṣmapittasya lakṣaṇam ||12||

tatraiva ‘kevalānilakaphamilitānilakaphamātrāṇām’ iti pā.| kevalānilakaphānilakaphamātrāṇāṃ saṃsargamāha– sānilamityādi| bhiṣaṅmohakaramiti tasyordhvādhaḥpravartamānatvena chardyatīsārābhyāṃ sakāśādbhedasya ‘durjñānatvāt vaidyasya mohakaratvam|’ iti pā.| durjñeyatvāt vaidyamohakaratvam| ‘kaphetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kaphetyādi– sādavamilepā ityatra sādo'ṅgasādaḥ, lepaḥ śleṣmaliptāsyatā| dahanabalasādeti sādaśabdo dahanabalābhyāṃ sambadhyate||8-12||

tasminnanilakaphasaṃsargamāha– sānilamityādi| taccāmlapittaṃ sānilaṃ savātaṃ, sānilakaphaṃ savātakaphaṃ lakṣayet| doṣaliṅgena vātapittakaphaliṅgenetyarthaḥ| yatastadbhiṣaṅmohakaraṃ vaidyabhrāntijanakaṃ, tasyordhvādhaḥpravartamānatvena chardyatīsārābhyāṃ bhedasya ‘durjñānatvāt’ iti pā.| durjñeyatvāt| sānilasyāmlapittasya lakṣaṇamāha– kampetyādi| ‘vibhramaharṣaṇamohāśca vātayute’ iti pā.| vātayute'mle kampādayastathā tamodarśanādayo bhavanti| kaphānugatasya lakṣaṇamāha– kaphetyādi| kaphānugate'mle kaphaniṣṭhīvanādiliṅgaṃ syāt| sādavamilepā iti sādaḥ aṅgasādaḥ, lepaḥ kaphaliptāsyatā| dahanabalasādeti sādaśabdo dahanabalābhyāṃ sambandhyate, anyatsugamam||8-12||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne'mlapittanidānaṃ samāptam ||51||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmlapittanidānaṃ samāptam||51||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāmamlapittanidānam||51||

div.head: visarpanidānam
div.ab: atha visarpanidānam | lavaṇāmlakaṭūṣṇādisaṃsevādoṣakopataḥ | visarpaḥ saptadhā jñeyaḥ sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt ||1|| pṛthak trayastribhiścaiko visarpā dvandvajāstrayaḥ | vātikaḥ paittikaścaiva kaphajaḥ sānnipātikaḥ ||2|| catvāra ete vīsarpā vakṣyante ‘dvandvaśāstrataḥ’ iti pā. | dvandvajāstrayaḥ | āgneyo vātapittābhyāṃ granthyākhyaḥ kaphavātajaḥ ||3|| yastu kardamako ghoraḥ sa pittakaphasambhavaḥ |4| (ca. ci. a. 21) | ‘ ... vighātādraktaduṣṭau’ iti pā.|

amlapittasambhavacchardervegavidhāraṇādraktaduṣṭau satyāṃ ‘ ... sāmānyāt’ iti pā.| visarpotpatterhetusāmyāt tadanantaraṃ visarpanidānam| chardivegavighātasya raktadūṣakatve carakavacanaṃ yathā– “ ‘chardivegavighātāttu’ iti pā.| chardivegapratīghātāt kāle cānavasevanāt| ‘śaratkālasvabhāvācca’ iti pā.| śaratkālaprabhāvācca śoṇitaṃ sampraduṣyati||” (ca. sū. a. 24) iti| tasya nidānapūrvikāṃ saṅkhyāṃ niruktiṃ cāha– lavaṇāmletyādi| “visarpo na hyasaṃsṛṣṭo raktapittena lakṣyate|” iti vacanāt lavaṇāmlādikaṃ viśeṣeṇa raktapittanidānamuktam| saṃsevayā satatasevayā doṣakopaḥ saṃsevāddoṣakopastataḥ| atra, ādigrahaṇāt carakoktānāṃ ‘ ... piṇḍākīprabhṛtīnām’ iti pā.| haritaśākaśiṇḍākīprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| saptadheti ulbaṇaikaikadoṣajāstrayaḥ, sannipātaja ekaḥ, trayo dvandvajāḥ, iti saptaprakāratvamuktam| sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāditi sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt parisarpaḥ, vividhaṃ sarpāṇādvisarpaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “vividhaṃ sarpati yato visarpastena sa smṛtaḥ| parisarpo'thavā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti||1-3||–

ab.seg: amlapittasambhavacchardervegavighātādraktaduṣṭau satyāṃ visarpotpatterhetusāmānyāccānantaraṃ visarpanidānamāha– chardivegavighātasya ca raktadūṣakatve carakavacanaṃ yathā– “chardivegavighātāttu kāle cānavasevanāt| śaratkālasvabhāvācca śoṇitaṃ sampraduṣyati||” iti| tasya nidānapūrvikāṃ saṅkhyāṃ niruktiṃ cāha– lavaṇetyādi| lavaṇādibhirvisarpo rogo bhavati, sa saptadhā jñeyaḥ| “visarpo na hyasaṃsṛṣṭo raktapittena” iti vacanāllavaṇādikaṃ viśeṣeṇa raktapittanidānamuktam| eṣāṃ santatasevayā doṣakopaḥ| ‘ ... piṇḍākīprabhṛtīnām’ iti pā.| ādigrahaṇāccarakaktaharitaśākaśiṇḍākīprabhṛtīnāṃ grahaṇam| sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt parisarpaḥ, vividhaṃ sarpatīti visarpaḥ| yaduktaṃ carake– “vividhaṃ sarpati yato visarpastena sa smṛtaḥ| parisarpo'tha vā nāmnā sarvataḥ parisarpaṇāt||” iti| saṅkhyāsamprāptimāha– pṛthaktrayastribhiścaiko visarpā dvandvajāstraya ityādi sugamam| āgneya ityādisugamam||1-3||
raktaṃ lasīkā tvaṅmāṃsaṃ dūṣyaṃ doṣāstrayo malāḥ ||4||
visarpāṇāṃ samutpattau vijñeyāḥ sapta dhātavaḥ | (ca. ci. a. 21) tatra vātāt sa vīsarpo vātajvarasamavyathaḥ ||5||
śothasphuraṇanistodabhedāyāsārtiharṣavān | pittāddrutagatiḥ pittajvaraliṅgo'tilohitaḥ ||6||
kaphāt kaṇḍūyutaḥ snigdhaḥ kaphajvarasamānaruk | (vā. ni. a. 13) | sannipātasamutthaśca sarvaliṅgasamanvitaḥ ||7||

sarveṣāmeva raktādidūṣyacatuṣṭayadoṣatrayajanyatvamāha– raktamityādi| visarpasya samānasāmagrīkatve'pi kuṣṭhādbhedaḥ kuṣṭhādhyāye eva nirūpitaḥ| doṣaśabdenaiva vātādigrahaṇe siddhe malā iti ‘yat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yat kṛtaṃ, tadatyarthaduṣṭyā śarīramalinīkaraṇatvaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pratipādayitum| sannipātaje'sādhyatvamapi “sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaśca na siddhimeti|” (su. ni. a. 10) iti vacanāt| tena vikṛtiviṣamasamavetatvamasya| carake tvantarjabahirjabhedena visarpaḥ paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “marmopaghātāt sammohādayanānāṃ vighaṭṭanāt| tṛṣṇātiyogādvegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt|| vidyādvisarpamantarjamāśu cāgnibalakṣayāt| ato viparyayādbāhyamanyaṃ vidyāt svalakṣaṇaiḥ||” (ca. ci. a. 21) iti||4-7||

sarveṣāmeva raktādidūṣyacatuṣṭayajanyatvamāha– raktamityādi| visarpasya samānasāmagrīkatve'pi kuṣṭhādbhedaḥ kuṣṭhādhyāya eva nirūpitaḥ, doṣagrahaṇenaiva vātādigrahaṇe siddhe malā iti yat kṛtaṃ tadatyarthaduṣṭyā śarīramalinīkaraṇatvaṃ doṣāṇāṃ pratipādayitum| ‘asya tvagantare vraṇagatam’ ityādirbodhyaḥ| lasīkājalaṃ, tvakśabdenātra atra ‘tvageva’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| rasasya saptadhātuṣu klṛptatvāt| vātajaṃ visarpamāha– tatretyādi| vātajvarasamavyatha iti ‘vepathurviṣamo vegaḥ’ ityādikaḥ| nistodaḥ śūlena tudyata iva, bhedo vidīryata iva, artiḥ pīḍā, ‘bhedārtyāyāmaharṣavān’ iti pā.| āyāmo vistāravān, harṣo romaharṣaḥ| paittikamāha– pittādityādi| drutagatiḥ śīghragatiḥ| pittajvaraliṅga iti “vegastīkṣṇo'tisāraḥ” ityādikaḥ| atilohito'tiriktaḥ| kaphajamāha– kaphādityādi| kaphajvarasamāna iti “staimityaṃ stimito vegaḥ” ityādikaḥ| sānnipātikamāha– sannipātetyādi| sarvadoṣalakṣaṇairyukta ityarthaḥ| sannipātaje'sādhyatvamuktaṃ “sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaśca na siddhimeti” iti vacanāt| tena vikṛtiviṣamasamavetatvamasya| carake ‘tvasyāntarjabahirjabhedena’ iti pā.| tvantarjabahirjabhedena visarpaḥ paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “marmopatāpātsammohādayanānāṃ ca ghaṭṭanāt| tṛṣṇātiyogādvegānāṃ viṣamaṃ ca pravartanāt| vidyādvisarpamantarjamāśu cāgnibalakṣayāt| ato viparyayādbāhyamanyadvidyātsvalakṣaṇaiḥ||” iti||4-7||

div.ab: vātapittājjvaracchardimūrchātīsāratṛḍbhramaiḥ | granthibhedāgnisadanatamakārocakairyutaḥ ||8|| karoti sarvamaṅgaṃ ca dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavat | yaṃ yaṃ deśaṃ visarpaśca visarpati bhavet sa saḥ ||9|| śāntāṅgārāsito nīlo rakto vā''śu ca cīyate | agnidagdha iva sphoṭaiḥ śīghragatvāddrutaṃ sa ca ||10|| marmānusārī vīsarpaḥ syādvāto'tibalastataḥ | vyathate'ṅgaṃ haret sañjñāṃ nidrāṃ ca śvāsamīrayet ||11|| hikkāṃ ca sa gato'vasthāmīdṛśīṃ labhate na nā | kvaciccharmāratigrasto bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu ||12|| ceṣṭamānastataḥ kliṣṭo manodehapramohavān | duṣprabodho'śnute nidrāṃ so'gnivīsarpa ucyate ||13|| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

ab.seg: āgneyavisarpamāha– vātapittādityādinā| dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavaditi jvaladaṅgāreṇaiva vyāptamaṅgaṃ manyate| śāntāṅgārāsita iti nirvāṇāṅgāravat kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ sa deśo bhavati| nīlo rakto veti sa deśaḥ snigdhanīlo rakto vā bhavati| agnidagdha iveti agnidagdhadeśa iva| śīghragatvāditi śīghrakāritvāt| marmānusārī hṛdayādyanusārī| vyathate'ṅgamityatrāntarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ, tena vyathayatītyarthaḥ| nidrāṃ cetyatra harediti sambadhyate| śarma sukham| duṣprabodho'śnute nidrāmiti nidrāṃ maraṇarūpāṃ prāpnoti||8-13||

vātapittajamāgneyākhyaṃ visarpamāha– vātapittāditi| vātapittajo'yaṃ sañjñeyaḥ| jvarādibhirupadravairyutaḥ| dīptāṅgārāvakīrṇavaditi jvaladaṅgāreṇeva vyāptamaṅgaṃ manyate| śāntāṅgārāsita iti nirvāṇāṅgāravatkṛṣṇavarṇaḥ, nīlaḥ cāṣapakṣivadvā rakto vā sa deśo bhavati| agnidagdha iveti āśu śīghramagnidagdha iva sphoṭairupacīyate vṛddhiṃ nīyate, śīghragatvāt śīghrakāritvāt, drutaṃ śīghraṃ, sa visarpaḥ, marmānusārī hṛdayānusārī, atīva balavān vātaḥ| vyathate'ṅgamiti atrāntarbhāvito ṇyarthaḥ, tena vyathayatītyarthaḥ| nidrāṃ sañjñāṃ ca harennāśayet| śvāsaṃ hikkāṃ ca īrayet prakopayet| īdṛśīmavasthāṃ gato nā puruṣaḥ, kvaciccharma sukhaṃ na prāpnoti, keṣu bhūmiśayyāsanādiṣu, ‘tataḥ’ ityatra ‘svataḥ’ iti pā.| svataḥ ātmanaiva, kliṣṭaḥ pīḍitaḥ, ceṣṭamāno ‘vikṛtāṃ iti pā.| viddhatāṃ ceṣṭāṃ kuryāt, duḥkhaprabodhaḥ manodehaśramodbhavāṃ nidrāṃ maraṇarūpām, aśnute prāpnoti||8-13||

div.ab: kaphena ruddhaḥ pavano bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kapham | raktaṃ vā vṛddharaktasya tvaksirāsnāyumāṃsagam ||14|| dūṣayitvā tu dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanām | granthīnāṃ kurute mālāṃ saraktāṃ tīvrarugjvarām ||15|| śvāsakāsātisārāsyaśoṣahikkāvamibhramaiḥ | mohavaivarṇyamūrchāṅgabhaṅgāgnisadanairyutām ||16|| ityayaṃ granthivīsarpaḥ kaphamārutakopajaḥ |17| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

granthivisarpamāha– kaphena ruddha ityādi| kapheneti svahetukupitena, pavanaḥ svahetukupitaḥ, tena kaphamārutajatvamasyopapannaṃ bhavati| bhittvā taṃ bahudhā kaphamiti kaphaṃ vistārya| raktaṃ veti dūṣayitvetyanena vakṣyamāṇena sambadhyate| dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanāmiti vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, sthūlamucchūnaṃ, kharaṃ kaṭhinam, evaṃrūpāṇāṃ granthīnāṃ mālāṃ karoti, ayaṃ ca granthivisarpaḥ suśrute'pacīsañjñayā paṭhyate||14-16||–

kaphamārutajaṃ granthivisarpamāha– kaphenetyādi| kaphena svahetukupitena, svahetukupitaḥ pavanaḥ, kaphaṃ bhittvā vidārya, raktaṃ ca dūṣayitvetyanena vakṣyamāṇena sambadhyate, vṛddharaktasya manuṣyasya| tvaksirāsnāyumāṃsagamiti raktaviśeṣaṇam| dīrghāṇuvṛttasthūlakharātmanāmiti aṇu sūkṣmaṃ, vṛttaṃ vartulaṃ, sthūlamasūkṣmaṃ, kharaṃ kaṭhinam, evaṃrūpāṇāṃ granthīnāṃ mālāṃ karoti||14-16||–

kaphapittājjvaraḥ stambho nidrā tandrā śirorujā ||17|| aṅgāvasādavikṣepau pralepārocakabhramāḥ | mūrchāgnihānirbhedo'sthnāṃ pipāsendriyagauravam ||18|| āmopaveśanaṃ lepaḥ srotasāṃ sa ca sarpati | prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇannekadeśaṃ na cātiruk ||19|| piḍakairavakīrṇo'tipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ | snigdho'sito mecakābho malinaḥ śothavān guruḥ ||20|| gambhīrapākaḥ prājyoṣmā spṛṣṭaḥ klinno'vadīryate | paṅkavacchīrṇamāṃsaśca ‘ ... śirāgaṇaḥ’ iti pā. | spaṣṭasnāyusirāgaṇaḥ ||21|| śavagandhī ca vīsarpaḥ kardamākhyamuśanti tam |22| (vā. ni. a. 13) |

kardamavisarpamāha– kaphapittādityādi| stambha iti gātrasya stabdhatā, āmopaveśanamāmasya varcasastyajanam| sa ca ‘visarpati’ iti pā.| sarpati prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇannekadeśamiti ‘ ... sthānatvāt’ iti pā.| kaphapittayorāmāśayasthatvāt prāyeṇāmāśaye bhavannekadeśavyāpī bhavatītyarthaḥ| piḍakairiti piḍakābhiḥ| malina iti maladigdhaḥ| gambhīrapāka ityantaḥpākaḥ, prājyoṣmā pracuroṣmā| spaṣṭasnāyusirāgaṇa iti pūtimāṃsagalanena snāyvādīnāṃ spaṣṭatā| kardamākhyamuśanti tamiti taṃ kardamasārūpyāt kardamākhyamicchanti||17-21||–

ab.seg: kaphapittātmakaṃ kardamavisarpamāha– kaphapittādayaṃ jñeyaḥ| stambho gātrasya stabdhatā, aṅgāvasādaḥ aṅgakhedaḥ, vikṣepaḥ aṅgānāmitaścetaśca preraṇam| indriyagauravamiti cakṣurādīnāṃ gauravam| āmopaveśanamityādi| āmasya varcasastyajanam| lepaḥ srotasāṃ śuṣirāṇāṃ liptatā śleṣmādinā| prāyeṇāmāśayaṃ gṛhṇanniti kaphapittayorāmāśayasthānatvāt; prāyeṇāmāśaye bhinnaikadeśavyāpī bhavatītyarthaḥ| na cātipīḍākaraḥ| piḍakaiḥ piḍakābhiravakīrṇo vyāptaḥ, kimbhūtaiḥ atipītalohitapāṇḍuraiḥ| asitaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ, mecakābhaḥ añjanābhaḥ, malino maladigdhaḥ| gambhīrapāka iti antaḥpākaḥ, prājyoṣmā pracuroṣmā| sphuṭasnāyusirāgaṇa iti pūtimāṃsāpagamena snāyvādīnāṃ ‘spaṣṭatā’ ityatra ‘sphuṭatā’ iti pā.| sphuṭatā| kardamākhyamuśanti taṃ kardamasārūpyāt kardamākhyaṃ kathayanti||17-21||
bāhyahetoḥ kṣatāt kruddhaḥ saraktaṃ pittamīrayan ||22||
vīsarpaṃ mārutaḥ kuryāt kulatthasadṛśaiścitam | sphoṭaiḥ śothajvararujādāhāḍhyaṃ śyāvaśoṇitam ||23||
(vā. ni. a. 13) | jvarātisārau vamathustvaṅmāṃsadaraṇaṃ klamaḥ | arocakāvipākau ca visarpāṇāmupadravāḥ ||24||

kṣatavisarpamāha– bāhyahetorityādi| ayaṃ ca pittaje visarpe'ntarbhāvanīyaḥ, tena na saṅkhyādhikyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “śastraprahāraistaistaistu ‘vyāladanta...’ iti pā.| vyāḍadantanakhairapi| kṣate vā'pyathavā bhagne bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ|| raktaṃ pittaṃ ca kupitaṃ vraṇamāśu prapadyate| kurutaste samete tu ‘vraṇaśothe’ iti pā.| vraṇotsedhaṃ sudāruṇam|| ācitaṃ tanuvisphoṭaiḥ kṛṣṇaiḥ pītakasannibhaiḥ| pittavīsarpavalliṅgaṃ tasya śeṣaṃ vinirdiśet||” iti||22-24||

kṣatajamāha– bāhyahetorityādi| śyāvalohitaṃ varṇena| ayaṃ kṣatajo visarpaḥ pittaje'ntarbhāvanīyaḥ, tena na saṅkhyādhikyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “śastraprahāraistaistaistu vyāladantanakhairapi| kṣate vā'pyatha vā bhagne bahudoṣasya dehinaḥ|| raktaṃ pittaṃ ca kupitaṃ vraṇamāśu prapadyate| kurutaste samete tu vraṇotsedhaṃ sudāruṇam|| ācitaṃ vraṇavisphoṭaiḥ kṛṣṇapītasamanvitaiḥ| ‘pittavīsarpaliṅgaṃ ca’ iti pā.| pittavīsarpavalliṅgaṃ tasya śeṣaṃ vinirdeśet||” iti| visarpopadravānāha– jvaretyādi| māṃsadaraṇaṃ māṃsavidaraṇam| śeṣaṃ sugamam||22-24||

div.ab: sidhyanti vātakaphapittakṛtā visarpāḥ sarvātmakaḥ kṣatakṛtaśca na siddhimeti | pittātmako'ñjanavapuśca bhavedasādhyaḥ kṛcchrāśca marmasu bhavanti hi sarva eva ||25|| (su. ni. a. 10) |

ab.seg: sādhyatvādikamāha– sidhyantītyādi| pittātmako'ñjanavapuriti atyantamudriktapitto'ñjanasamavarṇatanuḥ, agnivisarpākhyo na sādhya iti vyākhyānayanti| kṛcchrāśca marmasviti asādhyatvena kṛcchratvaṃ boddhavyam| yadāha bhojaḥ– “varjyastu kṣatajasteṣāṃ sannipātāttu yo bhavet| bhiṣajā jānatā tyājyāḥ sarva eva tu marmajāḥ||” iti||25||

sādhyāsādhyānāha– siddhyantītyādi| ekaikadoṣajanitāstrayaḥ sādhyāḥ, tridoṣajaḥ kṣatajaścāsādhyaḥ| pittātmako'ñjanavapuriti paittiko yo'tyantamudriktapittatvādañjanasavarṇaḥ so'sādhyaḥ, agnivīsarpo na sādhyaḥ; kṛcchrāśca marmasviti asādhyatvaṃ kṛcchratvena boddhavyam| tathā ca bhojaḥ– “tyājyastu kṣatajasteṣāṃ sannipātācca yo bhavet| bhiṣajā jānatā tyājyāḥ sarva eva tu marmajāḥ||” iti||25||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne visarpanidānaṃ samāptam ||52||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ visarpanidānaṃ samāptam||52||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ visarpanidānam||52||

div.head: visphoṭanidānam

ab.seg: atha visphoṭanidānam | kaṭvamlatīkṣṇoṣṇavidāhirūkṣakṣārairajīrṇādhyaśanātapaiśca | tathartudoṣeṇa viparyayeṇa kupyanti doṣāḥ pavanādayastu ||1||
tvacamāśritya te raktamāṃsāsthīni pradūṣya ca | ghorān kurvanti visphoṭān sarvān jvarapuraḥsarān ||2||

prāyeṇa doṣadūṣyacikitsāsāmyādvisphoṭanidānamāha– kaṭvityādi| ajīrṇādhyaśanātapaiśceti ajīrṇāśanamapakvadravyasyāśanam, adhyaśanamajīrṇe bhojanam; athavā ajīrṇaṃ svarūpato heturadhyaśanaṃ ca| ṛtudoṣeṇeti śītoṣṇādīnāmatiyogena| viparyayeṇeti ṛtuviparyayaśca ṛtusvabhāvasyānyathābhāvaḥ| ebhirhetubhiryathāsambhavaṃ pratyekaṃ doṣatrayaprakopo boddhavyaḥ| jvarapuraḥsarānityanena jvarasya pūrvarūpatāṃ darśayati||1-2||

prāyeṇa doṣadūṣyacikitsitatvatulyatvādato'nantaraṃ visphoṭanidānārambhaḥ, tasya nidānamāha– kaṭvityādi| ajīrṇāśanamapakvadravyāśanam| adhyaśanamajīrṇabhojanam| ‘tathartudoṣeṇa’ iti pā.| athartudoṣeṇa viparyayeṇeti śītoṣṇāderatiyogena ṛtudoṣaḥ, ṛtuviparyayaḥ ṛtusvabhāvasyānyathābhāvāt; ebhirhetubhiḥ yathāsambhavaṃ pratyekaṃ doṣatrayaprakopo boddhavyaḥ| visphoṭakasamprāptimāha– tvacamityādi| jvarapuraḥsarānityanena jvarasya pūrvarūpatāṃ darśayati||1-2||

div.ab: agnidagdhanibhāḥ sphoṭāḥ sajvarā raktapittajāḥ | kvacit sarvatra vā dehe visphoṭā iti te smṛtāḥ ||3|| (su. ni. a. 13) | śiroruk śūlabhūyiṣṭhaṃ jvarastṛṭ parvabhedanam | sakṛṣṇavarṇatā ceti vātavisphoṭalakṣaṇam ||4|| jvaradāharujāsrāvapākatṛṣṇābhiranvitam | pītalohitavarṇaṃ ca pittavisphoṭalakṣaṇam ||5|| chardyarocakajāḍyāni kaṇḍūkāṭhinyapāṇḍutāḥ | avedanaścirātpākī sa visphoṭaḥ kaphātmakaḥ ||6|| asmātpūrvaṃ kvacitpustake ‘kaṇḍūrdāho jvaraśchardiretaistu kaphapaittikaḥ’ iti paṅktiḥ upalabhyate vātapittakṛto yastu kurute tīvravedanām | kaṇḍūstaimityagurubhirjānīyāt kaphavātikam ||7|| kvacitpustake agrimapaṅktiḥ ekaślokapūrvaṃ upalabhyate kaṇḍūrdāho jvaraśchardiretaistu kaphapaittikaḥ |8|

visphoṭasvarūpamāha– agnidagdhanibhā ityādi| raktapittajā iti sarvatraiva visphoṭe raktapittayoravyabhicāritvaṃ, yathā śūle vātasya; vātānubandho'pyatra boddhavyaḥ| yadāha bhojaḥ– “yadā raktaṃ ca pittaṃ ca vātenānugataṃ tvaci| agnidagdhanibhān sphoṭān kurutaḥ sarvadehagān|| sajvarān saparīdāhān vidyādvisphoṭakāṃstu tān||” iti||3-7||–

ab.seg: visphoṭakasāmānyaliṅgamāha– agnītyādi| sajvarā iti jvarasteṣāṃ pūrvarūpatvena jñeyaḥ| raktapittajā iti sarvavisphoṭeṣu raktapittayoravyabhicāritvaṃ sūcitaṃ śūleṣu vātasyeva| yaduktaṃ bhoje– “yadā raktaṃ ca pittaṃ ca vātenānugataṃ tvaci| agnidagdhanibhān sphoṭānkurutaḥ sarvadehagān|| sajvarānsaparīdāhān vidyādvisphoṭakāṃstu tān|” iti| kvaciditi kvaciccharīradeśe| vātikavisphoṭamāha– śira ityādi| śūlaṃ śarīrasya todarūpaṃ, parvabhedanaṃ sandhisphuṭanam| paittikamāha– jvaretyādi| sugamam| ślaiṣmikamāha– chardītyādi| ‘vātapaittikamāha– vātetyādi sugamam|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake ‘kaphajaprasaṅgāt kaphapaittikamāha– kaṇḍūrityādi| etairlakṣaṇaiḥ kaphapaittiko jñeyaḥ|’ etatpāṭhasya paścādupalabhyate | vātapaittikamāha– vātetyādi sugamam| kaphajaprasaṅgāt kaphapaittikamāha– kaṇḍūrityādi| etairlakṣaṇaiḥ kaphapaittiko jñeyaḥ| ‘kaphavātikamāha– kaṇḍviti| staimityamiti niścalatvam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kaphavātikamāha– kaṇḍviti| staimityamiti niścalatvam||3-7||
madhye nimnonnato'nte ca kaṭhino'lpaprapākavān ||8||
dāharāgatṛṣāmohacchardimūrchārujājvarāḥ | pralāpo vepathustandrā so'sādhyaḥ syāttridoṣajaḥ ||9||

sānnipātikalakṣaṇamāha– madhya ityādi| madhye nimnonnato'nte ceti madhye nimno'nte connata ityarthaḥ| nimnonnata iti prayogo'siddhasyānityatvena| evaṃ ‘sampūrṇā lakṣaṇe’ iti pā.| sampūrṇalakṣaṇo yastridoṣajaḥ so'sādhyaḥ||8-9||

tridoṣajamāha– madhya iti| madhye nimnaḥ, ante connata ityarthaḥ| ayametādṛśameva pāṭhaṃ manute| alpaprapākata iti alpapākavānityarthaḥ| moha indriyāṇām| evaṃ sampūrṇalakṣaṇo yastridoṣajaḥ so'sādhyaḥ||8-9||
raktā raktasamutthānā guñjāvidrumasannibhāḥ | veditavyāstu raktena paittikena ca hetunā ||10||
na te siddhiṃ samāyānti siddhairyogaśatairapi | ekadoṣotthitaḥ sādhyaḥ kṛcchrasādhyo dvidoṣajaḥ | sarvadoṣotthito ghorastvasādhyo bhūryupadravaḥ ||11||

raktajalakṣaṇamāha– raktā ityādi| raktasamutthānā iti lakṣyapadaṃ, veditavyāstu rakteneti lakṣaṇapadam, aśmarīhetuḥ tatpūrvamiti yathā; ayamarthaḥ– raktasamutthānāśca visphoṭā bhavanti te ca kathaṃ vijñeyā ityata uktam– veditavyāstu raktenati; athavā raktasamutthānā iti raktaṃ samutthāpayantīti nirucya raktacchardanamabhimatamācāryasya, veditavyāstu rakteneti padasya kāraṇadyotakasyāvyavasthānāt| ghoro'tyantaduḥkhadaḥ| bhūryupadrava iti atra visarpokta evopadravo jñeyaḥ||10-11||

raktajamāha– raktā ityādi| raktā raktavarṇāḥ, raktasamutthānā iti raktasamutthānāśca visphoṭā bhavantītyarthaḥ| te ca pittahetubhiḥ kupittena raktena veditavyāḥ, rakteneti lakṣaṇapadaṃ, yathā'śmarīhetu tatpūrvamiti| ghora iti atyantaduḥkhapradaḥ| bhūryupadrava iti bahūpadravaḥ, atra visarpoktā evopadravā jñeyāḥ||10-11||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne visphoṭanidānaṃ samāptam ||53||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ visphoṭanidānaṃ samāptam||53||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ visphoṭanidānam||53||

div.head: masūrikānidānam
div.ab: atha masūrikānidānam | kaṭvamlalavaṇakṣāraviruddhādhyaśanāśanaiḥ | duṣṭaniṣpāvaśākādyaiḥ praduṣṭapavanodakaiḥ ||1|| krūragrahekṣaṇāccāpi deśe doṣāḥ samuddhatāḥ | janayanti śarīre'smin duṣṭaraktena saṅgatāḥ ||2|| masūrākṛtisaṃsthānāḥ piḍakāḥ syurmasūrikāḥ | tāsāṃ pūrvaṃ jvaraḥ kaṇḍūrgātrabhaṅgo'ratirbhramaḥ ||3|| tvaci śothaḥ savaivarṇyo netrarāgaśca jāyate |4|

visphoṭaprabhedatvāt prāyeṇa tulyanidānatvācca masūrikānidānam| tasyā nidānapūrvikāṃ samprāptimāha– kaṭvamletyādi| viruddhādhyaśanāśanairiti viruddhairannairadhyaśanaiśca, ‘viruddhādhyaśanena tu’ iti pāṭho vā| duṣṭaniṣpāvaśākādyairiti duṣṭaṃ vyāpannamannaṃ, niṣpāvaḥ śimbibījam, ādyaśabdānmadhvālukādigrahaṇam| praduṣṭapavanodakairiti viṣakusumādisaṃsparśāt praduṣṭaḥ pavanastathodakaṃ ca, taiḥ| krūragrahekṣaṇācceti śanaiścarādayo deśakṣobhakarāḥ krūragrahāsteṣāmīkṣaṇāt| duṣṭaraktena saṅgatā ityanena raktasya kaṭvamlādibhirhetubhirviśeṣeṇa kopaṃ darśayati| ata evoktaṃ tantrāntare– “pittaṃ śoṇitasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ yadā dūṣayati tvacam| tadā karoti piḍakāḥ sarvagātreṣu dehinām|| masūramudgamāṣāṇāṃ tulyāḥ kolopamā api| masūrikāstu tā jñeyāḥ pittaraktādhikā budhaiḥ||” iti||1-3||–

sphoṭāḥ śyāvāruṇā rūkṣāstīvravedanayā'nvitāḥ ||4|| kaṭhināścirapākāśca bhavantyanilasambhavāḥ | sandhyasthiparvaṇāṃ bhedaḥ kāsaḥ kampo'ratiḥ klamaḥ ||5|| śoṣastālvoṣṭhajihvānāṃ tṛṣṇā cārucisaṃyutā |6|
vātajāmāha– sphoṭā ityādi| cirapākā iti vikāraprabhāvāt||4-5||–

raktāḥ ‘pītāḥ sitāḥ’ iti pā. | pītāsitāḥ sphoṭāḥ sadāhāstīvravedanāḥ ||6|| bhavantyacirapākāśca pittakopasamudbhavāḥ | viḍbhedaścāṅgamardaśca dāhastṛṣṇā'rucistathā ||7|| mukhapāko'kṣirāgaśca jvarastīvraḥ sudāruṇaḥ |8|
pittajāmāha– raktā ityādi| jvarastīvraḥ sudāruṇa iti tīvraścaṇḍavegaḥ, sudāruṇo bahuduḥkhenātiduḥsaha||6-7||–

ab.seg: raktajāyāṃ bhavantyete vikārāḥ pittalakṣaṇāḥ ||8||
kaphaprasekaḥ staimityaṃ śirorug gātragauravam | hṛllāsaḥ sārucirnidrā tandrālasyasamanvitāḥ ||9||
śvetāḥ snigdhā bhṛśaṃ sthūlāḥ kaṇḍūrā mandavedanāḥ | masūrikāḥ kaphotthāśca cirapākāḥ prakīrtitāḥ ||10||

raktajāmāha– raktajāyāmityādi| ete vikārāḥ pittalakṣaṇā iti pittajamasūrīlakṣaṇatvena uktāḥ| ‘ ‘raktāḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | raktāḥ ‘pītāḥ sitāḥ’ iti pā.| pītāsitāḥ sphoṭā’ ityādayo ye ye vikārāste raktajāyāṃ bhavanti| atra kaphajāmanuktvaiva pittajāyā anantaraṃ raktajāyā uktiḥ pittalakṣaṇasyātidiṣṭasyāvyavahitatvena sukhagrahaṇārthaṃ, raktarasasamatvāt raktamalatvādvā pittasya pittajāmabhidhāya asyāḥ kathanaṃ, sarvatra kṛtasya samarthanāya||8-10||
ab.note: ādyāḥ sārdhasaptaślokāḥ sugamatvānna vyākhyātāḥ, lekhakapramādādvā teṣāṃ vyākhyānaṃ paribhraṣṭamiti na niścīyate||

ab.seg: raktajāmāha– raktajāyāmityādi| ete vikārāḥ pittamasūrikālakṣaṇatvena ye uktāḥ ‘raktāḥ ‘pītāḥ sitāḥ’ iti pā.| pītāsitāḥ sphoṭāḥ’ ityādayo ye vikārāḥ te raktajāyāṃ bhavanti| kaphajāmāha– śvetā ityādi| sugamam||8-10||
nīlāścipiṭavistīrṇā madhye nimnā mahārujāḥ | cirapākāḥ pūtisrāvāḥ prabhūtāḥ sarvadoṣajāḥ ||11||
kaṇṭharodhārucistambhapralāpāratisaṃyutāḥ | duścikitsyāḥ samuddiṣṭāḥ piḍakāścarmasañjñitāḥ ||12||
sānnipātikalakṣaṇamāha– nīlā ityādi| cipiṭavistīrṇā iti cipiṭaḥ ‘ciuḍā’ iti khyātaḥ, tadvadvistṛtāḥ| carmasañjñitā iti ‘carmadala’ iti khyātāḥ||11-12||

sannipātajāmāha– nīlā ityādi| nīlāścāṣapakṣapratimāḥ| cipiṭavistīrṇā iti cipiṭāściuḍā iti khyātāḥ, tadvadvitatāḥ| madhye nimnā ityukte prāntonnatatvaṃ jñeyam| prabhūtāḥ pracurāḥ kaṇṭharodhaḥ kaṇṭhagrahaḥ, pralāpo'baddhabhāṣaṇaṃ, duścikitsyāḥ asādhyāḥ, carmasañjñitā iti ‘ ‘cāghamāṃsa’ iti pā.| cāmaghāṃsa’ iti khyātaḥ||11-12||
romakūponnatisamā rāgiṇyaḥ kaphapittajāḥ | kāsārocakasaṃyuktā romāntyo jvarapūrvikāḥ ||13||
masūrikāyāḥ prakāraṃ romāntikāmāha– romakūponnatisamā ityādi| rāgiṇya iti lohitāḥ, jvarapūrvikā iti jvarapūrvarūpāḥ||13||
masūrikāyāḥ prakārāntaraṃ romāntikāmāha– rometyādi| romakūpocchrāyāḥ, rāgiṇya iti lohitāḥ, jvarapūrvikā iti jvarapūrvarūpāḥ||13||
toyabudbudasaṅkāśāstvaggatāstu masūrikāḥ | svalpadoṣāḥ prajāyante bhinnāstoyaṃ sravanti ca ||14||
raktasthā lohitākārāḥ śīghrapākāstanutvacaḥ | sādhyā nātyarthaduṣṭāśca bhinnā raktaṃ sravanti ca ||15||
māṃsasthāḥ kaṭhināḥ snigdhāścirapākā ghanatvacaḥ | gātraśūlatṛṣākaṇḍūjvarāratisamanvitāḥ ||16||
medojā maṇḍalākārā mṛdavaḥ kiñcidunnatāḥ | ghorajvaraparītāśca sthūlāḥ snigdhāḥ savedanāḥ ||17||
sammohāratisantāpāḥ kaścidābhyo vinistaret | kṣudrā gātrasamā rūkṣāścipiṭāḥ kiñcidunnatāḥ ||18||
majjotthā bhṛśasammohavedanāratisaṃyutāḥ | chindanti marmadhāmāni prāṇānāśu haranti hi ||19||
bhramareṇeva viddhāni kurvantyasthīni sarvataḥ | pakvābhāḥ piḍakāḥ snigdhāḥ sūkṣmāścātyarthavedanāḥ ||20||
staimityāratisammohadāhonmādasamanvitāḥ | śukrajāyāṃ masūryāṃ tu lakṣaṇāni bhavanti hi ||21||
nirdiṣṭaṃ kevalaṃ cihnaṃ dṛśyate na tu jīvitam | doṣamiśrāstu saptaitā draṣṭavyā doṣalakṣaṇaiḥ ||22||
tvaggatā raktajāścaiva pittajāḥ śleṣmajāstathā | śleṣmapittakṛtāścaiva sukhasādhyā masūrikāḥ ||23||

rasādisaptadhātugatamasūrikāliṅgamāha– toyabudbudasaṅkāśā ityādi| atra duṣṭadūṣyaprabhāvāt toyabudbudasaṅkāśādīni doṣalakṣaṇāni ca bhavanti, doṣamantareṇa dūṣyaduṣṭerabhāvāt; ata eva vakṣyati– “doṣamiśrāśca saptaitā draṣṭavyā doṣalakṣaṇaiḥ|” iti| tvakśabdenātra raso'bhidhīyate, dhātugataprastāvāt| tvaggatāḥ sādhyāḥ, alpadoṣasambandhādraktajāyā api sādhyatvenābhidhānāt| māṃsasthāḥ kṛcchrasādhyāḥ, atyavagāḍhadoṣaduṣṭeḥ| medojāyāṃ kaścidābhyo vinistaredityanenātyantakṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ bodhayati, ‘ ... majjaḥ’ iti pā.| asthimadhyasthitatvānmajjñaḥ| kṣudrā ityādinā asthimajjagatayoḥ samānaṃ liṅgam| majjotthā ityatra majjagrahaṇādasthno'pi grahaṇam, ādhāratvāt; ata eva vakṣyati– “bhramareṇeva viddhāni kurvantyasthīni sarvataḥ|” iti| marmadhāmānīti marmasthānāni| pakvābhā ityādinā śukrajāyā liṅgam| dṛśyate na tu jīvitamiti gambhīradhātugatadoṣaduṣṭeḥ śukrajāyā asādhyatvam| asya nyāyasya samānatayā asthimajjagatayorapyasādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam||14-23||

rasādisaptadhātugatamasūrikāyā liṅgamāha– toyetyādi| atra duṣṭadūṣyaprabhāvāttoyabudbudasaṅkāśādīni lakṣaṇāni doṣalakṣaṇāni ca bhavanti, doṣamantareṇa dūṣyaduṣṭerabhāvāt| ata eva vakṣyati– “doṣamiśrāstu saptaitā draṣṭavyā doṣalakṣaṇaiḥ|” iti| tvakśabdenātra raso gṛhyate, dhātugataprastāvāt| tvaggatāḥ sādhyāḥ, svalpadoṣasambandhāt| raktajāmāha– raktotthā ityādi| atyarthaṃ cenna duṣṭā tadā sādhyā| atrāpi svalpadoṣānubandhatvena sādhyatvam| māṃsasthāmāha– māṃsasthā ityādi| māṃsasthāḥ kṛcchrasādhyāḥ, atyavagāḍhadoṣaduṣṭeḥ| medogatāmāha– medojā ityādi| mṛdavo mṛdusparśāḥ, ghorajvaraparītā iti dāruṇajvaro yataḥ| sammoha indriyāṇām| kaścidābhyo vinistaredityanenātyantaṃ kṛcchrasādhyatvaṃ bodhayati| asthimajjagatāmāha– kṣudrā ityādi| atra asthimajjāgatayoḥ samānaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| majjotthā ityatra majjagrahaṇādasthno'pi grahaṇamādhāratvāt, kṣudrāḥ tanvyaḥ, gātrasamāḥ śarīrasamavarṇāḥ, cipiṭāḥ ciuḍākārāḥ, ata eva vakṣyati– “bhramareṇeva viddhāni bhavantyasthīni sarvataḥ|” iti| marmadhāmāni marmasthānāni hṛdayādīni| śukragatāmāha– pakvābhā ityādi| pakvākārā ananupakvā| anye ‘paṅkābhāḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra kardamābhāḥ| ‘sūkṣmāḥ’ ityatra ‘ślakṣṇāḥ’ iti pā.| ślakṣṇāḥ masṛṇāḥ| cihnaṃ dṛśyate na tu jīvitamiti| gambhīradhātugatadoṣaduṣṭeḥ śukrajāyāmasādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam| dhātugatānāṃ doṣajānāmapi sādhyatvamāha– tvaggatā ityādi| rasagatāḥ||14-23||
vātajā vātapittotthāḥ śleṣmavātakṛtāśca yāḥ | ‘kṛcchrasādhyā matās ... ’ iti pā. | kṛcchrasādhyatamāstasmādyatnādetā upācaret ||24||
asādhyāḥ sannipātotthāstāsāṃ vakṣyāmi lakṣaṇam | pravālasadṛśāḥ kāścit kāścijjambūphalopamāḥ ||25||
lohajālasamāḥ kāścidatasīphalasannibhāḥ | āsāṃ bahuvidhā varṇā jāyante doṣabhedataḥ ||26||
