div.ab: samunnataṃ vṛttamamandadāhaṃ tīvrajvaraṃ vṛndamudāharanti | taccāpi pittakṣatajaprakopājjñeyaṃ satodaṃ pavanātmakaṃ tu ||47|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: vṛndamāha– samunnatamityādi| vṛndameva pavanānuviddhaṃ satodaṃ syāt| nanu, saptadaśa kaṇṭhagatā uktāḥ; uktaṃ hi– “saptadaśāmayāḥ kaṇṭhe” iti, vṛndena sahāṣṭādaśa syuḥ? ucyate– ekavṛndasyāvasthāviśeṣa eva vṛndaḥ, tulyasthānākṛtito na saṅkhyātirekaḥ; yadyapyekavṛndaḥ kapharaktajaḥ, vṛndastu pittaraktajaḥ paṭhitaḥ, tathā vṛndasyaiva satodatvena vātātmakatvamuktaṃ, tathā'pyekavṛndasyāvasthāviśeṣatvena vṛndaḥ saṅgacchata eva; yathā kāmalāyāṃ tadbhinnahetulakṣaṇasyāpi halīmakasya saṅgrahaḥ, yathā vātamadātyayena dhvaṃsakavikṣepakayoratyantābhede'pi ‘ ... ratyantabhede hi’ iti pā.| sa eva syānna punastena saṅgrahaḥ; bhoje'pyayamekavṛndaja eva paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “śleṣmaraktasamutthānamekavṛndaṃ vibhāvayet| tulyasthānākṛtirvṛndo vṛndajo raktapittajaḥ||” iti| vṛndaja ityekavṛndajaḥ| gadādharastu kāraṇabhedāt dharmabhedācca utpannatvena caikakāryakāraṇayorabhedaprasaṅgamabhidhāya vṛndaśabdaṃ chando'nurodhādādilopādekavṛnda eva varṇayati, tathāca sati samunnatamityādinā pittānubandhasahitabahularaktakṛtaikavṛndasya lakṣaṇamucyate, satodaṃ pavanātmakaṃ cetyanena ca vātānubandhaikavṛndalakṣaṇamiti vyākhyeyam| parantu vṛndajo vṛnda iti bhojavacanenāsaṅgatamidaṃ vyākhyānam||47||

vṛndamāha– samunnatamityādi| nanu, saptadaśakaṇṭhagatā uktāḥ, uktaṃ hi– “saptadaśāmayāḥ kaṇṭhe” iti, vṛndena sahāṣṭādaśa syuḥ? ucyate– ekavṛndasyāvasthāviśeṣa eva vṛndaḥ, tulyasthānakṛtiścāto na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| bhoje'pyayamekavṛndaja eva paṭhitaḥ| yadāha– “śleṣmaraktasamutthānamekavṛndaṃ vibhāvayet| tulyasthānākṛtirvṛndo vṛndajo raktapittajaḥ||” iti| vṛndaje ityekavṛndaja iti||47||

div.ab: vartirghanā kaṇṭhanirodhinī yā citā'timātraṃ piśitaprarohaiḥ | anekaruk prāṇaharī tridoṣājjñeyā śataghnī ca śataghnirūpā ||48|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: śataghnīlakṣaṇamāha– vartirityādi| anekarugiti vātapittakaphajatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanānvitetyarthaḥ| śataghnirūpeti ayaḥkaṇṭakācchannā ‘śataghnī mahatī śilā’ iti pā.| mahatī śilā śataghnī, tattulyā| prāṇaharītyasādhyā| bhoje'pyuktam– “śaṅkuneva gale viddhā śataghnyeṣā na sidhyati|” iti||48||

śataghnīlakṣaṇamāha– vartirityādi| anekarugiti vātapittakaphajatodadāhakaṇḍvādivedanānvitetyarthaḥ| śataghnirūpeti ‘ayaḥkaṇṭakasañchannā śataghnī mahatī śilā’ tattulyā| prāṇaharītyasādhyā| bhoje'pyuktam “vātapittakaphā duṣṭā māṃsāṅkurasamācitām| madhyakaṇṭacayāṃ vartiṃ janayanti ‘hyapekṣitāḥ’ iti pā.| hyupekṣitāḥ|| śaṅkuneva gale viddhā śataghnyeṣā na sidhyati|” iti||48||

div.ab: granthirgale tvāmalakāsthimātraḥ sthiro'tirugyaḥ kapharaktamūrtiḥ | saṃlakṣyate saktamivāśanaṃ ca sa śastrasādhyastu galāyusañjñaḥ ||49|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: galāyulakṣaṇamāha– granthirityādi| kapharaktamūrtiriti kapharaktajaḥ| saktamiveti lagnamiva| aśanaṃ bhuktam||49||
galāyuliṅgamāha– granthirityādi| saktamiveti lagnamiva, aśanaṃ bhojanaṃ, saṃlakṣyate, sa galāyusañjño vikāraḥ, sa śastrasādhyaḥ||49||

div.ab: sarvaṃ galaṃ vyāpya samutthito yaḥ śotho rujaḥ santi ca yatra sarvāḥ | sa sarvadoṣairgalavidradhistu tasyaiva tulyaḥ khalu sarvajasya ||50|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: galavidradhiliṅgamāha– sarvamityādi| tasyaiva tulyaḥ khalu sarvajasyeti prāguktasya vidradheḥ sannipātajasya tulya ityarthaḥ| sa ca sthānaprabhāveṇa sannipātaja eva, cikitsābhedārthaṃ ca punaḥ paṭhitaḥ||50||
galavidradhimāha– sarvamityādi| tasyaivetyādiprāguktavidradheḥ sannipātajasya tulya ityarthaḥ| ayaṃ ca sthānaprabhāveṇa sannipātaja eva, cikitsābhedārthaṃ ca punaḥ paṭhitaḥ||50||

div.ab: śotho mahānannajalāvarodhī tīvrajvaro vāyugaternihantā | kaphena jāto rudhirānvitena gale galaughaḥ parikīrtyate tu ||51|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: galaughalakṣaṇamāha– śotha ityādi| vāyugaternihanteti atimahattvādudānavāyugatirodhaka ityarthaḥ||51||
galaughalakṣaṇamāha– śopha ityādi| vāyugaternihantetyādi| atimahattvādudānavāyugatirodhaka ityarthaḥ||51||

div.ab: yastāmyamānaḥ śvasiti prasaktaṃ bhinnasvaraḥ śuṣkavimuktakaṇṭhaḥ | kaphopadigdheṣvanilāyaneṣu jñeyaḥ sa rogaḥ śvasanāt svaraghnaḥ ||52|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: svaraghnalakṣaṇamāha– ya ityādi| tāmyamāna iti mūrchāṃ gacchan, athavā tamaḥ paśyan| śvasiti prasaktamiti nirantaraṃ śvasiti| śuṣkavimuktakaṇṭha iti śuṣko nīraso vimuktaścāsvādhīnaḥ kaṇṭho yasya sa tathā| asvādhīnatā ca kimapi gilitumaśakyatayā boddhavyā| anilāyaneṣviti anilamārgeṣu kapharuddheṣu satsu, vāyugatasrotasordvitve'pi bahuvacanaṃ pratānabahutvāt| śvasanāditi vātāt||52||

svaraghnalakṣaṇamāha– ya ityādi| prasaktamiti nirantaraṃ niḥśvasiti, śuṣkavimuktakaṇṭha iti śuṣko nīraso vimuktaścāsvādhīnaḥ kaṇṭho yasya sa tathā, asvādhīnatā ca kimapi gilitumaśakyatayā boddhavyā| keṣu satsu? anilāyaneṣviti anilamārgeṣu kaphopadigdheṣu kapharuddheṣu satsu, vāyuvahasrotasordvitve'pi bahuvacanaṃ pratānabahutvāt| sa rogaḥ śvasanāt vātāt svaraghno jñeyaḥ||52||

div.ab: pratānavān yaḥ śvayathuḥ sukaṣṭo galoparodhaṃ kurute krameṇa | sa māṃsatānaḥ kathito'valambī prāṇapraṇut sarvakṛto vikāraḥ ||53|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: māṃsatānaliṅgamāha– pratānavānityādi| pratānavāniti vistāravān| sukaṣṭa iti mahāduḥkhapradāyī; na tu kṛcchrasādhyaḥ, prāṇapraṇuditi vacanāt; athavā pākataḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ, samastagaloparodhe tu prāṇapraṇut| ‘sa māṃsatānaḥ kathito'valambī’ ityasya sthāne ‘sa māṃsatāneti bibharti sañjñām’ iti pāṭhāntare māṃsatānetyatra itiśabdena prātipadikārthasyoktatvādvibhaktyabhāvaḥ| ‘bibharti sañjñām’ ityasya sthāne ‘niruṇaddhi ceṣṭām’ iti kārtikaḥ| asmin vyākhyāne ‘sa māṃsatāna’ ityasyānantaraṃ ‘khyāta’ iti draṣṭavyam||53||

māṃsatānaliṅgamāha– pratānetyādi| pratānavāniti vistāravān, sukaṣṭaḥ mahāduḥkhadāyī natu kṛcchrasādhyaḥ, prāṇapraṇuditi vacanāt; athavā pākataḥ kaṣṭasādhyaḥ, samastagaloparodhe tu prāṇapraṇut| atra ‘prāṇaprerakaḥ’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| avalambī lambanaśīlaḥ||53||

div.ab: sadāhatodaṃ śvayathuṃ sutāmramantargale pūtiviśīrṇamāṃsam | pittena vidyādvadane vidārīṃ pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete ||54|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: vidārīlakṣaṇamāha– sadāhatodamityādi| vadana iti svarūpaparamidam, antargala ityanenaiva vadanaśabdasya labdhatvāt| pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete iti sa puruṣo yena pārśvena viśeṣādbāhulyena śete tasminneva pārśve vidārī bhavatītyarthaḥ| viśeṣagrahaṇādanyasmin pārśve'pi sambhavo'syāḥ| vidārīsañjñā ca māṃsavidāraṇena| bhoje'pyuktam– “pittena jāto vadane vikāraḥ pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete| snāyupratānaprabhavo viśeṣāddāhaprapākapracuro vidārī||” iti||54||

vidārīlakṣaṇamāha– sadāhetyādi| pūtiviśīrṇamāṃsaṃ durgandhaśaṭitamāṃsam| vadana iti svarūpaparamidaṃ, ayameva pāṭhamūrīkaroti| antargalamityanenaiva vadanasambandhasya labdhatvāt| pārśve ityādi sa puruṣo yena pārśvena ‘viśeṣaṇāt’ iti pā.| viśeṣāt bāhulyena śete tasmin pārśve viśeṣeṇa bhavatītyarthaḥ; viśeṣagrahaṇādanyapārśve'pi sambhavo'syāḥ| vidārīsañjñā ca māṃsavidāraṇena, bhoje'pyuktam– “pittena jāto vadane vikāraḥ ‘pārśvairviśeṣāt’ iti pā.| pārśve viśeṣāt sa tu yena śete| snāyupratānaprabhavo viśeṣāddāhaprapākapracuro vidārī||” iti||54||

div.ab: sphoṭaiḥ satodairvadanaṃ samantādyasyācitaṃ sarvasaraḥ sa vātāt | raktaiḥ sadāhaistanubhiḥ sapītairyasyācitaṃ cāpi sa pittakopāt | avedanaiḥ kaṇḍuyutaiḥ savarṇairyasyācitaṃ cāpi sa vai kaphena ||55|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: sarvasarāstrayo'bhidhīyante– ‘sphoṭaiḥ satodairityādinā’ iti pā.| sphoṭairityādinā| ‘mukhadantoṣṭhādi ... ’ iti pā.| mukhagatoṣṭhādisaptasthānavyāpakatayā sarvasaratvaṃ jñeyam| sphoṭairiti vadanamiti ca uttaratra sambandhanīyam| ācitaṃ vyāptam| sarvasarā mukhapākā ucyante| kecidvidehaktaraktajasarvasaralakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti| yathā– “raktena pittodita eva cāpi kaiścit ‘prayukto’ iti pā.| pradiṣṭo mukhapākasañjñaḥ|” iti| ayaṃ ca paittika evāntarbhūta iti neha darśita iti||55||

sarvasarāstrayo'bhidhīyante| tatra vātajaṃ sarvasaramāha– sphoṭairityādi| ācitaṃ vyāptam| mukhadantauṣṭhādisaptasthānavyāpakatayā teṣāṃ sarvasaratvaṃ jñeyam| sphoṭairiti vadanamiti cottaratra sambandhanīyam| ‘pittam’ iti pā.| pittajaṃ sarvasaramāha– raktairityādi| sugamam| ‘kaphasarvasaramāha’ iti pā.| kaphajasarvasaramāha– avedanairityādi| sugamam| sarvasarā mukhapākā ucyante| kecidvidehaktaraktajasarvasaralakṣaṇaṃ paṭhanti| tadyathā– “raktena pittodita eva cāpi kaiścitpradiṣṭo mukhapākasañjñaḥ|” iti| ayaṃ ca paittikasarvasare pradiṣṭa eveti neha darśitaḥ||55||

div.ab: oṣṭhaprakope varjyāḥ syurmāṃsaraktatridoṣajāḥ | dantamūleṣu varjyau ca triliṅgagatiśauṣirau ||56|| danteṣu ca na sidhyanti śyāvadālanabhañjanāḥ | jihvāroge balāśastu tālavyeṣvarbudaṃ tathā ||57|| svaraghno valayo vṛndo balāśaśca vidārikā | galaugho māṃsatānaśca śataghnī rohiṇī gale ||58|| asādhyāḥ kīrtitā hyete rogā nava daśaiva tu | teṣu cāpi kriyāṃ vaidyaḥ pratyākhyāya samācaret ||59|| (su. ni. a. 16) |

ab.seg: oṣṭhaprakopādiṣvasādhyānāha– oṣṭhaprakope varjyāḥ syurityādi| triliṅgagatiśauṣirāviti tridoṣajanāḍī tridoṣajaśca mahāśauṣiro'sādhyaḥ| rohiṇī gala iti tridoṣajā rohiṇī||56-59||

asādhyānāha– oṣṭhetyādi| oṣṭhajāstrayaḥ, dantamūle dvau, dantabhaveṣu trayaḥ, jihvāgateṣvekaḥ, tālunyapyeka eva, svaraghnādayo nava gale, samudāyasaṅkhyā navadaśaiveti| triliṅgagatiśauṣirāviti tridoṣajanāḍī tridoṣajaśca mahāśauṣiro'sādhyaḥ| ‘balāśaśca vidārikā’ ityatra ‘balāśaḥ saha dāriṇā’ iti pā.| balāśaḥ saha dāriṇeti| vidāryā saha, chando'nurodhāddāriṇeti nirdeśaḥ, rohiṇī gala iti tridoṣajā rohiṇī||56-59||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne mukharoganidānaṃ samāptam ||56||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ mukharoganidānaṃ samāptam||56||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ mukharoganidānam||56||

div.head: karṇaroganidānam
div.ab: atha karṇaroganidānam | samīraṇaḥ śrotragato'nyathācaran samantataḥ śūlamatīva karṇayoḥ | karoti doṣaiśca yathāsvamāvṛtaḥ sa karṇaśūlaḥ kathito durācaraḥ ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) |

ab.seg: mukharoge jihvāśrayarogo'bhihitaḥ, jihvā cendriyādhiṣṭhānam, ata indriyādhiṣṭhānaduṣṭisāmyāt karṇaroganidānamucyate; ‘karṇaśabdena ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | karṇaśabdena ca karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnamadṛṣṭopagṛhītaṃ śrotramucyate, tatra yadyapyekadeśagato rogastathā'pyavayave'pi samudāyopacārataḥ karṇavyapadeśaḥ| tatra karṇaśūlaṃ kaṣṭatvāt prāgāha– samīraṇa ityādi| atrānayaiva samprāptyā'rthato nidānasañcayādyākṣiptaṃ; yato nidānāt sañcayaḥ, sañcayāt prakopaḥ, prakopāt prasaraḥ, prasarāt sthānasaṃśrayaḥ, tato vyaktiḥ, tato bheda iti| karṇaśūlasya ca kaṣṭatvaṃ mūrchādyupadravayogāt| yadāha videhaḥ– “mūrchā dāho jvaraḥ kāso hṛllāso vamathustathā| upadravāḥ karṇaśūle bhavantyete mariṣyataḥ||” iti| anyathācaranniti pratilomaṃ caran| doṣairiti kaphapittaraktaiḥ; rakte'pi rujākartṛtvāt sāmānyena doṣavyapadeśaḥ| yathāsvamāvṛta iti svanidānakupitadoṣairyathāsvīyalakṣaṇairāvṛto na tu kopitairvāyunā; “ekaḥ prakupito doṣaḥ sarvāneva prakopayet” iti nyāyāt; yataḥ svatantrakupitā doṣāḥ saṃsargabhājo bhavanti, paratantrakupitāstvanubandharūpā bhavanti; athavā yathāsvamiti śūlaviśeṣaṇaṃ, yathāsvīyamityarthaḥ| durācāra iti duḥkhenācaryate iti durācaraḥ||1||

mukharoge jihvāśrayā rogā abhihitāḥ, jihvā cendriyādhiṣṭhānam, ata indriyādhiṣṭhānaduṣṭisāmyātkarṇaroganidānamucyate| karṇaśabdena karṇaśaṣkulyavacchinnamadṛṣṭopagṛhītaṃ śrotramucyate| atra yadyapyekadeśe rogaḥ, tathā'pyavayave'pi samudāyopacārātkarṇarogavyapadeśaḥ| atra karṇaśūlaṃ kaṣṭasādhyatvātprāgāha– samīraṇa ityādi| atrānayaiva samprāptyā'rthato nidānasañcayādyākṣiptaṃ boddhavyam| yato nidānāt sañcayaḥ, sañcayāt prakopaḥ, prakopātprasaraḥ, prasarāt sthānasaṃśrayaḥ, tato vyaktiḥ, tato bheda iti| karṇaśūlasya ca kaṣṭatvaṃ mūrchādyupadravayogāt| yadāha videhaḥ– “mūrchā dāho jvaraḥ kāsaḥ kutsā'nne vamathuḥ satṛṭ| upadravāḥ karṇaśūle bhavantyete mariṣyataḥ||” iti| śrotragataḥ śrotraṃ śaṣkulīparicchinnamākāśaḥ, samīraṇo vāyuḥ, śrotragataḥ śrotraprāptaḥ, anyathā caranniti pratilomaṃ caran vimārgaga iti vā; caran samantataḥ karṇayoratīva śūlaṃ karotīti sambandhanīyam| kathambhūto vāyuḥ? doṣairiti pittakapharaktaiḥ, rakte'pi rujādikartṛtvena doṣasāmyāddoṣavyapadeśaḥ| yathāsvamāvṛta iti yathāsvamatra svasya doṣasyānatikrameṇa yathāsvaṃ, tena svanidānakupitairdoṣairyathātmīyalakṣaṇāvṛto na tu kupitena vāyunā kopitaiḥ, atha vā yathāsvamiti śūlaviśeṣaṇaṃ, yathātmīyamityarthaḥ| sa tathāvidho rogaḥ karṇaśūlaḥ kathitaḥ| kiṃviśiṣṭaḥ? asyāyameveṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ| durāsado durvāraḥ, ‘durācaraḥ’ iti pāṭhe duḥkhena caryate upacaryata iti durācaraḥ||1||
karṇasrotaḥ sthite vāte śṛṇoti vividhān svarān | bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāṃ karṇanādaḥ sa ucyate ||2||
yadā śabdavahaṃ vāyuḥ srota āvṛtya tiṣṭhati | śuddhaḥ śleṣmānvito vā'pi bādhiryaṃ tena jāyate ||3||

karṇanādamāha– karṇasrotaḥsthita ityādi| yadā karṇasrotasi vividhaprakāreṇāvasthito vāyurbhavati tadā tasya vividhābhihananāduktavividhaśabdaśravaṇaṃ, bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāmityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena bhṛṅgārādiśabdaśravaṇaṃ ca bhavati| yaduktaṃ videhe– “śirogato yadā vāyuḥ śrotrayoḥ pratipadyate| tadā tu vividhān śabdān samīrayati karṇayoḥ|| bhṛṅgārakrauñcanādaṃ vā maṇḍūkakākayostathā| tantrīmṛdaṅgaśabdaṃ vā sāmatūryasvanaṃ tathā|| gītādhyayanavaṃśānāṃ nirghoṣaṃ kṣveḍanaṃ tathā| apāmiva patantīnāṃ śakaṭasyeva gacchataḥ|| śvasatāmiva sarpāṇāṃ sadṛśaḥ śrūyate svanaḥ|” iti||2-3||

karṇanādamāha– karṇetyādi| bherīmṛdaṅgaśaṅkhānāmityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena bhṛṅgārādiśabdagrahaṇaṃ ca bhavati| yaduktaṃ videhe– “śirogato yadā vāyuḥ śrotrayoḥ pratipadyate| tadā tu vividhāñchabdānsamīrayati karṇayoḥ|| bhṛṅgārakrauñcanādaṃ vā maṇḍūkakākayostathā| tantrīmṛdaṅgaśabdaṃ vā sāmatūryasvanaṃ tathā|| gītādhyayanavaṃśānāṃ nirghoṣaṃ kṣveḍanaṃ tathā| apāmiva patantīnāṃ śakaṭasyeva gacchataḥ|| śvasatāmiva sarpāṇāṃ sadṛśaḥ śrūyate svanaḥ|” iti| praṇādasyāpīḍākaratve'pi rogākhyā, tilakālakavanmanoduḥkhajanakatvāt| bādhiryamāha– yadetyādi| śabdavahaṃ srotaḥ karṇaśaṣkulīparicchinnamākāśaṃ, tadgatavātajanitamatra bādhiryam, apiśabdādraktapittāvaraṇayorupagraha iti||2-3||
vāyuḥ pittādibhiryukto veṇughoṣopamaṃ svanam | karoti karṇayoḥ kṣveḍaṃ karṇakṣveḍaḥ sa ucyate ||4||

karṇakṣveḍamāha– vāyurityādi| kṣveḍameva vyākaroti– veṇughoṣopamaṃ svanamiti| nanu, karṇanādāt kathamasya bhedaḥ? ucyate– karṇanāde kevalānilaje nānāśabdān śṛṇoti, atra tu veṇuśabdameva niyamena; tathā'yaṃ pittādisaṃsṛṣṭavātajanya iti| tathāha videhaḥ– “mārutaḥ kaphapittābhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śoṇitena ca| karṇakṣveḍaṃ sañjanayet kṣveḍanaṃ veṇughoṣavat||” iti||4||

karṇakṣveḍamāha– vāyurityādi| nanu? karṇanādakarṇakṣveḍayoḥ ko bhedaḥ? ucyate– karṇanāde kevalānilaje nānāśabdān śṛṇoti, atra tu veṇuśabdameva niyamena, tathā'yaṃ pittādisaṃsṛṣṭavātajanyaḥ| tathāca videhaḥ– “mārutaḥ kaphapittābhyāṃ saṃsṛṣṭaḥ śoṇitena ca| karṇakṣveḍaṃ sañjanayetkṣveḍanaṃ veṇughoṣavat||” iti||4||

div.ab: śiro'bhighātādathavā nimajjato jale prapākādathavā'pi vidradheḥ | sraveddhi pūyaṃ śravaṇo'nilārditaḥ sa karṇasaṃsrāva iti prakīrtitaḥ ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) |

ab.seg: karṇasrāvamāha– śiro'bhighātādityādi| sraveddhi pūyamityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena raktajale ca sravata iti mantavyaṃ, śiro'bhighātajalamajjanamātreṇa pūyasyāsambhavāt; athavā prapākāditi sarvatra sambadhyate; tarhi na pākāt pṛthak srāva uktaḥ, sarvatra pākasyāviśiṣṭatvāditi kārtikaḥ| nanu, pākāt vidradheḥ srāvasambhavo'stu, vidradhau tu vātetaradoṣasyāpi sambhavāt kathamanilārdita ityuktam? ucyate– atisrāveṇātrānilakopādanilārditatvaṃ boddhavyam||5||

karṇasrāvamāha– śiro'bhighātādityādi| atra pūyamityupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena raktajale ca sravata iti mantavyam| atra prapākāditi sarvatra sambadhyate, tarhi na pākātpṛthak srāva uktaḥ syāt, sarvatra pākasyāviśiṣṭatvāditi kārtikaḥ| nanu, pākādvidradheḥ srāvasambhavo'stu, vidradhau tu vātetaradoṣasyāpi sadbhāvāttatkathamanilārdita ityuktaṃ? ucyate, atisrāveṇātrānilakopādanilārditatvaṃ boddhavyam| śiro'bhighātāt, athavā jale nimajjataḥ, athavā vidradheḥ karṇavidradheḥ prapākādanilārditaḥ śravaṇaḥ pūyaṃ sravet, sa karṇasaṃsrāvākhyo roga uktaḥ||5||

div.ab: mārutaḥ kaphasaṃyuktaḥ karṇakaṇḍūṃ karoti ca | pittoṣmaśoṣitaḥ śleṣmā kurute karṇagūthakam ||6|| sa karṇagūtho dravatāṃ gato yadā vilāyito ghrāṇamukhaṃ prapadyate | tadā sa karṇapratināhasañjñito bhavedvikāraḥ śiraso'rdhabhedakṛt ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) |

ab.seg: karṇapratināhamāha– sa karṇagūtho dravatāmityādi| vilāyita iti snehasvedābhyāṃ vilīnīkṛtaḥ san| ghrāṇamukhamiti dvandvatvādekavadbhāvaḥ, tena ghrāṇaṃ ca mukhaṃ ca pratipadyate ityarthaḥ| anye ‘ghrāṇamukhāt’ iti paṭhanti, tadā ghrāṇamukhāt nāsāsakāśāt pratipadyate gacchatītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ kaphajo vikāraḥ; athavā karṇagūthaśoṣe mārutapittavyāpārāttrayāṇāmapi sambandho'sti, tena sannipātajo'yaṃ; tathāca videhaḥ– “kaphādvā mārutādvā'pi sannipātena vā punaḥ|” iti| śiraso'rdhabhedakṛditi ardhāvabhedaśirorogakṛt||6-7||

karṇakaṇḍūmāha– māruta ityādi| sugamam| ‘karṇavardha āha’ iti pā.| karṇagūthamāha– pittetyādi| sugamam| ‘karṇapratinādamāha’ iti pā.| karṇapratināhamāha– sa ityādi| yadā sa karṇagūtho vilāyita iti snehasvedābhyāṃ vilīnīkṛto dravatāṃ gataḥ san| ghrāṇamukhamiti dvandvaikavadbhāvaḥ, tena ghrāṇaṃ mukhaṃ ca pratipadyata ityarthaḥ| anye ‘ghrāṇamukhād’ iti paṭhanti, tadā ghrāṇamukhātsakāśātpratipadyate gacchatītyarthaḥ| tadā sa karṇapratināhasañjñito vikāro bhavet| ayaṃ kaphajo vikāraḥ; athavā karṇagūthaśothe mārutapittavyākhyāpārāttayorapyatra sambandho'sti, tena sannipātajo'yam| tathāhi videhaḥ– “kaphādvā mārutādvā'pi saha pittena vā punaḥ|” iti| śiraso'rdhabhedakṛditi ardhāvabhedaśirorogakṛt||6-7||

div.ab: yadā tu mūrchantyathavā'pi jantavaḥ sṛjantyapatyānyathavā'pi makṣikāḥ | tadvyañjanatvācchravaṇo nirucyate bhiṣagbhirādyaiḥ krimikarṇako gadaḥ ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) |

ab.seg: krimikarṇakamāha– yadā tu ‘mūrchantītyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mūrchantītyādi| mūrchanti ucchritā bhavanti| jantavaḥ krimayaḥ| krimimūrchanaṃ ca māṃsaśoṇitakothe sati jñeyaṃ, tadantareṇa krimīṇāmasambhavāt| apatyānīti ‘ḍimbakān’ iti pā.| ḍimbhakān| tadvyañjanatvāditi krimilakṣaṇatvāt| śravaṇo nirucyate iti krimikarṇako gada iti āśrayāśritayorabhedopacārācchravaṇaḥ krimikarṇako gado bhaṇyate| śravaṇaśabdaḥ puṃliṅgo'pyastītyasmādeva nirdeśāt pratīyate| ayaṃ vikārastridoṣajo mantavyaḥ| tathā ca nimiḥ– “śleṣmapittajalonmiśre kothe śoṇitamāṃsaje| ‘jāyante’ iti pā.| mūrchanti jantavastatra kṛṣṇāstāmrāḥ sitāruṇāḥ|| bhakṣayantīva te karṇaṃ kurvanto vividhā rujaḥ| krimikarṇaṃ tu taṃ vidyāt sannipātaprakopajam||” iti||8||

kṛmikarṇakamāha– yadetyādi| mūrchanti ucchritā bhavanti, jantavaḥ kṛmayaḥ, kṛmimūrchanaṃ ca māṃsaśoṇitakothe sati jñeyaṃ, tamantareṇa kṛmīṇāmasambhavāt| apatyāni ḍimbhakān sūkṣmakṛmīniti yāvat| makṣikā mammaṇākhyā nīlavarṇāḥ| ādyairgbhiṣabhirvidehādibhiḥ, tadvyañjanatvāditi kṛmilakṣaṇatvāt, āśrayāśritayorabhedopacārāt śravaṇaḥ kṛmikarṇako gado bhaṇyate| śravaṇaśabdaḥ puṃlliṅgo'pyastītyasmādeva nirdeśātpratīyate| ayaṃ vikārastridoṣajo mantavyaḥ| tathāca nimiḥ– “śleṣmapittajalonmiśre kothe śoṇitamāṃsaje| jāyante jantavastatra kṛṣṇāstāmrāḥ sitāruṇāḥ|| bhakṣayantīva te karṇaṃ kurvanto vividhā rujaḥ| kṛmikarṇaṃ tu taṃ vidyātsannipātaprakopajam||” iti||8||
pataṅgāḥ śatapadyaśca karṇasrotaḥ praviśya hi | aratiṃ vyākulatvaṃ ca bhṛśaṃ kurvanti vedanām ||9||
karṇo nistudyate tasya ‘yathā’ iti pā. | tathā pharapharāyate | kīṭe carati ruk tīvrā niṣpande mandavedanā ||10||
karṇapraviṣṭapataṅgakīṭādiliṅgamāha– pataṅgā ityādi| śatapadya iti kāraṇḍikāḥ| niṣpande iti sthire||9-10||
karṇapraviṣṭakīṭapataṅgādiliṅgamāha– pataṅgā ityādi| śatapadyaḥ kāraṇḍikāḥ| nistudyate prājaneneva| anyat sugamam||9-10||

div.ab: kṣatābhighātaprabhavastu vidradhirbhavettathā doṣakṛto'paraḥ punaḥ | saraktapītāruṇamasramāsravet pratodadhūmāyanadāhacoṣavān ||11|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20) |

ab.seg: karṇavidradhimāha– kṣatābhighātaprabhavastvityādi| kṣataprabhavo'bhighātaprabhavaśca, kṣatābhighātaprabhavayorāgantukatvādekatvam, evaṃ vātādijasyāpi doṣajatvādekatvam| saraktapītāruṇamasramāsravediti asramāsrāvaṃ, saraktapītāruṇavarṇatvaṃ cāsrāvasya vātapittakaphasambhavāt||11||

karṇavidradhimāha– kṣatetyādi| kṣataprabhavaścābhighātaprabhavaśca, kṣatābhighātaprabhavayorāgantukatvādaikyam| evaṃ vātādijasyāpi doṣajatvādekatvam| kṣatavidradherlakṣaṇamāha– setyādi| asraṃ āsrāvaṃ, raktapītāruṇavarṇatvaṃ cāsrāvasya vātapittaraktasambhavatvāt| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmodvamanamiva vedanāviśeṣaḥ, coṣa ācūṣyata iva vedanāviśeṣaḥ| doṣavidradherlakṣaṇaṃ taireva jñātavyam||11||
karṇapākastu pittena kothavikledakṛdbhavet | karṇavidradhipākādvā jāyate cāmbupūraṇāt ||12||

karṇapākalakṣaṇamāha– karṇapāka ityādi| kothavikledakṛditi kothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ, vikleda ārdratā| nanu, ‘karṇagūthanidāne’ iti pā.| karṇagūthalakṣaṇe pittena śoṣaṇamuktaṃ, tatkathamārdratā? naivam, evaṃvikārajanakakarmasahakāriṇā dravāṃśodriktena pittenārdratā, tatra tvetadviparītatvena śoṣaḥ||12||

karṇapākalakṣaṇamāha– karṇetyādi| kothavikledakṛditi kothaḥ pūtibhāvaḥ, vikleda ārdratā| atra ‘atha vā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| karṇavidradhipākāt, athavā ambupūraṇāt karṇapāko jāyate| nanu, karṇagūthalakṣaṇe pittena śoṣaṇamuktaṃ, tatkathamārdratā? maivam, etadvikārajanakakarmasahakāriṇā dravāṃśodriktena pittenārdratā, tatra tvetadviparītena śoṣaḥ||12||

div.ab: pūyaṃ sravati ‘vā pūti’ iti pā. | pūti vā sa jñeyaḥ pūtikarṇakaḥ |13|

pūtikarṇalakṣaṇamāha– pūyamityādi| ‘pūyaṃ sravati vā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pūyaṃ sravati vā pūtīti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, vāśabdo'tra samuccaye; tenāvedanatvaṃ, savedanatvaṃ vā, ghanasrāvitvaṃ ca samuccīyate| ghanasrāvaniyamācca karṇasrāvādasya bhedaḥ| tathācoktaṃ suśrute– “srotaḥsthite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā vilīyamāne bhṛśasampratāpite| avedano vā'tha savedano vā ghanaṃ sravet pūti ca pūtikarṇaḥ||” iti| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20)| pūtimān karṇaḥ pūtikarṇaḥ|13|–

pūtikarṇalakṣaṇamāha– pūyamityādi| pūtīti kriyāviśeṣaṇaṃ, vāśabdo'tra samuccaye; tenāvedanatvaṃ savedanatvaṃ vā, ghanasrāvitvaṃ ca samuccīyate| ghanasrāvaniyamācca karṇasrāvādasya bhedaḥ| tathācoktaṃ suśrute– “ ‘srotaḥsthite’ iti pā.| śrotaḥsthite śleṣmaṇi pittatejasā vilīyamāne bhṛśasampratāpite| avedano vā'pyathavā savedano ghanaṃ sravetpūti ‘sa pūtikarṇakaḥ’ iti pā.| ca pūtikarṇaḥ||” iti| (su. u. taṃ. a. 20)| pūtimān karṇaḥ pūtikarṇakaḥ|13|–

ab.seg: karṇaśothārbudārśāṃsi jānīyāduktalakṣaṇaiḥ ||13||

idānīṃ saṅkhyāpūraṇārthaṃ karṇagataśothārbudārśasāmatideśena lakṣaṇamāha– karṇaśothetyādi| karṇaśothāścatvāro vātapittakapharaktajatvena; evamarśaścaturvidhaṃ, sahajasannipātajārśasoḥ sannipātāgantujaśothayoścātrāsambhūtirādhāraprabhāvāt| arbudaṃ ca saptavidhaṃ vātapittakapharaktamāṃsamedaḥsirānimittabhedāt; ‘śirājasya’ iti pā.| sirājasya vātajāvaruddhasyātra pṛthaggaṇanaṃ śālākyasiddhāntasaṃvādāditi kārtikaḥ| ‘yadāha’ iti pā.| yathā suśrute eva karṇarogānantaram– “doṣaistribhistaiḥ pṛthagekaśaśca brūyāttathā'rśāṃsi tathaiva śothān| śālākyasiddhāntamavekṣya cāpi sarvātmakaṃ saptamamarbudaṃ tu||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) iti| nāsāroge'bhidhāsyati, tathehāpi yujyate; tena raktajasya pittasamānaliṅgatvāt pittaje'ntarbhāvaḥ, ‘tathā''gantujasyāpi’ iti pā.| tathā''gantujasyāpi raktapittaliṅgatvāt pittaja evāntarbhāvaḥ; tena śothaḥ sannipātajo'tra agaṇanīyaḥ, evaṃ sahajaraktajayordoṣaja evāntarbhāvāt ‘sannipātajamarśaḥ pṛthaggaṇanīyam’ iti pā.| sannipātajamarśo'pṛthaggaṇanīyam, arbudaṃ ca sannipātajaṃ saptamiti, evamebhiḥ sahāṣṭāviṃśatiḥ suśrutoktāḥ karṇarogā bhavanti||13||

karṇagataśophārbudārśasāmatītāvekṣaṇena lakṣaṇamāha– karṇetyādi| yadyapi śophādayaḥ ‘prāg nirdiṣṭāḥ’ iti pā.| prāṅnirdiṣṭāḥ, tathāpi karṇarogasaṅgrahārthaṃ sādhyāsādhyavibhāgārthaṃ ca punarnirdiṣṭāḥ karṇaśophāścatvāraḥ, vātapittakapharaktajatveneti; evamarśaścaturvidham| sahajasannipātajārśasoḥ sannipātajāgantujaśophayoścātrāsambhūtirādhāraśca prabhāvāt| arbudaṃ ca saptavidhaṃ ‘ ... śirānimittabhedāt’ iti pā.| vātapittakapharaktamāṃsamedaḥsirānimittabhedāt; ‘śirājanyavātajāvaruddhasyātra’ iti pā.| sirājanyasya vātajāvaruddhasyātra pṛthagdarśanaṃ śālākyasiddhāntasaṃvādāditi kārtikaḥ| yadāha suśruta eva karṇarogānantaram– “doṣaistribhistaiḥ pṛthagekaśaśca bhūyāttathā'rśāṃsi tathaiva śophān| śālākyasiddhāntamavekṣya cāpi sarvātmakaṃ saptamamarbudaṃ syāt||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) iti| nāsāroge'bhidhāsyati, tathehāpi yujyate; tena raktajasya pittaliṅgatvāt pittaje'ntarbhāvaḥ, ‘āgantujasya ca’ iti pā.| āgantujasyāpi raktapittaliṅgatvāt pittaja evāntarbhāvaḥ; tena śophaḥ ‘sannipātajo'tra gaṇanīyaḥ’ iti pā.| sannipātajo'trāgaṇanīyaḥ, evaṃ sahajaraktajayordoṣaja evāntarbhāvāt ‘sannipātajamarśasaḥ pṛthaggaṇanīyam’ iti pā.| sannipātajamarśaso'pṛthaggaṇanīyam, arbudaṃ ca sannipātajaṃ saptamiti, evamebhiḥ sahāṣṭāviṃśatiḥ suśrutoktāḥ karṇarogā bhavanti||13||

div.ab: nādo'tiruk karṇamalasya śoṣaḥ srāvastanuścāśravaṇaṃ ca vātāt | śothaḥ sarāgo daraṇaṃ vidāhaḥ sapītapūtisravaṇaṃ ca pittāt ||14|| vaiśrutyakaṇḍūsthiraśothaśuklasnigdhasrutiḥ svalparujaḥ kaphācca | sarvāṇi rūpāṇi ca sannipātāt srāvaśca tatrādhikadoṣavarṇaḥ ||15|| (ca. ci. a. 26) |

ab.seg: idānīṃ carakoktaṃ karṇarogacatuṣṭayaṃ vātapittakaphasannipātajabhedādāha– nādo'tirugityādi| aśravaṇamiti aśabdaśrutiḥ| vaiśrutyamiti viruddhaśravaṇam||14-15||
idānīṃ carakoktakarṇarogacatuṣṭayaṃ vātapittakaphasannipātajabhedādāha– nāda ityādi| sugamam| vaiśrutyeti vaiśrutyaṃ viruddhaṃ śravaṇaṃ, srutiḥ srāvaḥ, snigdhā syāt||14-15||

div.ab: saukumāryāccirotsṛṣṭe sahasā'tipravardhite | karṇaśotho bhavet pālyāṃ sarujaḥ paripoṭavān | kṛṣṇāruṇanibhaḥ stabdhaḥ sa vātāt paripoṭakaḥ ||16|| (su. ci. a. 25) |

ab.seg: karṇāvayavatvāt karṇapālyāstadvikārānāha– saukumāryādityādi| saukumāryāddhetościraṃ vardhanena tyakte sahasā ca vardhayitumārabdhe karṇe śothaḥ, paripoṭavān manāktvagavadaraṇavānityarthaḥ||16||

karṇāvayavatvāt karṇapālyāstadvikārānāha– saukumāryādityādi| saukumāryāddhetościrotsṛṣṭe ściraṃvardhanena ‘ityukte’ iti pā.| parityakte sahasā ‘vā’ iti pā.| ca vardhayitumārabdhe karṇe śophaḥ, paripoṭaka iti paripoṭavān manāktvagavadaraṇavānityarthaḥ| atha ḍallanābhiprāyaḥ– karṇe cirotsṛṣṭe bahukālamupekṣite sahasā ‘tṛḍiti’ iti pā.| jhaṭiti pravardhite sati saukumāryāt pālyāṃ śophaḥ sarugityādilakṣaṇayuktaḥ syāt sa vātāt paripoṭako rogaḥ syāt; cirotsṛṣṭatve saukumāryaṃ hetuḥ||16||

div.ab: gurvābharaṇasaṃyogāttāḍanādgharṣaṇādapi | śothaḥ pālyāṃ bhavecchyāvo dāhapākarujānvitaḥ ||17|| rakto vā raktapittābhyāmutpātaḥ sa gado mataḥ | (su. ci. a. 25) |
utpātalakṣaṇamāha– gurvityādi| śyāvatvaṃ vyādhiprabhāvāt, pittaraktayoḥ śyāvatvājanakatvāt; kiṃvā vātānubandhādatra śyāvatvam||17||–
utpātalakṣaṇamāha– gurvityādi| śyāvatvaṃ vyādheḥ prabhāvāt, pittaraktayoḥ śyāvatvajanakatvābhāvāt; kiñca vātānubandhādatra śyāvatvam||17||–

karṇaṃ balādvardhayataḥ pālyāṃ vāyuḥ prakupyati ||18|| kaphaṃ saṅgṛhya kurute śothaṃ stabdhamavedanam | unmanthakaḥ sakaṇḍūko vikāraḥ kaphavātajaḥ ||19|| saṃvardhyamāne durviddhe kaṇḍūpākarujānvitaḥ | śotho bhavati pākaśca tridoṣo duḥkhavardhanaḥ ||20|| (su. ci. a. 25) |

ab.seg: unmanthakamāha– karṇamityādi| stabdhatvaṃ vātakṛtaṃ, kaṇḍūḥ kaphāt, iti vātakaphaliṅgam||18-20||

unmanthakamāha– karṇamityādi| karṇaṃ balādvardhayataḥ pālyāṃ vāyuḥ kopaṃ yāti, sa vāyuḥ kupitaḥ san kaphaṃ saṅgṛhya stabdhaṃ tathā avedanaṃ śophaṃ kurute, sa kaphavātajaḥ unmanthakākhyo rogaḥ syāt| sa kiṃlakṣaṇaḥ? sakaṇḍūkaḥ kaṇḍūyuktaḥ, stabdhatvaṃ vātakṛtaṃ, kaṇḍūḥ kaphāditi vātakaphaliṅgam| duḥkhavardhanamāha– etacca– ‘saṃvardhamāne’ iti pā.| saṃvardhamāna ityādi| karṇe durviddhe daivakṛtacchidramatikramya viddhe saṃvardhamāne sati kaṇḍvādiyuktaḥ śopho bhavati, pākaścātra doṣatrayotthaḥ| duḥkhavardhanāt duḥkhavardhanako nāma rogaḥ||18-20||

div.ab: kaphāsṛkkrimayaḥ kruddhāḥ sarṣapābhā visarpiṇaḥ | kurvanti pālyāṃ piḍakāḥ kaṇḍūdāharujānvitāḥ ||21|| kaphāsṛkkrimisambhūtaḥ sa visarpannitastataḥ | lihet saśaṣkulīṃ pālīṃ parilehīti sa smṛtaḥ ||22|| (su. ci. a. 25) |

ab.seg: parilehīmāha– kaphāsṛgityādi| sa visarpanniti sa iti piḍakātmako vikāra; ‘visarpānvitaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare visarpeṇānvitaḥ| lihediti nirmāṃsīṃ karoti ācchādayedvā||21-22||
parilehīmāha– kaphetyādi| lihediti nirmāṃsīṃ karoti utsādayati vā, ‘savisarpānvitaḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare visarpeṇānvitaḥ||21-22||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne karṇaroganidānaṃ samāptam ||57||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ karṇaroganidānaṃ samāptam||57||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ karṇaroganidānam||57||

div.head: nāsāroganidānam
div.ab: atha nāsāroganidānam | ānahyate yasya viśuṣyate ca praklidyate dhūpyati cāpi nāsā | na vetti yo gandharasāṃśca janturjuṣṭaṃ ‘vyavasyettamapīnasena’ iti pā., ‘vyavasyetimapīnasena’ iti ca pā. | vyavasyediha pīnasena | taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavaṃ vikāraṃ brūyāt pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgam ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: indriyādhikaraṇavikārādhikārānnāsāroganidānam| ‘tatrādau pīnasamāha’ iti pā.| tatrādāvapīnasamāha– ānahyata ityādi| ānahyata ityābadhyate, vātaśoṣitakaphena| praklidyate ārdrībhavati| dhūpyatīti santāpamanubhavati; divāderākṛtigaṇatvāt dhūpyatīti rūpam| gandharasāniti gandhān surabhyasurabhīn, ābaddhatvena nāsāyāḥ; nāsārogārambhakadoṣeṇa ‘ca rasanāyāśca’ iti pā.| rasanāyā api duṣṭeḥ rasān madhurādīnna vetti| taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavamiti vātakaphajam| nanu, anyatra pittakaphajo'sadṛśaliṅgaśca paṭhyate; tadyathā– “mastuluṅgocitaḥ śleṣmā yadā pittādvidahyate| tadā'sṛk picchilaṃ nāsā bahusiṃhāṇakaṃ sravet|| sakaṇḍūdāhapākaṃ ca taṃ tu ‘vidyāddhi pīnasam’ iti pā., ‘vidyādapīnasam’ iti ca pā.| vidyādapīnasam|” iti, tat kathaṃ na virodhaḥ? naivaṃ, samprāptiviśeṣeṇāsya tathābhāva iti kārtikaḥ| tantrāntarapratyayāt pittasambandho liṅgaviśeṣaścātra boddhavya ityarthaḥ| gadādharastu tatsaṃvādāt ‘analaśleṣmabhavam’ iti paṭhitvā śleṣmapittaja eva nyāyya ityāha| pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgamiti kaphavātajapratiśyāyatulyaliṅgam||1||

indriyādhikaraṇādhikārānnāsāroganidānārambhaḥ| tatraikatriṃśannāsārogāḥ, ‘tatra pīnasamāha’ iti pā.| tatrāpīnasamāha– ānahyata ityādi| ānahyate ābadhyate, viśuṣyate vātaśoṣitakaphena, praklidyate ārdrībhavati, dhūpyati santāpamanubhavati, gandhān surabhyasurabhīn, ānaddhatvena nāsāyāḥ; nāsārogārambhakadoṣeṇa rasanāyāśca duṣṭeḥ| rasān madhurādīnna vetti| taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavamiti vātakaphajaṃ brūyāt| nanvanyatra pittaśleṣmajo'nyādṛśaśca paṭhyate, tadyathā– “mastuluṅgocitaḥ śleṣmā yadā pittādvidahyate| tadā'sṛkpicchilaṃ nāsā bahusiṃhāṇakaṃ sravet|| sakaṇḍūdāhapākaṃ ca taṃ tu ‘vidyādipīnasam’ iti pā.| vidyāddhi pīnasam” iti, tatkathaṃ na virodhaḥ? maivaṃ, samprāptiviśeṣeṇāsya tathābhāva iti kārtikaḥ| tantrāntarapratyayāt pittasambandho liṅgaviśeṣaśca boddhavya ityarthaḥ| pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgamiti kaphavātajapratiśyāyatulyaliṅgam||1||

div.ab: doṣairvidagdhairgalatālumūle sammūrchito yasya samīraṇastu | nireti pūtirmukhanāsikābhyāṃ taṃ pūtinasyaṃ pravadanti rogam ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: pūtinasyamāha– ‘doṣairityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | doṣairityādi| doṣairiti pittakapharaktaiḥ, raktasyāpi doṣatulyarūpatvāddoṣatvam| vidagdhairiti pittaśleṣmaṇoḥ saraktayorūṣmaṇā viruddhalavaṇāmlarasapākena pūtibhāvamāpannaiḥ| sammūrchita iti ucchrāyaṃ nītaḥ| niretīti samīraṇa eva, anyasya kartṛpadasyābhāvāt| taṃ pūtinasyamiti nāsikābhavo nasyaḥ, ‘pūtinasyo’ iti pā.| pūtirnasyo vāyuryatra taṃ pūtinasyam| ihaiva videhaḥ– “kaphapittamasṛṅmiśraṃ sañcitaṃ mūrdhni dehinām| vidagdhamūṣmaṇā gāḍhaṃ rujāṃ kṛtvā'kṣiśaṅkhajām|| tataḥ prasyandate ghrāṇāt saraktaṃ pūtipītakam| pūtinasyaṃ tu taṃ vidyād ‘ghrāṇakaṇḍu ... ’ iti pā.| ghrāṇakaṇḍūjvarapradam||” iti||2||

pūtinasyamāha– doṣairityādi| doṣaiḥ pittakapharaktaiḥ, raktasyāpi tulyadoṣatvāddoṣatvam, ato bahuvacanaṃ; vidagdhairiti pittaśleṣmaṇoḥ saraktayorūṣmaṇā viruddhalavaṇāmlarasapākena pūtibhāvamāpannaiḥ| sammūrchita ucchrāyaṃ nītaḥ, nireti nirgacchati, samīraṇa eva, taṃ pūtinasyamiti nāsikābhavo nasyaḥ, pūtirnasyo vāyuryatra| tathāca videhe– “kaphapittamasṛṅmiśraṃ sañcitaṃ mūrdhni dehinām| vidagdhamūṣmaṇā gāḍhaṃ rujāṃ kṛtvā'kṣiśaṅkhajām|| tena prasyandate ghrāṇātsaraktaṃ pūtipītakam| pūtinasyaṃ tu taṃ vidyād ghrāṇakaṇḍūjvarapradam||” iti||2||

div.ab: ghrāṇāśritaṃ pittamarūṃṣi kuryādyasmin vikāre balavāṃśca pākaḥ | taṃ nāsikāpākamiti vyavasyedvikledakothāvathavā'pi yatra ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: nāsāpākamāha– ghrāṇāśritamityādi| arūṃṣīti vraṇān| yasmin vikāra iti yasyāṃ vikṛtau satyām| vyavasyet jānīyāt| vikledaḥ ārdratā, kothaḥ, pūtibhāvaḥ||3||
nāsāpākamāha– ghrāṇāśritamityādi| arūṃṣi vraṇān, yasminniti yasminvikāre, ‘athavāpi yatra’ ityatra ‘atha yatra dṛṣṭau’ iti pā.| dṛṣṭau darśanaṃ gatau||3||

div.ab: doṣairvidagdhairathavā'pi jantorlalāṭadeśe'bhihatasya taistaiḥ | nāsā sravet pūyamasṛgvimiśraṃ taṃ pūyaraktaṃ pravadanti rogam ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: doṣāgantujaṃ pūyaraktamāha– doṣairityādi| vidagdhairiti pittaraktādhikatvādviruddhāṃ pariṇatiṃ prāptaiḥ, lalāṭābhighātena vā pākaṃ prāptaiḥ| taistariti prahārapīḍanādibhiḥ||4||
doṣāgantujaṃ pūyaraktamāha– doṣairityādi| vidagdhairiti pittaraktādhikatvāt viruddhāṃ gatiṃ prāptaiḥ lalāṭābhighātena vā pākaṃ prāptaiḥ, taistairiti prahārapīḍanādibhiḥ||4||

div.ab: ghrāṇāśrite marmaṇi sampraduṣṭo yasyānilo nāsikayā nireti | kaphānujāto bahuśo'tiśabdastaṃ rogamāhuḥ kṣavathuṃ vidhijñāḥ ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: kṣavathurdoṣāgantubhedāddvividho bhavati; tatra doṣajaṃ prāgāha– ghrāṇāśrita ityādi| marmaṇīti śṛṅgāṭake, ‘nastakayoḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare nāsāpuṭayoḥ, ‘tadāśritaḥ san’ iti śeṣaḥ||5||
kṣavathurdoṣāgantubhedād dvividho bhavati, tatra doṣajamāha– ghrāṇāśrita ityādi| marmaṇi śṛṅgāṭakākhye, ‘nastakayoḥ’ iti pāṭhāntare nāsāpuṭayoḥ, tadāsthitaḥ sanniti śeṣaḥ||5||

div.ab: tīkṣṇopayogādabhijighrato vā bhāvān kaṭūnarkanirīkṣaṇādvā | sūtrādibhirvā taruṇāsthimarmaṇyudghāṭite'nyaḥ kṣavathurnireti ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: āgantujamāha– tīkṣṇopayogādityādi| tīkṣṇopayogādrājikāditīkṣṇadravyabhakṣaṇāt| bhāvān kaṭūniti kaṭūni dravyāṇi| abhijighrato bhṛśaṃ jighrataḥ| arkanirīkṣaṇādvā kaphavilayanakarāt| taruṇāsthimarmaṇīti taruṇāsthi nāsāvaṃśāsthi tadeva marma ‘tasmin phaṇāmarmaṇītyarthaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tasmin phaṇāmarmaṇītyarthaḥ, abhighātādinā marmavyathājanakatvāt; athavā taruṇāsthni ca marmaṇi ca śṛṅgāṭake, dvandvaikavadbhāvanirdeśāt| udghāṭite cālite| anya āgantujaḥ||6||

āgantujamāha– tīkṣṇetyādi| tīkṣṇopayogāt rājikādibhakṣaṇāt, bhāvān kaṭūniti kaṭudravyāṇi, atijighrato bhṛśaṃ jighrataḥ, arkanirīkṣaṇādvā kaphavilayanakaratvād, athavā sūtrādibhiḥ, taruṇāsthimarmaṇīti taruṇāsthi nāsāvaṃśāsthi, tadeva marma, abhighātādinā marmavadvyathājanakatvāt, udghāṭite'rdhacālite, anyaḥ āgantujaḥ, doṣajāgantureka eva gaṇanīyaḥ||6||

div.ab: prabhraśyate nāsikayā tu yasya sāndro vidagdho lavaṇaḥ kaphastu | prāksañcito mūrdhani sūryataptastaṃ bhraṃśathuṃ rogamudāharanti ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: bhraṃśathumāha– prabhraśyata ityādi| prabhraśyate galati| vidagdho lavaṇa iti svarūpākhyānaṃ, vidagdhatvādeva kaphasya lavaṇatvasiddheḥ| prāksañcita ityanena sañcayapūrvakaṃ kopaṃ darśayati, hetubhūyastvena cayamantareṇāpi kopadarśanāt| yaduktam– “na kevalaṃ cayaṃ prāpya doṣāḥ kupyanti dehinām| anyato'pi hi kupyanti hetubāhulyato balāt||” iti||7||
bhraṃśathumāha– prabhraśyata ityādi| vidagdho lavaṇa iti svarūpākhyānaṃ, vidagdhatvādeva kaphasya lavaṇatvasiddheḥ, ‘pittatapta’ iti suśrutapāṭhaḥ||7||

div.ab: ghrāṇe bhṛśaṃ dāhasamanvite tu viniḥsareddhūma iveha vāyuḥ | nāsā pradīpteva ca yasya jantorvyādhiṃ tu taṃ dīptamudāharanti ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: dīptamāha– ghrāṇe bhṛśamityādi| pradīpteveti prajvaliteva||8||
dīptamāha– ghrāṇa ityādi| pradīpteveti prajvaliteva, videhe'sya lakṣaṇam– “dhūmāyate yadā nāsā calatkṛṣyati dīpyate| niścarettama ucchvāsaṃ taṃ vyādhiṃ dīptamādiśet||” iti||8||

div.ab: ucchvāsamārgaṃ tu kaphaḥ savāto rundhyāt pratīnāhamudāharettam |9| (ca. ci. a. 26) |
pratīnāhamāha– ucchvāsamārgamityādi|9|–
pratīnāhamāha– ucchvāsamārgamityādi|9|–
ghrāṇādghanaḥ pītasitastanurvā doṣaḥ sravet srāvamudāharettam ||9|| (ca. ci. a. 26) |

ab.seg: nāsāsrāvamāha– ghrāṇādityādi| doṣa iti kaphaḥ||9||
nāsāsrāvamāha– doṣa iti kaphaḥ| asya lakṣaṇaṃ videhe– “srotaḥśṛṅgāṭake śleṣmā| citaḥ kledita ūṣmaṇā| viśeṣātsyandate rātrau nāsāsrāvaṃ tu tadviduḥ||” iti||9||

div.ab: ghrāṇāśrite srotasi mārutena gāḍhaṃ pratapte pariśoṣite ca | kṛcchrācchvasedūrdhvamadhaśca janturyasmin sa nāsāpariśoṣa uktaḥ ||10|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 22) |

ab.seg: nāsāśoṣamāha– ghrāṇāśrite srotasītyādi| atra ca vāyukṛtasrotaḥśoṣaṇena tadgataśleṣmaśoṣo boddhavyaḥ| pratapta ityanena pittamapi gamyate, pratapanasya pittamantareṇāsambhavāt| tathāca kaścit paṭhati– “ghrāṇāśrite śleṣmaṇi mārutena pittena gāḍhaṃ pariśoṣite ca||” iti| pratapta ityasya sthāne ‘pradīpte’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ| kṛcchrācchvasedūrdhvamadhaśca yasminniti kaṣṭenocchvāsaniḥśvāsau karoti yatretyarthaḥ||10||

nāsāśoṣamāha– ghrāṇetyādi| nāsāśoṣastu vāyukṛtasrotaḥśoṣaṇena tadgataśleṣmaśoṣo jñeyaḥ| pratapta ityanena ca pittamapi gamyate, pratapanasya pittamantareṇāsambhavāt| pratapta ityasya sthāne ‘pradīpte’ iti pāṭhāntare sa evārthaḥ| asyāyameveṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ| kṛcchrācchvasitīti kaṣṭenocchvasiti śvāsaṃ karoti yatretyarthaḥ| vaidehe'sya lakṣaṇam– “vātapittau yadā ghrāṇakapharaktaṃ viśoṣayet| tadā syāducchvasennāsā tasya śuṣkaṃ vidhīyate|| bhṛśaśuṣkāvacūrṇena nāsāśoṣaṃ tu taṃ viduḥ|” iti||10||
śirogurutvamarucirnāsāsrāvastanuḥ svaraḥ | kṣāmaḥ ṣṭhīvatyathābhīkṣṇamāmapīnasalakṣaṇam ||11||
āmaliṅgānvitaḥ śleṣmā ghanaḥ kheṣu nimajjati | svaravarṇaviśuddhiśca paripakvasya lakṣaṇam ||12||

cikitsābhedārthaṃ pīnasasyāmapakvalakṣaṇamāha– śirogurutvamityādi| tanuraghanaḥ| svaraḥ kṣāma iti avispaṣṭaṃ vacanam| ṣṭhīvatyathābhīkṣṇamiti muhurmuhurnāsikayā śleṣmāṇaṃ nirasyatītyarthaḥ| āmarasānvitena doṣeṇa śirogurutvādayaḥ| “āmaliṅgānvitaḥ śleṣmā ghanaḥ kheṣu nimajjati” ityādi pakvalakṣaṇam| āmaliṅgaiḥ śirogurutvādibhiranvitaḥ śleṣmā nimajjatīti līno bhavati| ayamarthaḥ– śleṣmā tāvallīno bhavati, āmaliṅgānyapi līnāni bhavanti, tathāca ‘tanutvamāmaliṅgānām’ iti suśrutaḥ| ‘na sajjati’ iti pāṭhāntare na sakto ‘bhavatīti’ iti pā.| bhavati, na tiṣṭhatīti yāvat; tadā''maliṅgānvitaḥ stokenāmaliṅgenānvitaḥ| ghanaḥ styānaḥ| kheṣu nāsārandhreṣu, ‘sthitaḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ; vyaktyapekṣayā bahuvacanam| svaraviśuddhiḥ svarabhedābhāvaḥ, varṇaviśuddhiḥ prakṛtisavarṇatā||11-12||

cikitsābhedārthaṃ pīnasasyāmapakvalakṣaṇaṃ kathayannāha– śira ityādi| tanuḥ aghanaḥ, svaraḥ kṣāmaḥ avispaṣṭavacanaḥ, etacca– ‘ṣṭhīvettathā'bhīkṣṇam’ iti pā.| ṣṭhīvettathā'bhīkṣṇamiti murhurmuhurnāsayā śleṣmāṇaṃ nirasyatītyarthaḥ| pakvalakṣaṇamāha– āmetyādi| āmaliṅgaiḥ śirogurutvādibhiranvitaḥ śleṣmā, nimajjati līno bhavatīti, ayamarthaḥ– śleṣmā vilīno bhavati, āmaliṅgānyapi, tathāca– “tanutvaṃ cāmaliṅgānām” iti suśrute| ‘na sajjati’ iti pāṭhāntare na sakto bhavati, na tiṣṭhatīti yāvat| svaraviśuddhiḥ svarabhedābhāvaḥ, varṇaviśuddhiḥ prakṛtivarṇatā||11-12||

div.ab: sandhāraṇājīrṇarajotibhāṣyakrodhartuvaiṣamyaśirobhitāpaiḥ | prajāgarātisvapanāmbuśītairavaśyayā maithunabāṣpadhūmaiḥ | saṃstyānadoṣe śirasi pravṛddho vāyuḥ pratiśyāyamudīrayettu ||13|| (ca. ci. a. 26) | cayaṃ gatā mūrdhani mārutādayaḥ pṛthak samastāśca tathaiva śoṇitam | prakupyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇaistataḥ pratiśyāyakarā bhavanti hi ||14|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) |

ab.seg: pratiśyāyaḥ pañcavidho bhavati, vātapittakaphasannipātaraktajabhedāt; tasya nidānaṃ dvividham– ekaṃ sadyojanakaṃ, tacca balavattvena cayaṃ nāpekṣata eva; aparaṃ cayādikrameṇa janakaṃ, cayādikramotpannaśca doṣo garīyān sakalaśarīrasambhāvanayā baddhamūlatvāt| tatra sadyojanakanidānapūrvikāṃ tasya samprāptimāha– sandhāraṇetyādi| sandhāraṇaṃ purīṣādivegadhāraṇaṃ, rajo dhūliḥ, śirobhitāpaḥ śiro'bhitapyate yena sa śirobhitāpo dhūmādiḥ; rajodhūmādayaśca nāsāpraviṣṭāḥ santo hetavaḥ| atisvapanaṃ divāsvapanamityarthaḥ| avaśyayā tuṣāreṇa| saṃstyānadoṣe śirasīti ghanībhūtaśleṣmaṇi śirasi| suśrutenāpi sadyojanakaṃ nidānaṃ paṭhitaṃ; tadyathā– “nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītamatipratāpaḥ| sandhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayośca sadyaḥ pratiśyāyanidānamuktam||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) iti| cayādikrameṇa janakamapi doṣaṃ darśayannāha– cayaṃ gatā ityādi| cayaṃ gatā iti sāmarthyāt sve sve sthāne, “svasthānavṛddhirdoṣāṇāṃ caya ityabhidhīyate|” iti vacanāt| tathaiva śoṇitamiti cayaṃ gatam| nanu, yadi svasthānasthitā doṣāḥ tat kathaṃ mūrdhni pratiśyāyasambhavaḥ? ityāha– ‘prakopyamāṇā vividhaiḥ’ iti pā.| ayameva pāṭho jyāyān, antarbhāvitaṇyarthakalpane gauravāt| prakupyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇairiti| vividhairiti balavadvigrahadivāsvapnādibhiḥ| prakopaviśeṣaśca prasaraḥ| yaduktam– “prakupitānāṃ paryuṣitakiṇvodakapiṣṭasamavāya ivodriktānāṃ prasaro bhavati|” (su. sū. a. 21) iti| ata eva, “cayaprakopapraśamāḥ pittādīnāṃ yathākramam|” ityatra prakopamātramupāttam| etena prasareṇa śiraḥsamprāptā doṣāḥ pratiśyāyakarāḥ| anye tu cayaṃ gatā mūrdhanīti yathāsthitameva yojayanti, udānavāyorūrdhvagatitvācchirasyapi sambhavāt, tvaksirāśritatvāt pittāsṛjoḥ kaphasya ca nisargataḥ śirovasthiteḥ śirasi caya iti| tata iti prakopaviśeṣāt prasarādanantaram| pratiśyāya iti vātaṃ prati abhimukhaṃ śyāyo gamanaṃ kaphādīnāṃ yatra sa pratiśyāyaḥ| ‘śaiṅ’ gatau, ityasya prayogaḥ| tathāca carakaḥ– “ghrāṇamūle sthitaḥ śleṣmā rudhiraṃ pittameva vā| mārutādhmātaśirasaḥ śyāyate mārutaṃ prati||” (ca. ci. a. 8)||13-14||

evaṃ nāsārogā daśa śrīkaṇṭhoktāḥ kathitāḥ| pratiśyāyaḥ pañcavidho bhavati, vātapittakaphasannipātaraktajabhedāt, tasya samprāptimāha– sandhāraṇetyādi| nidānaṃ dvividham– ekaṃ sadyojanakam, aparaṃ ‘cayādikriyājātam’ iti pā.| cayādikramajātaṃ, tatredaṃ sadyonidānam| sandhāraṇaṃ purīṣādivegavidhāraṇaṃ, rajo dhūliḥ, śirobhitāpaḥ śiro'bhitāpyate yena sa śirobhitāpaḥ dhūmādiḥ, rajodhūmādayaśca nāsāpraviṣṭāḥ pratiśyāyahetavaḥ, atisvapnaṃ divāsvapnamityarthaḥ| avaśyayā tuṣāreṇa| saṃstyānadoṣe śirasīti saṃhatakaphe śirasi| suśrutenāpi sadyojanakaṃ ‘nidānam’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | nidānaṃ paṭhitam| tadyathā– “nārīprasaṅgaḥ śiraso'bhitāpo dhūmo rajaḥ śītamatipratāpaḥ| sandhāraṇaṃ mūtrapurīṣayośca sadyaḥpratiśyāyanidānamuktam||” iti| cayādikramajasya nidānamāha– cayamityādi| cayaṃ gatāḥ iti sve sve sthāne sañcayaṃ prāptāḥ “svasthānavṛddhirdoṣāṇāṃ cayaḥ” iti vacanāt| mārutādaya iti vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ ete, tathaiva śoṇitamapi cayaṃ gataṃ tato mūrdhni pratiśyāyakaraṃ bhavatīti yojyam| nanu, yadi sve sve sthāne sthitā doṣāstatkathaṃ mūrdhni pratiśyāyasambhavaḥ ityāha– etacca ‘prakopyamāṇā vividhaiḥ’ iti pā.| ayameva pāṭho jyāyān, antarbhāvitaṇyarthakalpane gauravāt| prakopyamāṇā vividhaiḥ prakopaṇairiti, ‘balavadvigrahādibhiḥ krodhādibhirdivāsvapnādibhiśca’ iti pā.| balavadvigrahādikrodhādidivāsvapnādibhiśca kopanaiḥ prakopyamāṇāḥ; prakopaviśeṣaśca prasaraḥ| yaduktam– “kupitānāṃ doṣāṇāṃ kiṇvodakapiṣṭasamavāya ivodgatānāṃ prasaro bhavati” iti| ata evāha– “cayaprakopopaśamāḥ pittādīnāṃ yathākramam” iti| ata eva prakopamātramupāttam| evaṃ ca prasaraṇasthānasaṃśrayeṇa śiraḥsamprāptā doṣāḥ pratiśyāyakarāḥ| anye tu cayaṃ gato mūrdhnīti yathāvasthitameva manyante, udānavāyorūrdhvagatitvāt, śirasyapi vātasamudbhavatvāt| ‘tvakśirā ... ’ iti pā.| tvaksirāsṛtatvātpittāsṛjoḥ kaphasya ca nisargataḥ śirovasthiteḥ śirasi caya iti| athavā sarvaśarīracarāstu vātapittaśleṣmāṇaḥ saraktāḥ, sarvatraitatkāryadarśanāt| tata iti prakopaviśeṣāt prasarādanantaram| pratiśyāya iti vātaṃ prati abhimukhaṃ śyāyo gamanaṃ kaphādīnāṃ yatra sa pratiśyāyaḥ| ‘śyaiṅ’ gatau ityasya prayogaḥ| tathā carakaḥ– “ghrāṇamūle sthitaḥ śleṣmā rudhiraṃ pittameva ca| mārutādhmānaśirasaḥ śyāyate mārutaṃ prati|| pratiśyāyastato ghoro jāyate dehakarṣaṇaḥ|” iti||13-14||

div.ab: kṣavapravṛttiḥ śiraso'tipūrṇatā stambho'ṅgamardaḥ parihṛṣṭaromatā | upadravāścāpyapare pṛthagvidhā nṛṇāṃ pratiśyāyapuraḥsarāḥ smṛtāḥ ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) |

ab.seg: tasya pūrvarūpamāha– kṣavapravṛttirityādi| upadravāścāpyapare iti upadravāstatkālabhāvino rogāḥ, natu pāribhāṣikāḥ paścātkālabhāvinaḥ; te ca ghrāṇadhūmāyanamanthādayaḥ| yadāha videhaḥ– “pūrvarūpāṇi dṛśyante pratiśyāye bhaviṣyati| ghrāṇadhūmāyanaṃ manthaḥ kṣavathustāludāraṇam|| kaṇṭhadhvaṃso mukhasrāvaḥ śirasaḥ pūraṇaṃ tathā|” iti| puraḥsarā iti pūrvarūpāṇi||15||

tasya pūrvarūpamāha– kṣavetyādi| upadravāḥ tatkālabhāvino rogāḥ| apare iti ghrāṇadhūmāyanamanthādayaḥ| yaduktaṃ videhe– “pūrvarūpāṇi dṛśyante pratiśyāye bhaviṣyati| ghrāṇadhūmāyanaṃ manthaḥ kṣavathustāludāraṇam| kaṇṭhadhvaṃso mukhasrāvaḥ śirasaḥ pūraṇaṃ tathā||” iti| puraḥsarā iti pūrvarūpāṇi||15||

div.ab: ānaddhā pihitā nāsā tanusrāvaprasekinī | galatālvoṣṭhaśoṣaśca nistodaḥ śaṅkhayostathā ||16|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) | kṣavapravṛttiratyarthaṃ vaktravairasyameva ca | bhavet svaropaghātaśca pratiśyāye'nilātmake ||17|| uṣṇaḥ sapītakaḥ srāvo ghrāṇāt sravati paittike | kṛśo'tipāṇḍuḥ santapto bhaveduṣṇābhipīḍitaḥ ||18|| sadhūmamagniṃ sahasā vamatīva sa mānavaḥ | ghrāṇāt kaphaḥ kaphakṛte śītaḥ pāṇḍuḥ sravedbahuḥ | śuklāvabhāsaḥ śuklākṣo bhavedguruśirā naraḥ ||19|| kaṇṭhatālvoṣṭhaśirasāṃ kaṇḍūbhirabhipīḍitaḥ | (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) |

vātādipratiśyāyaliṅgānyāha– ānaddhetyādi| ānaddhā vibaddhā| pihitā sapidhāneva| nistodaḥ sūcivyadhanavadvyathā| śaṅkhayoriti bhrūpucchāntayoḥ| sapītaka iti īṣat pītaḥ| pittapratiśyāyavān mānavaḥ kṛśo bhavati| atipāṇḍurdhūsaraḥ| uṣṇābhipīḍita iti uṣṇaguṇenābhipīḍita ityarthaḥ||16-19||–

teṣu vātikamāha– ānaddhetyādi| ānaddhā vibaddhā, ādhmānāpūriteveti yāvat| pihitā sapidhāneva, tathā galatālvoṣṭhaśoṣādayo bhavanti, nistodaḥ śūlavyadhanavadvyathā, śaṅkhayoriti bhrūpucchāntayoḥ| paittikamāha– sapītaka ityādi| īṣatpītakaḥ| pittapratiśyāyavānmānavaḥ kṛśo bhavati| atipāṇḍurdhūsaraḥ, uṣṇābhipīḍita iti uṣṇaguṇenābhipīḍitaḥ| ślaiṣmikamāha– sadhūmamityādi| śuklāvabhāsaḥ śvetavapuḥ, etacca ‘śuklāvabhāsaḥ śūnākṣaḥ’ iti pā.| śūnākṣaḥ ucchūnanayanaḥ||16-19||–
bhūtvā bhūtvā pratiśyāyo yasyākasmānnivartate ||20|| sampakvo vā'pyapakvo vā sa sarvaprabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ | (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) |

sannipātajamāha– bhūtvetyādi| bhūtvā bhūtvā iti vīpsayā punaḥ punaḥ ‘sambhavanam’ iti pā.| sambhavaṃ darśayati| anyatamadoṣasya kālādinā'navadhāritena balahānernivṛttiḥ, akasmāt pravṛttirapi asamyaṅnivṛttadoṣasya kālādinā balalābhāt| atra yadyapi doṣatrayaliṅgāni noktāni, tathā'pi sarvaprabhavatvāt pratyetavyāni| asādhyaścāyaṃ duṣṭatāṃ gataḥ san, “nṛṇāṃ duṣṭapratiśyāyastvasādhyaḥ sarvajaḥ smṛtaḥ|” iti videhavacanāt||20||–

sānnipātikamāha– ‘bhūtvābhūtveti’ iti pā.| bhūtvetyādi| vīpsayā punaḥpunaḥ sambhavaṃ darśayati| anyatamadoṣasya kālādinā'navadhāritena balahānernivṛttiḥ, akasmāt pravṛttirapi, asamyaṅnivṛttadoṣasya kālādinā balalābhāt| atra yadyapi doṣatrayaliṅgāni noktāni tathā'pi sarvaprabhavatvāt pratyetavyāni| kecit ‘sarvaprabhavaḥ smṛtaḥ’ ityasyāgre'dhikaṃ pādadvayaṃ paṭhanti, tacca– “liṅgāni caiva sarveṣāṃ pīnasānāṃ ca sarvaje” iti sarvaje pratiśyāye sarveṣāṃ vātādīnāṃ pīnasānāṃ liṅgāni bhavantīti yojyam| asādhyaścāyaṃ duṣṭatāṃ gataḥ san– “nṛṇāṃ duṣṭapratiśyāyastvasādhyaḥ sarvajaḥ smṛtaḥ” iti videhavacanāt||20||–

praklidyate punarnāsā punaśca pariśuṣyati ||21|| punarānahyate vā'pi punarvivriyate tathā | niḥśvāso vā'tidurgandho naro gandhān na vetti ca ||22|| evaṃ duṣṭapratiśyāyaṃ jānīyāt kṛcchrasādhanam | (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) |

ab.seg: ekadoṣasyāpi durupacārāddoṣadvayānubandhena duṣṭatāṃ gatasya doṣatrayasambandhasāmyena sannipātajānantaraṃ liṅgamāha– praklidyate punarnāsetyādi| ānahyata iti ‘vidahyate’ iti pā.| vibadhyate| vivriyata iti vigatāvaraṇā bhavatītyarthaḥ| kledaśoṣapidhānavivaraṇāni naikakālaṃ bhinnadoṣajāni boddhavyāni, tena virodho nodbhāvanīyaḥ| evamiti itthambhūtaliṅgaṃ duṣṭapratiśyāyaṃ parasparaviruddhopakramadoṣasambandhāt kṛcchrasādhyaṃ jānīyāt| ayaṃ ca pañcānāmevāvasthāntaratayā ananyatvānna ṣaṣṭhaḥ| nanu, avasthāntaratve'pi abhiṣyandādadhimantha iva bhinno bhaviṣyati? na, tadvadvātādijatvenānirdeśāt||21-22||

ekadoṣasyāpi durupacārād doṣadvayānubandhena ‘duṣṭatām’ iti pā.| duṣṭiṃ gatasya doṣatrayasambandhasāmyena sannipātajānantaraṃ duṣṭapratiśyāyaliṅgamāha– praklidyata ityādi| ānahyata iti vibadhyate, vivriyata iti vigatāvaraṇā bhavati, kledaśoṣapidhānavivaraṇāni naikakālaṃ bhinnadoṣajāni boddhavyāni, tena virodho nodbhāvanīyaḥ| itthambhūtaliṅgaṃ duṣṭapratiśyāyaṃ parasparaviruddhopakramadoṣasambandhāt kṛcchrasādhyaṃ jānīyāt| ayaṃ ca pañcānāmevāvasthāntaratayā'nanyatvānna ṣaṣṭho gaṇanīyaḥ| nanvavasthāntaratve'pi abhiṣyandādadhimantha iva bhinno bhaviṣyatīti? naivaṃ, tadvadvātādijatvenānirdeśāt||21-22||

div.ab: raktaje tu pratiśyāye raktasrāvaḥ pravartate ||23|| tāmrākṣaśca bhavejjantururoghātaprapīḍitaḥ | durgandhocchvāsavadano gandhānapi na vetti saḥ ||24|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) |

ab.seg: raktajaliṅgamāha– raktaja ityādi| uroghātaprapīḍita iti uroghātastantrāntarapaṭhitalakṣaṇaḥ, tena prakarṣeṇa pīḍitaḥ| tadyathā– “uraḥkṣatamuraḥstambhaḥ pūtikarṇakaphorasaḥ| sakāsaḥ sajvaro jñeya uroghātaḥ sapīnasaḥ||” iti| atra pittapratiśyāyaliṅgānyapi boddhavyāni, tulyatvāt pittaraktayoḥ| tathā ca kvacit paṭhyate– “pittapratiśyāyakṛtairliṅgaiścāpi samanvitaḥ|” iti||23-24||

raktajapratiśyāyaliṅgamāha– raktaja ityādi| uroghātaḥ tantrāntarapaṭhitalakṣaṇaḥ, tena prakarṣeṇa pīḍitaḥ, tadyathā– “uraḥkṣatamuraḥstambhaḥ pūtikarṇakaphorasaḥ| sakāsaḥ sajvaro jñeya uroghātaḥ sapīnasaḥ||” iti| atra pittapratiśyāyaliṅgānyapi boddhavyāni, tulyatvātpittaraktayoḥ| tathāca kvacitpaṭhyate– “pittapratiśyāyakṛtairliṅgaiścāpi samanvitaḥ” iti||23-24||

div.ab: sarva eva pratiśyāyā narasyāpratikāriṇaḥ | duṣṭatāṃ yānti kālena tadā'sādhyā bhavanti hi ||25|| mūrchanti cātra krimayaḥ śvetāḥ snigdhāstathā'ṇavaḥ | ‘krimijaḥ’ iti pā. | krimito yaḥ śirorogastulyaṃ tenāsya lakṣaṇam ||26|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) |

ab.seg: apratikriyayā kālāntareṇa sarva eva ‘duṣṭapratiśyāyo bhavati, sa cāsādhya’ iti pā.| duṣṭapratiśyāyā bhavanti, te cāsādhyā ityāha– sarva evetyādi| mūrchanti cātra krimaya iti atreti eṣu, bahuvacanāntāttralpratyayavidhiḥ; anye tu pratyāsannatvāt raktaja eva krimimūrchanaṃ vadanti| śvetā iti kaphādhikatvāt pratiśyāyasya sarvatra kaphajā eva śvetakrimayo bhavanti| ‘krimito yaḥ śirorogastulyaṃ tenāsya lakṣaṇam’ iti krimijaśirorogeṇeha tulyaṃ liṅgaṃ, tacca “nistudyate yasya śiro'timātram” ityādinā vakṣyamāṇam||25-26||

sarva eva pratiśyāyā apratikriyamāṇāḥ kālāntareṇa duṣṭatāṃ yānti, te cāsādhyā bhavantītyata āha– sarva ityādi| atra eṣu pratiśyāyeṣu, bahuvacanāntāttral| anye tu pratyāsannatvāt raktaja eva krimimūrchanaṃ vadanti| śveta iti kaphādhikatvāt| ‘pratiśyāyasya’ iti pā.| pratiśyāye sarvatra kaphajā eva śvetāḥ kṛmayo bhavanti| etacca– ‘krimijo yaḥ śirorogaḥ’ iti pā.| krimijo ya ityādi krimijaśirorogeṇa tulyaṃ liṅgamityarthaḥ| tallakṣaṇam– “nistudyate yasya śiro'timātram” ityādi śiroroganidāne vakṣyamāṇam||25-26||

div.ab: bādhiryamāndhyamaghratvaṃ ghorāṃśca nayanāmayān | śothāgnisādakāsāṃśca vṛddhāḥ kurvanti pīnasāḥ ||27|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 24) |

ab.seg: ataḥ paramaparān vikārān pravṛddhāḥ pratiśyāyāḥ kurvanti, tānāha– bādhiryamityādi| ‘ghoranayanāmayābhidhānādevāndhye’ iti pā.| ghorānnayanāmayānityabhidhānādevāndhye labdhe viśeṣeṇa tatkaratvapratipādanārthamāndhyagrahaṇam| aghratvamiti na jighratītyaghrastasya ‘ ... aghratvaṃ prāṇendriyaduṣṭyā’ iti pā.| bhāvo'ghratvam| ‘ghrā’ gandhopādāne, ityasmāt ‘supi sthaḥ’ ityatra yogavibhāgāt kapratyayaḥ||27||

ataḥ paramaparān yān vikārān pravṛddhāḥ pratiśyāyāḥ kurvanti tānāha– bādhiryamityādi| ghoranayanāmayābhidhānādevāndhye labdhe viśeṣeṇa tatkaratvapratipādanārthamāndhyagrahaṇam| aghratvamiti na jighratītyaghraḥ, tasya bhāvo'ghratvam| ‘ghrā’ gandhopādāne, ityasmāt “supi sthaḥ” ityatra “supi” iti yogavibhāgātkapratyayaḥ||27||
arbudaṃ saptadhā śothāścatvāro'rśaścaturvidham | caturvidhaṃ raktapittamuktaṃ ghrāṇe'pi tadviduḥ ||28||

suśrute nāsārogā ekatriṃśaduktāḥ, ‘tatra pīnasamārabhya’ iti pā.| atrāpyapīnasamārabhya pratiśyāyaparyantena pañcadaśoktāḥ, ‘aparān ṣoḍaśasaṅkhyāpūraṇāya’ iti pāṭhaḥ| śeṣasaṅkhyāpūraṇāya aparān ṣoḍaśa nāsārogānāha– arbudaṃ saptadhetyādi| ekaikadoṣaraktamāṃsamedaḥsambhavatvena ṣaḍarbudāni, śālākyasiddhāntena sannipātajamadhikam, evaṃ sapta| tathāca videhaḥ– “sarvaliṅgaṃ rujāyuktamarbudaṃ viddhi sarvajam|” iti| śothāścatvāro vātapittakaphasannipātajabhedāt, ‘evamarśo hi’ iti pā.| evamarśo'pi caturvidhaṃ, raktapittaṃ caturvidhamapi tacca raktapittatvasāmānyādekatvena gaṇanīyaṃ, tena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| arbudādīnāṃ tatra tatroktānāmatrābhidhānaṃ śālākyoktasaṅkhyāpūraṇārthamāśrayaprabhāveṇātiriktaliṅgādikhyāpanārthaṃ ca||28||

suśrute nāsārogā ekatriṃśaduktāḥ| tatra pīnasamārabhya pratiśyāyaparyantena pañcadaśoktāḥ, aparān ṣoḍaśa saṅkhyāpūraṇāya nāsārogānāha– arbudamityādi| vātapittakaphaśoṇitamāṃsamedojatvena ṣaḍvidhamarbudaṃ, śālākyasiddhāntena, videhena sannipātajamadhikamuktam, evaṃ sapta| śothāścatvāro vātapittakaphasannipātabhedāt evamarśo'pi caturvidhaṃ, sahajaraktajayorarśasordoṣaje'ntarbhāvaḥ| raktapittaṃ caturvidhamapi raktapittatvasāmānyādekatvena gaṇanīyaṃ, tena na saṅkhyātirekaḥ| arbudādīnāmuktānāmapyatrābhidhānaṃ śālākyoktasaṅkhyāpūraṇāya, āśrayaprabhāveṇātiriktaliṅgādikhyāpanārthaṃ ca| ghrāṇārśo'rbudayorgranthāntare bheda uktaḥ, tadyathā– “śirolalāṭatālūnāṃ gauravaṃ duḥkhanidratā| arśasāmarbudānāṃ ca doṣaiḥ ‘śoṣākṛtiḥ’ iti pā.| śeṣākṛtiḥ samā|| arśāṃsi gostanākārāṇyarbudaṃ kolasammitam|” iti||28||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne nāsāroganidānaṃ samāptam ||58||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ nāsāroganidānaṃ samāptam||58||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ nāsāroganidānam||58||

div.head: netraroganidānam
div.ab: atha netraroganidānam | uṣṇābhitaptasya jale praveśāddūrekṣaṇāt svapnaviparyayācca | svedādrajodhūmaniṣevaṇācca chardervighātādvamanātiyogāt ||1|| dravāttathā'nnānniśi sevitācca viṇmūtravātakramanigrahācca | prasaktasaṃrodanakopaśokācchiro'bhighātādatimadyapānāt ||2|| tathā ṛtūnāṃ ca viparyayeṇa kleśābhighātādatimaithunācca | bāṣpagrahāt sūkṣmanirīkṣaṇācca netre vikārāñjanayanti doṣāḥ ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 1) | ‘ ... netraroganidānam’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: indriyādhiṣṭhānagatavikārapāriśeṣyānnetrarogābhidhānam| ete ca nayanarogā vātapittakapharaktasannipātāgantujāḥ santaḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “taistribhistriṃśaduktāste ‘kaphenātyadhikāstrayaḥ’ iti pā.| kaphenāpyadhikāstrayaḥ| raktajāḥ ṣoḍaśa proktāḥ sarvajāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ|| bāhyau punardvau ca tathā rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ smṛtāḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 1) iti| ṣaṭsaptatiścaite rogā āśrayabhedena suśrutenaiva vibhaktāḥ|| yadāha– “nava sandhyāśrayāsteṣu vartmajāstvekaviṃśatiḥ| śuklabhāge daśaikaśca catvāraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgajāḥ|| sarvāśrayāḥ saptadaśa dṛṣṭijā dvādaśaiva ‘tu’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tu| dvau ca bāhyāśrayāvanyāvanimittanimittajau|| ṣaṭsaptatirnetrarogāḥ saṅgraheṇa prakīrtitāḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 1) iti| netrapramāṇaṃ ca suśrutenaivoktaṃ “vidyād dvyaṅgulabāhulyaṃ svāṅguṣṭhodarasammitam| dvyaṅgulaṃ sarvataḥ sārdhaṃ bhiṣaṅnayanabudbudam||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 1) iti| dvyaṅgulabāhulyaṃ vistāreṇa, antaḥsvāṅguṣṭhodarasammitam, dvyaṅgulaṃ sarvataḥ sārdhamāyāmena| anye dvyaṅgulabāhulyamiti yaduktaṃ tatra dvyaṅgulamānaniyamaṃ svāṅguṣṭhodarasammitamityanenāhuḥ| ayamarthaḥ– svenāṅguṣṭhodareṇa sammitaṃ dvyaṅgulabahulaṃ, dvyaṅgulaṃ sarvataḥ sārdhamiti cāyāmavistārābhyāṃ boddhavyamiti| nanu, yadyardhatṛtīyāṅgulāyāmaṃ netraṃ tarhi “dvyaṅgulāyataṃ ca nayanam” (su. sū. a. 35) ityāturopakramaṇīyoktaṃ virudhyate? naivaṃ, vartmamaṇḍalaṃ gṛhītvā gaṇanayā'rdhatṛtīyāṅgulaṃ, tadvirahāt dvyaṅgulāyatamiti na virodhaḥ| nayanarogahetumāha– uṣṇābhitaptasyetyādi| uṣṇenātapādinā santaptadehasya jalāvagāhanāt, ‘taduṣmaṇordhvagena’ iti pā.| śītāvṛtadehasyordhvagatenoṣmaṇā ‘yathā madhyandinolkāpātaḥ sūryakiraṇenābhibhūyate’ iti pā.|nayanatejaso'bhibhavāccakṣūrogodayaḥ svedādrajodhūmaniṣevaṇācceti gharmarajodhūmānāṃ nayanasambandhānāṃ hetutvam| chardervighātāt vāntivegavighātāt| vamanātiyogādativānteḥ| viṇmūtravātakramanigrahāt viṇmūtravātānāṃ krameṇa śanaiḥ śanairnigrahāt vegavidhāraṇāt| prasaktasaṃrodanaśokakopāditi prasaktaṃ nirantaraṃ kṛtasaṃrodanāderityarthaḥ| ṛtuviparyayeṇa ‘ekartucaryānyartukaraṇena’ iti pā.| ekartucaryāyā anyartau karaṇena| kleśābhighātāt kleśaḥ kāyādiduḥkhaṃ, ‘kiṃvā kleśo manaḥkhedaḥ, tena abhihananaṃ duḥkhameva|’ iti pā.| tenābhisambandhāt; bāṣpanigrahāt aśruvegadhāraṇāt| ‘yaduktam– “ānandajaṃ vā'pyatha śokajaṃ vā netrodakaṃ prāptamamuñcato hi| śirogurutvaṃ nayanāmayāśca bhavanti tīvrāḥ saha pīnasena||” iti|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yaduktam– “ānandajaṃ vā'pyatha śokajaṃ vā netrodakaṃ prāptamamuñcato hi| śirogurutvaṃ nayanāmayāśca bhavanti tīvrāḥ saha pīnasena||” iti| nayanarogasamprāptiśca suśrute paṭhyate– “ ‘śirānusāribhi ... ’ iti pā.| sirānusāribhirdoṣairviguṇairūrdhvamāśritaiḥ| jāyante netrabhāgeṣu rogāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 1) iti||1-3||

indriyādhiṣṭhānagatavikārapāriśeṣyānnetraroganidānam| ete ca nayanarogā vātapittakapharaktasannipātāgantujāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ| yadāha suśrutaḥ– “taistribhistriṃśaduktāste kaphenābhyadhikāstrayaḥ| raktajāḥ ṣoḍaśa jñeyāḥ sarvajāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ|| bāhyau punardvau ca tathā rogāḥ ṣaṭsaptatiḥ smṛtāḥ|” iti| ṣaṭsaptatiśca rogā āśrayabhedena suśrutenaiva vibhaktāḥ| yadāha– “nava sandhyāśrayāste syurvartmajāstvekaviṃśatiḥ| śuklabhāge daśaikaśca catvāraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgajāḥ|| sarvāśrayāḥ saptadaśa dṛṣṭijā dvādaśaiva tu| dvau ca bāhyāśrayāvanyāvanimittanimittajau|| ṣaṭsaptatirnetrarogāḥ saṅgraheṇa prakīrtitāḥ|” iti| tatra nayanarogahetumāha– uṣṇābhitaptasyetyādi| uṣṇenātapādinā santaptadehasya jalāvagāhanāt| tadūṣmaṇordhvagatena tejaso'bhibhavāccakṣūrogodayaḥ, yathā madhyandinolkāpātaḥ saurakiraṇenābhibhūyate| dūrekṣaṇāt dūrāvalokanāt, svapnaviparyayāt rātrijāgaraṇāddivāsvapnāt, svedādityādi gharmarajodhūmānāṃ nayanasambaddhānāṃ hetutvam| chardervighātāt vāntivegavidhāraṇāt, vamanātiyogādativānteḥ| viṇmūtravātakramanigrahāt viṇmūtravātānāṃ krameṇa śanaiḥśanairgrahāt vegadhāraṇāt| prasaktasaṃrodanaśokakopāt prasaktaṃ nirantaraṃ kṛtasaṃrodanādityarthaḥ| kleśābhighātāt kleśaḥ kāmādiduḥkhaṃ, tena sambandhāt; bāṣpagrahāt bāṣpaṃ netrāmbu, tadvegavidhāraṇāt, sūkṣmavastvavalokanāt, etairhetubhirnetrarogā jāyante| nayanarogasamprāptiḥ suśrute paṭhitā| tadyathā– “ ‘śirānusāribhirdoṣairviguṇairūkṣamārgagaiḥ’ iti pā.| sirānusāribhirdoṣairviguṇairūrdhvamārgagaiḥ| jāyante netrabhāgeṣu rogāḥ paramadāruṇāḥ||” iti||1-3||
vātāt pittāt kaphādraktādabhiṣyandaścaturvidhaḥ | prāyeṇa jāyate ghoraḥ sarvanetrāmayākaraḥ ||4||

sāmānyapūrvakatvāt viśeṣasya, tathā sarvanayanarogahetutvācca, ādau sarvanayanagatamabhiṣyandamāha– vātādityādi| ghora iti duḥsahavedanaḥ| sarvanetrāmayākara iti sarveṣāṃ netrarogāṇāmadhimanthādīnāmākara utpattikaratvāt; ākaraḥ sthānam| ata evāha suśrutaḥ– “prāyeṇa sarve nayanāmayāste bhavantyabhiṣyandanimittamūlāḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 1) iti||4||

sāmānyapūrvakatvādviśeṣasya, sarvanayanarogahetutvāccādau sarvanayanagatamabhiṣyandamāha– vātādityādi| ghoraḥ duḥsahavedanaḥ| sarvanetrāmayākara iti sarveṣāmeva netrarogāṇāmadhimanthādīnāmākaraḥ sthānam, utpattikaratvāt| ata evāha suśrutaḥ– “prāyeṇa sarve nayanāmayāste bhavantyabhiṣyandanimittamūlāḥ|” iti||4||

div.ab: nistodanastambhanaromaharṣasaṅgharṣapāruṣyaśiro'bhitāpāḥ | viśuṣkabhāvaḥ śiśirāśrutā ca vātābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: vātābhiṣyandarūpamāha– nistodanetyādi| nistodanaṃ ‘prājanavyadhanavadvyathā’ iti pā.| sūcīvyadhanavadvyathā, stambhanaṃ jaḍimā, saṅgharṣaḥ karakarikā, pāruṣyaṃ rūkṣatā, śiro'bhitāpaḥ śirovyathā| viśuṣkabhāvo dūṣikārahitatvaṃ, na tvāsrāvarahitatvaṃ, śiśirāśrutetyukteḥ||5||

vātābhiṣyandamāha– nistodanaṃ śūlaṃ tadvad vyathā, stambhanaṃ jaḍimā, saṅgharṣaḥ vālukāpūritā iva karakarikā, pāruṣyaṃ rūkṣatvaṃ, śirobhitāpaḥ śirovyathā, viśuṣkabhāvo dūṣikārahitatvaṃ, netrāsrāvarahitatvaṃ tu śiśirāśrutetyuktaṃ na ghaṭate||5||

div.ab: dāhaprapākau śiśirābhinandā dhūmāyanaṃ bāṣpasamucchrayaśca | uṣṇāśrutā pītakanetratā ca pittābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: paittikalakṣaṇamāha– dāhaprapākāvityādi| prapākaḥ prakṛṣṭapākaḥ| śiśirābhinandā śītecchā| dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmasyodvamanam| bāṣpasamucchrayo bāṣpabāhulyam||6||
pittajamāha– dāhetyādi| śiśirābhinandā śiśirecchā, dhūmāyanaṃ dhūmasyevodvamanaṃ, bāṣpasamucchrayaḥ bāṣpabāhulyam||6||

div.ab: uṣṇābhinandā gurutā'kṣiśothaḥ kaṇḍūpadehāvatiśītatā ca | srāvo muhuḥ picchila eva cāpi kaphābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: kaphajaliṅgamāha– uṣṇābhinandetyādi| upadehaḥ piccaṭabāhulyam| śītatā netrasya| picchila iti srāvaviśeṣaṇam| kaphābhipanne kaphayukte| nayane cakṣuṣi| bhavanti jāyante||7||
kaphajamāha– uṣṇetyādi| sugamam||7||

div.ab: tāmrāśrutā lohitanetratā ca nāḍyaḥ samantādatilohitāśca | pittasya liṅgāni ca yāni tāni raktābhipanne nayane bhavanti ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: raktābhiṣyandalakṣaṇamāha– tāmrāśrutetyādi| pittasya liṅgānīti pittābhiṣyandaliṅgāni||8||
raktajamāha– ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | tāmrāśrutetyādi| pittasyāpi liṅgāni pittābhiṣyandasyāpi liṅgāni||8||

div.ab: vṛddhairetairabhiṣyandairnarāṇāmakriyāvatām | tāvantastvadhimanthāḥ syurnayane tīvravedanāḥ ||9|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: adhimanthānāmabhiṣyandajatvamāha– vṛddhairityādi| tāvanta iti abhiṣyandairvātapittakapharaktajaiścatvāro'dhimanthāḥ pratyetavyāḥ| tīvravedanā iti sāmānyalakṣaṇam| vedanāśabdaścātra vyathāmātravācī, tena vātikābhiṣyandādvātika evādhimanthastīvravātajanitatodādisakalavedanaḥ, evaṃ pittajakaphajaraktajāścādhimanthāḥ pratyetavyāḥ||9||

adhimanthānāmabhiṣyandajatvamāha– vṛddhairityādi| vṛddhiṃ gataiḥ apratikriyamāṇatvāt| tāvanta iti abhiṣyandairvātapittakapharaktajaiścaturbhiścatvāro'dhimanthāḥ| tīvrā vātajā eva sarvā nistodādivedanā, evaṃ pittakapharaktajāścādhimanthāḥ pratyetavyāḥ||9||

div.ab: utpāṭyata ivātyarthaṃ netraṃ nirmathyate tathā | śiraso'rdhaṃ ca taṃ vidyādadhimanthaṃ svalakṣaṇaiḥ ||10|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: asyāparaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– utpāṭyata ‘ivātyarthamityādi’ iti pā.| ityādi| ‘śiraso'rdhaṃ cetyatra’ iti pā.| śiraso'rdhamityatra pūrvakriye sambadhyete, tena śiraso'rdhamutpāṭyate tathā nirmathyate cetyarthaḥ| śiraso'rdhe ca vedanā vyādhiprabhāvāt| svalakṣaṇairiti yathoktavātādyabhiṣyandalakṣaṇaiḥ| sa ‘cādhimanthastadātmakaḥ’ iti pā.| cādhimandhaḥ syandātmakaḥ||10||
asyāparaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– utpāṭyata ityādi| śiro'rdhe vedanā vyādhiprabhāvāt| svalakṣaṇairiti yathoktavātābhiṣyandalakṣaṇaiḥ, sa cādhimanthastadātmakaḥ||10||

div.ab: hanyāddṛṣṭiṃ ślaiṣmikaḥ saptarātrādadhimantho raktajaḥ pañcarātrāt | ‘ṣaḍrātrādvai mārutottho’ iti pā. | ṣaḍrātrādvātiko vai nihanyānmithyācārāt paittikaḥ sadya eva ||11|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) | ‘doṣabhedena kālāvadhimāha– hanyādityādi|’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: yāvatā kālena ‘yāvatkālena’ iti pā.| mithyācārāddṛṣṭiṃ hanti ‘tānāha’ iti pā.| tamāha– ‘hanyāddṛṣṭimityādi’ iti pā.| hanyādityādi| sadya eveti śleṣmaṇi saptarātrasyoktatvāt sadyaḥśabdenātra trirātramuktaṃ, vaidyake hi sadyaḥśabdasya trirātrasaptarātravācitvena dṛṣṭatvāt| kālāvadhiratra vyādhisvabhāvāt||11||

yāvatā kālena mithyācārād dṛṣṭiṃ harati, tadāha– hanyādityādi| śleṣmaṇi saptarātrasyoktatvāt| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sadyaḥśabdenātra trirātramuktam| kālāvadhistu vyādhisvabhāvāt||11||
udīrṇavedanaṃ netraṃ rāgaśothasamanvitam | gharṣanistodaśūlāśruyuktamāmānvitaṃ viduḥ ||12||

laṅghanapralepādividhānārtham añjanādiniṣedhārthaṃ ca netrarogasya sāmatvalakṣaṇamāha– udīrṇavedanamityādi| udīrṇavedanamudgatabahuvedanam| gharṣaḥ karakarikā| laṅghanādividhānārthamañjanādiniṣedhārthaṃ ca tantrāntaram– “svedaḥ pralepastiktānnaṃ dhūmo dinacatuṣṭayam| laṅghanaṃ cākṣirogāṇāmāmānāṃ pācanāni ṣaṭ|| añjanaṃ sarpiṣaḥ pānaṃ kaṣāyaṃ gurubhojanam| netrarogeṣu sāmeṣu snānaṃ cāpi vivarjayet||” iti||12||

laṅghanapralepanādividhānārtham añjanādiniṣedhārthaṃ ca ‘netrarogasya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| netrarogasyāmalakṣaṇamāha– udīrṇetyādi| udīrṇavedanam udgatavedanam| gharṣaḥ karakarikāviśeṣaḥ| laṅghanādividhānārthamañjanādiniṣedhārthaṃ ca tantrāntare uktam– “svedaḥ pralepastiktānnaṃ dhūmo dinacatuṣṭayam| laṅghanaṃ cākṣirogāṇāmāmānāṃ paktiriṣyate||” iti||12||
mandavedanatā kaṇḍūḥ saṃrambhāśrupraśāntatā | praśastavarṇatā cākṣṇoḥ sampakvadoṣamādiśet ||13||
nirāmalakṣaṇamāha– mandetyādi| saṃrambhāśrupraśāntateti saṃrambhaḥ śothaḥ tasya, aśruṇo netrajalasya ca praśamaḥ||13||
nirāmalakṣaṇamāha– mandetyādi||13||

div.ab: kaṇḍūpadehāśruyutaḥ pakvodumbarasannibhaḥ | saṃrambhī pacyate yastu netrapākaḥ sa śothajaḥ | śothahīnāni liṅgāni netrapāke tvaśothaje ||14|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: saśothapākaliṅgamāha– kaṇḍūpadehāśruyuta ityādi| pakvodumbarasannibha iti ‘rāgātiśayitatvāt’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| lohitaḥ| saṃrambhīti śothavān; kārtikastu mahārambhavānityāha; śothastvanukto'pi gamyate, tatpradhānatvāt pākasya, uttaratra śothahīnānītyasyābhidhānācca| ayaṃ tridoṣajaḥ, evamaśothapākaśca||14||

netrapākamāha– kaṇḍvityādi| pakvodumbarasannibha iti lauhityena| saṃrambhī śothavān| kārtikastu ‘mahārambha iti paṭhitavān’ iti pā.| mahārambhavānityāha; śothastvanukto'pi gamyate, tatpradhānatvāt pākasya, uttaratra śothahīnānītyabhidhānācca| ayaṃ tridoṣajaḥ| aśothamāha– śothetyādi atra śotharahitāni netrapākalakṣaṇāni jānīyāt||14||

div.ab: upekṣaṇādakṣi yadā'dhimantho vātātmakaḥ sādayati prasahya | rujābhirugrābhirasādhya eṣa hatādhimanthaḥ khalu nāma rogaḥ ||15|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: hatādhimanthalakṣaṇamāha– ‘upekṣadakṣītyādi’ iti pā.| upekṣaṇādityādi| ayaṃ rogo videhe dṛṣṭyutkṣepalakṣaṇa ekaḥ, anyaḥ sakalanayanaśoṣalakṣaṇaḥ paṭhyate| tadyathā– “antargataḥ ‘śirāṇām’ iti pā.| sirāṇāṃ tu yadā tiṣṭhati mārutaḥ| sa tadā nayanaṃ prāpya śīghraṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nirasyati|| tasyāṃ nirasyamānāyāṃ nirmanthanniva mārutaḥ| nayanaṃ nirvamatyāśu śūlatodādhimanthanaiḥ||” iti| idaṃ dṛṣṭinirgamalakṣaṇam, ata evaitasminnarthe suśrute kecit paṭhanti– “antaḥ ‘śirāṇām’ iti pā.| sirāṇāṃ śvasanaḥ sthito dṛṣṭiṃ pratikṣipan| hatādhimanthaṃ janayettamasādhyaṃ vidurbudhāḥ||” iti| videha eva sakalākṣiśoṣaḥ paṭhyate– “athavā śoṣayedakṣi kṣīṇatejobalādayam| tatpadmamiva saṃśuṣkamavasīdati locanam|| hatādhimanthaṃ taṃ vidyādasādhyaṃ vātakopataḥ||” iti| ataḥ śoṣārthe upekṣaṇādakṣītyādi śloko'vagantavyaḥ| sādayatīti śoṣayati| rujābhirugrābhiriti rujābhistodādibhirmahatībhirupalakṣitaḥ||15||

hatādhimanthalakṣaṇamāha– upekṣaṇādityādi| sādayati śoṣayati, rujābhiriti satodarujābhiḥ| videhe'yaṃ rogo dṛṣṭyutkṣepaṇalakṣaṇa ekaḥ, anyaḥ sakalanayanaśoṣalakṣaṇaḥ paṭhitaḥ| tadyathā– “antargataḥ ‘śirāṇām’ iti pā.| sirāṇāṃ tu yadā tiṣṭhati mārutaḥ| sa tadā nayanaṃ prāpya śīghraṃ dṛṣṭiṃ nirasyati|| tasyāṃ nirasyamānāyāṃ nirmanthanniva mārutaḥ| nayanaṃ nirvamatyāśu śūlatodo'bhimanthanaiḥ||” ityayaṃ dṛṣṭinirgamalakṣaṇaḥ; ‘sakalākṣiśoṣo manthaḥ’ iti pā.| sakalākṣiśoṣādhimanthaṃ videha'pyāha– “athavā śoṣayedakṣi kṣīṇatejobalādayam| tatpadmamiva saṃśuṣkamavasīdati locanam|| hatādhimanthaṃ taṃ vidyādasādhyaṃ vātakopajam|” iti||15||
vāraṃvāraṃ ca paryeti bhruvau netre ca mārutaḥ | rujaśca vividhāstīvrāḥ sa jñeyo vātaparyayaḥ ||16||
vātaparyayaliṅgamāha– ‘vāraṃvāraṃ ca paryetītyādi|’ iti pā.| vāraṃvāramityādi| paryāyeṇa krameṇa kadācidbhruvi, kadācillocane, vāyustīvrāṃ rujāṃ karotīti vātaparyāyārthaḥ||16||
vātaparyāyalakṣaṇamāha– vāraṃvāramityādi| paryāyeṇa krameṇa kadācit bhruvi kadācillocane vāyuḥ tīvrāṃ rujaṃ karotīti tātparyārthaḥ||16||

div.ab: yat kūṇitaṃ dāruṇarūkṣavartma sandahyate cāviladarśanaṃ yat | sudāruṇaṃ yat pratibodhane ca śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣi ||17|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: śuṣkākṣipākamāha– yat kūṇitamityādi| kūṇitamiti nimīlitam| dāruṇaṃ kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca vātaśoṣāt vartma yasya taddāruṇarūkṣavartma| sandahyate sadāhaṃ bhavati| āviladarśanamākuladarśanam| sudāruṇaṃ kṛcchronmīlanam| pratibodhane unmeṣaṇe| sudāruṇaṃ sukaṭhinamiti gadādharaḥ| śuṣkākṣipākopahataṃ tadakṣīti tacchuṣkeṇākṣipākena upahatamakṣītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ rogaḥ saraktavātajanyaḥ| yadāha karālaḥ– “kūṇitaṃ kharavartmākṣi kṛcchronmīlāvilekṣaṇam| sadāhaṃ sāsṛjādvātācchuṣkapākānvitaṃ vadet||” iti||17||

śuṣkākṣipākamāha– yadityādi| ‘kuṇitaṃ mīlanam|’ iti pā.| kūṇitaṃ nimīlitam| dāruṇaṃ kaṭhinaṃ rūkṣaṃ ca vātaśoṣaṇādvartma yasya tat| dāruṇaṃ sukaṭhinamiti gadādharaḥ| śuṣkākṣipākopahatamiti śuṣkeṇākṣipākenopahatamakṣītyarthaḥ| ayaṃ rogaḥ saraktavātajanyaḥ| yadāha karālaḥ– “kūṇitaṃ kharavartmākṣi kṛcchronmīlāvilekṣaṇam| sadāhaṃ sāsṛjo vātācchuṣkapākānvitaṃ vadet||” iti||17||

div.ab: yasyāvaṭukarṇaśirohanustho manyāgato vā'pyanilo'nyato vā | kuryādrujaṃ vai bhruvi locane ca tamanyatovātamudāharanti ||18|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) |

ab.seg: anyatovātamāha– ‘yasyāvaṭukarṇetyādi’ iti pā.| yasyetyādi| avaṭurghāṭā| manye ‘ ... śire’ iti pā.| grīvāpārśvasire| anyato veti uktapradeśāditaratra pṛṣṭhe, saptamyarthe tasiḥ| anyatra vātasya kāraṇasyāvasthānam, anyatra locane bhruvi ca rujāṃ karotītyanyatovātaḥ| videhe'pyuktam– “ ‘manyānāmantare’ iti pā.| manyayorantare vāyurutthitaḥ pṛṣṭhato'pi vā| karoti bhedaṃ nistodaṃ śaṅkhe cākṣṇorbhruvostathā|| tamāhuranyatovātaṃ rogaṃ dṛṣṭivido janāḥ||” iti||18||

anyatovātamāha– yasyetyādi| avaṭurghāṭā, manye ‘ ... śire’ iti pā.| grīvāpārśvasire| anyato veti uktapradeśāditaratra pṛṣṭhe; anyatra vātasya kāraṇasyāvasthānam, anyatra locane bhruvi ca rujāṃ karoti– ityanyatovātaḥ| videhe'pyuktaḥ– “ ‘manyānāmantare’ iti pā.| manyayorantare vāyurutthitaḥ pṛṣṭhato'pi vā| karoti bhedaṃ nistodaṃ śothaṃ vā'kṣṇorbhruvostathā|| tamāhuranyatovātaṃ dṛṣṭirogavido janāḥ|” iti||18||
śyāvaṃ lohitaparyantaṃ sarvaṃ cākṣi prapacyate | sadāhaśothaṃ sāsrāvamamlādhyuṣitamamlataḥ ||19||
amlādhyuṣitamāha– śyāvamityādi| śyāvamīṣannīlam| amlata ityamlabhojanāt| amlādhyuṣitamiti pittādhyuṣitaṃ, kāraṇe kāryopacārāt||19||
amlādhyuṣitamāha– śyāvamityādi| pittajo'yaṃ vyādhiḥ||19||

div.ab: avedanā vā'pi savedanā vā yasyākṣirājyo hi bhavanti tāmrāḥ | muhurvirajyanti ca yāḥ sa tādṛgvyādhiḥ ‘śirotpāta’ iti pā. | sirotpāta iti pradiṣṭaḥ ||20|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) | ‘śirotpāta ... ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: sirotpātamāha– avedanā vā'pītyādi| akṣirājya iti ‘ ... śirāḥ’ iti pā.| akṣisirāḥ| virajyantīti viraktā bhavanti, viśeṣaraktā bhavantītyarthaḥ| raktajo'yam||20||
sirotpātamāha– avedanetyādi| akṣirājyaḥ ‘ ... śirāḥ’ iti pā.| akṣisirāḥ|, virajyanti viraktā bhavanti, viśeṣaraktavarṇā bhavantītyarthaḥ| raktajo'yaṃ vikāraḥ||20||

div.ab: mohāt sirotpāta upekṣitastu jāyeta rogastu ‘śirāpraharṣaḥ’ iti pā. | sirāpraharṣaḥ | tāmrābhamasraṃ sravati pragāḍhaṃ tathā na śaknotyabhivīkṣituṃ ca ||21|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 6) | ‘śirāpraharṣamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: sirāpraharṣamāha– mohādityādi| ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ayamapi raktajaḥ| iti sarvagatāḥ||21||
sirāpraharṣamāha– mohādityādi| tāmramaruṇam, etacca– ‘tāmrācchamasram’ iti pā.| acchaṃ nirmalam| pragāḍhamityatiśayena abhivīkṣituṃ draṣṭuṃ na śaknotītyarthaḥ| iti sarvanetragatāḥ||21||

div.ab: nimagnarūpaṃ tu bhaveddhi kṛṣṇe sūcyeva viddhaṃ pratibhāti yadvai | srāvaṃ sraveduṣṇamatīva yacca tat savraṇaṃ śukla(kra)mudāharanti ||22|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 5) |

ab.seg: sandhivartmaśuklakṛṣṇadṛṣṭigateṣu madhye prādhānyāddṛṣṭigateṣu vaktumuciteṣu svalpavaktavyatayā dṛṣṭimaṇḍalapratyāsattyā kṛṣṇagatavikārābhidhānam| tatra savraṇaśuklalakṣaṇamāha– nimagnarūpamityādinā| rūpagrahaṇamābhāsaniṣedhārthaṃ, tena nimagnarūpameva| yat sūcyevetyupamānaṃ vartulatvakhyāpanāya sūcīvyadhanavadvedanādarśanāya ca| srāvaṃ sraveduṣṇamiti sraveduṣṇamityetāvataiva labdhe srāve punaḥ srāvagrahaṇaṃ nirantarasrāvaṃ lakṣayati| atiśabdastūṣṇena sambadhyata iti kārtikaḥ| uṣṇasrāvatā raktātmakatvāt| śuklasyātra cātyantaruk boddhavyā, savraṇatvāt| yadāha avraṇalakṣaṇe suśrutaḥ– ‘nātirugaśruyuktaṃ’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 5) iti| tat sravaṇaṃ sakṣataṃ, kṣate tu rujā yuktaiva, nayane tu sukumāre viśeṣeṇodāharanti videhaprabhṛtayaḥ| videhe'pyuktam– “raktarājīnibhaṃ kṛṣṇe chinnābhaṃ yacca lakṣyate| sūcyagreṇeva tacchuklamuṣṇāśrusrāvi savraṇam||” iti||22||

atha kṛṣṇagatāścatvāraḥ| dṛṣṭimaṇḍalapratyāsannatayā kṛṣṇagatavikārābhidhānam, tatra savraṇaśuklamāha– nimagnarūpamityādi| rūpagrahaṇamābhāsaniṣedhārthaṃ, tena nimagnasvarūpameva yat sūcyā viddhamiva pratibhāti, sūcyevetyupamā vartulatvakhyāpanāya, sūcīviddhavedanādarśanāya ca| srāvaṃ sraveduṣṇamiti sraveduṣṇametāvataiva labdhe srāve srāvagrahaṇaṃ nirantaraṃ srāvaṃ bodhayati| atiśabdastūṣṇena sambadhyata iti kārtikaḥ| videhe'pyuktam– “raktarājīnibhaṃ kṛṣṇe chinnābhaṃ yacca lakṣyate| sūcyagreṇeva tacchuklamuṣṇāśrusrāvi savraṇam||” iti||22||

div.ab: dṛṣṭeḥ samīpe na bhavettu yacca na cāvagāḍhaṃ na ca saṃsraveddhi | avedanaṃ vā na yugmaśuklaṃ tat siddhimāyāti kadācideva ||23|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 5) |

ab.seg: asyāsādhyatayā nirdiṣṭasyāvasthāvaśena pākṣikīṃ siddhimāha– dṛṣṭeḥ samīpa ityādi| kṣataṃ hi svabhāvata eva saṃśrayopaghātakaram, ato dṛṣṭisamīpe na sādhyam; uktaviparyayāttu dṛṣṭisamīpe'pi sukhasādhyamavraṇam| na cāvagāḍhamekatvaggatam| viparyayāttvavagāḍhamapyavraṇaṃ sidhyati| ata ‘eva vraṇe’ iti pā.| evāvraṇe vakṣyati– gambhīrajātamiti| na ca saṃsravediti na cātyarthaṃ sravet, saṃśabdasyātiśayārthatvāt| avedanaṃ mandavedanaṃ, raktasya kaphānugamāt; vātānugamādativedanaṃ tu na sidhyati| yugmaṃ ca kṣataśuklaṃ kadā'pi na sidhyati||23||

asyāsādhyatayā nirdiṣṭasyāvasthāviśeṣeṇa pākṣikīṃ siddhimāha– dṛṣṭerityādi| kṣataṃ svabhāvata evāśrayopaghātakaram, ato dṛṣṭisamīpe na sādhyam ‘uktaviparyayāttu’ iti pā.| uktaviparyayātta dṛṣṭisamīpe'pi sukhasādhyāvasthamavraṇam| na cāvagāḍhamekatvaggataṃ viparyayotthamavagāḍhamapyavraṇaṃ siddhyati| ata evāvraṇe vakṣyati– gambhīrajātamityādi| na saṃsravediti na cātyarthaṃ sravet, atra saṃśabdasyātiśayārthatvāt| avedanaṃ mandavedanaṃ, raktasya kaphānugamāt; vātānugamādativedanaṃ tu na siddhyati| yugmaśuklamiti kṣataśuklaṃ, tat kadācit na siddhyati||23||

div.ab: syandātmakaṃ kṛṣṇagataṃ sacoṣaṃ śaṅkhendukundapratimāvabhāsam | vaihāyasābhrapratanuprakāśamathāvraṇaṃ sādhyatamaṃ vadanti ||24|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 5) |

ab.seg: idānīmavraṇaśukralakṣaṇamāha– syandātmakamityādi| syandātmakamabhiṣyandanimittakaṃ, sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇāmabhiṣyandanimittatve'pi cāsya niyamapratipādanārthamabhidhānam| vaihāyasābhrapratanuprakāśamiti vihāyasi sthitaṃ vaihāyasaṃ, ‘tasya nivāsaḥ’ ityaṇ, vihāyo nabhaḥ; ākāśasthitābhravat pratanuprakāśamityarthaḥ| etenācchatvaṃ pratipādyate| śuklatvaṃ tu śaṅkhendukundapratimāvabhāsamityanenaiva labdham| vaihāyasābhragrahaṇaṃ sajalābhravyavacchedārthaṃ, taddhi prāyaḥ pārvataṃ bhavatīti kārtikaḥ| sādhyatamaṃ sukhasādhyam| nanu, gambhīrajātamityādinā kṛcchrābhidhānenaiva ‘taduktiviparyayeṇa’ iti pā.| tadviparyayeṇa sukhasādhyatvāvagatiḥ setsyati, tat kiṃ sādhyatamābhidhānena? naivam, asatyatra sādhyatamābhidhāne ubhayatrāpi kṛcchratvabhrāntiḥ syādatastadabhidhānam||24||

idānīmavraṇaśuklalakṣaṇamāha– syandātmakamityādi| abhiṣyandanimittajātaṃ, sarveṣāmakṣirogāṇāmabhiṣyandanimittatve'pyasya niyamapratipādanārthamabhidhānam| vaihāyasābhrapratanuprakāśamityanena svacchatvaṃ pratipādyate, śuklatvaṃ tu śaṅkhendukundapratimāvabhāsatvenaiva labdhaṃ, vaihāyasābhragrahaṇaṃ sajalābhravyavacchedārtham| sādhyatamaṃ sukhasādhyam||24||

div.ab: gambhīrajātaṃ bahulaṃ ca śuklaṃ cirotthitaṃ cāpi vadanti kṛcchram | vicchinnamadhyaṃ piśitāvṛtaṃ vā calaṃ ‘śirā ... ’ iti pā. | sirāsūkṣmamadṛṣṭikṛcca | dvitvaggataṃ lohitamantataśca cirotthitaṃ cāpi vivarjanīyam ||25|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 5) |

ab.seg: avraṇasyaivāvasthābhedena kṛcchratvamāha– gambhīrajātamityādi| gambhīrajātaṃ dvitritvaggatam| bahulaṃ pratanuno'bhrādghanam| avraṇasyaivāvasthābhedenāsādhyatvamāha– ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vicchinnamadhyamityādi| vicchinnamadhyaṃ vidīrṇamāṃsatvāt sacchidraṃ, nimnamiti yāvat; tadviparyayaṃ tu piśitāvṛtamunnatamāṃsarūpatayā| calamityanavasthitam| ‘śirāsūkṣmamiti’ iti pā.| sirāsūkṣmamiti ‘śirāvṛtatvāt’ iti pā.| sirāvṛtatvāt sūkṣmam; anye ‘ ‘śirāsaktam’ iti pā.| sirāsaktam’ iti paṭhanti, vyācakṣate ca– ‘śirāsaktam’ iti pā.| sirāsaktaṃ yatastataścalaṃ, ‘śirāṇām’ iti pā.| sirāṇāṃ calatvāt; ‘śirā’ iti pā.| sirā hi matsyavat parivartamānā muhurmuhuścalanti; anye ‘ ‘śirāśuklam’ iti pā.| sirāśuklam’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ vyācakṣate; ‘śirābhiḥ’ iti pā.| sirābhiḥ śuklaṃ, ‘śirāśuklam’ iti pā.| sirāśuklaṃ ‘śirāśukla ... ’ iti pā.| sirāśuklatvahetukaṃ; na hi ‘śirābhavanam’ iti pā.| sirābhavanaṃ śuklatve heturiti gadādharaḥ| adṛṣṭikṛditi darśanābhāvakāri, dṛṣṭeḥ samīpe na bhavedityasya viparyayo'yam| dvitvaggataṃ dvipaṭalāśritam, etadaparaliṅgasahitamasādhyaṃ, na tu kevalaṃ; dvitvaggatasya kṛcchratvābhidhānāt| ‘lohitamantaśceti’ iti pā.| lohitamantataśceti ‘ante lohitam’ iti pā.| madhye śuklamante lohitaṃ, vraṇākāreṇa||25||

avraṇasyaivāvasthābhedena kṛcchratāmāha– gambhīrajātamityādi| gambhīrajātaṃ dvitritvaggataṃ, bahulaṃ pratanuno'bhrād ghanam| avraṇasyaivāvasthāto'sādhyatvamāha– vicchinnetyādi| vicchinnamadhyaṃ viśīrṇamāṃsatvāt sacchidraṃ, nimnamiti yāvat| tadviparyayaṃ tu piśitāvṛtamunnatamāṃsarūpatayā| calamanavasthitam, ‘śirāsūkṣmamiti’ iti pā.| sirāsūkṣmamiti ‘śirākṛtatvāt’ iti pā.| sirākṛtatvāt sūkṣmam, anye ‘ ‘śirāsaktam’ iti pā.| sirāsaktam’ iti paṭhanti| ‘śirāsaktam’ iti pā.| sirāsaktaṃ yatastataścalaṃ, ‘śirā’ iti pā.| sirā hi matsyavat parivartamānā muhurmuhuścalanti| tadāśritaṃ śuklamapi calameva| adṛṣṭikṛditi darśanābhāvakāri| dvitvaggataṃ dvipaṭalāśritam, etadaparaliṅgasahitamasādhyaṃ, na kevaladvitvaggatasya kṛcchrābhidhānāt, savraṇaṃ tritvaggataṃ cāsādhyamiti jñeyam| lohitamantata iti prānteṣu lohitaṃ vraṇākāreṇa| cirotthitaṃ cirakālajam||25||

div.ab: uṣṇāśrupātaḥ piḍakā ca netre yasmin bhavenmudganibhaṃ ca śuklam | tadapyasādhyaṃ pravadanti kecidanyacca yattittiripakṣatulyam ||26|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 5) |

ab.seg: na kevalamevaṃvidhaṃ paramasādhyaṃ kintvanyādṛśamapītyata āha– uṣṇāśrupāta ityādi| piḍakā ca netra ityantaṃ dvitvaggataśukle| tathā''ha videhaḥ– “ekatvaggatamevaṃ syāt dvitvaggatamidaṃ bhavet| coṣoṣṇasrāvadāhāstu tṛṣṇā ca piḍakodgamaḥ||” iti mudganibhaṃ ca śuklamityākāreṇa, etaddvitvaggatam| tathā ca videhaḥ– “vyaktamudgaphalākāraṃ śuklaṃ dvitvaggataṃ bhavet|” iti| ‘dvitritvaggatasyāvraṇasya’ iti pā.| dvitritvaggatasyāvraṇaśukrasya kṛcchratve etat piḍakodgamamudgaphalākāratvenaivāsādhyatvaṃ bodhyam| anye punaḥ savraṇaśuklasya vicchinnamadhyamityādikamasādhyalakṣaṇaṃ varṇayanti| atra pakṣe dvitvaggatamiti kevalamevāsādhyalakṣaṇam, etanna cāvagāḍhamityasya viparyayaḥ| lohitamantataḥ, uṣṇāśrupātaḥ piḍakā cetyādi dvitvaggataśuklalakṣaṇamiti| kintviyamatrāsaṅgatiḥ– vicchinnamadhyaṃ ‘sachidramadhyaṃ,’ iti pā.| sacchidraṃ, tadyadi sacchidratvaṃ savraṇaśuklasyābhyupagamyate, tadā nimagnarūpamityanenaiva ‘sidhyatvāt’ iti pā.| siddhatvāt punaruktaṃ syāt, kiñca savraṇaśuklānantaramasya pāṭho viphalaḥ syāt| anye tu savraṇāvraṇaśuklaviṣayaṃ sāmānyamasādhyalakṣaṇametadāhuḥ; yathāyogyatayā kvacilliṅgāntarayogena ca vyavastheti ca varṇayanti| asādhyatvaṃ videhadanyeṣāṃ matenāha– kecidityādi| tittiripakṣatulyamiti śabalam; etaccāniṣedhādanumatam||26||

na kevalamevaṃvidhaṃ paramasādhyaṃ, kintvanyādṛśamapītyāha– uṣṇāśrupāta ityādi| piḍakā ca| netra ‘ityatra’ iti pā.| ityantaṃ dvitvaggate śukle| yaduktaṃ videhe– “ekatvaggatamevaṃ syāddvitvaggatamidaṃ bhavet| coṣoṣṇasrāvadāhāstu tṛṣṇā ca piḍakodgamaḥ||” iti| mudganibhaṃ ca śuklamiti ākāreṇa, edddvitvaggataṃ syāt| tathā ca videhaḥ– “vyaktamudgaphalākāraṃ śuklaṃ dvitvaggataṃ bhavet|” iti| dvitritvaggatasyāvraṇaśuklasya kṛcchratve etat piḍakodgamamudgaphalākāratvenaivāsādhyatvaṃ boddhavyam| asādhyatvaṃ videhadanyeṣāṃ matenāha– kecidityādi| ‘anyat’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | anyat tittiripakṣitulyamiti śabalam| ‘etacca niṣedhādanumatam’ iti pā.| etaccāniṣedhādanumatam||26||

div.ab: śvetaḥ samākrāmati sarvato hi doṣeṇa yasyāsitamaṇḍalaṃ ca | tamakṣipākātyayamakṣirogaṃ sarvātmakaṃ varjayitavyamāhuḥ ||27|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 5) |

ab.seg: idānīmakṣipākātyayamāha– śveta ityādi| doṣeṇa yaḥ kṛtaḥ śvetaḥ sa samākrāmati| sarvātmakaṃ tridoṣajam; anye tu ‘syandātmakam’ iti paṭhitvā abhiṣyandātmakamāhuḥ| tadā sarveṣāmabhiṣyandamūlatvādviśeṣārthamabhidhānam||27||
idānīmakṣipākātyayamāha– śveta ityādi| doṣeṇa kṛto yaḥ śvetaḥ, kṛṣṇamaṇḍalaṃ sarvataḥ samākrāmati| sarvātmakaṃ tridoṣajam, anye ‘syandātmakam’ iti paṭhitvā abhiṣyandātmakamāhuḥ||27||

div.ab: ajāpurīṣapratimo rujāvān salohito lohitapicchilāsraḥ | vigṛhya kṛṣṇaṃ pracayo'bhyupaiti taccājakājātamiti vyavasyet ||28|| (iti kṛṣṇajāḥ) | (su. u. taṃ. a. 5) |

ab.seg: ajakājātamāha– ajāpurīṣapratima ityādi| ajāpurīṣapratimaḥ śuṣkājapurīṣatulyaḥ| salohita īṣallohitaḥ| vigṛhya kṛṣṇamiti svocchrāyeṇa kṛṣṇadeśaṃ mahattvādvicchidya| pracaya iti prakṛṣṭaścayaḥ udgama iti yāvat| ajakāyā medovat saṃśrayastṛtīyatvaggatatvena medasaḥ pracayo boddhavyaḥ| tathāca videhaḥ– “kṛṣṇe'kṣṇoryadbhavecchuklaṃ chāgalīviṭsamaprabham| sāndrapicchilaraktāsraṃ tritvaggamajaketi sā||” iti| iti kṛṣṇajāḥ||28||

ajakājātamāha– ajetyādi| ajāpurīṣapratimaḥ śuṣkacchāgalīpurīṣatulyaḥ| salohita iti īṣallohitaḥ, vigṛhya kṛṣṇamiti svocchrāyeṇa kṛṣṇadeśaṃ mahattvādvicchidya, vidāryeti yāvat| pracaya iti prakṛṣṭaścayaḥ, udgama iti yāvat| abhyupaiti samantādāgacchati| ajakāyā medovatsaṃśrayastṛtīyatvaggatatvena medasaḥ pracayo boddhavyaḥ| yaduktaṃ videhe– “kṛṣṇe'kṣṇoryadbhavecchuklaṃ chāgalīviṭsamaprabham| sāndrapicchilaraktāsraṃ tritvaggamajaketi sā||” iti| sa vraṇaśuklaḥ akṣipākātyayaḥ ajakājātaḥ| evaṃ ‘kṛṣṇagate cakṣurogāścatvāraḥ’ iti pā.| kṛṣṇagatāścakṣūrogāścatvāraḥ| iti kṛṣṇajāḥ||28||
