pakṣmakopamāha– pracālitānītyādi| etādṛśapāṭhābhiprāyeṇa| mūlasthānātpatantyapīti ‘pakṣmāṇi’ iti śeṣaḥ; apiśabdānna patantyapi| ayaṃ sannipātajo yāpyaḥ||97-98||

div.ab: vartmapakṣmāśayagataṃ pittaṃ romāṇi śātayet | kaṇḍūṃ dāhaṃ ca kurute pakṣmaśātaṃ tamādiśet ||99|| nava sandhyāśrayāsteṣu vartmajāstvekaviṃśatiḥ | śuklabhāge daśaikaśca catvāraḥ kṛṣṇabhāgajāḥ ||100|| sarvāśrayāḥ saptadaśa dṛṣṭijā dvādaśaiva tu | bāhyajau dvau samākhyātau rogau paramadāruṇau ||101|| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate bhūya etān pravakṣyāmi saṅkhyārūpacikitsitaiḥ ||102|| (iti vartmagatāḥ) | (su. u. taṃ. a. 1) |

ab.seg: pakṣmaśātalakṣaṇamāha– vartmetyādi| pakṣmāśayo'tra pakṣmamūlam| śātayedunmūlayedityarthaḥ| ‘kaṇḍūratra pittadūṣitaraktabhavā’ iti pā.| ayaṃ ca kaphapaittikaḥ, kaṇḍūdāhavattvāt| atra kṛcchronmīlanaṃ vāgbhaṭaḥ paṭhati– “rogān kuryuścalastatra prāpya vartmāśrayāḥ ‘śirāḥ’ iti pā.| sirāḥ| suptotthitasya kurute vartmastambhaṃ savedanam|| pāṃśupūrṇābhanetratvaṃ kṛcchronmīlanamaśru ca| vimardanāt syācca śamaḥ kṛcchronmīlaṃ vadanti tam||” (vā. u. a. 8) iti| asya cakāreṇa saṅgrahaḥ| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | pakṣmaṇāṃ vartmāśrayatvādayamaghi vartmaroga eva| iti vartmagatā ekaviṃśatirvyādhayaḥ samāptāḥ| iti vartmagatāḥ||99||

pakṣmaśātalakṣaṇamāha– vartmetyādi| pakṣmāśayaḥ pakṣmamūlaṃ, śātayet utpāṭayet, kaṇḍūraktapittaprakopitaraktāt| taṃ pakṣmaśātaṃ vyādhimādiśet kathayet| ayamapi vartmarogaḥ pakṣmaṇāṃ vartmāśrayatvāt|| iti vartmajāḥ||99||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne netraroganidānaṃ samāptam ||59||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ netraroganidānaṃ samāptam||59||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ netraroganidānam||59||

div.head: śiroroganidānam
div.ab: atha śiroroganidānam| śirorogāstu jāyante vātapittakaphaistribhiḥ | sannipātena raktena kṣayeṇa krimibhistathā | sūryāvartānantavātārdhāvabhedakaśaṅkhakaiḥ ||1|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) | ‘śiraḥsaṃśritān śravaṇādirogānabhidhāya ūrdhvajatrugatapāriśeṣyādāśrayabhūtaśiroroganidānam’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: atha karṇanāsānetrāṇāmadhiṣṭhānatvena śiraso nayanarogānantaraṃ śiroroganidānārambhaḥ| śirorogāścaikādaśa, tatra kāraṇabhedena śirorogabhedaṃ darśayannāha– śirorogāstvityādi| vātapittakaphairityukte gamyata eva tribhiriti, ‘tatkimarthaṃ punarabhidhānam’ iti pā.| tat kathaṃ taduktiḥ? ucyate– sarveṣāṃ śirorogāṇāṃ sannipātajatvakhyāpanārthaṃ, vātādibhedaścotkarṣāt; taduktaṃ śālākye– “sarva eva śirorogāḥ sannipātasamutthitāḥ| autkaṭyāddoṣaliṅgaiste kīrtitāstadvidā daśa||” iti| tribhiḥ sannipāteneti padadvayena prakṛtivikṛtisamavetasannipātadvayamāhuranye| atra pakṣe sannipātajatvādekatvagaṇanayā na saṅkhyātirekaḥ; tribhiriti padaṃ ‘dyotanārtham’ iti pā.| pṛthaktvadyotanārthamiti gadādharaḥ| kṣayeṇeti asṛgvasādīnāṃ kṣayeṇa; kṣayajo'yaṃ dhātukṣayajanitavātakopena sahasākṛtavātajanyatvenācayapūrvakaḥ, vātajastu sañcayaprakopajanita iti bhedaḥ; ata evānupaśayo'pyasya saṃsvedanādinā ‘śuddhikṛdevopanyastaḥ’ iti pā., ‘śukrakṣayakṛdevopanyastaḥ’ iti vā pā.| doṣakṣayakṛdevopanyastaḥ| śirorogaśabdena śirogataśūlarūpā rujā'bhidhīyate, tena sūryāvartānantavātārdhāvabhedakaśaṅkhakairityabhidhānamupapadyate, anyathā teṣāmeva śirorogatvāttaiḥ śirorogā jāyanta ityasaṅgataṃ syāt||1||

śiraāśritya śravaṇanāsārogāstu jāyante, tānabhidhāyāśrayabhūtaśirorogābhidhānam| śirorogāścaikādaśa bhavanti, tānāha– śira ityādi| vātapittakaphairityukte tritvamabhyupagamyata eva, yatpunastribhiriti grahaṇaṃ tatsarveṣāṃ śirorogāṇāṃ sannipātajatvakhyāpanārthaṃ, vātādibhedaścotkarṣāt| yaduktam– “sarva eva śirorogāḥ sannipātasamudbhavāḥ| autkaṭyāddoṣaliṅgānāṃ kīrtitāstadvidā daśa||” iti| kṣayeṇeti asṛgvasādīnāṃ kṣayeṇa; ‘sūryāvartārdhabhedābhyāṃ śaṅkhakena tathaiva ca|’ iti pā.| kṣayajastathaiva ceti cakāreṇa ‘tantrāntaroktamanantavātamupalabhyate’ iti pā.| tantrāntarokto'nantavāta upalabhyate [ śirorogaśabdena ‘śirorogagataśūlarūpā’ iti pā.| śirogataśūlarūpā śirorujā'bhidhīyate| tena ‘ ‘sūryāvartānantavātārdhāvabhedakaśaṅkhāvityabhidhānamupapadyate’ iti pā.| sūryāvarto'nantavāto'rdhāvabhedakaśaṅkhakau’ ityabhidhānamupapadyate||1||

div.ab: yasyānimittaṃ śiraso rujaśca bhavanti tīvrā niśi cātimātram | bandhopatāpaiḥ praśamaśca yatra śiro'bhitāpaḥ sa samīraṇena ||2|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) | ‘vātikalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: vātikaśirorogalakṣaṇamāha– yasyānimittamityādi| ‘alakṣitanimittam’ iti pā.| animittamatarkitanimittaṃ, vāyorviṣamakriyatvāt; tena nimittānuṣaṅgiṇā kālādinetyarthaḥ| niśi cātimātramiti rātrau śītena vāyorādhikyānmahatī rujā bhavati, śītayonitvādvāyoḥ| ‘bandhopatāpairityavayavabahutvāddvandve bahuvacanam’ iti pā.| bandhopatāpairiti bandho bandhanaṃ vastrādibhiḥ, upatāpaḥ ‘snehasvedādibhiḥ’ iti pā.| svedādibhiḥ, vyaktyapekṣayā bahuvacanam; etenopaśayo darśitaḥ| śiro'bhitāpaḥ śirorujā||2||

tatra vātikamāha– yasyetyādi| animittamatarkitanimittaṃ, ‘vāyoḥ pittavātayoḥ’ iti pā.| vāyoḥ viṣamakriyatvāt| atra tīvrā ityabhidhānāt pittena madhyā, kaphena mandā rujā| niśi cātimātraṃ bandhapratāpaiśca bhavedviśeṣaḥ śirobhitāpa iti gamyate| niśi cātimātramiti rātrau śaityādvāyorādhikyāt| bandhapratāpairiti bandhaḥ uṣṇīṣādinā, pratāpaḥ svedena| śirobhitāpaḥ iti śirorujā||2||

div.ab: yasyoṣṇamaṅgāracitaṃ yathaiva bhavecchiro ‘dahyati’ iti pā. | dhūpyati cākṣināsam | śītena rātrau ca bhavecchamaśca śirobhitāpaḥ sa tu pittakopāt ||3|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) |

ab.seg: pittajalakṣaṇamāha– yasyoṣṇamaṅgāracitamityādi| aṅgāracitaṃ yathaiveti jvaladaṅgārācchannamivetyarthaḥ| dhūpyati ‘dhūpāyate’ iti pā.| dhūmāyate dhūmapūrṇamiva bhavatītyarthaḥ| dhūpyatīti divāderākṛtigaṇatvāt| akṣi ca nāsā ca ityakṣināsaṃ, prāṇyaṅgatvādekavadbhāvaḥ| upaśayaṃ darśayati– śītena rātrau cetyādi||3||

paittikamāha– yasyetyādi| aṅgāracitamivoṣṇaṃ śiro bhavati| nāsā ‘dhūmavatī ca nāsā’ iti pā.| dhūmāvṛtā bhavati| “dhūpyati cāpi nāsā” iti ‘cāha’ iti pā.| pāṭhāntaram| śira iti pittaṃ santāpayatītyarthaḥ||3||

div.ab: śiro bhavedyasya kaphopadigdhaṃ guru pratiṣṭabdhamato himaṃ ca | śūnākṣikūṭaṃ vadanaṃ ca yasya śiro'bhitāpaḥ sa kaphaprakopāt ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) |

ab.seg: śleṣmajalakṣaṇamāha– śiro bhavedityādi| kaphopadigdhamiti ‘kaphaliptamiva prastutamiti yāvat’ iti pā.| kaphaliptam| guru gauravayutam| pratiṣṭabdhaṃ baddhamiva| himaṃ himasparśam| śūnākṣikūṭamiti vadanaviśeṣaṇam| tathā hi carakaḥ– “śiro mandarujaṃ tena gurustimitabhārikam|” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti| atrāpi svedādinopaśayo jñeyaḥ||4||
kaphajamāha– śira ityādi| kaphopadigdhaṃ kaphena liptaṃ, guru gauravayuktaṃ, ‘pralabdhaṃ ca tathā himaṃ ca’ iti pā.| prabaddhaṃ baddhamiva| śūnākṣikūṭamiti vadanaviśeṣaṇam||4||

div.ab: śiro'bhitāpe tritayapravṛtte sarvāṇi liṅgāni samudbhavanti |5| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) |

sānnipātikalakṣaṇamāha– śiro'bhitāpa ityādi| sarvāṇi liṅgāni anantaroktāni vātādiliṅgāni| ( ( ) etaccihnamadhyasthaḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ayaṃ ca sannipāto vikṛtiviṣamasamaveto jñeyaḥ, anyathā sarveṣāmeva śirorogāṇāṃ tridoṣajatvāt pṛthagabhidhānaṃ vyarthaṃ syāt; asya ca vikṛtiviṣamasamavetatvaṃ kāraṇabhedāt jñeyaṃ, na tu viruddhalakṣaṇatayā; sa cāyaṃ kāraṇabheda utkaṭasarvadoṣajatvādeva vijñeyaḥ| yathā tridoṣaje rājayakṣmaṇi svarabhedādijanakānāṃ vātādīnāmutkaṭatvamiti| uktaṃ hi carake– “ ‘vātācchūnam’ iti pā.| vātācchūlaṃ bhramaḥ kampaḥ, pittāddāho madastṛṣā| kaphādgurutvaṃ tandrā ca śiroroge tridoṣaje||” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti|5|–
sannipātajamāha– śira ityādi| tritayapravṛtte doṣatrayasambhūte, uktavātādiliṅgānāṃ muhurmuhurbhavanāt|5|–
raktātmakaḥ pittasamānaliṅgaḥ sparśāsahatvaṃ śiraso bhavecca ||5|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) |

ab.seg: raktajalakṣaṇamāha– raktātmaka ityādi| pittasamānaliṅga iti ‘ ... śiroruk ... ’ iti pā.| pittajaśirorogatulyalakṣaṇaḥ| paittikaliṅgādhikamiha sparśāsahatvam||5||
raktajamāha– raktātmaka ityādi| pittajaśirorogalakṣaṇam| atra tu sparśāsahatvamadhikam||5||

div.ab: asṛgvasāśleṣmasamīraṇānāṃ śirogatānāmiha saṅkṣayeṇa | kṣayapravṛttaḥ śiraso'bhitāpaḥ kaṣṭo bhavedugrarujo'timātram | saṃsvedanacchardanadhūmanasyairasṛgvimokṣaiśca vivṛddhimeti ||6|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) |

ab.seg: kṣayajalakṣaṇamāha– asṛgityādi| vasāsṛjoḥ sarvadehasthitatvācchirasi sthitiḥ, ‘śleṣmaṇaḥ’ iti pā.| śleṣmaṇaśca sthānameva śiraḥ, udānavāyorūrdhvagatitvācchirasyavasthānaṃ, teṣāṃ kṣayeṇa ugrarujatvaṃ vyādhiprabhāvāt; yato vṛddhe vāyāvugrarujā yujyate na tu kṣīṇe; ‘taduktam’ iti pā.| yaduktam– “ ‘kṣīṇā jahati svaṃ liṅgam’ iti pā.| vāte pitte kaphe caiva kṣīṇe lakṣaṇamucyate| karmaṇaḥ ‘prakṛterhāniḥ’ iti pā.| prākṛtāddhāniḥ” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti| ‘anyairapi’ iti pā.| anyaiḥ punarayaṃ pāṭhaḥ suśrute svīkṛtaḥ; yathā– “vasābalāsakṣayasambhavānāṃ” (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) iti| yuktaścāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ, vātakṣaye hi kaphavṛddhau kaphajaḥ śirorogaḥ syāt, “vṛddhirvā'pi virodhinām|” (ca. sū. a. 18) iti vacanāt| kiṃ caitasya cikitsāyāmuktaṃ “pāne nasye ca sarpiḥ syādvātaghnamadhuraiḥ śṛtam|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 26) iti| ‘tataḥ’ iti pā.| tataśca samīraṇapāṭho na saṅgataḥ, ‘yataḥ kṣīṇe vardhanaṃ kartavyam’ iti pā.| na hi kṣīṇe vāyau śamanamuktam, api tarhi vardhanavidhiḥ; yaduktam– “kṣīṇā vardhayitavyāḥ” (su. ci. a. 33) iti| vasā dehasnehasyopalakṣaṇaṃ, tena medomajjaśukramastiṣkāṇyapyavarudhyante, teṣāṃ dehasnehatvāt| pittamāṃsādikṣayajastu cayādikramajakṣayakṛtavātaśiroroga evāvarudhyate, iti gadādharaḥ| śirobhitāpaḥ śirorujā| saṃsvedanacchardanadhūmanasyaiḥ kaphakṣayaḥ, nāgarāditīvradhūmena vasāmastiṣkādikṣayaḥ, ‘śirāmokṣādibhi ... ’ iti pā.| sirāmokṣādibhirasṛkkṣayaḥ, ata evaitaiḥ saṃsvedanādibhiḥ kṣayajasya vṛddhiḥ| ayaṃ videhe'pi paṭhyate “ ‘śūnyaṃ bhramati tudyeta śirovibhrāntanetratā’ iti pā.| bhramati tudyate śūnyaṃ śiro vibhrāntanetratā| mūrchā gātrāvasādaśca śiroroge kṣayātmake||” iti| cakṣuṣya'pyāha– “strīprasaṅgādabhighātādathavā dehakarmaṇā| kṣipraṃ sañjāyate kṛcchraḥ śirorogaḥ kṣayātmakaḥ|| vātapittātmakaṃ liṅgaṃ vyāmiśraṃ tatra lakṣayet|” iti||6||

kṣayajamāha– asṛgityādi| vasāsṛjoḥ sarvāṅgagatatvāt śirasi sthitiḥ, kaphasya ca tatsthānameva ‘lakṣayet’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | lakṣayet| ugrarujatvaṃ vyādhiprabhāvādityeke| śiraso'bhitāpa iti śirorujā| ayameva tadiṣṭaḥ pāṭhaḥ| saṃsvedanacchardanatīvranasyaiḥ kaphasya kṣayaḥ; nāgarāditīvradhūmena mastiṣkavasādikṣayaḥ; ata eva taiḥ saṃsvedanādibhiḥ kṣayajasya vṛddhiḥ| ayaṃ videhe'pi paṭhyate– “śūnyaṃ bhramati rujyeta śiro vibhrāntanetratā| mūrchā gātrāvasādaśca śiroroge kṣayātmake||” iti||6||

div.ab: nistudyate yasya śiro'timātraṃ sambhakṣyamāṇaṃ sphuratīva cāntaḥ | ghrāṇācca gacchet ‘rudhiram’ iti pā. | salilaṃ sapūyaṃ śirobhitāpaḥ krimibhiḥ sa ghoraḥ ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) |

ab.seg: krimijamāha– nistudyata ityādi| nistudyate sūcībhiriva tudyate| sambhakṣyamāṇam ‘ityatra’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ityatra ‘krimibhiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ, prakaraṇāt| sphuratīva manāk calatīva| ‘ghrāṇācca gacchedityatra cakāreṇa kṛmayaśca gacchantīti draṣṭavyam’ iti pā.| ghrāṇācceti cakāro bhinnakrameṇa salilamityatra sambadhyate; tena salilaṃ pūyaṃ ca gacchet, tathā krimayaśca kadācidgacchantīti; tathā ca carakaḥ– “krimīṇāṃ darśanena ca|” (ca. sū. a. 17) iti||7||
krimijamāha– nistudyata ityādi| sambhakṣyamāṇamityatra krimibhiriti śeṣaḥ| sphuratīva manāk calatīva| ghrāṇācca gacchedityatra cakāreṇa krimayaśca gacchantīti draṣṭavyam||7||

div.ab: sūryodayaṃ ‘vā’ iti pā. | yā prati mandamandamakṣibhruvaṃ ruk samupaiti ‘gāḍham’ iti pā. | gāḍhā | vivardhate cāṃśumatā sahaiva ‘sūryāpravṛttau’ iti pā. | sūryāpavṛttau vinivartate ca | sarvātmakaṃ kaṣṭatamaṃ vikāraṃ sūryāpavartaṃ tamudāharanti ||8|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) |

ab.seg: sūryāvartalakṣaṇamāha– sūryodayamityādi| sūryodayaṃ prati lakṣīkṛtya yā rugakṣibhruvaṃ samupaitīti sambandhaḥ| ‘akṣibhruvau’ iti pāṭhāntare prāṇyaṅgatvena prāptaikavadbhāvasyābhāvaḥ, nāsikāstanayoritivat lakṣaṇavyabhicārāt| sūryodaye prātarmandaṃ mandaṃ yathā syāttathā rujāṃ samupaiti, aṃśumatā ca sūryeṇa saha gāḍhā yathā bhavati tathā vardhate| ayamarthaḥ– yathā sūryo vardhate tathā vedanā pravṛddhā bhavati, sūryasyāpavṛttau sāyāhne vinivartate śāmyatītyarthaḥ| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ‘gāḍhā’ ityatra ‘gūḍhā’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tadā sūryāpagame gūḍhā rātrau līnetyarthaḥ| sarvātmakamiti sannipātajam| vyādhisvabhāvācca kālaviśeṣaniyamaḥ| kaṣṭatamaṃ kṛcchrasādhyam| nanu, ayaṃ suśrute vātapittābhyāṃ paṭhyate, tadyathā– “āvartasañjñaḥ sa tu sūryapūrvo vyādhirmataḥ pittasamīraṇābhyām| śītena śāntiṃ labhate kadāciduṣṇena jantuḥ sukhamāpnuyācca||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) iti| tat kathaṃ sarvajatvam? ucyate– suśrute autkarṣeṇa vyapadeśa iti na virodhaḥ| nanu, evaṃ kathaṃ rātrau vāyusamānaguṇaśītaprādurbhāve vedanālīnatā, divasasyādyantayormandaruktvaṃ ca? ucyate– atrāpi pittasya prabalatamatvāt| yattu cikitsāyāṃ śirīṣamūlapippalīmūlavacāvapīḍādyabhihitaṃ tadvyādhipratyanīkatvāt| atha vātapittajatvavarṇanena viśiṣṭakālabhavane heturdarśito bhavati| yato vātapittayoḥ śītoṣṇātmakatvāt pūrvāhṇe sūryavṛddhikrameṇa srotasāṃ saṅkocakramādavaruddhamārgayorvedanākaratvam, aparāhṇe nivartamāne sūrye tu srotasāṃ vivṛtatvāt svamārgavyāghātaviraheṇa vedanāyā ajanakatvamiti yuktaḥ kālaviśeṣaniyamaḥ| tathā cāha nimiḥ– “sūryasomātmakau ‘nityamahetū’ iti pā.| nityaṃ svahetū pittamārutau| kurvate vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ dināt pūrvāhṇa eva tu|| ādityatejasā yukte nivṛtte'pi ca bhāskare| srotasāṃ vivṛtatvācca tataḥ śleṣmā'dhigacchati|| udgato mātariśvā ca svamārgaṃ pratipadyate| tasmānmadhyadinādūrdhvaṃ vedanā'tra praśāmyati||” iti| vātapittajatvamasya “adhikatvena vyapadeśa” iti nyāyāt; tena pūrveṇa samaṃ na virodhaḥ| videhe sūryāvartaviparyayo'pi paṭhyate– “tatra vātānugaṃ pittaṃ citaṃ śirasi tiṣṭhati| madhyāhne tejasā'rkasya tadvivṛddhaṃ śirorujam|| karoti paittikīṃ ghorāṃ saṃśāmyati dinakṣaye| astaṅgate prabhāhīne sūrye ‘vāyurnivartate’ iti pā.| vāyurvivardhate|| pittaṃ śāntimavāpnoti tataḥ śāmyati vedanā| eṣa pittānilakṛtaḥ sūryāvartaviparyayaḥ||” iti| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ayamatra sūryāvarta evāntarbhāvanīyaḥ, cāturthike cāturthikaviparyayavat||8||

sūryāvartamāha– sūryodayamityādi| sūryodayaṃ prati lakṣīkṛtya yā ruk atarkitā'kṣibhruvaṃ samupaitīti sambandhaḥ| ‘akṣibhruvau’ iti pāṭhāntaraṃ paṭhanti’ iti pā.| ‘gūḍhā’ iti pāṭhāntaram| tatra gūḍhā rātrau līnā bhavati| ‘sarvātmakaṃ sannipātajam; suśrute'yaṃ vātapittābhyāṃ paṭhyate, tatkathaṃ sarvajatvamityucyate?’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sarvātmakaṃ sannipātajam; suśrute'yaṃ vātapittābhyāṃ paṭhyate, tatkathaṃ sarvajatvamityucyate? tatrautkaṭyena nirdeśādavirodhaḥ| nanvevaṃ rātrau kathaṃ vāyoḥ samānaguṇaśītaprādurbhāve vedanā līyate, divasasyādyantayormandā ruk? ucyate– atrāpi pittasya prabalatamatvāt||8||

div.ab: doṣāstu duṣṭāstraya eva manyāṃ sampīḍya ghāṭāsu rujāṃ sutīvrām | kurvanti yo'kṣibhruvi śaṅkhadeśe sthitiṃ karotyāśu viśeṣatastu ||9|| gaṇḍasya pārśve tu karoti kampaṃ hanugrahaṃ locanajāṃśca rogān | anantavātaṃ tamudāharanti doṣatrayotthaṃ śiraso vikāram ||10|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) |

ab.seg: anantavātalakṣaṇamāha– doṣā ityādi| manyā ‘grīvāśirādvayam’ iti pā.| grīvāsirādvayaṃ, tāṃ sampīḍya; ghāṭāsu grīvāpaścādbhāgeṣu, doṣāstraya eva rujāṃ vedanāṃ sutīvrāṃ kurvanti, tathā akṣibhruvi śaṅkhadeśe ca sthitimārabdhatvaṃ yo viśeṣataḥ karoti, tathā gaṇḍapārśve kampaṃ hanugrahādikaṃ ca yaḥ karoti, tamanantavātamudāharantīti yojyam| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | gaṇḍasya kapolasya, pārśve ekadeśe| hanugraho vātavyādhiviśeṣaḥ| amuṃ ca suśrute anyatovātenaiva tulyatvādanantavātaṃ parityajya daśa śirorogā ‘suśrutena netrarogoktānyatovātena saha tulyatvādasya enamapaṭhitvā daśa śirorogā abhihitāḥ’ iti pā.| abhihitāḥ, evaṃ tantrāntare'pi “kīrtitāstadvidā daśa” ityabhidhānaṃ; mādhavakareṇa tu tridoṣajatvena tadadhikakampahanugrahaliṅgayogācca kevalavātajādanyatovātādvilakṣaṇa evāyamiti anantavāto'dhikaḥ paṭhitaḥ, bhedo hi bhedavatāṃ kāraṇabhedādviruddhadharmādhyāsācca bhavatīti||9-10||

anantavātamāha– doṣā ityādi| svarujāṃ svāṃ svāṃ rujām| gaṇḍasya pārśve ‘gaṇḍasyopāntadeśe’ iti pā.| gaṇḍasyopāntikadeśe| suśrutenānāntavātaṃ parityajya daśa śirorogā uktāḥ| tantrāntare'pi daśa– “kīrtitāstadvidā daśa” ityabhidhānāt||9-10||
rūkṣāśanātyadhyaśanaprāgvātāvaśyamaithunaiḥ | vegasandhāraṇāyāsavyāyāmaiḥ kupito'nilaḥ ||11||
kevalaḥ sakapho vā'rdhaṃ gṛhītvā śiraso balī | manyābhrūśaṅkhakarṇākṣilalāṭārdhe'tivedanām ||12||
śastrāraṇinibhāṃ kuryāttīvrāṃ so'rdhāvabhedakaḥ | nayanaṃ vā'thavā śrotramativṛddho vināśayet ||13||

ardhāvabhedalakṣaṇamāha– rūkṣāśanetyādi| adhyaśanamajīrṇe bhojanam| avaśyāyeti avaśyāyo himamucyate, chando'nurodhena ‘yakāralopo’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yakāralopo hrasvatvaṃ ceti vyācakṣate| ‘kadāpi’ iti pā.| kadācit saśleṣmavātajatvamiti vikalpaṃ darśayati– kevala ityādi| śastrāraṇinibhāṃ śastracchedanibhāmaraṇinibhāṃ ca; araṇiḥ agnyutthāpanakāṣṭhayantraṃ, tasya ‘araṇiragnyutpādamanthānakāṣṭhayantraṃ, tatkṛtamanthananibhāṃ vedanāṃ karoti’ iti pā.| manthanavat pīḍā; kiṃvā, araṇinā kāraṇena agnirevocyate, tenāgninibhāṃ ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca vedanām| suśrute tvayaṃ tridoṣajaḥ paṭhitaḥ| tadyathā– “yasyottamāṅgaṃ rujate'rdhamātraṃ satodabhedabhramamohaśūlaiḥ| ‘pakṣāddaśāhādathavā'pyakasmātsyādardhabhedam’ iti pā.| pakṣāddaśāhādathavā'pyakasmāttamardhabhedaṃ tritayādvyavasyet||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) iti| atra tu kevalo'nilaḥ sakapho vetyautkarṣyādabhidhānaṃ, “so'rdhabhedaḥ kaphānilāt|” iti videhe'pyevaṃ boddhavyam| ayamupekṣyamāṇo nayanādikaṃ hanyādityāha– nayanamityādi| atraiva videhaḥ– “śiraso'nyatare pārśve kupito māruto yadā| śleṣmaṇā rudhyate jantostodasphuṭanadālanaiḥ|| śūlāvadāraṇairgāḍhamardhaṃ tadavarudhyate| nayanaṃ cāvadīryeta so'rdhabhedaḥ kaphānilāt|| tathā tryahāt sa pañcāhāt pakṣānmāsācca dehinām|” iti| suśrute “pavanāt sapittāt” (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) iti kecit paṭhanti| tena vātapittajatvamasya| sātyakinā “vāyuḥ śiraḥśaṅkhabhrūnetramavagṛhya” ityādinā vātajatvamasya darśitam| anye tu sannipātādhikārāt sannipātajaṃ paṭhanti, tathāca suśrutaḥ– ‘tritayādvyavasyet|’ (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) iti| vyādhisvabhāvādacirānubandhakatvaṃ sānnipātikatve'pi||11-13||

ardhāvabhedakamāha– rūkṣetyādi| adhyaśanamajīrṇabhojanaṃ, prāgvātaḥ, avaśyāyo niśājalam| śastrāraṇinibhāmiti śastracchedananibhām, araṇiḥ agnyutpādanaṃ kāṣṭhayantraṃ, tatkṛtamanthananibhāṃ vedanāṃ karoti| suśrute tvayaṃ doṣatrayajaḥ paṭhitaḥ– “yasyottamāṅgaṃ rujate'rdhamātraṃ satodabhedabhramamohaśūlaiḥ| pakṣāddaśāhādatha ‘vā'pyakasmātsyādardhabhede’ iti pā.| vā'pyakasmāttamardhabhede tritayādvyavasyet||” iti| atra tu kevalo'nilaḥ sakapha ityuktaḥ| “ ‘so'rdhāvabhedakaḥ sakaphānilāt’ iti pā.| so'rdhabhedaḥ kaphānilāt” iti videhe'pyevameva boddhavyam| ayamupekṣyamāṇo'tipravṛddhaḥ śrotre netre hanti||11-13||
raktapittānilā duṣṭāḥ śaṅkhadeśe vimūrchitāḥ | tīvrarugdāharāgaṃ hi śothaṃ kurvanti dāruṇam ||14||
sa śiro viṣavadvegī nirundhyāśu galaṃ tathā | trirātrājjīvitaṃ hanti śaṅkhako nāmataḥ param | tryahājjīvati bhaiṣajyaṃ pratyākhyāya samācaret ||15||

śaṅkhakalakṣaṇamāha– raktapittānilā ityādi| duṣṭāścayādimantaḥ| ‘vimūrchitā viśeṣeṇa vṛddhā ityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| mūrchitāḥ anyo'nyamekībhūtāḥ| kapho'pyatra boddhavyaḥ; tathā ca suśrutaḥ– “śaṅkhāśrito vāyurudīrṇavegaḥ kṛtānutāpaḥ kaphapittaraktaiḥ|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 25) iti| ( ( ) etaccihnamadhyasthaḥ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | mārakatvamāha– trirātrājjīvitaṃ hantīti| kuśalenopakrame kriyamāṇe trirātrāt parato jīvatyevetyata āha– paraṃ tryahājjīvatīti| atra ahaḥsambandhinī rātrirupalakṣyate, tena trirātrāt, paraṃ jīvatītyarthaḥ| tat kimasya trirātrābhyantare sādhyatvamasādhyatvaṃ vetyata āha– bhaiṣajyamityādi| tadanena trirātrābhyantare vikalpitāsādhyatvaṃ, trirātrāt ‘paraṃ sādhyatvam’ iti pā.| paramasādhyatvaṃ darśitam| tatraiva videhaḥ– “cīyate tu tadā pittaṃ śaṅkhayoranilācitam| niruṇaddhi tato marma paripūritamulbaṇam|| tataḥ śaṅkhau ‘prayujyeta dahyeta’ iti pā.| prarujyete dahyete iva vahninā| sūcībhiriva tudyete nikṛtyete ivāsinā|| śaṅkhako nāma śirasi vyādhireṣaḥ sudāruṇaḥ| tṛṣṇāmūrchājvarakarastrirātrāt paramantakṛt|| kuśalena tūpakrāntastrirātrādeva jīvati|” iti)||14-15||

śaṅkhakamāha– ‘raktapittaḥ’ ityatra ‘pittaraktaḥ’ iti pā.| pittetyādi| mūrchitāḥ pravṛddhāḥ| “śaṅkhāśrito vāryurudīrṇavegaḥ kṛtā'nupāpaḥ kaphapittaraktaiḥ||” iti suśrutavacanātkapho'pyatrāvagantavyaḥ| trirātrātparato jīvitaṃ hanti| trirātraṃ kuśalavaidyādhiṣṭhite jīvati| tryahāditi tryahaṃ prāpya| bheḍe'pyuktam– “kuśalenānupakrāntastrirātrādeva jīvati”| evaṃ suśrutoktā daśa śirorogā uktāḥ, anantavātastvatrādhikaḥ||14-15||
iti śrīmādhavakaravicite mādhavanidāne śiroroganidānaṃ samāptam ||60||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ śiroroganidānaṃ samāptam||60||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ śiroroganidānam||60||

div.head: asṛgdaranidānam

ab.seg: athāsṛgdaranidānam | viruddhamadyādhyaśanādajīrṇādgarbhaprapātādatimaithunācca | yānādhvaśokādatikarṣaṇācca bhārābhighātācchayanāddivā ca | taṃ ‘...catuḥprakāram’ iti pā. | śleṣmapittānilasannipātaiścatuṣprakāraṃ pradaraṃ vadanti ||1||

strīpuṃsāṃ sādhāraṇān vikārānabhidhāya pumpratiniyatasyopadaṃśāderuktatvāt strīniyatarogābhidhānam| tatra ca yonivyāpattiviśeṣe'pyārtavapravṛttisadbhāvāt prathamaṃ ‘...svarūpasya pradasya nidānamucyate’ iti pā.| duṣṭārtavapravṛttisvarūpaṃ pradaramāha– viruddhetyādi| viruddhamadyaṃ duṣṭamadyam; athavā viruddhaṃ saṃyogādiviruddhaṃ, madyaṃ ca svarūpataḥ| ajīrṇādapakvabhojanāt| atikarṣaṇāt laṅghanādyatiyogena kṣīṇadhātutvāt| taṃ śleṣmapittānilasannipātairityatra śleṣmaṇo'gre'bhidhānaṃ ‘ślaiṣmike'tipravṛttibodhārtham’ iti pā.| śleṣmaje'pi vedanāsūcanārtham||1||
atha pradaranidānārambhaḥ| tasya nidānamāha– viruddhetyādi| viruddhamadyaṃ vyāpannaṃ madyaṃ, kiṃvā viruddhaṃ kṣīramatsyādi madyaṃ ca| tasya saṅkhyāsamprāptimāha– tamityādi| vṛddhāḥ vṛddhavaidyāḥ||1||

div.ab: asṛgdaraṃ bhavet sarvaṃ sāṅgamardaṃ savedanam |2| (su. śā. a. 2) |

tasya sāmānyarūpamāha– asṛgdaramityādi| savedanaṃ saśūlam| asṛg dīryate cyavate yasminnityasṛgdaraṃ; tantrāntaramatra– “tadevātiprasaṅgena pravṛttamanṛtāvapi| asṛgdaraṃ vijānīyāt purastāduktalakṣaṇam||” (su. śā. a. 2) iti| tadeveti ārtavam|2|– ‘tasyātivṛddhau’ iti pā. |
tasyātivṛttau daurbalyaṃ bhramo mūrchā madastṛṣā | dāhaḥ pralāpaḥ pāṇḍutvaṃ tandrā rogāśca vātajāḥ ||2|| (su. śā. a. 2) |

ab.seg: ārtavātipravṛttau upadravānāha– tasyātivṛttau daurbalyamityādi| rogāśca vātajā iti ākṣepakakampādayaḥ||2||
upadravānāha– tasyetyādi| atipravṛttau atipravṛddhau daurbalyādayaḥ| vātajā iti ākṣepāpatānakampādayaḥ||2||
āmaṃ sapicchāpratimaṃ sapāṇḍu pulākatoyapratimaṃ kaphāttu | sapītanīlāsitaraktamuṣṇaṃ pittārtiyuktaṃ bhṛśavegi pittāt ||3||
rūkṣāruṇaṃ phenilamalpamalpaṃ vātārti vātāt piśitodakābham | sakṣaudrasarpirharitālavarṇaṃ majjaprakāśaṃ kuṇapaṃ tridoṣāt ||4||
taṃ cāpyasādhyaṃ pravadanti tajjñā, na tatra kurvīta bhiṣak cikitsām | śaśvat sravantīmāsrāvaṃ tṛṣṇādāhajvarānvitām | kṣīṇaraktāṃ durbalāṃ ca tāmasādhyāṃ vinirdiśet ||5||

ślaiṣmikādibhedena viśeṣalakṣaṇānyāha– āmamityādi| āmam āmarasānuviddham| sapicchāpratimamiti picchā śālmalyādiniryāsaḥ, tatsadṛśaṃ picchilamityarthaḥ; ‘saśabda īṣadarthe’ iti pāṭho kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | saśabda īṣadarthe| pulākatoyapratimaṃ ‘tucchadhānyaprakṣālanajalasadṛśam’ iti pā.| prakṣālitapalalatoyasadṛśam; anye pulākaṃ gavedhukamāhuḥ| pittārtiyuktaṃ dāhacimicimādiyuktam| bhṛśavegi bahuvegi| vātārti todādilakṣaṇam| piśitodakābhaṃ ‘prakṣālitamāṃsajalasadṛśam’ iti pā.| māṃsaprakṣālanajalasadṛśam| sakṣaudrasarpirharitālavarṇamiti nānāvarṇatvaṃ tridoṣakopādeva| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | kṣaudravarṇaṃ manākkapilaṃ, sarpirvarṇaṃ vilīnaghṛtavat kiñcidaruṇaṃ ca| majjaprakāśaṃ majjā asthisnehaḥ, tatsamam| kuṇapaṃ śavagandhi| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | taccāpyasādhyamiti cikitsānivṛttyartham||3-5||

tatra śleṣmajamāha– āmamityādi| āmam āmarasasaṃyuktaṃ, sapicchāpratimaṃ, ‘sadyaḥśālyādimaṇḍatulyam’ iti pā.| sadyaḥsrutaśālyādimaṇḍatulyaṃ, picchilamityarthaḥ| pulākatoyapratimaṃ gavedhukānnavārivat, atra ‘pūyarasaḥ|’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| anye pulākaṃ tucchadhānyamāhuḥ| pittajamāha– setyādi| pittārtiyuktaṃ santāpādiyuktaṃ, bhṛśavegi bahudhāraṃ bhūripravṛtti| vātikamāha– rūkṣetyādi| piśitodakābhaṃ māṃsaprakṣālanodakavarṇam| tridoṣamāha– setyādi| kṣaudravarṇaṃ manākkapilaṃ sarpirvarṇaṃ vilīnaghṛtavat, haritālavarṇaṃ pītaṃ, majjaprakāśaṃ majjā'sthisnehaḥ tatsamaṃ, kuṇapaṃ śavagandhi, ‘cāpyasādhyamiti’ iti pā.| asādhyamiti cikitsānivṛttyartham||3-5||

div.ab: māsānniṣpicchadāhārti pañcarātrānubandhi ca | naivātibahulātyalpamārtavaṃ śuddhamādiśet ||6|| śaśāsṛkpratimaṃ yacca yadvā lākṣārasopamam | tadārtavaṃ praśaṃsanti yaccāpsu na virajyate ||7|| (su. śā. a. 2) | ‘cikitsānivṛtyarthaṃ śuddhārtavalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: viśuddhārtavalakṣaṇamāha– māsādityādi| niṣpicchadāhārtīti apicchilamadāhamaśūlādi vedanam, etena ‘nirdoṣatvāddāhapicchādirahitam’ iti pā., ‘nirdoṣatvāddāhapittādirahitam’ iti vā pā.| | vikṛtavātādiliṅgarahitamityarthaḥ| pañcarātrānubandhīti “pañcarātraṃ ‘..'nubadhnāti yadityarthaḥ’ iti pā.| prabhūtapravṛttyā'nubadhnātītyarthaḥ|” alpapravṛttyā pañcarātrāt parato'pyanubadhnāti| taduktaṃ hārīte– ‘ ‘udbhūtapravṛttyā pañcarātraṃ, tataḥ paraṃ svalpapravṛttyā tu ṣoḍaśadināni’ iti pā.| ṣoḍaśadivasānyṛtukālaḥ’| iti| videhe'pyuktam– “strīṇāmṛturbhavati ṣoḍaśa vāsarāṇi|” iti| śaśāsṛgityādinā varṇadvayaṃ vātādiprakṛtibhedāt| yaccāpsu na virajyate iti yenārtavena rañjitaṃ vastramapsu prakṣālitaṃ sallohitaṃ na bhavati tadviśuddham| tathāca hiraṇyākṣaḥ– “surendragopasaṅkāśaṃ snigdhaṃ ca madhugandhi ca| apicchilamaśītaṃ ca yadvāso na virañjayet||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti||6-7||

śuddhārtavalakṣaṇamāha– māsetyādi| etādṛśapāṭhābhiprāyeṇa| apicchadāhārtīti apicchilam, adāham, aśūlādivedanam, etena vikṛtavātādilakṣaṇarahitamityarthaḥ| pañcarātrānubandhīti pañcarātraṃ ‘prabhūtapravṛttyanubadhnāti’ iti pā.| prabhūtapravṛttyā'nubadhnāti yadityarthaḥ| alpapravṛtyā pañcarātrātparato'pyanubadhnāti| yaduktaṃ hārīte– “ṣoḍaśadivasānyṛtukālaḥ” iti| videho'pyuktavān– “strīṇāmṛturbhavati ṣoḍaśa vāsarāṇi” ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | iti| punaśca śuddhalakṣaṇamāha– śaśetyādi|| varṇadvayābhidhānaṃ vātādiprakṛtibhedena varṇabhedāt| yaccāpsu na virajyata iti yadārtavaṃ karpaṭagataṃ sat apsu jaleṣu saṃyujyamāneṣu na vivarṇaṃ bhavati| ayamarthaḥ– yat dhautaṃ sat vāso na virañjayati| yaduktaṃ hiraṇyākṣe– “indragopakasaṅkāśaṃ snigdhaṃ ca madhugandhi ca| apicchilamaśītaṃ ca yadvāso na virañjayet||” iti||6-7||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne asṛgdaranidānaṃ samāptam ||61||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāmasṛgdaranidānaṃ samāptam||61||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ pradaranidānam||61||

div.head: yonivyāpannidānam
div.ab: atha yonivyāpannidānam | viṃśatirvyāpado yonau nirdiṣṭā rogasaṅgrahe | mithyācāreṇa tāḥ strīṇāṃ praduṣṭenārtavena ca ||1|| jāyante bījadoṣācca daivācca śṛṇu tāḥ pṛthak | (ca. ci. a. 30) |

stryadhikārānuvṛtteḥ praduṣṭārtavakāryatvācca yonivyāpannidānamāha– viṃśatirityādi| rogasaṅgraha iti aṣṭodarīye, ‘carakoktatvādasya vākyasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ nopalabhyate | carakoktatvādasya vākyasya| mithyācāreṇa asamyagāhārācāreṇa, caratergatibhakṣaṇārthatvāt| praduṣṭenārtaveneti vātādiduṣṭarajasetyarthaḥ| tena, vandhyādiṣvārtavaduṣṭirapi kāraṇaṃ bhavati| bījadoṣānmātāpitrorārambhakabījadoṣāt| daivāt ‘prāktanādharmāt kāraṇāt’ iti pā.| prāktanādharmakāraṇāt; daivasya sarvatra kāraṇatve siddhe'tra viśeṣeṇa kāraṇatvamuktam||1||–

yonipravṛttatvādasṛgdarasyānantaraṃ yonivyāpannidānamāha– viṃśatirityādi| vyāpado rogāḥ| rogasaṅgraha iti aṣṭodarīye, carakokteḥ| mithyācārataḥ asamyagāhārācārataḥ| praduṣṭenārtaveneti kupitavātādiduṣṭenārtavena, bandhyāsu ārtavaduṣṭirapi kāraṇaṃ bhavati| bījadoṣādityādi garbhārambhakabījagatārtavadoṣāt| daivādityādi daivaṃ sarvatra sādhāraṇaṃ ‘viśiṣṭādaṣṭakāraṇādarśane’ iti pā.| viśiṣṭadṛṣṭakāraṇādarśane sati kāryadarśanādunneyam||1||–

sā ‘phenilamudāvṛttā’ iti pā. | phenilamudāvartā rajaḥ kṛcchreṇa muñcati ||2|| vandhyāṃ naṣṭārtavāṃ vidyādviplutāṃ nityavedanām | pariplutāyāṃ bhavati grāmyadharmeṇa rugbhṛśam ||3|| vātalā karkaśā stabdhā śūlanistodapīḍitā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu bhavantyanilavedanāḥ ||4|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 38) |

ab.seg: ślaiṣmikā āha– sā phenilamityādi| sā yoniḥ phenavadārtavaṃ muñcati| ‘udāvṛtteti ūrdhvamāsamantādvṛttaṃ vartulaṃ yatra vāyunā sā tathā, udāvarteti pāṭhe'pyayamevārthaḥ’ iti pā.| udāvarteti ūrdhvamāvartaḥ samantādvartanaṃ vāyoryatra sā tatheti, arśaāditvādac| viplutāmiti viplutāṃ vātavedanayā viplutatvāt| nityavedanām atikupitenaiva vāteneti| pariplutāyāmiti pari sarvato vātavikāreṇa plutatvāt pariplutāsañjñā| pariplutāyāṃ ‘ ... vedanādiryuktāyām’ iti pā.| bāhyābhyantaravātavedanābhiryuktāyām| “grāmyadharmeṇa rugbhṛśam” ityatra “grāmyadharme rucirbhṛśam” iti pāṭhāntaraṃ, tatra rucirabhilāṣaḥ; ‘grāmyadharme maithune’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | grāmyadharme maithune| vātaletyādi yoniviśeṣaṇaṃ, vātalayā saha pañca yonivyāpadaḥ| vātalāyāḥ pṛthagabhidhānaṃ ‘vātalāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | vātalāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa vātavedanāprādurbhāvārtham| evaṃ pittalādiṣvapi boddhavyam| catasṛṣviti udāvartāvandhyāviplutāpariplutāsu||2-4||

pūrvaṃ yonerviṃśatirvyāpada uktāstāsu udāvartāmāha– sā phenilamityādi| ud ūrdhvamā samantāt vṛttā vartulā yoniryatra sā tathā| ‘udāvartā’ iti pāṭhāntaram| tatrāpyayamevārthaḥ| sā yoniḥ phenenārtavaṃ muñcati| vandhyāmāha– naṣṭamārtavaṃ rajo yasyāṃ sā tathā| viplutāmāha– vātavedanāviplutatvāt| nityavedanāṃ ‘vātajanitatodanādivedanāyuktām’ iti pā.| vātajanitatodavandhyādinānāvedanāyuktām| pariplutāmāha– pariplutāyāmiti| pari sarvato vātavikārapariplutatvātparipluteti sañjñā| grāmyadharme maithune bhṛśaṃ pīḍā bhavati| “grāmyadharme'ruciḥ” iti pāṭhāntaram| tatrāruciranabhilāṣaḥ| vātajāmāha– ‘vātalā’ iti pā.| vātaletyādi| karkaśā stabdhā, śūlanistodapīḍiteti| vātaleti yoniviśeṣaṇam| vātalayā saha pañcayonivyāpadaḥ| vātaleti pṛthagvidhānamatyarthavātavedanāprādurbhāvārtham| evaṃ pittalādiṣvapi vyākhyeyam| ādyāsu catasṛṣu ‘vātānubandhimāha’ iti pā.| vātānubandhitvamāha– catasṛṣvapītyādi| ‘ ... pariplutāsu’ iti pā.| udāvartāvandhyāviplutāparipluteti catasṛṣu vātavedanā jñeyā, vātalāyāmadhikā'taḥ sañjñā||2-4||

div.ab: sadāhaṃ kṣīyate raktaṃ yasyāṃ sā lohitakṣayā | savātamudgiredbījaṃ vāminī rajasā yutam ||5|| prasraṃsinī sraṃsate ca kṣobhitā duṣprajāyinī | sthitaṃ sthitaṃ hanti garbhaṃ putraghnī raktasaṅkṣayāt ||6|| atyarthaṃ pittalā yonirdāhapākajvarānvitā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu pittaliṅgocchrayo bhavet ||7|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 38) |

ab.seg: paittikā āha– sadāhamityādi| kṣīyate raktamiti atipravṛttyā raktasya kṣayaḥ| vāminyudgiredbījamiti śukraṃ ‘śuddhamapi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śuddhamapi vamatītyarthaḥ| prasraṃsinī sraṃsate iti svasthānāccyavate niḥsaratīti yāvat| ata eva “ ‘kṣīrasnigdham’ iti pā.| kṣīrasvinnāṃ praveśayet|” (su. u. taṃ. a. 38) iti cikitsitam| kṣobhitā ‘anilārditā’ iti pā.| vimarditā| duṣprajāyinī duḥkhaprasavā| raktasaṅkṣayādārtavasya vāyunā kṣayāt| yadyapi sarvasyaivāpatyasya nāśastathā'pi putrasya prādhānyāt ‘putraghnīvyapadeśaḥ’ iti pā.| putraghnīti vyapadeśaḥ| pittalayā saha pañca pittajāḥ| dāhapāketyādyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena nīlapītāsitārtavā ca bhavatītyarthaḥ| yaduktamanyatra– “vyāpallavaṇakaṭvamlakṣārādyaiḥ pittajā bhavet| dāhapākajvaroṣṇārtā nīlapītāsitārtavā||” iti| ādyāsviti raktakṣayāvāminīprasraṃsinīputraghnīṣu||5-7||

atha pittānubandhinyaḥ| tatra raktakṣayāmāha– sadāhamityādi| atipravṛttyā raktasya kṣayaḥ, tena raktakṣayeti sañjñā| vāminīmāha– savātamityādi| sugamam| prasraṃsinīmāha– ‘prasraṃsinītyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | prasraṃsinītyādi| sraṃsate svasthānāccyavate, niḥsaratītyarthaḥ| kṣobhitā vimarditā, duṣprajāyinī duḥkhaprasavā| sthitamityādi| ‘putraghnīmāha’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | putraghnīmāha– putraghnīti ‘sarvā api apatyavināśinyastathā'pi’ iti pā.| sarvāpatyavināśinyastathā'pi putrasya prādhānyādatra putraghnīti vyapadeśaḥ| pittalāmāha– ‘atyarthamiti’ iti pā.| atyarthamityādi| dāhapākajvarānvitetyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena nīlapītāsitārtavā ca bhavatītyavagantavyam| tathā ca tantrāntare– “vyāpallavaṇakaṭvamlakṣārādyaiḥ pittajā bhavet| dāhapākajvaroṣṇārtā nīlapītā'sitārtavā||” iti| catasṛṣvapi pittānubandhamāha– raktakṣayāvāminīprasraṃsinīputraghnīṣu pittalayā saha pañcapittānubandhinyaḥ||5-7||

div.ab: atyānandā na santoṣaṃ grāmyadharmeṇa gacchati | karṇinyāṃ karṇikā yonau śleṣmāsṛgbhyāṃ ‘ca jāyate’ iti pā. | prajāyate ||8|| ‘maithune'caraṇāt’ iti pā. | maithune'caraṇā pūrvaṃ puruṣādatiricyate | bahuśaścāticaraṇā tayorbījaṃ na vindati ||9|| ‘śleṣmajā’ iti pā. | śleṣmalā picchilā yoniḥ kaṇḍūgrastā'tiśītalā | catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu śleṣmaliṅgocchrayo bhavet ||10|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 38) |

ab.seg: ślaiṣmikā āha– ‘atyānandāyām’ iti pā.| atyānandetyādi| grāmyadharmeṇa maithunena| karṇinyāṃ karṇiketi karṇikā māṃsakandākāragranthiḥ| ‘maithune'caraṇā’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | maithune'caraṇā pūrvaṃ puruṣādatiricyate iti ‘acaraṇāt’ iti pā.| acaraṇā samyaṅmaithunācaraṇāt pūrvaṃ prathamaṃ, puruṣādatiricyate viramati, atra kvacitpustake ‘ayamarthaḥ– yāvat puruṣastu sukhaṃ nāpnoti tāvadasau viramati’ ityadhikaṃ pāṭhāntaramupalabhyate | tena bījaṃ na gṛhṇāti| atra acaraṇaśabdenopacārāt tadvatī strī bhaṇyate| bahuśaścāticaraṇeti bahuśo maithunācaraṇādaticaraṇā, ‘iyaṃ puruṣādatiricyate paścāddravati tena bījaṃ na gṛhṇāti’ iti pā.| sā ca śleṣmajanitakaṇḍūbhirājageva (?) bahumaithunācaraṇādbījaṃ na dhatte| ata uktam– tayorbījaṃ na vindatīti| tayoriti acaraṇāticaraṇayoḥ| śleṣmalāyāmatiśītaletyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena ‘savedanādikamapi’ iti pā.| vedanādikamapi jñeyam| tathāca tantrāntare– “kapho'bhiṣyandibhirvṛddho yoniṃ ceddūṣayet striyāḥ| sa kuryāt picchilāṃ śītāṃ kaṇḍūgrastāṃ savedanām||” iti||8-10||

atha śleṣmānubandhinyaḥ| tatrātyānandāmāha– atītyādi| karṇinīmāha– karṇinyāmityādi| bahuśo maithunācaraṇādaticaraṇā, sā ca śleṣmajanitakaṇḍuyogādbahumaithunācaraṇādaticaraṇā, bījaṃ garbhāṅkurajananaṃ na labhate| ata evoktam– tayorbījaṃ na vindatītyādi| tayoriti caraṇāticaraṇayoḥ| śleṣmalāmāha– śleṣmaletyādi| atiśītaletyupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena vedanetyapi boddhavyam| yaduktaṃ tantrāntare– “kapho'bhiṣyandibhirvṛddho yoniṃ dūṣayate striyāḥ| sa kuryātpicchilāṃ śītāṃ kaṇḍugrastāṃ savedanām||” iti| asyāgre ‘catasṛṣvapi’ iti pā.| śleṣmānubandhatvamāha– catasṛṣvapītyādi| atyānandākarṇinīcaraṇāticaraṇāsu| evaṃ śleṣmānubandhinyaḥ pañca||8-10||

div.ab: anārtavā'stanī ṣaṇḍī kharasparśā ca maithune | ‘ ... taruṇyāstvaṇḍinī’ iti pā. | atikāyagṛhītāyāstaruṇyāstvaṇḍalī bhavet ||11|| vivṛtā ca mahāyoniḥ sūcīvaktrā'tisaṃvṛtā | sarvaliṅgasamutthānā sarvadoṣaprakopajā ||12|| catasṛṣvapi cādyāsu ‘sarvaliṅganidarśanam’ iti pā. | sarvaliṅgocchrayo bhavet | pañcāsādhyā bhavantīha yonayaḥ sarvadoṣajāḥ ||13|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 38) |

ab.seg: sānnipātikā āha– ‘anārtavetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | anārtavetyādi| anārtavā rajaḥśūnyā| astanī īṣatstanī| atikāyagṛhītāyā mahāmehanena gṛhītāyāḥ| aṇḍalī aṇḍavanniḥsṛtā ‘yoniḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | yoniḥ| vivṛtā ‘mahāyoniḥ vivṛtamukhī|’ iti pā.| mahāyoniḥ ativivṛtamukhī| sūcīvaktrā atisaṃvṛtā ‘sūcīrandhrā'tisaṅkaṭamukhī’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sūcīrandhrā'tisaṅkaṭamukhī| sarvaliṅgasamutthāneti sarvadoṣaliṅgānāṃ samutthānaṃ asyāgre ‘nidānaṃ ca’ iti pā.| yatra sā tathā| anye tvāhuḥ– ‘sarvadoṣaliṅgā sarvadoṣasamutthā ceti|’ iti pā.| sarvadoṣasamutthānā sarvadoṣahetujetyarthaḥ| carakoktā adhikā ‘raktayonyādayastāsām’ iti pā.| raktayonyādayaḥ suśrutoktānāmadūrāntaratvenāvaboddhavyāḥ||11-13||

sannipātajādayaḥ pañca| tatra ṣaṇḍīmāha– ‘anārtavetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate [ anārtavetyādi| anārtavā arajaskā, astanī īṣatstanī| aṇḍinīmāha– atikāyo bṛhanmehanapuruṣaḥ, tena gṛhītāyā iti apragalbhāyāḥ, aṇḍalī aṇḍavanniḥsṛtā yoniḥ| vivṛtāmāha– ativivṛtā| sūcīvaktrāmāha– atiśayena sūcīvatsaṅkīrṇamukhī saṃvṛtā| sannipātajāmāha– sarvaliṅgetyādi| sarvaliṅgānāṃ samutthānaṃ yatra sā tathā| catasṛṣvapi sarvaliṅgānubandhamāha– catasṛṣviti| ṣaṇḍyaṇḍalīvivṛtāsūcīvaktrāsu| tridoṣajāḥ pañca| āsāmasādhyatāmāha– pañcetyādi||11-13||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne yonivyāpannidānaṃ samāptam ||62||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ yonivyāpannidānaṃ samāptam||62||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ yonivyāpannidānam||62||
atha yonikandanidānam | divāsvapnādatikrodhādvyāyāmādatimaithunāt | kṣatācca nakhadantādyairvātādyāḥ kupitā yadā ||1||
pūyaśoṇitasaṅkāśaṃ ‘likucākṛtisannibham’ iti pā. | nikucākṛtisannibham | janayanti yadā yonau nāmnā kandaḥ sa yonijaḥ ||2||

yonyāśrayatvāt yonikandanidānamāha– divāsvapnādityādi| nakhadantādyairityatrādiśabdāt kaṇṭakādiparigrahaḥ| vātādyāḥ kupitā iti yathānidānaṃ pratyekaṃ vātādayaḥ kupitāḥ| ‘lakucākṛtiṃ vartulaṃ’ ‘guḍakam’ iti śeṣaḥ, tena ‘napuṃsakaliṅgatā bhavati’ iti pā.| nikucākṛtisannibhamiti vartulamityarthaḥ; asyānantaraṃ guḍakamiti draṣṭavyaṃ, tena napuṃsakaliṅgatā saṅgatā bhavati| kandaḥ prāyeṇa jarannārīyonigato nikucākāro rogaḥ||1-2||

ihaiva yonisaṃśritatvena kandanidānamāha– divetyādi| nakhadantādyairityupalakṣaṇam| ādigrahaṇāt kaṇṭakādiparigrahaḥ| vātādyāḥ kupitā iti yathānidānena vātādayaḥ pratyekaṃ kupitāḥ| ‘lakucākṛtiṃ vartulaṃ’ ‘guḍakam’ iti śeṣaḥ, tena ‘napuṃsakaliṅgatā bhavati’ iti pā.| lakucākṛtisannibhametasyānantaraṃ guḍakamiti draṣṭavyam| kandaḥ prāyeṇa jarannārīyonigato lakucākāro rogaḥ||1-2||
rūkṣaṃ vivarṇaṃ sphuṭitaṃ vātikaṃ taṃ vinirdiśet | dāharāgajvarayutaṃ vidyāt pittātmakaṃ tu tam ||3||
nīlapuṣpapratīkāśaṃ kaṇḍūmantaṃ kaphātmakam | sarvaliṅgasamāyuktaṃ sannipātātmakaṃ viduḥ ||4||

vātajādibhedena rūpamāha– ‘rūkṣamityādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ nopalabhyate | rūkṣamityādi| ‘nīlapuṣpapratīkāśam atasīkusamādivarṇam|’ iti pā.| nīlapuṣpapratīkāśamiti atasīkusumavarṇam| kaphaje'pi ‘nīlo’ iti pā.| nīlatā vyādhiprabhāvādeva; anye tu paittikalakṣaṇa eva sambadhnanti, yogyatvāt||3-4||

vātajamāha– rūkṣamityādi| sugamam| paittikamāha– dāhetyādi| sugamam| ślaiṣmikamāha– nīletyādi| ‘atasīkusumādivarṇam|’ iti pā.| atasīkusumādevavarṇam| evaṃvidhavarṇatā ca kaphaje'pi rogaprabhāvāt, anye tvetatpaittike eva sambadhnanti, yogyatvāt, vadanti ca– “dāharāgajvarayutam” ityabhidhānādikalpitametadavagantavyamiti| sannipātikamāha– sarvetyādi; sugamam||3-4||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne yonikandanidānaṃ samāptam ||63||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ yonikandanidānaṃ samāptam||63||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyapraṇītāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ yonikandanidānam||63||

div.head: mūḍhagarbhanidānam

ab.seg: atha mūḍhagarbhanidānam | bhayābhighātāttīkṣṇoṣṇapānāśananiṣevaṇāt | garbhe patati raktasya saśūlaṃ darśanaṃ bhavet ||1||

yonisthānavikārānuvṛtteḥ strīroganidānārambhaḥ| tatra garbhapātanidānamāha– bhayābhighātādityādi| etaccopalakṣaṇaṃ, tenānye'pi suśrutoktā grāmyadharmayānavāhanapatanaskhalanādayo boddhavyāḥ| patatīti sraṃsamāne, tena srāvapātayorapi saśūlaṃ raktadarśanaṃ bhavati, etattu pūrvarūpamiti darśayati||1||

atha strīvikārādhikārātstrīroganidānam| tatra garbhapātahetumāha– bhayetyādi| etaccopalakṣaṇam| tenānye'pi suśrutoktā grāmyadharmayānavāhanapatanaskhalanādayo grāhyāḥ| patatīti sraṃsamāne, saśūlaṃ raktadarśanaṃ ‘bhavati’ iti pā.| bhavatīti pūrvarūpakathanam||1||

div.ab: ācaturthāttato māsāt prasravedgarbhavidravaḥ | tataḥ sthiraśarīrasya pātaḥ pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ ||2|| (su. ni. a. 8) |

ab.seg: etayoḥ kālabhedamāha– ācaturthādityādi| garbhavidrava iti anatighanāvayavatvena viśeṣeṇa dravarūpatayā garbhavidravo bhaṇyate; ‘srāvo nātighanatvāt, pātastu ghanatvāt’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | srāvo nātighanatvāt, pātastu ghanatvāt| yattu bhoje'bhihitam– “ātṛtīyāttato māsādgarbhaḥ sravati śoṇitam| ūrdhvaṃ ‘saṃyāvabhūtastu’ iti pā.| saṅghātabhūtastu garbhaḥ patati yoṣitām||” iti| ‘saṃyāvabhūtaḥ’ iti pā.| saṅghātabhūtaḥ komalāṅgaḥ, piṇḍitāvastha ityarthaḥ| ata eva suśrute caturthamāse'pyadṛḍhatvāt srāvaḥ kathitaḥ| sthiraśarīrasyeti kaṭhinaśarīrāvayavasya| pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoriti saptame ‘anuguṇapavane’ iti pā.| anuguṇajanane jīvadarśanāyoktaṃ, ‘viguṇapavane’ iti pā.| viguṇajanane tu ‘saptamādimāse pātaḥ|’ iti pā.| saptamādimāseṣvapi garbhapātaḥ| anye tu pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoreva pātaḥ, saptamādiṣu doṣavaiguṇyāddhi prasava iti ācāryaprāmāṇyādvyavahārācca manyante||2||

srāvapātayoridānīṃ kālaniyamamāha– ācaturthādityādi| anatighanāvayavatvena viśeṣeṇa dravarūpatayā garbhavidravo bhaṇyate| yaduktaṃ bhoje– “ātṛtīyāttato māsādgarbhaḥ sravati śoṇitam| ūrdhvaṃ saṅghātabhūtastu garbhaḥ patati yoṣitām||” iti| taccaturthe māsi saṃyāvarūpatayā anabhivyaktadṛṣṭāṅgatayā suśrutena srāvapakṣe nikṣiptam| sthiraśarīrasyeti kaṭhinaśarīrāvayavasya| pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoriti saptame anuguṇajanane jīvanadarśanāyoktiḥ| viguṇajanane tu ‘saptamādimāseṣvatipātaḥ’ iti pā.| saptamādimāseṣvapi pātaḥ| saptamādiṣu tu doṣavaiguṇyāddhi prasava iti ācāryaprāmāṇyādvyavahārācca manyante||2||

div.ab: garbho'bhighātaviṣamāśanapīḍanādyaiḥ pakvaṃ drumādiva phalaṃ patati kṣaṇena |3|

garbhasyākālapāte nidānapūrvakaṃ dṛṣṭāntamāha– garbho'bhighātetyādi| pakvaṃ drumādiveti dṛṣṭāntenaiva darśayati– yathā vṛntalagnaṃ pakvaphalamabhighātenākāla eva patati, tathoktahetubhirakāle garbhapātaḥ|3|–
garbhasyācirapātaṃ sadṛṣṭāntamāha– garbha ityādi| pūrṇasarvāvayavastu prasavaḥ samucite kāle|3|–

ab.seg: mūḍhaḥ karoti pavanaḥ khalu mūḍhagarbhaṃ śūlaṃ ca yonijaṭharādiṣu mūtrasaṅgam ||3||

ucitaprasavakāle yathā mūḍho garbhaḥ syāttadāha– mūḍhaḥ karotītyādi| mūḍho vyāsaktagatiḥ, śūlaṃ ca yonijaṭharādiṣu ‘karoti’ iti śeṣaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ‘karoti’ iti śeṣaḥ; ‘mūtrasaṅgam’ iti pā.| mūtrasaṅgamityatra karotīti sambadhyate||3||

yathā mūḍho garbho bhavati tadāha– mūḍha ityādi| mūḍho vyāsaktagatiḥ, atra ‘pavano’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| mūḍhagarbhaṃ karoti, yonijaṭharādiṣu śūlaṃ ca karoti, mūtrasaṅgaṃ ca karotīti sambadhyate||3||
bhugno'nilena viguṇena tataḥ sa garbhaḥ saṅkhyāmatītya bahudhā samupaiti yonim | dvāraṃ nirudhya śirasā jaṭhareṇa kaścit kaściccharīraparivartitakubjadehaḥ ||4||
ekena kaścidaparastu bhujadvayena tiryaggato bhavati kaścidavāṅmukho'nyaḥ | pārśvāpavṛttagatireti tathaiva kaścidityaṣṭadhā gatiriyaṃ hyaparā caturdhā ||5||

viguṇānilatvādasaṅkhyeyatve'pi ‘viśeṣāt’ iti pā.| viśiṣṭā aṣṭau gatīrāha– bhugno'nilenetyādi| bhugno viguṇīkṛtaḥ| bahudheti kathitaprakārādapyadhikaṃ darśayati| ‘yonidvāram’ iti pā.| dvāraṃ nirudhya śirasetyekaḥ prakāraḥ, śirasā vipulena dvāraṃ yonimukhaṃ pidhāya lagno bhavatītyarthaḥ| jaṭhareṇa kaścidityaparaḥ, jaṭhareṇodareṇa yonidvāraṃ pidhāya sakto bhavatītyarthaḥ| kaścit śarīraparivartitakubjadeha iti śarīraparivartanena kubjadehaḥ kaścit sakto bhavati, ‘anena sahajakubjatvagrahaṇam’ iti pā., ‘anenāntaḥkubjapṛṣṭhayoḥ parigrahaḥ’ iti ca pā.| anenāntaḥkubjapṛṣṭhakubjayoḥ parigrahaḥ| ekeneti bāhunā, ayaṃ caturthaḥ| tiryaggata iti argalāyamānaḥ| kaścidavāṅmukho'nya iti ‘grīvābhaṅgādantarlagnaḥ’ iti pā.| grīvābhaṅgādadhaḥ saṃlagnaḥ| pārśvāpavṛttagatiriti pārśvabhaṅgena ‘viguṇībhūto ratidvāraṃ gacchati’ iti pā.| viguṇīkṛtaḥ; pārśvanata iti yāvat| etīti svasthānādapaiti, tathaiveti avāṅmukhaḥ san| ‘suśrute tvaṣṭadhā’ iti pā.| suśrute'pyaṣṭadhā gatireva paṭhyate| yathā– “kaściddvābhyāṃ sakthibhyāṃ yonimukhaṃ prapadyate, kaścidābhugnaikasakthirekena sakthnā, kaścidābhugnasakthiśarīraḥ sphigdeśena ‘tiryaggataḥ’ iti pā.| tiryagāgataḥ, kaścidudarapṛṣṭhapārśvānāmanyatamena yonidvāraṃ pidhāyāvatiṣṭhate, antaḥpārśvāpavṛttaśirāḥ kaścidekena bāhunā, ‘kaścidābhugnaśiro’ iti pā.| kaścidābhugnaśirā bāhudvayena, kaścidābhugnamadhyo hastapādaśirobhiḥ, kaścidekena sakthnā yonimukhamabhiprapadyate apareṇa pāyum|” (su. ni. a. 8) iti||4-5||

viguṇānilayogādasaṅkhyeyāṃ gatimāha– bhugna ityādi| bhugno viparītīkṛtaḥ, bahudheti ‘uktaṃ prakārādadhikam|’ iti pā.| uktaprakārādadhikam| tatra vyavahārayogyānaṣṭau prakārānāha– dvāramiti| vipulena śirasā yonimukhaṃ pidhāya lagno bhavati, ityekaḥ prakāraḥ| aparo dhmātena jaṭhareṇodareṇa ‘yonimukham’ iti pā.| yonikubjamukhaṃ pidhāya sakto bhavatīti dvitīyaḥ prakāraḥ| kaścit śarīraparivartanena viparītavartanena ‘kubjadehaḥ’ iti pā.| dehaḥ sakto bhavati, anena cāntaḥkubjapṛṣṭhakubjayoḥ parigrahaḥ, ayaṃ tṛtīyaḥ prakāraḥ| kaścidekena bāhunā iti caturthaḥ prakāraḥ| aparo bāhudvayeneti pañcamaḥ prakāraḥ| pārśvāpavṛttagatiriti pārśvabhaṅgena viguṇīkṛtaḥ pārśvanata iti yāvat| etīti svasthānādapaiti| tathaivetyavāṅmukhaḥ san, evamaṣṭadhā gatirbhavati| garbhasya caturaḥ prakārān punarāha– apyaparāścaturdhā ityādi| saṅkīlakādibhedena aparā vakṣyamāṇāścatuḥprakārāḥ||4-5||

saṅkīlakaḥ pratikhuraḥ parigho'tha bījasteṣūrdhvabāhucaraṇaiḥ śirasā ca yonim | saṅgī ca yo bhavati kīlakavat sa kīlo dṛśyaiḥ khuraiḥ pratikhuraṃ sa hi kāyasaṅgī | gacchedbhujadvayaśirāḥ sa ca bījakākhyo yonau sthitaḥ sa parighaḥ parigheṇa tulyaḥ ||6||
ab.note: ‘ityaṣṭavidhā gatīḥ pradarśya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate |

ab.seg: ityaṣṭavidhā gatīḥ pradarśya catuḥprakāreṇa ‘ye’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ye gativiśeṣāḥ ‘paṭhitāḥ ...’ iti pā.| kathitāstānāha– saṅkīlaka ityādi| ‘bhāgurūtaḥ kīlakaḥ, saṃśabdaprayogaśchando'nurodhāt’ iti pā.| samyak kīlavat saṅkīlakaḥ, svārthe kan| tenordhvabāhucaraṇaśirobhiḥ kīlakavallagno ‘kīlabandhanaḥ’ iti pā.| yonyāṃ saṅkīlakaḥ| ‘yoniṃ prati dṛśyaiḥ khuraiḥ pratikhuraḥ’ iti pā.| pṛṣṭhena yonyāṃ tathaitadviparītena dṛśyaiḥ hastapādaśirobhiḥ pratikhuraḥ khurasādharmyāt; khuraśabdena hastapādāvucyete| gacchedbhujadvayaśirā iti ‘bhujadvayoḥ pihitam’ iti pā.| bhujadvayopahitaṃ śiro yasya sa asmātpūrvaṃ ‘tathā,’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| tathābhūtaḥ san yo gacchet sa bījakaḥ kāyasaṅgī| bhoje'pyetā gatayaḥ paṭhyante| tathāhi– “ūrdhvabāhuśiraḥpādo rundhyādyonimukhaṃ tu yaḥ| pratikīlopamasthityā ‘saṅkīla iti sañjñitaḥ’ iti pā.| sa ca kīlakasañjñitaḥ|| ‘adhaḥ pārśvagato vā'pi’ iti pā.| adhastāt pārśvato vā'pi tathaivākuñcito'pi vā| yo niḥsṛtya mukhaṃ yonerjñeyaḥ pratikhurastu saḥ|| yonidvārāttu nirgacchedyaścaikaḥ saśirobhujaḥ| tamāhurbījakaṃ nāma ‘mūḍhaṃ garbhacikitsakāḥ|’ iti pā.| mūḍhagarbhacikitsakāḥ|| yonimāvṛtya yastiṣṭhet parigho gopuraṃ yathā| ‘yonyantargarbhamāyātam’ iti pā.| tathā'ntargarbhamāyāntaṃ vidyāt parighasañjñitam||” iti||6||

tānāha– saṅkīlaka ityādi| ūrdhvabāhucaraṇaśirobhiḥ kīlitaiḥ yonyāṃ kāyalagnaḥ saṅkīlakaḥ| yonimiti yoniṃ pratikhurairiti khurasādharmyātkhuraśabdena hastapādā ucyante, tena hastapādaiḥ bahirgataiḥ pratikhura ucyate, sa pratikhuraḥ kāyasaṅgī niruddhakāyo bhavati| bījakamāha– gacchedityādi| bhujadvayopahitaṃ śiro yasya sa tathābhūtaḥ san yo gacchet sa bījakaḥ| parighamāha– yo yonimāvṛtya tiṣṭhetsa parighaḥ| parigheṇa tulya iti| parigho'rgalādaṇḍaḥ| bhoje'pyetā gatayaḥ paṭhyante– “ūrdhvabāhuśiraḥpādo rujanyonimukhaṃ tu yaḥ| pratikīlopamaḥ sthitvā saṅkīla iti sañjñitaḥ|| adhaḥpārśvagato vāpi tathaivākuñcito'pi vā| yo niḥsṛtya mukhaṃ yonerjñeyaḥ pratikhurastu saḥ|| yonidvārāttu nirgacchedyaścaikāṃsaśirobhujaḥ| tamāhurbījakaṃ nāma mūḍhagarbhacikitsakāḥ| yonimāvṛtya yastiṣṭhetparigho gopuraṃ yathā| tathā'ntargarbhamāyāntaṃ vidyātparighasañjñitam||” ‘iti’ etatpāṭhaḥ nopalabhyate | iti||6||

div.ab: apaviddhaśirā yā tu śītāṅgī nirapatrapā | ‘nīlodgataśirā’ iti pā. | nīlodgatasirā hanti sā garbhaṃ sa ca tāṃ tathā ||7|| (su. ni. a. 8) |

ab.seg: asādhyamūḍhagarbhagarbhiṇyorlakṣaṇamāha– apaviddhaśirā yā tvityādi| apaviddhaśirā śiro dhārayitumaśaktetyarthaḥ, avanataśirā iti gadādharaḥ| nirapatrapā lajjāśūnyā| ‘nīlodgataśirā’ iti pā.| nīlodgatasirā iti ‘nīlā udgatāḥ ca śirāḥ’ iti pā.| nīlavarṇā udgatāḥ sirāḥ kukṣau yasyāḥ sā tathā| sa ceti garbhaḥ||7||

asādhyamūḍhagarbhagarbhiṇyorlakṣaṇamāha– apaviddhetyādi| apaviddhaśirāḥ śiro dhārayitumaśaktā| avanataśirā iti gadādharaḥ| nirapatrapā lajjārahitā| nīlodgatasireti nīlā udgagatāḥ ‘śirāḥ’ iti pā.| sirāḥ kukṣau yasyāḥ sā tathā, sā garbhaṃ hanti sa ceti asmātpūrvaṃ ‘sa’ iti adhikaḥ pā.| garbhastāmityarthaḥ||7||

div.ab: garbhāspandanamāvīnāṃ praṇāśaḥ śyāvapāṇḍutā | bhaveducchvāsapūtitvaṃ śūnatā'ntarmṛte śiśau ||8|| (su. ni. a. 8) |

ab.seg: mṛtagarbhalakṣaṇamāha ‘mṛtamūḍhagarbhasya paripāṭyākarṣaṇārthaṃ lakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| garbhāspandanamityādi| aspandanaṃ niścalatvaṃ, ‘jīvato garbhasyāvayavacalanaṃ bhavati|’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | jīvato garbhasyāvayavacalanaṃ bhavati| āvīnāṃ praṇāśaḥ prasavavedanānāmabhāvaḥ; athavā āvīśabdena prasavaliṅgānyucyante, tāni ‘ca’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | ca mūtrakaphaprasekādīni, teṣāṃ nāśaḥ| śūnateti ucchūnatā, antargatasya mūḍhagarbhasyādhmāpanena||8||

atha garbhiṇīrakṣārthaṃ mṛtasya mūḍhagarbhasya paripīḍyākarṣaṇārthaṃ lakṣaṇamāha– garbhetyādi| garbhāspandanaṃ garbhasyā'calatvam| āvīnāṃ praṇāśa iti prasavavedanānāmabhāvaḥ, athavā āvīśabdena prasavaliṅgāni bhaṇyante, tāni ca mūtrakaphaprasekādīni, teṣāṃ nāśaḥ| śūnateti uddhatatā, mṛtasya garbhasyādhmāpanena||8||

div.ab: mānasāgantubhirmāturupatāpaiḥ prapīḍitaḥ | garbho vyāpadyate kukṣau vyādhibhiśca nipīḍitaḥ ||9|| (su. ni. a. 8) | ‘tasyāntargatasya’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate |

ab.seg: tasyāntargatasya mānasāgantuduḥkhavyādhibhedena dvividhaṃ maraṇahetumāha– mānasāgantubhirityādi| upatāpaiḥ duḥkhaiḥ||9||
tasyāntarmṛtasya mānasāgantuduṣṭavyādhibhedena dvividhaṃ hetumāha– mānasetyādi| upatāpairiti duḥkhaiḥ, tathāgantubhirapi pīḍitaḥ||9||
yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ saṅgaḥ kukṣau makkalla eva ca | hanyuḥ striyaṃ mūḍhagarbhāṃ yathoktāścāpyupadravāḥ ||10||
vāyuḥ prakupitaḥ kuryāt saṃrudhya rudhiraṃ srutam | sūtāyā hṛcchirobastiśūlaṃ makkallasañjñakam ||11||

aparamasādhyagarbhiṇīlakṣaṇamāha– yonisaṃvaraṇamityādi| yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ tantrāntarapaṭhito rogaḥ| tathāhi– “vātalānyannapānāni grāmyadharmaṃ prajāgaram| atyarthaṃ sevamānāyā garbhiṇyā yonimārgagaḥ|| mātariśvā prakupito yonidvārasya saṃvṛtim| kurute ruddhamārgatvāt punarantargato'nilaḥ|| niruṇaddhyāśayadvāraṃ pīḍayan ‘garbhasaṃsthitam’ iti pā.| garbhasaṃsthitim| niruddhavadanocchvāso garbhaścāśu vipadyate|| baddhāṃ saṃruddhahṛdayāṃ ‘nāśayatyeva’ iti pā.| nāśayatyāśu garbhiṇīm| yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ vidyādvyādhimenaṃ sudāruṇam|| antakapratimaṃ ghoraṃ nārabheta cikitsitam|” iti| saṅgaḥ kukṣāviti yonisaṃvaraṇe ‘sati pravṛddho’ iti pā.| pratinivṛtto vāyurgarbhāśayaṃ yadā niruṇaddhi tadā garbhaḥ kukṣau sakto bhavati| agrimapaṅktiḥ nopalabhyate | sa ucyate– saṅgaḥ kukṣāviti| makkallo raktamārutajaḥ śūlaviśeṣaḥ| yadyapi prasūtāyāḥ śūlaṃ makkallamuktaṃ asmātpūrvaṃ ‘yaduktam’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| suśrute– “ ‘prajātāyāścottaraṃ kālaṃ tīkṣṇairaviśoṣitaṃ śarīraṃ makkallaṃ karoti’ iti pā.| prajātāyāścottarakālaṃ tīkṣṇairaviśodhitaṃ raktaṃ makkallaṃ karoti|” (su. śā. a. 10) iti, tathā'pi prajātāyāśceti cakāreṇāprajātāyā api śūlaṃ makkallamiti| yathoktāścāpyupadravā iti yathoktā ye ye uktāste punarākṣepakaśvāsādayaḥ||10-11||

aparamasādhyagarbhiṇīlakṣaṇamāha– yonītyādi| yonisaṃvaraṇe sati pratinivṛtto vāyurgarbhāśayadvāraṃ yadā ruṇaddhi, tadā garbhaḥ kukṣau sakto bhavati sa ucyate– saṅgaḥ kukṣāviti| makkallo raktamārutajaḥ śūlaviśeṣaḥ| yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ tantrāntare rogaviśeṣaḥ| yathā “vātalānyannapānāni grāmyadharmaṃ prajāgaram| atyarthaṃ sevamānāyāṃ ‘garbhiṇyām’ iti pā.| garbhiṇyā yonimārgagaḥ|| mātariśvā prakupito yonidvārasya saṃvṛtim| kurute ruddhamārgatvātpunarantargato'nilaḥ| niruṇaddhyāśayadvāraṃ pīḍayan garbhasaṃsthitam| niruddhavadanocchvāso garbhaścāśu vipadyate|| vipannaḥ śūnasarvāṅgaḥ sarvāṇyevāyanāni ca| baddhāṃ saṃruddhahṛdayāṃ nāśayatyāśu garbhiṇīm|| yonisaṃvaraṇaṃ nāma vyādhimenaṃ sudāruṇam| antakapratimaṃ ghoraṃ nārabheta cikitsitam||” iti| yathoktāścāpyupadravāste ca punarākṣepakakāsaśvāsādayaḥ| “pūtigandhi tathā svedo jihvā tālu ca śuṣyati| vepate bhrāmyati tathā jīvitaṃ coparudhyate|| etairliṅgairvijānīyānmūḍhagarbhaṃ cikitsakaḥ||” makkallamāha– vāyuḥ prakupita ityādi| yadyapi prasūtāyāḥ śūlaṃ makkallamuktam| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “prajātāyāścottarakālaṃ tīkṣṇairavaśoṣitaṃ raktaṃ makkalaṃ karoti” iti, tathāpi prajātāyāśceti cakāreṇāprajātāyā api śūlaṃ makkallamiti||10-11||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ samāptam ||64||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ mūḍhagarbhanidānaṃ samāptam||64||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ mūḍhagarbhanidānam||64||
atha sūtikāroganidānam | aṅgamardo jvaraḥ kampaḥ pipāsā gurugātratā | śothaḥ śūlātisārau ca sūtikārogalakṣaṇam ||1||

kramaprāptatvāt sūtikāroganidānārambhaḥ– agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | aṅgamarda ityādi| sūtikārogalakṣaṇamiti sūtikāroga eva lakṣaṇam, ‘aṅgamardādivyatiriktānāṃ rogāṇāmanabhidhānāt| aṅgamarda ityādi|’ iti pā.| aṅgamardādivyatiriktasya rogasyānabhidhānāt| ete'ṅgamardādayaḥ prāyeṇa sūtikāyā bhavantaḥ sūtikārogatvena lakṣyante ityarthaḥ||1||

sūtikārogalakṣaṇamāha– aṅgamarda ityādi| sūtikāroga eva lakṣaṇam, aṅgamardādivyatiriktasya rogasyānabhidhānāt| ‘ete'ṅgamardādayaḥ’ iti pā.| etenāṅgamardādayaḥ prāyeṇa sūtikāyā ‘bhavanti’ iti pā.| bhavantaḥ sūtikārogatvena lakṣyanta ityarthaḥ||1||
mithyopacārāt saṅkleśādviṣamājīrṇabhojanat | sūtikāyāśca ye rogā jāyante ‘dāruṇāḥ smṛtāḥ’ iti pā. | dāruṇāstu te ||2||
jvarātīsāraśothāśca śūlānāhabalakṣayāḥ | tandrāruciprasekādyāḥ kaphavātāmayodbhavāḥ ||3||
kṛcchrasādhyā hi te rogāḥ ‘kṣīṇamāṃsabalāśritāḥ’ iti pā. | kṣīṇamāṃsabalāgnitaḥ | te sarve sūtikānāmnā rogāste cāpyupadravāḥ ||4||

sūtikāroganidānamāha– mithyetyādi| saṅkleśāditi saṅkliśyate utkliśyate doṣo'neneti saṅkleśo doṣajanakamannam| viṣamājīrṇabhojanāditi viṣamabhojanādajīrṇabhojanācca| jvarātīsārādīnāmaṅgamardādibhyaḥ pṛthak punarupādānaṃ rogādhikyaṃ kṛcchratvamupadravatvaṃ ca khyāpayitum| kaphavātāmayodbhavāḥ ‘ityasya tandrāruciprasekādyā iti’ iti pā.| iti tandrāruciprasekādyā ityasya viśeṣaṇam| agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | manyante kecit, anye sarvasya jvarātisārādeḥ| kaphavātaje vikāre sati yeṣāmudbhavaste kaphavātāmayodbhavāḥ jvarātīsārādayaḥ kṛcchrasādhyā ityarthaḥ| te sarve sūtikānāmneti te jvarātīsārādayaḥ sarve sūtikābhavatvenāśrayāśritayorabhedopacārāt ‘sūtikā iti nāmnocyante’ iti pā.| sūtikānāmnocyante; te cāpyupadravāḥ ‘te upadravāśca bhavanti’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | te upadravāśca bhavanti uktānāṃ rogāṇāmanyatamaṃ pradhānīkṛtya||2-4||

mithyopacārādityādi| mithyopacārādibhiḥ sūtikāyā ye rogā jāyante| saṅkleśāditi saṅkliśyate utkliśyate doṣo'neneti saṅkleśo doṣajanakamannam| viṣamājīrṇabhojanāditi ‘viṣamabhojanājīrṇabhojanācca|’ iti pā.| viṣamabhojanādajīrṇabhojanācca| jvarātīsārādīnāmaṅgamardādibhyaḥ pṛthagupādānaṃ kṛcchrasādhyā ityarthaḥ| te sarve sūtikānāmnetyādi| jvarātīsārādayaḥ sarve sūtikābhavatvenāśrayāśritayorabhedopacārātsūtikānāmnocyante| te cāpyupadravā iti, te upadravāśca bhavanti rogāṇāmanyatamaṃ pradhānīkṛtya atra ‘bhavanti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|||2-4||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne sūtikāroganidānaṃ samāptam ||65||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ sūtikāroganidānaṃ samāptam||65||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānaṭīkāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ sūtikāroganidānam||65||
atha stanaroganidānam | sakṣīrau vā'pyadugdhau vā prāpya doṣaḥ stanau striyāḥ | pradūṣya māṃsarudhiraṃ stanarogāya kalpate ||1||

sūtikārogādhikārāt stanarogā ucyante| pāribhāṣikastanarogasamprāptimāha– sakṣīrau vā'pītyādi| sakṣīrau garbhavatyāḥ, adugdhau veti dohadāyogena prasūtāyāḥ, stanau prāpyeti vivṛtadhamanīmukhenāviśya, stanarogaśabdena ‘stanakopa’ iti prasiddho roga ucyate||1||

sūtikārogādhikārātstanarogā ucyante| pāribhāṣikastanarogasamprāptimāha– sakṣīrāvityādi| garbhavatyāḥ sakṣīrau atra ‘ceti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.|| adugdhau veti dohadāyogena prasūtāyāḥ| stanau prāpyeti vivṛtadhamanīmukhena praviśya| stanarogaśabdenātra ‘stanakopa’ iti prasiddho roga ucyate||1||
pañcānāmapi teṣāṃ hi raktajaṃ vidradhiṃ vinā | lakṣaṇāni samānāni bāhyavidradhilakṣaṇaiḥ ||2||
teṣāṃ vātapittakaphasannipātāgantujānāmatideśena lakṣaṇamāha– pañcānāmapītyādi| etat subodhyam| āgantustanarogo'bhighātena śalyena ca| raktajasyāsambhavo vyādhisvabhāvāt||2||
teṣāṃ vātakaphapittasannipātāgantujānāmatideśena lakṣaṇamāha– pañcānāmityādi| sugamam||2||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne stanaroganidānaṃ samāptam ||66||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ stanaroganidānaṃ samāptam||66||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ stanaroganidānam||66||
atha stanyaduṣṭinidānam | viśaṃsteṣvapi gātreṣu yathā śukraṃ na dṛśyate | sarvadehāśritatvācca śukralakṣaṇamucyate ||1||

adṛśyasyāpi ‘stanyaprasiddhopamānena’ iti pā.| stanyasya prasiddhopamānena pravartane hetuṃ darśayannāha– viśannityādi| śukralakṣaṇaṃ stanyamucyata iti śeṣaḥ| kuta ityāha– yathā śukraṃ viśaṃsteṣu chinneṣvapi gātreṣu na dṛśyate, tasmāddhetoḥ| dvitīyaṃ hetumāha– sarvadehāśritatvāditi| śukravatsamastaśarīrāśritatvāt||1||
tadeva ceṣṭayuvaterdarśanāt smaraṇādapi | śabdasaṃśravaṇāt sparśāt saṃharṣācca pravartate ||2||
suprasannaṃ manastatra harṣaṇe heturucyate | ‘āhārasamayonitvādevam’ iti pā. | āhārarasayonitvādevaṃ stanyamapi striyāḥ ||3||

śukradṛṣṭāntena stanyasyābhyantaradarśanaṃ pratipādya tenaiva dṛṣṭāntena bahiḥpravartanaṃ pratipādayannāha– tadityādi| tadeva śukraṃ pravartate bahirniḥsarati| saṃharṣāt viśiṣṭasaṅkalpalakṣaṇāt| saṃharṣe hetucatuṣṭayaṃ nirdiśannāha– iṣṭayuvaterityādi| iṣṭayuvatidarśanādihetucatuṣṭayena yaḥ saṃharṣaḥ, sa suprasanna eva manasi bhavati, iti manaso'pi prasannasya kāraṇatvaṃ darśayannāha– suprasannetyādi| tatra harṣaṇe hetuḥ suprasannamīrṣyādyanabhibhūtaṃ mana ucyate| śukreṇa saha prastutasya stanyasya sādharmyāddhetuṃ darśayannāha– āhāretyādi| pūrvaṃ stanyamapi striyāḥ pratartate, śukramāhārarasayonitvātpravartate, stanyamapi tathā, tasmātpravartate||2-3||
tadevāpatyasaṃsparśāddarśanāt smaraṇādapi | grahaṇācca śarīrasya śukravat sampravartate | sneho nirantarastatra ‘prasave’ iti pā. | prasrave heturucyate ||4||

nanu śukramāhārarasayonyapi saṃharṣātkāraṇātpravartate, atra ca kiṃ kāraṇamityāha– tadevetyādi| tadeva stanyaṃ śukravat ‘saṃvartate’ iti pā.| sampravartate| apatyasaṃsparśādikāraṇacatuṣṭaye'pi sneho mūlakāraṇamiti tadeva darśayannāha– sneha ityādi| prasrave stanyasravaṇe atrāpi catvāro hetavaḥ parameṣṭayuvatisthāne'trāpatyagrahaṇaṃ, mūlahetuharṣasthāne snehaḥ, prasannasthāne nirantaraḥ||4||
ab.note: atra ‘iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ stanyaduṣṭinidānam||67||’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ|

ab.seg: gurubhirvividhairannairduṣṭairdoṣaiḥ pradūṣitam | kṣīraṃ ‘dhātryāḥ’ iti pā. | mātuḥ kumārasya nānārogāya kalpate ||5||
stanāśritatvena stanyaduṣṭimāha– gurubhirvividhairityādi| gurubhirannairhetubhūtairye duṣṭā doṣāstaiḥ pradūṣitam||5||
stanāśritatvena stanyasya duṣṭimāha– gurubhirityādi| gurubhirannairhetubhūtairye duṣṭā doṣāstaiḥ pradūṣitaṃ dhātryāḥ kṣīraṃ kumārasya nānārogāya kalpate| nānārogānutpādayatītyarthaḥ||5||
kaṣāyaṃ salilaplāvi stanyaṃ mārutadūṣitam | kaṭvamlalavaṇaṃ pītarājīmat pittasañjñitam ||6||
kaphaduṣṭaṃ ghanaṃ toye nimajjati sapicchalam | dviliṅgaṃ dvandvajaṃ vidyāt sarvaliṅgaṃ tridoṣajam ||7||

stanyaduṣṭilakṣaṇamāha– kaṣāyamityādi| salilaplāvīti salile yadutplavate lāghavāt tat salilaplāvi| etadupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena tanutvādyapi boddhavyam| kaṭvamlalavaṇamiti kaṭu tiktaṃ, tikte'pi kaṭuśabdapravṛtteriti vadanti| pītarājīmaditi pītarekhāyuktam, ‘atrāpi’ iti pā.| tatrāpi nīlalohitāśca rājyo jñeyāḥ| ‘nimajjati’ iti pā.| pittasañjñitamiti pittaduṣṭasañjñitam| sañjñitamityatra saṃyutamiti pāṭhāntaram| toye nimajjati gurutvāt| atimādhuryādyapi bodhyam| prasannasya tu sādhāraṇaṃ madhurapāṇḍutvam| abhighātenāpi stanyaṃ duṣṭaṃ sambhavatyeva, kintu tasya vātikastanyalakṣaṇaireva saṅgrahaṇaṃ kartavyam| stanyasvarūpaṃ ca suśrutenoktam| tadyathā– “rasaprasādo madhuraḥ pakvāhāranimittajaḥ| kṛtsnadehāt stanau prāptaḥ stanyamityabhidhīyate||” (su. ni. a. 10) iti||6-7||

vātikamāha– kaṣāyamityādi| ‘salile plavate’ iti pā.| salilaplāvi salile yadutplavate lāghavāt, etadupalakṣaṇaṃ, tena tanutvādyapyanuktaṃ boddhavyam| paittikamāha– kaṭvityādi| kaṭu tiktaṃ, tikte'pi kaṭuśabdasya pravṛtteriti vadanti, pītarājīmaditi pītarekhāyuktam, atrāpi nīlalohitāśca rājyo boddhavyāḥ| pittasañjñitamiti pittaduṣṭamiti sañjñitam| ślaiṣmikamāha– kaphaduṣṭamityādi| toye nimajjatīti gurutvāt| atimādhuryādyapi boddhavyam| sāṃsargikasānnipātikāvāha– dviliṅgamiti| sugamam||6-7||
aduṣṭaṃ cāmbunikṣiptamekībhavati pāṇḍuram | madhuraṃ cāvivarṇaṃ ca prasannaṃ tat praśasyate ||8||

avikṛtastanyamāha– aduṣṭamityādi| ambunikṣiptamekībhavati sarvātmanā jalena sahaikībhavatīti bodhyaṃ, vātādiduṣṭasyāpyekadeśenaikībhāvopalambhāt| avivarṇamiti avidyamānavātādiduṣṭavarṇam| etat samadoṣaprakṛtikṣīrasya prasannasya lakṣaṇam| anye tvavivarṇamityatra nañ īṣadarthe, tena yadvātādiprakṛtivarṇānuviddhamapi pāṇḍuramalpaduṣṭatvāttad gṛhṇanti| kecit pāṇḍurasthāne ‘sarvaśaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tadā sarvātmanā jalena sahaikībhavatīti vyakto'rthaḥ| atra pakṣe avivarṇamityanenaivāduṣṭaśuklavarṇatā jñeyā| prasannaṃ ‘pravṛtistham’ iti pā.| prakṛtistham||8||

avikṛtaṃ stanyamāha– aduṣṭamityādi| ambunikṣiptamekībhavati asmātpūrvaṃ ‘sa’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| sarvātmanā jalena sahaikībhūtaṃ bhavatīti boddhavyam| avivarṇamiti avidyamānavātādiduṣṭavarṇam||8||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne stanyaduṣṭinidānaṃ samāptam ||67||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ stanyaduṣṭinidānaṃ samāptam||67||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyaviracitāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ stanyaduṣṭinidānam||67||

div.head: bālaroganidānam
div.ab: atha bālaroganidānam | vātaduṣṭaṃ śiśuḥ stanyaṃ piban vātagadāturaḥ | kṣāmasvaraḥ kṛśāṅgaḥ syādbaddhaviṇmūtramārutaḥ ||1|| svinno bhinnamalo bālaḥ kāmalāpittarogavān | tṛṣṇāluruṣṇasarvāṅgaḥ pittaduṣṭaṃ payaḥ piban ||2|| kaphaduṣṭaṃ piban kṣīraṃ lālāluḥ śleṣmarogavān | nidrānvito jaḍaḥ ‘śūnaḥ śuklākṣaḥ’ iti pā. | śūnavaktrākṣaśchardanaḥ śiśuḥ ||3|| dvandvaje dvandvajaṃ rūpaṃ sarvaje sarvalakṣaṇam |4|

bālarogāṇāṃ duṣṭastanyena sambhavāttadanantaraṃ tānāha– vātaduṣṭamityādi| vātagadātura iti vakṣyamāṇakṣāmasvarādiyuktaḥ| tṛṣṇāluriti tṛṣṇāvān| lālāluriti lālāsrāvayuktaḥ| chardana iti stanyavāntikaraḥ||1-3||–

duṣṭastanyapānasambhavāt strīrogānantaraṃ bālarogamāha– vātaduṣṭamiti| sugamam| pittaduṣṭamāha– svinna ityādi| tṛṣṇāluḥ tṛṣṇāvān| kaphaduṣṭamāha– kaphaduṣṭamiti| lālāluḥ lālāvān, tathā śleṣmarogayuktaḥ, nidrayā pīḍitaḥ, jaḍaḥ apaviddhāṅgaḥ, śūnavaktrākṣaḥ saśophamukhanayanaḥ, chardana iti stanyavāntikaraḥ||1-3||–

ab.seg: śiśostīvrāmatīvrāṃ ca rodanāllakṣayedrujam ||4||
sa yaṃ spṛśedbhṛśaṃ deśaṃ yatra ca sparśanākṣamaḥ | tatra vidyādrujaṃ mūrdhni rujaṃ cākṣinimīlanāt ||5||
agrimapaṅktiḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate hṛdi jihvauṣṭhadaśanaśvāsamuṣṭinipīḍanaiḥ | koṣṭhe vibandhavamathustanadaṃśāntrakūjanaiḥ | ādhmānapṛṣṭhanamanajaṭharonnamanairapi ||6||
bastau guhye ca viṇmūtrasaṅgatrāsadigīkṣaṇaiḥ | srotāṃsyaṅgāni sandhīṃśca paśyedyatnānmuhurmuhuḥ ||7||
śiśorvaktumakṣamasyāntargatavedanājñānopāyamāha– ‘śiśorityādinā|’ iti pā.| śiśorityādi| tīvrāṃ ‘rujām’ iti pā.| rujaṃ bahurodanāt, atīvrāmalparodanāt lakṣayet||4-7||

śiśorvaktumakṣamasyāntargatavedanājñānopāyamāha– śiśorityādi| atirodanena kiñcidrodanena ca atra ‘yadā’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ| rujaṃ pīḍāṃ vidyādityarthaḥ| sa śiśuryaṃ dehadeśaṃ bhṛśamatyarthaṃ spṛśet, yatra ca dehadeśe sparśanākṣamaḥ syātsparśaṃ na sahate, tatra dehadeśe vedanāṃ jānīyāt, akṣinimīlanāt netrayoḥ saṅkocanācchirasi pīḍāṃ vidyāt, jihvauṣṭhadaśanādibhirbālasya hṛdi pīḍāṃ vidyāt, vibandhādibhirādhmānādibhiśca koṣṭhe rujaṃ vidyāt, bastau guhye ca viṇmūtrayoḥ saṅgena tathā trāsena digīkṣaṇena ca bālasya rujaṃ vidyāt||4-7||
kukūṇakaḥ ‘kṣīradoṣācchiśūnāmakṣivartmani’ iti pā. | kṣīradoṣācchiśūnāmeva vartmani | jāyate tena tannetraṃ kaṇḍūraṃ ca sravenmuhuḥ ||8||
śiśuḥ kuryāllalāṭākṣikūṭanāsāvagharṣaṇam | śakto nārkaprabhāṃ draṣṭuṃ na vartmonmīlanakṣamaḥ ||9||

bālānāmeva duṣṭastanyapānādvartmarogamāha– kukūṇaka ityādi| kukūṇakaḥ ‘kothaya’ iti pā.| ‘kotha’ iti khyātaḥ| sravenmuhuriti picciṭasrutiyuktaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| na vartmonmīlanakṣama iti na ‘vartmacālanakṣamaḥ’ iti pā.| vartmacālanapaṭuḥ||8-9||

bālānāmeva duṣṭastanyapānādvartmarogamāha– kukūṇaka ityādi| kṣīradoṣātkukūṇako nāma rogaḥ śiśūnāmeva vartmani jāyate, na mahatāṃ puṃsām| tathā ca vāgbhaṭaḥ– “kukūṇakaḥ śiśoreva dantotpattinimittajaḥ|” iti| kutsite kūṇite nimīlite netre yasmādrogādasau kūkūṇakaḥ, loke kothaya ityākhyātaḥ| tena kukūṇakena netraṃ kaṇḍūyuktaṃ jāyate| tathā tannayanaṃ sravenmuhuriti picchalasrutiyuktaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| lalāṭādimardanaṃ kuryāt| na vartmonmīlanakṣama iti na vartmacālanapaṭuḥ||8-9||
mātuḥ kumāro garbhiṇyāḥ stanyaṃ prāyaḥ pibannapi | kāsāgnisādavamathutandrākārśyārucibhramaiḥ ||10||
yujyate koṣṭhavṛddhyā ca tamāhuḥ pārigarbhikam | rogaṃ paribhavākhyaṃ ca yuñjyāttatrāgnidīpanam ||11||

pārigarbhikamāha– māturityādi| pibannapīti apiśabdādapibannapi| tamāhuḥ pārigarbhikamiti pārigarbhiko'hiṇḍīti khyātaḥ; tasyaiva paribhavākhya iti nāmāntaraṃ, bālaṃ paribhavatīti paribhavaḥ, sa eva ākhyā yasya tam| upaśayenāpi tajjñānamāha– yuñjyādityādi||10-11||

pārigarbhikamāha– māturityādi| ‘kumārī’ iti pā.| kumāro garbhiṇyā mātuḥ prāyo vāyorbāhulyena stanyaṃ pibannapīti apiśabdena apibannapi kāsādibhistathā koṣṭhavṛddhyā yujyate yukto bhavati| tadāhuḥ ‘pārigarbhikā’ iti pā.| pārigarbhikaṃ ahiṇḍīti loke khyātaṃ, tasyaiva nāmāntaraṃ paribhavākhyamiti| upaśayenāpi tasya jñānamāha– yuñjyāttatrāgnidīpanamityādi||10-11||
tālumāṃse kaphaḥ kruddhaḥ kurute tālukaṇṭakam | tena tālupradeśasya nimnatā mūrdhni jāyate ||12||
tālupātaḥ stanadveṣaḥ kṛcchrāt pānaṃ śakṛddravam | tṛḍakṣikaṇṭhāsyarujā ‘grīvādurvahatā’ iti pā. | grīvādurdharatā vamiḥ ||13||

tālukaṇṭakamāha– tālumāṃsa ityādi| asyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ tālupāta ityādi| tālupāta ityabhyantare tāluno'dhaḥpātaḥ| kṛcchrāt pānamityatra ‘stanyasya’ iti śeṣaḥ| śakṛddravaṃ bhinnapurīṣatā| ‘grīvādurvahatā’ iti pā.| grīvādurdharatā grīvāyā duḥkhena dhāraṇam| vamiḥ stanyasya vāntiḥ||12-13||

tālukaṇṭakamāha– tālumāṃsa ityādi| kaṇṭakākāratvena tālukaṇṭakaḥ, nimnatā gartākāratā| tālupātamāha– tālupāta ityādi| tālupātākhyo rogaḥ, tālunaḥ patanaṃ sraṃso yatra roge sa tathā| kṛcchrātpānamityatra stanyasyeti śeṣaḥ| śakṛddravaṃ bhinnapurīṣatā, grīvādurdharatā grīvāyā duḥkhena dhāraṇaṃ, vamiḥ stanyasya vāntiḥ||12-13||

div.ab: visarpastu śiśoḥ prāṇanāśano bastiśīrṣajaḥ | padmavarṇo mahāpadmanāmā doṣatrayodbhavaḥ ||14|| śaṅkhābhyāṃ hṛdayaṃ yāti hṛdayādvā gudaṃ vrajet |15|

mahāpadmanāmānaṃ visarpamāha– visarpastvityādi| bastiśīrṣaja iti bastijaḥ śīrṣajaśca, śīrṣaṃ śiraḥ| padmavarṇa iti lohitapadmavarṇaḥ| śaṅkhābhyāṃ hṛdayaṃ yātīti śīrṣajaḥ| padmapatratulyavarṇatāṃ mukhatāluni ‘bahirdeśeṣu ca’ iti pā.| bahirdeśe veti vadanti| hṛdayādgudaṃ yātīti bastijaḥ; ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ gatvā gudaṃ yātītyarthaḥ| atra padmasavarṇatā bastideśe gude ca| vāśabdaścātra vyavasthitavikalpavacanaḥ||14||–

mahāpadmanāmānaṃ visarpamāha– visarpa ityādi| bastiśīrṣaja iti bastijaḥ, śīrṣajaśca, śīrṣa śiraḥ, tatra jātaḥ| padmavarṇa iti lohitapadmavarṇatulyaḥ| śaṅkhābhyāṃ hṛdayaṃ yātīti śīrṣajaḥ| atra padmavarṇatā bastideśe gude ca| vāśabdo'tra vyavasthitavikalpavacanaḥ| hṛdayādgudaṃ yātīti ‘bastiśīrṣajaḥ’ iti pā.| bastijaḥ, ūrdhvaṃ hṛdayaṃ gatvā gude yātītyarthaḥ||14||–

ab.seg: kṣudraroge ca kathite tvajagallyahipūtane ||15||
anyau dvau vikārau bālānāṃ bhavatastāvāha– kṣudretyādi| ‘snigdhāḥ savarṇāḥ’ ityādinā'jagallikā, ‘kaṇḍūyanāt’ ityādinā'hipūtanā||15||
anyau dvau vikārau bālānāṃ bhavatastāvāha– kṣudretyādi| ‘snigdhāḥ savarṇāḥ’ ityādinā'jagallikā| ‘kaṇḍūyanāttataḥ kṣiptam’ ityādinā'hipūtanam||15||
jvarādyā vyādhayaḥ sarve ‘mahānto’ iti pā. | mahatāṃ ye pureritāḥ | bāladehe'pi te tadvadvijñeyāḥ kuśalaiḥ sadā ||16||
anye'pi vikārā bālānāṃ sambhavantītyatideśena tānāha– jvarādyā ityādi| pureritā iti pūrvoktāḥ| te tadvaditi te jvarādayastādṛśā jñeyāḥ| kuśalairiti vijñaiḥ||16||
anye vikārā bālānāṃ bhavanti, tānatideśenāha– jvarādyā ityādi| te tadvat te jvarādayastādṛśā jñeyā ityarthaḥ||16||

div.ab: kṣaṇādudvijate bālaḥ kṣaṇāttrasyati roditi | nakhairdantairdārayati dhātrīmātmānameva vā ||17|| ūrdhvaṃ nirīkṣate dantān khādet kūjati jṛmbhate | bhruvau kṣipati dantauṣṭhaṃ phenaṃ vamati cāsakṛt ||18|| kṣāmo'ti niśi jāgarti śūnākṣo bhinnaviṭsvaraḥ | māṃsaśoṇitagandhiśca na cāśnāti yathā purā ||19|| sāmānyaṃ grahajuṣṭānāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ samudāhṛtam |20|

prāyeṇa śaucabhraṃśādinā skandagrahādayo nava ‘bāleṣvāśrayam’ iti pā.| bāleṣvāveśaṃ kurvantyatastatparijñānāya sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– kṣaṇādudvijate bāla ityādi| ete grahāḥ pūjārthaṃ bālān hiṃsanti| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “dhātrīmātroḥ prāk pradiṣṭāpacārācchaucabhraṣṭān maṅgalācārahīnān| ‘hṛtān trastān tarjitān tāḍitāṃśca’ iti pā.| trastān hṛṣṭāṃstarjitān kranditān vā pūjāhetorhiṃsyurete kumārān||” (su. u. taṃ. a. 27) iti| udvijata ityudvigno bhavati; udvigno vihvalaḥ, na tu bibhetītyarthaḥ, ‘trasyatītyasyopāttatvāt’ iti pā.| trasyatītyanena paunaruktyaprasaṅgāt| kūjatyārtanādaṃ karoti| bhruvau kṣipatīti bhrūbhaṅgaṃ racayati| dantauṣṭhamityatra kṣipatīti sambadhyate| kṣipati khādati, dhātūnāmanekārthatvāt| bhinnaviṭsvara iti bhinnaviṭ bhinnaśakṛt, bhinnasvaraḥ svarabhedavān| māṃsaśoṇitagandhiriti visragandhiḥ| na cāśnāti yathā pureti pūrvavanna bhakṣayatītyarthaḥ||17-19||–

prāyeṇa śaucabhraṃśādinā skandagrahādayo nava bāleṣvāviśanti, tatparijñānārthaṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇaṃ ca vyācaṣṭe| tatra sāmānyalakṣaṇamāha– kṣaṇādityādi| ete grahāḥ pūjāhetorbālānhiṃsanti| yaduktaṃ carake– “dhātrīmātroḥ prākpradiṣṭāpacārācchaucabhraṣṭānmaṅgalācārahīnān| kliṣṭāṃstāṃstāṃstarjitāṃstāḍitāṃśca pūjāhetorhiṃsyurete kumārān||” iti| udvijata iti udvigno vihvalo bhavati; na tu bibhetītyayamasyārthaḥ, trasyatītyasyopāttatvāt| kūjatīti avyaktanādaṃ karoti, bhruvau kṣipati bhrūbhaṅgaṃ racayati, dantauṣṭhamityatra kṣipatīti sambadhyate| kṣipati khādati, dhātūnāmanekārthatvāt| ‘bhinnaviṭsvara iti’ iti pā.| bhinnaviḍityādi| bhinnaviṭ bhinnamalaḥ, bhinnasvaraḥ svarabhedavān| māṃsaśoṇitagandhiriti visragandhiḥ| na cāśnātīti pūrvavanna bhakṣayatītyarthaḥ| etatsarvaṃ grahāṇāṃ sāmānyalakṣaṇam||17-19||–

ekanetrasya gātrasya srāvaḥ spandanakampanam ||20|| ūrdhvaṃ dṛṣṭyā nirīkṣeta vakrāsyo raktagandhikaḥ | dantān khādati vitrastaḥ stanyaṃ naivābhinandati ||21|| skandagrahagṛhītānāṃ rodanaṃ cālpameva ca |22|

sāmānyaliṅgamabhidhāya ‘viśeṣaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.| viśeṣagrahaliṅgamāha– ekanetrasyetyādi| ekanetrasya vāmasya dakṣiṇasya vā ‘srāvaḥ srutiḥ’ iti pā.| srāvo'śrusrutiḥ prabhāvāt; gātrasya srāvo gharmayuktagātratetyarthaḥ| spandanakampanamiti spandanaṃ manāk calanaṃ, kampanaṃ mahatā vegena vepanaṃ; spandanaṃ kampanaṃ vā bhavatītyarthaḥ| vakrāsyo vakramukhaḥ| raktagandhika ityetat sāmānyalakṣaṇalabdhamapyatiśayārthamuktam; evamanyatrāpi sāmānyalakṣaṇe punarukte vyākhyeyam||20-21||–

viśeṣaliṅgaṃ tatra skandagrahagṛhītalakṣaṇamāha– eketyādi| skando'tra skandavinodārthaṃ rudreṇa sṛṣṭo grahaḥ, na punarbhagavān kārtikeyaḥ| ekanetrasya vāmasya dakṣiṇasya vā srāvo'śrusrutirbhavati prabhāvāt, gātrasya srāvo gharmayuktagātratetyarthaḥ, spandanaṃ kampanamiti| spandanaṃ manāk calanaṃ, kampanaṃ mahatā vegena vepanaṃ vā bhavatītyarthaḥ| vakrāsya iti vakramukhaḥ| raktagandhika ityetena sāmānyalakṣaṇalabdhamapyatiśayārthamuktam||20-21||– ‘naṣṭasaṅgo’ iti pā. |

ab.seg: naṣṭasañjño vamet phenaṃ sañjñāvānatiroditi | pūyaśoṇitagandhitvaṃ skandāpasmāralakṣaṇam ||22||

skandāpasmāralakṣaṇamāha– ‘naṣṭetyādi’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | naṣṭetyādi| naṣṭasañjño mūrchitaḥ san phenaṃ ‘vamet yathā naṣṭasaṅgo phenaṃ vamet tathā sañjñāvānatiroditi’ iti pā.| vamati, tathā sañjñāvān sannatiroditi||22||
skandāpasmāralakṣaṇamāha– naṣṭetyādi| naṣṭasañjñaḥ san phenaṃ vamati, sañjñāvān jñānavān atiroditi, naṣṭasañjño mūrchitaḥ||22||

div.ab: srastāṅgo bhayacakito vihaṅgagandhiḥ sāsrāvavraṇaparipīḍitaḥ samantāt | sphoṭaiśca pracitatanuḥ sadāhapākairvijñeyo bhavati śiśuḥ kṣataḥ śakunyā ||23|| (su. u. taṃ. a. 27) |

ab.seg: śakunīlakṣaṇamāha– srastāṅga ityādi| srastāṅga iti aṅgasraṃsavadvyathāvān| bhayacakita iti bhayaheturbhayaṃ bhayānakamucyate, tataścakitaḥ; asati bhayahetau trasyatītyarthaḥ| vihaṅgagandhiriti vihaṅgasyeva gandho yasya sa tathā, ‘upamānācca’ iti samāsānta ‘i’ pratyayaḥ| vihaṅgaśabdena jalacarā māṃsādāśca pakṣiṇo gṛhyante, visragandhitvāt| hiraṇyākṣe'pyuktam– “saṃsrāvadāhapākādyaiścitaḥ sphoṭairbhayānvitaḥ| srastāṅgo visragandhiḥ syācchakunyā pīḍitaḥ śiśuḥ||” iti| sāsrāvavraṇaparipīḍita iti sphoṭaireva vidīrṇairvraṇarūpamāpannaiḥ paripīḍitaḥ| sphoṭaiśca pracitatanuriti navanavaiḥ sphoṭairvyāptatanuḥ| kṣata ityabhibhūtaḥ||23||

śakunīgrahalakṣaṇamāha– srastetyādi| srastāṅgaḥ aṅgasraṃsanavyathāvān| bhayacakita iti bhayaheturbhayaṃ bhayānakamucyate, tataścakitaḥ asati bhayahetau trasyatītyarthaḥ| vihaṅgaśabdena jalacarā māṃsādāśca pakṣiṇo gṛhyante visragandhitvāt| hiraṇyākṣe'pyuktam– “saṃsrāvadāhapākādyaiścitaḥ sphoṭairbhayānvitaḥ| srastāṅgo visragandhiḥ syācchakunyā pīḍitaḥ śiśuḥ||” iti| sāsrāvavraṇaparipīḍita iti sphoṭaireva vidīrṇairvraṇarūpatāmāpannaiḥ paripīḍita ityarthaḥ| sphoṭaiśca pracitatanuriti navanavaiḥ sphoṭairvyāptatanuḥ| kṣata ityabhibhūtaḥ||23||
vraṇaiḥ sphoṭaiścitaṃ gātraṃ paṅkagandhaṃ sravedasṛk | bhinnavarcā jvarī dāhī revatīgrahalakṣaṇam ||24||
atīsāro jvarastṛṣṇā tiryakprekṣaṇarodanam | naṣṭanidrastathodvigno grastaḥ pūtanayā śiśuḥ ||25||
chardiḥ kāso jvarastṛṣṇā vasāgandho'tirodanam | stanyadveṣo'tisāraśca andhapūtanayā bhavet ||26||
vepate kāsate kṣīṇo netrarogo vigandhitā | chardyatīsārayuktaśca śītapūtanayā śiśuḥ ||27||
prasannavarṇavadanaḥ sirābhirabhisaṃvṛtaḥ | mūtragandhī ca bahvāśī ‘mukhamaṇḍatikāgrahī’ iti pā. | mukhamaṇḍikayā bhavet ||28||
‘chardispandanakaṇṭhāsyaśoṣamūrchāvigandhitā’ iti pā. | chardispa(sya)ndanakaṇṭhāsyaśoṣamūrchāvigandhitāḥ | ūrdhvaṃ paśyeddaśeddantān ‘naigameyaṃ graham’ iti pā. | naigameyagrahaṃ vadet ||29||
prastabdhākṣaḥ stanadveṣī muhyate cāniśaṃ muhuḥ | taṃ bālamacirāddhanti grahaḥ sampūrṇalakṣaṇaḥ | agrimapaṅktiḥ nopalabhyate viparītatamaṃ sādhyaṃ cikitsedacirārditam ||30||

revatīgrahalakṣaṇamāha– vraṇairityādi| ‘vraṇaiḥ sphoṭaiścitaṃ gātraṃ paṅkagandhaṃ sravedasṛgiti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ| vraṇaiḥ purāṇaiḥ, sphoṭairavidīrṇairnūtanaiḥ, citaṃ vyāptam| ‘gātraṃ paṅkagandhaṃ sravedasṛgiti’ iti adhikaḥ pāṭhaḥ| gātramiti kartṛpadaṃ, paṅkagandhaṃ ‘śaṭitakardamagandham’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | śaṭitakardamagandhaṃ, ‘samāsāntavidheranityatvādupamānāccetīpratyayo na bhavati|’ iti pā.| samāsavidheranityatvādipratyayo na bhavati| pūtanālakṣaṇamāha– atīsāra ityādi| ‘grastaḥ pūtanayā śiśuriti’ iti kvacitpustake adhikaḥ pā.| grasta iti gṛhīta ityarthaḥ||24-30||

revatīgrahalakṣaṇamāha– vraṇairityādi| vraṇaiḥ purāṇaiḥ, sphoṭairnavaiḥ, paṅkagandhaṃ kardamagandhamasṛk sravet| pūtanāgrastalakṣaṇamāha– atīsāra ityādi| tiryak vā dakṣiṇanetraprāntasyāvalokanam, udvigno vyagracittaḥ, grasto gṛhītaḥ| andhapūtanayā grastamāha– chardirityādi| vasāyā māṃsasnehasya gandhavān| śītapūtanāgrastalakṣaṇamāha– vepata ityādi| sugamam| mukhamaṇḍalikāgrastalakṣaṇamāha– prasannetyādi| ‘udgataśirābhi ... ’ iti pā.| udgatasirābhirvyāptasirāḥ, mūtragandhīti bastamūtragandhaḥ, bahvāśī bahubhakṣaṇaśīlaḥ| ‘naigameṣu grastalakṣaṇamāha’ iti pā.| naigameyagrastalakṣaṇamāha– chardirityādi| syandanaṃ lālāsrāvaḥ, athavā gharmāmbusrāvaḥ| sādhyāsādhyalakṣaṇamāha– prastabdhākṣa ityādi||24-30||
iti śrīmādhavakaraviracite mādhavanidāne bālaroganidānaṃ samāptam ||68||
iti śrīkaṇṭhadattakṛtāyāṃ madhukośavyākhyāyāṃ bālaroganidānaṃ samāptam||68||
iti śrīvācaspativaidyakṛtāyāṃ mādhavanidānavyākhyāyāmātaṅkadarpaṇākhyāyāṃ bālaroganidānaṃ samāptam||68||

div.head: viṣaroganidānam

ab.seg: atha viṣaroganidānam | sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ caiva dvividhaṃ viṣamucyate | mūlādyātmakamādyaṃ syāt paraṃ sarpādisambhavam ||1||

pāriśeṣyādviṣaroganidānamucyate– sthāvaramityādi| viṣādajanakatvādviṣaṃ; tacca dvividham– sthāvaraṃ, jaṅgamaṃ ca| mūlādyātmakamiti ādyaṃ sthāvaraṃ mūlādirūpaṃ daśavidhaṃ; yaduktaṃ suśrute “mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvak kṣīraṃ sāra eva ca| niryāso dhātavaścaiva kandaśca daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ||” (su. ka. a. 2) iti| tatra klītakāśvamārakaguñjāsugandhagargarakaraghāṭavidyucchikhā'nantā-vijayānītyaṣṭau mūlaviṣāṇi, viṣapatrikālambāsuradārukarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca patraviṣāṇi, ‘ ... nandanakaṅkolasārapākāni’ iti pā.| kumudvatīveṇukākarambhamahākarambhakarkoṭakareṇukakhadyotaka-carmarībhagandhāsarpaghātinandanasārapākāni dvādaśa phalaviṣāṇi, vetrakādambavallījakarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca puṣpaviṣāṇi, antrapācakakartarīyaśaileyakarambhanandanakaraghāṭavarāṭakāni sapta tvaṅniryāsasāraviṣāṇi, kumudaghnīsnuhījālakṣīrīṇi trīṇi kṣīraviṣāṇi, phenāśmabhasma haritālaṃ ca dve dhātuviṣe, ‘ ... markeṭakāni’ iti pā.| kālakūṭavatsanābhasarṣapakapālakardamakavairāṭakamustakamahāviṣa-prapauṇḍarīkamūlakahalāhalaśṛṅgimarkaṭakāni trayodaśa kandaviṣāṇi, etāni prāṇaharāṇi; evaṃ pañcapañcāśat sthāvarāṇi viṣāṇi bhavanti| eṣāṃ ca vyādhapulindādibhyo vyaktijñānaṃ kartavyam| paraṃ sarpādisambhavamiti paraṃ jaṅgamaṃ, tacca ṣoḍaśābhidhānam– dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsadaṃṣṭrānakhamūtrapurīṣaśukralālārtavamukhasandaṃśaparditagudāsthi-pittaśūkaśavabhedāt| parditaṃ pāyukṛtaḥ kutsitaśabdaḥ; ‘parda’ kutsite śabde, ityasya prayogāt| tatra dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsaviṣā divyāḥ sarpāḥ, bhaumāḥ sarpā daṃṣṭrāviṣāḥ, mārjāramakaravyāghrādayo daṃṣṭrānakhaviṣāḥ, picciṭakauṇḍinyādayo mūtrapurīṣaviṣāḥ, mūṣikāḥ śukraviṣāḥ, vṛścikavaraṭyucciṭiṅgādaya “āraśabdenātra vṛścikādilāṅgūlasthitaḥ kaṇṭako bhaṇyate, tasya ca sthūlaśūkarūpatvācchūkagrahaṇenaiva grahaṇam; ata eva dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsetyādisūtre pṛthaṅnodāhṛtamāragrahaṇam|” iti ḍalhaṇaḥ| ārāviṣāḥ, lūtā ‘lālāsparśaviṇmūtra ... ’ iti pā.| lālārtavaviṇmūtraśukramukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ, citraśīrṣakaśatadārukaśārikādayo mukhasandaṃśadaṃṣṭrāparditagudapurīṣaviṣāḥ, viṣahatāsthimatsyāsthiprabhṛtayo'sthiviṣāḥ, ‘śakunīmatsyādayaḥ’ iti pā.| śakulīmatsyādayaḥ pittaviṣāḥ, sūkṣmatuṇḍabhramarādayaḥ śūkaviṣāḥ, kīṭasarpadehā gatāsavaḥ śavaviṣāḥ| eṣāṃ ca suśrutasya kalpasthāne vistaro draṣṭavyaḥ||1||

pāriśeṣyādviṣaroganidānamucyate| viṣādajanakatvādviṣaṃ, tacca dvividham– sthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ ca| taddvaividhyamāha– sthāvaramityādi| mūlādyātmakamiti ādyaṃ prathamam, adanīyamādyamityanye| sthāvaraṃ mūlādisvarūpaṃ daśavidham| yaduktaṃ suśrute– “daśādhiṣṭhānamādyaṃ syāddvitīyaṃ ṣoḍaśāśrayam|” iti, “mūlaṃ patraṃ phalaṃ puṣpaṃ tvak kṣīraṃ sāra eva ca| niryāso dhātavaścaiva kandaśca daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ||” iti ca| tatra klītakāśvamārakaguñjāsugandhagargarakaraghāṭakavidyucchikhā'nantā-vijayānītyaṣṭau mūlaviṣāṇi, viṣapatrikālambāsuradārukarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca patraviṣāṇi, kumudvatīveṇukākarambhamahākarambhakarkoṭakareṇukakhadyotaka-carmarībhagandhāsarpaghāticandanakaṅkolasārapākāni dvādaśa phalaviṣāṇi, vetrakādambavallīkarambhamahākarambhāṇi pañca puṣpaviṣāṇi, antrapācakakartarīyaśaileyakarambhanandanakaraghāṭavarāṭakāni sapta tvaṅniryāsasāraviṣāṇi, kumudaghnīsnuhījālakṣīrīṇi trīṇi kṣīraviṣāṇi, ‘phenāśmabhasma’ iti pā.| phenāśma haritālaṃ ca dve dhātuviṣe, kālakūṭavatsanābhasarṣapakapālakardamavairāṭakamustakaśṛṅgīprapauṇḍarīka-mūlakahālāhalamahāviṣamarkaṭakānīti trayodaśa kandaviṣāṇi; evaṃ pañcāśatsthāvaraviṣāṇi bhavanti| eṣāṃ vyādhapulindādibhyo vyaktijñānaṃ kartavyam| paraṃ sarpādisambhavamiti paraṃ jaṅgamaṃ; tacca ṣoḍaśābhidhānam| ‘dṛṣṭiṃ niḥśvāsa ... ’ iti pā.| dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsadaṃṣṭrānakhamūtrapurīṣaśukralālāsparśamukhasandaṃśaviśardhita-gudāsthipittaśūkaśavabhedāt| parditaṃ viśardhitaṃ pāyukṛtaḥ kutsitaḥ śabdaḥ ‘śṛdhu śabdakutsāyām’ ityasya prayogāt| tatra dṛṣṭiniḥśvāsaviṣā divyāḥ sarpāḥ, bhaumāstu daṃṣṭrāviṣāḥ, mārjāraśvamakaravyāghrādayo daṃṣṭrānakhaviṣāḥ, picciṭakauṇḍinyādayo mūtrapurīṣaviṣāḥ, ‘sarpalādayo’ iti pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake nopalabhyate | sarpalādayo mūṣikāḥ śukraviṣāḥ| vṛścikavaraṭīmatsyocciṅgaṭādaya ārāviṣāḥ, lūtā lālāsparśaviṇmūtraśukrārtavamukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ, makṣikājalāyukādayo mukhasandaṃśaviṣāḥ, citraśīrṣakaśatadārukasārikādayo mukhasandaṃśadaṃṣṭrāviśardhitagudapurīṣaviṣāḥ, viṣahatāsthimatsyāsthiprabhṛtayo'sthiviṣāḥ, ‘śakunīmatsyādayaḥ’ iti pā.| śakulīmatsyādayaḥ pittaviṣāḥ, sūkṣmatuṇḍabhramarādayaḥ śūkaviṣāḥ, kīṭasarpadehā vyasavaḥ śavaviṣā iti| eṣāṃ ca suśrutasya kalpasthāne vistaro draṣṭavyaḥ||1||

div.ab: nidrāṃ tandrāṃ klamaṃ dāhamapākaṃ lomaharṣaṇam | śothaṃ ‘caivātīsāram’ iti pā. | caivātisāraṃ ca jaṅgamaṃ kurute viṣam ||2|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |3| ‘atra ca’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: tatra jaṅgamaviṣasya bahvadhiṣṭhānatvena prādhānyāt sarvavegānugataṃ sāmānyaliṅgamāha– nidrāmityādi| etat subodhyam||2||

div.ab: sthāvaraṃ ca jvaraṃ hikkāṃ ‘dantaharṣagalagraham’ iti pā. | dantaharṣaṃ galagraham | phenacchardyaruciśvāsaṃ mūrchāṃ ca kurute ‘viṣam’ iti pā. | bhṛśam ||3|| (ca. ci. a. 23) |4| ‘sthāvarasāmānyaliṅgamāha’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: sthāvarasya sāmānyaliṅgamāha– sthāvaraṃ cetyādi| phenacchardiriti phenasya chardiḥ||3||
tatra jaṅgamaviṣasya sāmānyena liṅgamāha– nidrāmityādi| phenacchardīti phenasya chardirityavagamyate||3||
